price_range: 20€ online, 25€ na mieste pre hlavné kategórie; 3€ online, 5€ na mieste pre deti
description: Zemplínsky extrém - Beh v múzeu je jesenný bežecký závod v areáli Zemplínskeho múzea v Michalovciach, ktorý sa koná 14. novembra 2026. Tento beh ponúka unikátny zážitok spojený s kultúrnym prostredím múzea a okolitou prírodou. Pretek je súčasťou série Zemplínsky extrém, ktorá zahŕňa viacero podujatí v regióne. Bežci môžu očakávať zaujímavú trať s atmosférou jesene a miestnej histórie.
course_highlights: Trať vedie areálom Zemplínskeho múzea v Michalovciach
Jesenné prostredie s kultúrnym nádychom
Súčasť série Zemplínsky extrém s viacerými podujatiami
additional: Podujatie sa koná 14. novembra 2026, súčasťou je viacero kategórií vrátane detských, a prebieha v areáli Zemplínskeho múzea v Michalovciach.

name: Beh na Minčol
description: Beh na Minčol je náročný horský beh do vrchu v krásnom prostredí Višňovskej doliny. Trasa vedie značeným turistickým chodníkom s prudkými stúpaniami až na vrchol Minčola vo výške 1363 m.n.m., kde sa bežci môžu tešiť na krásne výhľady na Krivánsku a Lúčanskú časť Malej Fatry. Pretek je určený pre odvážnych bežcov, ktorí si chcú vyskúšať svoje sily na náročnej trase s minimom priestoru na oddych. Po dobehu je zabezpečené občerstvenie a vyhodnotenie pretekárov s cenami pre najlepších v kategóriách.
course_highlights: Značený turistický chodník s modrou značkou
Prudké stúpania od začiatku až do konca trate
Cieľ na vrchole Minčola s výhľadmi na Krivánsku a Lúčanskú časť Malej Fatry
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov je od 8:30 do 9:30. Vyhodnotenie výsledkov je krátko po dobehu posledného pretekára, približne o 12:30. Na trati je občerstvenie približne na 2 km a v cieli, po dobehu sa podáva obed (domáca kapustnica a nápoj). Bežci môžu využiť drop bag, ktorý bude prevezený do zázemia pod zjazdovkou, kde sa budú odovzdávať ceny. Organizátori zabezpečujú odvoz vecí pretekárov do miesta vyhlásenia výsledkov. Po dobehu je zabezpečené občerstvenie a vyhodnotenie pretekárov s cenami pre najlepších v kategóriách.

name: Ferčekovská desiatka
location: Ferčekovce, Spišská Nová Ves, Ferčekovce, Spišská Nová Ves, Malé pole
description: Ferčekovská desiatka je bežecký pretek konaný v obci Ferčekovce pri Spišskej Novej Vsi, ktorý ponúka trate pre deti, dorast a dospelých. Preteky sa konajú na lesných cestách a trávnatých, zvlnených terénoch, čo vytvára príjemné a prírodné prostredie pre bežcov všetkých vekových kategórií. Organizátorom je Športový klub Ferčekovce v spolupráci s mestom Spišská Nová Ves. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť vrátane rodín a bežeckých nadšencov, ktorí si môžu vybrať z viacerých kategórií a vzdialeností.

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec is a traditional autumn trail race in the Plzeň area, offering scenic routes through nature with minimal asphalt. The race is intended both for fans of healthy outdoor exercise and for competitive athletes and elite trail runners. Choose from routes of 42 km with 700 m of elevation gain, 22.5 km, 7 km, and shorter children’s and youth routes, including a multigenerational relay. The race hub, start and finish are in the suburban district of Plzeň - Bílá hora. The organizers follow the motto “I don’t run on asphalt” and prepare a race focused on running in nature and enjoying beautiful views.
course_highlights: Scenic trails along both banks of the Berounka River valley
Forests around the Bolevec ponds
A climb to Krkavec with 700 m of elevation gain on the marathon route
additional: Three main routes are available (42 km, 22.5 km, 7 km), along with shorter children’s and youth routes, including a multigenerational relay. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup. The race hub is in the suburban district of Plzeň - Bílá hora. Terrain: trail, cross-country; the race takes place in November 2026; exact registration details are not provided.

name: BoBoBěh
description: BoBoběh is the final mountain race in the BoBoloppet trilogy, taking runners through the beautiful Jizera Mountains. The race offers a challenging 30 km course with climbs up Olivetská hora, a section across the Černá Nisa dam, and a tough ascent up Bílý Štolpich. A shorter 10 km course is available for less experienced runners, as well as a 1 km children’s MINI run. The race is open to all running and nature lovers, whether they are registered for the full trilogy or wish to take part in this race only.
course_highlights: 30 km mountain race over Vysoký hřeben and Kanál
Two climbs up Olivetská hora and a section across the Černá Nisa dam
The toughest climb in the Jizera Mountains — Bílý Štolpich
additional: The race does not have a mass start. The start area is open for two hours, during which runners choose their start time. The course is not marked, so the race involves some orienteering. There are three options: 30 km, 10 km (fit), and the 1 km children’s MINI run. The event is open to everyone and offers registration for different course options, with an emphasis on natural beauty and sporting experiences in a mountain setting.

name: Běh přes Černovírský les
description: The Run through Černovír Forest is a flat 10 km race held in Hlušovice near Olomouc. It is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners and attracts local runners who enjoy a course along cycle paths and paved roads. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers not only a sporting experience but also a chance to meet the local running community. The race is a welcome opportunity to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and spend time actively outdoors.
course_highlights: Flat course along cycle paths and paved roads
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners
Open to participants in various age categories
additional: 10 km race, part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners, flat terrain, participation by local distance runners

name: Běh Dlouhými záhony
description: Běh Dlouhými záhony is a challenging 6.8 km cross-country race with significant elevation changes, held in Úpice. The race is part of the Czech Cup in Hill Running and the Winter Running League for the King of the Jestřebí Mountains. The course challenges runners with hilly terrain and beautiful natural scenery in the Jestřebí Mountains. This race is suitable for experienced runners looking for a technically demanding mountain run.
course_highlights: Challenging cross-country race with significant elevation changes
Course length: 6.8 km
Part of the Czech Cup in Hill Running and the Winter Running League
additional: The race is part of the Winter Running League and the Czech Cup in Hill Running, with the best Czech hill runners ranked after the race.

name: Svatomartinský běh
location: Petřkovice u Starého Jičína, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The St. Martin’s Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Petřkovice near Starý Jičín in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race offers a sporting experience in beautiful countryside, with a course approximately 5.5 km long that is suitable for the general public. The event is organized at the Hotel Zámek Berchtold grounds, which provide facilities and comfort for participants and spectators alike. The race is ideal for runners who want to combine sport with a pleasant atmosphere and beautiful views of the surrounding area.
course_highlights: A 5.5 km course in a natural setting
Picturesque surroundings of Petřkovice near Starý Jičín
Start and finish at the Hotel Zámek Berchtold grounds
additional: Results from previous editions are available online. The route passes through natural surroundings and is mostly on forest and field surfaces. The Zámek Berchtold grounds offer facilities for participants, including parking and refreshments. The race takes place in November 2026; exact details about registration and the courses are not provided. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle.

name: Ludgeřovický kros

price_tiers.distance: běh 10 km, 4 km, Nordic walking 9 km, děti

description: Ludgeřovice Cross-Country Race is a traditional running event held in the natural surroundings of the village of Ludgeřovice, attracting runners of all ages every year. The main course is 10 km long and follows varied terrain, including forest roads, field paths and routes past local landmarks. In addition to the main race, there are shorter 4 km runs, a 9 km Nordic walking event and children’s races by age category. The event is part of the Prajzsko-Opavská Running League and is subtitled the Veterans’ Run, paying tribute to heroes from both past and present.
course_highlights: Main 10 km course with 140 m of elevation gain
Terrain includes forest roads, field paths and routes around local landmarks
Additional events: 4 km run, 9 km Nordic walking and children’s races of 100 m and 500 m
additional: A custom-designed metal finisher’s medal; a commemorative magnet for the first 200 participants to register in person; a copy of the book Ještě jeden maraton for the first 300 entrants; cash prizes for the main race winners; chip timing for children’s races too; awards presented down to fourth place in all races; the accompanying Ludgeřovice Veterans’ Day programme; personal race videos and photos; changing rooms, showers and convenient parking; children’s races with an awards ceremony and a raffle. Courses: 10 km, 9 km, 4 km and children’s races. Weather uncertain. Held in conjunction with Veterans’ Day.

name: Půlmaraton pátera Václava Kosmáka
description: The Páter Václav Kosmák Half Marathon is a road race running from Moravské Budějovice to Lukov and back. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves over the half-marathon distance in the picturesque Vysočina region. The race is suitable for anyone looking for a quality road race with a traditional atmosphere. The organizers welcome both experienced and beginner runners and look forward to your participation.
course_highlights: Road race from Moravské Budějovice to Lukov and back
Picturesque setting in the Vysočina region
Traditional half-marathon course
additional: The race is open to all age groups and is part of a running league. It offers a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to take part as a recreational runner.

description: Hubert’s Forest Trail is a running race for children and adults, held in the beautiful surroundings of the Hradec forests on the Forest “Finnish” Running Trail in Malšovice. The start and finish are located near the Forest Cemetery. The event offers children’s categories with shorter, untimed courses, as well as a main race for adults. Medals and small gifts are prepared for the first three finishers in each category. Results are published on the organiser’s website within 24 hours of the race.
course_highlights: Forest “Finnish” Running Trail in Malšovice
Start and finish 200 m from the Forest Cemetery
Beautiful woodland setting in the Hradec forests
additional: Registration is available online until 10.11.2026 or in person on race day. Children’s categories start from 10:20, with check-in for children from 09:30 to 10:15. The main adult race starts between 11:00 and 11:45. Medals and small gifts are prepared for the first three finishers in each category. Results are published on the organiser’s website within 24 hours. The children’s races start at 10:20 and the main race at 12:00. The entry fee includes timing, refreshments and a medal; the first three finishers in each category also receive a small gift. Public transport: bus line 9, Forest Cemetery stop; parking is available at the Forest Cemetery.

name: Dvouetapový kros Zaječov
location: Louka, Malá Víska, Zaječov, Czech Republic
description: Dvouetapový kros Zaječov is a two-day running race held at Louka, Malá Víska near Zaječov. The race offers two stages: a long 13.5 km route with 330 m of elevation gain and a short 6.7 km route with 190 m of elevation gain. Both follow courses originally designed for sled-dog races. The main challenge is the combined competition across both stages, covering a total of 20.2 km with 520 m of elevation gain. The race is open to everyone regardless of gender or age, with finishing times adjusted by age and gender coefficients. The long stage starts on Saturday at 9:00, and the short stage starts on Sunday at 8:30.
course_highlights: Long stage: 13.5 km with 330 m of elevation gain
Short stage: 6.7 km with 190 m of elevation gain
Routes run through meadows and along forest paths prepared for sled-dog races
additional: Registration is online only, and you must register separately for each stage. Race numbers can be collected from 7:00 on Saturday and on Sunday. The competition is open regardless of gender or age, with finishing times adjusted by age and gender coefficients. The first 5 runners are announced after each stage. For runners taking part in both stages, times are added together and the 10 runners with the fastest combined times are announced. Online registration is open until 11. 11. 2026. To enter the combined competition, you must register separately for each stage; the entry fee must be paid by 11. 11. 2026.

description: Kuchařovická Výzva is a running race held in Kuchařovice, offering courses for men, women, and children. The men’s course is 8.4 km with 114 m of elevation gain, the women’s course is 5.9 km with 71 m of elevation gain, and the children’s course is 150 m long. The race takes place in pleasant surroundings, mainly on forest paths and sections of asphalt, giving the course a rolling profile. The start and registration are in front of the multi-purpose facility in Kuchařovice, creating a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Rolling course profile with 114 m of elevation gain for men and 71 m for women
70% forest paths and 30% asphalt
Start and finish in front of the multi-purpose facility in Kuchařovice
additional: Registration for the main race takes place from 8:30 to 9:30 in front of the multi-purpose facility in Kuchařovice. Parking is available by Emrammus restaurant, by the kindergarten, and on Větrná Street. The start and facilities are at the multi-purpose facility (cultural center) in Kuchařovice. The listed children’s race distances are 100, 300, and 600 m. Parking is available by Emrammus restaurant, by the kindergarten, or on Větrná Street.

The event is for runners seeking a challenge in a natural setting and looking to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in beautiful surroundings. name: W rytmie biegu, w rytmie jeziora
Tanúhegyek Trail 7 / 21 / 42
description: The Tanúhegyek Trail is a trail-running race organized by the Terepfutó Műhely Sports Association in one of the most beautiful parts of the Balaton Uplands National Park, in Badacsonytomaj. Participants can choose from 7, 21, and 42 km distances, taking on 1, 3, or 5 witness hills, with wonderful views of Lake Balaton and the surrounding countryside. The start and finish are at Halászkert. The race also supports a charitable cause: participants can donate their timing chip deposit to the Üröm Animal Shelter. A dog race is also held over the shortest distance. Everyone is warmly welcome at the event on November 14, 2026.
course_highlights: Trail running in the Balaton Uplands National Park
Breathtaking views of Lake Balaton and the countryside in its autumn colors
Routes taking in 1, 3, or 5 witness hills
additional: Timing is electronic, using a chip. The chip deposit is 2,000 HUF, which is refundable or can be donated to charity. Unannounced checkpoints may be placed along the course. A dog race is also held over the shortest distance. The race does not close public roads, so traffic rules must be observed. Distances: 7 km, 21 km, 42 km; dog race over 7 km; charitable event supported through donations of timing chip deposits.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 11. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelný bežecký závod na vzdialenosť 2 míle (3,218 km), ktorý sa koná v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave. Organizuje ho Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team a je súčasťou série pretekov s bodovaním podľa kategórií mužov a žien. Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste pri volejbalovom ihrisku od 9:30, štart je o 10:00. Súťažia kategórie detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov, pričom pretekári môžu získať body aj za zlepšenie svojich časov v roku.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 2 míle (3,218 km)
Prezentácia a štart pri volejbalovom ihrisku v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda
Kategórie pre deti, juniorov, ženy, mužov a veteránov
additional: Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste pri volejbalovom ihrisku od 9:30. Súťaž o Putovný pohár Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu s bodovaním podľa koeficientov podľa roku narodenia. Pri rovnosti bodov rozhoduje najlepší čas a potom veľkosť topánky. Na konci roka sa zrušia 2 mesiace s najnižším počtom bodov (amnestia). Registrácia je možná priamo na mieste; podujatie sa koná v rôznych kolách počas roka, pričom každý beh má dĺžku približne 2 míle (3,218 km).

name: Beh na Husárik
location: Horské hoteli Husárik, Čadca, Žilina, Slovakia
description: Beh na Husárik je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný Klubom Kysuckého maratónu Čadca, Mestom Čadca a Horským hotelom Husárik. Tento pretek sa koná na počesť dňa študentstva a ponúka bežcom možnosť zmerať si sily v krásnom horskom prostredí. Štart je vždy o 11. hodine a pretek je známy svojou priateľskou atmosférou a pohárom primátora mesta Čadca ako ocenením pre víťazov. Beh na Husárik je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť, ktorá má záujem o šport a prírodu.
course_highlights: Horské prostredie okolo Horského hotela Husárik
Pretek na počesť dňa študentstva
Pohár primátora mesta Čadca pre víťazov
additional: Online registrácia je ukončená, prihlásiť sa je možné aj v deň preteku za zvýšené štartovné 8 EUR. Pretek sa koná 15. novembra 2026, štart o 11:00, možnosť online registrácie, trať je kopcovitá a trailová, organizované v Čadci v blízkosti Horského hotela Husárik.

It is a sporting and recreational event, with the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Kędzierzyn-Koźle as its partner. In partnership with the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre

name: Krosová 12°
description: Krosová 12° is a 12 km or 6 km running race on a hilly 6 km loop around Velešín in the South Bohemian Region. This cross-country race challenges runners with demanding, hilly terrain, making it ideal for those who enjoy trail running and hills. The race is suitable for the general public who want to try running off-road amid beautiful views and a natural atmosphere. Recommended running gear and accessories are presented on the official website.
course_highlights: Hilly 6 km loop with elevation gain
Choice of 12 km or 6 km course
Natural terrain with views around Velešín
additional: The race offers two course distances: 12 km and 6 km, both on a hilly loop. The website recommends running gear and accessories such as Ultra Trail socks, Altra and Puma running shoes, and lightweight jackets suitable for changeable weather. The race is suitable for runners of all levels, offering an attractive hilly course and a choice of two distances.

name: Běh 17. listopadu
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The 17 November Run is a traditional running race in Ostrava-Hrabová commemorating an important day in Czech history. It offers two main distances: the certified 10 km Freedom Ten and the 5 km Revolution Five. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and support the idea of freedom. Check-in and registration take place at ZŠ Paskovská, with the races starting in the morning. The routes pass through the scenic surroundings of Ostrava-Hrabová, which is easy to reach by public transport and shared Nextbike bicycles.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km Freedom Ten course
5 km Revolution Five
Routes through Ostrava-Hrabová, with good public transport connections
additional: On-site check-in and registration take place at ZŠ Paskovská 110/46 from 8:30 to 9:40. The individual races start in the morning. Public transport is available on lines 27, 39, 41 and 77, with a stop at Šídlovec. Shared Nextbike bicycles are also available. The race includes several course distances, online registration is available, and the event has a long tradition, with results from previous editions.

name: Sametový běh
location: Odolena Voda, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 150,- pro závodníky starší 18 let při registraci on-line do 30. 9., platba převodem

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 200,- pro závodníky starší 18 let při registraci on-line do 11. 11., platba převodem

tiers.label: tier_3

description: The Velvet Run is a traditional running event held in Odolena Voda, offering races for all age groups, including a family run for parents and children. The event takes place at the football field and includes distances of 300 m, 600 m, 5 km and 10 km. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere, a handmade gingerbread medal and light refreshments after the race, including tea and mulled wine. The organizers ensure the course is safe and also prepare a raffle with a variety of prizes. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:17.
course_highlights: Distances of 300 m, 600 m, 5 km and 10 km
Start and finish at the football field in Odolena Voda
Handmade gingerbread medals for participants
additional: Race-day registration opens at 08:45 at the event venue. Light refreshments are available after the race, including tea, mulled wine and homemade buns. Runners receive a race bib with a timing chip and safety pins. Parking is available by Penny Market. The organizers provide course and event safety. Categories are divided by age and gender, including the Fighters, Champions and Legends categories. The course surface includes the football field; the event features a raffle, refreshments and fun activities for families. Registration is available on site.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Přerov
description: The November 17 Run in Přerov is a traditional athletics event organized by Atletika SK Přerov. The race offers runners of all ages and abilities the opportunity to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and test themselves on an interesting course. It takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the city of Přerov and is part of the local athletics calendar. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: A 9 km cross-country race, with children’s categories also available
Part of the Grand Prix of Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region
Online registration and results available
additional: The race is part of the local running calendar, offers various courses including cross-country, and attracts a wide range of participants from the region.

name: Běh kolem koupaliště
description: The Run Around the Swimming Pool is a traditional running race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletics Club Kopřivnice. The race takes place on a 5,000-meter course that runs around the local swimming pool. The start is at 11:00, and participants can compete in several age categories. Race facilities include registration at the sports hall, changing rooms and showers. After the race, the results are announced and prizes are awarded. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 5,000-meter course (4 laps)
The route runs around the swimming pool in Kopřivnice
Start and registration at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall
additional: Registration from 9:45 at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall. Categories are divided by age and gender. Changing rooms and showers are available. The results will be announced at 12:30 in the sports hall buffet, with prizes awarded. Registration takes place at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall. The race is open to men and women; participants run 4 laps. Roots and stones are marked for safety. Refreshments are available at the finish, and there is a raffle. The ceremonial start is signaled by a pistol shot fired by the mayor.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Kadaň
location: Rooseveltovy sady, Kadaň, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The November 17 Run in Kadaň is a traditional running race organized by the SK Městská policie Kadaň sports club. The race takes place in Rooseveltovy sady and offers an opportunity for runners of all ages. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and support for the local running community. The race information and further details are available to download in PDF format on the official website.
course_highlights: The race runs through Rooseveltovy sady in Kadaň
A course suitable for different age groups
A friendly atmosphere and support for the local running community
additional: The race information is available to download in PDF format. Results and photo galleries from previous editions are published on the website. The organizer is SK Městská policie Kadaň, a sports club with Bc. Jiří Vlasák as its contact. The event includes starts at various distances (e.g. 100 m, 280 m, 550 m, 1300 m, 1800 m, 2500 m, 5000 m). Registration is available on the website, and the event is suitable for all age groups. The venue is in Rooseveltovy sady in Kadaň, behind the sports hall.

name: Běh městem Hradec Králové
location: V Lipkách, Hradec Králové, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Běh městem Hradec Králové is a traditional road race held in the city centre on a flat course. The race offers a 9.7 km route consisting of five laps. A shorter 200-metre lap is prepared for children and young athletes. The event is suitable for the general public and is organised by TJ Liga 100 Hradec Králové with the support of the Czech Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: 5 laps on a flat course in the city centre
200-metre children’s lap
9.7 km road race
additional: The first category starts at 10:00, and the main category starts at 12:00. The race takes place in the V Lipkách residential area, near ZŠ Josefa Gočára in Hradec Králové. The organiser is TJ Liga 100 Hradec Králové z.s.; the contact person is Jiří Brych. Starts are scheduled for 10:00 and 12:00. Registration is available through the sport-reg.cz sports portal.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Polička
location: Lesopark Liboháj, Polička, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč hlavní závod, dobrovolné startovné lidový běh
description: The November 17 Run in Polička is a traditional cross-country race held in Liboháj Forest Park. The main race is 6 km, split into two 3-kilometre loops, and is complemented by a 3 km fun run. The race is part of the ISCAREX running cup and also offers an additional uphill race on the Polička ski slope for the brave. The start is at the ski slope at 11:00, with registration from 10:00 to 10:45. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in Liboháj Forest Park, with paths and trails
Main race: 6 km (2 × 3 km loops); fun run: 3 km (1 loop)
Additional uphill race on the Polička ski slope
additional: Runner registration is from 10:00 to 10:45. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The additional uphill race on the ski slope is for brave runners. The weather is usually autumnal, and the course may be slippery or icy after overnight rain. The course follows paths and trails in the forest park; a special challenge is the uphill race on the ski slope. Part of the ISCAREX Cup 2025

name: Běh o pohár Jehnic
location: Základní škola Jehnice, Brno, Czech Republic
organizer: VSK Univerzita Brno – oddíl atletiky, Atletika UNI CZ s.r.o., ZŠ v Jehnicích, Fakulta sportovních studií MU a ÚMČ Brno-Jehnice
description: The Jehnice Cup Run is part of the 27th edition of the Brno Running Cup, which comprises eleven races in the Brno area. The race takes place at the Jehnice Primary School and offers courses for various age groups, from the youngest runners to adults. The event is open to the general public and is supported by the Statutory City of Brno. Runners can expect a friendly atmosphere, good organization, and the opportunity to score points in the series.
course_highlights: Courses for the youngest runners, children, youth, and adults, with distances of 1, 1.5, 5, and 10 km
Start and registration at Jehnice Primary School
Drinking water is provided; BBP reusable cups are available to borrow
additional: Registration closes 15 minutes before the start of each category. The race is open to the public without restrictions. Youth and junior runners may enter the 10 km race and score points in the older category. Drinking water is provided only for runners using their own cups, or they can borrow a BBP reusable cup for a 20 Kč deposit. The race takes place at Jehnice Primary School and is part of the Brno Running Cup. A championship for students and teachers of Brno’s universities is also listed.

name: Podzimní cross – Běh 17. listopadu
location: Fotbalové hřiště, Bořice, Pardubice District, Czech Republic
organizer: Běžecký oddíl Vejvanovice – TJ Sokol Bořice
description: The Autumn Cross-Country – 17 November Run is a traditional trail race through the Dvakačovice-Podborský Forest near Bořice. The race offers two options: a short 5 km race (1 lap) and a long 10 km race (2 laps), with 110 metres of elevation gain per lap. The course follows forest roads and trails, making for an enjoyable cross-country experience. The event also includes children’s races, and traditional refreshments and prizes for the winners are provided at the finish. It is organized by Běžecký oddíl Vejvanovice - TJ Sokol Bořice.
course_highlights: The course follows forest roads and trails
110 m of elevation gain per lap
Each lap is 5 km; the short race is 1 lap and the long race is 2 laps
additional: The event includes children’s races. Traditional refreshments and prizes for the winners are provided at the finish. The start and finish are at the football pitch in Podboři - Bořice. According to the organizers, registration opens at 9:00 and the race program starts at 10:00.

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, ZŠ Pavla Horova Michalovce
description: Beh oslobodenia mesta Michalovce je tradičný večerný bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná v centre mesta Michalovce. Pretekári bežia mestskými ulicami s dĺžkou trate približne 5,8 km, ktorá je tvorená viacerými okruhmi. Po dobehnutí na cieľ ich čaká občerstvenie a účastnícka medaila. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru s možnosťou osobnej prezentácie v deň preteku.
course_highlights: Večerný beh centrom mesta Michalovce
Trať dlhá 5,8 km, tvorená okruhmi po 1 450 m
Občerstvenie a účastnícka medaila po dobehnutí
additional: Prezentácia prebieha vo vestibule Mestského úradu od 16:30 do 17:45, odporúčajú sa čelové LED lampy kvôli bezpečnosti. Po dobehnutí sa štartové číslo vracia a pretekári dostanú medailu. Vyhlásenie výsledkov je o 19:30 v telocvični 8. ZŠ P. Horova. Trať je skrátená na 5,8 km, beží sa na asfaltových a kamenných povrchoch, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste, štartovné pri registrácii je 20 €, znížené pri online registrácii do 19.11.2025

name: Lesný beh priateľov Šemše
price_range: 12-18 € v závislosti od dĺžky trate a spôsobu registrácie
description: Lesný beh priateľov Šemše je bežecké podujatie v obci Šemša v okrese Košice okolie, ktoré ponúka tri trate rôznej dĺžky: 22 km, 11 km a 5,5 km. Trať vedie po spevnených lesných cestách, cestičkách, poľných cestách a asfalte, čo vytvára príjemné a rozmanité bežecké prostredie. Preteky sú otvorené pre všetky vekové kategórie bez rozdelenia na vekové skupiny a organizuje ich občianske združenie Šemša v pohybe. Štart je rozdelený na dve vlny, pričom dlhšia trať začína o 10:00 a kratšie trate o 11:00 hodine. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov, ktorí hľadajú lesný beh s rôznou náročnosťou a dĺžkou trasy.
course_highlights: Trať vedie po spevnených lesných cestách a cestičkách
Zahrnuté sú poľné cesty a asfaltové úseky
Tri dĺžky tratí: 22 km, 11 km a 5,5 km
additional: Štart je rozdelený na dve vlny: o 10:00 štartuje 22 km trať, o 11:00 štartujú trate 5,5 km a 11 km. Kategórie sú bez vekových obmedzení, určené pre deti, mužov a ženy. Organizátorom je občianske združenie Šemša v pohybe. Povrch trate je rôznorodý, zahŕňa lesné cesty, poľné cesty a asfalt. Preteky sa konajú na teréne s lesnými cestami, poľnými cestami a asfaltom. Registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste. Súčasťou sú kategórie pre deti, mužov a ženy, s možnosťou výberu medzi krátkymi a dlhými traťami.

organizer: Klub orientačného behu Kysak, Obec Kysak

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Beh na Kysacký hrad je bežecké podujatie organizované Klubom orientačného behu Kysak a obcou Kysak, ktoré sa koná pri Kultúrnom Dome v Kysaku. Trať vedie prevažne lesnými cestami (85 %) s menším podielom asfaltu (15 %). Pretek je určený pre rôzne vekové kategórie od dorastencov až po veteránov, s rozdelením podľa veku a pohlavia. Štartovné je rozdelené podľa kategórií a platí sa pri registrácii a platbe prevodom do určitého termínu. Podujatie ponúka príjemnú atmosféru a možnosť súťažiť v krásnom prírodnom prostredí.
course_highlights: 85 % lesné cesty, 15 % asfalt
Štart pri Kultúrnom Dome v Kysaku
Viacero vekových kategórií od dorastencov po veteránov
additional: Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia: dorastenci, juniori, muži a ženy v rôznych vekových skupinách. Miesto štartu je pri Kultúrnom Dome v Kysaku. Pretek je organizovaný v prostredí historického Kysackého hradu s možnosťou registrácie cez online formulár a platbou bankovým prevodom do 18.11.2024. Súčasťou sú kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny a pohlavia.

name: GoBala Pól&Maratón
location: Komjatice, Nové Zámky District, Nitra Region, Slovakia

name: Kružská Kundratická - Memoriál Honzy Šíra
description: Kružská Kundratická - Honza Šír Memorial is a hilly road race in Kruh, Liberec Region. Men run a 12 km course with a turnaround in Kundratice, while women run 5 km, turning around earlier. The race is named in memory of Honza Šír and is suited to runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain. Contact details for the organizers are available for more information. The race is part of the running community and offers an opportunity to test yourself on a demanding course.
course_highlights: Hilly road course
12 km course for men with a turnaround in Kundratice
5 km course for women with an earlier turnaround
additional: For information about the race, contact Jiří Sedláček (606280856) or Jan Šír (732851697). Race information is also available by calling Jiří Sedláček (606280856) or Jan Šír (732851697).

name: Přáslavická desítka
location: Přáslavice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Přáslavice Ten is a traditional running race organised by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the village of Přáslavice near Olomouc. The race offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners to enjoy a course in the picturesque surroundings of Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the regional running community. The Přáslavice Ten is part of the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje race series and attracts runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque countryside around Přáslavice near Olomouc
Mostly asphalt and forest terrain
Part of the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje
additional: The race takes place on 21 April 2026 and is part of a series of local runs. The course is mostly on asphalt roads.

name: Běh na Čáp
location: Teplice nad Metují, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Běh na Čáp is a public hill running race with a mass start, held in Teplice nad Metují. This traditional race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and offers a sporting experience in beautiful natural surroundings. It is suitable for the general public and gives participants the chance to test themselves on challenging terrain. It is organized by Redpoint Teplice nad Metují, which ensures high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Hill race with a mass start
Challenging terrain around Teplice nad Metují
Part of the Běžecké vršky series, with a long tradition and history
additional: A hill running race with categories. Registration is available for an entry fee of 50 Kč. The race takes place on terrain with a challenging elevation gain. Results are published regularly, and the race has a long tradition.

name: Forestovo Nočník
location: Záluží u Plzně, Plzeň-sever, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Forestovo Nočník is a nighttime trail race in Záluží near Plzeň, offering a 5 km course full of fun and challenges. The race takes place in the dark, so a headlamp is mandatory, and the course is marked with reflective elements to ensure safety and create a unique atmosphere. Tea and refreshments are provided for participants after the finish. This race is ideal for fans of night running and trail challenges who want to experience running in an unusual setting with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 5 km nighttime trail course
Course marked with reflective elements
Headlamp mandatory for safe running
additional: Tea and refreshments are provided for runners at the finish. The race is characterized by 100% darkness and 100% fun. The organizers are Jiří Cipra and team. The course is 5 km long, a headlamp is mandatory, the course is marked with reflective elements, refreshments are available at the finish, and the race is intended for various age groups.

name: Slánské běhy
description: Slánské běhy is a traditional orienteering race organized by the Slaný Orienteering Sports Club. The race takes place around the town of Slaný and offers various categories, including a 12 km main category and children’s categories. The race is suitable for the general public and attracts runners of all ages. The organizers provide facilities and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: 12 km main category around Slaný
Children’s and youth categories with shorter courses
Facilities provided at Gymnázium V.B.T. Slaný
additional: The race is traditionally held in November; the most recent edition took place on 29 November 2025. The organizers thank all participants and look forward to the next edition. In the past, around 70 runners took part in the main category, along with several dozen children and young people. The main race is 12 km. Registration takes place at Gymnázium V.B.T. Slaný, and the races are held on Saturday, 21 November 2026, at 10:00.

name: Čertovskej wintertrail
location: Hamr na Jezeře, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné stejné pro obě trasy: 1 111 Kč

description: Čertovskej wintertrail is a trail race through the hills, forests and rocky terrain around Hamr na Jezeře. The race offers two distances, 33.3 km and 16.6 km, and runners can switch between them free of charge. Participants can expect challenging winter conditions, several aid stations and an unforgettable experience on the “hellish” course. Both distances start together at 10:00, and the time limit is 7 hours. The entry fee includes timing, gifts and refreshments on the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: Trail running through hills, forests and rocky terrain
Two distances: 33.3 km and 16.6 km, with the option to switch free of charge
3 aid stations on the long course and 1 on the short course, plus refreshments at the finish
additional: The maximum number of participants is 400. The time limit is 7 hours, with cut-off times at the aid stations at km 15 (3 hours) and km 25 (5 hours). Runners must bring their own drinking cup; a Čertovskej running cup is available to buy at race registration. The entry fee includes pre-race refreshments (coffee, homemade cake), gifts in the race pack (sports socks), chip timing and split times, and food and drinks at the finish (soup, main course, beer, soft drink, mulled wine, tea). Marked course, aid stations, bring your own drinking cup, accommodation nearby, registration on Friday and Saturday before the race.

name: Vranov Trail
location: Vranov, Brno-Country District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Vranov Trail is a series of running races organized by friends who run ultratrails and create high-quality events with carefully planned courses, good food, and a relaxed atmosphere. The races take place around Brno and Vranov, often in forests and on trails with carefully marked routes. Each race has its own special feature, such as a winter night run or a spring half marathon symbolizing the balance between day and night. After each race, there is an afterparty with hot food and drinks, adding to the friendly atmosphere of the event.
course_highlights: Courses follow forest paths and trails around Brno and Vranov
Routes are clearly marked with red-and-white and yellow tape and reflective spray
A winter night trail with a heated tent and hot drinks
additional: Race facilities are often set up outdoors at the Stará Prádelna or Samovýčep venues. There are plenty of refreshments on the course, including water and sports drinks, and hot food after the finish. After the race, there is an afterparty with hot food and drinks, including mulled wine. Bus travel is recommended, with stops nearby. Parking is limited, and participants should follow the organizers’ instructions. Race bibs are collected at designated times before the start.

name: GP vytrvalců Kamenného Újezda
location: Kamenný Újezd, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

name: Lysacup – Visalaje, parkoviště
location: Parkoviště ve Visalajích, Visalaje, Staré Hamry, Czech Republic
description: Lysacup is a winter stage running series in the Beskydy Mountains, held mostly on Lysá hora. Each weekend, a stage starts from a different location, and both individuals and teams compete. The start is usually at 10:00, and participants use chips activated for the entire season with a voluntary contribution. The race offers the atmosphere of a traditional mountain run, with the option to take part as a walker too. The overall winner receives a perpetual trophy, and the race is supported by a number of partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: Winter stage race on mountainous terrain in the Beskydy Mountains
Each stage starts from a different location, usually on Lysá hora (1323 m above sea level)
Mountain-running atmosphere with scoring for individuals and teams
additional: The start is usually at 10:00. Participants must have a chip activated for the entire season, which is obtained by sending a voluntary contribution. Chips can also be bought from other competitors or the organizers. If there are many competitors, the organizers reserve the right to adjust the scoring. The two worst stages are discarded from the overall standings, one from each half of the series. It is also possible to take part as a walker, with an assigned number of points. The overall winner and the best teams receive perpetual trophies. The organizers provide refreshments and prizes from sponsors.

name: II Mazowiecki Bieg Jesieni
description: The 2nd Mazovian Autumn Run is an annual race held in Staroźreby, taking place on November 21, 2026. Participants can compete in the 10 km race, and a 400-meter race is prepared for the youngest runners. The event is open to everyone, offering attractive prizes, medals, and the opportunity to take part in both the main race and children’s races. The race takes place in urban and park areas, providing a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 10 km route on asphalt and through park areas
400-meter race for children
Medals and prizes for participants
additional: Online and on-site registration; the event also includes a program for children and adults, with the schedule and details available on the organizer’s website.

name: X Koszęcińska Dycha
description: The anniversary 10th Koszęcińska Dycha is a special race held in Koszęcin that attracts runners from various places. Its anniversary edition highlights the event’s special significance and atmosphere. The race follows a 10 km course, giving participants the chance to test their fitness in scenic surroundings. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain, providing an attractive and varied course
Anniversary edition, highlighting the event’s long-standing tradition
Local sporting event that brings together the Koszęcin municipality community
additional: The event is held as a race over a distance of approximately 10 km, with strong involvement from the local community and broad participation.

name: XLVII MnO Pierwszy Śnieg
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Rozwoju Orienteeringu, GKT Cyrkino Gliwice, Czartak Katowice, AKInO Kraków, RO PTTK Częstochowa, PlesInO Pszczyna, be-lość Piekary Śląskie, Krokus Miliardowice
description: The Silesian Voivodeship Orienteering Walks Cup is a series of events organized by tourism clubs and groups across Silesia. Competitions take place in different rounds throughout the year, with participants competing in six age categories and a team classification. The “First Snow” round is the tenth edition of the cup in the 2026 season and will take place on November 21 in Katowice. The event combines sporting competition with spending active time outdoors and navigating the terrain.
course_highlights: Orienteering walks across the Silesian Voivodeship
Competition in six age categories
Team classification and cups for the top participants
additional: The event includes different age categories, is part of an orienteering event series, and takes place in forested and urban areas in Katowice.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

The race takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times. The event promotes an active lifestyle and education about appropriate conduct in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both recreational runners and members of sports clubs.

The route can be completed up to 4 times

Running and Nordic walking events; 3-hour time limit; annual packages available.

description: 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (12) – November is a regular running race in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The race is part of the 16th edition of the Vaší Liga running series, where runners can compare their performances with others and track their progress throughout the year. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to achieve the qualifying standard for the Czech Championships. After the race, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, refreshments, and the chance to share your experiences at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex.
course_highlights: A pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district
Course measured by a certified measurer; suitable for achieving the Czech Championships qualifying standard over 10 km
Relaxed running atmosphere with refreshments after the race
additional: The 10 km race starts at 14:00 and the 5 km race at 14:05. Check-in is open from 13:00 in the blue tent by the cycle path near U Kempinku 2, Prague. After the race, an isotonic drink is available, as well as refreshments at the Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available in the organizers’ tent. The race is timed using chip timing, and each runner also receives a chip time. The race takes place in November 2026; registration is probably through the official website. The series includes multiple races throughout the year.

The event offers 5 km and 10 km routes on flat loops with crossings over small bridges and cycle paths. It also includes a 1.5 km family run in costume, a children’s programme, and St. Nicholas and devil-themed festivities. Runners receive a race pack with gifts and a commemorative medal at the finish. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant Advent atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route follows a wide grassy path along the Dřevnice River
Crossings over a concrete bridge and an iron footbridge
Flat loops around the football pitch in Zlín-Louky
additional: A 1.5 km family run in costume, with gingerbread as a finish-line reward. A children’s programme and St. Nicholas and devil-themed festivities in costume. The race pack contains gifts from partners and a commemorative medal. A charity raffle for Krtek, with prizes sold and awarded during the event. 5 km and 10 km races, family and children’s runs, a charity event, start and finish by the football pitch in Zlín-Louky, a varied accompanying programme, and a race pack.

Start on Lovošská Street in Lovosice
Challenging climb to the summit of Lovoš

description: Strzeliński Rogaining is a walking orienteering event in which teams of 2–5 plan their own route to visit as many checkpoints as possible within a set time. The checkpoints are spread across the terrain and marked on a map. The event is open to participants of different ages and experience levels, from enthusiasts and recreational participants to families. Rogaining combines tourism and sport, and participants can modify their route at any time during the competition, making it an appealing way to enjoy the outdoors. The event is organised by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin District Branch, which has been holding orienteering competitions in the region for many years.

Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake.

course_highlights: Trails on the Ještěd Ridge with beautiful views
Challenging mountain terrain with courses of varying distances (22 km, 13 km, 6 km)
Extensive accompanying program, including healthy and varied refreshments
additional: Participants receive a specially stocked race bag. Healthy and varied refreshments are available, including meat, vegetarian, and vegan options, as well as quality coffee. The event also features a TV studio with interviews and competitions, and an expanded partner zone with equipment and accessories for runners. Original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary is available. Races on different courses, a series of summer and winter races, registration, results, and rules are available on the official website.

name: Čertovská 5
description: Čertovská 5 is a traditional winter run in Unhošť over a distance of 5.7 km. It offers not only a sporting experience, but also a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Runners are welcome to wear devil costumes, adding a unique atmosphere to the race. The race is divided into categories by age and gender, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place at the Sokol hall and is popular with locals and visitors alike.
course_highlights: Traditional 5.7 km winter run
Runners in devil costumes are welcome
Sokol Cup results announced after the race
additional: The race takes place on 6 December 2025 from 08:00 to 11:00 in Unhošť, at the Sokol hall, Melicharova Street. Categories are divided by age and gender (men and women in different age groups). After the race, there is a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Terrain: winter course. Registration via naZávody.cz. The event is suitable for all age groups and fans of dressing up.

name: Běh do vrchu Ráztoka-Pustevny
description: The Ráztoka–Pustevny Uphill Run is a traditional mountain race held in Ráztoky and around Pustevny. It offers a challenging course with elevation gain that tests runners’ endurance and strength in the beautiful setting of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids. The event is popular with athletes of all levels and has a rich history dating back to 1969. It welcomes everyone who enjoys mountain running and wants to experience the race’s unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Climb to Pustevny with 400 m of elevation gain
Course length of approximately 5.7 km
Mountain setting in the Moravian-Silesian Beskids
additional: The race is also suitable for children. Weather may affect conditions. Registration details are not provided. The event has a long tradition and is very popular.

name: Jested Series
description: Ještěd Skyrace is a technical trail-running race on the Ještěd Ridge, featuring challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 metres of elevation gain. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and professionals and includes several route options, including races for children. The event is part of a race series with a friendly atmosphere and a generous participant race pack.
course_highlights: Technical trail sections on the Ještěd Ridge
Challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 m of elevation gain
Route options from 6 km to 22 km, including children’s races
additional: Mandatory equipment is required. Race bibs and timing chips are provided. On-site registration is available, along with bag storage, changing rooms and toilets. Refreshments and an awards ceremony are provided after the finish. The race is livestreamed, and results are available online. The race also offers canicross options and children’s races on shorter routes. The series also includes children’s races. The listed Winter SkyRace distances are 22, 12 and 6 km; the date 5 December 2026 is not confirmed in the available information.

name: Last Man Standing Run VYSOČINA
description: Last Man Standing Run Vysočina is a unique endurance race held on December 5, 2026, at Želiv Monastery. Competitors repeatedly complete a 6.7 km loop, starting every hour, with the aim of lasting as long as possible and lining up for another start on the hour. The inaugural edition is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops, with the winner being the person who completes all 24 loops. The race is not about speed, but about endurance and the ability to overcome physical and mental challenges in the winter conditions of Vysočina.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km loop through the hilly terrain of Vysočina
A new start every hour, up to a maximum of 24 loops / 24 hours
The official time is set by the tolling of the church bell at Želiv Monastery
additional: The race is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops. Every competitor must wear their race bib throughout the event and keep a timing chip on their ankle. Headphones are prohibited on the course for safety reasons. Registration is processed manually; payment details are sent by email after the application has been processed. A T-shirt can be ordered as an add-on for 490 Kč. The official race time is set by the tolling of the church bell, which also symbolically closes the finish gate on the hour. The entry fee includes participation, light refreshments and facilities. Mandatory equipment includes a red rear light, a reflective item, neck protection and a personal drinking container. Part of the route may run along roads open to regular traffic.

name: Veleslavín běží
location: Přerost a Švorc, Veleslavín, Prague 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Veleslavín běží is a 7.2 km run through the Veleslavínka Valley, past Libocký Pond in Prague 6. It takes place on December 5, 2026, at the Přerost a Švorc grounds. The race is part of the Běhej s námi 2026 series and offers events for children and adults. Children’s races of 100 m to 1,500 m, depending on age, take place in the morning, followed by the main adults’ race in the afternoon. The field is limited to 200 runners, and the race bib is also valid for other races in the series. The route runs mainly along park and field paths, with one more pronounced climb beyond the pond.
course_highlights: The 7.2 km route runs through the Veleslavínka Valley, past Libocký Pond
Mostly park and field paths with gravel and dirt, plus short sections of asphalt
One more pronounced climb of about 25 m of elevation gain beyond the pond
additional: The race bib with timing chip is also valid for other races in the Běhej s námi 2026 series. The field is limited to 200 runners. Check-in and bib pickup close 30 minutes before the start. Parking is included in the entry fee. Running with a dog is not permitted. There is no time limit. The adults’ race starts at 13:00, and the children’s races begin at 11:00. Online entry costs 200 Kč for adults; children can enter free of charge. Entry on the day costs 300 Kč for adults and 100 Kč for children. Check-in closes no later than 30 minutes before the start. Adults must be at least 15 years old to compete; running with a dog is not permitted.

name: Běh na 2 míle, Zlín – Příluky
location: Madal Bal, Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and covers just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake. Categories are divided by age and gender, with times recorded and prizes awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit covering just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children’s course is 800 metres long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are Men (ages 13–127), Women (ages 13–127), Boys (up to 12 years) and Girls (up to 12 years); age categories remain the same throughout the calendar year. Recommended ways to get there are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The top three finishers in the men’s, women’s and children’s categories receive small prizes. The men’s course record is 9:31.8. Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal building from 8:15 to 8:55, and the main race starts at 9:00. Times are recorded for all participants, and the top three in the women’s, men’s and children’s categories receive small prizes. Runners can look forward to a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish.

name: Adventní běh Žatec
location: Náměstí Svobody, Žatec, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Advent Run in Žatec is a traditional pre-Christmas running race held through the city’s historic centre, starting at Svobody Square. The race offers various categories for men, women, youth and children, with distances ranging from 330 metres to 6.6 km. Every participant receives a medal and mulled wine at the finish, adding to the pleasant Advent atmosphere. Registration opens at 14:00, and the main races start from 15:55. The event is organised by the Hopman Triathlon team, which puts on events for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: A 2,200 m loop through the historic centre of Žatec
Men run 3 loops (6,600 m); women and youth runners run 2 loops (4,400 m)
Children’s and school-age races: 330 m and 1,000 m
additional: Registration opens at 14:00, the first children’s races start from 15:15, and the main adult categories start from 15:55. Every participant receives a medal and mulled wine at the finish. Registration opens at 14:00, the children’s races start from 15:15, and the main categories start from 15:55. Every participant receives a medal and mulled wine at the finish.

name: Adventní běh pro zdraví
location: Městský úřad Hodonín, Hodonín, Czech Republic
description: The Advent Run for Health is a traditional running event organized by Běžecký klub Hodonín, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the community. The race takes place in the center of Hodonín, by the Municipal Office, and offers an opportunity for runners of all ages and ability levels. The club has a long history of organizing running competitions and supports the development of distance running in the region. The event is part of a wider running calendar and is popular with locals and visitors alike.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the Municipal Office in Hodonín
The route runs through an urban setting on a pleasant surface
Friendly atmosphere and support for a healthy lifestyle
additional: The organizer is Běžecký klub Hodonín, which has a long-standing tradition. The club also organizes other running events in the region. Contact details for the club's chairman, Pavel Bíl, are listed on the website. Results from previous editions and information about other races in the Grand Prix of Distance Runners of Hodonín District are available on the website. In the 2025 edition, the first category started at 10:30; results are published on the Běžecký klub Hodonín website.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing together runners of all abilities. The event takes place in Mysłowice and is open to all age groups and running levels. Participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to compete throughout the Grand Prix series. Registration is available only at the Race Office on race day, and participation is free.
course_highlights: 10 km race in the scenic surroundings of Mysłowice
A series of seasonal events promoting a healthy lifestyle
A running community and opportunities to connect with the local community
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation in the Grand Prix races is free. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or ability. It focuses on promoting physical activity, health, and the running community, with varied courses and seasonal editions.

name: ADVENTI JÓTÉKONY FUTÁS
description: The Advent Charity Run is a welcoming, family-friendly running event in Bölcske, where participants can test their abilities over 3 or 6 kilometers. Part of the entry fee goes to charity, making the event not only a sporting activity but also a chance to help others. It is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners looking to enjoy a pleasant winter running event.
course_highlights: Choose between 3 km and 6 km
A family-friendly running event supporting charity
Set in the natural surroundings of Bölcske
additional: HUF 500 from each entry fee goes to charity. Runners can choose whether to take part in the 3 km or 6 km event. Family registration is also available for the 2 km distance, for up to 4 participants. The event supports charitable causes, payment of the entry fee is mandatory, and participation is open to all ages. The run takes place at 1435/6 Csorda út, Bölcske.

name: ADVENTI KOCOGÓ
description: The Advent Jog is a charity running event held at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre in Kecskemét. The aim is to raise donations for the NM Foundation for the Recovery of Muscles, supporting children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, including Marci Nemes. The event offers participants a sense of community and an active experience while serving a worthy cause. The organizers thank all the runners and volunteers who contributed to its success.
course_highlights: The run takes place at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre
A charity event supporting children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy
A community-focused sporting experience for families and runners
additional: Volunteers also help behind the scenes at the event. The run is organized for charity, supporting the local foundation and children with the condition. It is part of the Advent season; the run supports the recovery of sick children and is traditionally held every year to bring the community together.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 12. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelný bežecký závod na 2 míle (3,218 km) organizovaný Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team v areálu kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave. Závod je určený pre širokú škálu kategórií vrátane detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov. Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste od 9:30 a štart je o 10:00. Súťaž je súčasťou série, kde bežci zbierajú body do Putovného pohára Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu, pričom výsledné časy sa prepočítavajú podľa koeficientov podľa roku narodenia.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 2 míle (3,218 km), deti cca 200 m
Miesto konania: Areál kúpaliska Kuchajda, Bratislava
Prezentácia pri volejbalovom ihrisku
additional: Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste pri volejbalovom ihrisku od 9:30. Kategórie sú deti (13 rokov a mladší), juniori, ženy, muži, veteránky a veteráni. Súťažiaci sú bodovaní podľa počtu účastníkov v kategóriách, juniori a juniorky sú bodovaní samostatne. Pri rovnosti bodov rozhoduje rok narodenia a najlepší čas v danom roku. Na dve účasti je vyhlásená amnestia, kedy sa zrušia 2 mesiace s najnižším počtom bodov. Preteky majú rôzne kolá počas roka, vrátane decembrového 12. kola. Registrácia je možná na mieste, podrobnosti o cene nie sú špecifikované, a trať je prevažne asfaltová v mestskom prostredí.

Podujatie sa koná 6. decembra 2025 so štartom o 19:00 zo Základnej školy Hviezdoslavova v Lipanoch. Bežci sa môžu tešiť na jedinečný zážitok v nočnom prostredí s výhľadom z rozhľadne. Štartovné je stanovené na minimálnu sumu 7 € a záujemcovia sa musia prihlásiť do 5. decembra 2025.

Trasa vedie na rozhľadňu na Balážke
Podujatie určené pre účastníkov starších ako 15 rokov
additional: Podujatie je jedinečné nočné podujatie s minimálnym štartovným 7 €. Účastníci musia byť starší ako 15 rokov. Registrácia je možná do 5. decembra 2025. name: Malá cena Velké Verandy
description: The Malá cena Velké Verandy is a traditional forest cross-country race held in Choceň. The race is 4,300 metres long and follows forest roads and trails, with approximately 200 metres of elevation gain. The course is marked with ribbons and includes a short stretch of asphalt. The race is also the Jirka Švadlena Memorial and is popular with runners looking for challenging terrain with a hilly profile.
course_highlights: 4,300 m along forest roads and trails
Hilly profile with approximately 200 m of elevation gain
Course marked with ribbons, approximately 400 m of asphalt
additional: The race includes approximately 400 m of asphalt and is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting. It is part of the local sporting calendar.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - prosinec
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily against themselves. It also includes a cup competition, with results adjusted using an age coefficient and runners collecting points throughout the year. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The start is by the fountain in the park.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
A race suitable for all ages and running abilities
A picturesque park setting, with the fountain as the starting point
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The race venue is by the fountain in Smetana Gardens, except for two races in June and August, which take place by the river on U Dětského domova Street. The top three finishers in each category receive awards. The race is held on an asphalt course. It is part of a series of runs in Olomouc, with multiple dates throughout the year.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - září
location: Smetanovy sady fountain, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. Everyone competes primarily against themselves and runs for the joy of it. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of Smetana Gardens, by the fountain in Olomouc. It also includes a cup competition, where results are adjusted using an age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens, by the fountain
Suitable for all ages and running abilities
Cup competition with scoring adjusted using an age coefficient
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The first three places are announced in each category. The race is part of a cup competition running from September 2026 to August 2027, with the best results from a maximum of 9 races counted. The series cup standings run from September 2026 to August 2027.

description: Čertovský běh Damníkov is a traditional uphill road race from Damníkov to Anenská Studánka in the Lanškroun region, held since 1984. The 4 km course runs on an asphalt road with approximately 150 metres of elevation gain and features a challenging uphill profile, especially in the second half. The race is part of the ISCAREX POHÁR 2026 series and is suitable for the general public, including junior categories. The start is at the Damníkov Primary and Nursery School and the finish is at the cultural centre in Anenská Studánka, where refreshments and the results ceremony are provided.
course_highlights: 4 km asphalt course with approximately 150 m of elevation gain
The climb becomes steeper after the railway crossing
The route runs from Damníkov to Anenská Studánka; in December, snow or ice may be present
additional: Race-day registration takes place from 9:00 to 10:10 in the Damníkov Primary and Nursery School building. Changing rooms are available at both the start and finish. Refreshments and the results ceremony are provided at the finish. Anenská Studánka railway station is on the route, approximately 1.2 km before the finish, making it easier to return after the race. The race is part of the ISCAREX POHÁR 2026 series. According to available information, registration takes place on race day during check-in at the Damníkov Primary and Nursery School building; winter weather may affect the course surface.

name: 22. Bieg Barbórkowy - Rybnik
description: The 22nd Barbórka Run in Rybnik is an annual running event organized by MOSiR Rybnik and held on December 6. The race is a long-standing tradition and an important sporting event in the region, attracting runners of different age groups. It is part of the Rybnik Running Grand Prix, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: Organized by MOSiR Rybnik, providing professional conditions and timing
A variety of city routes suited to different distances
Part of the Rybnik Running Grand Prix series, promoting activity and health in the region
additional: The race will take place on December 6, 2026, with the start at 12:00. Registration is open until November 29, 2026. Various distances and city routes are available.

name: Festiwal Biegów Świętych Mikołajów – XXIV Półmaraton Świętych Mikołajów
Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful forest settings. In Katowice, the course runs through the State Forests of the Katowice Forest District, with the start about 700 metres from the finish near the “Rybaczówka” centre by Janina Pond. The event is open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced runners, who can regularly compare their results on the same course. Races take place throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and nationwide rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the forests of the Katowice Forest District
The start is about 700 m from the finish, near the “Rybaczówka” centre by Janina Pond
A course suited to runners of varying abilities
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. The 5 km main race starts at 11:00. It is not possible to drive directly to the start; parking is available on Karolinki Street, about 1 km from the race office. CITY TRAIL Junior races over shorter distances are also held as part of the event. In Katowice, the finish is located near the “Rybaczówka” centre. The race is part of the Grand Prix CITY TRAIL 2026/2027 season.

name: XV Grand Prix Krakowa w biegach górskich – Bieg Mikołajkowy
STOP-MIKULÁS FUTÁS
description: The Stop Santa Claus Run is a traditional, family-friendly running race in Tatabánya, held for the 33rd time in 2025. The event features three distances: 200 metres for young children, and 1,900 and 5,900 metres for adults and older runners. More than 200 people took part, each receiving a unique finisher’s medal, and Santa’s gifts await the youngest participants. The race has a welcoming, family atmosphere, with the organisers presenting numerous prizes and special awards. Participants can also celebrate those with December birthdays with cake and pastries.
course_highlights: Three distances: 200 m, 1,900 m and 5,900 m
Unique finisher’s medal for the 1,900 m and 5,900 m distances
Family-friendly atmosphere, with gifts from Santa for the children
additional: Runners over 70 are honoured with certificates, and the sportiest families receive a special award. The event’s main sponsors are Tatabányai SC and Stop Cukrászda, which treats participants to cake and pastries. The oldest participant completed the longest distance at the age of 87. Community support, an awards ceremony, gifts and a cheerful winter running celebration.

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races in the beautiful surroundings of the Berounka River, from Radotín to Nižbor, running from January to December 2026. The routes follow trails with stunning views and varied terrain, often near nature reserves and historical sites. The series is suitable for experienced runners and beginners alike, and aims to encourage regular running. Most starts are at accessible locations with train connections and facilities at local pubs. At the end of the series, winners are announced and prizes are awarded in 12 categories.
course_highlights: Trails with views of the Berounka River and the Český kras Protected Landscape Area
Challenging climbs and nature reserves, such as Klapice and Radotínské skály
Starts at accessible locations with train connections and facilities at local pubs
additional: Refreshments, baggage storage, changing rooms with showers, and race bibs are available at the race venues. Bringing a headlamp is recommended. Rankings are based on the 10 highest-scoring races in the series. Most starts are near train stations and at local pubs that provide facilities. Trail races in the Berounka area; starts mostly accessible by train; winners announced in December; 12 categories; scoring based on the 10 best races
