name: Winter Milada Run
location: Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: WINTER Milada Run is a winter running race held in the unique landscape of a former brown-coal mine, transformed into the beautiful natural setting of Lake Milada, between the Ore Mountains and the Central Bohemian Uplands. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in Chabařovice and offers 12.5 km and 5.3 km routes, as well as Olympia children’s races. The event marks the end of the running season in northern Bohemia and attracts hundreds of runners each year to the lake’s magical snowy and icy landscape. All races have a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere and are suitable for children, families and adult competitors.
course_highlights: Routes run through the natural surroundings of a former brown-coal mine transformed into Lake Milada
A winter run through the snowy and icy landscape of Lake Milada
Two main routes: a 12.5 km long route and a 5.3 km short route, plus children’s races
additional: A race pack and medal for every competitor. The official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt can be ordered during registration and collected on race day. The first 100 children to register receive a children’s T-shirt free of charge. The race is limited to 500 competitors. The accompanying programme includes St. Nicholas, a devil and an angel, and the Olympia children’s corner. Terrain in the former mine area, winter/icy conditions, family and children’s categories, on-site registration, medals for all participants, official T-shirts available for purchase.

name: Mikulášský běh Úpice
location: Náměstí v Úpici, Úpice, Czech Republic
description: The St. Nicholas Run in Úpice is a traditional running race organized by the Maratonstav Úpice sports club. The race takes place in the square in Úpice and offers categories for children and adults. The race bib is valid for the entire series of races organized by the event organizer. The event is suitable for all age groups and runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the square in Úpice, by the A. Jirásek Theatre
Categories for children and adults, with separate starts
Friendly atmosphere and the option to take part in the race series
additional: The race office opens one hour before the first category starts. Registration closes at 13:30 for the children’s categories and at 14:00 for adults. The race bib is valid for the entire race series and must be brought to each subsequent race. Results are not announced after each individual race but are published on the organizer’s website. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in the square in Úpice. The scheduled start times are 14:00 for children and 14:30 for adults. Registration takes place one hour before the start, and results are published online.

name: Zručský adventní běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zruč Advent Run will take place for the seventh time on December 12, 2026. It is both a charity event and a race. The aim is to encourage more people to take up sport, help those in need, and give participants a chance to unwind from pre-Christmas stress by running through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas. The route passes through the beautiful chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere. You can preview it in a video or download the GPX file for your smartwatch. After the race, warm soup and mulled wine will be served to round off the event.
course_highlights: Run through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas
The route passes through the chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere
Downloadable GPX route file for smartwatches
additional: The race is a charity event, and warm soup and mulled wine will be served to participants after the run. The overall male and female winners hold the course record with a time of 19:10. The route is illuminated for Christmas, and festive decorations add to the atmosphere. The event offers two distances, 900 m and 5,500 m, and is open to children and adults. It features a Christmas atmosphere and a downloadable GPX route file.

name: Předvánoční běh
description: The Pre-Christmas Run is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1984, held in Frýdek-Místek. The race offers courses for both young people and adults. Young runners take on asphalt loops in the stadium grounds ranging from 180 m to 1.7 km. Adults run kilometre loops: men run 8 km and women 3 km, with various distances available in the stadium grounds. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of the TJ Slezan Frýdek-Místek athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Asphalt loops in the stadium grounds for young runners, from 180 m to 1.7 km
Kilometre loops in Staré Město for adults — 8 km for men and 3 km for women
Race with a long-standing tradition dating back to 1984
additional: A run in the stadium grounds, with on-site registration, refreshments in the stadium clubhouse, and various distances from 200 m to 8 km

name: Vranovský noční Trail
location: Samovýčep, Vranov u Brna, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Vranov Night Trail is a winter race run in the dark around Vranov u Brna, offering a challenging yet beautiful course. The race symbolizes the balance between day and night and is the first real running test of the new season. The start and finish are at the Samovýčep venue, which has facilities including a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. After the race, warm Italian food, mulled wine and a relaxed after-party await. The organizers emphasize quality refreshments and a friendly atmosphere that runners can enjoy after finishing.
course_highlights: A 21.3 km course in the Podkomorské forests and around the reservoir
The course is marked with red-and-white and yellow tape and reflective spray
A winter race run in the dark over challenging terrain
additional: Race facilities at the Samovýčep venue include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. There is plenty of water and sports drinks on the course. After the race, there is warm Italian food, mulled wine and an after-party with the opportunity to share feedback and socialize. A headlamp is essential. Facilities include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea, a warm post-race meal and an after-party.

name: CHRISTMAS RUN Praha
location: Před Rudolfinem, náměstí Jana Palacha, Prague, Czech Republic

name: Běh okolo náměšťského zámku
location: Náměšť na Hané, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Náměšť Castle is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering runners the chance to experience the beauty of the area around Náměšť na Hané. The club specializes in recreational and competitive running and organizes a number of endurance races in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of Central Moravia’s running events and welcomes runners of all levels who want to test themselves in a picturesque setting. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and support for the running community.
course_highlights: The area around Náměšť na Hané, with views of the castle
A traditional endurance race in the Olomouc Region
Picturesque natural and historic surroundings
additional: In the previous edition, the start was at the KVS Náměšť na Hané grounds; the date and location for the 2026 edition have not been confirmed in the available information.

name: 9 Bieg Śladami Żubra
description: The Bieg Śladami Żubra is an annual running event organized by the Aktywna Pszczyna Sports Association in Studzienice, held in December. The route follows one or two loops through Studzienice Forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest, offering scenic woodland views. The event features several distances, including the Fancy Dress Run, children’s races, 6 km and 12 km runs and Nordic Walking, as well as a half marathon and marathon. Participants can expect medals, awards for costumes, and traditional pea soup at the finish.
course_highlights: The route runs through Studzienice Forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest
Races cover one or two forest loops
Scenic woodland views and natural mud
additional: Start times are staggered: 08:00 marathon, 08:30 Fancy Dress Run (1.8 km), and 10:10 half marathon. Children’s races are offered over distances of 200 m, 400 m, 800 m and 250 m, 400 m, 850 m, depending on age. Medals and awards for the most creative costumes await at the finish. A team classification is held (the four fastest times after one loop). The route is also used for Nordic Walking. Traditional pea soup is served at the finish. GPX files are available for the half-marathon, marathon, and 6 km and 12 km routes. New marathon distance, changed start and finish location, food and recovery attractions, honorary patronages, additional cross-country races, and team classification.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: The Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Bydgoszcz. The race is recreational and competitive, aimed at people aged 16 and over, and promotes outdoor physical activity. The course runs through the forested areas of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District, offering beautiful natural surroundings. Races take place regularly, giving participants the opportunity to test themselves on the same course throughout the season.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the forests of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Polana Różopole
A cross-country route through forests and urban parks
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place at 10:45 before the race. Parking is not available at Polana Różopole; participants are advised to use parking areas approximately 1–1.5 km from the start. The event schedule and race-office location remain the same throughout the season. The race is scheduled to start at 11:00. Register via the participant portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day.

description: Perły Małopolski Rabka-Zdrój Gorce is a regional race taking place on 13 December 2026 in Rabka-Zdrój. The event is part of the Perły Małopolski race series, which includes various locations across Małopolska, and attracts running enthusiasts from different regions. The course passes through the scenic Gorce Mountains, offering participants a unique experience and the chance to admire the beauty of the surrounding nature.
course_highlights: A scenic course in the Gorce Mountains
Part of the prestigious Perły Małopolski series
Various distances to suit runners of different abilities
additional: The event includes various distances, and registration opens in January 2025. Participants can look forward to beautiful views and a sporting atmosphere.

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque Panewniki forests in Katowice. The event takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times. It promotes an active lifestyle and education about responsible behaviour in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both recreational runners and athletes affiliated with sports clubs.
course_highlights: A route through the Panewniki forests, approximately 4,882 m long
The loop is marked every 1 km
The route can be completed up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for running and Nordic walking is 3 hours. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration accepting responsibility for their participation or provide a medical certificate. Minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian during verification. Annual race-entry packages are available for purchase. Entry fees are non-refundable but may be transferred to a subsequent race if requested by 3:00 p.m. on the Thursday before the race. The event is recreational, with a 3-hour time limit and online registration; entry fees are non-refundable. It also has an educational aspect, promoting responsible behaviour in forest areas.

name: Bieg po moczkę i makówki
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Stanowicach, Stanowice, Opole, Poland
description: Bieg po Moczkę i Makówki is an annual, friendly running event held in Stanowice. Since 2012, it has become a fixture on the holiday running calendar. The course is 10 km long, divided into four 2.5 km loops, and runners may finish after any number of loops. After the run, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and traditional moczka and makówki, and can also enjoy hot coffee and tea. The event has a relaxed, friendly atmosphere, with a prize-winning contest for the most interesting costume and a spectator competition.
course_highlights: A 10 km course divided into four 2.5 km loops
Start and finish at Stanowice Primary School, ul. Szkolna 17A
Runners may finish after any number of loops
additional: After the run, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and servings of traditional holiday dishes: moczka and makówki. A prize-winning spectator competition is held along the course, as well as a contest for the most interesting individual or group holiday-carnival costume. The event has a relaxed, friendly atmosphere and encourages active spectating. It features costume contests and recreational activities, is based at Stanowice Primary School, and offers the option to take part in the 10 km run. The event is usually held in December during the holiday season.

name: 406. Malá cena Monaka – Vánoční
description: Malá cena Monaka - Christmas is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. This Christmas race is part of the Malá cena Monaka series and gives runners the opportunity to compete in a pleasant pre-Christmas atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public and is known for its friendly organization and sporting spirit. It is organized by KRB Chrudim, which has been organizing running events in the region for many years.
course_highlights: A traditional Christmas run in the picturesque surroundings of Slatiňany
A friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization
Part of the long-running Malá cena Monaka series
additional: The race takes place on 20 December 2026 in Slatiňany, Pardubice Region, and is part of the Malá cena Monaka series. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: Vánoční běh Opava
description: The Opava Christmas Run is a traditional running race organized by the BěhOpava association team. The race covers a 4.7 km course starting on Englišova Street and heading toward Gappay (Latarna) along a farm track with an asphalt surface, with several turns before returning to the finish. Kilometer markers are placed along the course to help runners track their performance. The race is open to various age categories, from pupils to men across several age groups. The organizers provide small prizes for the top runners and hold a prize draw for additional prizes.
course_highlights: A 4.7 km course along a farm track with an asphalt surface
Kilometer markers along the course for orientation
Start and finish by Englišova Street – the gate of the School Farm
additional: The course record is held by Petr Gebel, set in 1994 with a time of 13:39. Participants race at their own risk and are advised to take care when crossing roads and follow the organizers’ instructions. The finish judges are members and supporters of the BěhOpava association. The race takes place on an asphalt course with a slight uphill section, starts at the School Farm, and includes small prizes and a commemorative run.

description: The Christmas Run in Ďáblický háj is a non-competitive running event held at the health area in Ďáblický háj in Prague 8. The course consists of two loops through Ďáblický Forest. It is mostly flat, with one gentle hill, making it suitable for runners of all levels. The event traditionally takes place on 24 December, with the first category starting at 10:00. It is organised by AVC Praha and is free of charge, fostering a friendly, community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Two loops through Ďáblický Forest
Flat terrain with one gentle hill
Woodland setting in the health area
additional: This is a non-competitive event. The start is at the health area in Ďáblický háj, and the run is free of charge. It is organised by AVC Praha. Contact: Zdeněk Weig, tel. 733 690 323. The course is suitable for all age groups. The event takes place on Christmas Eve, 24 December 2026, at the health area in Ďáblický háj.

description: The St. Stephen’s Run in Prachatice is a traditional sporting event being held for the 44th time, open to everyone from children to veterans. The morning program begins with children’s and youth categories. The 10 km main race and 5 km hobby race start at 11:00. The route follows paved roads, with an elevation gain of 176 metres on the main course and 68 metres on the hobby course. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Stadium in Prachatice and is part of the 2025 South Bohemian Running Cup.
course_highlights: 10 km main course with an elevation gain of 176 metres
5 km hobby race with an elevation gain of 68 metres
Start and finish in front of the Municipal Stadium in Prachatice
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available to runners in the stadium stand, and refreshments (tea and pastries) are provided at the finish. Race numbers and timing chips are issued during check-in and must be returned to the organizers after the race. Trophies, prizes in kind, and cash bonuses for breaking the course record are awarded to the top finishers. The first 100 participants in the main races to register and pay will receive gifts from sponsors. The event includes 5 km and 10 km courses. Registration is available via maraton.cz, and showers, refreshments, and facilities for runners are provided.

name: Štěpánský kros pro děti všech kategorií a Lidový běh
location: Svitavy, Svitavy District, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
description: The Štěpánský Cross-Country Race for children of all age groups and the People’s Run is an open running event held in Svitavy, with courses for children and adults on a mixed asphalt and grass surface. The race is suitable for all age groups, from the youngest children running 100 metres to adults taking part in the 4,200-metre People’s Run. The event takes place in all weather and offers a sporting atmosphere and support for all participants. Registration is available online, by email or on site on race day.
course_highlights: Mixed course surface: asphalt and grass
Categories for children aged 4 and up, as well as adults
Adults’ 4,200 m People’s Run (2 × the large loop)
additional: On-site check-in runs from 8:45 to 9:45; children’s categories must check in by 9:30. Changing rooms are available in the stadium stand, but they are public and the organizers are not responsible for items left there. Entries can be submitted electronically by 23. 12. 2025, by email, using a QR code or in person on race day. The course has a mixed surface—both asphalt and grass; registration is available online or on site; there are different course lengths for different age groups; changing rooms are available; the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Štěpánský běh Zlín
location: Příluk u Zlína, Zlín, Czech Republic
price_range: zdarma (dětské běhy), ceny za dospělé od 300 Kč výše
description: The St. Stephen’s Run in Zlín is a traditional running race organized by the Běhy Zlín association in Příluky. The 10 km main race consists of three laps and starts at the football field at 10 a.m. The event also includes free children’s races, held after the main race. The race offers rewards for adult runners and original medals for category winners. It attracts runners from the wider area and is part of the Běhy Zlín series.
course_highlights: 10 km main course consisting of three laps
Around the football grounds in Příluky
Children’s races after the main race
additional: The awards ceremony takes place at 11:45 at the race registration area. Category winners receive original medals and, where applicable, non-cash prizes. Children’s races are free, with a small reward for every child and no winners’ awards ceremony. The race is part of the Christmas season celebrations, with the awards ceremony at 11:45, and offers various categories and prizes for winners. The event takes place around the football grounds in Příluky and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Vánoční běh Třtice
description: The Třtice Christmas Run is a traditional running race held annually on December 26 in the village of Třtice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 4.8 km long, with categories based on age and gender. This popular sporting event continues a long-standing tradition and attracts runners from the surrounding area. It is part of the village’s sporting activities and offers a pleasant atmosphere for athletes and spectators alike.
course_highlights: 4.8 km course
Categories by age and gender: A (up to 39 years), B (40–49 years), C (50–59 years), D (over 60 years), E (women)
Traditional Christmas run held since 1976
additional: The race uses the same categories as the summer Třtická Punčocha run. Results from previous editions are regularly published on the village website. Třtice offers sports facilities, including a children’s playground and a multi-purpose sports court. The race takes place on December 26, 2026, and is attended by approximately 200 runners. The course is around 4.8 km long, with approximately 50 metres of elevation gain. The race is suitable for the general public and fosters a festive Christmas sporting atmosphere.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly running event with optional laps, held in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint. Runners can complete the half-marathon distance in four laps, or choose to run fewer laps. The event has a welcoming atmosphere, with apples, hot tea and mulled wine for participants. Every entrant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three men and women receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00, and registration is on-site, with a suggested voluntary entry fee.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Dióskert area of Törökbálint
The half-marathon consists of 4 laps, but runners can choose to complete fewer
A friendly, community atmosphere with apples, hot tea and mulled wine
additional: Registration is on-site, with a suggested voluntary entry fee of 500 Ft per lap. Every entrant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three men and women receive a special medal. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. Apples, hot tea and mulled wine are provided for participants. Runners can choose to complete fewer laps. On-site registration, refreshments and commemorative medals are provided. The event supports the community and local runners.

description: The New Year’s Eve Run in Lysá nad Labem is a traditional race organized by the Sokol Lysá nad Labem sports association. Held at the end of December, it attracts runners who want to enjoy a sporting activity during the winter. After a two-year hiatus, the race is once again looking forward to welcoming participants, who can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and a sporting challenge in Lysá nad Labem. The event is part of a long-standing tradition and promotes physical fitness and sportsmanship.

Routes of 6.2 km and 3.1 km are available
The race is part of a traditional year-end celebration with a Christmas-season atmosphere
additional: The race starts and finishes in Lysá nad Labem. It is a traditional annual event that promotes sporting activity in the community.

description: Malacvágta is a recreational pre-New Year’s Eve running race taking place on December 30, 2024, at Bókay Garden in Budapest. Several age groups can take part, including junior, adult, senior and veteran categories, and there is also a stroller race. Participation is free, and every runner receives a free T-shirt, making this a friendly, family-oriented event.
course_highlights: 6,000-metre race for junior, adult, senior and veteran categories
3,000-metre stroller race
The race venue is Bókay Garden, Budapest
additional: Every runner receives a free T-shirt. The event has two races: a 6,000 m race for junior, adult, senior and veteran categories at 12:20, and a 3,000 m stroller race at 13:00. The venue is Bókay Garden; race times are 11:35 and 13:40. The event is part of the year-end community programme.

name: Horovská desiatka
description: Horovská desiatka je tradičný silvestrovský beh, ktorý sa koná už 40. ročník so štartom pri Kultúrnom dome v Horovciach. Pretekári súťažia na 10 km trati vedúcej z obce Horovce do Tušíc a späť. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny vrátane detí. Atmosféra behu je priateľská a ideálna na zakončenie roka športovým výkonom.
course_highlights: 10 km trať z Horoviec do Tušíc a späť
Štart a cieľ pri Kultúrnom dome v Horovciach
Tradičný silvestrovský beh s dlhoročnou históriou
additional: Súťaži sa v kategóriách pre dospelých aj deti podľa veku. Trať je jeden okruh dlhý 10 km. Podujatie sa koná 31. decembra, ide o silvestrovský beh. Dátum: 31.12.2026; terrain: pravdepodobne cestný; registrácia je možná cez webové stránky, štart pre dospelých o 11:00, pre deti o 9:30; počet kategórií pre rôzne vekové skupiny.

description: The Jistebnice New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional race organized by the Association for Sports of All Kinds and the town of Jistebnice, held every year on New Year’s Eve. In 2025, the event will celebrate its 43rd edition. This popular event also includes a scooter race and children’s races. The race takes place in full road traffic, with organizers assisting at key intersections, and offers a sporting experience for the general public. The organizers warmly invite all sports enthusiasts to take part and wish them an enjoyable experience and a great start to the new year.
course_highlights: The race takes place in full road traffic, with organizers assisting at key points and intersections
The event also includes scooter races and children’s races
A traditional New Year’s Eve run with a long history (43rd edition)
additional: By registering, participants confirm that they are fit to complete the race and acknowledge the health risks. The organizer accepts no liability for health-related injuries. The race is part of the wider SPSVD Jistebnice sporting calendar and is accompanied by other sporting and cultural events. races, routes, schedule, facilities, start, health warning, road traffic

name: Silvestrovský běh Hrabovou
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The New Year’s Eve Run in Hrabová is a traditional race held at the end of the year in Ostrava-Hrabová. It gives participants the chance to end the year with some exercise in a friendly atmosphere. The routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Hrabová and are suitable for a range of ability levels. The race is part of the Hrabová Runs series and is known for its long-standing tradition and community spirit.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Ostrava-Hrabová
A range of course distances suitable for runners of varying abilities
The race is part of the traditional Hrabová Runs series
additional: The race is part of the Hrabová Cup and the Moravian-Silesian Running Cup. Refreshments, changing rooms and toilets are available after the race. Photos and videos are taken to promote the event. Participants can find relay partners and take part in the New Year’s Eve relay. The event takes place every year on 31 December. Participants can choose from various categories and courses, and registration is available on the website.

description: The New Year’s Eve Run Around 3 Reservoirs is a relaxed race held on the last day of the year in Jablonec nad Nisou. The route runs around three Jablonec reservoirs and is approximately 5 km long. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant sporting atmosphere at the end of the year. Gifts are prepared for those who register in advance, and the winners receive interesting prizes from the partners.
course_highlights: The route runs around three reservoirs in Jablonec nad Nisou
The route is 5 km long
Start and finish at the Volt Brewery grounds
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the start location from 9:30 to 10:30. In the event of adverse weather conditions, the organizer reserves the right to change the route. Gifts from the partners are prepared for those who register in advance. The start list and results are published at www.stopnito.cz. The course is approximately 5 km long, with possible changes in adverse weather. Registration is open until 29.12.2025; entry fees are non-refundable. The event is open to the general public and is ideal for ending the year actively.

name: Silvestrovský běh Karviná
price_range: 200 Kč předem, na místě zdarma pro děti
description: The Silvestrovský běh in Karviná is a traditional 10 km road race held every year on December 31. The route runs along the city’s outer streets and features more than 100 metres of elevation gain, making it a challenge for every runner. The event also includes free children’s races in the local forest park, over distances from 200 m to 1.8 km. The start and registration take place at the city stadium, which also serves as the event’s base. After the race, participants can enjoy refreshments and the medal ceremony for various categories.
course_highlights: The 10 km route runs along the outer streets of Karviná
More than 100 metres of elevation gain
Children’s races in the forest park over distances of 200 m, 350 m, 900 m and 1.8 km
additional: Registration is open from 8:30 to 9:45. The children’s races start at 10:05. The main route is on paved roads; the children’s races take place in the forest park. Refreshments after the race include goulash soup and tea, with rum available. Registered athletes are entered by their clubs; parents enter unregistered children. The race starts at 10:00, and the children’s races start at 10:05. Registration is open until December 28 or 29. The event takes place at the City Stadium and in the forest park.

name: Silvestrovský běh Havlovicemi
description: The Havlovice New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional running race organized by Maratonstav Physical Education Association Úpice and held annually on New Year’s Eve in Havlovice. The event offers a 6.6 km main race on a new four-lap course, as well as children’s categories with shorter distances. It is suitable for adults, juniors, and youth runners, and concludes with New Year’s Eve refreshments at the finish. The race starts at the HAPO grounds in Havlovice, where runner registration also takes place. The event is part of a long-standing tradition of running races in the region.
course_highlights: Main race: 6.6 km — 4 laps on a new course
Start and finish at the HAPO grounds in Havlovice
New Year’s Eve refreshments at the finish
additional: Children’s races start at 10:00, and the main race starts at 11:00. Registration is open until 9:30 for the children’s categories and until 10:30 for the main race. The event includes the main course and children’s categories; race day concludes with festive refreshments; the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Silvestrovský běh Zlín
description: The New Year’s Eve Run in Zlín is a traditional race held on New Year’s Eve, offering 10-kilometer and 5-kilometer courses. The main 10 km race consists of two laps on an out-and-back route along the cycle path from Vršava to Kostelec and back. The race is suitable for the general public, including young people and juniors, and is part of the Běhy Zlín series. Winners are announced shortly after the race, with prizes awarded to the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: The route follows the cycle path from Vršava to Kostelec and back
The main race is 10 kilometers long, split into two laps
A shorter 5-kilometer course is also available for young people and juniors
additional: Online registration is open until December 30 at 12:00; on-site registration on race day is open until 10:40. Winners are announced at 12:45 at the race registration venue. Age categories are according to the rules of the Běhy Zlín series. Category winners receive prizes, subject to the organizer’s options. 5 km and 10 km races, online registration, category winner announcements, photos and results available

name: Silvestrovský běh Stříbro
organizer: Sdružení vytrvalců Stříbro, z.s. a TJ Baník Stříbro
description: The Silvestr Stříbro Run is a traditional year-end running race held in the picturesque town of Stříbro in the Plzeň Region. The race offers a 10.5 km course, mostly off-road, starting and finishing at the KERMI complex. It is suitable for all runners who want to end the year on an active and enjoyable note, with the option to start in different waves according to pace. After the race, there will be an awards ceremony, a get-together and refreshments for participants. The organizer, KERMI Stříbro, provides a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: 10.5 km course, mostly off-road
Start and finish at the KERMI Stříbro complex
Option to start at 10:00 or 10:30, depending on the runner’s pace
additional: After the race, there will be an awards ceremony, a get-together and refreshments. The entry fee can be paid in advance by email or on site at the KERMI complex, training center. The race includes a trail at KERMI and a historic city run. Registration is available on site or by email. The start is at 10:00. The race is suitable for the general public.

name: Silvestrovský běh - memoriál Richarda Plcha
location: Park Pod Plachtami, Brno-Nový Lískovec, Brno, Jihomoravský, Czech Republic
price_range: 120 Kč – při přihlášení předem do 29. 12. 2025, 18:00 hodin; 200 Kč – na místě

description: The Silvester Run – Richard Plch Memorial is a traditional running race organized by the AC Moravská Slavia Brno athletics club. It takes place on 31 December in Brno-Nový Lískovec, in Pod Plachtami Park, and offers races for all age groups, from children to veterans. Runners can choose between the main races of 9.84 km and 4.92 km, a 1.64 km fun run, and children’s races starting at 100 m. The course is asphalt with a mix of paved paths, and runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere as they end the year on the move.
course_highlights: Asphalt surface combined with paved paths
Routes for all age groups, from 100 m to 9.84 km
Held in Pod Plachtami Park in Brno-Nový Lískovec
additional: Check-in is required no later than 30 minutes before the start of each category at ZŠ Svážná 438/9; it opens at 8:00. Changing rooms are available at ZŠ Svážná and are for changing only; the organizers are not responsible for belongings left there. Results will be posted throughout the event in the start/finish area and later published on mslavia.cz and atletika.cz. The first three finishers in each category will receive prizes, and children will receive a small prize at the finish. In the fun run, prizes will be drawn among three runners. Entering two races is permitted only for categories up to and including older pupils. The course consists of asphalt and paved paths; online registration runs from 20. 11. 2025 to 29. 12. 2025; the event includes various age categories and a fun run open to all birth years.

name: Silvestrovský běh Kolín
location: Lesopark Borky, Kolín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kolín New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional three-kilometre race held in Borky Forest Park. In 2026, the race will take place in an unusual format: the course will be marked from December 30 to January 1, and each participant can complete it individually. Results can be sent to the organisers by email or SMS, after which the results list will be published. The start is by the FK Kolín football pitch, and the course follows a road, a cycle path and a chestnut avenue, finishing at the athletics stadium.
course_highlights: Traditional three-kilometre course in Borky Forest Park
Start by the FK Kolín artificial-turf football pitch
The route follows a road, a cycle path and a chestnut avenue past STAP
additional: The race can be completed individually between December 30 and January 1, with results submitted by email or SMS. The start is by the FK Kolín football pitch, and the finish is on the cycle path by the athletics stadium. The results list will be published on January 2. The race will not be held as a conventional mass start due to pandemic-related restrictions. Modified format due to the pandemic; individual participation; the course is marked from December 30 to January 1; results submitted by email or SMS; results published on January 2.

name: Půlnoční silvestrovsko - novoroční běh metropolí
description: The Midnight New Year’s Eve–New Year’s Day Metropolis Run is a unique sporting event held in Prague at night, just before midnight on New Year’s Eve. The race starts at Galerie Butovice and offers the last run in Europe in 2025. It is for recreational runners as well as more experienced competitors who want to celebrate the arrival of the new year together in an active, sporting way. The start is scheduled for December 31, 2025, at 23:50. Registration is available in advance and on race day.
course_highlights: A night run in Prague’s unique atmosphere
Start at Galerie Butovice
The last race in Europe in 2025
additional: Registration is also available at the race-day check-in desk. Detailed information about the course, rules, safety measures, and videos from previous editions are available at www.behmetropole.cz. Start at Galerie Butovice, registration at www.behmetropole.cz, course and safety information on the website

name: Silvestrovský běh Přerov
description: We invite you to the traditional Přerov New Year’s Eve Run, held on December 31, starting at 10:00 from the boathouse. Men run 7.5 km, while women, junior women and junior men run 5 km, consisting of two 2.5 km laps. The race offers a pleasant end-of-year atmosphere and the chance to compete in the beautiful surroundings of Přerov. You can register online in advance or at the race office on the day of the event. We look forward to seeing you!
course_highlights: The course runs around the boathouse and skatepark in Přerov
Men run 7.5 km; women and juniors run 5 km (two 2.5 km laps)
Start at 10:00 from the boathouse
additional: Registration is available in advance via an online form or at the race office on the day of the event. The course is a 2.5 km loop: boathouse – skatepark – boathouse. Men run three laps (7.5 km), while women and juniors run two laps (5 km). The race takes place on December 31, 2026. Registration is available online or on-site on race day. Start at 10:00.

name: Běh od Hasy k Hase
location: Roudnice nad Labem, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: The Run from Hasa to Hasa is a traditional New Year's Eve run in Roudnice nad Labem, now being held for the 42nd time. The race offers a simple, easy-to-follow format, with times recorded using chip timing. The atmosphere is friendly, and participants enjoy a beautiful race at the end of the year. Check-in takes place from 8:30 in the Elbe River Board building in Roudnice nad Labem.
course_highlights: A traditional New Year's Eve run with high participation
Chip timing
Start and check-in at the Elbe River Board building, Pod Katovnou 228
additional: Check-in from 8:30 at the Elbe River Board building, Pod Katovnou 228, Roudnice n.L. The start is between 10:00 and 11:00. The race is simple and easy to follow, and suitable for the general public. It is part of a regional celebration attended by runners and organizers from Sokol and local partners. The course is approximately 5.2 km long, and registration is available online at naZávody.cz. The event is traditionally associated with celebrating the arrival of the new year.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz Orienteering is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz Orienteering Foundation. They take place in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. The activity is for everyone, regardless of age or experience, combining sport with adventure and exploring nature using a map and compass. The foundation promotes accessibility by also creating courses for blind and partially sighted participants. The series includes a variety of courses with different difficulty levels, and participants can earn badges for completing individual rounds.
course_highlights: A variety of forest terrain around Bydgoszcz, changing with each round
Courses for beginners and advanced participants, including courses for blind and partially sighted participants
The opportunity to earn digital badges and collectible stickers for completing rounds
additional: The series consists of six rounds held from November to January in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. For each completed round, participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for their collectible card. A special final badge is available upon completing the entire series. Courses are tailored to different ability levels, and the final round features a mass start on the semi-open grounds of a former manor farm. Information about a specific edition on December 31, 2026, is not provided in the available materials.

name: Kresowe Trail #1
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in natural surroundings. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The events are for both beginner and experienced runners, aiming to build a running community based on passion, competition, and friendship. Each race offers carefully marked courses, electronic timekeeping, and a generous race package.
course_highlights: Trail courses ranging from approximately 5 km to over 18 km
Carefully marked trails with colored arrows (green, red, purple)
Aid stations along the course and at the finish; time limit of approximately 2 hours
additional: Registration is available on race day until 08:40 and on-site from 8:00. New race numbers are in use starting with the 2026 season; the first race number is free of charge. The race package includes a hot recovery meal (vegetarian option also available), electronic timekeeping, medical support, aid stations along the course and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for early registration), photography service, and points toward the series’ overall standings. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited. Online registration and race-day on-site registration are available.

name: Lekkoatletyczne Halowe Mistrzostwa Europ... Bieg Uliczny 5 km
description: The 15th European Masters Athletics Indoor Championships will take place in Toruń from 27 March to 2 April 2026. As part of the event, a 5 km road race will be held, giving masters runners an excellent opportunity to compete on the city's scenic routes. The competition combines sporting rivalry with a chance for the athletics community to come together. We invite all running enthusiasts to take part in this prestigious event.
course_highlights: A 5 km road race in the centre of Toruń
Scenic city routes suited to fast times
An event accompanying the 15th European Masters Athletics Indoor Championships
additional: Details of the date and event may change.

name: XVII Noworoczny Bieg z Ochotą
description: The New Year's Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw, giving participants the chance to run into the New Year full of energy. The course passes through the capital's scenic spots, offering both amateur and more experienced runners a unique sporting experience. The organizers provide professional support and a friendly atmosphere, encouraging everyone to celebrate together and start the new year actively.

description: The 20th Anniversary Silesian New Year’s Cyborg Marathon takes place in Silesian Park in Chorzów and invites participants to start the year actively. Participants can choose a distance from 7 km to the marathon, covering one to six 7 km loops. The program also includes a Nordic Walking half marathon. The start is scheduled by the Silesian Park administration building.
course_highlights: A 7 km loop in Silesian Park
Choose from one to six loops, up to the marathon distance
Nordic Walking half marathon over three loops
additional: The start is at 12:00 by the Silesian Park administration building. Participants could change the number of loops during the race; the time limit for the marathon was 360 minutes.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Leśny parking Łysy Młyn, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter tournament consisting of a series of four races and Nordic Walking events, offering both amateur and professional athletes the opportunity to compete over half-marathon and marathon distances. The races take place on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests near Biedrusko, with the event hub at the Łysy Młyn forest car park. The courses are challenging, running through natural woodland with varied surfaces, and each race has its own theme. Races start on Saturdays, and race packs can be collected on race morning. Additional races and walks are also held over 5 km and 10 km distances.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is one 21.3 km loop, while the marathon is two loops totalling 42.6 km.
The course follows forest tracks and trails along the Warta River, with sections of asphalt and natural surfaces that are often slippery.
The marathon has 220 m of total ascent, with the biggest climb gaining 35 m over a 1 km stretch.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. Themed outfits and accessories are encouraged for the individual races. The course is marked with red-and-white tape and “Łysy Młyn” running trail signs. The 21.3 km Nordic Walking event starts together with the half-marathon runners. The New Year’s Run is event no. 2 in the series. The event hub and race office are at the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. Race-pack collection is scheduled for 7:45–9:30 on race day, with the start at 10:00. Free parking is available by the event hub.

name: 5 Wieluński Bieg Noworoczny
description: The 5th Wieluń New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Atelier Sport Association in Wieluń. The race takes place in early January and attracts runners from various regions. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and timing is provided using modern electronic systems. The organizers ensure a high standard of event management and sport, providing professional support and an atmosphere conducive to competition.
additional: Timing is provided using a state-of-the-art electronic system based on RFID chips and mats at the start and finish lines. The organizer provides phone support from 8:00 to 16:00, as well as assistance on race day. The event is organized by the Atelier Sport Association. Available information concerns the fifth edition, held on January 4, 2026; there are no confirmed details about the 2027 edition.

name: Bieg Noworoczny
description: The New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Wroniecki Running Club. It takes place on scenic routes near Rzecińska Street in Wronki. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle among residents of the Wronki municipality and brings the local community together. The route passes through the beautiful forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest, offering participants a distinctive sporting challenge and the chance to start the new year together. The event is open to runners and Nordic walkers, with chip timing and prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 5.5 km for runners and Nordic walkers
Scenic forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest
Start and finish near Rzecińska Street in Wronki
additional: Chip timing (a reusable chip attached to the shoelace). The race office is open from 11:30 to 12:45 on Rzecińska Street. Participant limit: 200. The awards ceremony will be held at the Zamość estate community center on Topolowa Street. A refreshment area at the finish will serve hot tea and coffee. Participants under 18 must have written parental consent. The organizer does not allow anyone under 15 to take part. The 2026 edition regulations provided for electronic chip timing and participation from age 15; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Noworoczny Bydgoszcz FAN Maraton od 2014...
description: Bydgoszcz Fan Marathon is a unique long-distance event held in Bydgoszcz since 2014, mainly at the KS Gwiazda stadium and along the Old Bydgoszcz Canal. The course consists of multiple loops of approximately 4.22 km, following park paths with a gravel-and-asphalt surface and little elevation change. The event is small-scale and friendly, promoting recreational exercise and active leisure while continuing the tradition of similar races in other European cities. Participants time themselves and report their times to the organizers. Both runners and Nordic walkers are welcome. The start is usually in the morning, and the atmosphere is informal and friendly.
course_highlights: The course follows park paths around the Old Bydgoszcz Canal, with 4.22 km loops
Gravel-and-asphalt surface, mostly gravel
Start and finish at the KS Gwiazda stadium; little elevation change (approximately 53 m above sea level at the start and 45.95 m above sea level at the turnaround)
additional: There is no time limit; participants time themselves and report their times by email. People over 18 may take part, including Nordic walkers and walkers. The race office is located on the park path by the KS Gwiazda stadium. No entry fee is planned, except in special circumstances. Participants provide their own drinks and nutrition. The start is usually at 8:00 or 9:00. The course requires completing a multiple of the loop, up to a maximum of 10 loops. Participants arriving after the scheduled start time start together with the first participant. The event has no entry fee and no medals.

name: Zamczyska Winter Trail
location: Drewniane altany nad Czarnym Potokiem, Rymanów-Zdrój, Poland
description: Zamczyska Winter Trail is a mountain race held in the scenic area of Rymanów-Zdrój. The course runs along both marked and unmarked hiking trails. The 12.5 km course has a total elevation gain of +650 m and is additionally marked by the organizer to make navigation easier during the race. The start and finish are by the wooden shelters above the Czarny Potok. The race requires good physical fitness and experience in mountain running. The participant limit is 200.
course_highlights: 12.5 km course with +650 m elevation gain
Two checkpoints and water stations along the course
The course follows marked and unmarked hiking trails
additional: The participant limit is 200. The start and finish are by the wooden shelters above the Czarny Potok. The race office is open from 8:00 to 9:45. The time limit is 2 hours 30 minutes. After registering, participants have 48 hours to pay the entry fee. If withdrawing, the entry fee is refundable until 30.11.2026. The participant limit is 200, and the time limit is 2 hr 30 min. Entry is open to adults with experience running on difficult terrain. Registration is available through raatiming.pl.

name: 10 Bieg Trzech Króli
description: The Three Kings Run is a 5 km street race in Łódź, held to celebrate Epiphany. Participants start and finish at Manufaktura Market Square, and the route runs through the city streets, including Piotrkowska Street. It’s an opportunity to start the year actively and run in a festive atmosphere. Information about the 2027 edition has not been confirmed in the available sources.
course_highlights: A 5-kilometre route through the streets of Łódź
Start and finish at Manufaktura Market Square
The route includes Piotrkowska Street
additional: The sources refer to the 10th edition, held on 6 January 2026; they do not confirm a date of 5 January 2027.

name: Ultra CK Maraton
location: Hala Legionów, ul. Leszka Drogosza, Kielce, Poland
description: Ultra CK Marathon is a demanding ultra race of approximately 51 km with around 1,520 m of elevation gain, held in Kielce. The event also offers shorter races: Czarci Oddech, 15 km with 422 m of elevation gain, and the MTB cycling route Upiorna Trzydziestka, 30 km with 828 m of elevation gain. The event is aimed at enthusiasts of challenges and varied forms of sporting suffering, and is organized by the Świętokrzyskie Mountain Biking Association MTBCross Kielce. The start and race office are located at Hala Legionów in Kielce. Participants in the longest-distance race must carry mandatory safety equipment.
course_highlights: Piekielna Pętla: 51 km ultra race with around 1,520 m of elevation gain
Czarci Oddech: 15 km race with around 422 m of elevation gain
Upiorna Trzydziestka: 30 km MTB route with around 828 m of elevation gain
additional: The race office is open on 5.01.2026 at Hala Legionów Kielce from 17:00 to 20:00, and on race day from 6:00. The cutoff for all distances is 18:00/18:30. Mandatory equipment for ultra-race participants: a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, a charged mobile phone, identification, and clothing suitable for the weather. The race office is located at Hala Legionów, ul. Leszka Drogosza, Kielce. Participants in Piekielna Pętla are required to carry safety equipment, including a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, and a charged phone. Details of the 2027 edition are not confirmed in the available information.

The organizers provide professional timing and a welcoming atmosphere, creating a unique “Dziewicza Family.”

course_highlights: The 12 km main race route passes through Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka, and Ślepuchowo
Accompanying races for children and young people on routes adapted to their age categories
Picturesque surroundings and a winter atmosphere make for an active start to the year
additional: The main race is limited to 200 participants. The race pack includes a commemorative medal, a recovery meal, a doughnut, and water. The top finishers receive statuettes or trophies. The accompanying children’s races start at 11:05, immediately after the main race begins. In the 2026 edition, the main race was scheduled to start at the Bronisław Malinowski Primary School in Chrustowo; the limit was 200 participants. The race pack included a medal, a recovery meal, a doughnut, and water. This information refers to the previous edition.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by a group of running enthusiasts. The events take place in scenic locations, with a particular focus on the visual appeal of the courses, often in botanical gardens and green spaces. The Łódź race is held in the Botanical Garden, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by nature. The organizers promote running and create a welcoming atmosphere for runners of different ability levels.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Botanical Garden in Łódź
Scenic, attractive green surroundings
Courses suited to runners of different ability levels
additional: The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Biegiem w Las from Poznań. The events are cross-country races held in various locations in Wielkopolska and other cities. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka celebrates its 10th anniversary. The organizers encourage people to sign up for the newsletter to stay up to date with events. The Łódź editions also include children's races. The cited sources concern previous editions and do not confirm details of the event on January 16, 2027.

name: XIII Bieg Podhalański
location: Nowy Targ Airport, Nowy Targ, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Zgłoszenie internetowe do dnia 14 stycznia 2026 r. -40 zł – osoby dorosłe

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Zgłoszenie internetowe do dnia 14 stycznia 2026 r. -20 zł – dzieci i młodzież do 18 roku życia (2008 r.)

description: The 13th Bieg Podhalański is a prestigious classic-style cross-country skiing race held at the airport in Nowy Targ. Competitors race over 6 km, 15 km, and 30 km courses (two laps of the 15 km loop). The event attracts cross-country skiing enthusiasts of all ages and also offers activities for children and families, such as dog-sled rides and a play zone. After the races, there is an awards ceremony and a quiz with prizes from sponsors. This sporting event has a unique atmosphere, combining competition with community spirit.
course_highlights: Classic-style cross-country skiing courses over 6 km, 15 km, and 30 km
A 15 km loop completed twice by competitors in the 30 km race
Start and finish at the airport in Nowy Targ, with views of the winter scenery of Podhale
additional: Total entry limit: 950 participants, with distance-specific limits of 300 for 30 km, 599 for 15 km, and 499 for 6 km. The race is held in classic style. Underage competitors may enter only the 5 km and 15 km distances with written parental consent. On race day, registration is available at the race office at the airport in Nowy Targ. Results are sent by SMS to the phone number provided. Dog-sled rides and a play zone are available for children and families. A quiz with prizes from sponsors takes place after the awards ceremony. The 13th edition was held on 17 January 2026; available sources do not confirm 16 January 2027 as the date. The program for the edition described included, among other things, a play zone for children and dog-sled rides.

name: IV Zimowy Bieg Chrząszcza
description: The 4th Winter Beetle Run is a winter running event scheduled in Szczebrzeszyn, with the venue in Kawęczynek. It’s an opportunity to spend an active day running around the town. The race calendar lists a distance of 10 km, but this is not confirmed in the available registration details. The event date needs confirmation, as sources indicate January 17, 2027, rather than January 16.
course_highlights: Event location: Szczebrzeszyn – Kawęczynek
A winter run in the area around Szczebrzeszyn
The race calendar lists a 10 km distance, not confirmed in the registration details
additional: The race calendar gives an approximate date of January 17, 2027, which differs from the stated date of January 16.

name: Zimní šestka Kravaře – Kouty
location: Sportovní areál Olšinky, Kravaře-Kouty, Czech Republic

name: XVII Bieg o Puchar Burmistrza Miasta Pszów
description: The 17th Pszów Mayor’s Cup Run is an annual running event organized by the Pszów City Office. The run attracts participants of different ages and ability levels, promoting physical activity and community integration. The race takes place on a course in Pszów and is a recreational sporting event featuring competition for the mayor’s cup. It’s a great opportunity to test your abilities and celebrate sport together in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Main race over a distance of 12 km
Course in Pszów
additional: This edition took place on January 18, 2026, not January 10, 2027. A total of 156 runners started the 12 km race.

name: 9 Miński Bieg Biegiem dla WOŚP
description: The 9th Mińsk Biegiem dla WOŚP Run is an annual 10 km road race held in Mińsk Mazowiecki. The event is charitable and offers an excellent opportunity to support the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity through sport. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the streets of Mińsk Mazowiecki
Asphalt course of moderate difficulty
Charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to participants’ VDOT levels. Expert support is available during preparation. The organizer encourages the use of its platform for managing the race listing and marketing collaboration.

name: IV Pogórzański Bieg Górski
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Burzynie, Burzyn, Poland
description: The 4th Pogórzański Mountain Run is a mountain race of approximately 21 km with around 800 m of elevation gain, held in the picturesque village of Burzyn. The route is approximately 70% forest trails and 30% asphalt, with three aid stations along the way. The time limit is 240 minutes, and timing is electronic. The race office, start and finish are at the Primary School in Burzyn, where changing rooms, bag storage and showers are available. There are overall classifications for women and men, as well as age-group categories.
course_highlights: Approximately 21 km with around 800 m of elevation gain
Route is 70% forest trails and 30% asphalt
3 aid stations along the route (5 km, 12 km, 19 km)
additional: The race office is open from 7:30 to 10:00 at the sports hall of the Primary School in Burzyn. Changing rooms, bag storage and showers are available on site. A race pack may be collected on another participant’s behalf only with a written authorization and proof of identity. The route is marked every 1 km. The time limit is 240 minutes. The winners’ ceremony is scheduled for approximately 14:30–15:00. Route and event information is based on previous editions. In the 4th edition, the start, finish and race office were at the Primary School in Burzyn; the time limit was 240 minutes.

name: Trail Kamieńsk
location: OSiR Góra Kamieńsk, Góra Kamieńsk, Poland
description: Trail Kamieńsk is a mountain race held on Mount Kamieńsk in central Poland, offering three distances: 6 km, 14 km, and 30 km. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle and attracts runners of varying abilities. The route passes through scenic, varied terrain, offering challenges and beautiful views. The organizers provide professional event management and support for participants along the course.
course_highlights: Mountain routes on Mount Kamieńsk, measuring 6 km, 14 km, and 30 km
Scenic views and varied terrain
Well-marked and secured routes with refreshment points
additional: The race office is located at the OSiR Kamieńsk grounds, by the lower ski-lift station. The routes are well marked and secured, with refreshment points along the course. The event takes place in winter conditions, so appropriate equipment and clothing are required. The rules require a signed statement confirming there are no medical contraindications to participation. In 2027, the minimum age is 16 for the 6 km race and 18 for the 14 km and 30 km distances. The official website lists the date as February 7, 2027, not January 17.

name: Běh po Bremstě
location: Malé Svatoňovice, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč dospělí, 30 Kč děti za závod
description: The Run around Bremst is part of the Winter Running League organised by TJ Maratonstav Úpice in the Jestřebí Mountains region. The race offers courses for adults of approximately 5 to 7 km and shorter courses for young runners from 0.5 to 3 km, which may be adjusted depending on the weather. The race starts in Malé Svatoňovice, where race check-in and the race office are also located. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and is part of a series in which the five best races count towards the score. The organiser prioritises safety, including mandatory reflective gear for all participants.
course_highlights: A 5 to 7 km course for adults in the Jestřebí Mountains region
Short 0.5 to 3 km courses for young runners, which may be adjusted depending on the weather
Start and check-in in Malé Svatoňovice (SŠBPA)
additional: Check-in until 9:30, children’s categories start at 10:00, and the main race starts immediately after the children finish. The race number is valid for the entire Winter Running League series. The race takes place in all weather conditions and at participants’ own risk. All runners must wear reflective gear. The race office opens one hour before the first category starts. The races are open to the general public; registration is available 15 minutes before the start. Reflective gear is required, and weather may affect course conditions.
