name: 11 Górski Zimowy Maraton Ślężański
description: The Górski Zimowy Maraton Ślężański is a challenging mountain race held in Sobótka, covering 42.6 km with approximately 1,130 m of elevation gain. A half marathon is also held as part of the event, covering 23.9 km with approximately 575 m of elevation gain. The course runs through scenic mountain terrain, offering participants unique challenges and beautiful views. The event has a long-standing tradition and is popular among mountain runners.
course_highlights: Marathon distance: 42.6 km with ±1,130 m of elevation gain
Half marathon distance: 23.9 km with ±575 m of elevation gain
Mountain course with scenic views and a challenging profile
additional: The event includes two races: a marathon and a half marathon. The attendance record is 714 people (2020). The marathon and half-marathon course records are listed with the athletes’ names and times. GPX routes are available for both distances. The event’s Facebook page provides a GPX track of the course.

name: Zimowy Półmaraton Gór Stołowych
location: Centrum Szkoleniowo-Edukacyjne Parku Narodowego Gór Stołowych, Karłów, Poland
description: The Stołowe Mountains Winter Half Marathon is a challenging 21 km mountain race held in winter conditions in the scenic Stołowe Mountains. The route follows hiking trails with numerous rocks, turns and significant elevation gains. It is often covered in snow and ice, requiring participants to be in good shape and have sound technique. The start and finish are located at the Stołowe Mountains National Park Training and Education Centre and the Shelter on Szczeliniec, which can be reached only under your own power. The race is part of a series of mountain running events and takes place whatever the weather, with mandatory equipment and environmental rules.
course_highlights: The route follows hiking trails in Poland’s Stołowe Mountains
Significant elevation gains, many rocks and turns, and potentially heavy snow and ice
The finish is at the Shelter on Szczeliniec, accessible only on foot
additional: The time limit for completing the route is 5 hours. There are 2 checkpoints with refreshment stations and time cutoffs: Parking under Szczeliniec (6.7 km, cutoff 2:30 hours) and Błędne Skały (13.6 km, cutoff 4:00 hours). Participants may use snowshoes. Race packs can be collected at the Stołowe Mountains National Park Training and Education Centre in Karłów on Friday and Saturday morning. After the race, a recovery meal, an awards ceremony and a prize draw for prizes from partners are planned. Deposits weighing up to 3 kg can be left at the finish, but valuables and documents must not be left. The start is at 09:00; the finish time limit is 5 hours. Snow and ice may occur on the route in winter; snowshoes are permitted. There are two checkpoints on the route with refreshment stations and time cutoffs.

name: X Ultra River Ultra Świder - zima
6 Nocny Maraton / Półmaraton
organizer: Klub Sportowy Ultra Team Łódź i Fundacja Wybiegaj Marzenia
description: The 6th Night Marathon and Half Marathon with the Ultra Team in Łagiewnicki Forest is a unique running event organized by runners for runners. The race takes place in the scenic Łagiewnicki Forest in Łódź, offering participants a nighttime atmosphere and a memorable running experience. It is a great opportunity to test yourself on a marathon or half-marathon course surrounded by nature. The event has become a tradition and is attracting growing interest among runners from the region.
course_highlights: The course runs through scenic Łagiewnicki Forest
The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere
Organized by the experienced Ultra Team—runners for runners
additional: According to the available information, the participant limit is 250: 170 for the half marathon and 80 for the marathon. The program includes a race pack, a hot meal, prizes for the women's and men's overall categories, and a medal for every participant.

name: 20 Bieg WOŚP Policz się z cukrzycą
description: The 20th WOŚP “Measure Up to Diabetes” Run is a charity race in Warsaw, held as part of the 35th Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity. It combines sporting activity with support for the Grand Finale’s cause and invites everyone to run together for a good cause. The event is scheduled for January 23, 2027, in Warsaw.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale marathon in Chwałowice, held in a friendly atmosphere. The course passes through forest and countryside, offering a chance to run away from the bustle of the city. One local landmark along the route is Napoleon’s Stone. It’s an event for people who enjoy relaxed running meetups and a cross-country feel.
course_highlights: A forest and countryside route around Chwałowice
Passes by Napoleon’s Stone
A small-scale race with a cross-country feel
additional: Available sources describe previous editions and a historical series of four marathons in 2024; they do not confirm details of the edition scheduled for January 23, 2027.

name: X Zabrzański Bieg dla WOŚP
location: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 15 im. ks. Jana Dzierżona, ul. Czołgistów 1, Zabrze, Poland
organizer: Sztab WOŚP Zabrze oraz Bieg Pluszaka działający przy Stowarzyszeniu Wielka Flota Zjednoczonych Sił
description: The 11th Zabrze Run for WOŚP is an annual sporting event organized by the WOŚP Zabrze Headquarters and Bieg Pluszaka, part of the Wielka Flota Zjednoczonych Sił Association. The run takes place on January 30, 2027, in Zabrze, at Primary School No. 15 named after Rev. Jan Dzierżon. Participants can choose between two routes: 3 km and 6 km (two 3 km loops). The event is charitable and community-focused, welcoming runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: 3 km and 6 km routes (two 3 km loops)
Start and finish on the grounds of Primary School No. 15 in Zabrze
Charitable event supporting WOŚP
additional: The run takes place from 10:00 to 15:00. It is organized by the WOŚP Zabrze Headquarters and Bieg Pluszaka, part of the Wielka Flota Zjednoczonych Sił Association. The event is community-focused and charitable, and takes place on the grounds of a primary school. It will be held on January 30, 2027, at Primary School No. 15 named after Rev. Jan Dzierżon, ul. Czołgistów 1. There is no age limit for participation.

name: XII Zimowy Maraton Bieszczadzki
description: The 13th Bieszczady Winter Marathon is a winter mountain race taking place in Cisna on 23 January 2027. Participants can choose from three distances: 10 km, 26/28 km, and 42/44 km, with routes adapted to weather conditions and snow cover. The races start from designated points, and the course runs through the scenic Bieszczady Mountains, featuring challenging climbs and descents. Participants can expect refreshment points with drinks and snacks, as well as shared transport to the start for the 10 km distance. The finish closes at 15:30, and the organizer provides professional support and attractive race packages.
course_highlights: Mountain routes of 10 km, 26/28 km, and 42/44 km, with a total elevation gain and loss of up to 860 m
A route adapted to winter conditions, with alternative versions in the event of heavy snow cover
Refreshment points along the course with water, tea, and snacks
additional: The 42/44 km and 26/28 km races start at 7:00 at the school in Cisna. The 10 km race starts at 8:40 in Przysłup, with coach transport from Cisna at 8:00 (participants cannot make their own way to the start). Participants must bring their own cups or bottles for the refreshment points. The time limit for completing the course is when the finish closes at 15:30. Safety and hygiene rules in force at the time apply during the race. The start is scheduled for 7:00. The race office is located at the school in Cisna, Cisna 58; it will be open on 22 January 2027 from 17:00 to 22:00 and on 23 January from 6:00 to 9:30.

name: XIII Karnawałowy Bieg Górski Pielgrzym
description: The 13th Carnival Mountain Run Pielgrzym is a challenging 10 km mountain race taking place in Leśnica. The event is an excellent opportunity to test yourself on a demanding trail course, ideal for fans of mountain challenges. The organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The race takes place in a winter setting, which adds to its unique character and appeal.
course_highlights: A challenging 10 km mountain trail course
Winter scenery in Leśnica
A challenge for runners who prefer demanding terrain
additional: Training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including training instructions and expert support. The date shown in calendars is approximate; the date listed there, January 24, 2027, differs from the event date provided.

name: TIHANY TRAIL
location: Tihanyi Bencés Iskola, Csokonai utca 73, Tihany, Hungary
description: Tihany Trail is a winter trail-running and Nordic walking race held on varied, challenging terrain in the beautiful surroundings of the Balaton Uplands. The course is especially distinctive because participants run along the rim of the caldera and on a rocky cliff edge, making for an exciting and scenic race. Participants can choose from 5, 10 and 15 km distances, and aid stations provide hydration and energy. This is a real treat for trail runners, attracting running enthusiasts even in winter.
course_highlights: Varied, challenging terrain in the beautiful surroundings of the Balaton Uplands
Running along the rim of the caldera, on a rocky cliff edge and along narrow trails
Aid stations with water, energy drink, glucose tablets and salted pretzels
additional: Race-pack collection takes place from 8:00 to 9:50, followed by a warm-up with Gabi Piros at 9:50. Refreshments are available at two points on the course and at the event centre. There will be no cups at the aid stations, so participants must bring a flask or cup. On the 15 km course, the first aid station is at the Forest School (approximately 6.9 km) and the second is beside the Apáti Church (approximately 10.3 km). <i:am> mineral+ energy drink and cherry-flavoured hypotonic drink are also available on the course. Trail-running shoes are recommended, with anti-slip aids if needed; road-running shoes are not suitable for the terrain. The race starts at 10:30. The event centre is at Tihanyi Bencés Iskola, Tihany, Csokonai u. 73. The organisers recommend trail-running shoes and, if needed, anti-slip aids. Participants must bring their own cup or flask for the aid stations.

name: Zimní běh Hlučín
location: Jasénky, Hlučín, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

name: 5. Pietrasze Cross Country 3/5
description: Pietrasze Cross Country is a series of cross-country races held in the picturesque Pietrasze Forest in Białystok. The course is entirely natural and highly varied, featuring forest trails, uphill and downhill sections, and different surfaces such as forest floor, grass, sand, and mud. The race requires versatility and good fitness from participants, with volunteers and lead cyclists present along the course. After the race, participants can socialize over music, doughnuts, and tea, adding to the event’s friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A course entirely on varied, natural forest terrain
Numerous climbs and descents, with a total elevation gain of 140 m+
The course is marked with blue-and-white tape, with lead cyclists and volunteers present
additional: Race packs are distributed from 8:30 to 9:30 at Primary School No. 32 named after Major Henryk Dobrzański, nom de guerre Hubal, at ul. Pietrasze 29. Before the start, a warm-up with a trainer and music takes place from 9:40 to 9:50. After the race, a music event and social gathering with doughnuts and tea continue until 12:00. Participants start from the start zones, where race numbers are checked by officials at 9:55. The series includes multiple races on different dates, with online registration available. Participants can look forward to a sporting atmosphere and beautiful surroundings.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
description: The Olęder Double Marathon is a series of running races organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Runners’ Club and held in a friendly, social-sporting atmosphere. The event is aimed at both experienced runners and beginners who want to stay active outdoors through the challenging autumn and winter months. Participants run a marathon or a multiple of the 10.5 km loop. The races take place in different towns between October and March. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and encourage all running enthusiasts to take part.
course_highlights: The course consists of a 10.5 km loop
Off-road running in autumn and winter conditions
Option to run a marathon or a multiple of the loop
additional: The Olęder Double Marathon takes place on a series of weekends from October to March, each in a different town. Races start at 10:00, and the race office opens an hour earlier. The time limit for the first race is 16:00 and for the second race, 15:00. The minimum distance is 10.5 km. The races are co-financed by Nowy Tomyśl County and are held in accordance with the applicable restrictions. The date of January 17, 2027, comes from a running calendar; the organizer’s available pages do not yet confirm details of this edition in Grudna.

name: XVIII Jelczańsko-Oławski Zimowy Maraton ...
description: The 19th Jelczańsko-Oławski Toyota Winter Marathon in Stages is a series of seven races, each 7.033 km long, held at different locations around Jelcz-Laskowice and Oława. The event combines running and Nordic walking, with a shared start and electronic timing. Participants can collect their race packets the day before the first stage or on race day. The event is organized by KB Harcownik Jelcz-Laskowice and supported by local authorities and partners, including Toyota Motor Manufacturing Poland.
course_highlights: Seven stages, each 7.033 km long
Courses in different localities: Chwałowice, Oława, Jelcz-Laskowice, Janików, Miłoszyce
Nordic walking and running starts with electronic timing
additional: A race packet may be collected by an authorized person presenting a printed and signed form. Collection the day before the start is recommended, at Termy Jakuba in Oława or at Jelcz-Laskowice City Hall. Nordic walking and running starts take place at 11:00, with Nordic walking starting 30 minutes earlier from the second stage onward. On race day, the race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30 before the first stage and from 10:00 before subsequent stages. For the date January 31, 2027, the source lists Stage III of the 19th edition, not the 18th edition. Nordic walking is scheduled for 10:30 and the run for 11:00.

name: 10 Bieg Pobiegnij z WOŚP
description: The 10th Run with WOŚP in Ostrów Wielkopolski is an annual running event organised under the patronage of the WOŚP Ostrów Wielkopolski Committee. The race covers a distance of 10 km and is a charity event, combining sporting competition with a social cause. It takes place in January, and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to train and compete together. On race day, the organiser provides an information point at Plażowa Restaurant.
course_highlights: 10-kilometre road race
Charitable event supporting WOŚP
Race in Ostrów Wielkopolski
additional: On race day, 25 January 2026, the information point will be open from 10:00 to 11:30 at Plażowa Restaurant, ul. Plażo. Training sessions count from the time of registration until the race. No information is available about start waves, participant limits or additional equipment. Information about the 10th edition gives the date as 25 January 2026; the running calendar tentatively indicates 25 January 2027. Information about the course and entry fee has not been confirmed.

name: 13 Bieg Wielkich Serc
location: Bulwar Kurlandzki near Galeria Kazimierz, Kraków, Poland
organizer: Sztab Wielkiej Orkiestry Świątecznej Pomocy #7702 przy Hufcu ZHP Kraków-Podgórze
description: The 13th Bieg Wielkich Serc is an annual running event held in Kraków on the Kurlandzki Boulevard near Galeria Kazimierz. The race is a charity event associated with the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity. Participants can expect a special atmosphere and the opportunity to support a worthy cause through a sporting event. The organizers provide a baggage drop at Galeria Kazimierz, but there are no changing rooms for participants.
course_highlights: The route follows Kurlandzki Boulevard in Kraków
Start and finish near Galeria Kazimierz
The race takes place in the morning on 25 January
additional: The organizer does not provide changing rooms. The baggage drop for participants will be located at Galeria Kazimierz and will be open on race day from 11:00 to 13:30. Previous editions have also included races for children and young people, as well as Nordic walking. Information for the 2026 edition listed a baggage drop at Galeria Kazimierz; the organizer did not provide changing rooms.

name: 14 Opolski Bieg
organizer: Sztab Wielkiej Orkiestry Świątecznej Pomocy w Opolu
description: The 14th Opole “Count Yourself in with Diabetes” Run is an annual event held during the Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity in Opole. The run is a charity event, and all entry fees go to the account of the 34th WOŚP Grand Finale. Participants can expect a certificate, a medal, and gifts from sponsors. Registration is online, and places are limited.
course_highlights: Approximately 5-kilometre route
Start at Plac Wolności
The route passes, among other places, along the Nadodrzański Boulevard and through Bolko Island, with the finish at the National Centre of Polish Song
additional: Every participant will receive a certificate, a medal sponsored by ARTAL, and gifts from SFD and Smooth The Fruit at the finish. Start numbers are sponsored by INFODRUK printing house (www.startowe.eu). Registration opens on 11 November at 11:11 via zmierzymyczas.pl; places are limited. At the finish, participants will receive a certificate, a medal, and a gift.

name: 34 Finał WOŚP
organizer: Tarnogórskie Stowarzyszenie Obywatelskie i Gmina Świerklaniec

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: minimum 30 zł od osoby za pośrednictwem eSkarbonki WOŚP Tarnogórskiego Stowarzyszenia Obywatelskiego

description: The 34th Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity in Świerklaniec is a special charity event organised jointly with the Świerklaniec Municipality. As part of the finale, the 3rd Run in Funny Costumes takes place, with participants covering a route of approximately 2 kilometres in amusing and unusual outfits. The event combines sporting fun with a rich arts programme and numerous attractions for the whole family. The fundraising goal is the diagnosis and treatment of digestive tract diseases in children. In the evening, the symbolic “Light to the Sky” illuminates the park in Świerklaniec.
course_highlights: Approximately 2 km route through the park in Świerklaniec
Run in amusing and unusual costumes
Symbolic “Light to the Sky” at 20:00
additional: Participants receive a commemorative medal, and the creators of the most original and funniest costumes are rewarded. Adults and minors may take part, with parental or guardian consent required for minors. After the run, numerous attractions are available, including a bonfire with free sausages in exchange for a donation to a WOŚP collection box, dance performances, a food area, first-aid lessons, a children’s play area, and free admission to the Pałac Kawalera. Participation is at the participant’s own risk and requires acceptance of the event rules. Costumes are not compulsory. Registration is via a Google form, and payment is made through the WOŚP Tarnogórskie Stowarzyszenie Obywatelskie e-collection box. Minors may participate with the consent of and under the supervision of a parent or guardian; participation is at the participant’s own risk.

name: Bieruński Bieg Utopca
description: The Bieruń “Utopiec” Run is a cross-country race promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity, held in Bieruń. The event brings the running community together and supports the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity. Competitors can choose between two distances: 17 km (the main race) and 5 km (running and Nordic walking). The course features varied surfaces, along with numerous uphill and downhill sections. The start and finish are in Bieruń’s Market Square, alongside a Family Sports Picnic with activities for children and local exhibitors.
course_highlights: Cross-country course with varied surfaces
Numerous uphill and downhill sections
Start and finish in Bieruń’s Market Square
additional: The race package includes a personalised race bib, a commemorative T-shirt and a medal featuring a depiction of the “Utopiec” that changes each year. The race office is located at the Sports Hall at 15 Szarych Szeregów Street, about 400 metres from the Market Square. The event also features a Family Sports Picnic with local artists, sports clubs, handicrafts, food products, activities for children and an awards ceremony. Previous editions offered 17 km and 5 km distances, with Nordic walking also available on the shorter distance. The race package included a bib, commemorative T-shirt and medal; the race office was located at the Sports Hall at 15 Szarych Szeregów Street. Details of the 24 January 2027 edition are not provided in the available materials.

description: Gramy dla WOŚP is a running event and walking rally held in the wooded areas of the Bydgoszcz Forest, partly along the Blessed Czesław Jóźwiak Trail. Participants can choose from several walking distances and an 11 km run, which was shortened in 2026 due to weather conditions. The finish is in Nowa Wieś Wielka, where the awards ceremony, refreshments and a campfire get-together take place. The organizer provides return transport from the finish to the start locations, and every participant receives a commemorative medal and access to aid stations along the route.
course_highlights: The running and walking rally routes pass through the wooded areas of the Bydgoszcz Forest
Part of the route follows the Blessed Czesław Jóźwiak Trail
Aid stations are located in Łażyn and before the finish
additional: Race packs are handed out one hour before the start in the start area. The combined participant limit for the run and walking rally is 250. Time is recorded before the railway crossing in Nowa Wieś Wielka. The organizer provides return bus transport from the finish to the start locations (Plaża Piecki and Solec Kujawski). Hot drinks, firefighters’ pea soup and a campfire are available at the finish. A mobile bag drop is available for participants’ personal belongings. Separate classifications are held for women and men, with awards for the top 5 runners and the top 3 participants in the walking rally. Information in the sources describes earlier editions, including an 11 km run from Plaża Piecki to Nowa Wieś Wielka and bus transport from the finish to the car parks by the beach.

description: The 11th “Get to Know Diabetes!” Run is an annual sporting event held in the City Park in Stalowa Wola, combining physical activity with charitable support. The run is part of the 34th Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity, and aims to support the treatment of digestive diseases in children. The event attracts whole families and sports enthusiasts, offering activities for both children and adults. Participants can expect professional organization, race packs, and a varied programme of accompanying events.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque City Park in Stalowa Wola
A family event with races for children and young people (Kids/Junior)
A sports warm-up led by activity leaders before the main race
additional: The race office opens at 9:00 at the City Park. Races for children and young people start at 11:00, preceded by a warm-up with an activity leader. After the main race at 12:00, the winners’ award ceremony and WOŚP charity auctions are scheduled to take place in the auditorium of the State Music School. The event officially ends at 16:30. The event combines sport, music, and charitable activities. Source information concerns the 11th edition in 2026; the date and programme for the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed.

name: VII Zimowy Bieg po Zdrój
description: The Winter Run po Zdrój is an annual running event held in Jaworze that attracts runners and their families. The races take place in a winter setting, offering participants a unique running experience on urban and mountain routes. The event includes a road race and a mountain half marathon, and GPX files of the routes are available for navigation. The organizers welcome both younger and older runners, dividing participants into age categories.
course_highlights: Routes available in GPX format for navigation devices
A road race and mountain half marathon in the winter setting of Jaworze
Age categories from 16 and up, including M20, M30 and M60
additional: Race packs can be collected at the Race Office in tents at the sports complex on ul. Koralowa. Race routes can be downloaded in GPX format. The races take place in winter conditions, so runners need to be appropriately prepared. Sources refer to the 7th edition, scheduled for 25 January 2026; they do not confirm an edition on 24 January 2027.

name: X Bieg Wokół Stołu
description: The X Around the Table Run is a commemorative recreational running event organized by the “Pszczelnik” Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Siemianowice Śląskie. The event involves covering a distance of 1 km, or 117 laps around a table, without touching it. The run takes place in the sports hall of the “Michał” Sports Complex and is divided into two age categories, with separate classifications for women and men. Participants start in heats of 6, and at the end all those who complete the run in accordance with the regulations receive commemorative medals.
course_highlights: 1 km distance — 117 laps around a table
The run takes place in the sports hall of the “Michał” Sports Complex
Competition in two age categories, with separate classifications for women and men
additional: Entries are accepted by email until January 21, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. After that deadline, entries can be made on the day of the event from 9:00 to 9:40 a.m. using an entry form. Participants start in heats of 6. Trophies are provided for the winners, and commemorative medals for everyone who completes the run. In the edition described, participants started in heats of 6. The age categories were born in 2013 or later and born in 2012 or earlier, with separate classifications for women and men. This information concerns the 2026 edition.

name: XI Bieg z Puszką dla WOŚP
description: The 11th Run with a Can for WOŚP is an annual charity running event held in the Kleszczewo municipality. Participants start in Komorniki and run through several localities, finishing in the GOKiS sports hall in Tulce. The run brings people together and supports the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP), while the route offers a chance to explore nearby towns and villages. The event also features children’s races and a play zone, where children receive medals and gifts. The main race is scheduled to start at 14:30.
course_highlights: The route passes through Komorniki, Nagradowice, Kleszczewo, Gowarzewo and Tulce
The finish is in the GOKiS sports hall in Tulce
The run is a charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: Children’s races and a play zone are available, with age categories and distances ranging from 200 m to 2,000 m. In the youngest children’s category, a parent or guardian may accompany the child during the race. Every child who finishes receives a commemorative medal and gifts from the organizers and sponsors. The date in the source calendar is approximate and indicates 25 January 2027; the event date provided is 24 January 2027.

name: XII Biegu Pobij Dystans z Sercem!
description: The 12th Run Beat the Distance with Heart is an annual race held in Piła as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The event takes place during the WOŚP Grand Finale and combines sporting competition with a charitable purpose, supporting children and seniors by raising funds for medical equipment. The race attracts people from the city and surrounding areas, bringing together a community of kind-hearted people who join forces to help those in need. It is a special opportunity to take an active part in Poland’s largest charitable campaign.
course_highlights: The race will take place in Piła, in the Greater Poland Voivodeship.
The running calendar lists the distance as 10 km, although route details are unavailable.
The event takes place on the day of the WOŚP Grand Finale.

name: XX Indywidualny Bieg dla WOŚP
description: The 20th Individual Run for WOŚP in Radom is an annual running event organized to support the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity. The race takes place on city routes that combine sporting competition with bringing the local community together. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and comprehensive technical support, ensuring participants’ comfort and safety. The event is for runners of various ability levels and promotes an active lifestyle and charitable causes.
course_highlights: City route in Radom
Professional RFID electronic timekeeping
Charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: Timekeeping and technical support are provided by Time-Sport.pl, a leader in professional timing for sporting events with many years of experience. The event uses RFID technology to ensure accurate timekeeping. Results from previous editions and a complaints form are available on the website. The event is part of a broader calendar of races organized by Time-Sport.pl in the region.

description: Łódź Mountain Runs is a series of cross-country trail races held in Łagiewnicki Forest, with distances of 6.6 km, 10.5 km and 14.4 km and elevation gains of 140, 220 and 300 metres, respectively. The races are organised by the “Orientuś” Student Sports Club and take place on a loop in Modrzew Forest, offering technically challenging routes. Each stage of the series offers a cast medal and a meal for participants, and the overall standings include 4 of the 5 stages. The event promotes physical activity and sporting competition in scenic woodland.
course_highlights: Routes in Modrzew Forest measuring 6.6 km, 10.5 km and 14.4 km
Elevation gains of 140 to 300 metres on the running loops
Scenic woodland with technical cross-country sections
additional: The event base is at Primary School No. 61, 183 Okólna Street, Łódź. Mass start with electronic timing. A cast medal and a meal are provided to every participant at each stage. A free stage is available when registering for the whole series. The overall standings include 4 of the 5 stages. Parking is limited; parking near the Sanctuary of St Anthony of Padua and Blessed Father Rafał Chyliński, and by the shrine at the junction of Okólna and Wycieczkowa streets, is recommended. A medal and a meal are provided at the finish. In the 2026/2027 season, the overall standings include 4 of the 5 stages. The date 24.01.2027 does not appear in the published schedule; the nearest scheduled stages are 17.01.2027 and 14.02.2027.

name: Ľudova 50
description: Ľudova 50 je horský ultramaratón a turistický diaľkový pochod vedúci krásnym pohorím Strážovských vrchov. Trasa s dĺžkou 51 km a prevýšením 2600 metrov začína a končí v obci Uhrovec, rodisku Ľudovíta Štúra, po ktorom je pretek pomenovaný. Pretek je náročný a odporúča sa mať skúsenosti s podobnými dlhými trasami. Počas trate sú tri občerstvovacie stanice a trať vedie výhradne po značených turistických chodníkoch s krásnymi výhľadmi a historickými miestami.
course_highlights: 51 km dlhá trasa s prevýšením 2600 m
Vedie po značených turistických chodníkoch Strážovských vrchov
Kontrolné stanovištia na Uhrovskom hrade, Chate pod Čiernym vrchom a Kajtárovom
additional: Limit účastníkov je 200 bežcov/turistov. Prezentácia účastníkov prebieha deň pred pretekom a v deň preteku ráno. Na trase sú tri občerstvovacie stanice. Organizátor odporúča mať pred štartom absolvované aspoň jedno podujatie s 50 km trasou. Trať vedie cez oblasti s výskytom medveďa hnedého a inej divej zveri. Organizátor sleduje počasie a v prípade nebezpečenstva môže upraviť trasu alebo program. Štart a cieľ sú na Námestí Ľudovíta Štúra v Uhrovci. Na oficiálnom webe sú informácie o povinnej výbave, pravidlách a registrácii.

name: Běh Velbabou
description: Běh Velbabou is a traditional winter running race organized by Maratonstav Tělovýchovná jednota Úpice in the village of Radeč. The race is part of the Winter Running League and offers starts for children’s categories as well as a main race. The course runs through picturesque surroundings, with the museum in Radeč as the start location. The event is suitable for all ages and for runners who want to enjoy a winter run in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the museum in Radeč
Part of the Winter Running League, with the entry fee valid for the entire series
Race courses for children and adults

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of urban parks. In Poznań, the course runs around Lake Rusałka, with the start and finish located by the city beach. The races are open to runners of all levels, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly track their results on the same course. Races are held throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and national rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start on Św. Wawrzyńca Street; finish by the city beach
The course is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The race on 17 January 2027 is one of four Poznań dates in the 2026/2027 season; the others are scheduled for 11 October and 22 November 2026, and 21 March 2027. The CITY TRAIL program also includes races for children.

The race features beautiful, scenic routes that encourage outdoor activity in a winter setting. The organisers place particular emphasis on the cross-country nature of the course and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

Winter scenery ideal for outdoor activity

description: Gliwice Park Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026, organized by the Amateur Running Enthusiasts’ Club “Pędziwiatr.” The events aim to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation and take place on Saturdays in Gliwice’s municipal forest. Each lap is 4,219.5 metres long and runs mainly on forest trails and gravel paths, with some asphalt. A refreshment point is located at the start/finish line. Participants can choose from 1 to 5 laps, or approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon, in either the running or Nordic Walking event.

The route runs mainly on forest trails and gravel paths, with some asphalt
A drinks refreshment point at the start/finish line after each lap
additional: Events take place once a month on Saturdays. The time limit for running and Nordic Walking is 3 hours. Participants can choose 1 to 5 laps (approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon) and may take part in both disciplines. After the event, participants return their race numbers and receive a drink and a snack (sausage or banana), as well as a snack bar in a prize draw, if sanitary regulations allow. There is a “persistent participants” classification for those who take part in at least 9 events. Race numbers are valid for the entire year and assigned to individual participants. Anyone changing disciplines must register again and collect a new race number. The organizer publishes separate regulations for the park events and e-Prowokacja. description: Bieg 3 Jezior is a running series held in Chodzież, comprising three events over 5 km and 10 km distances, taking place by three lakes: Karczewnik, Miejskie and Strzeleckie. The event is intimate in scale, with a limit of 130 participants. Participants can purchase a pass for the entire series, which includes all three races and a commemorative T-shirt. A permanent race number with a timing chip makes participation convenient, without the need to collect a number separately for each event. The races take place on Sundays at 10:00, offering an active way to spend the weekend amid scenic surroundings.

5 km and 10 km distances
Scenic areas of Chodzież
additional: The participant limit is 130. Pass holders receive a permanent race number with a timing chip, used for all three races, so they only need to visit the race office once. name: Bieg Wedla
description: Bieg Wedla is a non-profit running event organized by enthusiasts from the PTTK Warsaw-Praga Branch. It takes place in the picturesque Skaryszewski Park in Warsaw. The routes follow a paved loop, with connecting sections on mineral-surfaced paths, and participants can enjoy the special atmosphere and historic park. The event is held in winter, which gives it a unique character, while the organizers take care to minimize its impact on the environment and local residents. After the race, participants receive medals and gifts, and can also enjoy free pea soup and hot tea.
course_highlights: Running routes on a paved loop, with connecting sections on mineral-surfaced paths
Picturesque, historic Skaryszewski Park in Warsaw
Routes covered with compacted snow and sand, providing winter running conditions
additional: Starts are held over various distances: Nordic walking at 10:00; O-run from 10:30 to 12:00; running routes of 1.86 km (for children and young people up to age 15), 5.43 km, and 9 km; and a 250 m route for children up to age 7. Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected in the days before the race at the Decathlon City store in Warsaw, or on event day at the Drukarz Sports Club. After the race, participants receive medals and a gift. Free pea soup (including a vegetarian option) and hot tea are available on site, but water is not provided. Parking is available in public spaces around the park; vehicles are not permitted to enter the park. Archived results confirm that the event has been held regularly from 2011 to 2026. The distances and schedule provided are for the 2026 edition; registration and fee details for 2027 are not available.

Natural terrain suited to cross-country running
Limit of 70 participants for each running distance and 30 for Nordic walking

The event page lists the registration deadline as January 23, 2026, and the hours as 9:00–10:30; participants were told that grilled sausage, bread and tea would be provided.

5 km and 10 km distances in previous editions

Participants can choose from four distances: 56 km, 28 km, 10 km, and 10 km Nordic Walking. The routes follow forest tracks with a few climbs, and the start and finish are at the Running Shelter. The event is well organized, with aid stations along the routes and a limited number of participants, creating an intimate atmosphere.

additional: The participant limit is 150 paid entrants. The 56 km and 28 km routes are forest loops, with aid stations operating during specified hours. name: Zimowy Bieg Zbója
description: The Zimowy Bieg Zbója is a mountain race in Bielsko-Biała inspired by the legend of the Klimczok outlaw. The course follows scenic but demanding mountain trails, offering participants exceptional views and an intense challenge. The 18 km and 13 km distances, with substantial elevation gain, will test every runner’s strength and determination. It’s a great opportunity to kick off the running season in a winter setting and experience the atmosphere of a true mountain race.
course_highlights: 18 km course with 996 m of elevation gain, starting below the Szyndzielnia cable car
Klimczok summit as the course’s high point
A fast, rugged descent that demands stamina and courage

Payment by PayU, PayPal, or bank transfer is available. Organizer: Alpas Artur Sarosiek, Bielsko-Biała. Registration for the 2027 edition is open. Part of the Winter Running League, with children’s categories

A patriotic atmosphere commemorating the Greater Poland Uprising
A commemorative cast medal for every participant
additional: All events start at 11:00 (the 5 km Nordic walking event starts at 11:01). Places are limited. Participants can enjoy a hot meal after the event. The runs are scheduled to start at 11:00, and Nordic walking at 11:01. The entry fee is 75 zł until 10 January 2027, 85 zł from 11 January to 3 February, and 90 zł on race day, subject to availability. Places are limited.

name: 5 Zmrożona Połówka
location: Zajazd Jowisz, ul. Harcerska 2, Turawa, Poland
description: The 6th Frozen Half is a 5 km race held in Turawa at Zajazd Jowisz. The event takes place on February 6, 2027, and is organized by the Od Zmierzchu Do Świtu Foundation in cooperation with Turawa Municipal Office. The race offers electronic timing and is a great opportunity for a sporting challenge amid winter scenery. The race office is open from 8:30 to 10:30, and the race starts in the morning.
course_highlights: 5 km race
Winter course in Turawa
Electronic timing
additional: The race office is open from 8:30 to 10:30. The organizer provides electronic timing. Turawa Municipal Office is a co-organizer. Turawa Municipal Office is a co-organizer. The race office for the 5 km distance is open from 8:30 to 10:30.

name: Bieg Pamięci Sybiru
description: The Sybir Memorial Run is an annual sporting event commemorating the first mass deportation of Polish citizens to Siberia on February 10, 1940. The race takes place in two cities: Białystok and Wrocław, offering 5 km and 10 km distances in Białystok and a 5 km distance in Wrocław. The route in Białystok runs through the picturesque Turczyński Forest, with evening starts using a wave-start system. The event combines sporting competition with historical remembrance and the emotional significance of commemoration.
course_highlights: The route through Turczyński Forest in Białystok
Evening starts with a wave-start system
Winter scenery and an unobstructed running route
additional: The 10 km race uses wave starts, with starting groups based on declared finish times. Start lines close 10 minutes after the last wave starts. Participants should report 30 minutes before the start. A 50% discount is available to people born in 1961 or earlier. The 2026 edition also offered virtual participation, requiring participants to cover at least 5 km in a single run. Participants received a race package and a commemorative medal.

name: Cross maraton u Ryśka vol 80
location: Ruda, Wieluń County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: Janosik Winter Race
description: Janosik Winter Race is a unique winter mountain race held in the heart of Spiš, at the foot of the majestic Tatra Mountains, in Niedzica. The course runs through scenic areas, including trails such as Spacer Murgrabiego, Bedzies, Kwicoł, Zawiany, Pyzdra, Kierpce and Maryny. The event is part of the Janosik Race Series, organized by a foundation with a passion for sport and development. It also offers races for children and young people, creating a family-friendly atmosphere and promoting physical activity in winter conditions.
course_highlights: Routes through the scenic areas of Spiš and the foothills of the Tatras
The Spacer Murgrabiego, Bedzies, Kwicoł, Zawiany, Pyzdra, Kierpce and Maryny trails
A winter mountain race featuring varied, challenging terrain
additional: Races for children and young people. Routes of varying distances and difficulty. The event takes place in winter mountain conditions. Photo and video galleries from previous editions are available. Parking and a race office are provided. The program also includes Janosik Kids races. The routes available in the edition described by the sources are 10, 21, 30 and 55 km.

name: Silesia Race
location: Hala Sportowa MOSiR w Knurowie, al. Lipowa 12A, Knurów, Poland
organizer: Stowarzyszenie „Planeta Przygody” oraz Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Knurowie
description: Silesia Race is an annual event held in the Silesia region, combining sporting competition with orienteering. Equipped with maps and, on selected courses, GPS devices, participants must find checkpoints placed along the route. The event base is the Sports Hall of the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Knurów. The event is organised by the Planeta Przygody Association and MOSiR Knurów. It is a great opportunity for lovers of outdoor activities and navigational challenges.
course_highlights: Sporting competition combined with orienteering
Participants use maps; GPS is available on selected courses
Checkpoints placed along the route for participants to find
additional: The event base is the MOSiR Sports Hall in Knurów at 12A Lipowa Avenue. The organisers are the Planeta Przygody Association and MOSiR Knurów. Participants can use GPS on selected courses. Registration is available on the external website silesiarace.pl. The event base is the MOSiR Sports Hall in Knurów at 12A Lipowa Avenue.

description: Trail!ON Stawiguda is a series of four 5 km trail races held monthly on the same scenic route through the forests and along the Łyna River near Ruś. Winter weather is no obstacle to staying active—crisp air and forest trails create a unique running atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to regularly check your fitness, enjoy the excitement of competition and spend time outdoors. The organizers also cater to participants’ comfort by offering children’s races at various distances. The series concludes with an awards ceremony and a bonfire with the Mayor.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the beautiful forests of Ruś
Start and finish by the beach at the bend in the Łyna River
Variable forest terrain and natural winter conditions
additional: Children’s races take place over distances of approximately 300 m, 500 m and 1,000 m, with different start times. The final race concludes with an awards ceremony and a bonfire with the Mayor. A one-off race entry can be purchased on race day at the race office. The race number included with a series pass is the same for the entire series and must be brought to every race. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. The program also includes children’s races over distances of approximately 300 m, 500 m and 1,000 m. Online registration is open until 3 February 2027 at 23:59.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Parking leśny Łysy Młyn, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter competition consisting of a series of four runs and Nordic Walking events, offering both amateur and professional athletes the opportunity to compete over half-marathon and marathon distances. The races take place on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests near Biedrusko, with the event center by the Łysy Młyn forest car park. The courses are challenging, passing through natural woodland with varied surfaces, and each race has its own theme. Races start on Saturdays, and race packs can be collected on race day in the morning.
course_highlights: The course follows forest tracks and trails through the Warta River forests, along the Warta River
The half marathon is one 21.3 km loop; the marathon is two loops (42.6 km)
The course has a natural surface and is slippery and uneven in places, with leaves, puddles, and mud
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. The course is marked with red-and-white tape and “Łysy Młyn” running-trail signs. Themed outfits and accessories are encouraged for the individual races. Nordic Walking events over 21.3 km are also organized, along with 5 km and 10 km runs and walks. The event center is by Lake Łyse, next to the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. The venue can be reached by car and by municipal and suburban public transport; free parking is available on site.

name: XXIII Zimowy Bieg Trzech Jezior
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Trzemesznie
description: The 24th Winter Three Lakes Run will take place on February 6, 2027, in Trzemeszno. This winter running event is held in the picturesque area of three lakes. The competition combines sporting rivalry with local classifications, and is open to runners from the Trzemeszno municipality as well as other participants.
additional: The previous edition included, among others, classifications for the Trzemeszno Municipality Championships, State Forests employees, and PAROC employees.

name: Zimowy Bieg Górski
location: Stok narciarski Na Complu, Rajcza, Poland
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Rajczy
description: The Wilcze Gronie Winter Mountain Run is an annual running event held on the ski slopes of Na Complu in Rajcza. The race features a winter mountain course that challenges participants and offers an active way to spend time in the picturesque surroundings of the Żywiec Beskids. The organizers invite runners to take part in this sporting competition, which combines a passion for running with the beauty of winter nature.
course_highlights: The course runs along the Na Complu ski slopes
Winter mountain scenery of the Żywiec Beskids
Picturesque views and demanding terrain
additional: A course map and GPX file were made available for the 2025 edition. These details refer to a previous edition and are not confirmed information about the 2027 event.

description: The Mountain Half Marathon in Jedlina-Zdrój is a challenging mountain race set in the picturesque Wałbrzych Mountains. The course follows natural trails, technical sections and varied terrain, offering runners a sporting challenge and contact with nature. The event has an intimate atmosphere and is supported by the local community, creating a unique experience for participants. The start and finish are at Jedlinka Palace in Jedlina-Zdrój. The event offers several distances, including a mountain half marathon, a 10 km race and an ultra, as well as the accompanying Mountain Festival.
course_highlights: The course follows natural trails and technical sections in the Wałbrzych Mountains
Several refreshment and nutrition points along the course
Start and finish at Jedlinka Palace, ul. Zamkowa 4, Jedlina-Zdrój
additional: The field is limited to 300 participants for the Winter Half Marathon and Winter 10K. The course is marked with orange ribbons and arrows. Refreshment and nutrition points are provided along the course. Race numbers and race packs (socks, isotonic drink) can be collected at Hotel Jedlinka. All participants must wear their race number visibly on their torso. Winners are awarded during the event. Carrying a charged phone and a GPS track or course map is recommended. The race starts on 7 February 2027 at 10:00 from Jedlinka Palace, ul. Zamkowa 4. The total participant limit is 300 for the half marathon and Winter 10K combined. The organizer provides baggage storage, changing rooms, a post-race meal, hot drinks, and refreshment and nutrition points.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Polana Różopole, Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in scenic woodland and parkland. In Bydgoszcz, the route passes through the Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District, with the start and finish at Różopole Clearing. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can compete on the same course year after year. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Races take place throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete for overall standings and prizes.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the woodland scenery of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Różopole Clearing
The route is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. Before the main race at 11:00, there is a group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. Parking is not available at Różopole Clearing; participants are advised to use car parks approximately 1–1.5 km from the start. The race schedule and race-office location remain the same throughout the season. The main race starts at 11:00. Registration is available online through the Competitor Panel or at the race office on race day.

name: XIV Grand Prix Krakowa
description: The Krakow Mountain Running Grand Prix is a series of mountain races held in Krakow, offering a range of distances from 3.7 km to 23.2 km, as well as a Vertical race. The races take place on scenic routes with varying levels of difficulty, inviting both beginners and experienced runners to take on the challenge. The event is a recurring series with an anniversary edition, attracting hundreds of participants and offering individual and team classifications. The organizers provide a varied program, including races for children and relays, creating a welcoming sporting atmosphere for the whole family.
course_highlights: Distances: 3.7 km, 5.7 km, 11.6 km, 23.2 km, and Vertical 1.5 km
Scenic mountain routes around Krakow with varied terrain
Special races for children and an anniversary relay
additional: Starts take place at various times on Sunday, including the 23.2 km race at 9:00. The Vertical GPK competition takes place on Saturday from 10:00 to 12:00. The series also includes races for children and an anniversary relay. The courses can already be tested during the summer. The series also includes the 5.7 km distance, the Vertical race (1.5 km), and races for children. The prices listed apply to a single race in the 14th edition and depend on the distance, registration date, and discounts.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz na Orientację is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz na Orientację Foundation, aimed at people of all ages and skill levels. Participants use a map and compass to explore a variety of forest and urban areas around Bydgoszcz. The event promotes outdoor activity, family participation, and the development of navigation skills, offering courses suited to both beginners and experienced runners. The foundation also works to create courses for blind and visually impaired participants, making the event accessible to everyone.
course_highlights: A variety of forest and urban areas around Bydgoszcz
Courses for beginners, experienced runners, and blind and visually impaired participants
A series of several events during the season, with an overall series classification
additional: The Autumn-Winter Series comprises six orienteering rounds in different forests around Bydgoszcz and nearby areas, with courses of varying difficulty. Participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for their collectible card for each completed round. Completing the entire series is rewarded with a special final badge and discounts on the Bydgoszcz and Surrounding Areas Championships. The project is supported by the Ministry of Sport and Tourism and the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Government. Available sources do not confirm details of the edition on 7 February 2027.

description: The Chomiczówka Run is a historic road race held in Bielany, Warsaw, with a tradition dating back to 1984. The main race is 15 km long and attracts runners from across Poland, bringing together the local community and running enthusiasts. The event also features a shorter 5 km race for the Bielany Cup. The organizers provide electronic registration and set a participant limit to ensure runners’ comfort and safety.
course_highlights: 15 km main race route in Bielany
Historic connection to the first race in 1984
Additional 5 km race for the Bielany Cup
additional: Participant limit: 3,000 (1,800 for the 15 km race, 1,200 for the 5 km race). Registration is exclusively online through the datasport.pl system. Participants can pay extra for clothing and a running shirt when registering. Registration will close if the participant limit is reached. Registration at the Race Office is available from February 19–21, 2027, at different prices. The official website states that registration for the 2027 edition opens on November 9. Available materials indicate that the 44th Chomiczówka Run will take place in 2027, so the stated edition and date may be inconsistent.

name: Ultra River Ultra Świder
description: Ultra River Ultra Świder is a winter race along the Świder River in Mazovia, featuring three distances: 11 km, 21 km, and 47 km. The route passes through areas by three rivers: the Świder, Mienia, and Vistula, offering participants a chance to connect with nature, explore wild landscapes, and enjoy a unique atmosphere without the pressure of competition or timing. This event is for running and adventure enthusiasts who value community and the experience over results. The winter scenery gives the race a distinctive character and an added challenge.
course_highlights: The route follows three rivers: the Świder, Mienia, and Vistula
A winter race through the wild landscapes of Mazovia
No timing; the focus is on the experience and community
additional: There is no timing or competition, and registration is available on-site at the race office. The event is intimate and community-focused, emphasizing a connection with nature and shared experiences. Information about the schedule and the day's events is published on Ultra River's Facebook and Instagram. Volunteer opportunities are available at the winter race. The event takes place without timing or the pressure of competition.

name: V Dziki Cross 2026 – Edycja II
location: Leśny parking w Kozłowie, Kozienicki Park Krajobrazowy, Poland
description: V Dziki Cross 2026 – Edition II is a race organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association in the picturesque Kozienice Landscape Park. The event will take place on February 8, 2026, offering participants the chance to compete in races of various distances, including a 10 km run, Nordic walking, and a half marathon. This event is for outdoor enthusiasts and combines a passion for sport with the beauty of nature. The organizers invite everyone to take part and share in the excitement of competition.
course_highlights: The routes run through Kozienice Landscape Park
Available categories: 10 km run, Nordic walking, half marathon
Picturesque woodland and natural surroundings
additional: The event is scheduled for February 8, 2026, at 10:00; the start and event facilities are listed at the forest parking lot in Kozłów. This edition is part of the Dziki Cross series.

name: XII Parkowe Hercklekoty
location: Park Leśny w Dolinie Trzech Stawów, Katowice, Poland
description: XII Parkowe Hercklekoty is an annual race held in the Forest Park in the Valley of the Three Ponds in Katowice. It is the first race in the 2026 MK team Grand Prix series and is held under the Honorary Patronage of the Mayor of Katowice. The event includes children’s races over short distances, main races of approximately 6 km and 12 km, and a Nordic walking event of approximately 6 km. The routes pass through the scenic Valley of the Three Ponds, offering participants an appealing setting for competition and recreation.
course_highlights: The routes run entirely through the picturesque Valley of the Three Ponds
The approximately 6 km distance is one 5.8 km lap
The approximately 12 km distance is two laps, totaling 11.6 km
additional: Children’s races cover distances from 50 to 700 metres. The event also includes a Nordic walking event of approximately 6 km. The race is held under the Honorary Patronage of the Mayor of Katowice. Distance and fee information refers to the 12th edition on 8 February 2026; available sources do not confirm details of the edition on 7 February 2027. The course is not certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA).

name: XIX Bieg o Puchar Bielan
location: Ulice Conrada i Pabla Nerudy, Bielany, Warsaw, Poland
description: The 19th Bielany Cup Run is an annual road race held in the Bielany district of Warsaw. Runners set off along Conrada and Pablo Neruda streets, and the organizers provide convenient facilities, including changing rooms, bag storage, and a post-race meal at the finish. The event takes place on a Sunday when shops are closed. Participants can use the parking area and access washbasins, toilets, and showers free of charge. The welcoming atmosphere suits both recreational and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: Road course in the Bielany district of Warsaw
Start on Conrada Street, finish on Pablo Neruda Street
Portable toilets available at the start and finish
additional: The race office is located in Bemowo Shopping Centre at 126 Powstańców Śląskich Street. Changing rooms and bag storage are at Primary School No. 352, 6 Conrada Street, where runners can use washbasins, toilets, and showers. A post-race meal at the finish consists of soup (meat and vegetarian options), bread, and hot tea. The organizers provide bag-storage sacks, tents, benches, and tables for eating. The parking area is about 1 km from the start line. The event takes place on a Sunday when shops are closed. The race office and race-pack collection were located in Bemowo Shopping Centre. Changing rooms and bag storage were available at Primary School No. 352, 6 Conrada Street; the organizers also provided toilets, washbasins, showers, parking, and a post-race meal.

name: Zimowa Zawierucha
organizer: Klub Biegacza Warta i Atelier Sportu
description: Zimowa Zawierucha is a race organized by the Atelier Sportu Association and held in Bobrowniki. The event has a winter theme and attracts runners who enjoy competing on a 21 km course. Timing is provided using modern electronic systems to ensure accurate results. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness in winter conditions and connect with the running community.
course_highlights: 21 km course
Winter trail race in Bobrowniki
Professional timing using RFID chips
additional: Online registration closes on January 21, 2027, at 23:59. Timing is provided using a state-of-the-art electronic system based on RFID chips and start/finish mats. The organizer provides phone support on race day and on business days from 8:00 to 16:00.

name: Běh Kvíčalou
description: Běh Kvíčalou is a traditional winter running race organized by Maratonstav tělovýchovná jednota Úpice. The race takes place in Úpice in the Hradec Králové Region and is part of the Winter Running League. It starts on Saturday morning, with the children’s categories running first and the main race starting as soon as the children have finished. The race offers a friendly atmosphere and is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children and adults.
course_highlights: Winter running race in Úpice (Kvíčala)
Children’s categories start at 10:00; the main race starts after the children finish
Part of the Winter Running League, with a long tradition and a strong community
additional: Check-in by 9:30. The race number is valid for the entire Winter Running League series. The main race starts as soon as the children’s categories have finished. Online registration is available. The race takes place in February and is suitable for a wide range of participants, including families with children.

name: INNOGY WINTER RUN Olomouc
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic

name: Bieg Walentynkowy
description: The Poznań Valentine’s Day Run is an annual running event held by Lake Rusałka, bringing together couples, singles, and families to celebrate Valentine’s Day through physical activity. Traditionally, it features 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as Nordic walking, with individual and pairs categories. The event is inclusive and family-friendly, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the joy of exercising outdoors.
course_highlights: Course around Lake Rusałka in Poznań
5 km and 10 km running distances, plus Nordic walking
Option to participate individually or in pairs
additional: The event also includes runs for children. It is family-friendly and inclusive, and takes place annually around Valentine’s Day by Lake Rusałka. The 12th edition has been announced for 13 February 2027 at 12:00. Prices from the 2026 edition may not apply in 2027.

name: Walentynkowy Marsz Nordic Walking
location: Leśny kompleks przy ul. Szybowej, Knurów, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Knurowie
description: The Valentine’s Day Nordic Walking March is an annual event organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Knurów. It takes place on Valentine’s Day, February 14. Participants follow a route of about 6 kilometres through the forest complex near Szybowa Street. The event is open to everyone, not just couples, and promotes active outdoor recreation. Registration is open until February 9, and the start is scheduled for 11:00.
course_highlights: A route of about 6 km through the forest complex near Szybowa Street
The event takes place on February 14, Valentine’s Day
Organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Knurów
additional: Registration for the march is open until February 9. The event takes place in a forest complex, offering participants a chance to connect with nature while walking.

name: Walentynkowo Szwungiem przez Przyłęk
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: ARM Race Walentynki
location: Zbiornik Kępina, Zduńska Wola, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland
description: ARM RACE is an extreme obstacle race offering a sporting challenge for people who want to tackle a course packed with obstacles and do something more than an ordinary run. The event offers a variety of formats, from classic 5 km and 10 km distances to multi-hour Selection challenges, dynamic OCR100 races, and family adventures. The starting line brings together both results-focused athletes and people new to OCR, as well as whole families, creating a unique atmosphere of competition and excitement. ARM RACE combines physical activity, technique, and the satisfaction of overcoming obstacles along the course.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses with around 25 and 40 obstacles, respectively
A variety of formats: PRO, OPEN, FUN, Selection 12H/24H, OCR100, and a family course
An approximately 1 km family course with obstacles for children and parents, with no pressure to achieve a particular result
additional: Season 2027 passes are available, covering 3 ARM RACE starts (5 km or 10 km, PRO/ELITE with no extra charge) or 2 Selection starts for 699 zł, with an ARM RACE technical cap as a gift. Passes can be purchased by bank transfer to the account of the Rajsport Active Association. The event offers different formats suited to participants’ ability levels, including a format in which participants choose which obstacles to tackle. Races for young competitors aged 6–13 are also available, with timing and rankings.

name: Bieg Karnawałowy
description: The Carnival Run is a 10 km race held in Puszczykowo, combining sporting competition with running together in a carnival atmosphere. The event is part of the local running calendar, and previous editions have been held in Puszczykowo.

name: Bieg Zdobywców Modyni
description: The Bieg Zdobywców Modyni is an annual mountain race held in the Beskid Wyspowy, attracting runners from across Poland and Europe. The event offers a range of running and Nordic walking courses for different ability levels, as well as children’s races. It combines sporting competition with a family-friendly atmosphere and promotes the scenic Modyń mountain and the Beskid Wyspowy region. The organizers support local community engagement and an active lifestyle, and also offer additional activities and attractions for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain courses of 8.5 km and 17 km through the scenic Beskid Wyspowy
The longest course is 36 km and has ITRA certification (Bieg 6 Szczytów)
Courses are available as GPS files
additional: The event features races for adults and children, Nordic walking, and additional family attractions, such as sweets dropped from a light aircraft and sensory activities for children. The organizers provide GPS files for the courses. The Bieg 6 Szczytów (36 km) is certified by ITRA and included in the international trail-running rankings.

name: Wrocławska Dycha
description: Wrocławska Dycha is an annual running event held in Wrocław, offering 5 km and 10 km distances. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, with an appealing route through the urban surroundings. The event is open and welcoming to participants, promoting an active lifestyle and sporting competition in the heart of the city.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances
Urban route in Wrocław
A race for recreational and experienced runners

name: XVI Bieg Górski
description: The 16th Leszno–Grzybowo Mountain Run is a forest trail race organized by the “Aktywna Trz” Physical Culture Association. The race takes place in the scenic area around Leszno and Grzybowo, offering participants a demanding route through forest terrain. The event is held regularly and is popular with mountain runners. It is a great opportunity to test your abilities on natural trails and spend time outdoors.
course_highlights: A forest route with a mountain-running character
Scenic areas around Leszno and Grzybowo
A demanding race through natural terrain
additional: The edition scheduled for 13 February 2027 is listed as the 17th Leszno–Grzybowo Mountain Run; the 16th edition took place on 14 February 2026.

name: XXVI Bieg Grzmią Pod Stoczkiem Armaty
description: The 26th “The Cannons Thunder at Stoczek” Race is an annual road race held in Stoczek Łukowski. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering a unique atmosphere and sporting excitement. The route passes through the town’s scenic areas, bringing together elements of history and local culture. The organizers ensure professional event management and participant safety.
course_highlights: Road race route through the center of Stoczek Łukowski
Scenic views and historic sites along the route
A local community atmosphere and a celebration of sport
additional: Available sources describe the 26th edition, which took place on February 14, 2026; they do not confirm an event scheduled for February 13, 2027.

name: Zimowy Bieg Piasta
description: The Piast Winter Run is an annual winter race, now in its 22nd edition, organized by WKB Piast Wrocław and held in Miękinia. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in a friendly atmosphere, welcoming both fast and more leisurely runners. Participants can also take part in the Valentine’s Day distance, giving the event a special character and encouraging people to celebrate Valentine’s Day together. The race takes place on routes near the Oder, and the organizers focus on fun and bringing runners together.
course_highlights: A winter route around Miękinia and along the Oder embankments
A welcoming atmosphere for both fast and recreational runners
A special Valentine’s Day distance for couples and loved ones
additional: Participants are encouraged to dress up for Valentine’s Day. Runners can take part in the Valentine’s Day distance with a partner. The race is held in changeable winter weather, and the route may sometimes be changed due to terrain conditions. Volunteers and sponsors support the event. Previous editions have also featured a Valentine’s Day distance. The race calendar gives an approximate date of February 14 for 2027, which differs from the stated date of February 13.

price_range: 3000 Ft regisztrációs díj; 2000 Ft chiprajtszám-díj; futamonként nincs nevezési díj
