description: Run 4 Her Klimkówka is a charity race organized to celebrate Women’s Day. It takes place beside the picturesque Lake Klimkówka, at Czarna Chata LUXURY RESORT. Participants can choose between two distances, 5 km and 10 km, on a gently graded asphalt course suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. After the race, participants can enjoy a concert by the band Krucabanda and compete for attractive prizes, including the grand prize: a weekend stay for two at Czarna Chata. The event combines sporting competition with a charitable mission and the promotion of the Low Beskids region.
course_highlights: Gently graded asphalt course with minimal elevation gain (15 m over 5 km; 30 m over 10 km)
Scenic paths beside Lake Klimkówka
5 km (1 loop) and 10 km (2 loops)
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:45 at Czarna Chata LUXURY RESORT. There is no parking at Czarna Chata; parking is available beside the Water Sports Centre (about a 600 m walk). The race pack includes a clothing bag, vouchers for a hot meal and tea, a commemorative T-shirt, and gifts from local municipalities. Electronic timing and medical support are provided. A concert by the band Krucabanda follows the race. Cash and in-kind prizes are awarded to the top women and men in both distances, and prizes are raffled among all participants. In the 2026 edition, the start, finish, and race office were at Czarna Chata LUXURY RESORT in Klimkówka; a concert by the band Krucabanda was announced after the race. This information refers to the previous edition and may not apply in 2027.

name: XRUN Tajemnicze Kopce
description: XRUN Tajemnicze Kopce is a mountain trail race held in the picturesque Glichowiec Range near Dobczyce. Runners can choose from several distances, from short children’s races to the demanding 32 km Long Trail with 1,100 m of elevation gain. The route passes through dense forests, technical climbs, ravines and winding forest trails, with the finish at Hotel Dobczyce. It’s a unique opportunity to experience the spirit of XRUN and take on natural mountain terrain.
course_highlights: A mountain crossing of the Glichowiec Range, with technical climbs and descents
The Long Trail covers the loop via Kacza Góra, Trupielec and Glichowiec twice
The final kilometres pass through Stare Miasto and the Dobczyce Dam before finishing at Hotel Dobczyce
additional: The start and finish for all distances are at Hotel Dobczyce. The time limit is 6 hours for the Long Trail (32 km), 4 hours for the Classic Trail (21 km) and 14 km, and 2 hours for the 6 km race. Age categories for the children’s races cover ages 3 to 15. Routes include natural forest trails, technical sections and fast descents. The time limits for the 32, 21 and 14 km distances are 6, 4 and 4 hours respectively; the limit for 6 km is 2 hours. The children’s races cover distances of 150, 300, 500, 800 and 1,000 m.

name: XVIII Bieg Kazików
description: The 18th Kaziki Run is an annual street-running celebration in Radom, attracting both recreational and experienced runners. The 10 km route runs through the city centre, offering a demanding race with a fast pace from the start. The event combines sport, community engagement and charitable activities, making it an important fixture in the region’s sporting calendar.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through the centre of Radom
A fast-paced, demanding race from the first metres
A road race with a history and sporting tradition
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Radom City Hall, 53 Żeromskiego Street. The organisers provide race shirts and medals for participants. The event also includes races for children and young people, as well as charitable activities. It brings residents together and promotes outdoor physical activity. The previous edition, the 18th Kaziki Run, took place on 8 March 2026; available sources do not confirm details of the edition planned for 2027.

name: Cytadela by Night # 112
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed runs held in Cytadela Park in Poznań. The runs cover a distance of approximately 5 km and attract both recreational and more experienced runners. The event combines recreation and sport, offering a great opportunity to spend an active evening in the park’s scenic surroundings. It is very popular and held regularly, creating a welcoming atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: The run takes place in Cytadela Park in Poznań
Approximately 5 km with timekeeping
An evening route through scenic, green surroundings
additional: The runs are free and held regularly, with timekeeping. The event is recreational and open to everyone. Timed run.

name: Deset jarních kilometrů
description: A spring running race in Kunčina near Moravská Třebová, now in its 11th year. The main race is 10 km on a rolling course (95% asphalt, with 400 m on a compacted dirt road), alongside a 3.8 km hobby race and children’s races from 40 to 919 m. The race is part of the Iscarex Cup.
additional:
Start times: children’s races at 13:00, hobby race at 15:00, main race at 15:05.
Race-day registration: children 11:30–12:30; 10 km and hobby races 12:00–14:00.
Entry fees in advance / on the day: 10 km 250 / 350 Kč, hobby 150 / 250 Kč, children 50 / 100 Kč.
Prizes of 1,000 Kč for the fastest man (under 35 min) and woman (under 40 min), and 2,000 Kč for a course record. Competitions for the best climber and sprinter via Strava.
Travel by train to Kunčina station. Online registration at desetjarnichkm.cz (registration opens in early November).

name: XIV Zimowy Bieg Dębowy
location: Zespół Szkół, ul. Sportowa, Dąbrowa, Gmina Dąbrowa, Poland
description: The Winter Oak Run is an annual sporting event held since 2012. It attracts an ever-growing number of participants and is an important sporting event in Mogilno County. The race promotes physical activity among people of all ages and is part of the Mogilno County Crown series. The main race route passes through the villages of Dąbrowa, Parlin and Parlinek, and runs on asphalt certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The organizers warmly invite everyone to take part and celebrate their passion for sport together.
course_highlights: Route certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
Asphalt surface with markers every kilometer
Water stations along the route in Parlin and Parlinek
additional: The start and finish are by the school sports field of the School Complex in Dąbrowa, ul. Sportowa. The event includes children's races over distances from 60 m to 1,000 m and a 7.5 km Nordic walking event. Electronic timing. Awards ceremonies and prize drawings take place in the sports hall in Dąbrowa. The race office is open from 07:00; registration closes at 10:45. The start and finish are by the School Complex sports field on ul. Sportowa; the race office is in the sports hall. The race pack includes, among other things, a medal, a hot meal and an SMS with the result. Registration is open until 3 March 2027; there is no race-day registration or fee.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Boisko w Lesie Osobowickim, Wrocław, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful woodland settings in city parks. The Wrocław event takes place in Osobowicki Forest, with the start and finish located by the sports field. The races are open to runners of different ages and ability levels, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The series is held regularly, and participants can compete in both local and national rankings. The course remains unchanged, allowing runners to compare their results over the years.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in the woodland setting of Osobowicki Forest
Start and finish by the sports field in Osobowicki Forest
A course suitable for both beginners and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. The main race is open to participants aged 16 and over. It is not possible to drive directly to the start or race office; parking is available along Osobowicka Street, with traffic management in place. CITY TRAIL Junior races over shorter distances also take place on race day. A group warm-up before the main race starts at 10:45. The event follows a fixed schedule, and the race office remains in the same location throughout the season. The start is scheduled for 11:00. Registration is available online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day. Driving near the start and race office is not possible; parking is available along Osobowicka Street.

name: 1 Gibko Piątka
description: Gibko Piątka is a fast 5 km race on a PZLA-certified course, held in Frydek, Miedźna Municipality. The course is flat with minimal elevation gain, making it ideal for both beginner runners and those looking to improve their personal best. The event also includes the Wartki Bajtel run for children and young people up to 16 years old, divided into three age groups, offering an appropriate level of competition and plenty of fun. The event attracts hundreds of runners and is a great opportunity for sporting competition and a good time.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 5 km course
Flat and fast course with minimal elevation gain
Course ideal for a personal best
additional: The event includes the Wartki Bajtel run for children and young people up to 16 years old, divided into three age groups (3–6, 7–10, and 11–16 years). The awards ceremony is planned after the race, and the race office is on site. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association. Registration is open until race day. The cited sources refer to the first edition on 14 March 2026; they do not confirm details of the edition scheduled for 13 March 2027.

name: 42 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Kuropatnik, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej (PTTK Strzelin)
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is an orienteering event on foot in which teams of 2–5 plan their own route to visit as many checkpoints as possible within a set time. The checkpoints are spread across the terrain and marked on a map. The event is open to participants of different ages and experience levels, from enthusiasts to those taking part for recreation. Rogaining combines tourism and sport and is an excellent way to enjoy the outdoors. Organized by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin Land Branch, it has a long tradition and is popular among orienteering enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Teams travel on foot only, using a map and compass to navigate the terrain
Checkpoints have different point values depending on how difficult they are to find
Participants can choose and change their own route, of any length from around 5 km to 70 km
additional: The event takes place in teams of 2–5. Each team independently decides the order in which to visit checkpoints and which checkpoints to visit. Rogaining is open to all age groups and genders. The event combines tourism and sport and is also attractive to families. Night rogaining events have also been held in the past. Strzeliński Rogaining is contested in teams of 2–5; checkpoints have different point values, and the route is covered on foot.

name: Baran Trail Races
organizer: Michał Loska, Piotr Winter, MWC sp. z o.o. i Gmina Węgierska Górka
description: Baran Trail Race is a mountain running event taking place on March 13, 2027, in Węgierska Górka. Runners can choose from several distances, including 10 km, 25 km, and 60 km, with substantial elevation gain and challenging mountain terrain in the Silesian Beskids. The 10 km course is a loop with numerous climbs and descents, following scenic trails, including a section of the Main Beskid Trail. The race is officially scored in the ITRA and UTMB systems, highlighting its competitive nature and endurance challenge.
course_highlights: The 10 km course is an 11-kilometer loop with approximately 550 m of elevation gain
A section of the course follows the Main Beskid Trail (red trail)
Varied terrain: narrow, muddy paths, asphalt descents, and scenic sections
additional: There are no aid stations on the 10 km course. The intermediate time limit for the 25 km race is 5 hours, at the sports hall in Węgierska Górka. Mandatory equipment includes, among other items, a switched-on and charged phone with emergency numbers and the organizer’s number saved, a visible race bib, and a chip attached to the shoe. There are no disposable cups at the aid stations. Navigation using the latest GPX file is recommended; supplementary course markings are permitted in accordance with the regulations. Registration is scheduled to open on October 13, 2026. BTR 25 is a UTMB Index 20K category race and awards 1 ITRA point; BTR 60 is a UTMB Index 50K category race and awards 3 ITRA points. BTR 60 has an intermediate time limit of 5 hours at the 25th kilometer. The organizer recommends using the latest GPX file for navigation.

name: III Beskidzkie Grónie Zima
description: Beskidzkie Grónie Zima is a winter mountain race held in the picturesque town of Istebna. Participants can choose from three routes of different lengths: Rodzinna 15 km, Beskidzkie Grónie 30 km, and Beskidzkie Grónie 50 km. The routes wind through the varied mountain terrain of the Beskids, offering both challenging trails and beautiful views. The event is part of the Beskidzkie Grónie series and is growing in popularity among mountain running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The routes cross the varied mountain terrain of the Beskids
Three distances available: 15 km, 30 km, and 50 km
Picturesque views and natural winter trail conditions
additional: The routes are available to download in GPX format. The event is available in the UTRA app, which provides easy access to event information. It includes three distances of varying difficulty to suit runners of different experience levels. This is a mountain hiking event, not a race. The family route has an elevation gain of approximately 410 m and a time limit of 7 hours.

name: IX Cross Maraton Jana Kulbaczyńskiego
description: The 9th Jan Kulbaczyński Cross Marathon is a marathon held in picturesque Kodeń, in the Masovian Voivodeship. The event takes place on Sunday, March 14, 2027, and offers an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately difficult course. The organizers provide training plans tailored to different experience levels, helping participants prepare optimally for the start. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes running and athletic development.
course_highlights: A marathon course measuring 42.195 km
A moderately difficult cross-country run
Picturesque landscapes of Kodeń and the surrounding area
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to runners’ VDOT levels, with instructions and expert support. You can manage the race listing and arrange marketing cooperation through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: Ladies & Gentlemen

price_tiers.distance: Bieg 5 km i 10 km oraz Nordic Walking 5 km

description: The Ladies & Gentlemen Run 2026 will take place on March 14 in Kabaty Forest in Warsaw as part of the Warsaw Grand Prix. This running event gives participants the opportunity to compete over different distances, with age and gender categories. The race office is located in Kabaty, and the different distances will start at different times. The organizer provides a race pack, a commemorative medal, and prizes for the top finishers and oldest participants.
course_highlights: Routes in Kabaty Forest—natural forest paths
5 km and 10 km races, plus 5 km Nordic walking
Time limits: 60 minutes for the 5 km run and 80 minutes for the 10 km run
additional: The race office opens at 09:00 in the clearing next to the Kabaty Metro Technical Depot. Race bibs will be distributed only on race day. A special trophy will be awarded to the oldest male and female participants, along with recognition for the funniest outfit. Prizes will be awarded in the overall standings and age categories, separately for women and men. 120 participants took part in the race.

name: Mistrzostwa Polski Masters w Biegach Prz...
description: The Polish Masters Cross Country Championships is a national competition for masters runners, scheduled for March 14, 2026, in Toruń. The races will take place in Rudelka Park, next to the Kujawsko-Pomorska Arena. It is an opportunity to compete in cross-country running and meet masters athletes from across Poland.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in Rudelka Park
Rudelka Park is next to the Kujawsko-Pomorska Arena
The competition takes place in Toruń
additional: The competition is scheduled for Saturday, March 14, 2026.

name: Odlotowa 5 - Olsztyn Mazury
description: Odlotowa 5 - Olsztyn Mazury is a 5 km race held in the scenic area around Olsztyn-Mazury Airport in Szymany. The event takes place annually and attracts runners of various age groups, offering a friendly atmosphere and professional organization. The course is fast and accessible to runners of varying experience levels. Participants can expect efficient service and the option to collect their race packs on race day or the day before.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Start and finish at Olsztyn-Mazury Airport in Szymany
Fast, flat course conducive to good results
additional: Race packs can be collected at the race office in Szczytno on 22.03.2025 or in Szymany on 23.03.2025. Authorization is required to collect a race pack, as is parental consent for minors. Olsztyn-Mazury Airport co-organized the 2026 edition. Sources for that edition stated a limit of 600 participants and a 60-minute time limit for the 5 km distance; it has not been confirmed whether these rules will apply in 2027.

name: Test Coopera - wiosna
description: The Cooper Test is a recurring run organized by the Mafia Team Sports Club in Lubliniec. This sporting event takes place in spring and autumn and is popular with local runners. The run is an endurance test, and its results are regularly published and archived by the organizers. The event is part of a wider series of runs organized by the club.
course_highlights: An endurance test with results measured in meters
Spring edition of the recurring Mafia Team event
Location: Lubliniec
additional: Results from previous editions are available in the organizer’s archive.

name: Zimowy Bieg Trasą Mokrzyny
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

description: The Oxygen Cup is a traditional winter running series in Debrecen’s Nagyerdő, offering middle- and long-distance runners and amateur athletes the opportunity to compete. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, and encourage people to stay active during winter. The course follows the Nagyerdő’s natural, runner- and joint-friendly terrain, with a variety of distances for several age groups and categories. The series includes both individual and team competitions, strengthening the sense of community among participants.
course_highlights: Forest trails in the Nagyerdő with runner- and joint-friendly terrain
Distances: 1.5 km, 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km laps, with categories for several age groups
A running series featuring both individual and team competitions
additional: Participants need to register once per year for the series; there is no separate entry fee for individual races. Teams may have a minimum of 4 and a maximum of 8 members, regardless of gender or age. If a race number is lost or damaged, a replacement can be obtained for a fee of 2,000 HUF. Parking is available in the car park next to the cemetery. Registration is completed once per season; there is no per-race entry fee. A round may be cancelled in the event of dangerous weather or course conditions.

name: Kobeřická dvacítka
location: TJ Sokol Kobeřice sports ground, Kobeřice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

name: 5. Pietrasze Cross Country 5/5
description: Pietrasze Cross Country is a series of cross-country races held in Pietrasze Forest in Białystok. The course follows natural, varied forest terrain, with numerous ascents and descents that require versatility and good fitness. The event attracts runners who value sporting competition in scenic surroundings and the chance to socialize in a sporting atmosphere. Organizers offer the option to purchase a pass for the entire series, making it easier to take part and encouraging regular starts.
course_highlights: A course approximately 7.83 km long with 109 m of elevation gain
A run on natural forest surfaces: leaf litter, grass, sand, mud, and puddles, depending on the weather
The course is marked with blue-and-white tape, with volunteers and cyclists acting as guides
additional: Race packets are distributed from 8:30 to 9:30 at Primary School No. 32 named after Maj. Henryk Dobrzański, alias Hubal, at 29 Pietrasze Street. After the start, there is a music event with refreshments (doughnuts and tea) and an opportunity to socialize. Starts take place in designated start zones, with officials verifying participants and checking race numbers. The course is available as a downloadable GPX file for GPS watch users.

name: BeMore5K
description: BeMore5K is a special 5 km race held in Bemowo, Warsaw. Its fast, officially certified course is ideal for setting a personal best, combining high-level competition with the joy of running. The event attracts both experienced runners and people just starting out, offering attractive prizes, cheering zones, and professional photo and video coverage. The race takes place in a spirit of community and motivation, encouraging participants to push their limits and draw inspiration from others’ achievements.
course_highlights: Fast, PZLA-certified 5 km course
Start and finish on the western carriageway of Powstańców Śląskich, beyond Górczewska
The route runs along Powstańców Śląskich and Radiowa, with a turnaround near the Stare Bemowo stop
additional: Participant limit: 3,000 race packages. T-shirt size can be changed after logging in to b4sportonline.pl. The start and finish area is close to a metro line. Open 5 km Championships in age categories in five-year increments. Race time limit until 12:00; winners’ awards ceremony at 12:15. Race office and race-package pickup at the Bemowo District Office on March 14 (14:00–20:00) and March 15 (09:00–10:30). Side event: sports EXPO and cheering zone. The official website lists the date as March 7, 2027, which conflicts with the March 14, 2027 date in the metadata. The 2026 edition had a 45-minute time limit and a participant limit of 3,000; these details may not apply to the 2027 edition.

name: Cross Śrem Grand Prix

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 40 zł – przy zapisie online na jeden bieg

description: Cross Śrem Grand Prix is a cross-country running series held in the forested areas near the Orlik sports field in Psarskie, Śrem. The approximately 5.4 km course follows forest paths and paved sections, giving runners a chance to enjoy nature and a unique atmosphere of sporting competition. The start and finish are in the same location, making it easier to organize the event and cheer on the runners. Participants receive a medal, a post-race meal, and prizes in the age-group classifications. The event is organized by Śremski Sport together with the Municipality of Śrem and the Konstantynowo Forest District.
course_highlights: An approximately 5.4 km course on forest paths and paved sections
Start and finish at the Orlik sports field in Psarskie, in one convenient location for runners and spectators
A run surrounded by forest near the center of Śrem
additional: The race office, warm-up, and official opening take place at the Orlik sports field in Psarskie. The warm-up and opening are scheduled for around 11:45. Participants have access to water, hot tea, and coffee in the new building with changing rooms. A medal, a post-race meal, and prizes in the age-group classifications are provided. The start and finish are at the Orlik sports field in Psarskie. Information about the price and details of the edition scheduled for 14 March 2027 has not been confirmed by available sources.

name: II Bieg Trzech Wież
description: The 2nd Three Towers Run in Biała is a unique sporting event held among the oldest historic landmarks in the Opole region. Following the success of the first edition, the organizers invite participants to the next edition, with new features including children’s categories that bring generations together. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km runs, or a 5 km Nordic walking event. The race package includes a hot meal, a race pack, a recovery bar, drinks, sports merchandise and a commemorative medal. Trophies and attractive prizes, including cash prizes, are planned for the top finishers.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km running routes in the historic surroundings of Biała
5 km Nordic walking event
Children’s categories bringing different generations together
additional: The race package includes a hot meal, a recovery bar, drinks, sports merchandise and a commemorative medal. Trophies and cash prizes are planned for the top finishers. The event takes place among the oldest historic landmarks in the Opole region. The children’s categories encourage whole families to take part. The 2026 edition program included races for children and young people; the race package included, among other things, a commemorative medal, a hot meal and drinks.

name: Krakoski Kros
description: Krakoskikros is a cross-country running event held on unpaved paths and clearings in Kraków’s parks. The competition is open to people of various ages, from children to adults, and does not require a PZLA licence or club membership. The event features a range of athletics competitions, including sprints, middle-distance races, long jump, softball throw, and relays. The competitions take place in green spaces and at the AKF stadium in Kraków, with age- and gender-based categories.
course_highlights: A course on unpaved paths and clearings
Competitions in green spaces and at the AKF stadium in Kraków
A range of athletics competitions for children and adults
additional: Categories are organised by age and gender for children, young people, and adults. The project is carried out with financial support from the Małopolska Voivodeship.

name: Murowana Goślina Półmaraton
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Murowanej Goślinie
description: The Murowana Goślina Half Marathon is a historic race dating back to 1978. Initially organized for masters athletes, it is now open to everyone who wants to take on the half-marathon distance of 21.097 km. The race has a rich tradition and runs through the scenic surroundings of Murowana Goślina. After a break caused by the coronavirus pandemic, the race was revived in 2025 by the Centre for Culture and Sport in Murowana Goślina.
course_highlights: A classic half-marathon distance of 21.097 km
Scenic surroundings of Murowana Goślina
A tradition dating back to 1978, with a history of races for masters athletes
additional: The race is open to everyone, not just masters athletes. Entry fees increase across three registration periods, and registration is also available at the race office for a higher fee. The half-marathon has a long tradition and has been organized intermittently since 1978. The event is part of the Grand Prix series. The entry fees listed on the website are 99 zł, 119 zł, or 139 zł for the successive registration periods, and 200 zł at the race office.

name: Wrocławska Trzydziestka
description: Wrocławska Trzydziestka is a training run designed to prepare participants for a marathon, organized by the Pro-Run Wrocław Association. Runners can choose distances from 5 to 30 km, run on a 5 km loop. The course runs over gravel and cobblestones, with the start and finish at the Olympic Stadium in Wrocław. The event promotes running and physical activity among Wrocław residents, and showcases the city’s running routes.
course_highlights: 5 km loop over gravel and cobblestones
Start and finish at the Olympic Stadium, al. Paderewskiego 35
One hydration and refreshment point on the course, approximately every 5 km
additional: The time limit for completing the course is 4 hours. Timing is recorded using chips attached to race bibs; these are required to be classified. The race office opens at 8:00 on race day. The course is a 5 km loop, with a choice of 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, or 30 km. In previous editions, the race started at 9:00, the time limit was 4 hours, and a hydration and refreshment point was located approximately every 5 km. The details and price provided apply to a previous edition and do not confirm the conditions for 2027.

name: X Zimowe Grand Prix Zadyszki
location: ul. Kamieniec, near the animal shelter, Oświęcim, Poland
description: The 10th Zadyszka Winter Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Oświęcim Running Club “Zadyszka,” promoting running as a form of recreation and a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place in the scenic area around Kamieniec Street, near the animal shelter in Oświęcim. The club welcomes runners of all abilities to take part together and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the sense of community among local runners. The events are friendly and offer a chance to spend time actively outdoors.
course_highlights: The course runs around Kamieniec Street, near the animal shelter in Oświęcim
The races take place in a winter setting, adding a distinctive character
The event brings together the local running community and promotes a healthy lifestyle
additional: The club holds meetings on the first Wednesday of every month at 5:00 p.m. at MOSiR, 15 Legionów Street, Oświęcim. The events are open to runners of all abilities. The club maintains an events calendar and actively communicates through social media. No details about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees are provided on the website. In the previous edition, registration was available only on race day, and the start was scheduled for 11:00 a.m. This information relates to the 2025/2026 season and does not confirm the rules for the 2027 edition.

name: XI Myślenicki Bieg Uliczny
location: Stadion KS Dalin Myślenice im. Gustawa Grochala, Myślenice, Poland
organizer: KS Dalin Myślenice – Sekcja Biegowa i Miasto i Gmina Myślenice
description: The Myślenice Street Run is a 10 km race held on the streets of Myślenice. In its 11th edition, held on March 15, 2026, 389 runners took part. The event is organized by the running community of KS Dalin Myślenice in cooperation with the City and Municipality of Myślenice.
course_highlights: A 10 km street course in Myślenice
The start and finish are associated with the KS Dalin Myślenice Gustaw Grochal Stadium
The race is organized as part of a local running event
additional: Available information about the 11th edition concerns the race held on March 15, 2026; it does not confirm an edition scheduled for March 14, 2027.

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic Walking event held in the Panewniki forests in Katowice. The course is approximately 4,882 meters per loop and can be completed up to four times, with a time limit of 3 hours. The event promotes an active lifestyle and educates participants about proper conduct in forest areas. Participants may be amateurs or members of sports clubs. The event is organized by the Jerzy Kukuczka Academy of Physical Education and the Katowice State Fire Service.
course_highlights: Loop course approximately 4,882 m long
The course is marked at least every 1 km
Participants may complete up to 4 loops, with a time limit of 3 hours
additional: The participant limit is 700. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration accepting responsibility for their participation or provide a medical certificate. Minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian during check-in. Fees are non-refundable but may be transferred to a subsequent race, provided the request is submitted by 15:00 on the Thursday before the race. Running and Nordic Walking events are available. The time limit is 3 hours. The start is at the forest entrance opposite M&M Gastro, 58A Owsiana Street; race-day registration is available at the race office from 9:30 to 10:30.

name: Łódzkie Biegi Górskie
location: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 61, ul. Okólna 183, Łódź, Poland
price_range: 30–65 zł przy płatności do niedzieli poprzedzającej bieg; 40 zł dla juniorów lub 80 zł w kategorii OPEN przy dogłoszeniu
description: Łódź Mountain Runs is a series of cross-country mountain races held in Łagiewnicki Forest, with distances of 6.6 km, 10.5 km and 14.4 km and elevation gains of 140, 220 and 300 metres respectively. The races are organised by the “Orientuś” Student Sports Club and take place at Primary School No. 61 in Łódź. Each participant receives a cast medal and a meal at every event, with competition in junior and OPEN categories. The series promotes physical activity and sporting competition in scenic woodland.
course_highlights: Routes in Modrzew Forest, measuring 6.6 km, 10.5 km and 14.4 km
Elevation gains of 140 to 300 metres on running loops
Scenic woodland routes with multiple loops (two or three laps)
additional: At every event, each participant receives a cast medal and a meal. A free event is available when registering for the whole series. Four of the five events count towards the overall standings. Event wrap-ups begin at 12:35, and prize giveaways at 12:40. The race office is open from 9:30 on race day. Parking is limited near the event base; parking around the Shrine of St Anthony of Padua and other designated locations is recommended. Electronic timing from a mass start. The fifth race in the series will take place on 14 March 2027 at 11:00. Event base: Primary School No. 61, 183 Okólna Street, Łódź. Entry fees for the OPEN category depend on the distance: PLN 55 for 6.6 km, PLN 60 for 10.5 km and PLN 65 for 14.4 km.

name: 106 Vejvanovických
location: Hostinec na Křižovatce, Vejvanovice, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic

name: BackYard Ultra Warmia
description: BackYard Ultra Warmia is a unique and extreme “Last One Standing” ultramarathon, regarded as the best race of its kind in Poland, with world-class results. The race takes place in Warmia, where Poland’s highest results are achieved and champions of this format are made. The atmosphere is legendary, with long, cold nights, rain, a blazing campfire, and the dark mood of the Warmian forest. It’s the perfect place for those who want to take on the best competitors and push beyond their own limits of endurance.
course_highlights: Course through the dark Warmian forest
Extreme weather conditions: long, cold nights and rain
A blazing campfire and a legendary atmosphere
additional: BackYard Ultra Warmia is a “Last One Standing” race with record-breaking results in Poland. The event is known for its difficult conditions, including cold nights and rain. Participants have the chance to qualify for the National Team and represent Poland at the World Championships and at Big Dog’s Backyard Ultra in the USA. The race follows international Backyard Ultra rules. Outside assistance is prohibited during the loop.

name: X Setka Komandosa
location: Ośrodek Harcerski, ul. Pusta, Lubliniec, Poland
description: The X Setka Komandosa is a 100 km ultramarathon held in challenging woodland conditions around Lubliniec. Runners complete the course in full field or training uniform, carrying a mandatory backpack weighing at least 10 kg. The race is part of the Komandos Grand Slam and promotes competition among uniformed services and awareness of service in special forces units. The start and finish are at the Scout Centre on Pusta Street in Lubliniec, and the time limit is 20 hours.
course_highlights: The 100 km course consists of five laps on forest roads
Full field or training uniform and tactical boots covering the ankles are required
A backpack measuring at least 45 × 30 cm and weighing at least 10 kg is mandatory
additional: The participant limit is 999. The race course consists of five laps on forest roads. Clothing and equipment requirements are strict, including a mandatory uniform, tactical boots, and a backpack weighing at least 10 kg. The race counts toward the Komandos Grand Slam. The “Setki Komandosa” badge can be ordered for an additional fee. The X edition took place in March 2026, with more than 1,000 participants.

name: ALS charitatívny beh
description: ALS charitatívny beh - memoriál Jána Svočáka je horský trailový beh v lokalite Svit, ktorý ponúka náročnú 21 km trať s prevýšením 950 metrov. Trať vedie prevažne lesom (80 %) a lúkami (20 %) a obsahuje dve občerstvovačky na 8. a 16. kilometri. Okrem hlavného behu sú súčasťou podujatia aj detské behy, štafety, nordic walking a špeciálny trail so psom. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov, ktorí hľadajú výzvu v prírodnom prostredí s kvalitnou organizáciou a certifikovanou traťou.
course_highlights: 21 km trail s 950 m prevýšenia
80 % trasy vedie lesom, 20 % lúkou
Dve občerstvovačky na 8. a 16. km
additional: Individuálne štarty pre trail so psom medzi 09:30 a 09:40 v 10-sekundových intervaloch s presným časom na štartovnom čísle. Štafety sú 3×1,7 km s prevýšením 140 m, povrch trate les, lúka, asfalt a šotolina. Nordic walking má povrch 90 % les, 10 % asfalt. Všetky detské kategórie sú ocenené a vyhodnotené hneď v cieli. Certifikácia trate ITRA, 1 kvalifikačný bod pre ALS 21 km. Podujatie podporuje ľudí s nervovo-svalovými ochoreniami. Zdroje sa rozchádzajú v dátume ročníka 2027: uvedený dátum je 27. marca, zatiaľ čo stránka podujatia uvádza 20. marca.

name: Nitrianska 24 hodinovka – Memoriál Alexandra Bögiho
location: Atletický štadión TJ Stavbár Nitra, Nitra, Slovakia

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland setting by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly test themselves on the same course. The event is recreational and competitive in nature, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The start and finish are near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, and the course runs through picturesque woodland and the city beach. The races are part of the Grand Prix CITY TRAIL 2026/2027 series, which includes four races in Poznań, with an overall classification and a separate classification for each city.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in the woodland setting by Lake Rusałka
Start near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, with the finish by the city beach
The course is suitable for both beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event follows a consistent schedule, and the race office remains in the same location throughout the season. Participants can choose charity packages supporting the Siepomaga Foundation. The event receives funding from the budget of the City of Poznań. The series also includes races for children.

name: Zimowe Biegi Górskie Falenica
location: Falenica Dune, Mazowiecki Landscape Park, Warsaw, Poland
description: The Falenica Winter Mountain Runs are an annual running event held on the Falenica dune in the Masovian Landscape Park in Warsaw. Runners can choose from three distances: 3.33 km, 6.66 km, or 10 km, corresponding to one, two, or three loops with elevation gains of 85 m, 170 m, and 255 m, respectively. The race office is located at Primary School No. 124 and is open on race day from 9:00 to 10:30. The course is marked on the ground, and the races traditionally take place on Saturdays, attracting runners who enjoy winter challenges in natural, hilly terrain.
course_highlights: The course runs along the Falenica dune in the Masovian Landscape Park
Three distances available: 3.33 km (1 loop), 6.66 km (2 loops), and 10 km (3 loops)
Elevation gains range from 85 m to 255 m, depending on the distance
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30 at Primary School No. 124, ul. Bartoszycka 45/47. In the event of epidemic-related restrictions, the office may operate outdoors near the start, without changing facilities. Race office: Primary School No. 124, ul. Bartoszycka 45/47; open from 9:00 to 10:30. If the school cannot be used, the race office may operate outdoors near the start.

name: 10 KonstantyNOVA Dycha by Night
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 11th KonstantyNOVA DYCHA by NIGHT is a unique 10-kilometer race through the scenic areas of the Konstantynowo Forest District. In 2027, its night edition will be held for the second time, with runners taking on the 10 km distance after dark and required to wear headlamps or carry flashlights. Children’s and youth races take place during the day over shorter distances tailored to different age groups. The event is inclusive and charitable, with an opportunity to support a local association when collecting race packs.
course_highlights: The route passes through the scenic areas of the Konstantynowo Forest District
Night edition of the main 10 km race
Children’s and youth races over distances from 150 m to 1,000 m
additional: Children’s and youth races start at 16:30. Participants in the main race are required to have a headlamp or flashlight. When collecting race packs, participants can voluntarily support a local association by putting a donation in the collection box. The main race will take place on March 20, 2027; children’s and youth races are scheduled from 16:30. When collecting race packs, participants will be able to make a voluntary donation to support an association from the Municipality of Mosina.

name: 14 Luboń Track
location: Stadion Miejski w Luboniu, Luboń, Poland
description: The 15th Luboń Track is an athletics competition held at the municipal stadium in Luboń. The event is scheduled for Saturday, August 29, 2026, and includes races over 3,000 m and 1,609 m, as well as children’s races over shorter distances suited to participants’ ages. Runners are divided into heats based on their submitted times, with results classified by gender and age category. Timing is provided by PZLA judges, and each heat is limited to 15–20 participants. The detailed timetable will be published on the event’s official Facebook fan page.
course_highlights: Races at the municipal stadium in Luboń
Heats divided according to submitted times
Results classified by gender and age category
additional: Each heat is limited to 15–20 participants. Heats are assigned based on submitted times. Timing is provided by PZLA judges, without photo-finish equipment. Children’s races are held in different age categories, with separate classifications by gender. The detailed timetable is published on the Facebook fan page two days before the competition. Heats are determined based on submitted times. The 1,609 m and 3,000 m races are for participants aged 13 and over.

name: 8 Dycha z Górką
description: The VIII Dycha z Górką Run is a cross-country race organized by the Oborygeni Running Group in Oborniki Śląskie. The course consists of two five-kilometer loops over the hilly terrain known as “Grzybek.” The event takes place in early spring, offering runners a challenge on scenic, hilly terrain. The start and finish are located on Kasztanowa Street.
course_highlights: Cross-country route over the hilly terrain of “Grzybek”
Two five-kilometer loops
Start and finish on Kasztanowa Street
additional: Admission is ticketed. The race takes place from 10:00 to 13:00. The route is a cross-country course through Oborniki’s Grzybek. Confirmed information concerns the VIII edition, scheduled for 21 March 2026, with the start at 10:00. The date of 20 March 2027 has not been confirmed.

name: Bieg Stolarza
description: The 7th Stolarz Run is an annual running event organized in Radomsko by the Radomsko Cycling and Running Sports Club. The race takes place on a route suited to runners, and timing is provided using a modern electronic system based on RFID chips. The race is scheduled to start at 16:00, and participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Running route in Radomsko
Electronic timing with RFID chips
High-quality organization by a local sports club
additional: Online registration closes the day before the race at 23:59. Timing is provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu, which uses systems used at the world’s largest marathons. Telephone contact is available from 8:00 to 16:00 and on race day via the emergency number. In 2026, the event was accompanied by a picnic and a charity drive. The previous edition was scheduled to start at 16:00.

name: Bieg Wiosenny
description: The XIII Spring Run in TAURON Park Śląski is an annual running event held in one of Europe’s largest urban parks, in Chorzów. The route winds through the scenic grounds of Park Śląski, giving participants a chance to connect with nature and enjoy the unique atmosphere of a sporting celebration. The finish is at Superauto.pl Stadion Śląski, and to mark the 13th edition, all participants whose race number contains the digit “13” will receive a gift. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, encouraging them to spend time actively outdoors.
course_highlights: The route passes through more than 600 hectares of meadows, forests and gardens in Park Śląski
Finish at Superauto.pl Stadion Śląski
Scenic running paths in a unique urban green oasis
additional: To mark the 13th edition, all participants whose race number contains the digit “13” will receive a gift. The route passes through Park Śląski, one of Europe’s largest urban parks, with varied vegetation and landscapes. The start and finish are at Superauto.pl Stadion Śląski. In previous editions, places were limited. Details of the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed.

name: Mistrzostwa Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie w Bie...
Na przijmo bez Gaszowice
location: OKiS recreational area, Rydułtowska 7, Gaszowice, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Gaszowicach
description: Na Przijmo bez Gaszowice i Okolice is a spring orienteering race held near Gaszowice, offering four routes of varying difficulty and distance. Participants can choose a walking route of approximately 50 km (TP50), a cycling route of approximately 50 km (TR50), a shorter 15 km walking route (TP15), or a family route of approximately 10 km with additional attractions. The race takes place at the OKiS recreational grounds in Gaszowice and combines sporting competition with the chance to enjoy time outdoors. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and a hot meal, while the top finishers on the TP50, TR50, and TP15 routes also receive prizes. This event is for everyone who values exercise, fun, and being close to nature.
course_highlights: Walking and cycling routes of approximately 50 km
Family route with attractions and activities for children and adults
Start and finish at the OKiS recreational grounds in Gaszowice
additional: Every participant receives a medal bearing the event logo and a hot recovery meal. The top finishers on the TP50, TR50, and TP15 routes receive additional prizes. The family route includes extra attractions and activities along the course. In the previous edition, the event base was at the recreational grounds by OKiS, ul. Rydułtowska 7, Gaszowice. In 2025, participants received a medal and a hot recovery meal.

name: Ultramaraton Zielonogórski
description: The Zielona Góra New Borders Ultramarathon is a unique running event held in the picturesque Piast Hills in Zielona Góra. As part of the anniversary edition, participants can choose between two distances: 13 km and a new, demanding 23 km course featuring technical sections, numerous elevation gains, and beautiful views. It is an excellent option for trail-running enthusiasts who want to experience a mountain atmosphere without leaving the city. The event has a welcoming atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners, promising sporting excitement and unforgettable experiences.
course_highlights: The 13 km course features dynamic changes of pace, forest singletrack, and demanding climbs
The new 23 km course features technical sections, numerous climbs, and fast descents
Picturesque trails in the Piast Hills, with beautiful views and a natural trail-running character
additional: The Ultramarathon offers several running distances: 23 km, 48 km, and 103 km, as well as a solo 103 km duathlon and a 103 km cycling race. The 48 km and 23 km courses start at checkpoints in Nowy Kisielin and Jarogniewice. The organizer provides professional catering during the event. GPX course files are available to download. Information on the official website refers to the 12th edition on 21 March 2026; a GPX track for the 103 km course is available.

name: VI Koleżeński Bieg Henryka Brauna
description: The 6th Henryk Braun Friends’ Run is a 10 km race taking place in Radzyny, Masovian Voivodeship, on Sunday, March 21, 2027. The race is an excellent opportunity to test your running fitness on a moderately challenging asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to each runner’s level. The event is part of the running calendar and is aimed at runners looking for a spring challenge.
course_highlights: 10 km distance
Moderately challenging asphalt course
Held in Radzyny, Masovian Voivodeship
additional: Training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including training instructions and expert support.

name: Wiosenny Ultra Świr
location: Centrum Sportów Zimowych w Ptaszkowej, Ptaszkowa, Grybów, Poland
description: Ultra Świr is a mountain race run on a 15.5 km loop with +650 m of elevation gain, starting at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa. The route features a fast, steep climb to the summit of Mount Jaworze (882 m above sea level), followed by a sharp descent to the aid station in the valley. Competitors can choose how many loops to complete within the time limit, allowing them to adapt the distance to their abilities. The race combines mountain challenges with a comfortable event base offering changing rooms, showers, a hot meal and a support area, among other facilities.
course_highlights: A 15.5 km loop with +650 m of elevation gain
A fast, steep climb to the summit of Mount Jaworze (882 m above sea level)
90% trails and gravel surfaces; aid stations at 6 km and at the event base
additional: Timing is provided using B4Sport chips. The event base at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa offers changing rooms, showers, hot water, lockable lockers, a hot recovery meal (including vegetarian options), a support area, and space for a sun lounger or tent for 12-hour and 24-hour teams. Free, ample parking is available directly next to race registration. Safety on the course is a priority, and competitors are required to check off the mandatory gear before packing it in their backpacks. The programme includes 6- and 12-hour races, a single loop, and a 17 km Nordic walking event. For the timed races, only completed full loops count.

name: Wiosna z kompasem
description: Wiosna z kompasem is a 10 km race held in Bobrowniki, Mazowieckie. It is an excellent opportunity to prepare for a spring race using training plans tailored to your individual level and VDOT. The organizers offer detailed training instructions and support from experts, helping you prepare optimally for the race. The event is aimed at runners looking for a challenge on a moderately difficult asphalt course.
course_highlights: Asphalt course
10 km distance
Intermediate level
additional: Training plans from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s level and VDOT. Expert support and detailed training instructions are provided. Organizers can manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing. The date of 21 March 2027 listed in calendars is tentative; it has not been confirmed whether the event will take place.

name: XX Bieg Wiosny
organizer: Wydział Kultury i Sportu Urzędu Miasta Siemianowice Śląskie oraz Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji „Pszczelnik”
description: The 20th Spring Run and Nordic Walking is an annual sporting event organized by the “Pszczelnik” Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Siemianowice Śląskie. Participants cover a 5.5-kilometre route along the paths of Pszczelnik Park, passing through the Golf Course, Bażantarnia and Rzęsa Pond, and finishing in Pszczelnik Park. The event has a friendly atmosphere, and every participant receives a sweet treat and a drink. Entries are accepted by email until 18 March and on race day at the Race Office.
course_highlights: 5.5 km route along the paths of Pszczelnik Park
Passes through the Golf Course and Bażantarnia
Views of Rzęsa Pond
additional: Entries for the race are accepted by email until 11:00 on 18 March. After that, paper entries can be submitted at the Race Office on race day between 10:15 and 10:50. Every participant receives a sweet treat and a drink. The route follows park paths with natural scenery and recreational areas. The organizer’s announcement refers to the event on 21 March 2026 and says that entries are accepted by email until 18 March, followed by registration at the Race Office. It does not confirm a date of 20 March 2027.

description: The Kraków Marzanna Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Kraków, combining sporting competition with the opportunity to admire the beauty of the city. The half-marathon course passes through some of Kraków’s most beautiful areas on roads closed to traffic and is certified by the PZLA. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and kicks off the 2027 running season. The event also includes the Kraków “For Little Hearts” 5K Run. Participants start in time-based waves according to their predicted finish times, allowing for efficient race organization and competition at different levels.
course_highlights: The course passes through some of Kraków’s most beautiful areas, featuring exceptional architecture
The race takes place on roads closed to traffic and is certified by the PZLA
Refreshment stations approximately every 5 km offering water, isotonic drinks, bananas, and snacks
additional: The start and finish locations will be confirmed later. The start is divided into time-based waves according to participants’ predicted finish times. Refreshment stations along the course offer water, isotonic drinks, bananas, dark chocolate, and sugar cubes; at the finish, an apple and a poppy-seed roll are also available. The race office and Expo are open on Saturday and Sunday at MOS Kraków Zachód Stadium. Payment is available online or by traditional bank transfer. During registration, participants can order medal engraving, a home delivery package, and the official T-shirt. The accompanying “For Little Hearts” run is 5 km. A virtual edition is also available and can be run anywhere except on a treadmill.

name: 12 Harpagańska Dycha
location: VII Liceum Ogólnokształcące im. Krzysztofa Kamila Baczyńskiego, Sosnowiec, Poland
description: We invite you to take part in the 12th Harpagańska Dysza, which will take place on March 21, 2027, in Sosnowiec, at the Krzysztof Kamil Baczyński No. 7 General Secondary School. The race is organized by Harpagan Sosnowiec Sports Club, which brings together people passionate about running and sport. This event is a great opportunity to train together, compete, and enjoy a friendly atmosphere among runners of different ability levels. The club also welcomes beginners, offering support and motivation to start running.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Krzysztof Kamil Baczyński No. 7 General Secondary School in Sosnowiec
Running course tailored to the 10 km distance
A sense of community and motivation among the local running community
additional: The club's training sessions take place on Tuesdays at 19:00 (runners) and Thursdays at 17:00 (Nordic Walking). The club organizes group long runs, hill training, and intervals, as well as trips to running competitions. The 2026 edition took place on March 22 at 10:00. The March 21, 2027 date has not been confirmed in the available sources.

It is a great opportunity to test your fitness and spend time in nature alongside other runners.
course_highlights: The course runs through the forests near Krotoszyn
Scenic woodland trails
The anniversary fifth edition of the race
additional: Information about fees, entry limits and packages applies to the 2026 edition. Registration was handled through DataSport; the main race had a limit of 500 participants, and the children’s races had 200 places.

The event takes place in the park by the railway station and is coordinated by the local Biegnij Oławo association together with Oława City Hall. Participants can expect electronic timing and support from local partners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and support a worthy cause.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 5 km for both the run and the walk
Start and finish in the park by the railway station in Oława
Electronic timing provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl

The event is held in cooperation with local partners and features professional timing. In the previous edition, Nordic Walking competition was available, and prizes were raffled after the run. Information about the route and registration for the edition on 21 March 2027 has not been confirmed.

The event combines sporting competition with the beauty of nature and a local atmosphere.

Picturesque green spaces and natural trails
A course suitable for runners of different ability levels

description: The 3rd Run in the Ochna River Valley is a running event held in Kutno, featuring 5 km and 10 km races and a 5 km Nordic walking event. The course runs through the city, including the Zielona Oś bicycle path and streets such as Sienkiewicza and Zamenhofa and Wolności Square. The surface is asphalt and paving stones. The course is marked every kilometre and is not certified by the PZLA. The participant limit is 400, and the main race is scheduled to start at 12:00.
course_highlights: Mixed surface: asphalt and paving stones
Runs along the Zielona Oś bicycle path and through the streets of Kutno
Course marked every kilometre
additional: The participant limit is 400. The running and Nordic walking courses are not certified by the PZLA. The courses are marked every kilometre and partly follow the Zielona Oś bicycle path and streets of Kutno. Entry packages are available at different prices, including an option for Kutno residents with a resident card. Information about the date of 21 March 2027 has not been confirmed; sources refer to the 22 March 2026 edition.

name: III Sulmierzycka Wiosenna 10
description: Sulmierzycka Wiosenna 10 is an annual celebration of sport and a healthy lifestyle held in Sulmierzyce. The 10-kilometre race, which has been held since 2024, is a great opportunity to welcome spring actively and bring residents together. The event has become a permanent fixture in the municipality’s calendar, promoting a sporting spirit after the winter months.
course_highlights: The main race covers 10 km.
A 10 km Nordic Walking event takes place on the same course.
Children’s races are planned over 200, 600 and 1,000 m.
additional: Sources give different dates: the municipality’s website and registration refer to 22 March 2026, while the race calendar lists 22 March 2027; 21 March 2027 has not been confirmed.

name: IV Bieg Konspiracji
location: Fort I, ul. Winna 19, Toruń, Poland
description: The 4th General Elżbieta Zawacka Underground Resistance Run is a 10-kilometre race in Toruń, combining sporting competition with a tribute to its namesake and the history of the city. The course passes through the grounds of Fort I and heads towards the General Zawacka Bridge, with the start and finish in the fort’s courtyard. Participants can look forward to a commemorative medal and a hot meal after the race. The historic setting of Toruń Fortress gives the event a distinctive character.
course_highlights: 10-kilometre course in Toruń
Route through the grounds of Fort I
Course heads towards the General Elżbieta Zawacka Bridge
additional: The start and finish are in the courtyard of Fort I at 19 Winna Street. Available information relates to the 2026 edition and does not confirm details of the edition planned for 2027.

name: Potrójna Korona Gorczańska
location: Miejska Hala Sportowa Gorce, Nowy Targ, Poland
description: The Gorczańska Triple Crown is a demanding mountain race held near Nowy Targ, in the harsh conditions of late winter. The route runs through the flysch valleys of the Pieniny Mountains and the mountain pastures of the Beskid Sądecki, where every step demands your full attention. This is authentic mountain country, untamed nature, and a true challenge for the determined—marking the start of the Triple Crown series. The event counts toward the large and small gold badges, and the race base is at the Gorce Municipal Sports Hall in Nowy Targ.
course_highlights: Route through the flysch valleys of the Pieniny Mountains and the mountain pastures of the Beskid Sądecki
Views of Turbacz, the highest peak in the Gorce Mountains (1,310 m above sea level)
Harsh winter weather and demanding terrain
additional: A limited-edition metal finisher pin. A set of laminated maps for every participant. A commemorative race bib bearing your name. A race pack gift with a special event print. A booklet-diploma for collecting route confirmations. Well-stocked refreshment points and professional photography and filming. Recovery treats at selected checkpoints. A relaxation area with deckchairs and beer. Fees for the National Park and forest districts. Help with transport to the finish if you withdraw. Buses to the start of the long and short routes. Registration and race-pack collection at the race office from 15:30 to 20:00 on the previous day. The event base will be at the Gorce Municipal Sports Hall in Nowy Targ. The race pack includes, among other things, laminated maps, a race bib, and a gift; at the finish, participants receive a metal finisher pin.

Details of the route for the 7th edition have not been confirmed; during the previous edition, participants covered a 12.5 km route.

The event includes running and Nordic walking.
The event takes place in Horyniec-Zdrój.

description: The 12th Ostrów Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Ostrów Wielkopolski, attracting both amateur and professional runners. The 21 km half-marathon course is certified by PZLA and consists of three fast laps that are conducive to setting personal bests. The event also includes a 7 km fun run. It is organized by the ICE MAT Team Sports Club, which promotes running and brings the local running community together.
course_highlights: Course certified by PZLA
Fast, flat course conducive to setting personal bests
Three laps totaling 21 km
additional: The race pack includes a commemorative mug, a cap, and a trophy medal made of stone and metal. The half marathon is part of the Grand Prix of Greater Poland Half Marathon, where participants can earn the crown. The course is flat and certified, making it ideal for setting personal bests. The available registration page and results are for the edition held on March 22, 2026, not the stated date of March 21, 2027.

name: XLIII Perła Paprocan
description: Perła Paprocan is a marathon held on a 7 km loop around Paprocany Lake in Tychy. Participants can run any number of laps, from one up to a full marathon, without having to declare their distance in advance. The event is recreational and community-oriented, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a friendly atmosphere among participants. Tychy is the only city in Poland where a marathon is held twice a year, and Perła Paprocan is one of those editions.
course_highlights: A 7 km loop around Paprocany Lake
Paved sections (over 50%), along with compacted paths and forest trails
A refreshment point with drinks, fruit and sweets after each lap
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the Irysy restaurant by Paprocany Lake in Tychy on October 23 and 24, and on race day before the start. A race number may be collected on another person’s behalf with written authorization. Participants under 18 must have written consent from a parent or legal guardian. On the course, runners and walkers must use only half of the paths, leaving the other half clear for overtaking. The course is marked every 1 km. Nordic walking is also permitted. Information about the 43rd edition indicates that it supported the PSONI Therapeutic Day Centre in Tychy.

name: Poznań Malta #63
description: Poznań Malta #63 is a 10 km race in Poznań, held on 17 March 2026 as part of the Kiprun Poznań Malta series. 27 runners took part, and Robert Walczak was the fastest, finishing in 37:57. It is a small-scale edition of the running series organized in Poznań.
course_highlights: 10 km distance
Race in Poznań
Small-scale edition with 27 participants
additional: Robert Walczak won with a time of 37:57.

description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Centre for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. The event takes place in the evening and encourages residents and visitors to spend time actively outdoors. It is recreational and community-building in nature, promoting a healthy lifestyle and sports activity in the local community.
course_highlights: A 5 km race in the previous edition
The event takes place in the evening
The route is in Bolechowo, in the Czerwonak municipality
additional: The event is free and takes place from 19:30 to 22:00. This evening activity is recreational and community-building in nature.

name: Ekstremalna Droga Krzyżowa
description: The Extreme Way of the Cross is a spiritual, nighttime hike of approximately 40 km, undertaken in silence and contemplation. Participants follow the route alone or in small groups, focusing on prayer and reflection rather than sports competition. This unique event aims to inspire inner transformation and take participants beyond their comfort zones, offering a profound spiritual and personal experience. The route may be approximately 30 km if the elevation gain exceeds 500 m. EDK is a way of life and a path to changing yourself, not just covering the distance.
course_highlights: 40 km at night in silence and contemplation
A route of approximately 30 km when the elevation gain exceeds 500 m
The Way of the Cross with spiritual reflections, without sporting or social elements
additional: Participants set out at their own risk. It is recommended that they download the official EDK app, which includes route maps, GPS navigation, and the Way of the Cross reflections in text and audio, and also works offline. Silence and contemplation are observed along the route; picnics and social stops are not part of the event. Participants should be prepared for varying weather conditions and bring suitable clothing, food and drink, and a phone with a power bank. EDK takes place at participants’ own risk. Registration and route selection are available through the EDK service.

The event is for all sports enthusiasts who want to enjoy a friendly atmosphere and a day of sport in nature. Following the success of the first edition, minor changes have been made to enhance the experience for all participants.

A unique setting for runners and spectators alike
A friendly atmosphere for all sports enthusiasts

description: Lake Run is a unique trail race held on the shores of Lake Strzeszyńskie in Poznań. The approximately 5 km and 10 km routes, as well as the Nordic Walking course, follow natural paths around the lake, offering a light trail feel with uphill sections and a short off-road stretch. The start and finish are right by the water, providing beautiful views and an intimate atmosphere that’s ideal for both beginners and experienced runners. Organized by the EVsport Foundation, the race combines a passion for sport with closeness to nature and a welcoming community.
course_highlights: The routes loop around Lake Strzeszyńskie, with views of the lake
Natural paths and a light trail feel, including a short off-road stretch
Start and finish right by the water, with no streets or traffic jams
additional: One entry fee applies to all distances: 5 km, 10 km and Nordic Walking. Souvenirs from the “Feel the Rhythm of the Lake” collection can be purchased separately (T-shirt, mug, bandana, premium bag or set). Participants under 18 must have a consent form signed by a parent or guardian. The routes have a light trail feel, with natural surfaces and gentle uphill sections. The organizer recommends shoes with good grip. The available options are 5 km, 10 km and Nordic Walking. The organizer recommends shoes with good grip; a detailed route map will be published later. Participants under 18 need a consent form signed by a parent or guardian when collecting their race pack.

name: 12 Górska Pętla UBS 12:12
location: Hotel Kotarz Spa & Wellness, Brenna, Poland
description: The 12th Górska Pętla UBS 12:12 is a 12-hour mountain race held on a varied loop of approximately 16 km in the Stary Groń area of the Silesian Beskids. Runners aim to complete as many loops as possible within 12 hours, and at least one loop is required to be classified. The course starts at Hotel Kotarz Spa & Wellness in Brenna and passes through scenic terrain, with approximately 800 m of elevation gain per loop. A new distance has also been introduced: a single 16 km loop for beginner mountain runners who want to test themselves before taking on an ultra-distance race.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 16 km with around 800 m of elevation gain
The course passes through the Silesian Beskids, including Hala Jaworowa and the summit of Kotarz
Scenic, fast descents to the Brennica River and the transition area
additional: To be classified, runners must complete at least one loop. The course is identical to previous years. The start and finish are at Hotel Kotarz Spa & Wellness in Brenna. The course includes one difficult section that requires particular attention for safety. The start and finish are at Hotel Kotarz Spa & Wellness in Brenna. The previous edition described on the organizer’s website took place on 28 March 2026; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Dzikie Ultra dla Lenki
description: Dzikie Ultra is a six-hour race organized by the BDB Team crew, held in the scenic Valley of Three Ponds in Katowice. This unique event for long-distance running enthusiasts combines sporting competition with the beauty of nature. The course follows natural trails, offering participants an unforgettable experience and a chance to test their endurance.
course_highlights: A six-hour race through the Valley of Three Ponds
The course follows natural trails and green areas
Organized by the experienced BDB Team crew

name: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa
location: Las Komunalny przy ul. Chorzowskiej, Gliwice, Poland
description: Gliwice Park Prowocation Run is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice, in the municipal forest. The 4219.5 m course runs mainly along forest and gravel paths, with some asphalt sections, and is open to runners and Nordic Walking enthusiasts. The events are amateur in nature and promote a healthy, active outdoor lifestyle. Participants can choose to complete 1 to 5 laps, covering distances from approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon. A refreshment point with drinks is available after each lap, and participants receive a drink and a snack after the event.
course_highlights: A 4219.5 m course along forest, gravel, and asphalt paths
Start and finish on a clearing near the Piast Stadium in the Municipal Forest
A refreshment point is available after each lap
additional: Events are held once a month on Saturdays. Participants can take part in the run or Nordic Walking, as well as the e-Prowocation (any activity). The time limit for completing the course is 3 hours. Race numbers are valid for the whole year and must be returned after each race. After the event, participants receive a drink and a snack (sausage or banana), as well as a chocolate bar in a prize draw, if sanitary regulations allow. Events are held once a month on Saturdays. According to information about the series from 2026, the race office opens at 9:00, and the run starts at 10:00.

description: The Jura Wild Dog Run is a unique event for people and their dogs, offering three routes of 5 km, 13 km and 28 km. The routes suit different ability levels, from a family-friendly walk to more demanding running and dogtrekking challenges. The dogtrekking format ensures comfort and safety, with a marked route, checkpoints and a GPX file to eliminate the stress of navigating the terrain. Starts are arranged in pace-based sectors, and the atmosphere is friendly and relaxed, with a quiet start and dogs creating a distinctive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes of 5 km, 13 km and 28 km to suit different ability levels
Marked route with checkpoints and a GPX file
A dogtrekking format that removes the stress of navigating the terrain
additional: Starts are arranged in pace-based sectors: ELITE (under 5:00 min/km), RUNNERS (5:01–6:00 min/km), OTHERS (over 6:01 min/km, walkers, families and first-timers). The start is quiet, with no gunshots or countdown; a designated person at the start line gives the signal to start. Race packs are handed out on Friday evening before the race, with priority given by distance. The event website lists the date as 28 March 2026, not 27 March 2027. In the edition described on the website, starts were in sectors, without a gunshot or countdown.

name: Prymulek-Dąbrowska Górka skansen forteczny
description: Prymulek-Dąbrowska Górka Fortified Open-Air Museum is a 10 km race held in the picturesque surroundings of Karczew. Runners can prepare for the start with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is intended for runners seeking a challenge on a moderately difficult course. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness and enjoy outdoor activity amid the historic fortified open-air museum.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Moderate difficulty
Picturesque surroundings of the fortified open-air museum in Karczew
additional: Training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including instructions and expert support. The organizer encourages using the platform to manage the race listing and for marketing collaboration. The date in the race calendar is marked as tentative and differs by one day from the stated event date.

name: Skoczów biega
location: Wyciąg narciarski Pod Dębem, Skoczów, Poland
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Skoczowie i Skoczowski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji
description: Join the 9th edition of the “Skoczów Runs” cross-country race, held at the Pod Dębem ski lift in Skoczów. This sporting event is organized by Skoczów Municipal Office and the Skoczów Sports and Recreation Centre, and attracts runners of different ages and ability levels. The course runs through scenic areas, giving participants the chance to enjoy some active time outdoors. The event is open to all and promotes a healthy lifestyle and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Course at the Pod Dębem ski lift
Cross-country races in the scenic surroundings of Skoczów
Organized by the local sports and recreation centre
additional: Information about distances and the course route comes from the 2026 edition and may differ in the next edition.

name: Stęszewski Bieg Przełajowy
description: The Stęszew Cross-Country Run is an annual running event organized by the Stęszew Municipality, bringing the local community together through active recreation. The races take place on scenic routes in Wielkopolski National Park, mainly along forest trails and field tracks. The main race offers 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event and children’s races tailored to younger participants’ ages. The start and finish are on the beach by Lake Lipno, and the time limit is 1.5 hours.
course_highlights: The route is 95% forest trails, field tracks, and unpaved roads
The 5 km race is one forest loop by Lake Lipno and in Trzebaw forest
The 10 km race is two loops of the same route
additional: The race office is open on Friday, 27.03.2026, from 19:00 to 20:00, and on Saturday, 28.03.2026, from 8:30 to 11:30 (for the main race and Nordic Walking) and from 8:00 to 10:30 (for the children’s races). The start and finish are on the beach by Lake Lipno. The participant limit is 300. Net timing is measured using a chip. The route is not certified by the PZLA. The Nordic Walking event starts at 13:15. Parking is available at the Sports and Entertainment Hall and along Trzebawska Street. Previous editions have included children’s races at distances tailored to age and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The official website lists the contact details: +48 698 050 150, bieg@steszew.pl.

name: VIII Otwarte Górskie Mistrzostwa Polski
description: The 8th Open Polish Mountain Nordic Walking Half Marathon Championships is a prestigious competition held in the picturesque area of Prudnik and its surroundings. The 21.1 km mountain half-marathon course runs through forests and hilly terrain, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The event is open to all age categories from 18 years old and also includes a shorter, 5-kilometre mountain walk for children, young people and people with disabilities. The competition is held in accordance with the regulations of the Polish Nordic Walking Association and aims to popularize Nordic walking and bring the sporting community together.
course_highlights: A 21.1 km mountain half-marathon course through forested and hilly terrain
A 5 km mountain walk for children, young people and people with disabilities
Start and finish by the Shrine of St. Joseph in Prudnik
additional: Time limits apply to both the 21.0975 km and 5 km distances. The official opening of the competition is at 9:45, with a group warm-up at 9:30. The awards ceremony and prize draw are at 15:05. The competition is held in accordance with the regulations of the Polish Nordic Walking Association. Organizers can be contacted and administrative matters handled via the registration form. Materials from previous editions indicate the location was Prudnik-Las, near the Shrine of St. Joseph. Confirmed distances from the 9th edition are 21.0975 km and 5 km; details of the 8th edition may differ.
