organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Lwówku, Rozbiegany Lwówek, Powiatowe Centrum Sportu w Nowym Tomyślu
description: Wiosenna Lwówecka 5 is a race held in Lwówek, and its name indicates a distance of 5 km. The 2025 edition took place on March 22, while available calendars list only an approximate date for the next edition, in March 2027. It’s a way to kick off the spring running season with some sport.
additional: The race office and race-pack pickup on March 22, 2025, were scheduled from 7:30 to 8:30 at Parkowa 2, 64-310 Lwówek. The 2025 edition had its race office at 2 Parkowa Street in Lwówek.

name: WRC Waligóra Run Cross
description: WRC - Waligóra Run Cross is a mountain running festival held in Głuszyca, featuring three distances: an 82 km ultra, a 53 km mountain half marathon, and a 28 km race. The event is part of the Sudetes Mountain Running Festival and is included in the international ITRA and UTMB Index rankings. The course winds through scenic mountain terrain, with challenging climbs and varied surfaces. It is an excellent choice for mountain runners seeking long-distance challenges.
course_highlights: Mountain courses of 82 km (ultra), 53 km (half marathon), and 28 km
Scenic landscapes of the Sudetes
Challenging climbs and varied terrain
additional: The races are listed in the international ITRA and UTMB Index rankings. Results are available on the RaceResult platform. The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Walim Na Żądanie. Registration is handled through Race Result. Information about distances and elevation gains comes from previous editions; details for the 2027 edition may differ.

description: The 17th Jastrowie Marathon is an annual running event organized by the Municipality and Town of Jastrowie, held at the end of March. Competitors can choose from three distances: the marathon (42.195 km), the half marathon, and a 10.55 km Nordic Walking event. The marathon course is a cross-country route consisting of four loops, passing through forest tracks in the forest district and built-up areas just after the start. Participants who finish receive a commemorative medal and a race package. The event is small-scale, with a limited field of 50 participants, highlighting its distinctive character and local atmosphere.
course_highlights: A cross-country course along forest tracks in the forest district
The marathon consists of four loops
The start and finish are near the Sports and Entertainment Hall and Jastrowie-Miasto railway stop

The field is limited to 50 participants, with places allocated in order of registration. Registration will close once the limit is reached, and any overpayments will be refunded. Every participant who finishes will receive a commemorative medal and a race package. The organizer’s information concerns the 17th edition, scheduled for 28 March 2026; it does not confirm a race on 27 March 2027. name: 20 Półmaraton Warszawski LET’S RUN THIS PARTY!
description: The 21st Warsaw Half Marathon is a prestigious running event held in the heart of Warsaw, attracting both professionals and amateurs. The 21.0975 km course is fast and flat, certified by the PZLA and World Athletics, and passes some of the capital’s most beautiful sights, including views of the Vistula, PGE Narodowy, and the Presidential Palace. The event also features a 5 km race and a rich programme of activities, including the Running&Lifestyle Expo and musical entertainment. The organizers also promote the #BiegamDobrze charity initiative, combining sport with support for those in need.
course_highlights: A 21.0975 km course certified by the PZLA and World Athletics
A very fast, flat course suited to setting personal records
Views of the Vistula, PGE Narodowy, and the Presidential Palace
additional: The start and finish are in central Warsaw, by the Palace of Culture and Science. Participants start in start corrals marked on their race bibs. On race day, baggage storage, changing rooms, and toilets are available. The event also features the 5 km New Balance Bieg na Piątkę and the Running&Lifestyle Expo. The organizers encourage spectators to cheer along the course, with attractions for fans of all ages. The sources provided relate to the 20th edition on 22 March 2026, not the event listed for 4 April 2027. The 2026 half-marathon entry limit has been reached.

description: The PKO Half Marathon around Lake Żywieckie is an annual running event traditionally starting and finishing at Żywiec Market Square. The event attracts runners from across Poland, offering a unique course around picturesque Lake Żywieckie. The race atmosphere is enhanced by numerous cheering zones and the support of the local community and volunteers. It is a true celebration of running and cheering in the heart of the Beskids.
course_highlights: Course around Lake Żywieckie
Start and finish at Żywiec Market Square
Support from numerous cheering zones and local residents
additional: The event is organized with the help of more than 100 volunteers. The race course is part of the PKO Crown of Silesian Half Marathons series and the Beskids Euroregion Cup in road running. The event takes place on Sunday, March 14, 2027.

organizer: Polska Agencja Antydopingowa (POLADA); współorganizator: Fundacja Wychowanie przez Sport
description: Run with Pure Pleasure is a charity hybrid race organized by the Polish Anti-Doping Agency in cooperation with the Sport Through Education Foundation. The event promotes clean sport and fair competition, drawing attention to the harmful effects of doping and unverified supplements. Participants can choose a distance of 5 km or 10 km, completed in person on designated courses in four Polish cities or virtually. The race also welcomes people with disabilities, and proceeds from entry packages go to charitable causes supporting athletes in need.
course_highlights: Distances of 4,999 m and 9,999 m on in-person courses in Chorzów, Warsaw, Kielce and Wrocław
Chip timing on all in-person courses
Option to take part virtually from anywhere in Poland during the designated period
additional: In-person entry packages can be collected at the courses between 8:40 and 9:30 upon presentation of an ID card. Medals are awarded at the finish. Participants taking part virtually receive an entry package and a medal sent by InPost courier within 7 days of the race ending. The participant limit is 1,300. The start location can be changed until 22.03.2026 at 10:00 by contacting the organizers by email. Proof of completing the virtual distance must be submitted by 8 April 2026 at 23:59. The program includes races for children and young people in different age categories, as well as the Spring Flowers Parade for the youngest participants. Participants can look forward to beautiful medals, prizes, and a special, family-friendly atmosphere on a morning of sport.

Spring Flowers Parade for children born in 2021 or later

The organizers, Grupa ExtremeJura, ensure professional timekeeping and high-quality event organization, guaranteeing a satisfying race experience. Picturesque views and natural landscapes
Start and finish by the amphitheater in Niegowa

Previous editions offered a trentaraton (30 km), a half marathon, a quarter marathon (about 11 km), and a relaxed 5K (6.5 km); Nordic walking was also available for most distances. The main race route follows the scenic paths of Marceliński Forest and Węgorka Street, with distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event. The youngest participants can take part in the Niebieska miniFala family run, a 1 km route around ENEA Stadium. The event is family-oriented and inclusive, promoting a healthy lifestyle and counteracting the social exclusion of people with disabilities.

The race is scheduled to start at 3:00 p.m., and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and sporting competition.

5 km Nordic walking event
Children’s races and a firefighter competition in full protective gear

The organizers provided bus transport for participants from the race office in Świebodzin to the start in Sulechów.

Each race covers a distance of 10 km and follows scenic paths through Wrocław’s parks, giving both amateur and experienced runners the chance to compete and get to know the city. Participants can earn points toward the overall series standings, and generous refreshment stations and commemorative medals await them at the finish. course_highlights: Out-and-back course with climbs after the start and before the finish
Surface: field paths, asphalt, and gravel
7.1 km course at the KVS Olomouc complex in Náměšť na Hané
additional: The race is organized by SK RELAX Olomouc. The contact person is Karel Pikal. The race is part of Český běh, a service of the Czech Athletics Federation for runners. The course is certified, and the race is listed in the official Český běh race calendar. In 2026, the race was part of the Hanácký běžecký pohár and the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje. The race information also lists a fitness run open to all ages.

name: Širokodolský kros
location: Obecní sál, Široký Důl, Pardubice District, Czech Republic
description: Širokodolský Cross-Country Run is a traditional off-road race held in the village of Široký Důl near Polička in the Pardubice Region. The event offers races for children and young people ranging from 60 metres to 4 km, as well as a 7 km main race with a mass start for men and women. The course runs along paved roads, forest trails and dirt tracks, with a climbing bonus on the first hill. Children can win prizes, while adults can receive cash prizes in their categories. The start and finish are by the municipal hall, creating a welcoming race atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs along paved roads, forest trails and dirt tracks
Climbing bonus on the first hill
Start and finish by the municipal hall in Široký Důl
additional: Children and young people start in successive age categories, with distances ranging from 60 m to 4 km. The 7 km main race has a mass start for men and women. Children receive prizes for the first three finishers in each category, while adults receive cash prizes for the first three in each category. The race starts by the municipal hall. The programme includes races for children and young people; the results for the 2026 edition list distances from 80 m to 7.8 km.

name: Generali 1/2Maraton Praha
location: Bubenské nábřeží, Holešovice, Prague, Czech Republic

name: 18. PANAS Półmaraton Ślężański Piątka Ślężysława
organizer: Miasto i Gmina Sobótka, Ślężański Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sobótce, Klub Biegacza Sobótka, Zespół Szkolno-Przedszkolny im. Janusza Korczaka w Sobótce oraz Centrum Szkolenia Wojsk Inżynieryjnych i Chemicznych
description: Piątka Ślężysława is a 5 km race held as part of the 19th Ślęża Half Marathon, which starts on 20 March 2027 in Sobótka. The course was designed by local runners and has a unique route with no equivalent in Poland. The start and finish are in the centre of Sobótka, and the finish is inside a sports hall, providing comfort for participants. The event promotes physical activity and the tourist attractions of the Ślęża region.
course_highlights: Course designed by runners from Sobótka, unique in Poland
Start and finish in the centre of Sobótka; finish inside a sports hall
Scenic surroundings at the foot of Mount Ślęża
additional: The race finish is inside a sports hall, providing comfort for participants. The course is available to download in .gpx format. The event is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Lower Silesian Half Marathon classification for the Sudeten Mouflon statuette. The race will take place on 20 March 2027. Detailed information about the start time of Piątka Ślężysława was not provided in the available materials.

name: Čendův běh v Petrově
location: Obecní hřiště, Petrov, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Obec Petrov, Libřický osadní klub, osada Hřebena a SDH Petrov
description: Čendův Run is the oldest tramp-style running race in Bohemia and one of the oldest cross-country races of all. It is traditionally held on Easter Sunday in Petrov near Prague and offers technically challenging courses along soft forest roads and trails in the valley of the Záhořanský Stream and around Ďábel Hill. The race is known for its family atmosphere and demanding terrain, with professional chip timing provided by irontime. Courses range from 100 metres for children’s categories to 12 km for experienced cross-country runners.
course_highlights: Technically challenging courses along soft forest roads and trails
The valley of the Záhořanský Stream and the area around Ďábel Hill
A traditional Easter-time date and a family atmosphere
additional: Professional chip timing is provided by irontime. The race offers a wide range of categories, from 100 metres for children to 12 km for experienced runners. The event takes place at the municipal sports ground in Petrov near Prague. It is traditionally held on Easter Sunday; the listed courses in the previous edition included 6 km and 12 km. The date 11 April 2027 has not been confirmed by sources.

name: Velikonoční běh Tovačov
description: The Tovačov Easter Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque grounds of Tovačov Castle. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for endurance runners and gives athletes the chance to test themselves in recreational and competitive races. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for a wide audience who enjoy running in a pleasant setting steeped in history.
course_highlights: Picturesque grounds of Tovačov Castle
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for endurance runners
Traditional endurance race with a long history
additional: The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for endurance runners. Details for the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed by the listed sources.

name: Běh kolem Harrachovky v Táboře
description: The Easter Harrachovka Run in Tábor is a traditional 7.5 km running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the town of Tábor. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and offers a sporting experience for runners of all levels. The course surface is suitable for fast running, and the race has a friendly, motivating atmosphere. The event is organised by the South Bohemian Marathon Club, which provides high-quality organisation and support for participants.
course_highlights: Course distance: 7.5 km
Surface suitable for fast running
The route runs around the town of Tábor
additional: Registration is available online and requires payment of a membership fee of CZK 250. The registration fee must be paid within 14 days, otherwise the registration will be cancelled. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup, with a points system and the option of a team competition. In 2026, the start was scheduled for 14:00; the information provided does not confirm details for the 2027 edition.

name: 6 BMWielkanocny
description: The 6th BMWielkanocny is a 10 km race held in Kraków. Participants can prepare with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers offer detailed training instructions and expert support to help runners prepare optimally for race day. The race is part of the running calendar and is aimed at people looking to improve their fitness and achieve good results over 10 km.
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to each runner’s VDOT level. The organizer provides expert support and detailed training instructions. The race listing can be managed and marketing collaboration arranged through the TreningBiegacza platform.

location: Wieluń-Ruda, Wieluń County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: XII Bieg do Pustego Grobu
organizer: Parafia Rzymsko-Katolicka pw. Świętego Antoniego w Nowej Soli
description: The 12th Bieg do Pustego Grobu is a 10 km race held in Nowa Sól on Easter Monday at 14:00. The course passes important churches in the city, including St. Anthony’s, St. Barbara’s, St. Joseph’s, the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary, and St. Michael’s, as well as the cemetery on Wandy Street. The race has a spiritual and symbolic character, recalling the footsteps of St. Peter and St. John as they ran to the Tomb of the Lord to confirm the Resurrection of Jesus.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through churches in Nowa Sól: St. Anthony’s, St. Barbara’s, St. Joseph’s, the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary, and St. Michael’s
Passes through the cemetery on Wandy Street
Held on Easter Monday at 14:00
additional: The organizer is the Roman Catholic Parish of St. Anthony in Nowa Sól. The race has a spiritual and symbolic meaning, referring to the Easter tradition. No information was found about entry fees or participant limits. The start is scheduled for Easter Monday at 14:00. The 12th edition took place in 2026; available sources do not confirm details of the 2027 edition.

name: Noční běh pro Světlušku Praha
location: Výstaviště Praha, Stromovka, Prague 7, Prague, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Prague is a charity run held in the evening in the beautiful setting of Stromovka and Výstaviště. Participants can choose between two routes—a short 2.8 km loop and a long 4.5 km loop—which can also be walked. The start is at 21:00, and registration opens at 18:30. The event offers an accompanying programme, including a concert, and is open to all age groups. Proceeds support people with severe visual impairments. Capacity is limited to ensure runners’ safety and comfort.
course_highlights: 2.8 km route – short loop in Stromovka
4.5 km route – long loop in Stromovka
Night run with a choice of entry option including a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration is through the GoOut.cz portal, where participants can choose an entry option with a headlamp or sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P disability cards are admitted free of charge, without a headlamp or headband. Children under 15 accompanied by an adult are admitted free of charge, but do not receive a headlamp. A cloakroom and baggage storage, medical services and an accompanying programme including a concert are available on site. Dogs on a leash and wearing a muzzle are welcome, except in Jihlava. Information about the venue, route and price is based on the 2026 edition; the date 15. 4. 2027 has not been confirmed. In the 2026 edition, participants with a TP, ZTP or ZTP/P card and their companions were admitted free of charge.

name: 2. Běh pro zdraví
location: Lodičky, Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Jäkl Karviná, z. s. – oddíl atletiky
description: The Run for Health is a friendly running event in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Participants can run a 3 km route at their own pace and support their health. The start is at Lodičky, and proceeds from the entry fee are donated to help those in need. Everyone is warmly invited to take part in this community sporting event.
course_highlights: 3 km route in Božena Němcová Park
Start at Lodičky in Karviná
Run at any pace in pleasant natural surroundings
additional: Registration begins at 17:00, and the start is at 17:45 at Lodičky. Proceeds from the entry fee go to help those in need. Registration begins at 17:00, and the start is at 17:45 at Lodičky. Proceeds from the entry fee are intended to help those in need.

name: Jarní běh v Pávově
description: The Spring Run in Pávov is an 8.8 km race that follows both roads and trails around Jihlava, specifically in Pávov. The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup and gives runners the opportunity to enjoy a combination of paved and off-road sections in the picturesque Vysočina countryside. It is suitable for the general public and offers a sporting experience in spring.
course_highlights: 8.8 km course
Combination of road and off-road sections
Around Jihlava, in Pávov
additional: The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup.

name: Jarný beh Bojničky
description: Jarný beh obce Bojničky je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný Atletickým klubom Bojničky a obcou Bojničky. Preteky sa konajú v obci Bojničky pred Kultúrnym domom a sú súčasťou Nitrianskej bežeckej ligy 2026. Súťažiť môžu deti, dorastenci, dospelí a Nordic Walking účastníci, pričom sú pripravené kategórie podľa veku a pohlavia. Novinkou je súťaž trojčlenných družstiev mužov a žien na 5000 m Nordic Walking. Štart pretekov je rozdelený podľa kategórií od 9:45 do 12:15 hod.

name: Timravine Ostrôžky Trail
description: Timravine Ostrôžky Trail je horský bežecký pretek v Divíne, ktorý ponúka dve náročné trate s krásnymi výhľadmi a výrazným prevýšením. Pretek je organizovaný OZ Ostrôžky a je vhodný pre bežcov, ktorí hľadajú výzvu v prírode. Trať Ostrôšky ultra má dĺžku 47 km s prevýšením 2000 m, zatiaľ čo Langoš trail je kratší s dĺžkou 27 km a prevýšením 950 m. Štart preteku je rozdelený na dve vlny, pričom dlhšia trať začína o 7:30 a kratšia o 9:00.

name: Beh oslobodenia Kálnice
location: Kálnica, Kálnica, pred Kultúrnym domom Kálnica
description: Beh oslobodenia Kálnice je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný obcou Kálnica na počesť padlých rumunských vojakov pri oslobodení obce. Preteky sa konajú na trase z Kálnice do Rakoľúb a späť, s rôznymi dĺžkami tratí pre rôzne vekové kategórie. Povrch trate je asfaltový, rovinatý s miernym prevýšením a zákrutami. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí, ktoré môžu bežať v sprievode dospelej osoby. Štart pretekov je pri Kultúrnom dome v Kálnici.

name: Zvolenská Corrida
location: Zvolen, Zvolen, Námestie SNP, Fun zóna
organizer: Mesto Zvolen, Mišo s. r. o.
description: Zvolenská corrida je bežecké podujatie, ktoré sa koná na pešej zóne Námestia SNP vo Zvolene. Pretekári absolvujú päť okruhov po 1 km bez prevýšenia, celkovo teda 5 km. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské preteky a voľný beh rodičov s deťmi, ktoré sú bez štartovného. Podujatie je súčasťou Zvolenskej bežeckej ligy a ponúka profesionálnu organizáciu a meranie časov.

name: Furčiansky maratón – Memoriál Štefana Semana
location: Košice, Košice, pred SBD III, Furčianska 60
description: Furčiansky maratón - Memoriál Štefana Semana je tradičný bežecký maratón organizovaný O5 Bežeckým klubom Furča Košice. Tento 23. ročník sa uskutoční 11. apríla 2026 v Košiciach a ponúka bežcom možnosť zmerať si sily na certifikovanej trati. Maratón je známy svojou komunitnou atmosférou a podporou bežeckých aktivít v regióne. Organizátori vítajú všetkých bežcov, ktorí chcú zažiť kvalitný a dobre pripravený maratón.

name: Jarný beh Michalovčanov
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, Stredná odborná škola technická
description: Jarný beh Michalovčanov je tradičný bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná v sobotu 11. apríla 2026 v Michalovciach pri V. ZŠ na Školskej ulici. Pretekári sa môžu tešiť na súťaž v rôznych vekových kategóriách, vrátane detí do 9 rokov, ktoré bežia 400 metrov. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru jarného športového dňa s vyhlásením výsledkov a ocenením medailistov.

name: Horský půlmaraton Sušice
location: Ostrov Santos, Sušice, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Sušice Mountain Half Marathon is a challenging and beautiful running race in the heart of Šumava, offering a unique experience with stunning views from three peaks and of iconic places such as Žižkův vrch, Kalich, Sedlo, Kalovy and Pustý Hrádek. The race base is traditionally on Santos Island by the Otava River, where runners can enjoy quality services, marked courses and a family-friendly atmosphere. The organizers focus on providing excellent conditions and an unforgettable day filled with sport and nature. The race also has a strong tradition and is organized in memory of Matěj Molcar, an enthusiastic athlete.
course_highlights: The main course is 21.1 km long with 800 m of elevation gain
The surface consists of 90% paved roads, singletrack, forest trails and rocky climbs
The route crosses three peaks and offers stunning views of Šumava
additional: The race base on Santos Island offers a restaurant, parking, a children's playground, a swimming pool, a pump track and a skatepark. Relay teams are provided with transport to the start and a shuttle after the race. The children's race has several age categories, with different loop lengths. Cancellation insurance for the entry fee can be arranged through Kooperativa. The race offers several distances, including a half marathon and 10.5 km, with challenging terrain and a family-friendly atmosphere in the Sušice and Šumava area.

name: 57. ročník Běhu vítězství, 53. ročník Hranické dvacítky a 10. ročník Hranické desítky
location: Stadion SK Hranice, Hranice, Czech Republic
description: The Běh vítězství, Hranická dvacítka and Hranická desítka are traditional running races organized by SK Hranice. The races take place at the SK Hranice stadium and in the surrounding area, with the shorter distances of 100 to 500 metres run on the stadium track. The Hranická dvacítka and Hranická desítka partly follow forest paths, offering runners a pleasant natural setting. These races have a long tradition and are popular with runners of all kinds, as well as children and young people.
course_highlights: Races from 100 to 500 m on the stadium track
The Hranická dvacítka follows forest paths
Natural surroundings near the stadium
additional: The races have children’s categories and a training schedule for children and young people. Photos from previous editions are available online. The races are part of SK Hranice’s activities and promote a healthy lifestyle. The programme also includes children’s and youth races; the 100 to 500 m runs take place on the stadium track. The main 20 km race is part of the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje.

name: Mistrovství ČR v půlmaratonu mužů a žen
location: Společenské centrum IDEON, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The Czech Men’s and Women’s Half Marathon Championships is a prestigious 21.0975 km athletics race held in Pardubice. The start is on Smetana Square by the East Bohemian Theatre, and the finish is also in Pardubice. The race is for men, women and, where applicable, juniors who are entered by their athletics clubs and approved by the technical delegate. Participants receive a JOMA performance T-shirt free of charge. The Czech Championships results are announced shortly after the race, including the half-marathon results.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Pardubice, on Smetana Square by the East Bohemian Theatre
Course distance: 21.0975 km
Sports drinks and water at every lap
additional: Registration and race-number and timing-chip collection take place on Friday, 9 April, from 16:00 to 19:00 at the IDEON Social Centre, Jiráskova 1963, Pardubice. Runners must compete in club vests registered with the Czech Athletics Federation (ČAS). The race is technically organized by Oldřich Bujnoch in cooperation with the KPA Pardubice Sports Club. The Czech Championships results ceremony is at 15:40, and the half-marathon results ceremony is at 16:25. The race is scheduled for 10 April 2027, with a 14:00 start. The race office and race-number collection will be at the IDEON Social Centre. Runners receive a JOMA performance T-shirt, a medal and water at the finish; entries for the championship race are submitted by runners’ clubs.

name: Jarní běh Bílovice nad Svitavou
location: Palackého údolí, Bílovice nad Svitavou, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Run in Bílovice nad Svitavou is a traditional athletics event organized by Sokol Bílovice nad Svitavou with the support of the municipality. The race takes place in Palackého Valley, approximately 800 metres beyond the Sokol gym, and is open to all age groups, from preschool children to adult men and women. The first race starts at 9:00, with categories divided by age and ability. The event offers a pleasant sporting atmosphere amid beautiful natural surroundings and promotes an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course runs through Palackého Valley in Bílovice nad Svitavou
Start approximately 800 m beyond the Sokol gym
Categories range from preschool children to adults
additional: The race is open to all categories, from preschool children up to 6 years old through to men and women. It starts on Saturday morning at 9:00. The event is organized with the support of the municipality of Bílovice nad Svitavou and Sokol Bílovice nad Svitavou.

name: Pardubický vinařský půlmaratón – Mistrovství ČR v půlmaratonu
description: The Pardubice Wine Half Marathon is a traditional 21.097 km race held in Pardubice. It is also the Czech Republic Men’s and Women’s Half Marathon Championship, with a scenic course through the city centre and the finish at Pernštýnské Square. The start is at Smetana Square, and runners complete two laps. Participants receive a technical T-shirt and a bottle of wine if they pay the entry fee on time. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and elite athletes.
course_highlights: The course runs through the centre of Pardubice, starting at Smetana Square and finishing at Pernštýnské Square
Two laps, with a total distance of 21.097 km
Isotonic drinks and water at every lap
additional: The start and finish are in the centre of Pardubice. Registration takes place at the IDEON Social Centre in Pardubice. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours. Registrations not paid by 4.4.2027 do not include a T-shirt or wine. Timing chips are non-returnable and assigned by number. Parking is available in front of the IDEON Social Centre and in nearby car parks.

name: Zlínská lesní hodinovka
description: The Zlín Forest Hour Run is a unique running race in the Czech Republic, held in the forest above the Lesní čtvrť district of Zlín. The race has a long tradition: it was originally run on a cinder track, moved to the forest at Vršava in 1995, and since 2006 has taken place on a gently rolling one-kilometre loop. The run lasts 60 minutes, and competitors try to cover as much distance as possible. The race is organized by Jirka Prokop and his team and is known for its friendly, regional character.
course_highlights: A gently rolling one-kilometre loop in the forest above the Lesní čtvrť district of Zlín
A unique forest course, the only hourly race in the Czech Republic run in a forest
The Gustav Bělský Loop at Vršava (historically)
additional: Race registration takes place at the observatory. The race lasts 60 minutes of running time. The best performance is over 17 km in an hour. The race is part of the year-round competition for runners from the Zlín region.

name: Jarní kros Okolo Dračí studánky
location: Malíkovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: ZD Hradečno a Obec Malíkovice ve spolupráci s MK Kladno a Pavlem Žlábkem
description: The Spring Cross-Country Race around Dračí studánka is a 6 km race that runs mainly along field and forest paths in Malíkovice. This cross-country race gives runners the chance to enjoy the natural terrain and woodland setting of the Central Bohemian Region. It is organized by ZD Hradečno and the Malíkovice Municipal Office in cooperation with MK Kladno, ensuring high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys running in nature and wants to experience a springtime run.
course_highlights: 6 km course mainly along field and forest paths
Natural and woodland terrain in the Central Bohemian Region
Scenic surroundings of Dračí studánka in Malíkovice

name: Veřovská desítka
description: We invite you to the traditional Veřovská desítka run, held in the picturesque village of Veřovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all ages and abilities, including children’s categories and a race for non-registered participants. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and beautiful surroundings, inspiring active movement and a memorable sporting experience. Race information is available to download on the official website. We look forward to your participation and to sharing a great sporting experience.
additional: Race information and details of the children’s categories are available to download on the website. Orlovna’s contact telephone numbers and opening hours are listed for enquiries and reservations.

name: Běh Štěpánkou
location: Lesopark Štěpánka, Mladá Boleslav, Czech Republic
description: Běh Štěpánkou is a traditional running race organized by the AC Mladá Boleslav athletics club in the beautiful surroundings of Štěpánka Forest Park. The race offers runners of all ages and ability levels the opportunity to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and nature. The event is part of the club’s athletics calendar and supports community sports activities in the region.
course_highlights: Štěpánka Forest Park offers a natural setting for running
A traditional race with a long history in Mladá Boleslav
Courses suitable for different age groups and ability levels

name: Běhej lesy Karlštejn
location: Lom Velká Amerika, Bubovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běhej lesy Karlštejn is a trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Velká Amerika Quarry in Bubovice. The race offers various distances from 6 km to 30 km, with elevation gains that challenge runners on demanding terrain. It also features special timed sections, the Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, adding competition and motivation. The race is part of the UTMB Index Races, offering an international points ranking and the opportunity to earn a UTMB Index based on performance and distance. Join this traditional event and enjoy both the beauty of nature and a sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Routes pass by the Velká Amerika Quarry, with elevation gains ranging from 149 m to 1,011 m
A timed 150-meter Conti Speed Section on the 12 km, 18 km, and 30 km routes
A 500-meter Generali Investments Finish straight with a timed section and a competition for the fastest time
additional: Routes are available to download in GPX format. The race is part of the UTMB Index Races, with an international points ranking. At the finish, an extended 500 m straight features the timed Generali Investments Finish section, where the fastest runners are announced. The course also includes a Conti Speed Section with prizes from Continental. The race is part of the Běhej lesy series and was included in the UTMB Index Races in previous editions. Specific information for the 2027 edition has not been confirmed in available sources.

name: 7 pohoří Jizerské hory
location: Ski areál Severák, Janov nad Nisou, Czech Republic
description: The Jizera Mountains race is part of the 7 Mountains Trail Run series and offers technical trails with epic views around Smržovka, Josefův Důl, and Maxov. The start and race facilities are at the Severák Ski Resort in Janov nad Nisou. The course was designed by Mountain Rescue Service rescuer Michal Zavadil, and runners can choose from three distances with different elevation gains. The event takes place in all weather conditions, and participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments on the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: Technical trails in the Jizera Mountains with up to 860 m of elevation gain
Routes follow paths and rugged terrain around Smržovka, Josefův Důl, and Maxov
Epic views and an atmosphere you won’t experience anywhere else
additional: The time limit for completing the race is 4 hours, after which a runner is marked as DNF. Participants can leave small items at the registration tent. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The entry fee includes a professionally marked course, a race bib, chip timing, a commemorative medal, and refreshments on the course and at the finish. The start and race facilities are at the Severák Ski Resort. The listed distances and elevation gains are based on the previous edition; details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Běh Trojzemím
location: Rekreační areál Kristýna, Hrádek nad Nisou, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh Trojzemím is a family race for all ages and ability levels, held at the Kristýna recreation area in Hrádek nad Nisou. It features a very fast 5 km and 10 km course, mostly along flat cycle paths in the heart of the Three-Country Point. The race offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all levels and is supported by local partners and municipalities. The start and finish are located in a beautiful recreation area, with paid parking available nearby.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km and 10 km course, mostly along flat cycle paths
Start and finish at the Kristýna recreation area in Hrádek nad Nisou
Pleasant setting in the heart of the Three-Country Point
additional: Check-in for children’s categories is from 8:30 to 9:30, and for adults from 9:00 to 12:30 in the start and finish area. Paid parking is available in the immediate vicinity of the start; the car park is unattended. The race has reached capacity and registration is closed. It is not possible to register either online or on the day. Paid parking is available near the start.

name: Běh Litní a zámeckým parkem
location: Liteňský zámek and park, Liteň, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Včasná registrace předem: 20,- Kč pro registrované do 30.3.2025 s řádně uhrazeným startovným do 4.4.2025, závodníci při dodržení včasné registraci obdrží startovní číslo se svým jménem

tiers.label: tier_2

description: The Spring Run through Liteň and the Chateau Park is a public running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Liteň Chateau and its park. The race is part of the Regional Youth Cross-Country Running Cup and offers courses for adults and children. The main race is 6,760 metres long, and the children’s races take place in the chateau grounds. Winners of the main categories receive valuable accommodation vouchers for the Jizera Mountains, Šumava, or the Bohemian Forest.
course_highlights: The 6,760-metre main race course runs through the grounds of Liteň Chateau and its park
Children’s races take place in the chateau grounds
The race is part of the Regional Youth Cross-Country Running Cup
additional: Race bibs with runners’ names are provided to those who register in advance. On-site payment is possible only in cash. Main organizer: Česká tábornická unie - Záskalák Liteň, p.s. The race is part of the Regional Youth Cross-Country Running Cup. According to the available context, winners of the main categories receive accommodation vouchers.

name: Rozeběhni Stráž
location: School sports facility, Stráž pod Ralskem, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Základní škola a Mateřská škola ve Stráži pod Ralskem
description: Rozeběhni Stráž is a running race held in the picturesque town of Stráž pod Ralskem, offering an opportunity for athletes of all ages. The event is organized by the Stráž pod Ralskem Primary and Nursery School and takes place at the school sports grounds, which feature a running track and other sports facilities. The race is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the community. The website provides up-to-date information and photos from previous editions. Registration for the next edition is now open through an external registration system.
course_highlights: Running track and multipurpose sports facilities
Sports complex with a small-sided football pitch and high-jump and long-jump areas
Space suitable for runners of different ages and ability levels
additional: The sports complex includes a running track, multipurpose courts, and high-jump, long-jump, and shot-put areas. It is owned and managed by the Stráž pod Ralskem Primary and Nursery School. The pitch can be rented by prior arrangement. The website includes links to photo galleries from previous editions of the race.

name: Městský běh Brandýsem a Boleslaví
location: Zámecká zahrada, Brandýs nad Labem, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 Kč / dítě Platba předem na účet nejpozději do 27. 3. 2026.

description: The Brandýs and Boleslav City Run is a traditional running race held in the beautiful setting of the castle garden in Brandýs nad Labem. The race is open to all age groups and runners of varying abilities, with distances ranging from children’s races and 3 km up to a quarter marathon. It also includes a team race, where the three fastest times of team members are combined. The event features a programme of accompanying activities and refreshments, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and their supporters.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly on asphalt, but also on cobblestones, concrete paving and a compacted path
The 5 km and 10 km routes follow the same loop; the 10 km race completes it twice
The children’s routes follow a compacted path in the castle garden
additional: Registration is available online or in person at Kočárovna. Race numbers and chips can be collected on 10 and 11 April at the information centre or Kočárovna. Teams must have at least 3 runners. The winning team receives valuable prizes, including a keg of beer and running gear. Finishers receive a commemorative medal, light refreshments and fruit. Changing rooms, a baggage storage area and water stations on the course and at the finish are available. Traffic restrictions apply from 13:30 to approximately 15:30. Parking is limited, so using the P+R near the train station is recommended. The event includes refreshments and prizes for the winners.

name: Radonický běh
description: Radonický běh is a traditional running race held at the Amerika park grounds in Radonice. The event offers races for children and adults. The main races are 3.5 and 6.5 km long and follow field and forest paths, with part of the route on a paved road. The race is suitable for the general public and offers medals and prizes for winners in each category. Refreshments and a program of activities, including a Zumba session, are available after the race. The event takes place on Saturday, April 11, 2026. Children’s races start from 10:00, and the main races begin from 11:30.
course_highlights: The 3.5 and 6.5 km main routes follow field and forest paths
Part of the route follows a paved road in the Amerika park grounds
Children’s routes are marked within the park grounds
additional: Registration opens at 9:00 and closes at 9:40 for children and 11:15 for adults. Entry is voluntary. Prizes and medals are prepared for the top three in each category, and all children in category D receive sweets. Tea, fruit, Tatranky bars, and soup are available at the finish. Breaks will be filled with a Zumba session led by L. Burdová. Competitors run at their own risk; minors run at their parents’ risk. The record for the 11th edition gives the date as April 11, 2026, not the target date of April 10, 2027. In 2026, registration opened at 9:00; children’s races started from 10:00 and the main races from 11:30.

name: Benefiční rodinný běh
location: Malý Újezd, Mělník District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The charity family run in Malý Újezd is a community sporting event for families and people of all ages. The run offers an opportunity to spend an active day in the pleasant surroundings of the village of Malý Újezd and support a good cause. The event is organized by the Radost Sports and Entertainment Association, which provides a varied cultural and social program in the village. The course is suitable for runners and families with children, reinforcing the friendly atmosphere of the event.
course_highlights: A family-friendly atmosphere for people of all ages
The course runs through the picturesque surroundings of Malý Újezd
The event is part of the village’s cultural and sporting life
additional: The event is organized by the Radost Sports and Entertainment Association, which organizes a range of cultural and social events in the village for people of all ages.

name: ČEZ RunTour Hradec Králové
description: ČEZ RunTour Hradec Králové is a family-friendly running event with races for all ages, from children to adults. The event takes place at Malšovická Arena and offers distances of 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km, including children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. It is known for its friendly atmosphere, excellent facilities and activities for the whole family. Every participant receives a race pack and contributes to charity. The event is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners.

name: Běh cyklostezkou
organizer: AZ tým ve spolupráci se Sportovním zařízením města s.r.o. ve Světlé nad Sázavou

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 150 Kč při online registraci a uhrazení startovného

description: Běh cyklostezkou is a traditional race held in Světlá nad Sázavou. It offers runners a pleasant 5.2 km route along the Sázava River on the cycle path to the corn mill in Mrzkovice and back. The race is suitable for various age categories of men and women, as well as married couples, who compete concurrently. Separate races are organized for children, with different distances according to age. Participants can look forward to chip timing, commemorative medals, and prizes for the top finishers in each category. Refreshments and a raffle are available after the race.
course_highlights: 5.2 km route along the Sázava River on the cycle path
Finish at the tennis complex in Světlá nad Sázavou
Categories for men, women, married couples, and children, with different race distances for children
additional: Registration for the main race is open from 12:00 to 14:30. The children’s races start at 13:00, with registration from 12:00 to 12:30. The main race is chip-timed. After the race, a raffle and light refreshments are available at the finish, along with refreshments at the complex’s buffet. In case of bad weather, shelter is available in the covered tennis hall. The race includes chip timing, commemorative medals, prizes for the top finishers, and refreshments at the finish and at the complex’s buffet. In case of bad weather, covered facilities are available in the tennis hall.

name: Běh vítězství, Hranická dvacítka a Hranická desítka
location: Hranice, Přerov District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh vítězství, Hranická dvacítka and Hranická desítka are traditional running races organized by SK Hranice in the Olomouc Region. The races offer various distances, from children’s events on the stadium track to the main races in the forest and around the town of Hranice. The event has a long tradition and attracts runners of all ages, who can enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings and a high-quality sporting atmosphere. The races are suitable for amateurs and experienced runners alike.
course_highlights: Races from 100 to 500 m take place on the stadium track
The main routes follow forest paths around Hranice
Beautiful natural surroundings and changes in elevation along the routes
additional: Children’s races cover shorter distances of 100 to 500 m on the stadium track. Course maps for the main races, Hranická dvacítka and Hranická desítka, are available on the website. Photos from previous editions are also available on the website, helping runners get familiar with the courses and the race atmosphere.

name: Velká Morava
location: Mikulčice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Great Moravia Memorial – Cyril and Methodius Centre in Staré Město offers a multimedia exhibition dedicated to the history of the Great Moravian Empire and life at a Slavic hillfort in the 9th century. The exhibition is built around the story of the archaeologist Mojslav and features historical dioramas, 3D models and computer animations. Visitors can learn about significant moments in Great Moravia’s history and use an audio guide in several languages. The exhibition is accessible to blind and partially sighted visitors, and the recommended visit time is 60 minutes.
course_highlights: Historical dioramas with life-size figures
3D models of reconstructed churches and the fortifications of Veligrad
Multimedia exhibition with computer animations and an audio guide
additional: The exhibition is wheelchair accessible and has a lift and a toilet for visitors with disabilities. Texts and audio guides are available in Czech, English, German and Russian. The virtual guide also offers Russian. A printed guide is available in four languages. The recommended visit time is 60 minutes.

name: Jarní bahno - Goethovka
location: Goethova vyhlídka, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Jarní bahno - Goethovka is a traditional race in Karlovy Vary offering three disciplines: mountain biking, running, and canicross. The race takes place on challenging routes with elevation changes and technical sections that test competitors’ abilities. The event is suitable for the general public, including young people, and offers a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, and original medals for the winners. It is organized by the A.M.bike z.s. association, which prioritizes safety and fair competition.
course_highlights: A 7 km MTB course with 250 m of elevation gain
An off-road running race over 1 lap
A canicross race with mandatory equipment for dogs
additional: A timing chip is provided at registration; a fee of 500 Kč applies for any chip not returned. The organizer does not provide parking services; parking approximately 200 m from the start is recommended. Competitors start at intervals of several dozen seconds. Canicross dogs must be healthy and over 12 months old, and must start wearing a harness and an elasticated lead. The organizer reserves the right to postpone or cancel the race in extreme conditions. Winners are announced and diplomas awarded after the race; complete results are published online. The Jarní Bahno series is intended for different age groups and ability levels.

name: Jarní rozBěh
location: Husinec-Řež, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Jarní rozBěh is a cross-country and trail running event in the picturesque surroundings of the villages of Husinec and Řež in the Central Bohemian Region. The race offers three distances—11.4 km, 7.4 km and 5.7 km—and is suitable for runners of all fitness levels. The event is family-friendly and welcomes runners of all ages who want to enjoy a run in nature and a pleasant atmosphere. It is organized by the municipality of Husinec–Řež, which invites all runners to take part in this traditional event.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail-style courses
Routes run through the villages of Husinec and Řež
Distances of 11.4 km, 7.4 km and 5.7 km

name: Štěpánovský trhák
location: U Dubu, Trhový Štěpánov, Czech Republic
description: Štěpánovský trhák is a traditional running race held at the U Dubu site in Trhový Štěpánov. The route runs mostly through the forest, along forest paths and partly on a cycle path, offering runners a pleasant experience in a natural setting. The event includes children’s categories and a main race that starts in the afternoon. It is known for its community atmosphere and support for charitable activities.
course_highlights: The route runs through the forest and along forest paths
Part of the route follows a cycle path
New venue at the U Dubu site
additional: Registration for the main race is available online and in person on race day from 12:30. The children’s races start at 13:40, and the main race starts at 15:00. Parking is available on Lesní Street, Lipová Street and nearby streets. Driving onto the cycle path beyond the no-entry sign is prohibited. Previous available information lists both children’s and main races.

name: Jarní běh Plzeň
location: Park Homolka, Doudlevce, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Jarní běh Plzeň is a friendly cross-country and trail race held in Plzeň, offering courses for children, adults, and relay teams. The event is known for its cheerful atmosphere and excellent athletic performances, and is open to all generations and runners of every level. The race takes place at Park Homolka in Doudlevce and offers registration online and on site. It is an ideal opportunity to enjoy a sporting experience outdoors with family and friends.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail-style courses
Course distances: 6 km, 2 km, and relay
Location: Park Homolka, Doudlevce, Plzeň
additional: Registration is available online and on site. The race is open to all generations, including children and relay teams. The main category starts at 11:00; the first category starts at 10:00.

name: Jarní stodůlecký kros
description: The Jarní stodůlecký kros is a challenging, single-lap cross-country race that takes runners through almost every corner of Prague 13. The 9.6 km course passes through the Stodůlky housing estate, Central Park and the rocky areas above Prokop Valley. The race offers medals and certificates for the top finishers in each category, and prizes for the fastest runners. After the race, all participants can enjoy tea and a small sweet in the friendly atmosphere of a small race.
course_highlights: Single-lap course, 9.6 km long
Passes through the Stodůlky housing estate and Central Park
Climb over the rocky terrain above Prokop Valley
additional: The top three finishers in each category receive medals and certificates, while the fastest runners receive prizes. After the race, tea and a small sweet are provided for all participants. The organizer is TJ Stodůlky Praha; contact: Martin Žežulka. The top three runners in each category receive medals and certificates; prizes are prepared for the fastest runners. Tea and a sweet are available for participants after the race.

name: 57. Běh vítězství, 53. Hranická dvacítka a 10. Hranická desítka
location: Areál DDM Ježkovka Heřmanův Městec, Pardubický
description: Běh vítězství, Hranická dvacítka and Hranická desítka are traditional running races organized by SK Hranice, held at the DDM Ježkovka complex in Heřmanův Městec. The races feature a range of distances, from short children’s runs on the stadium track to longer off-road routes. The event is open to the general public and offers a sporting experience in pleasant surroundings, with a history spanning decades. The races take place on Saturday, April 11, 2026, and are popular with runners of all ages.

name: 23 Bieg Europejski Mistrzostwa Polski Ciepłowników
organizer: Klub Sportowy Altom Gniezno oraz Przedsiębiorstwo Energetyki Cieplnej w Gnieźnie Sp. z o.o.
description: The 23rd European Run is an annual running event held in Gniezno to commemorate Poland’s accession to the European Union. The 10 km main race follows city streets, with the start and finish at Gniezno’s Market Square. The course is certified by PZLA and consists of a single loop on asphalt and cobblestones. The event attracts runners from many countries, creating an international sporting celebration. After the race, participants can enjoy a recovery meal at the Market Square and attend the winners’ award ceremony.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through Gniezno, on asphalt and cobblestones (5%)
Start and finish at Gniezno’s Market Square
PZLA-certified, single-loop course
additional: The race office is open on Friday, 10.04.2027, from 17:00 to 20:30, and on race day, 11.04.2027, from 11:00 to 15:00 (the location has changed to the sports hall at Primary School No. 2 in Gniezno). The time limit for completing the race is 1 hour 30 minutes. Timing is recorded using chips in the race bibs. After the race, a recovery meal is available at the Market Square (for runners only). The winners’ award ceremony takes place at 18:00 on the stage at the Market Square. The event also includes a Preschoolers’ Run, divided into age groups, with wristbands and T-shirts required. The Polish Heating Engineers’ Championships are intended for employees of the heating industry. Available sources describe the 23rd edition, scheduled for 11 April 2026; details of the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed.

name: 9 Półaraton Leśny Na Żarcie
location: Leśna polana przy ul. Zakopiańskiej, Legionowo, Poland
price_range: 50 zł; biegi dzieci i młodzieży bez opłat

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za bieg w kategorii open wynosi – 50 zł.

description: The 9th "Na Żarcie" Forest Half Marathon is a cross-country race of approximately 21 km, held in a forest clearing on Zakopiańska Street in Legionowo. The course consists of two loops and runs exclusively along forest roads, giving the event a trail-running character. The event is open to adults and also includes free cross-country races for children and young people. Participants receive a race pack with a bib, a sports gift, a meal and a commemorative medal. The race takes place regardless of weather conditions in April, with a 12:00 start.
course_highlights: A cross-country course of approximately 21.1 km over two loops
Runs exclusively along forest roads
Start and finish in a forest clearing on Zakopiańska Street
additional: The race office will be open on 10 April 2026 from 8:00 to 18:00 at Arena Legionowo, and on 11 April from 8:30 in the forest clearing. A baggage drop is available to participants in the main race. The race pack includes a returnable race bib, a baggage-drop bag, a sports gift, a "Na Żarcie" meal and a commemorative medal. Prizes and trophies will be awarded to the top finishers in the overall and age categories, as well as to the top competitors from Legionowo. The race takes place regardless of weather conditions. The main race course is not officially certified. Information about the entry fee and organisation applies to the 2026 edition; details for the 2027 edition may differ.

name: Arm Race Wrocław
price_range: Karnet na 3 starty w 2027 roku: 699 zł; karnet Selection na 2 starty: 699 zł
description: Arm Race is an extreme obstacle race offering a range of formats suited to different experience levels. Participants can choose classic 5 km and 10 km distances in PRO, OPEN and FUN categories, take on multi-hour challenges in the Selection format, or try the fast-paced OCR100. This event is for those looking for sporting competition, technical obstacles and genuine excitement on the course, as well as for families and younger athletes. Arm Race combines movement, endurance and the satisfaction of overcoming one challenge after another.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses with approximately 25 and 40 obstacles
Selection format with 12- and 24-hour challenges
Family course of approximately 1 km, with no competitive pressure
additional: A 2027 season pass is available, covering 3 ARM RACE entries (5 km or 10 km, PRO/ELITE with no extra charge) or 2 entries in the SELECTION format for 699 zł, with an ARM RACE technical cap as a gift. The pass can be purchased by bank transfer to the account of Stowarzyszenie Rajsport Active. Family formats and options for young athletes, with timing and rankings, are also available. The 2027 price list gives season-pass prices but does not confirm the price of a single entry in Wrocław.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. It aims to promote the sport and showcase the scenic appeal of its courses. Held in the picturesque surroundings of the Wielkopolska region, the event offers participants a unique running experience amid beautiful natural scenery. The organizers place particular emphasis on the courses’ visual appeal and the event’s atmosphere, attracting runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in the Wielkopolska region
Courses with strong visual appeal
Organized since 2014 with experience and passion
additional: The event is organized by Stowarzyszenie Biegiem w Las, based in Poznań. It is a recurring event that also includes races for children and young people. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka will celebrate its 10th anniversary. The series has organized running events since 2014. Details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in available sources.

name: I Charytatywny Otwarty Bieg i Marsz Nord...
Leśny Zryw w Starych Jabłonkach
location: Hotel Anders Beach, ul. Spacerowa 2, Stare Jabłonki, Poland
description: Leśny Zryw in Stare Jabłonki is a race held on the beach at Hotel Anders and in the forest managed by the Stare Jabłonki Forest District. The event combines sport with an ecological initiative to plant a forest, offering two distances: a 10 km individual run and a 5 km family run or walk with tree planting. The event is family-oriented and brings people together, with additional culinary and educational activities for participants and their families. The start and finish are on the beach at Hotel Anders, and the 5 km course runs on gravel and asphalt. Online registration has closed, but registration and payment are available at the Race Office.
course_highlights: 5 km course: 4 km on gravel and 1 km on asphalt
Planting pine saplings along the 5 km course (1 tree per person)
Start and finish on the beach at Hotel Anders; the course passes through the Stare Jabłonki Forest District forest
additional: The Race Office and the start/finish are on the beach at Hotel Anders. Parking is available on the municipal sports field opposite the hotel. The time limit for the 5 km course is 2 hours. Participants receive a timing chip, which must be returned after the race. After the race, there are culinary and educational activities, as well as attractions for children. In the 2025 and 2026 editions, the start/finish and Race Office were on the beach at Hotel Anders, ul. Spacerowa 2. Entry fees from those editions were allocated to charitable causes; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Mistrzostwa Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie w Bie...
location: Zachowice, Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Ultra miles of Beskid Wyspowy
location: Łącko, Nowy Sącz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Ultra Miles of Beskid Wyspowy is a recurring running event held in the picturesque Beskid Wyspowy region, in Łącko. The event offers a range of distances, allowing participants to discover the charms of mountain trails and beautiful landscapes. Race packages for all distances include bandanas, and the organizers provide an efficient way to get in touch through the registration form. It’s a great opportunity for mountain-running enthusiasts who want to take on challenging routes and enjoy the atmosphere of a sporting event.
course_highlights: Mountain trails in Beskid Wyspowy
Picturesque landscapes and natural scenery
A range of distances suited to different experience levels
additional: Race packages for all distances include bandanas. You can contact the organizer via the registration form on the website. Race packages for all distances include bandanas.

name: V Bieg na Kokocińcu
description: The 5th edition of the Kokociniec Run is a family running event held in the picturesque Panewnicki Forest in Katowice. The routes follow forest paths with varied surfaces, offering a chance to connect with nature and enjoy outdoor activities. The event brings people together and welcomes both adults and children, who can take part in the family run. All participants receive a commemorative medal reflecting the event’s woodland character. Radio Katowice is the event’s media patron, highlighting the local importance of this sporting initiative.
course_highlights: Routes pass through picturesque parts of Panewnicki Forest
Varied surfaces and natural terrain
A family-friendly run with routes for children
additional: All participants who finish the run receive a commemorative medal featuring leaf motifs and green accents symbolising closeness to nature. The event is family-oriented, with routes suited to children and adults. Radio Katowice is the event’s media patron. Available information concerns the 5th edition, scheduled for 11 April 2026, and describes it as the final edition; it does not confirm an event in 2027.

name: VIII Festiwal Pieszo-Biegowy Przedwiośni...
location: Ciekoty, Masovian? No — Ciekoty, Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 8th Przedwiośnie Hiking and Running Festival is a unique event bringing together lovers of long-distance challenges and mountain scenery in the picturesque village of Ciekoty, at the foot of Łysica. Participants can choose from several distances: Mini Przedwiośnie (25 km), Maraton Przedwiośnie (44 km), Ultra Przedwiośnie (76 km), Giga Przedwiośnie (101 km), and the family-friendly Przedwiośniaczek (7 km). The routes pass through some of the most interesting and picturesque parts of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains, offering challenges for experienced runners as well as options for beginners. The festive sporting atmosphere and close contact with nature make it an ideal way to kick off spring activities.
course_highlights: Routes pass through picturesque parts of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains
Distances from 7 km to 101 km, for runners and hikers
Start and finish by the symbolic manor house of Stefan Żeromski in Ciekoty
additional: The event brings together hikers and runners. The routes are challenging but also accessible to beginners. The start is in front of Stefan Żeromski’s manor house in Ciekoty. Each year, the organizers prepare new routes that visit some of the most interesting parts of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. The festival is a hybrid event combining walking and running. In 2027, a lower entry fee applies through 31 October (fee details not provided). The edition announced for 2026 had a limit of 500 participants, and finishers were to receive a glass medal.

name: X Rajd Wilczy
description: Rajd Wilczy is an Adventure Race-style sporting challenge combining trail running, cycling, and special stages and tasks. The event takes place in Żory, with participants competing on different routes suited to various skill levels and team or individual formats. It engages whole families and promotes outdoor activity, bringing sport together with adventure and nature. The organizers provide professional event management and attractive routes that require fitness, navigation skills, and teamwork.
course_highlights: PROFI route: 130–150 km, midnight start, running, cycling, water stages, and special tasks; 16-hour time limit
OPEN route: 60–80 km, two-person teams, running and cycling with technical challenges; 6-hour time limit
BIEG route: approximately 20 km orienteering run in forest areas; 5-hour time limit
additional: Routes for different categories: PROFI (two-person teams, 130–150 km, 16-hour limit), OPEN (two-person teams, 60–80 km, 6-hour limit), ROWER (individual competition, 40–50 km, 5-hour limit), BIEG (individual 20 km orienteering run, 5-hour limit), RODZINNA (recreational 5–8 km route, no classification, free entry). The event is organized in cooperation with MOSiR Żory and Hufiec ZHP Żory. Participants must demonstrate navigation skills and physical fitness. The PROFI route starts at midnight. The event has a family-friendly, adventurous character. Details of the 2027 edition, including routes and fees, have not been confirmed in available sources. The 2025 edition was based at the MOSiR Sports and Entertainment Hall in Żory.

name: XI Kuźniański Półmaraton Leśny
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Kultury, Sportu i Rekreacji w Kuźni Raciborskiej

price_tiers.distance: Kuźniańska Leśna Zadyszka - bieg na 10 km
Dyszka z kija - marsz nordic walking

description: The 11th Kuźniański »Rafamet« Forest Half Marathon is an annual sporting event held at the municipal stadium in Kuźnia Raciborska. The main race, a half marathon (21.0975 km), follows scenic forest trails, giving participants a chance to enjoy nature and fresh air. The event also includes a 10 km race and a 10 km Nordic walking event, creating a unique sporting atmosphere. It is organized by the Municipal Centre for Culture, Sport and Recreation in Kuźnia Raciborska, which invites everyone to share in this special event.
course_highlights: The route follows forest trails
Enjoy nature and fresh air
Scenic natural surroundings
additional: The event includes three activities: a half marathon, a 10 km race, and a 10 km Nordic walking event. It is organized by the Municipal Centre for Culture, Sport and Recreation in Kuźnia Raciborska. The event takes place at the municipal stadium in Kuźnia Raciborska. Registration is conducted separately for each activity. The start is scheduled at the municipal stadium in Kuźnia Raciborska. An available source for the 11th edition gives the date as 11 April, which does not match the stated event date of 10 April 2027.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The Grand Prix Truchtacza in Mysłowice is a series of cross-country races organised by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association. The event combines a passion for running with an active lifestyle, promoting health, integration and the joy of physical activity. The races are open to all age groups and ability levels, and participation in the Grand Prix series is free. The organisers foster a supportive community that inspires people to get moving, making the event welcoming and accessible to everyone.
course_highlights: A series of cross-country races in Mysłowice
Several races make up the Grand Prix edition
Results and standings for each race are published by the organiser
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation is free. The event is open to all age groups and ability levels. The race regulations are available on the organiser’s website.

name: XVIII Wiszeńska (za)Dyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury Sportu i Rekreacji w Wiszni Małej
description: The 18th Wiszeńska (za)Dyszka is a 10 km race held in Ligota Piękna, in the municipality of Wisznia Mała. The event takes place annually and attracts runners from various places, offering a sporting competition on a scenic route. The start and finish are near Ligota Piękna, and the event is organized by the Culture, Sport and Recreation Centre in Wisznia Mała. The race takes place in April and is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: 10 km route
Scenic surroundings of Ligota Piękna
Organized by the local Culture, Sport and Recreation Centre
additional: Registration for the 18th edition closed on April 7, 2026.

name: Zorientowane Kozy
description: “Zorientowane Kozy” is an orienteering race held at the Quarry in Kozy, combining a sporting challenge with active exploration of the area. Previous editions featured competitive courses A, B and C, as well as the recreational R course, designed for people with different levels of experience and for families. The courses run through the former quarry and surrounding forests, where significant elevation changes, steep slopes and variable runnability make careful map reading just as important as pace. Details of the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed; this description is based on previous editions of the event.
course_highlights: Terrain of the former quarry and surrounding forests
Forest trails, significant elevation changes and steep slopes
Competitive courses and a recreational option for families and beginners
additional: In the 2026 edition, the recreational R course was approximately 2 - 2.5 km long and had no timed classification. The competitive courses had a 75-minute time limit; timing was conducted using the SportIdent system. Details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Kysucká desiatka
organizer: Mestské kulturno-športové stredisko Kysucké Nové Mesto
description: Kysucká desiatka je bežecký pretek v Kysuckom Novom Meste, ktorý ponúka trate pre rôzne vekové kategórie vrátane žiakov a dospelých. Štartuje sa v západnej časti ulice Murgašova, pričom pretekári môžu súťažiť na 1 km trati pre žiakov alebo na 10 km trati pre dospelých a juniorov. Pretek je organizovaný Mestským kultúrno-športovým strediskom Kysucké Nové Mesto a ponúka kategórie podľa veku a pohlavia. Štart pre žiactvo je o 10:05 a pre ostatné kategórie o 10:30 hod. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú bežeckú verejnosť a podporuje športový život v regióne.

name: Majstrovstvá SR v maratóne mužov a žien, veteránov a veteránok (ČSOB Bratislava maratón 2026) (4.kolo BP SAZ)
description: Majstrovstvá Slovenskej republiky v maratóne mužov a žien, veteránov a veteránok sú významnou atletickou udalosťou, ktorá sa uskutoční v Bratislave. Pretekári sa môžu tešiť na kvalitne pripravenú trať a profesionálnu organizáciu pod záštitou Slovenského atletického zväzu. Podujatie je súčasťou seriálu pretekov a ponúka možnosť súťažiť v rôznych kategóriách vrátane veteránov. Registrácia prebieha online a je určená pre širokú bežeckú komunitu.
sources: http://statistika.atletika.sk/admin/media/propozice/MAJSTROVSTVA SR v maratone - propozicie_12.4.2026, Bratislava akt..pdf

name: Trenčianská bežecká liga – 2. kolo
location: Trenčianske Stankovce, Trenčianske Stankovce, futbalové ihrisko
description: Trenčianska bežecká liga je séria deviatich bežeckých podujatí organizovaných od roku 2015 v okolí Trenčína, určená pre širokú verejnosť vrátane výkonnostných bežcov aj nadšencov. Každý mesiac od marca do novembra sa koná jedno kolo na rôznych zaujímavých a pestrých tratiach. Preteky ponúkajú priateľskú atmosféru, motiváciu a možnosť stretnúť sa s ľuďmi, ktorí podporujú zdravý životný štýl. Výsledky a bodovanie po každom kole slúžia ako motivácia pre ďalší tréning a zlepšovanie výkonov.

name: Běh lipovou alejí – Nymburská desítka
location: Tyršův ostrov and athletics stadium, Nymburk, Czech Republic
description: Běh lipovou alejí is a traditional road race in Nymburk, held since 1996. The race features a 10 km loop course, running mainly on paved paths on Tyršův ostrov and on the athletics stadium’s synthetic track. It is suitable for the general public, including children and young people, who have their own categories and courses. The race is organised by Sportovní klub POLICIE Nymburk, z.s., and takes place at the athletics stadium in Nymburk.
course_highlights: A 10 km loop course running mainly on the paved paths of Tyršův ostrov
The opening and closing sections, approximately 1,800 m in total, are on the athletics stadium’s synthetic track
The course complies with IAAF/AIMS rules for measuring courses outside a track
additional: Children’s and youth categories have separate starts from 8:30 to 10:55, with course distances ranging from 100 m to 2,700 m. The main 10 km race for men and women starts at 11:15. Registration for the children’s and youth categories is available only on race day, no later than 30 minutes before the start of the relevant category. The course is measured and can be run individually using GARMIN and STRAVA segments.

name: Horské běhy v Novohradských horách
location: Hojná Voda, Horní Stropnice, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Martin Brožka a tým Sportcentra Novohradské hory
description: The Mountain Runs in the Novohradské Mountains are traditional spring races held amid the beautiful scenery of the Novohradské Mountains, with their hub in Hojná Voda. They offer a variety of courses, from children’s categories and shorter runs to a challenging 63 km ultra trail with 2,050 m of elevation gain. The races are suitable for a wide range of runners, from amateurs to experienced athletes, and also include a canicross category. The start and finish are both in Hojná Voda, where you can also register on race day. The event is organised by Martin Brožka and the Sportcentrum Novohradské hory team.
course_highlights: Ultra trail: 63 km with 2,050 m of elevation gain
Canicross Classic: 19 km with 660 m of elevation gain
Zážitek: 12.4 km with 430 m of elevation gain
additional: You can register online at maraton.cz or in person on race day in Hojná Voda. Race numbers are distributed from 9:30 to 10:30 for adults and from 12:00 to 13:45 for children. Detailed course maps are available in the Mountain Runs Course section, along with course videos for each category. A prize raffle with valuable prizes, including accommodation and a subscription to the Svět běhu magazine, is planned for participants.

name: Kyfův Jarní běh
location: Louka pod bývalým lyžařským můstkem, Hrušov, Senohraby, Czech Republic
description: Kyfův Spring Run is a traditional running race organised by TJ Sokol Senohraby. It takes place in a meadow below the former ski jump in Hrušov, Senohraby. The race is part of the Ladův kraj Cup and offers a springtime sporting experience with various courses, including a special stream crossing for younger pupils. Participants can also look forward to a mobile café serving hot drinks and a friendly atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public and encourages sporting activity among children and adults.
course_highlights: The courses run through a meadow below the former ski jump in Hrušov
A special stream crossing on the 1.8 km course for younger pupils (born in 2011–2012)
Natural terrain with gentle uneven sections and a springtime atmosphere
additional: A mobile café serving coffee and hot chocolate will be on site. Bringing a change of shoes is recommended because of the stream crossing on the younger pupils’ course. The courses follow traditional routes, and marking is done the evening before the race. The terrain may be uneven in places due to animal activity. A mobile café serving hot drinks is usually on site.

name: Kros Sázava
location: Fotbalové hřiště, Pikovice, Hradištko, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kros Sázava is a running race held in Pikovice, by the football field, in the Central Bohemian Region. It offers three routes of varying distances and elevation gains, all entirely on natural terrain. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain with beautiful views. The routes are 15.5 km, 10 km and 5 km long, with elevation gains ranging from 120 to 500 metres, offering a varied experience for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Long route: 15.5 km with approximately 500 m of elevation gain
Medium route: 10 km with approximately 230 m of elevation gain
Hobby route: 5 km with approximately 120 m of elevation gain
additional: All routes run entirely on natural terrain. A photo gallery of the course is available at krosovypohar.cz/kros-sazava/fotky-z-trasy/.

name: Žďárská 10
location: Žďár nad Sázavou, Vysočina Region, Czech Republic
description: Žďárská 10 is a fast 10 km road race that opens the spring season in the heart of the Žďárské vrchy. The route starts in the center of Žďár nad Sázavou, follows cycle paths to the end of the Pilská Reservoir, and then returns, offering beautiful scenery and minimal elevation gain. The race has a mass start and is precisely measured, making it ideal for runners looking for a fast, enjoyable race in the picturesque Vysočina region. It is organized by Sportovní klub Žďárák z.s., with Vojtěch Bořil as the race representative.
course_highlights: Road route along a paved cycle path with minimal elevation gain
The route runs from the center of Žďár nad Sázavou to the Pilská Reservoir and back
A short 200-meter section on Dvorská Street with controlled road traffic
