description: The Boskovice Runs are a major sporting event in the Boskovice region, offering routes of various lengths, including the main 12.5 km Run over the Seven-Toothed Ridge. The event is for athletes as well as families with children, who can compete in children’s categories. Alongside the races, there is a varied program of activities, and hikers can join the runners. The Boskovice Runs promote a healthy lifestyle and community gatherings in a pleasant setting.
course_highlights: The main Run over the Seven-Toothed Ridge course is 12.5 km long
The route includes two long forest sections
Children’s races for all age groups
additional: Registration is also possible on site, and race numbers can be collected as early as the Thursday before the race. A new feature is a race for teams of three. The opportunity to receive a race number bearing your name is available for a limited time. The Boskovice Runs are held under the patronage of the town’s mayor, Jaroslav Dohnálek. The event also features a varied program of activities, including a cycling skills demonstration.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem
location: Zámecký park, Horšovský Týn, Czech Republic
organizer: Aktiv Sport Horšovský Týn, z. s.
description: The Run through the Castle Park is a sporting event organized by Aktiv Sport Horšovský Týn, held in the picturesque surroundings of the Castle Park in Horšovský Týn. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup and Běžec Chodska, creating a high-quality sporting atmosphere and competitive opportunities for runners of all levels. The event is scheduled for the afternoon of April 30, 2027, and offers an enjoyable experience in nature, with the opportunity to relax actively and take on a sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Run in the historic Castle Park
Part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup and Běžec Chodska
Picturesque natural surroundings in Horšovský Týn
additional: The race is included in the Plzeň Region Running Cup and Běžec Chodska. The race traditionally starts at 14:00. The venue is the Castle Park in Horšovský Týn. The organizer is Aktiv Sport Horšovský Týn. The date of April 30, 2027, is not confirmed in the available sources. In 2026, the race was scheduled for May 1 at 14:00.

name: Běh Krásné vyhlídky
location: Hliněný rybník, Struhařov, Benešov District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Beautiful Views Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Struhařov near Mnichovice. The race follows a unique panoramic route along the new Krásné vyhlídky nature trail, built by the Mnichovice and Surroundings Seniors’ Club in cooperation with local municipalities and the school. The main race is 7.4 km long and is part of the Pohár Ladova kraje running series. In addition to the main race, accompanying races are held for children and juniors. The event venue and race start are at Hliněný Pond in Struhařov.
course_highlights: Unique panoramic route along the Krásné vyhlídky nature trail
7.4 km loop for the main race
Accompanying races around the pond for children and juniors
additional: Registration for the main race is open from 14:00 to 16:00, and the main race starts at 16:30. Registration for the accompanying races for children and juniors is open from 13:00 to 14:30, and they start at 14:45. Categories include preschoolers (200 m), schoolchildren (620 m) and juniors (1860 m). The fastest man and woman from Struhařov are recognized in the main race. The race is made possible by volunteers, local associations and partners. It is part of the Pohár Ladova kraje running series; accompanying races for children are also held.

name: Běh Údolím vzdechů
location: Sudoměřice u Tábora, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Valley of Sighs Run is a traditional cross-country race organized by TJ Sokol Sudoměřice u Tábora. It has been held in the spring for several years. The race attracts enthusiastic athletes of all ages and offers an opportunity to enjoy a run in the picturesque surroundings of Sudoměřice u Tábora. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and community spirit, which promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through a picturesque valley
Traditional spring date on May 1
Suitable for children and adult runners
additional: Race results are published after the event. The event is organized by TJ Sokol Sudoměřice u Tábora. In previous editions, photos and downloadable results lists were available. The run is part of local sporting activities and community events.

name: Běh údolím samoty
location: Radvanec, Nový Bor, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run through the Valley of Samota is a traditional district running race held in the picturesque setting of Radvanec near Nový Bor in the Liberec Region. The race is part of the Českolipsko District Running League and gives runners the chance to test themselves on natural routes with varied terrain. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle amid the region’s beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Natural terrain in the Valley of Samota
Picturesque surroundings of Radvanec near Nový Bor
Part of the Českolipsko District Running League

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Chomutov
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Chomutov is a charity event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of eyewitnesses and helps them. The race takes place at Wakepark Chomutov and is part of a series of runs held throughout the Czech Republic. Participants run with a mass start, and the entry fee is a donation to a good cause, helping fund the recording and processing of eyewitness stories. The event is open to the general public and also offers the option of running symbolically anywhere outside the official course.
course_highlights: Mass-start run at Wakepark Chomutov
Charity event supporting the memory of the nation and eyewitnesses
Option to take part in a symbolic run anywhere in the Czech Republic or abroad
additional: Registered runners receive their race number at check-in on race day. It is recommended that they write any allergies and emergency contact details on the back of their race number in case of medical complications. Results are announced after the last runner has finished. The event is part of a wider series of runs throughout the Czech Republic and includes a corporate team run and a run anywhere. The race offers a timed 5 km course and an untimed 1 km family run.

name: Král Zvičiny 2026
description: Král Zvičiny 2026 is a mass-start individual uphill road race and an ideal way to start the season. The race takes place on May 1, 2026, starting in Dvůr Králové nad Labem and finishing at Raisova chata on Zvičina. The main race route is approximately 10 km long, on asphalt, with a continuous climb. Children can take part in a shorter 3 km route finishing in Dehtov. After the race, the results are announced at Motorest U Lípy in Třebihošť.
course_highlights: Main route: Lipnice → Dehtov → Třebihošť → Zvičina, approx. 10 km, asphalt, continuous climb
Children’s route: Lipnice → Dehtov, 3 km, asphalt, continuous climb
Finish at Raisova chata on Zvičina
additional: Registration takes place from 8:30 to 9:30 in Dvůr Králové - Lipnice - Zaháj. The results are announced at Motorest U Lípy in Třebihošť. Parking is available at Motorest U Lípy and at the Rodos company (start location). Categories are divided by age and gender, including youth and children.

name: 12 Półmaraton Grudziądz-Rulewo
organizer: Gmina Miasto Grudziądz, Miejski Ośrodek Rekreacji i Wypoczynku w Grudziądzu
description: The 12th Grudziądz–Rulewo Half Marathon, following in the footsteps of Bronisław Malinowski, is a race with a unique character, deeply rooted in the history of the city and the life of its namesake, Olympic champion Bronisław Malinowski. The course passes places associated with Bronisław’s life and training, starting at the Olimpia Grudziądz Stadium, crossing the Bronisław Malinowski Bridge, and finishing at Hanza Pałac Hotel in Rulewo. The race combines a passion for sport with remembrance of an outstanding athlete, offering participants an exciting experience and a sporting spirit that brings generations together. The event takes place on the first weekend of May, and participants can look forward to a varied program of accompanying events and organizational support.
course_highlights: The course passes historic places associated with Bronisław Malinowski, including the Bronisław Malinowski Bridge in Grudziądz
Start at the Olimpia Grudziądz Stadium; finish at Hanza Pałac Hotel in Rulewo
A course with varied surfaces, aid stations every 5 km, and markers every 1 km
additional: The race office is open on April 30 (16:00–20:00) at Marina Grudziądz and on May 1 (8:00–10:30) at the Olimpia Stadium. The time limit is 3 hours; the course closes at 14:00. There are at least 3 aid stations on the course, offering water, isotonic drinks, and fruit. After the race, participants receive a medal, diploma, and recovery meal, and can use physiotherapists’ massage services and free MZK bus transport. On race day, warm-ups are led by Fit House instructors. Children can take part in accompanying “Be Like Bronek” races. Information for the 12th edition lists the race office at Marina Grudziądz and at the GKS Olimpia Stadium. Available sources concern the race held on May 1, 2026, not the April 30, 2027 date given in the metadata.

name: 42 Krapkowicki Bieg Uliczny
description: The Krapkowice Street Race is an annual running event held in Krapkowice, with a tradition dating back to the 1980s. The race is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and takes place on a new route through the city streets, starting and finishing at 3 Kilińskiego Street. The event attracts runners of different ages and abilities, offering an exciting atmosphere and the chance to compete on the streets of Krapkowice. The organizers provide a lively program, including a cheering zone and contests for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: A 42 km street course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Start and finish at 3 Kilińskiego Street in Krapkowice
Route along the city's main streets, including Opolska Street, 1 Maja Street, and Mickiewicza Street
additional: The organizers provide the rules and entry forms in PDF format. The website features photo galleries from previous editions and an archive of results. The event includes a cheering zone with contests for spectators. The race route was recently changed and has official certification. The 42nd edition in 2026 was held over a distance of 10 km; available sources do not yet confirm details of the 2027 edition.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by running enthusiasts who emphasize scenic and attractive routes. The spring edition in Mikołów takes place in the beautiful Botanical Garden, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by nature. The event promotes physical activity and running among people of different ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Botanical Garden in Mikołów
Scenic and attractive natural surroundings
Races organized to promote running and physical activity
additional: The organizer is the Biegiem w Las Association. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka will celebrate its 10th anniversary. The event places particular emphasis on the aesthetic qualities of its chosen locations and on cross-country races.

name: III Aleksandryjska Piątka po Lesie
location: Parking at the end of ul. Sosnowa, Aleksandria Druga, Poland
description: The 3rd Aleksandria Forest Five is a race organized by the Atelier Sport Association, held in the scenic area of Aleksandria Druga. The event is a 5 km forest run, starting at 11:00 from the parking lot at the end of Sosnowa Street. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: A 5 km forest course
Start and finish at the parking lot on Sosnowa Street
Scenic surroundings of Aleksandria Druga
additional: Timekeeping is provided using a modern electronic system based on RFID chips and start/finish mats. The organizer provides telephone support from 8:00 to 16:00 and, on race day, via a special number. The event is held under the patronage of the Atelier Sport Association. Information about the edition described in the available sources gives the race date as May 1, 2026, not April 30, 2027. The time limit is 1 hour 30 minutes; the 5 km race is limited to 200 participants. The start and finish are at the parking lot at the end of Sosnowa Street in Aleksandria.

name: LENART XI Bieg Uliczny o Puchar Starosty Powiatu Kępińskiego
organizer: Powiat Kępiński, przy współudziale Stowarzyszenia Nasz Bezpieczny Powiat Kępiński oraz Spółdzielni Socjalnej Green Service
description: LENART 11th Street Race for the Kępno County Starosta’s Cup is an annual running event held in Kępno. The 10 km main race starts on Dąbrowskiego Street and includes OPEN, uniformed services, team, county championship, and disability categories. The organizers have provided cash prizes for the winners and special awards for the best athletes from Poland. The event also includes a Preschoolers’ Run, which starts before the main race. Registration for the main race is available via maratonypolskie.pl.
course_highlights: 10 km main race on the streets of Kępno
Categories: OPEN, uniformed services, team, county championship, and people with disabilities
Cash prizes for the winners and awards for the best athletes from Poland
additional: The Preschoolers’ Run has race-day registration from 9:00, with the start at 11:40. Awards for the best male and female athletes from Poland in the OPEN category. Organizers: Kępno County, Nasz Bezpieczny Powiat Kępiński Association, and Green Service Social Cooperative. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00. Registration for the Preschoolers’ Run takes place on race day from 9:00, and its start is scheduled for 11:40. Sources for this edition give the date as May 1, not April 30, 2027.

name: VIII Rydzewski przełaj - bieg dla trzeźw...
description: The 8th Rydzewo Cross-Country Run promotes a healthy lifestyle, sobriety, and running as a form of physical recreation. The event takes place on the sports field in Rydzewo and is open to everyone, regardless of age, gender, or place of residence. The organizers emphasize fair play and compliance with PZLA regulations. Participants run a cross-country distance and discover the scenic and tourist attractions of Miastkowo Municipality. The run is co-financed by Miastkowo Municipality from funds allocated to alcohol prevention and also aims to promote local communities.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on the sports field in Rydzewo
Route showcasing the scenic and tourist attractions of Miastkowo Municipality
Open competition for children, young people, and adults, held in the spirit of fair play
additional: Start and finish on the sports field in Rydzewo. Race office opens at 13:00, group warm-up at 14:30, results announcement and awards ceremony at 16:30, and the event ends at 18:00. Participant limit: 100. Registration is by name via the website. Minors need written consent from a parent or guardian and must sign a declaration confirming they have no contraindications to taking part. On-the-day registration is possible from 13:00 to 14:30 if places remain. Information about the 8th edition gives the date as May 1, 2026, while the stated event date is April 30, 2027; details of the latter date are not confirmed in the available materials. For the edition described on the registration page, the event began at 13:00 and the run at 15:00; the participant limit was 100.

name: XIII Bieg Borków
location: Osieczna, Leszno County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th Bieg Borków is an annual running event held in Osieczna, offering a great opportunity to spend the May holiday actively. The event includes main races over 5 km and 10 km, as well as a free 1 km children’s race held on race day. Every participant receives a race pack and a medal, and the top finishers are awarded trophies. The atmosphere encourages families and the local community to enjoy sport together.
course_highlights: Main races over 5 km and 10 km
1 km children’s race with age categories ranging from preschoolers to grades 7–8
Start and finish at the Centre of Culture and Library in Osieczna
additional: The 1 km children’s race is free. Registration takes place on race day at the Centre of Culture and Library in Osieczna from 8:00 to 9:45. The children’s race is limited to 250 participants. Each child receives a medal and a race pack; age categories have trophies, and prizes are awarded by raffle. This information refers to the 13th edition in 2026 and does not confirm details of the 2027 edition. In 2026, participants received a race pack and a medal, and the top finishers received prizes.

name: XIII Bieg Tropami Śląskich Dinozaurów
location: Lisowice, Gmina Pawonków, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th National Run in the Footsteps of Silesian Dinosaurs is a running event held in Lisowice, in the Pawonków municipality. The race is open to participants of all ages who want to spend time actively in a family-friendly atmosphere. The course draws on the region’s paleontological history, making it a unique sporting and educational event. Registration is online, and participants can enjoy being active together outdoors.
course_highlights: A course inspired by the region’s paleontological history
A family-friendly event for runners of all ages
The race takes place in the picturesque village of Lisowice
additional: Register online at https://formularz.ultimasport.pl/458. The event is family-friendly and offers an opportunity to enjoy outdoor activity. No information is available about the start time, start waves, participant limits, or race packages.

name: XXII Maraton Jelcz-Laskowice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Maraton, Półmaraton, 10 km wpisowe do 31.03. - 100 zł

description: You are warmly invited to the 22nd Toyota Jelcz-Laskowice Marathon, which will take place on the streets of Jelcz-Laskowice. The event features three main races: a marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.097 km, and a 10 km run and Nordic Walking event. The event is held in memory of Barbara Szlachetka and offers participants a commemorative T-shirt, access to a swimming pool and massages, and a post-race meal. Shorter distances on the school track are planned for children and young people, with a separate online registration system.
course_highlights: Route through the streets of Jelcz-Laskowice
Distances: marathon, half marathon, and 10 km run and Nordic Walking event
Access to a swimming pool and massages after the race
additional: After the race, participants can use the swimming pool, get massages, and have a meal. Children and young people can take part in races from 50 to 600 metres on the track at PSP No. 2, with the start at 11:00. The race package includes a commemorative T-shirt. According to the published information, the marathon starts at 8:00, while the half marathon and the 10 km run and Nordic Walking event start at 9:00. The listing for the 22nd edition gives prices of 100 zł until 31 March and 120 zł in April; however, it does not confirm the date or fees for the 2027 edition.

name: XXII Półmaraton Chełmżyński Chełmżyńska Dziesiątka
description: The XXII Chełmża Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Chełmża, attracting runners from various regions. The half-marathon course passes through scenic areas of the town and its surroundings, offering participants attractive views and sporting challenges. The event is open to all and promotes an active lifestyle and integration within the local community. The organizers provide professional support and an atmosphere conducive to both competition and recreation.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course passes through the centre of Chełmża and the surrounding area
Scenic views and varied terrain
A well-marked and secured course
additional: Available information concerns the XXII edition, scheduled for 1 May 2026; it does not confirm the stated date of 30 April 2027.

name: Etyekrun
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 12 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km, 5 km, 0.2 km
organizer: RUNaway Sportszervező Kft. és Etyek Trend
description: EtyekRUN is a special running race on the rolling hills of Etyek, where the atmosphere of the wine region, its vineyards, rows of grapevines, and spring scenery accompany participants every step of the way. The race is part of the Garmin WTF series, which celebrates the joy of movement and the diversity of athletic achievements, from shorter road distances to longer trail runs. The event is family-friendly, and sustainability, consistency, and enjoyment are at the heart of its community. Runners will enjoy a unique experience amid the beauty of nature and the wine region.

name: XI. Ezerjó Félmaraton 5 / 10 / 21
description: The 11th Ezerjó Half Marathon will take place on May 1, 2026, at Szent István Square in Mór. The race offers challenges over three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and the half marathon (21 km). Runners can complete the courses among beautiful vineyards on varied terrain, with climbs and panoramic views. The event is family-friendly and also welcomes younger participants with children's races. At the finish, participants are rewarded with refreshments and a finisher's medal. The local wine region and the sense of community give the race its unique atmosphere.

name: FUT AZ ÜLLŐ
description: “Fut az Üllő” is a traditional city running race held in the center of Üllő. The race aims to promote sport and community life and is open to all age groups. On-site registration is also available in limited numbers on race day from 7 a.m. The race is organized by the Municipality of Üllő, which ensures the event’s success with the support of the local community.

name: Behaj lesmi – Smolenice
description: Behaj lesmi Smolenice je súčasťou série siedmich pretekov v krásnej slovenskej prírode, ktoré ponúkajú trasy prevažne na mäkkom povrchu a v čerstvom vzduchu. Preteky sú zaradené do UTMB Index Races, čo znamená medzinárodné bodové hodnotenie trailových pretekov. Trasy vedú pod Smolenickým zámkom, kde bežcov povzbudzujú tematické postavy a vytvárajú tak jedinečnú atmosféru. Súťažiť môžete na dvoch hlavných trasách - 12 km a 19 km, pričom na trati je aj rýchlostný úsek Conti Speed Section s hodnotnou cenou.

name: Tlmačský polmaratón
location: Tlmače okr. Levice, Tlmače okr. Levice, Tlmače – Lipník, Nám. odborárov
description: Tlmačský polmaratón a desiatka je tradičný bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná v meste Tlmače. Tento 43. ročník pretekov ponúka polmaratónsku trať dlhú 21 km a desiatku, pričom súčasťou je aj hobby beh a nordic walking na 3,5 km. Podujatie je súčasťou Bežeckej ligy Patriotov a organizuje ho mesto Tlmače spolu s miestnymi športovými klubmi. Bežci si môžu vychutnať kvalitnú organizáciu, elektronické meranie času a štartovné balíčky s propagačnými predmetmi a poukážkou na stravu.

name: Jarný charitatívny beh Nitra
organizer: Mgr. Lukáš Čelinák, Rotary klub Nitra Harmony
description: Jarný charitatívny beh Nitra je komunitné športové podujatie, ktoré spája pohyb, solidaritu a podporu zdravotníctva v meste Nitra. Beží sa na podporu urgentného príjmu Fakultnej nemocnice Nitra a je organizované Rotary klubom Nitra Harmony spolu s tímom Oktoberfest Run Nitra. Podujatie ponúka rôzne disciplíny vrátane 10 km, 5 km a 1,2 km tratí, pričom je možné sa zapojiť aj tímovo. Bežci tak môžu prispieť k charitatívnemu cieľu a zároveň si užiť športovú atmosféru v Nitre.

name: Sklené sa hýbe
location: Sklené (okr. Turčianske Teplice), Sklené (okr. Turčianske Teplice), futbalové ihrisko
description: Sklené sa hýbe je bežecké podujatie konané na futbalovom ihrisku v Sklenom, okres Turčianske Teplice. Preteká sa na troch tratiach s rôznou dĺžkou a prevýšením: polmaratón (21,5 km, 740 m+), 14 km (420 m+) a 8 km (320 m+). Okrem hlavných kategórií sú pripravené aj detské aktivity. Štart hlavných kategórií je o 10:30 hod., detské behy začínajú o 10:45 hod. Podujatie je súčasťou série Beh tromi krajmi a Beh dvomi krajmi.

name: Plesnivec VerticalRun
location: Parkovisko chata Plesnivec - Tatranská Kotlina, Parkovisko chata Plesnivec - Tatranská Kotlina, Parkovisko chata Plesnivec - Tatranská Kotlina
description: Plesnivec VerticalRun je horský beh s dĺžkou 5 km a prevýšením 530 metrov, ktorý sa koná 2. mája 2026 v Tatranskej Kotline pri chate Plesnivec. Bežci si užijú náročný vertikálny profil trate, ktorý preverí ich kondíciu a vytrvalosť. Registrácia prebieha online a zabezpečuje zaradenie na štartovaciu listinu po úhrade štartovného poplatku. Podujatie je vhodné pre všetkých milovníkov horského behu, ktorí hľadajú výzvu v krásnom prírodnom prostredí.

name: Beh oslobodenia obce Budča
location: Budča, okr. Zvolen, Budča, okr. Zvolen, pred Obecným úradom
description: Beh oslobodenia obce Budča je tradičný bežecký pretek, ktorý sa koná v obci Budča s cieľom pripomenúť oslobodenie obce. Hlavný beh má dĺžku 8,4 km s prevýšením 232 metrov a vedie okolo obce cez lesné cesty a asfalt, so štartom a cieľom pri obecnom úrade. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské kategórie s kratšími traťami prispôsobenými veku pretekárov a kategória "Kolo pre zdravie" určená pre všetkých bez rozdielu veku a výkonnosti. Pretek je súčasťou Zvolenskej bežeckej ligy a ponúka elektronické meranie časov, občerstvenie a medaily pre účastníkov.

name: Memoriál Karla Raise

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registrace do čtvrtka 30.4. 2026 do 20:00, platba převodem

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné lidového běhu 50,- Kč, registrace do 30.4.2026 do 20:00

description: The Karel Rais Memorial is a traditional road race organized by the ELNA Počerady Athletics Sports Club in Louny. The race takes place on closed roads along a certified 15 km course that descends from an elevation of 219 m to 178 m. The program also includes a roller-skating race and a fun run for all ages and fitness levels. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and an accompanying cultural program, and is suitable for the general public and sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Course on closed class II and III roads, with no motor vehicle traffic
AIMS-measured certified course, 15 km long
Start at an elevation of 219 m; finish at an elevation of 178 m
additional: Race-day registration takes place from 7:30 to 9:30 in Pavilion B at the exhibition grounds in Masaryk Gardens. Changing rooms and showers are available at the swimming pool sauna next to the exhibition grounds. Personal belongings are transported by van from the start to the finish. The race starts in four waves according to category. Buses to the start run from 9:30 from the car park in front of the Municipal Swimming Pool in Louny. The fun run starts at 10:45 and is open to all ages and fitness levels, including participants on roller skates, in strollers, or in wheelchairs. All fun-run participants receive a T-shirt and can enter a prize draw with valuable prizes. The day also includes a Children’s Day with athletics competitions and a cultural program. Facilities, including changing rooms and showers, are available at the finish; the organizers provide transport to the start.

name: Maloskalský půlmaraton
location: Žlutá plovárna, Malá Skála, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The Maloskalský Half Marathon is a traditional running race on a scenic route from Malá Skála to Turnov and back. The race offers a half-marathon course with approximately 25 metres of elevation gain and a surface combining asphalt, gravel and farm tracks. It starts in the afternoon at Žlutá plovárna in Malá Skála. Runners can enjoy refreshments along the course and at the finish, a medal and other services. The race is suitable for runners across a wide range of ages and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: 21.098 km course with approximately 25 m of elevation gain
Surface: 80% asphalt, 10% gravel, 10% farm track
The route follows a cycle path and hiking trail, crossing a railway footbridge and passing Hrubý Rohozec Chateau
additional: The half marathon starts at 17:00; the 10 km race starts at 17:10. The race is at capacity, and on-site registration is not available. The entry fee includes a race number, with the option to have your name printed on it if you register by 26 April; STOPNITO chip timing; refreshments along the course and at the finish (water, isotonic drinks, glucose tablets, salt, homemade cakes, bananas, oranges and a bottle of Mattoni); a metal finisher’s medal; baggage storage; small gifts from sponsors; medical services; and a race photo gallery. Race-day registration is open from 14:45 to 16:40, and baggage storage closes at 16:40. A T-shirt with the race logo can be added to your order at Stopnito.cz. Parking is available at the central car park by the GBO petrol station in Malá Skála. According to the available description, the race provides chip timing, refreshments along the course and at the finish, baggage storage and medical services.

name: K6 Czech Ultramarathon Festival
location: Konstantinovy Lázně, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The K6 Czech Ultramarathon Festival is a prestigious ultramarathon held in Konstantinovy Lázně, featuring six races on a 2,854-metre loop. The longest event is a six-day race that attracts ultramarathon runners from many countries. In 2026, the 24-hour race will also be the Czech Republic Championship. The event offers a challenge for experienced runners and the experience of long-distance road running.
course_highlights: A 2,854-metre loop in Konstantinovy Lázně
The longest race lasts six days
The 24-hour race is the Czech Republic Championship
additional: The race is held on roads and includes several timed events: 24 hours, 48 hours, 72 hours and 144 hours. The organizer is Rumning klap z.s. The first event starts at 12:00. In 2026, the 24-hour race will also be the Czech Republic Championship.

name: Otrokovická 100
location: Otrokovice, Zlín District, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: Otrokovická 100 is a traditional long-distance walk in the Moravian-Silesian Region, offering a challenging 100 km route and a shorter 50 km option. The event is for experienced hikers and athletes looking to test their endurance and navigation skills in beautiful natural surroundings. Both the start and finish are in Otrokovice, and the route crosses varied terrain with GPS tracking available. The event is part of a series of timed long-distance walks with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 100 km and 50 km routes in the Moravian-Silesian Region
Challenging terrain with varied surfaces and scenic views
GPS tracking to follow participants
additional: A total of 578 runners registered in 2026. The event is part of a series of timed long-distance walks with GPS tracking.

name: Kokina běh
location: Horka nad Moravou, Olomouc District, Czech Republic
description: The Kokina Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc and held in Horka nad Moravou. It is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix of Endurance Runners series and offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners. The Liga stovkařů Olomouc club is known for its long-standing tradition of promoting endurance running and organizes several races in the region. The race is suitable for the general public and supports the running community in Central Moravia.

name: Přespolní běh Říp - Roudnice nad Labem
location: Tyršův stadion, Roudnice nad Labem, Czech Republic
organizer: T. J. Sokol Roudnice nad Labem
description: The Říp Cross-Country Run in Roudnice nad Labem is a traditional athletics event organized by T. J. Sokol Roudnice nad Labem. The race offers various distances for children, youth and adults, including challenging runs up Mount Říp and a longer endurance course. The start and registration take place at Tyrš Stadium, where a friendly atmosphere and sporting spirit prevail. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes outdoor activity and community gatherings.
course_highlights: Various distances, from 300 m for preschool children to 15,200 m for endurance runners
A challenging 8,700 m run up Mount Říp for men, women and veterans
Start and finish at Tyrš Stadium, with courses passing through Alej Sv. Čecha and by the small cross
additional: Registration is from 8:00 at Tyrš Stadium: until 8:45 for children and youth, and until 9:30 for adults. Entry fees are paid at registration. Categories are divided by age and course distance, with separate categories for women’s mile runners and women veterans in the 8,700 m race. The event is part of Sokol Roudnice nad Labem’s traditional sports program. According to the available information, entry fees are paid at registration.

name: Běh Klobasnou
location: Stadium TJ Lokomotiva, Veselí nad Lužnicí, Czech Republic
description: The Klobasna Run is a traditional running race organised by the TJ Lokomotiva Veselí nad Lužnicí athletics club. The race is open to the general public, including children and adults, and offers various categories and distances. The race starts at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium in Veselí nad Lužnicí. Participants can look forward to a pleasant atmosphere, awards for the top runners and a programme of activities for children. The race is part of the rich running tradition of the South Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the TJ Lokomotiva Veselí nad Lužnicí stadium
Categories for all age groups, from preparatory classes to adults
Short children’s races take place directly on the stadium grounds
additional: Athletes from Veselí nad Lužnicí can enter for free. An inflatable castle and face painting are available for children. All participants in the children’s categories receive a medal and refreshments at the finish. Parking is available in the sports complex. The race starts at the TJ Lokomotiva Veselí nad Lužnicí stadium.

name: 12 Wołowski Bieg Flagi Narodowej
location: Hala Widowiskowo-Sportowa, ul. Panieńska 4a, Wołów, Poland
organizer: Wydział Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji Urzędu Miejskiego w Wołowie
description: The 12th Wołów National Flag Run is an annual running event held in Wołów at the sports and entertainment hall at 4a Panieńska Street. The race takes place on May 2, 2026, and offers an opportunity to celebrate through sport and bring runners together. The organizers provide a secure start-package exchange and support from the Sports, Tourism and Recreation Department of Wołów Municipal Office. The event attracts both recreational and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: The 10 km race was part of the previous edition.
The start and event are located at the Sports and Entertainment Hall in Wołów.
The May race is associated with National Flag Day celebrations.
additional: The start-package exchange lets participants safely buy a package from another runner or list their own. The race office is open on event day from 15:00 to 17:30 at the Sports and Entertainment Hall in Wołów, 4a Panieńska Street. The registration panel for the 12th edition includes an exchange for reselling packages. The stated date for the 12th edition is May 2, 2026; details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: 2 Bieg dla Flagi
description: The 2nd Run for the Flag is an annual running event held in the picturesque Silesian Park in Chorzów. It offers a chance to spend time actively outdoors, surrounded by greenery and the park’s many attractions. The course passes through varied parts of the park, offering participants both challenges and beautiful views. The event has a family-friendly and patriotic character, bringing the local community together and promoting a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course passes through more than 600 hectares of meadows, forests and gardens in Silesian Park
The run takes place on varied terrain, including forest trails and park paths
Picturesque views and proximity to attractions such as the Elka Cableway and the Rosarium
additional: The park offers numerous attractions for participants and their families, including the Elka Cableway and extensive green spaces ideal for recreation. The Silesian Park mobile app is available to help with navigation and planning your visit. The park has parking facilities and house rules available on its website. In previous editions, participants could run or walk with poles; the event was recreational in nature.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce
location: Geonatura Kielce – Botanical Garden, ul. Jagiellońska 78, Kielce, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014, focused on promoting the sport and the scenic appeal of its courses. The event takes place in the picturesque Botanical Garden in Kielce, offering participants a unique experience on a route full of natural charm. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and stay active in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Botanical Garden in Kielce
Picturesque natural surroundings
Race organized by experienced running enthusiasts since 2014
additional: Location: Geonatura Kielce - Botanical Garden, ul. Jagiellońska 78, Kielce.

name: Maraton Górski Leśnik
description: Leśnik Mountain Marathon is an ultra-style mountain race held in the scenic area around Szczyrk. The course features challenging climbs and varied terrain, offering participants a unique challenge and beautiful views. The event offers several distances, including a full marathon, a half marathon, and shorter races, welcoming runners of different experience levels. The event is very popular and provides an excellent opportunity to test yourself in a mountain race.
course_highlights: Mountain course with significant elevation gain
Scenic views of the Beskids
Various distances: 49 km, 28 km, 10 km
additional: A GPX file for the 169 km Stumilak course, with 7,736 m of elevation gain, is available to download and use for planning. An unsupported race option is available (without support). Information about the race headquarters by the Skalite amphitheatre and the distances comes from the 2026 edition description; the 2027 edition schedule may differ.

name: Puszcza Festiwal
description: Puszcza Festival is a sports and recreation event held in the Niepołomice Forest, with its base at Sitowiec Clearing. Participants can choose a hiking or cycling event and find checkpoints themselves using a map. The routes follow forest trails and roads, and the festival encourages visitors to actively explore the area.
course_highlights: Routes through the forest setting of the Niepołomice Forest
Map navigation and checkpoint completion
Hiking and cycling options, including night routes in previous editions
additional: Previous editions started and finished at Sitowiec Clearing. Distances listed in promotional materials refer to earlier editions and do not confirm the program for 2027.

name: VII Półmaraton Bitwa pod Gorlicami
location: Cmentarz Wojenny nr 91 na Górze Cmentarnej, Gorlice, Poland
organizer: Akademickie Koło Polskiego Czerwonego Krzyża i Klub Honorowych Dawców Krwi przy Akademii Górniczo-Hutniczej im. Stanisława Staszica w Krakowie oraz Oddział Rejonowy PCK w Gorlicach
description: The 7th International “Battle of Gorlice” Half Marathon is a 21 km road race taking place on 1 May 2027 in Gorlice. The start and finish are located at War Cemetery No. 91 on Cemetery Hill and the Historical Park in Siary, respectively. The route runs through city streets and the scenic surrounding area, with a time limit of 2.5 hours. The event is sporting, historical and promotional in nature, commemorating the significance of the Battle of Gorlice in World War I and promoting international participation.
course_highlights: A 21 km road route with a time limit of 2.5 hours
Start at War Cemetery No. 91 on Cemetery Hill in Gorlice
Finish at the Historical Park in Siary; the route passes through scenic localities and along cycle paths
additional: The race office and race-pack collection will be open on race day from 8:00 to 10:30 at the Historical Park in Siary. The race time limit is 2.5 hours. The event is sporting, historical and promotional in nature, with international participants. The organizer provides electronic timing. Materials for the 7th edition list an 11:00 start and a limit of 250 paid entries. The race pack includes a bib number, medal, finish-line meal and gifts from sponsors. Available information about the 7th edition gives the date as 2 May, so it does not confirm the stated date of 1 May 2027.

name: X Dębiński Bieg po Flagę
location: Publiczna Szkoła Podstawowa w Woli Dębińskiej, Wola Dębińska, Poland
description: The 10th Dębiński Run for the Flag is an annual sporting event held at the sports field by the Public Primary School in Wola Dębińska. The event takes place on May 1 and includes races over various distances, including 2.5 km and 10 km, as well as a 4.5 km Nordic walking event and shorter races for children. This family-friendly event is full of sporting excitement and offers activities for children and a food zone, encouraging active recreation and bringing the local community together. The race is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Dębno Municipality and is an opportunity to celebrate the May holiday together.
course_highlights: Races over 2.5 km and 10 km
Nordic walking over 4.5 km
Children’s races over 150 m, 300 m and 600 m
additional: The event offers free activities for children and a food zone. It is family-friendly and held under the honorary patronage of Dębno Municipality Mayor Wiesław Kozłowski. In the previous, anniversary edition, the start and accompanying events took place at the sports field by the Public Primary School in Wola Dębińska. Participants received a commemorative medal and flag.

name: XII Bieg Flagi
location: Park Kępa Potocka, Żoliborz, Warsaw, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za udział w XII Biegu Flagi na dystansie 5 lub 10 km to 50 złotych.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Biegi dla dzieci 0-12 lat na dystansach 200, 400 i 800 metrów są bezpłatne.

description: The 12th Flag Run is an annual race held in Kępa Potocka Park in Warsaw to commemorate the Day of the Flag of the Republic of Poland. The route winds through the scenic park, giving participants the opportunity to celebrate Polish identity and national symbols through sport. The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, as well as shorter races for children, creating a family-friendly and patriotic atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through Kępa Potocka Park in Warsaw
One lap for 5 km; two laps for 10 km
Children’s races over 200, 400 and 800 metres in the central part of the park
additional: The adult race route is a 5 km loop through the park; the 10 km race consists of two laps. The children’s races cover shorter distances in the central part of the park. The organiser is the Żoliborz District Office of the Capital City of Warsaw. Information about the routes and children’s races is for the 2026 edition. The race traditionally takes place on 2 May, so the stated date of 1 May 2027 needs confirmation.

name: II. Mohácsi Gőcze Trail
description: The 2nd Mohács Gőcze Trail is a recreational running race taking place on May 2, 2026, at the Szőlőhegyi event venue in Mohács. The race follows trails in the Mohács Hills and offers a range of distances for all ages, from a 500-meter children’s race to a 22 km distance. The family-friendly event provides medical coverage and awards, and participants can track their times with chip timing. Runners can take part in a group warm-up before the start. Participation is at the runners’ own risk.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 4. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelný bežecký závod na vzdialenosť 2 míle (3,218 km), ktorý sa koná v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave. Organizuje ho Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team a je určený pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov. Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste v deň preteku od 9:30, štart je o 10:00. Súťaž je súčasťou série pretekov, kde bežci zbierajú body do putovného pohára podľa kategórií a výkonov.

name: Beh 2 míle
description: Beh 2 míle v Bratislave pri Kuchajde je pravidelný bežecký závod na vzdialenosť 2 míle (3,218 km), organizovaný Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamom. Prezentácia a registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste pri volejbalovom ihrisku od 9:30, štart je o 10:00 hod. Závod je otvorený pre rôzne vekové kategórie vrátane detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov. Súťaž je súčasťou putovného pohára Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu, kde sa výsledné časy prepočítavajú podľa vekových koeficientov a pretekári sú bodovaní podľa účasti a výkonov.

name: Stropkovská dvadsiatka
description: Stropkovská dvadsiatka je tradičný cestný bežecký pretek s bohatou históriou od roku 1977, ktorý sa koná v meste Stropkov. Trať vedie cez niekoľko obcí a ponúka bežcom možnosť súťažiť na 20 km vzdialenosti s občerstvením na trati a v cieli. Podujatie organizuje Klub Bežcov Stropkov, ktorý sa stará o rozvoj bežeckého hnutia v regióne. Bežci môžu očakávať kvalitnú organizáciu, štartovné balíčky a možnosť regenerácie po behu v krytej plavárni. Pretek je súčasťou Oblastnej bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance.

name: Stropkovská desiatka a  I. ročník Barefoot
location: Stropkov, Stropkov, Námestie SNP v Stropkove
description: Stropkovská desiatka a I. ročník Barefoot sú súčasťou tradičných cestných bežeckých pretekov v Stropkove, ktoré majú bohatú históriu od roku 1977. Podujatie organizuje Klub Bežcov Stropkov s cieľom podporiť bežecké hnutie v regióne a na Slovensku. Bežci môžu očakávať kvalitne pripravené trate s atmosférou, ktorú každoročne vytvárajú stovky fanúšikov a bežcov. Okrem hlavného behu je súčasťou programu aj beh na boso, ktorý prináša nový zážitok pre účastníkov.

name: Mistrovství ČR v maratonu mužů a žen
description: The Czech Republic Men’s and Women’s Marathon Championships is a prestigious race over the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km, held in Prague’s historic city centre, starting in Old Town Square. The race is for men and women over 18 who met the qualifying standards in previous years. It is organised by Juniorský maratonský klub, z.s. in cooperation with RunCzech. Runners can use modern timing services, and a professional photography service is available after the race. The start is traditionally at 08:00 in the morning.
course_highlights: Start and finish in historic Old Town Square in Prague
A 42.195 km route through central Prague
Professional timing and the option to download the GPX route
additional: The race office is open on 1 and 2 May 2026 at the Výstaviště exhibition grounds in Holešovice, in the Křižík Pavilions. Photography is provided by witisi.photo, with the option to pre-order during registration or order after the race. Applications are accepted only from runners who met the qualifying standards between 1 January 2025 and the registration deadline. Participation is subject to the qualifying standards and approval by the technical delegate. The available information relates to the 2025 and 2026 editions, not to the date 9 May 2027.

name: Prague International Marathon 2026
description: The Prague International Marathon is a traditional running race held in Prague’s historic center. The race offers a unique opportunity to run through picturesque streets and past the city’s iconic landmarks. Both the start and finish are in Old Town Square, giving the race a festive atmosphere. The marathon is part of the RunCzech running series and attracts a wide range of runners, from amateurs to professionals.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Old Town Square
The route runs through Prague’s historic center, with views of its landmarks
Firm asphalt surface with minimal elevation changes
additional: Marathon weekend includes accompanying runs such as the LAVAZZA Active Breakfast Run (4.2 km), the dm Family Mile (1.609 km), and the dm bambini run (100–200 m). Photography is provided by witisi.photo and can be pre-ordered during registration or ordered after the race. The time limit and rules are available on the RunCzech website. The race pack and further information are available in the RunCzech mobile app.

name: ORLEN Maraton Praha, MČR v maratonu mužů a žen
description: The ORLEN Prague Marathon is a prestigious race held in Prague’s historic city centre. It also serves as the Czech Republic Marathon Championships for men and women. The race offers runners a unique opportunity to experience the atmosphere of a city rich in history and enjoy beautiful views. The course passes iconic Prague landmarks and is suitable for both experienced and recreational runners. The running weekend also includes companion races for families and children, highlighting the community spirit of the event.
course_highlights: The course runs through Prague’s historic city centre, with views of its landmarks
A flat, fast course profile suitable for setting personal records
Also hosts the Czech Republic Marathon Championships for men and women
additional: The race pack contains everything participants need for the race. Timing is electronic, with official results. Photography is provided by witisi.photo and can be pre-ordered during registration or purchased after the race. The running weekend also includes family and children’s races, an accompanying programme and a virtual package in the RunCzech mobile app.

name: 10 Kobierzycki Bieg z Konstytucją
location: Hala Sportowo-Widowiskowa im. Adama Wójcika, ul. Dębowa 20, Kobierzyce, Poland
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Kobierzycach (KOSiR)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 20 zł – tylko osoby posiadające kartę mieszkańca Gminy Kobierzyce

description: The 10th Kobierzyce Constitution Day Run is an annual running event held in Kobierzyce, offering 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon races, as well as 5 km Nordic Walking. The event also includes youth races over 1,350 m and 2,700 m, and a children’s 340 m Dwarf Run. The start and finish are at the Adam Wójcik Sports and Entertainment Hall. Participants receive race packs with a T-shirt and medal, and a post-race meal is served.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
Water stations on all distances, with additional snacks on the half-marathon
Start and finish at the Adam Wójcik Sports and Entertainment Hall, 20 Dębowa Street
additional: The race office is open from 08:30 to 10:30 at the Sports and Entertainment Hall. After the race, participants can choose a recovery meal: soup or bigos. Participants in the youth races receive a personalised race number, water, a wafer bar and a medal. The participant limit for the main races is 600. The Dwarf Run (approx. 340 m) is free; registration takes place on race day, with a limit of 200 children. The youth races and Dwarf Run start at 10:00. Awards and a prize draw are scheduled. Information available for the 10th anniversary edition refers to the race on 3 May 2026; it does not confirm a date of 2 May 2027. Start and finish: Adam Wójcik Sports and Entertainment Hall, 20 Dębowa Street, Kobierzyce.

name: 32 Łaskarzewski Bieg Konstytucji 3 Maja
location: Krępa to Łaskarzew, Garwolin County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
price_range: 50 zł (bieg główny w 2026 r.); biegi dziecięce bezpłatne

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa za udział w biegu

description: The 32nd Łaskarzew Constitution of 3 May Run is an annual sporting and patriotic event held on the anniversary of the adoption of the Constitution of 3 May 1791. The 7 km main race runs from Krępa to Łaskarzew and is held under the honorary patronage of the Marshal of the Masovian Voivodeship and the Mayor of Łaskarzew. The event also includes a running picnic for children and young people, with free races over shorter distances. The organizers emphasize participants’ health and sobriety, promoting the slogan “FIT BECAUSE SOBER — SOBER BECAUSE FIT.”
course_highlights: A 7 km main route from Krępa to Łaskarzew
A running picnic for children and young people, with races over 100 m, 400 m and 800 m
An event with a patriotic character, held under the honorary patronage of local authorities
additional: The entry fee is treated as a donation and is non-refundable. Participants must pay within 3 days of registering; otherwise, they will be removed from the start list. The organizer decides the order in which race numbers are assigned. Complaints concerning the start list are not accepted on race day. Children’s races are free of charge. Information about the 32nd edition refers to the 2026 event; it does not confirm the date or fees for the 2027 edition.

name: 34 Bieg Konstytucji 3 Maja

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata na nordic walking jest stała i wynosi 89 złotych.

description: The May 3 Constitution Day Run is an annual, joyful running event held in central Warsaw, combining sport with a patriotic atmosphere and urban energy. Participants cover a 5-kilometre course along some of the capital’s most prestigious streets, starting and finishing at Three Crosses Square. The run is part of the Warsaw Running Triad, “Run for Remembrance,” commemorating important moments in Polish history. In addition to the run, a Nordic walking option is available, allowing people who prefer a more leisurely pace to take part. It is a great opportunity to enjoy an active May holiday in a spirit of community and sporting competition.
course_highlights: A certified 5 km course through central Warsaw
Scenic sections along Ujazdów Avenue, Savior Square and Constitution Square
A fast, visually appealing course that is ideal for chasing personal bests
additional: Participant limit: 6,500 in the running category and 250 in Nordic walking. The time limit for completing the run is 55 minutes. Start and finish at Three Crosses Square. Race packs can be collected on April 30 and May 2, and on race day only by people from outside Warsaw. The medal has space for an engraved time and name; engraving can be purchased. A technical T-shirt can be purchased during registration or by editing an entry. Nordic walking starts in the final wave, allowing participants to maintain a comfortable pace. Results are published online by STS TIMING; Nordic walking and 5 km wheelchair classifications are also available.

name: Bieg Konstytucji 3 Maja (Strzyżów)
location: Stadion Miejski w Strzyżowie, Strzyżów, Poland
description: The 3 May Constitution Run in Strzyżów is an annual sporting event commemorating the adoption of the Constitution of 3 May. The competition takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Strzyżów and includes various distances, including a half marathon, a run of approximately 10 km, and a Nordic walking event. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, and the local community and culture. It is organised by the Strzyżów Municipality and the Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre in Strzyżów, together with local partners and patrons.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Strzyżów
Distances: 21 km half marathon, approximately 10 km run and Nordic walking event
Age categories for children and young people, with shorter distances
additional: The race office opens at 11:00 at the Municipal Sports Stadium on 1 Maja Street in Strzyżów. Starts take place in waves: the half marathon at 15:00, the approximately 10 km run and Nordic walking event at 15:10, followed by children's races over distances from 60 m to 800 m in various age categories. The event is held under the patronage of the Mayor of Strzyżów and the Strzyżów County Starost. Previous editions have also included a 10 km run, a 10 km Nordic walking event, an adult sprint, and children's races over various distances. The start and finish are at the Municipal Stadium in Strzyżów. Confirmed information about the programme for the 2027 edition is not available in the sources provided.

name: Grybowski Bieg Majowy
location: Stadion Sportowy, ul. Grunwaldzka 47, Grybów, Poland
organizer: Burmistrz Miasta Grybów oraz Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Grybowie
description: The Grybów May Run is an annual running event organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Grybów. It takes place at the Sports Stadium at 47 Grunwaldzka Street. The event promotes national traditions, a healthy lifestyle, and physical activity through children’s races, an 8 km main race, and a Nordic walking event. The course is marked and has medical support. Participants receive race packs, commemorative T-shirts, and medals. After the race, organizers provide refreshments and a baggage deposit at MOSiR Grybów.
course_highlights: An 8 km course for the run and Nordic walking event
Marked course with medical support
Start and finish at the Sports Stadium in Grybów
additional: Time limits: Nordic walking, 8 km — 2 hours; 8 km run — 1.5 hours; children’s races of 60 m, 100 m, and 400 m — 5 minutes. The race office is open from 11:00 to 12:45. Post-race refreshments: grilled sausage, bread, ketchup, and tea. Electronic timekeeping and a baggage deposit are available at MOSiR Grybów. In previous editions, the start and finish were at the sports stadium at 47 Grunwaldzka Street. Participants received commemorative medals, and refreshments were served after the race. Details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: IX Rzekuńska Szybka Dycha

price_tiers.distance: Bieg Rzekuńska Szybka Dycha i Marsz Nordic Walking

description: The IX Rzekuńska Szybka Dycha is an annual sporting event in Rzekuń that attracts running and Nordic walking enthusiasts. It’s not only a competition, but also a great atmosphere and an opportunity to spend time actively. The race takes place on a course in Rzekuń, and participants can look forward to excitement and positive energy throughout the event.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
Nordic walking event
The previous edition also included races for children and youth
additional: The event includes a race and a Nordic walking event. The regulations are available on the organizer’s website. Registration is via the dostartu.pl platform. In the previous edition, the Nordic walking event was 5 km, and children’s and youth races were held over distances of 350 m, 700 m, and 1,050 m. Details of the IX edition may differ.
