location: Veľké Rovné, Okres Bytča, Žilinský kraj, Slovakia

name: Stropkovská dvadsiatka
location: Stropkov, Okres Stropkov, Prešovský kraj, Slovakia

name: Wings for Life World APP RUN Nižná Myšľa
location: Nižná Myšľa, Okres Košice-okolie, Košický kraj
description: Wings for Life World Run v Nižnej Myšli je jedinečné podujatie, kde bežci a účastníci na vozíku súperia proti virtuálnemu Catcher Caru, ktorý ich postupne dobieha. Trať vedie z archeoskanzenu Nižná Myšľa, známeho archeologického náleziska, cez lesné a nespevnené cesty, lúky a obec, s kombináciou asfaltových a prírodných povrchov. Štart pretekov je 10. mája 2026 o 13:00 a všetky registračné poplatky putujú na výskum poranení miechy. Pridajte sa k bežcom po celom svete a prekonajte sami seba v tomto globálnom behu bez cieľovej čiary.

name: Běh ve Skalce – Memoriál Radomila Večeři
location: Skalka u Prostějova, Prostějov District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh ve Skalce - Radomil Večeřa Memorial is a traditional running race organized by the Prostějov Marathon Club in the beautiful surroundings of Skalka near Prostějov. The race gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on challenging routes through a natural forest park with good signage. The event is suitable for both amateurs and experienced runners who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of the Olomouc Region. The club also regularly organizes other running events and supports the local running community.
course_highlights: Skalka forest park near Prostějov
Well-marked routes along cycle paths and partly on roads
Beautiful natural surroundings of the Drahany Highlands
additional: Registration has been handled through a partner system since 2026. The race is part of the Prostějov Marathon Club’s regular events. Maps of the routes and information about other running races in the region are available on the website.

name: Běh kolem Babího lomu
location: Kulturní dům, Kuřim-Podlesí, Kuřim, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné 100 Kč (zahrnuto občerstvení po závodě, pro děti je startovné dobrovolné)

description: The Run around Babí lom is a traditional race in the Kuřim Running League, held in the picturesque surroundings of Kuřim-Podlesí. The race offers a hilly 8.4 km course that runs almost entirely through the forest, providing runners with an enjoyable trail experience. Children can take part in a fun run on a shorter loop. Race facilities are available at the cultural centre, where participants can change, and refreshments are provided after the race. The start and registration take place at the sports field by the cultural centre.
course_highlights: Hilly 8.4 km course, almost entirely through the forest
Children’s fun run on a shorter 2.6 km loop
Changing facilities and refreshments at the cultural centre
additional: Registration takes place from 9:00 to 9:45 at the race venue. After the race, refreshments are available at Hospůdka U Anděla in exchange for returning the race number. Online registration is available, with the possibility of a discount on the entry fee. The race is part of the Kuřim Running League and takes place off public roads. Refreshments are provided after the race.

name: Běh choceňskými sady
location: Park u choceňského zámku, Choceň, Czech Republic
description: The Run through Choceň Gardens is a traditional running race organized by the Choceň Ski Club, held in the picturesque park by Choceň Castle. The race offers various courses for adults and youth categories, allowing participants to enjoy running in a natural setting with high-quality organization. It is part of the ISCAREX Cup and attracts runners of all ages and ability levels. It is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners looking to enjoy a pleasant day of sport in Choceň Gardens.
course_highlights: Run in the park by Choceň Castle
Various course distances from 0.15 km to 15 km
Categories for children and adults
additional: The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and offers a wide range of categories based on age and course distance. It is organized by the Choceň Ski Club. The total number of participants across all editions exceeds 4,500. Registration is available through the ISCAREX Cup website.

name: Polevský běh
location: Lyžařská bouda na Jedličné, Polevsko–Kytlice, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: předem přes web nazavody.cz do 8.5. za zvýhodněné startovné

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: předem přes web nazavody.cz do 8.5. za zvýhodněné startovné

description: The Polevský Run is a traditional running race organized by the Ski Polevsko club in the picturesque Lusatian Mountains between Polevsko and Kytlice. The race features a varied route across rolling, hilly terrain, partly following winter ski trails, forest paths and pastures, with beautiful views of the surrounding peaks and landscape. Choose between 5 km and 10 km routes; children’s races are also included, making the event suitable for all ages and abilities, including families with children. Race facilities are at the ski lodge in Jedličná, where registration, the start and the finish take place.
course_highlights: Rolling, hilly terrain in the Lusatian Mountains
The route follows winter ski trails, forest paths and pastures
Beautiful views of Klíč, Ještěd, Jedlová, Ralsko, Bohemian and Saxon Switzerland, Bezděz and the Česká Lípa region
additional: You can register online until 8 May for a discounted entry fee. Payment is accepted on site in cash or via QR code. Race numbers must be collected in good time, no later than half an hour before the start; otherwise, runners will not be allowed to start. Parking is available in the nearby parking area in Jedličná and, if it reaches capacity, in the winter car park below Jedličná. The race is part of the Česká Lípa District Running League. The programme also includes children’s races.

name: Lesní běh Kalichem
location: Besedice, Koberovy, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The Kalich Forest Run is a traditional sporting event organized by TJ Sokol Koberovy in the beautiful countryside of the Bohemian Paradise, in an area called Kalich. The race is open to all age groups, from preschoolers to seniors over 60 who enjoy running in nature. Starts are divided into several age categories so everyone competes against evenly matched opponents. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, excellent refreshments, and the participation of dozens to hundreds of runners each year. The organizers provide full event management, including timing and refreshments featuring traditional dishes and drinks.
course_highlights: A run through the beautiful countryside of the Bohemian Paradise in the Kalich area
Age categories ranging from preschoolers to seniors
Traditional refreshments including chicken legs, sausages, and draft beer
additional: Race-day registration runs from 8:00 to 9:15, with the first category starting at 9:25. The event is held under the patronage of the Koberovy Municipal Office and is supported by a grant program of the Liberec Region. The organizers provide timing, course setup, and refreshments at the race venue.

name: 5. Festiwal Gorski Jedlina-Zdroj
price_range: od 120 zł do 250 zł, mieszkańcy gminy 50 zł
description: The 5th Jedlina-Zdrój Mountain Festival is a mountain running event taking place on 10 May 2026 in Jedlina-Zdrój. Participants can choose from three distances: 10 km, 23.5 km and 50 km. The start and finish are at Jedlinka Palace. The route runs through the scenic Wałbrzych Mountains, including Borowa Mountain, which has a newly built observation tower, and features challenging climbs and varied terrain. The event is a great opportunity to enjoy an active break and discover the charms of the region.
course_highlights: The route passes over Borowa Mountain, with its new observation tower
Varied terrain: gravel roads, asphalt roads, forest trails and mountain paths
Distances of 10 km, 23.5 km and an ultra 50 km, with refreshment and timing checkpoints
additional: The total participant limit is 600. Festival T-shirts can be ordered until 19.04.2026 for 90 zł; they are made from high-quality Attiq technical fabric. The 50 km ultra route has 7 refreshment stations and 5 timing checkpoints. The start and finish are at Jedlinka Palace, ul. Zamkowa 4. The organizer reserves the right to modify the route up to one week before the start. The mountain route is demanding and features varied terrain. There is a limit of 600 participants, online registration, possible date changes in the event of sanitary restrictions, accommodation options and festival T-shirts for participants.

name: 13. PKO Białystok Półmaraton
description: The 13th PKO Białystok Half Marathon is the largest running event in eastern Poland. Organized since 2013, it is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown. Runners cover the half-marathon distance of 21.097 km in the picturesque city of Białystok. The event also includes the PKO Night Run over 5 km, which can be a great warm-up before the half marathon, as well as races for children. It is a true celebration of running, attracting participants from across Poland and abroad.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes in Bydgoszcz, with an emphasis on the aesthetic appeal of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during a spring race.

name: Wings for Life World Run 2026 Poznań
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race in which all participants start simultaneously around the world, running away from the Catcher Car. The race has no traditional finish line—participants run until they are caught by the car. All entry fees go toward research into treatments for spinal cord injuries, making this not only a sporting challenge but also a charity event. You can take part locally or via the app, which lets you run from anywhere in the world.

name: Charytatywna Dycha
description: Charytatywna Dycha is a sports and charity running festival held in Miechów to benefit Caritas Hospice. The event brings the local community together to support hospice patients by raising funds for essential medical equipment. The race takes place around the park, and participants, donors, and organizers come together to create an atmosphere of empathy and solidarity. This unique initiative not only promotes physical activity but also raises public awareness of hospice care.

name: II JBL Run Katowice
description: The II JBL Run Katowice is a charity street race taking place on May 10, 2026, in Katowice, with 3 km (family walk&run), 5 km, and 10 km routes. All proceeds from entry fees will be donated to the Dla Ludzi Potrzebujących Pomocy „Gniazdo” Foundation. The start and finish are located at Sławik and Antall Square, and the route passes iconic Katowice landmarks such as Spodek, MCK, NOSPR, the Silesian Museum, and the Silesian Insurgents’ Monument. The race promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants will receive commemorative medals and can enter a prize draw.

name: II Olkuski Test Coopera
description: The 2nd Olkusz Cooper Test is an annual sporting event held at the MOSIR stadium in Olkusz. The competition consists of a 12-minute Cooper Test, a popular measure of running endurance. The event is open to everyone, with participation limited to 100 people. Starts begin at 9:00, and participants can choose a convenient start time between 9:00 and 13:30. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness and compete in a friendly atmosphere.

name: IX Bieg Pilicy
description: The 9th Pilica Run is a small-scale running event held in the charming town of Białobrzegi on the Pilica River. The start and finish are located in the centrally situated, revitalized Zygmunt Stary Square, and the route runs along the town’s main streets. The event combines sport, passion, and a family-friendly atmosphere, offering distances for different ability levels: a 10 km main race, a 3 km recreational run, and a 3 km Nordic walking event. Colorful races tailored to participants’ ages are organized for children and teenagers. Every participant can enjoy a hot meal, drinks, and a voucher for local ice cream.

name: XV Działoszyńska Dziesiątka
description: The 15th Działoszyńska Dziesiątka is a road race held in Działoszyn on May 10, 2026. The event is organized by Stowarzyszenie Atelier Sportu, which specializes in professional timing and running-event organization. The race is scheduled to start at 16:00. The event attracts runners who value well-organized races with electronic timing.

name: XXIX Górski Bieg Magurki
description: The 29th National Magurka Mountain Run is an annual running event organized since 1997 by the “Groniczek” People’s Student Sports Club in Bielsko-Biała. The event is open to the public and promotes mountain running and an active lifestyle. The 8.8 km course, with 509 m of elevation gain, leads from the Straconka district to the summit of Magurka, passing through the scenic area of Mała Straconka and forest trails. The race attracts leading Polish mountain runners as well as competitors from abroad, and the course is professionally secured and clearly marked.

name: XXXIII Biegi Żnińskie
description: The 33rd Żnińskie Runs is an annual running event held in Żnin, scheduled for May 10, 2026. The event includes road races over 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are located at Freedom Square. The 10 km race counts toward the Pałuki Grand Prix. Participants receive a race pack containing a commemorative medal from the “Great People of Żnin” series, a recovery meal, and souvenirs from Pałuki. The race office is open on race day from 9:00 to 11:45 at Primary School No. 1 in Żnin.

name: Garmin WTF BRZSNY
distance_verbose: Maraton, Maraton, 33 km, 23 km, 13 km, 10 km, 8 km
organizer: RUNaway Rekreációs Kft. és RUNaway Sportszervező Kft.
description: Garmin WTF BRZSNY is a unique trail running race in the area around Szokolya and Királyrét, taking place on May 10, 2026. The race offers challenges over several distances, from 8 km up to the 42 km trail marathon, with varied elevation gain in a beautiful forest setting. One special feature is that road runners and trail runners start together, so everyone can complete the distance on their own terrain. The entry fee includes a bib number, timing, aid stations, bag storage, changing facilities and medical services, as well as chimney cake at the finish and optional medals. The race prioritizes sustainability and a sense of community, where every achievement matters.

name: IX. Runbogárd Futóverseny és családi futónap
description: The 9th Runbogárd Running Race and Family Run Day will be held on May 10, 2026, in Sárbogárd, at the City Sports Hall. Runners can choose from the 1 km Smile Run and distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 20 km; all participants start together in a mass start. The event aims to promote a love of sport and create a community gathering where people of all ages can find a suitable distance. Race numbers must be collected in advance; on-site registration is not available. Timing is chip-based, with the chip attached to the back of the race number.

name: Fertőrákos félmaraton 6 / 16 / 21
description: The Fertőrákos Half Marathon is a unique scenic run above Lake Fertő, starting and finishing at the Quarry – Cave Theatre. The varied, gently undulating course takes in some of the area’s most beautiful spots. The longer distance reaches as far as Balf, with runners accompanied by views of picturesque Lake Fertő and its reed beds. This race is not just a challenge but an enjoyable running experience, with new sights and inspiration at every kilometre. The event is also run as a green race, highlighting the importance of environmental protection.

name: EU-S FUTÁS 2026
organizer: Európai Bizottság Magyarországi Képviselete, Európai Parlament Magyarországi Kapcsolattartó Iroda, Nagy Sportágválasztó, BBU Nonprofit Kft.
description: The EU Half Marathon is a free running race requiring registration, taking place on May 10, 2026, at Liberty Square in Budapest. Participants can complete the 21.1-kilometer distance individually or in a relay team of 2–3, as part of Budapest’s Europe Day festival. Runners follow a three-lap route passing through Budapest’s iconic landmarks, and every finisher receives a unique commemorative medal. The event is organized by the Representation of the European Commission in Hungary and the European Parliament Liaison Office in Hungary, with Nagy Sportágválasztó, BBU Nonprofit Kft. as its professional partner.

name: FUSSUK LE! FÉLMARATON FESZTIVÁL
description: The Let’s Run! Half Marathon Festival is a three-day running event in Csongrád, taking place from May 8 to 10, 2026. The festival features a concert, community activities, and races, including half-marathon and quarter-marathon distances as well as children’s races. The course is flat and paved, making it ideal for runners of all levels who want to compete in a fun, supportive community. The event aims to provide an unforgettable experience where you can run and cross the finish line with a smile.

name: UBM RED RUN FUTÓVERSENY
description: The UBM RedRun running event will take place on May 10, 2026, in the heart of Pilisvörösvár, around Kacsa Lake. Celebrating its fifth anniversary, the event welcomes runners who can choose distances from 300 meters to 21 km, individually or as part of a team. With new courses, expanded distances, and special races, it offers an experience for all ages, with a particular focus on families and amateur athletes. The event aims to create a shared sporting experience in a safe and friendly environment, through some of the most beautiful parts of Pilisvörösvár.

name: Běh Violky
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Loučná nad Desnou, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: The Violka Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Kouty nad Desnou in the Olomouc Region. The race gives runners the opportunity to enjoy challenging terrain, beautiful views and the natural scenery of the Jeseníky Mountains. The course is suitable for experienced runners looking for the challenge of a mountain run. The event is friendly and welcomes everyone who loves running and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with elevation gain
Picturesque views of the Jeseníky Mountains
Forest and mountain trails
additional: A JPG course map is available on the official website. Results from previous editions are published online.

name: Běh na Červenou horu
location: Štěchovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Červená hora is a 3.71 km hill race with 270 metres of elevation gain, held in the scenic surroundings of Štěchovice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series and challenges runners with a demanding climb. The route is suitable for mountain-running enthusiasts and offers beautiful views and natural scenery. It’s ideal for anyone looking to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Route length: 3.71 km
Elevation gain: 270 m
Part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series

name: Noční běh pro Světlušku Jihlava

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Jihlava is a charity running event held at the Amphitheatre. Participants can choose between two routes: a short 3 km loop and a long 4.8 km loop. The run starts at 9:00 p.m. and is accompanied by a cultural programme, including a concert. The entry fee is CZK 500, half of which goes to support the Světluška project, which helps people with severe visual impairments. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers and is organised with participants’ safety and comfort in mind.
course_highlights: Two loops: a short 3 km route and a long 4.8 km route
Night run with a choice of entry option including a headlamp or a sports headband
Starts at the Amphitheatre in Jihlava, with an accompanying cultural programme
additional: Registration is via the GoOut.cz portal, where participants can choose an entry option with a headlamp or a sports headband. Capacity is limited to ensure participants’ safety and comfort. Children under 15 can attend for free, without a headlamp or headband; holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P cards can also attend for free, without equipment. A changing room and baggage storage, refreshments and medical services are available on site. Dogs are not allowed at the Jihlava event because the route passes through the zoo.

name: KPMG Noc rekordů
location: Atletický stadion Děkanka, Praha, Czech Republic
description: KPMG Night of Records is a running show held under the patronage of KPMG partner Eva Bláhová, British Ambassador Matt Field, and Czech 5,000-metre record holder Jiří Sýkora. The event attracts elite athletes, enthusiasts, and young athletes, while its proceeds support physical activity for children. Prague’s Děkanka is the venue, where records are regularly broken and more than a hundred children compete. It is an exciting sporting event with a live broadcast and a packed programme.
course_highlights: Prague’s Děkanka as the race venue
Czech 5,000-metre record holder Jiří Sýkora taking part
More than 120 competing children and elite athletes
additional: The event includes a live broadcast, start lists, results, and prize money. Its proceeds support physical activity for children.

name: FyzioRUN
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The charitable sporting event FYZIORUN invites all runners to a certified 5 km course in the beautiful surroundings of Prague’s Hvězda Game Reserve. The event is organized by the Cystic Fibrosis Patients Club and supports people living with the condition. The run is suitable for the general public and offers an enjoyable outdoor sporting experience in Prague 6. Come support a good cause and enjoy running in good company.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Beautiful surroundings of Prague’s Hvězda Game Reserve
Charity run supporting people living with cystic fibrosis
additional: The event is a charity run organized by the Cystic Fibrosis Patients Club. The Club’s opening hours are Mon–Fri, 8:00–12:00. The organizers can be contacted by phone or email. Visits to the Club must be arranged in advance due to health precautions for patients.

name: Beh do Strečnianských hradných schodov
location: Strečno okr. Žilina, Strečno okr. Žilina, parkovisko pod hradom
description: Beh do Strečnianských hradných schodov je náročný pretek v Strečne pri Žiline, ktorý preverí vašu kondíciu na trase s 151 schodmi a prevýšením 144 metrov. Pretek je určený pre všetky mládežnícke kategórie, študentov vysokých škôl, ženy aj mužov. Štartuje sa na parkovisku pod hradom Strečno, pričom mládež štartuje o 10:15 a študenti a dospelí o 11:45. Organizátorom je Ústav telesnej výchovy Žilinskej univerzity a OK Žilina, ktorí zabezpečujú kvalitný priebeh podujatia. Uzávierka prihlášok je 10. mája 2026, pričom dodatočné prihlásenia sú možné len vo výnimočných prípadoch.

name: Planderský běh
location: Obecní úřad v Plandrech, Plandry, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 Kè - muži, junioři, ženy, juniorky přihlášené on-line

description: The Plandry Run is a traditional cross-country race organized by the municipality of Plandry and Běžec Vysočiny, held in the picturesque surroundings of Plandry. The race offers various categories for men, women, juniors, veterans and children, with distances from 220 metres to 9 kilometres. The course runs along paved and unpaved paths, including a loop in the former castle park by the Jihlava River, with a turnaround at Brandl’s Mill. The mass start is at 18:00 by the municipal office in Plandry. The race is suitable for people of all ages who enjoy sport, and offers prizes for the top finishers in each category as well as refreshments for all participants.
course_highlights: 3 km loop on forest and field paths, with 16% on asphalt
600 m and 220 m loops for younger categories on local roads
Turnaround at Brandl’s Mill in the former castle park by the Jihlava River
additional: Runners aged 3 and over may take part. After the race, refreshments are available at the local volunteer fire brigade clubhouse, with roast pork available for purchase. Běžec Vysočiny sports T-shirts will be sold at a reduced price during the event. The bus from Jihlava departs at 16:20; there is no return bus. According to the available information, the mass start is at 18:00 by the municipal office in Plandry.

name: Beh Gáňom
location: Gáň, okr. Galanta, Gáň, okr. Galanta, pred Kultúrnym domom
description: Beh Gáňom je bežecké podujatie konané v obci Gáň, okr. Galanta, pred Kultúrnym domom. Pretek ponúka kategórie pre deti, dospelých aj seniorov, vrátane hlavného behu a behu zdravia. Štart je rozdelený na detské kategórie o 9:00, beh zdravia o 9:45 a hlavný beh o 10:45. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane obyvateľov obce, ktorí majú zvýhodnené štartovné. Organizátorom je Tomáš Mrva, ktorý poskytuje aj kontaktné informácie pre záujemcov.

name: VEREDA Night Run
location: Považská Bystrica, Okres Považská Bystrica, Trenčiansky kraj
organizer: VEREDA sport a OZ Dobrý pohyb
description: VEREDA Night Run je nočný beh v Považskej Bystrici, ktorý ponúka trať dlhú 8 km s možnosťou štartovať aj v štafetách (2 x 4 km). Pretek je určený pre jednotlivcov, dvojice, deti a firemné tímy, pričom kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia. Podujatie organizuje VEREDA sport a OZ Dobrý pohyb za podpory mesta Považská Bystrica a je známe svojou atmosférou a komunitným charakterom. Štart je pri fontáne pri kine Mier, pričom detský beh začína o 17:00 a hlavné štarty o 20:30.

name: Strachan run
description: Bežecké preteky Strachan Run 2026 na Strednici sú druhým ročníkom trailových pretekov, ktoré sa konajú v malebnej goralskej dedine Ždiar pod Belianskymi Tatrami. Pretekári sa môžu tešiť na nezabudnuteľný športový zážitok v prostredí rodinného parku Strachankovo a Ski centra Strednica. Podujatie je vhodné pre milovníkov behu, ktorí chcú zažiť prírodu a šport v jednom. Organizátori pozývajú všetkých bežcov na túto atraktívnu akciu s priateľskou atmosférou.

name: Beh revúckym chotárom – Memoriál Tomáša Kubeja
location: ZŠ J. A. Komenského, Revúca, Slovakia

name: O putovný pohár starostu obce Vlachy
location: Vlachy, okr. Liptovský Mikuláš, Vlachy, okr. Liptovský Mikuláš, Kultúrny dom Vlachy
description: O putovný pohár starostu obce Vlachy je bežecký pretek s dĺžkou trate 6900 metrov a prevýšením 150 metrov. Pretek sa koná v kultúrnom dome vo Vlachoch, v okrese Liptovský Mikuláš. Ide o tradičný bežecký závod, ktorý priláka bežcov z okolia a ponúka výzvu v podobe mierneho stúpania na trati. Organizátori srdečne vítajú všetkých bežcov, ktorí si chcú zmerať sily v peknom prostredí obce Vlachy.

name: RETRO Night Run
organizer: Športové centrum RETRO sport & wellness, SPORT RETRO, s.r.o.
description: RETRO Night Run je bežecké podujatie v Bratislave, ktoré ponúka nočný beh s rôznymi kategóriami pre deti aj dospelých. Preteky sa konajú v OC RETRO na Nevädzovej ulici a sú organizované športovým centrom RETRO sport & wellness. Bežci si môžu vybrať medzi 5 km a 10 km traťou, pričom štart detských behov je o 16:00 a hlavných behov o 20:00. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru nočného behu v meste.

name: Detva behá, tak sa pridaj!
description: Detva behá, tak sa pridaj! je tradičný bežecký pretek v Detve, ktorý ponúka trate pre deti aj dospelých. Preteky sa konajú 16. mája 2026 pri 4. ZŠ J.J. Thurzu a zahŕňajú hlavné trate Hobby (6,2 km) a Hlavnú trať (10,7 km) s povrchom lesnej cesty a asfaltu. Preteky sú vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane rôznych vekových kategórií a detských behov, pričom štartovné pre deti nie je vyžadované. Organizátorom je ŠK Detva v pohybe, ktorý vytvára priateľskú atmosféru a víta všetkých bežcov a rodiny.

name: Beh Jednoty
location: Nové Zámky, Nové Zámky, Hlavné námestie
description: Beh Jednoty 2026 v Nových Zámkoch je podujatie určené pre všetkých - od aktívnych športovcov až po rodiny s deťmi. Program zahŕňa detské behy rozdelené podľa vekových kategórií a hlavný 5-kilometrový beh mestom, ktorý je vhodný pre rekreačných aj výkonnejších bežcov. Počas dňa je pripravený sprievodný program s aktivitami pre deti, občerstvením a tombolou. Účasťou podporíte lokálnu komunitu a dobrú vec, čím spojíte šport s pomocou.

name: Behaj lesmi – Beckov
location: Beckov, Okres Nové Mesto nad Váhom, Trenčiansky kraj
description: Behaj lesmi Beckov je súčasťou série siedmich pretekov v krásnej slovenskej prírode, ktoré ponúkajú trasy prevažne na mäkkom povrchu a čerstvom vzduchu. Pretekári si môžu vychutnať nezabudnuteľný deň pod Beckovským hradom s podporou hradnej gardy a výhľadmi na okolitú prírodu. Trasy vedú cez tajomné zákutia Beckova a sú sprevádzané legendami, čo robí z behu dobrodružstvo plné energie. Preteky sú zaradené do UTMB Index Races, čo zvyšuje ich medzinárodný význam a atraktivitu pre trailových bežcov.

name: Babindolský májový kros
location: Babindol (okes Nitra), Babindol (okes Nitra), futbalové ihrisko
description: Babindolský májový kros je športové bežecké podujatie pre nadšencov behu všetkých vekových kategórií, ktoré sa koná v krásnej májovej prírode Dolnej Nitry v obci Babindol. Preteky ponúkajú dve hlavné trate s dĺžkami 8 km a 16 km, ktoré vedú prevažne po poľných cestách a lesných chodníkoch s miernym prevýšením. Súčasťou podujatia je aj detská trať okolo futbalového ihriska, sprievodný program, guláš pre pretekárov a vecné ceny pre víťazov v každej kategórii. Organizátorom je obec Babindol v spolupráci so Zdenom Zambojom, pričom štart je tradične o 10:00 hod na futbalovom ihrisku v Babindole.

name: Nočný beh Hlohovcom
description: Nočný beh Hlohovcom je obľúbený nočný beh, ktorý sa koná 16. mája 2026 v Zámockom parku v Hlohovci. Bežci si užijú atraktívny 6 km okruh vedúci malebným prostredím parku s jazierkom a najväčším platanovým hájom v strednej Európe, popri rieke Váh, cez centrum mesta a okolo hlavných dominánt Hlohovca. Podujatie ponúka kategórie pre deti, hlavný beh a nordic walking, pričom štart je pred amfiteátrom v Zámockej záhrade. Organizátori kladú dôraz na bezpečnosť, odporúčajú reflexné doplnky a čelovky, a pre prvých 550 pretekárov sú pripravené účastnícke medaily.

name: Závadská desítka
location: Přírodní rezervace Dařanec, Závada, Hlučín, Czech Republic
description: Závadská desítka is a 10 km cross-country race along forest trails around the Dařanec Nature Reserve near Závada. The race is highly appealing and has become a traditional part of the Prajzsko-Opava Running League (POBL), where it is considered the most attractive short-distance race. Safety along the course is ensured by event staff, and a refreshment station is provided at the 6 km mark. The race is divided into several men’s, women’s and youth categories, including special categories for local residents and people born in Závada, who compete for a perpetual trophy.
course_highlights: Cross-country race along forest trails in the Dařanec Nature Reserve
Refreshment station at the 6 km mark
Traditional race in the Prajzsko-Opava Running League (POBL)
additional: The race is divided into five men’s, four women’s and three youth categories. Safety is ensured by event staff. There is one refreshment station along the course. The race has special categories for local residents and people born in Závada, competing for a perpetual trophy. It is part of the Prajzsko-Opava Running League (POBL) and includes categories for local residents and people born in Závada, who compete for a perpetual trophy.

name: Běh města Nýřany
location: Atletický stadion ZŠ Nýřany, Nýřany, Czech Republic
organizer: Atletclub Nýřany, z.s. a komise pro školství, sport a kulturu

price_tiers.distance: Hlavní závod 10 km a týmový běh 2x 5 km

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Děti s bydlištěm mimo okolí Nýřan mají start zpoplatněný částkou 30,00 Kč

description: The Nýřany Town Run is a traditional athletics event organized by ATLETCLUB Nýřany, z.s. It offers a main 10 km race, including a 2 × 5 km team race, as well as additional races for children. The event takes place at the athletic stadium of ZŠ Nýřany and is suitable for all age groups, including children from Nýřany and the surrounding area. After the race, participants can enjoy a disco on the paved court in front of the stadium. Registration is available online and on site, with different fees. The event has a friendly atmosphere and promotes sports activity in the community.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race, with the option of a 2 × 5 km team race
Additional races for children, with free entry for local children
Post-race disco on the paved court in front of the athletic stadium
additional: On-site registration is available for a higher fee. Children’s race numbers are distributed at schools or in the white booth next to the gym. The disco starts at 18:00 and is free for all participants. The event takes place at the athletic stadium of ZŠ Nýřany. Children’s races are free or have a nominal fee; the program concludes with a disco with free admission.

name: Mácháč Run Fest
location: Rekreační zařízení Karolínka pod Borným, Staré Splavy, Czech Republic
organizer: Mácháč brothers crew, Jan Venca Francke
description: Mácháč Run Fest is a hilly cross-country race through the beautiful countryside around Lake Máchovo, offering distances of 160 km, 60 km, 25 km, 10 km, and 5 km. The race is 90% off-road, ensuring a challenging and appealing running experience. It is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting with varied terrain. The start is at RZ Karolínka pod Borným, an ideal location for nature lovers and trail runners.
course_highlights: Hilly cross-country terrain with 90% natural surfaces
Distances from 5 km up to an ultramarathon of 160 km
Picturesque countryside around Lake Máchovo
additional: For the 2024 edition, the 100-mile distance is listed as starting at 19:00 from RZ Karolínka pod Borným; details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Lesempolem
location: Sportovní areál, Veselice, Vavřinec, Czech Republic
description: Lesempolem is a traditional running race held in the scenic village of Veselice in the Moravian Karst. It offers three courses—14 km, a marathon (42 km), and an ultramarathon (84 km)—running mainly along forest and field paths around the Podvrší Lookout Tower, with beautiful views and a chance to run in nature. The race is suitable for all runners, from amateurs to experienced competitors, and the marathon is part of the Blansko District Running League. The start and finish are at the sports complex in Veselice, where a varied program, refreshments, and a friendly atmosphere await.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly along forest and field paths around the Podvrší Lookout Tower
Beautiful views and a run through the nature of the Moravian Karst
Three distances: 14 km, marathon (42 km), and ultramarathon (84 km)
additional: Plentiful refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish, including water, tea, isotonic drinks, fruit, and a traditional rum refreshment station. At the finish, runners can enjoy homemade soup and vegetarian treats, and every finisher receives a medal. Registration takes place at the cultural centre in Veselice, which also serves as the race headquarters. Parking is 200 m from registration. It is possible to sleep in your own sleeping bag at the cultural centre for a nominal fee. A cultural program and children’s races are planned for spectators. The start and finish are at the sports complex in Veselice.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton Karlovy Vary 2026
location: nábřeží Osvobození, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
description: The Mattoni 1/2Marathon Karlovy Vary is a unique race in the heart of the spa town of Karlovy Vary. The World Athletics-certified course passes the iconic Thermal and Pupp hotels and other UNESCO landmarks. It offers a beautiful run along the colonnade, with views of world-famous hotels and historic monuments. This race is part of the Mattoni Running Festival and attracts runners of all levels who want to combine the joy of running with discovering the city’s beauty.
course_highlights: The course passes the iconic Thermal and Pupp hotels
It runs along a unique colonnade in the spa town
The surrounding area features UNESCO landmarks
additional: Registration is available only with a registration code. The race starts on Saturday, 16 May 2026, at 14:00. Photography is provided by witisi.photo, with the option to pre-order photos during registration and after the race. The race is part of the RunCzech running league and offers special categories such as relays and a healthcare workers’ run.

name: Dobřichovický kros půlmaraton a 10 km
location: Nádvoří dobřichovického zámku, Dobřichovice, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Cross-Country Half Marathon and 10 km is a traditional running race organized by Radost v pohybu in the picturesque courtyard of Dobřichovice Castle. The race offers courses for children under 10, 10 km runners, and more experienced half-marathon runners. The half-marathon route combines flat terrain with more challenging hilly sections and has refreshment stations. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, from beginners to advanced runners, and creates a pleasant atmosphere for the whole family.
course_highlights: The half-marathon’s first half is flat and its second half is hilly
Refreshment stations at 5, 10, and 15 km on the half-marathon course
The 10 km course is mostly flat, with one refreshment station
additional: The 1 km children’s race is free for children under 10. Results for the children’s race are announced as soon as all the children have finished. The 10 km race awards ceremony is scheduled for 12:30. The routes are available online at mapy.cz. The race is suitable for runners of all levels. The 1 km children’s race is free; there are refreshment stations on the courses, and participants receive a commemorative medal.

name: Rakovnická 100
description: Rakovnická 100 is a challenging ultramarathon covering more than 100 kilometres, with around 2,400 metres of elevation gain, set in the picturesque Křivoklátsko region. The route is known for its fords, rivers and ferry crossing, adding interest and challenge to the race. The event is well organised and is a popular test of fitness and endurance for experienced runners and walkers alike. A shorter 60 km option is also available for less experienced participants. The start and finish are traditionally on Husovo Square in Rakovník.
course_highlights: A route of more than 100 km with 2,400 m of elevation gain
Fords, rivers and one ferry crossing along the route
The picturesque Křivoklátsko region
additional: The race is considered a less demanding ultramarathon, suitable for testing your actual capabilities. The route is revised and extended slightly, and participants can look forward to good organisation and aid stations. The organisers recommend bringing the essential equipment for a long route and offer the option of staying overnight before the start.

name: Májový běh Slapy
description: The Slapy May Run is a family-friendly spring race held in the picturesque forests around Slapy. It offers trail courses of varying lengths and elevation, suitable for adults and children, who may be accompanied by their parents. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running cup and focuses on the joy of movement and shared experiences in nature. The start and registration are at the Sigma Slapy venue, which has facilities including changing rooms and toilets. The tenth-anniversary edition brings its traditional atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: The main race is 7.5 km with 225 m of elevation gain, along forest trails with climbs and descents
Children’s races of 1.4 km and 2.8 km with minimal elevation gain; parents may accompany their children
The route passes around Vyhlídka Hill and old gold mines and is marked with white arrows
additional: The start and registration are at the Sigma Slapy venue, č. e. 43. You can change and leave belongings of no value near the start. Toilets are available. Children may be accompanied by their parents. The route is marked with white arrows on the ground. Expect uneven terrain and, in wet conditions, mud. The first three finishers in each category receive a medal and a small prize; every child receives a reward. A changing room and baggage storage are available at the Sigma Slapy venue. Children receive a reward.

name: Městecká desítka
location: Náměstí Republiky, Městec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Městecká Desítka is a traditional running race in Městec Králové, offering 10 km and 5 km courses and a 1 km children’s race. The race takes place on asphalt roads and paths with minimal elevation gain, with the start and finish at Náměstí Republiky. The event attracts hundreds of runners and is known for its course records and friendly atmosphere. Refreshments are available after the race, and results are sent by SMS.
course_highlights: Course with no significant elevation gain
Surface: 80% asphalt roads, 20% paving and paths
Start and finish at Náměstí Republiky in Městec Králové
additional: Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish. An SMS with your finishing time is sent after the race. On-site registration will not be available. NO.6 technical T-shirt available for 490 Kč. Prizes for the top three men and women in each category.

name: 7 pohoří Orlické hory
location: Deštné v Orlických horách, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: 7 Mountains Orlické Mountains is part of the largest trail running series in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The race offers technical trails with epic views and an atmosphere you won’t experience anywhere else. The routes pass through the picturesque countryside of the Orlické Mountains, including a climb to their highest peak, Velká Deštná. Whether you’re an experienced runner or a beginner, the race will test your strength, willpower and determination.
course_highlights: Main course: 24 km with 920 m of elevation gain
Climb to the highest peak in the Orlické Mountains, Velká Deštná (1,115 m)
The route follows forest paths, with views of Šerlich and the Polish border
additional: The race time limit is 4 hours. There are aid stations along the course with water, sports drinks, fruit and biscuits. Every participant receives a commemorative medal after finishing. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. Small items can be stored at the registration tent. The race takes place in all weather.

name: Energon běh – Penzion Nový rybník
location: Penzion Nový rybník, Obořiště, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Energon Run at the Nový rybník guesthouse in Obořiště is a traditional running event with courses for children and adults. The main race for adults and relay teams is run over four laps combining asphalt and off-road surfaces. The children’s routes follow a dirt road to Rosovice and back, with distances adapted to age. The event is part of the Brdy Running Cup and offers a pleasant atmosphere in a natural setting.
course_highlights: The course combines asphalt, dirt, and forest paths
The main race consists of 4 laps combining asphalt and off-road surfaces
The children’s routes follow a dirt road to Rosovice and back
additional: Start and finish at the Nový rybník guesthouse. The entry fee is paid on site when collecting the race number. Children’s races are part of the event. Results are published in the Brdy Running Cup system.

name: Hostivice RUN
location: Litovický rybník, Litovická, Hostivice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: ON-LINE – na oficiálních stránkách hostivicerun.cz do úterý 12. 5. 2026 do 23:59 hod.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: ON-LINE – na oficiálních stránkách hostivicerun.cz do úterý 12. 5. 2026 do 23:59 hod.

description: Hostivice RUN is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Hostivice, offering courses for all age groups, including children’s races. The races take place around the Hostivice ponds and feature distances ranging from 550 metres for children to a half marathon. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and offers a pleasant atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy outdoor sport. It is organised by MKSH, a contributory organisation, which ensures the race runs professionally and provides accompanying services.
course_highlights: Routes around the Hostivice ponds, with natural and forest sections
A choice of 5 km, 10 km, 21 km and 4 km cross-country routes
Children’s races of approximately 550 metres, with age-based categories
additional: The start and finish are at the Litovická × Na Hrázi intersection in Hostivice. Race bibs can be collected in advance in the days before the race at the Hostivice Municipal Library. Registered participants can order a Hostivice RUN T-shirt until 1 April 2026; children receive a T-shirt free of charge. On race day, bus services will be restricted and roads around the course will be temporarily closed.

name: Hradubický běh (start Pardubice)
location: Poděbradská bus stop, Poděbradská Street, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The Hradubický Run is an unconventional, friendly run connecting the cities of Pardubice and Hradec Králové. The 10 km route starts in Pardubice on Poděbradská Street, by the “Poděbradská” public transport stop. The event is for runners who want to experience a run between two major cities in a friendly atmosphere. The start is scheduled for 15 May 2027 at 9:00.
course_highlights: The route connects the cities of Pardubice and Hradec Králové
The run is 10 km long
The start is on Poděbradská Street, by the “Poděbradská” public transport stop
additional: The event is unconventional and friendly, with two starts and one finish. It is organized by pé há sedmička, an organization dedicated to unconventional cultural and sporting events. The race takes place in all weather conditions. The stated start location in Pardubice is the Poděbradská public transport stop.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.ph7.cz/): 2027-05-15 — "21. Hradubický běh a 1. Hradubický půlmaraton — 15. 5. 2027 09:00" (was estimated 2027-05-15)

name: Pivoňův běh
location: Louka Na Křižatkách u Bílého domu, Písecké hory, Czech Republic
description: Pivoň’s Run is a traditional race in the scenic Písek Mountains, offering routes for both beginners and experienced runners. The race takes place on the meadow at Na Křižatkách near the White House and passes through some of the most beautiful spots in the nature park, with forest trails, ponds, and a game reserve home to mouflons and fallow deer. Children’s races with different distances are also part of the event, encouraging children to stay active and embrace fair play. The race facilities are comfortable and welcoming, with refreshments, showers, and a place to store belongings.
course_highlights: Forest trails and soft terrain around Nový rybník and Rybník Němec ponds
U Vodáka game reserve, with mouflons and fallow deer at the edge of the enclosure
Facilities near the White House, with a relaxed atmosphere and views of the South Bohemian countryside
additional: Race numbers and timing chips are collected before the race. The chip is attached to the ankle and returned at the finish. Aid stations along the route offer water, sports drinks, fruit, and energy bars. The facilities include portable toilets, showers, and changing rooms in the White House building. Parking is on the meadow next to the facilities, with signs and instructions from the organizers. Transfer of a race number and changing the route distance are possible for a fee of CZK 50. The program includes children’s races and a charity walk. The race facilities are on the meadow at Na Křižatkách near the White House.

name: ČEZ RunTour Kopřivnice
location: Areál Tatra Kopřivnice, Kopřivnice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: ČEZ RunTour Kopřivnice is part of a popular running series held across the Czech Republic, offering races for runners of all levels, from family runs to a half marathon. The race takes place at the Tatra Kopřivnice complex, in front of the Tatra Truck Museum, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with activities for children and adults. Participants can enjoy excellent services, including a race pack, medical support and refreshments along the course. ČEZ RunTour is also a charity event, with every runner contributing to a good cause. Come and enjoy a day full of activity, fun and the joy of running!
course_highlights: 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km courses suitable for recreational and elite runners
Children’s races over 500 and 1,000 metres
Excellent services, including a race pack, a medical team and refreshments along the course
additional: There is a refreshment station on the PUMA RUN 5 KM, ČEZ RUN 10 KM and POWERADE HALF MARATHON courses, with at least two stations on the half-marathon course. Every participant receives an official gymsack with gifts from partners. Children receive a race pack from Lidl. A medical team is available, and pacers help runners reach their target finish time. Children can enjoy activities in the kids’ zone, and childcare can be arranged. The event offers quality refreshments and all-day entertainment for the whole family.

name: SKYRUN – DLOUHÉ STRÁNĚ
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Loučná nad Desnou, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je stanoveno na 1.200,- Kč / účastník

description: SKYRUN - DLOUHÉ STRÁNĚ is a technically challenging 22 km mountain half marathon with 820 metres of elevation gain, passing over the upper reservoir of the Dlouhé stráně pumped-storage power plant. The course combines 1.5 km of unpaved trail, 14 km of paved uphill running, and a technically demanding descent via a ski slope and forest trails with roots and rocks. The race is considered the toughest half marathon in the Czech Republic and offers unique views of the Jeseníky Mountains from the dam crest of the highest-altitude water surface in the Czech Republic. The start and finish are at the Kouty nad Desnou resort, which offers full facilities, including restaurants, accommodation, and parking.
course_highlights: 22 km course with 820 m of elevation gain
The first 1.5 km is unpaved, followed by 14 km of paved uphill running
Technically demanding descent on forest trails with roots and rocks
additional: There are two aid stations, at km 10 and km 15. Every runner must carry a GPS tracker and a mobile phone, and the race bib must be clearly attached to the front. The course is marked with white spray paint on paved sections and orange tarpaulins off-road. Support is permitted only in designated Support zones, using runners’ own bottles. The organizer provides GPX files and map materials for the course. Registration takes place at Penzion Kouty, and race packs are collected before the race. Parking is paid; guests staying at the venue have parking included in their accommodation. The Kouty nad Desnou resort offers facilities including restaurants, accommodation, and parking near the start and finish.

name: Standův českorybenský půlmaraton
location: Obecní hřiště, Česká Rybná, Pardubice District, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
description: We invite you to the 2nd annual Standův Českorybenský Half Marathon and Quarter Marathon, which will take runners through the beautiful foothills of the Orlické Mountains. The start and finish are at the municipal sports field in Česká Rybná. The race offers a welcoming atmosphere during and after the event, including plenty of refreshments and a place to store valuables. The event is part of a sports day with an accompanying program and is part of the ČUS Sportuj s námi project.
course_highlights: Run through the beautiful foothills of the Orlické Mountains
Start and finish at the municipal sports field in Česká Rybná
Course refreshments include water, fruit, sugar and salt
additional: On-site registration is also available from 8:00. Parking is available at the turnaround area or in the meadow above Dvončovými (signposted). For environmental reasons, bringing your own water container is recommended. Winners will be announced at 13:30 (fastest man/woman). The race is part of a sports day with plenty of refreshments throughout the day. The event is part of the ČUS Sportuj s námi project; refreshments and an accompanying sports program will be available at the municipal sports field.

name: Lomecký běh
description: The Lomecký Run is a running race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Lomecký region in the South Bohemian Region. The course winds through beautiful countryside and is moderately challenging, making it a suitable choice for both beginners and experienced runners. After the race, excellent refreshments, including soup, are provided, adding to the pleasant running experience. The race is part of Český běh, a service of the Czech Athletics Federation for runners and running races in the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: The course winds through beautiful countryside
The course is moderately challenging
Excellent refreshments, including soup, are provided after the race
additional: The race is suitable for beginners and professionals alike. Refreshments, including soup, are provided after the race. The main category starts at 11:00.

name: Dobřichovický půlmaraton
description: The Dobřichovice Half Marathon is a traditional cross-country race organized by Radost v pohybu in the picturesque surroundings of Dobřichovice. It offers three race categories: a children’s race for young runners up to 10 years old, a 10 km race suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike, and a half marathon for more experienced runners who enjoy challenging hilly courses. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and for giving families the opportunity to support children during their races. The routes are clearly marked and have refreshment stations, ensuring comfort for all participants.
course_highlights: Free 1 km children’s race for runners up to 10 years old
10 km route, mostly flat, with one refreshment station
Half marathon with a flat first section and a second half full of hills; refreshment stations at 5, 10 and 15 km
additional: Results for the children’s race are announced as soon as all the children have finished. Results for the 10 km race are announced at 12:30. Photos from previous editions are available on the official website. Routes are available online on mapy.cz.

name: Zkus půlmaraton Kuks
location: Hospital Kuks courtyard, Kuks, Czech Republic
description: Try the Kuks Half Marathon, a running race that starts in the courtyard of the Baroque Hospital Kuks complex. The route follows an educational trail past the unique gallery of sculptures carved into the rocks at Braun’s Nativity Scene, then continues through picturesque pilgrimage sites around Kuks. The race reaches its climax with a return via the modern Way of the Cross of the 21st Century, which brings history together with contemporary art. In addition to the half marathon, shorter 10 km and 5 km routes are also available, both passing through interesting places around Kuks.
course_highlights: Start in the courtyard of the Baroque Hospital Kuks complex
Route past Braun’s Nativity Scene, a gallery of sculptures carved into the rocks
Return via the modern Way of the Cross of the 21st Century, which brings history together with art
additional: The entry fee includes a race number and chip. Entry can also be purchased as a gift voucher with a unique code. The race is open to participants over 15; those under 18 may participate only with written consent from a legal guardian. The 5 km route follows the restored count’s avenue, with 222 trees, from Stanovice back to Kuks. The available distances are 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. The entry fee includes a chip and race number; if you cannot attend, you can transfer your race number to another person.

name: Šanovská desítka
location: Šanov, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Šanov Ten is a traditional running race organized by the Sokol Šanov Physical Education Association, inviting all runners to take on a ten-kilometer course through the picturesque surroundings of Šanov. The race takes place at the municipal sports field and offers an atmosphere full of excitement and determination. Starts are scheduled by category from 9:30, and participants can look forward to a friendly sporting environment and the support of the running community. The event is supported by local partners and is suitable for all passionate athletes.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometer course through the picturesque surroundings of Šanov
Start at the municipal sports field
Category starts from 9:30
additional: Starts are scheduled by category from 9:30 at the municipal sports field. The main contact is Mgr. Aneta Reischlová, who can also be reached by phone at +420 775 618 141. The event is supported by Vapas a.s.

name: Kryry třikrát jinak
location: Schillerova rozhledna, Kryry, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kryry Three Ways is a unique hill-running race held in the town of Kryry. Competitors climb the hill with Schiller’s Lookout Tower in three different ways: a short mass-start hill race, an interval uphill run, and a climb up the 127 steps to the lookout tower. The total time is the sum of the three individual races, with time deductions awarded to the top three finishers. The event also includes children’s races on courses below the lookout tower and a relay for teams of three runners.
course_highlights: 1.25 km mass-start hill race
750 m interval uphill run
Climb up 127 steps to Schiller’s Lookout Tower
additional: Race registration and changing facilities are in tents on Československé armády Square in Kryry. Children’s races are divided into several age categories, with different course lengths. The relay is open to teams of three, with no restrictions on age or gender. Winners in the individual categories and relays receive prizes. The event also includes a parent-and-child competition organised in cooperation with ZŠ Kryry. Part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series; runners can take part in a three-person relay. Overall standings are determined by the combined times from all three stages, with time deductions awarded to the top three finishers.

name: Běh Opárenským údolím
location: Bývalá hospoda Oráč, Opárno, Velemín, Czech Republic

description: The Opárenské Valley Run is a running race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Opárenské Valley, finishing at the former Oráč pub on the village square in Opárno. The route follows asphalt and forest paths, offering a combination of natural beauty and sporting challenge. The race is suitable for the general public, with refreshments provided for participants. It traditionally starts in the afternoon in May, with transport for participants from Lovosice available.
course_highlights: 5.5 km route along asphalt and forest paths
Finish at the former Oráč pub, with access to the building available
Refreshments provided for participants
additional: Backpacks will be transported to the finish after the start. The start and transport for participants from Lovosice (Lovosice město stop, at the junction of Lovošská and Ústecká streets) is at 15:00; transport to Lhotka is at 14:00. Refreshments and access to the building are provided at the finish; backpacks can be transported there.

description: Desítka z Jasének is a traditional running race held at the Gras Servis premises in Hlučín-Jasénky. The route runs through the valleys of Jasénka Creek and the Opava River, is approximately 8.6 km long, and is marked with colored ribbons. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere and features a unique bridge that runners and walkers cross only once. The start and finish are located at the Gras Servis premises, where refreshments are provided for participants. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.
course_highlights: The route runs through the valleys of Jasénka Creek and the Opava River
The route is 8.6 km long and marked with colored ribbons
A unique bridge over the river, crossed only once
additional: On-site registration is available from 13:00 to 13:50. Participants receive a drink and refreshments with their race number; they can decline these when registering. It is recommended that participants arrive at least 15 minutes before the race starts. The race is also suitable for walkers; according to the available description, refreshments are provided for participants.

name: Běh na Velký Javorník
location: Turistická chata Velký Javorník, Frenštát pod Radhoštěm, Czech Republic
description: The race up Velký Javorník is a traditional sporting event held in the picturesque surroundings of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids. It starts at the Velký Javorník mountain hut and offers beautiful views and challenging terrain. All runners are warmly invited to take part in this event, which takes place every year in May.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain terrain
Start and finish at the Velký Javorník mountain hut
Beautiful views of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids
additional: The race traditionally takes place on a Saturday in May. The start is at 10:00 at the Velký Javorník mountain hut.

name: Dubenský běh pro dobrou věc
location: Dubné, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Dubné Run for a Good Cause is a charity running event held in Dubné in the South Bohemian Region, bringing together sport, fun and a charitable purpose. It traditionally supports families with children with disabilities. The proceeds from the 9th edition will go to the family of Martin Kříha from České Budějovice to help pay for a special van and rehabilitation. The event offers 3 km and 5 km routes and is suitable for all ages. The race starts at the football pitch by Velký hajský pond, creating a pleasant setting for both running and walking.
course_highlights: 3 km and 5 km routes
Start and finish at the football pitch by Velký hajský pond in Dubné
Charity event supporting families with children with disabilities
additional: The event is suitable for all generations and combines sport with charity. The proceeds will support a family with a child with a disability. The event features mixed-gender races over 3 km and 5 km. The proceeds will help the family of Martin Kříha from České Budějovice, including a contribution toward a van with a winding platform and rehabilitation.

name: 12. Dynowska ZaDyszka
description: The 12th Dynowska ZaDyszka is a 10 km race organized by the Jarosławska Grupa Biegowa “Sokół” Association. The event will take place on May 16, 2026, at the Błękitny San Tourist Center in Dynów. The evening race follows a scenic route, promoting physical activity and the region’s tourist attractions. The event is part of the Piona Cup 2026 series, which brings together the local running community.

name: Bieg Iskier - IFMSA Poland Oddział Rzeszów
XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton Piastowski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 17th Piast Run is a traditional half marathon held in Inowrocław as part of the Piast Running Festival. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering an appealing course and a sporting atmosphere. It is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and compete over the 21 km distance. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

name: Rudawy Wiosenny Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Rudawy Spring Running Festival is a mountain running event held in the picturesque Rudawy Janowickie Mountains in Miedzianka. Participants can choose from several distances: 15, 25, 45, and 65 kilometers, as well as a 9 km family run. The event brings the mountain running community together, emphasizing the team spirit of the sport and offering unique routes along forest paths and rocky trails. The festival has been held since 2013 and is known for its beautiful views and challenging routes.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Stradomia – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Stradomia – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts. It takes place in the picturesque Prof. Stefan Białobok Forest Arboretum in the Syców Forest District. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which emphasizes scenic routes and natural surroundings. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a unique atmosphere and beautiful views. The organizers promote running and ensure a friendly, sporting atmosphere.

name: 4 Lędzińska Piwna Mila
description: The 4th Lędziny Beer Mile is an annual running event held in Lędziny, combining sporting competition with good fun and a local atmosphere. The race covers a distance of one mile, making it appealing to both amateur and more experienced runners. The event is organized by EMJOT Tri Team and attracts participants from across the region. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and get to know the local community.

name: 53 Cross Mysłowicki w biegach przełajowych
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mysłowicach
description: The 53rd Mysłowice Cross is a traditional cross-country race held in the scenic Słupna Park in Mysłowice. Participants run a loop of nearly 5.5 kilometres along challenging forest trails, featuring both climbs and a charming natural setting. The event is very popular, attracting nearly 300 runners, and is supported by UKS Chromik Mysłowice and the Central Museum of Firefighting. Participants can look forward to a unique medal with a moving element, legendary doughnuts, and attractive sports prizes.

name: 8 Okonińska Pętla
description: The 8th Okonińska Pętla is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Okoniny Nadjeziorne. The race will take place on May 16, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. It attracts outdoor enthusiasts with an appealing course surrounded by the Tuchola Forests and lakes. The organizers promise a friendly atmosphere and welcome both runners and spectators.

name: Bieg Krokodyla
description: Bieg Krokodyla is an annual running event held by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The event is scheduled for May 16, 2026, and includes 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km Nordic Walking event, and children’s and youth races over shorter distances. The main races and walk are scheduled to start at 12:00, while the children’s events begin at 9:00. Participants can choose a basic or extended package with a technical T-shirt. The course follows scenic terrain by the lake, offering attractive views and a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Mariuszowa 5-tka
organizer: Fundacja Mocni na starcie, Biegaj Leszno, Wojewódzki Szpital Wielospecjalistyczny w Lesznie
description: Mariuszowa 5-ka is a race taking place on May 16, 2026, in Leszno, in the Nowy Świat forest district. The course follows unpaved roads and forest tracks, offering distances of 5.3 km (one loop) and 10.3 km (two loops). In addition to the main races, there is a 4 km Nordic walking event, as well as youth and children’s races over shorter distances. The race office is located in the administrative building of the Regional Multi-Specialist Hospital in Leszno, while the start and finish are on Jana Kiepury Street. The event is small-scale, with participant limits for each event.

name: VIII Chrzanowski Bieg Uliczny
description: The 8th Chrzanów Street Race, known as Pociąg do biegania, is a popular sporting event in Chrzanów, taking place on May 16, 2026. The event offers three distances: a 5 km race for beginners and recreational runners, a 10 km race for more experienced runners, and a 5 km Nordic walking event. The organizers provide professional race management, course safety, and commemorative medals for all participants. It’s a great opportunity to join the sporting community of Chrzanów County and enjoy outdoor exercise.

name: XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton z Kruszwicy
description: The 17th Piast Run is a traditional half-marathon held in Inowrocław, attracting runners from across the region. The half-marathon course runs through the city's scenic areas, offering participants both a sporting challenge and the chance to admire local attractions. The event is part of the Piast Running Festival, which also includes other distances, fostering a running tradition and a sense of community.

name: XXVIII Oleskie Uliczne Biegi Pokoju
description: The 28th Olesno Street Peace Runs is an annual running event organized by the Olesno Municipality, attracting runners from various categories. The races take place on the streets of Olesno, with professional timing provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu. The race is scheduled to start at 16:50, and online registration is open until May 14, 2026. This sporting event brings together a passion for running, local tradition, and a competitive atmosphere.

name: SALOMON ULTRA TRAIL HUNGARY
location: Lázár cár tér, Szentendre, Pest County, Hungary
distance_verbose: 111 km, 50 miles, 50 km, Maraton, 30 km, Félmaraton
description: The Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary is Hungary’s most prestigious trail-running race, consisting of six separate distances and attracting around 1,500 trail runners in total. The race takes place across varied terrain, including dense, dark forests, with challenging climbs. The longest distance is 111 km, with 4,200 m of elevation gain, 9 aid stations, 2 drop bags, and a 20-hour cutoff. The race is held in Szentendre, with the start and finish at Lázár cár Square. A detailed map and an information center are available to runners and their accompanying supporters to help ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: 111 km distance with 4,200 m of elevation gain
9 aid stations and 2 drop bags on the longest distance
Dense, dark forests and varied terrain
additional: The race has a maximum capacity of 1,600 participants, with 300 places available on the longest distance. The race’s Google map shows the aid stations, start and finish locations, and race headquarters. There are staffed crossings along the course where supporters are not allowed to cheer. The Dömös and Pap-rét aid stations cannot be reached by car and require a 30-minute walk. Registration for the race opens on November 2, 2025, with various entry options and activities associated with the event.

description: The COLOPLAST Tata Lake Run is a traditional mass-participation running race organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. The race takes place around Lake Tata on varied terrain, making it ideal for both recreational and competitive runners. The event offers a great opportunity for anyone interested in running and enjoying nature to take part in sport and share a community experience. The race will be held on May 16, 2026, at the New Kayak House in Tata.

name: Vertikál Martinky
organizer: Fatra Outdoor Team a Winter Park Martinky
description: Vertikál Martinky je štvrtý ročník náročného behu do vrchu, ktorý je súčasťou Slovenskej skyrunningovej ligy. Pretekári majú možnosť získať ITRA Score body a porovnať sa s najlepšími na extrémnej trase s prevýšením 944 metrov. Podujatie ponúka výzvu pre profesionálov aj hobby bežcov v krásnom prostredí Martinských holí. Súčasťou sú aj detské kategórie s kratšími trasami a sprevádzaním rodičov. Organizátori zabezpečujú vývoz osobných vecí do cieľa, občerstvenie a bezplatné parkovanie.

name: Beh vďaky – Továrne – memoriál Františka Chmeľa
location: Tovarné okr. Vranov, Tovarné okr. Vranov, pred budovou Obecného úradu
description: Beh vďaky - Továrne - memoriál Františka Chmeľa je bežecké podujatie organizované obcou Továrne v okrese Vranov nad Topľou. Pretek sa koná pred budovou Obecného úradu v Tovarnom a je určený pre širokú kategóriu bežcov podľa veku a pohlavia. Podujatie má tradičný charakter a ponúka možnosť súťažiť v rôznych vekových kategóriách mužov a žien. Organizátori zabezpečujú kompletné informácie a podporu pre účastníkov.

name: Beh Zabudišovou
location: Zabudišová, okres Nové Mesto nad Váhom, Zabudišová, okres Nové Mesto nad Váhom, Zabudišová (otoč)
description: Beh Zabudišovou je bežecké podujatie konané v obci Zabudišová, okres Nové Mesto nad Váhom, ktoré ponúka trať dlhú 5400 metrov s peknými výhľadmi a prevýšením 133 metrov. Povrch trate je kombináciou asfaltu, štrku a trávnatej cestičky. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské sranda preteky pre rôzne vekové kategórie. Po dobehu čaká účastníkov guláš z diviny, tombola, medaily a ceny pre víťazov. Pretekári štartujú na vlastnú zodpovednosť a registrácia je možná online s limitom účastníkov, pričom deti štartujú zdarma.

name: 68. ročník půlmaratónu Kolín - Velký Osek - Kolín
description: The Kolín–Velký Osek–Kolín Half Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the T.J. Sokol Kolín athletics club. The race gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on a half-marathon course from Kolín to Velký Osek and back. The event is part of the region’s athletics calendar and attracts a broad running community. The organizers provide administrative support and communicate with participants through their athletics club.
course_highlights: The course runs from Kolín to Velký Osek and back
Half-marathon distance of 21.1 km
The race is part of the Central Bohemian Region athletics calendar

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Mimoň
location: Park před gymnáziem, Mimoň, Czech Republic
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Mimoň is a traditional running event that commemorates freedom fighters and the victims of totalitarian regimes. The race takes place in the park in front of the grammar school and is part of a nationwide series of runs organized to support the recording of eyewitness memories and history education. The event is open to all runners who want to run for the memory of the nation and support a good cause. We look forward to seeing you in May 2027!
course_highlights: A run in the park in front of the grammar school in Mimoň
Commemorating freedom fighters and the victims of totalitarian regimes
Part of the nationwide Memory of the Nation running series
additional: Proceeds from the entry fees go toward recording eyewitness memories, education, and helping heroes. The event is part of a series of races held in various towns and cities across the Czech Republic during May. Organizer contacts are available for registration and further information. The entry fee is a contribution supporting the Memory of the Nation.

name: Běh Lapákem
location: Městský stadion, Kladno, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh Lapákem is a traditional running race organized by Maratón klub Kladno and held at the municipal stadium in Kladno. The race gives runners of all levels the chance to enjoy a rolling course combining paved roads with forest and field paths. The club focuses on endurance running and organizing races in the Central Bohemian Region. The event is suitable for a broad running community and supports runners in the Kladno area.
course_highlights: Rolling course profile
A combination of paved roads and forest and field paths
Start and finish at the municipal stadium in Kladno
additional: Maratón klub Kladno is an association focused on endurance running and organizing running races. The club also organizes other events, including Lhotecká Kaštanka (15 km) and Závod dvojic (10 km). Organizer contact details are available, including mobile numbers and email addresses. The Běh Lapákem course is suitable for runners of all ages and levels.

name: Běh sídlištěm
location: Police nad Metují, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: The Housing Estate Run is a public running race organized by the SKI Police nad Metují Cross-Country Ski Club. The race offers an opportunity for all age groups and runners of varying abilities. The route runs through the urban area of Police nad Metují and is part of the club’s event calendar. The SKI Police nad Metují Club is known for organizing various running and skiing races in the Hradec Králové Region.
course_highlights: The route runs through the housing estate in Police nad Metují
The race is suitable for all age groups
Organized by the SKI Police nad Metují Cross-Country Ski Club

name: Jarov-Károv
description: The Jarov-Károv race is a 2.99 km uphill run with 150 meters of elevation gain, part of the Hill Runs in Prague and the Surrounding Area series. This race offers a challenge for runners who want to test their strength and endurance on demanding terrain with a significant climb. The route passes through the scenic surroundings of Jarov and Károv, adding to the race’s appeal and distinctive character. The race is suitable for all runners who enjoy mountain running and want to experience a sporting atmosphere in Prague.
course_highlights: Route length: 2.99 km
Elevation gain: 150 m
Part of the Hill Runs in Prague and the Surrounding Area series
