Capacity is limited, so early registration is recommended.
course_highlights: A trail run through the mountains, valleys, castles and waters of Kokořínsko and Máchův kraj
Well-stocked aid stations along the course
Scenic countryside and a family-friendly race atmosphere
additional: A personal drinking cup is mandatory equipment. You can order one during registration, along with a Čertovskej cup, T-shirt or socks. Race capacity is limited. Categories are available for individuals and relay teams, including a family relay with a child under 15. The route is marked with ribbons and arrows. The time limit for the Čertovskej Wintertrail is 7 hours. Post-race refreshments are provided at the finish, including soup, a main course and drinks. The race is part of the UTMB Index Races and ITRA National League. A personal cup is mandatory at the aid stations. A running cup, T-shirt or socks can be ordered during registration.

name: Jesenická šedesátka
description: Jesenická šedesátka is a hiking and running event along the ridges of the Hrubý Jeseník Mountains, offering beautiful natural surroundings and the chance to test yourself against the clock. The 60 km route is intended for more experienced participants aged 16 and over and includes refreshment stations. The event is a long-standing favourite, with chip timing and results announced at the finish. The organizers emphasize safety and a relaxed atmosphere, and the event is suitable for both runners and hikers.

name: Čertovskej ultratrail
description: Čertovskej Ultraltrail is a trail race across mountains, mines, castles and waters through the mysterious countryside of Kokořínsko and the Máchův kraj region. It offers a main 66.6 km route through beautiful scenery, with well-stocked aid stations, and is suitable for beginner ultrarunners too. The race is part of the Ultracup series and is also the final stage of the 8-day Čertovská výzva 666 km. The atmosphere is family-friendly, and runners will enjoy unforgettable experiences on the picturesque course.

name: Běh Zelenským údolím
location: Přírodní park Zelenov, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic

name: Skřipovská lítačka
description: Skřipovská lítačka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of fields, meadows, and forests around the village of Skřipov near Opava. The seventh edition will take place on June 6, 2026, with its hub at the TJ Sokol Skřipov football field. The race offers courses for all age groups, from the youngest children to adults, along with a varied accompanying program including an inflatable maze, face painting, and refreshments. All courses are clearly marked, and volunteers at intersections point runners in the right direction. The event is organized by Běžecký klub Skřipov, z. s.

name: Happy run
description: Happy Run is a charity run held on June 6, 2026, in Studenec u Třebíče in the Vysočina Region. It is open to everyone—athletes and non-athletes, families with children, and individuals—with several routes to choose from to suit their abilities. The event supports Viktorka, a boy with serious health complications, and the proceeds from the run will go toward his rehabilitation stay. In addition to the run itself, there will be a varied programme of activities and an evening social party.

name: Běh napříč republikou
location: Česko (867 km po celé republice), Vysočina
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event, now taking place for the fifth year. Participants run together from different parts of the Czech Republic to its geographical center in Čihošť, at a pace suited to recreational runners and comfortable for conversation. The routes are divided into individual sections, with pacers who help maintain the right pace and follow the route. This is not a race, but a shared experience that offers a chance to discover new places and meet other runners.

name: Z Hejnic do Pekla
description: Z Hejnic do Pekla 2026 is the second edition of a running race held in the Liberec Region, starting at the Hejnice Skatepark. The race offers a welcoming atmosphere, refreshments, medical support, and a race packet for every participant. It is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and seniors, who receive special entry fee conditions. The organizers prioritize runners’ comfort, providing changing rooms, showers, and luggage storage.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S01 – Machnín-Výpřež
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique event that is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace. In 2026, it will take place for the fifth time, with four parallel routes heading from different parts of the Czech Republic (including a route from Liberec-Machnín) to the country’s geographical center in Čihošť. The run follows a precise schedule, with pacers on every section to set the pace and guide the route. Participants can choose how many sections they want to run, and stop at interesting places along the way to enjoy the beauty of the landscape.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S02 – Výpřež-Rašovka
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event taking place for the fifth time. It brings together four starts from different corners of the Czech Republic, all heading to the country’s geographical center in Čihošť. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pacers on each section responsible for the pace and route guidance. Participants can choose any number of sections to run, and stop at interesting places along the way to enjoy the beauty of the landscape. The event is suitable for recreational runners and offers a chance to discover new places and meet like-minded people.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S11 – Ledce-Loučeň
description: Run Across the Republic, S11 - Ledce-Loučeň is a planned running race taking place on June 6, 2026, in the area around Ledce and Loučeň in the Central Bohemian Region. Exact details about the course, distance, or registration are not available in the sources, but the race is part of a broader concept of running or hiking events in the Czech Republic. It offers runners and hikers an opportunity to discover the region’s beauty and enjoy active recreation outdoors.

name: Běh na Kohout a zpět
description: Běh na Kohout is a traditional uphill race that has been held since 2006 in Besednice, by the swimming pool. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup, and most editions follow the same course, making it possible to compare times. The start and finish are at the swimming pool in Besednice, which offers excellent facilities. Each year, there is an accompanying programme and a raffle with attractive prizes. The race will take place on Saturday, June 6, 2026, and welcomes runners in all categories.

name: Barvám Neutečeš Ústí nad Labem
description: Barvám Neutečeš in Ústí nad Labem is a colorful run full of joy, friendship, and fun, taking place on June 6, 2026, in the Severní Terasa district. Participants can choose between a 5 km route with five color zones or a shorter 1.5 km route with three color zones and an interactive sports zone. It’s not about speed, but about sharing the experience, enjoying bursts of color, and soaking up a great atmosphere for all ages. Race packs include a T-shirt, colors, a medal, and other accessories that add to the event’s unique character. Come with family or friends, or on your own, and enjoy a day full of color and fun.

name: Běh na Čerchov
description: The Run to Čerchov is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series, which offers runners a range of routes around the Chodsko region. It is suitable for all running enthusiasts looking to experience a challenging yet beautiful run in nature, with views of Čerchov. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Běh okolo Hostěnic
description: The Run Around Hostěnice is a running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Hostěnice. It offers a flat 5.83 km course combining paved and forest paths. The race takes place on Saturday, June 6, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. and is suitable for the general public, including children, who have a shorter course tailored to their age. Organizers David Šálek and Jan Řebíček warmly invite all runners to take part in this traditional event.

name: 5, 10, 21 km trail okolo hory pro každého
description: The Trail Running Cup is a traditional series of trail races with a history dating back to 2011, offering courses of various distances from 5 to 50 kilometers amid the beautiful scenery of the Czech Republic. The races are suitable for all runners, including children, and provide great entertainment for the whole family. The series features a variety of terrain and difficulty levels, so everyone can find a course to suit them. The overall standings are based on points awarded for results in individual races held throughout the season.

name: Běh dobroučským krajem
description: The Běh dobroučským krajem is a traditional running race organized by the ISCAREX Athletics Club in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Dobrouč in the Pardubice Region. The race offers technically interesting courses with gentle undulations and a number of turns, running along paved paths. The event is open to the general public and welcomes experienced runners, recreational athletes, and families with children. It is part of the regional ISCAREX Cup running series and offers a great sporting atmosphere and facilities for runners and spectators alike.

name: Běháme pro radost - Help4Africa
description: Běháme pro radost is a traditional charity run held in the village of Smidary, celebrating its 10th edition in 2026. The event supports children’s projects in Africa through the organization Help4Africa, founded by Marcel Doubrava. The run combines physical activity with helping children in need, and participants can see the direct impact of their support through photographs from the projects. It is not only a sporting event, but also an opportunity to find joy in helping others.

name: Kounovský kros
description: Kounovský kros is a running race organized by TriClub Dobruška, held in the picturesque surroundings of Kounov near Dobruška in the Hradec Králové Region. The race is part of the Dobruška Cup and offers a sporting experience for the general public, including amateur runners. TriClub Dobruška is known for its long-standing tradition and for actively involving its members and the public in sporting events. The race is suitable for all age groups and levels of running ability.

name: Řepočetův výběh
description: Řepočetův výběh is a unique sporting and social event in Rokytnice nad Jizerou, taking place on June 6, 2026, at the open-air theatre grounds in Horní Rokytnice. The race offers two routes: 19.1 km with 650 m of elevation gain for Řepáci and 12 km with 400 m of elevation gain for Dumliky. The event supports the Run for the Memory of the Nation initiative and offers original race bibs, with the option to donate to the nonprofit organization Post Bellum. The race starts at 14:00, registration opens at 12:00, refreshments will be provided after the race, and the venue is accessible only on foot, with parking available within walking distance.

name: Heroes Race
location: Hradec nad Moravicí, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

name: Ultramaraton Babia Góra
description: Ultramaraton Babia Góra is a prestigious mountain race taking place on June 6, 2026, in Lipnica Wielka. The event features various distances, including multi-lap ultramarathons around Babia Góra and shorter races such as SkyRace®. The course runs through the scenic landscapes of Babia Góra National Park, offering challenging climbs and spectacular views. The event promotes an active lifestyle and supports the charitable work of the Rak’n’Roll Foundation. The organizer provides aid stations, medical support, and the option to have drop bags delivered to the course for the longest distances.

name: 12. Tarczyński Nocny Wrocław Półmaraton
description: The 12th Tarczyński Night Wrocław Half Marathon is one of Wrocław’s most important sporting events and will take place on June 6, 2026. Runners will follow a new, wide and safe course starting and finishing at Tarczyński Arena Wrocław. The half marathon symbolizes activity, health and the city’s openness, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad, as well as numerous spectators. The event aims to join the ranks of Europe’s largest half marathons, offering a record 21,975 race packages—a number that references the race distance.

name: II Półmaraton Miasteczkowskich Lasów
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Góra Jerzego w Miasteczku Śląskim
description: The 2nd Miasteczko Forests Half Marathon is organized by the Góra Jerzego Association in Miasteczko Śląskie and will take place on June 6, 2026. The half-marathon course is approximately 21.5 km long and runs through the town’s streets, the Świerklaniec Forest District, and the Tarnowskie Góry municipality. The start and finish are at the stadium by the Sports and Recreation Centre, making it easy for spectators to follow the race. The event will also include a 5 km run and races for children over various distances, promoting physical activity in the local community.

name: Poznańska Piwna Mila #19
description: Poznań Beer Mile is an annual cross-country race held in Poznań, attracting runners who value scenic routes and a sporty atmosphere. The event is part of a series of races organized by enthusiasts from the Greater Poland region, who have been promoting running and the beauty of local areas since 2014. The race is divided into start groups with participant limits, ensuring a comfortable experience and smooth organization. Special emphasis is placed on the scenic qualities of the route and bringing runners together.

name: Półmaraton Kurpiowski Pśejåk Bieg Szlakiem Schronów Bojowych SGO "Narew"
description: The Kurpie Pśejåk Half Marathon is a run along the route of the SGO “Narew” combat bunkers in Nowogród. The half-marathon course passes through historic areas dotted with combat bunkers, giving the race a distinctive character and combining sport with history. The event attracts runners who appreciate both off-road challenges and the atmosphere of the Kurpie region. It’s an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and learn about local history.

name: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84
description: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84 is a race held in Wieluń and part of the Running League, a platform promoting physical activity and running competition in Poland. The event is open to runners competing at various distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon. The Running League allows participants to earn points and compete in numerous rankings throughout the year, encouraging regular running and athletic development. The race is open and inclusive, welcoming both recreational and more experienced runners.

name: Kwietny Bieg
description: The Flower Run in Lisowice is a unique 24-hour relay race that commemorates the spirit of freedom awakened by the Holy Father John Paul II during his first pilgrimage to Poland. The race takes place on a certified 1,352-meter loop, which is clearly marked and illuminated after dark. The event is open to everyone and is growing in popularity, attracting a record number of participants. Everyone who completes the distance of 10 Flower Miles (35.3 km) receives a certificate and commemorative medal. It is not only an athletic competition, but also a community event with an atmosphere full of positive energy.

name: Nocna Dycha Kopernika Bieg z Panem Kleksem
description: Nocna Dycha Kopernika is a unique road race set in the magical surroundings of Toruń, the city of Copernicus. Participants can choose from the 10 km and 5 km distances, as well as Nordic walking, and there is also a special race for children, “Odkrywcy Mocy” (“Power Explorers”). The event takes place at night, giving it a distinctive atmosphere and appeal. The start and finish are located in the city center, and the organizers provide full logistical support and attractive race packages.

name: Sudecki Festiwal Biegów Gorskich
description: The Sudetes Mountain Running Festival continues the Riese Trail Runs in a new format, set in the picturesque area around Głuszyca. The festival offers three distances: Sudecki Olbrzym (43 km), Riese Trail Half Marathon (22 km), and Historic Ten (10 km), with routes available in GPX format. The event attracts mountain running enthusiasts with challenging yet beautiful routes in the Sudetes. The organizer provides professional support and rankings in the international ITRA and UTMB Index systems.

name: XII Festiwal Biegu Rzeźnika
description: The 12th Rzeźnik Run Festival will take place from June 3–6, 2026, in Cisna. This unique running event in the Bieszczady Mountains offers a wide range of distances, from 5 km to an extreme 500 km, including ultraruns, marathons, and children’s races. The routes pass through the picturesque mountain landscapes of the Beskids, offering unforgettable views and challenges for runners of varying experience levels. The festival is also an opportunity to take part in hiking and cycling events, as well as other accompanying activities.

name: Ederics VAD szíve - max pulzus 2026
distance_verbose: 30 km, 27 km, 24 km, Félmaraton, 18 km, 15 km, 12 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter

name: XXIV. Büchl Éjszakai Futóverseny
description: The XXIV Büchl Night Run will take place on June 6, 2026, in Győr, at Tulipános Primary School. The event offers several distances, including a children’s race, individual 7, 14 and 21 km runs, a three-person half-marathon relay, and 7 km Nordic walking. Runners receive a unique finisher’s medal, chip timing, refreshments and medical support. The courses are clearly marked and secured by police. Starter packs are provided to participants in the longer distances, and registration is finalized through advance registration and bank transfer.

name: Büchl Éjszakai Félmaraton
description: The Büchl Night Half Marathon is a traditional night race in Győr, offering running enthusiasts a range of distances, including a children’s race, individual races and relays. The event headquarters are at Tulipános Primary School. Participants can expect a well-organized event with chip timing, aid stations, medical support and police supervision. All entrants receive a unique finisher’s medal, and race packs are provided for the 14 km and 21 km distances. The race aims to offer an enjoyable and safe running experience for all ages.

name: Bükk Hegyi Maraton
description: The Bükki Mountain Marathon—Ádám Kisgyörgy Memorial Race is Hungary’s oldest trail marathon. It will take place on June 6, 2026, at Majális Park in Miskolc. The event offers a range of distances, from the marathon to the minimarathon, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. Runners compete amid the scenic natural beauty of the Bükk Mountains, while the race progress can be followed throughout the event at the race center, the “forest stadium.” The event aims to foster friendships through sport, promote a healthy lifestyle, and showcase the natural treasures of the Bükk.

name: Ceglédfürdő Futófesztivál
description: The 5th Ceglédfürdő Running Festival will take place on June 6, 2026, at the Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő és Szabadidőközpont. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and introduce the joy of running to all age groups. Participants can choose from a variety of distances, ranging from a 300-meter toddling race for the youngest runners to a half marathon and relay races. Runners can enjoy views of the beautiful lake and spa as they follow the synthetic-surface running track. Activities associated with the race, awards, and spa admission add to the experience.

name: Crazy5K
description: CRAZY5K is a unique 5 km obstacle race featuring 10 giant inflatable obstacles. The event is all about having fun rather than performance, making it a great way to enjoy an unforgettable day with friends, family or colleagues. A special family race is also available, designed specifically for families with children under 10, and there are surprises in store for the kids. The event takes place at Budaörs Airport, where parking is available. The entry fee includes a race bib, T-shirt, finisher’s pack, unique medal, refreshments, access to a cloakroom and medical supervision.

name: MOKÜ Run
location: Kismaros Focipálya, Liget utca, Kismaros, Hungary

name: Bathory Run
location: Sedliska, (okr. Vranov nad Topľou), Sedliska, (okr. Vranov nad Topľou), futbalové ihrisko
organizer: Obec Sedliska a MV Running team Sedliska
description: Bathory Run je bežecké podujatie v obci Sedliska pri Vranove nad Topľou, ktoré ponúka trate pre deti, dorast a dospelých. Pretekári bežia členitým terénom cez ovocný sad, čo dodáva behu príjemný prírodný charakter. Štart je rozdelený na detské kategórie o 10:30 a pre mužov a ženy o 13:00. Organizátormi sú Obec Sedliska a MV Running team Sedliska, ktorí zabezpečujú kvalitný priebeh pretekov pre všetky vekové kategórie.

name: Spoznaj Trebišov behom – Charity Run
location: Trebišov, Trebišov, námestie pod OD Billa
organizer: Mesto Trebišov, Stredná odborná škola služieb a priemyslu sv. Jozafáta
description: Charity Run v Trebišove je tradičným podujatím, ktoré spája beh, prechádzku, nordic walking a jazdu na bicykli. Tento charitatívny beh ponúka príležitosť spoznať mesto Trebišov a zároveň podporiť dobrú vec. Podujatie organizuje Majcher-Production s.r.o. a je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť, ktorá chce aktívne stráviť čas a prispieť na charitu.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 4. kolo
description: Šamorínska bežecká liga (ŠBL) je séria bežeckých pretekov organizovaných 3klubom Šamorín, určená pre širokú verejnosť bez vekových a výkonnostných limitov. Pretekári sú hodnotení v kategóriách muži, ženy, chlapci a dievčatá, pričom detské behy majú kratšie vzdialenosti. Liga prebieha počas celého roka a zahŕňa aj tradičnú akciu Pomlé Run. Štartovné zahŕňa štartové čísla, meranie časov, občerstvenie a vyhodnocovanie ligy. V poslednom kole prebehne oficiálne vyhodnotenie celkovej ligy s ocenením najlepších pretekárov.

name: Šebešská pätnástka
location: Vyšná Šebastová okr. Prešov, Vyšná Šebastová okr. Prešov, futbalové ihrisko Vyšná Šebastová
description: Šebešská pätnástka sú bežecké preteky organizované klubom MTC Vyšná Šebastová v spolupráci s obecným úradom Vyšná Šebastová a športovými združeniami. Hlavná trať meria 15,5 km s výbehom na Nevického chatu, doplnená je o rekreačnú 3 km trať a detské disciplíny pre rôzne vekové kategórie. Preteky sa konajú každoročne v nedeľu prvého júnového víkendu s dopoludňajším štartom a bohatým kultúrno-spoločenským programom, ktorý priláka stovky návštevníkov. Podujatie je súčasťou viacerých bežeckých súťaží a ligy, pričom organizátori kladú dôraz na rozvoj športu a budovanie mena obce. Šebešská pätnástka získala ocenenie Bežecký diamant v rokoch 2011 a 2012.

name: Mnichovohradištská patnáctka, memoriál ing. Josefa Hrona
description: The Mnichovohradištská Fifteen is a road race with a gently undulating out-and-back course measuring 15 km. It takes place in Mnichovo Hradiště, on T. G. Masaryk Square. The course is well paved and has marked kilometres, helping runners pace themselves. The race is held in memory of Ing. Josef Hron and offers a pleasant atmosphere for all runners. The start is at 10:00, and the organiser is Vladimír Koudelka. The race is suitable for runners looking for a quality road run with a long tradition.

name: Běh 2 míle Olomouc
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all age groups. Each participant competes primarily against themselves, creating a friendly and motivating atmosphere. The race takes place in the beautiful setting of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, adding to the enjoyment of the run. It is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners looking to test their speed over a short distance.

name: Běh přes Červený vrch
description: The Run over Červený vrch is a traditional running race organized by Atletický klub ISCAREX in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Čermná in the Pardubice Region. The race features a technically engaging course with gentle undulations and plenty of turns, suitable for a wide range of runners, from recreational athletes to experienced competitors. The event is part of the regional ISCAREX Cup running series and provides quality facilities for both runners and spectators. You can register online or on site on race day, June 7, 2026.

location: Sportovní areál Babice, Topolová 500, Babice, Czech Republic

description: Babický Trail 1/4 Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque Babice forest. It offers two main distances, 10.55 km and 5.95 km, with 160 m and 60 m of elevation gain, respectively. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, who can take part in shorter races. The course runs mainly along forest roads and trails, offering a pleasant experience in nature. The main race is limited to 200 participants, creating an intimate atmosphere. The organizers emphasize fair competition and safety, including course adjustments for the children’s categories.
course_highlights: Main race course: 10.55 km with 160 m of elevation gain
Mostly forest roads and trails (94% of the surface)
Specially adapted courses for children’s races (300 m, 1,000 m, 1,500 m)
additional: Registration and race bib collection take place from 08:30 to 09:45. The children’s races start between 09:45 and 10:01; the main race, combining the 1/4 and 1/8 marathons, starts at 11:00. The main race is limited to 200 participants. Parking is available at the sports complex and on surrounding streets; please be considerate of local residents. Online registration is also available on race day, but a 100% surcharge applies after registration check-in opens. The courses have been adjusted because of logging in the forest; this year, a course similar to the 2024 route returns. The race course consists of 38–51% forest roads, 43–56% forest trails, and 6% road. Start and event facilities: Sportovní areál Babice, Topolová 500. Entry fees are 400 Kč for the main races and 50–150 Kč for the children’s races; a parent + 1 child package costs 490 Kč. Capacity for the main race is limited.

name: Skalecký kros
description: Skalecký Cross-Country Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque Baroque grounds of Skalka in Mníšek pod Brdy. It offers 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as children’s races, running along forest paths and paved roads. The main race starts at 11:30 and is suitable for the general public, including children and teenagers. The event is organized by SK Mníšecko, z.s., which ensures high-quality organization and a welcoming atmosphere.

name: Červenkovská desítka
description: Červenkovská Desítka is a 10 km road race held in Červenka near Olomouc. The race is part of the 2026 Haná Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners. The course is an out-and-back route from Červenka through Dětřichov to Renoty and back, mostly on roads. Runners are divided into age categories, with prizes awarded to the winners in each category. The results ceremony will take place at the race venue, Hostinec u Nádraží, and the results will be published on hanackybeh.cz.

name: Milada Run
description: Milada Run is a popular sporting event held in the unique landscape of a former brown-coal mine, transformed into the beautiful natural surroundings of Lake Milada. The event offers various routes, including a half marathon, 10 km race, and children’s races, which follow undulating and flat paths with views of the lake. The atmosphere is family-friendly and welcoming, making it suitable for all ages and running abilities. All races are part of the Milada Tour series, which runners themselves praise for its high standards and popularity.

name: Konopišťská desítka
description: The Konopiště 10K is a traditional 10 km running race held in the beautiful natural amphitheatre and park at Konopiště near Benešov. The race is part of the Benešov Running Festival and offers the chance to compete in the main race, relays, and children’s categories. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to enjoy a run in picturesque countryside with high-quality organisation. The 30th anniversary edition will take place on 7 June 2026.

name: Bolfánek třikrát jinak
description: Bolfánek Three Ways is a running race organized by Pro Sport Activities in Chudenice, in the Plzeň Region. The race is part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series and offers an unusual format in which runners tackle the course in three different ways. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own age categories. The organizers emphasize a sporting experience in beautiful natural surroundings and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Mnichovická běhna
description: The Mnichovická běhna is an amateur running race through the beautiful Central Bohemian countryside, featuring a challenging course approximately 7–8 km long with around 200 meters of elevation gain. The varied terrain includes steep climbs and descents, running on paved paths, through forest, meadow, and pasture, accompanied by domestic and forest animals. The start and finish have been newly located at the Podhorky playing field by the Šibeniční vrch sports complex. All runners receive a commemorative medal and certificate; category winners receive trophies and a small surprise. The Mnichovická běhna is part of the Ladův kraj Cup running race series, and everyone who finishes the race healthy and alive is a winner.

name: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami
description: The Run Beneath the Thousand-Year-Old Oaks is a unique sporting event held in picturesque Kazimierz Biskupi, in the heart of the Bieniszew Forest. The race combines sport, history, and the beauty of the local landscape, taking participants along an avenue of thousand-year-old oaks in the Pustelnik Nature Reserve. The event is open to experienced runners, recreational runners, and families, with races over various distances as well as a Nordic walking event. It is organized by the Active Kazimierz Biskupi Association and the Municipality of Kazimierz Biskupi, and its tradition dates back to the beginning of the 21st century.

name: Bieg Śladem Konia
description: The Śladem Konia Run is an annual running event organized by the Wrocław PIAST Running Club and held at the Partynice horse racing track in Wrocław. The run is recreational and athletic in nature, attracting both casual runners and more experienced athletes. The route takes runners through scenic surroundings, combining elements of the natural landscape with the urban environment. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the running community together.

name: I Bieg po Jagodę Kamczacką
location: PLANTIN Haskap Berry Plantation, Muniakowice, Poland
description: The 1st Haskap Berry Run is a unique sporting event that combines a passion for running with the idea of a healthy lifestyle and closeness to nature. The race takes place at PLANTIN’s haskap berry plantation in Muniakowice near Kraków, with the start, finish and race village located in the heart of the plantation. The race is part of the Berry Relay and promotes mindful food choices and local products. It is not just a competition, but also a gathering of people who value outdoor activity and authentic experiences.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Warszawa
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Warsaw is a prestigious triathlon held in the heart of Poland’s capital, combining a swim in Lake Zegrzyńskie, a 90 km bike ride to central Warsaw, and a half-marathon run. The event attracts both experienced triathletes and amateurs, offering the opportunity to qualify for the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship. The atmosphere is filled with sporting excitement and the historic spirit of Warsaw, and the finish line is at the Multimedia Fountain Park, adding a unique character to the race.

name: Pogórzański Festiwal Biegowy - Lato
description: Pogórzański Running Festival – Summer is a running event held on June 7, 2026, in Burzyn near Tuchów. The event promotes running and a healthy lifestyle among residents of Małopolska, offering races at various distances, including a 22 km mountain run, a 10 km race, a 5.5 km race, and Nordic walking. The start and finish are at the LKS Burzyn stadium by Burzyn Primary School, where changing rooms and showers are also available. Participants receive a race pack with a gift, water, and snacks along the course and at the finish.

name: Test Coopera dla wszystkich
description: The Cooper Test for Everyone is a nationwide, free fitness test in which participants cover as much distance as possible in 12 minutes. It is open to everyone, regardless of age, gender, or running experience. Participants receive a race bib, a certificate with their result, and a bottle of water. It’s a great opportunity to check your fitness and get motivated to stay physically active.

name: VI EKO Bieg z Gwizdkiem po Zdrowie
description: The 6th Eco Run with a Whistle for Health takes place on June 7, 2026, in Jerzmanowice. The event is organized by Tomasz Gwizdała, Mayor of the Jerzmanowice-Przeginia Municipality, and KKS Jura Moto Sport. The run has an environmental focus and promotes a healthy lifestyle. Participants can use the official race-package exchange to safely buy or sell entry packages. The start and race office are at Chochołowy Dwór in Jerzmanowice.

name: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZR...
description: The 13th DASZRADE Foundation Marathon and Half Marathon in memory of Barbara Karaczyńska is a small-scale running event held in Opalenie, organized by the Daszrade Foundation in cooperation with the “Zapowiednik” Addiction Treatment Center. The marathon course is entirely paved, running through the picturesque fields and forests of Kociewie. It is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and features numerous, fairly steep climbs, with a total elevation gain of 646 m. The race takes place on a June morning and offers unforgettable views and a unique atmosphere. After the race, participants can look forward to a recovery meal, and everyone who finishes will receive a commemorative medal, diploma, and T-shirt.

name: XV Bieg Pszczyński
description: The 15th Carbo Asecura Pszczyna Run is an annual running event held in Pszczyna since 2012. The main race follows a familiar and popular 10 km course, run according to tried-and-tested rules. The event also includes races for children and teenagers, making it appealing to families and participants of all ages. All runners are invited to take part in this friendly, traditional sporting event.

location: Dąbrowa, Świerczów Municipality, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

location: Stryszawa, Sucha County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: 31. ALDI Női Futógála
description: The 31st ALDI Women’s Running Gala is a special running event taking place on June 7, 2026, in Budapest’s City Park. Participants can choose from several distances, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them: 2.5 km, 5 km, or 10 km. The goal of the running gala is to help participants step away from everyday life, enjoy the freedom of movement, and be part of a shared community experience. At the finish, runners will receive a unique finisher’s medal and a running T-shirt to make the day memorable.

name: Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Futás 9 / 21
description: The Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Run is a road race connecting the towns of Pécs, Orfű and Abaliget, with 465 meters of elevation gain. The race aims to bring local running communities together and promote running among the hills and lakes. The event traditionally takes place in early June and offers several distances, including a children’s race. The organizers warmly welcome runners to enjoy nature and the sense of community together.

name: PÉCS -> ORFŰ -> ABALIGET FÉLMARATON
description: The Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Run is a road half marathon connecting the towns of Pécs, Orfű and Abaliget, with 465 meters of elevation gain. The race aims to bring local running communities together and promote running among the hills and lakes. The event is traditionally held in early June and also offers family-friendly activities, such as a children’s race. With support from local communities and the university, the organizers welcome runners to enjoy nature and sport together.

name: Mladé BĚKODO
location: Doubravka, Teplice, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Mladé Běkodo is a series of running races for children and young people aged 2 to 15, held around Doubravka in Teplice. The races offer distances from 200 to 1,650 metres and are divided into age categories. Each race is followed by an awards ceremony for individual and team results. BK Běkodo is part of TJ Lokomotiva Teplice and has a long tradition dating back to 2001.

name: Běh Advenťáka BRNO
description: Běh Advenťáka Brno 2026 is a charity race held on June 9 by the Medlánky Pond in Brno. The race offers a 6.45 km course on paved paths, suitable for runners of all levels, with trail shoes recommended. The event also includes children’s categories with shorter courses. Participants’ entry fees support people who face challenges in life, and runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere, sports prizes, and other benefits.

name: Pivní míle Heřmanův Městec
description: The Beer Mile in Heřmanův Městec is an original race on the Bažantnice athletics track, where runners complete four laps of 400 metres with beer breaks. This unconventional sporting experience combines running and fun in a friendly atmosphere. This year marks the 10th edition of this popular event, which is part of the Heřmanův Městec running club.

name: Otevřený přebor SABZO v přespolním běhu
description: The SABZO Open Cross-Country Championship is a traditional running race organized by the SABZO Running Club in Prague. The race gives amateur runners the chance to test their strength in cross-country running in a pleasant sporting atmosphere. The SABZO Club is known for its long history and for regularly organizing running events in Prague and the surrounding area. The race is part of the club’s broader calendar of running events, which promotes an active lifestyle and a community of runners.

name: Běh Advenťáka OSTRAVA
description: The Advenťák Ostrava Run 2026 is a charity running race held on June 10 in Komenského sady. The race offers two main categories: adults running 6.45 km and children, called little elves, on courses from 0.2 to 1 km. The route follows paved and firm-surface paths, and road-running shoes are recommended. A large portion of the entry fee supports heroes who face challenges in life, and participants receive a race number, certificate, gingerbread cookie, and other benefits. The event is friendly, charitable, and suitable for all age groups.

name: Trail Zlíchovskými vyhlídkami VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: The VAŠÍ LIGA Trail of Zlíchov Viewpoints is an amateur trail race held in Prague, offering runners the experience of running in nature across varied terrain and enjoying interesting views. The races are part of VAŠÍ LIGA, the largest amateur league in the Czech Republic, which promotes the joy of sport and a community atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a friendly environment and the chance to test themselves against runners of all ages. Winners are regularly announced and awarded medals in the under-40 and 40+ categories.

name: Červnová Krásná Morava
description: The June Krásná Morava is a running race organized by the Central Moravian Association of Endurance Sports in Olomouc-Hejčín. It is part of the rich tradition of running events in the Olomouc Region, which are open to runners of all ages and abilities. The race offers a chance to experience the picturesque Haná countryside and join a community of sports enthusiasts. STMSVS is known for its long-standing organization of endurance sports and its support for running, cycling, and triathlon disciplines in the region.

name: Ekstremalny Półmaraton Górski
location: Lipowa, Żywiec County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Angličák night run Pezinok
description: Angličák Night Run Pezinok je nočný bežecký závod na 5 kilometrov, ktorý sa koná v Areáli zdravia Rozálka v Pezinku. Bežci si môžu užiť rýchly a dynamický beh po trase vedúcej cez Malokarpatskú oblasť s umelým osvetlením, čo vytvára jedinečnú atmosféru. Podujatie je určené pre všetkých od 15 rokov a je rozdelené do štartových koridorov podľa výkonnosti. Organizátori kladú dôraz na bezpečnosť, preto je zakázané používať slúchadlá a odporúčajú reflexné prvky či čelovky. Registrácia je možná online a je viazaná na meno pretekára, pričom je možné vykonať preregistráciu do 9. júna 2026.

name: Runway Run
location: Kamenica nad Cirochou Airport, Kamenica nad Cirochou, Slovakia

name: The Run Slovakia
location: naprieč Slovenskom, naprieč Slovenskom, Košice, ul. Hlavná, resp. Teplička nad Váhom
description: THE RUN SLOVAKIA 2026 je národný štafetový beh naprieč Slovenskom, ktorý prebieha počas troch dní. Bežci spoločne prekonávajú viac ako 530 km z Košíc do Bratislavy, prechádzajúc krásnymi prírodnými scenériami, historickými pamiatkami a malebnými mestami. Podujatie ponúka jedinečnú športovú atmosféru, tímovú spoluprácu a množstvo nezabudnuteľných zážitkov. Trasa vedie cez významné miesta ako Spišský hrad, Vysoké Tatry, Oravský hrad či Malé Karpaty, pričom bežci zažijú aj bohatý sprievodný program.

name: Přes tři hráze Opatov
description: Přes tři hráze Opatov is a traditional running race held in Opatov in the Vysočina Region and is part of the Vysočina Runner’s Cup series. The race offers various distances, including the 8.8 km main course for men and veterans up to 69 years old, as well as shorter courses for women, veterans over 70, juniors, youth, and children. The course runs mainly along field and forest paths, including a route over the dams of three local ponds, giving the race its unique character. The event is open to a broad range of age groups and emphasizes sporting experiences and support for the local running community.

name: Ultra Nízke Tatry
description: Ultra Nízke Tatry je prvý ročník horského bežeckého podujatia, ktoré vedie hrebeňom Nízkych Tatier od západu na východ. Trať má dĺžku 49,7 km s prevýšením 2650 metrov a vedie po turistických značkách z Donovalov na Srdiečko. Podujatie je súčasťou kalendára Slovenskej Skyrunningovej asociácie a zároveň slúži ako Memoriál Milana Styka, významného bežca a horolezca, ktorý tragicky zahynul v roku 2025. Štart je plánovaný na 13. júna 2026 o 7:00 hodine v Donovaloch pri Donovalskom pivovare.

name: Strečnianska mašľa
description: Strečnianska mašľa je horský ultramaratón a diaľkový pochod okolo Strečna, ktorý sa uskutoční 13. júna 2026. Pretek ponúka dve trasy - náročnú 50 km trasu s prevýšením približne 2985 metrov a kratšiu 25 km trasu, ktorá je vhodná aj pre bežcov so psom. Trasy vedú po turisticky značených chodníkoch cez obe časti Malej Fatry a časťou národného parku, pričom štart a cieľ sú na futbalovom ihrisku Radinové v Strečne. Organizátori zabezpečujú štartovné balíčky, ceny pre najlepších a kvalitné podmienky pre účastníkov.

name: Krosak pod hradom
location: Trnava pri Laborci, okr. Michalovce, Trnava pri Laborci, okr. Michalovce, Obecný úrad
organizer: Mgr. Ján Podstavský, Vladimír Adam, Ing. Ladislav Ondrik, Vladimír Sikorai, Gabriel Sabo, Štefan Karafa
description: Krosák pod hradom je bežecký pretek v Trnave pri Laborci, ktorý ponúka rôzne kategórie vrátane veľkého krosáku na 10 km, malého krosáku na 5 km, behu zdravia a nordic walkingu. Trať vedie po poľných a lesných cestách s asfaltovým povrchom, pričom veľký krosák pozostáva z dvoch päťkilometrových okruhov. Pretek je súčasťou Bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance a je vhodný pre širokú škálu bežcov od juniorov až po veteránov. Štart pretekov je na Obecnom úrade v Trnave pri Laborci, pričom detské kategórie začínajú o 9:00 a hlavný pretek o 11:00.

name: Kysucký maratón
location: Čadca, Čadca, Matičné námestie - pred Domom kultúry Čadca
description: Kysucký maratón je druhým najstarším maratónom na Slovensku a významnou športovou a spoločenskou udalosťou regiónu Kysúc. Trať vedie malebnou kysuckou dolinou pozdĺž rieky Kysuca, s bezpečnejšou a atraktívnejšou trasou po bežeckej cyklotrase od roku 2025. Súčasťou podujatia sú okrem maratónu aj polmaratón, maratónska štafeta a minimaratón pre deti. Štart a cieľ sú na Matičnom námestí v Čadci pred Domom kultúry. Preteká sa v rôznych vekových kategóriách a účastníci majú k dispozícii občerstvovacie stanice a zázemie vrátane šatní a wellness služieb.

name: Beh Hodkovským parkom
location: Žehra časť Hodkovce, Žehra časť Hodkovce, Kaštieľ Hodkovce 1, Žehra, areál DSS DOMOVINA no.
description: Beh Hodkovským parkom je bežecké podujatie v areáli Kaštieľa Hodkovce v Žehre, ktoré ponúka trať prevažne poľnými a lesnými cestami s asfaltovým povrchom. Pretek je rozdelený do kategórií na 8 km súťažný beh pre rôzne vekové skupiny mužov a žien, ako aj nesúťažné kategórie Beh pre zdravie a Nordic walking na 4 km bez vekového obmedzenia. Organizátorom je DOMOVINA n.o., ktorý zabezpečuje príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu pre všetkých účastníkov. Štartovné je dostupné online za zvýhodnenú cenu, čo podporuje včasnú registráciu.

name: Beh Kalváriou
description: Beh Kalváriou je charitatívny bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná v krásnom prostredí Kalvárie v Považskej Bystrici. Podujatie ponúka trate pre dospelých aj deti, pričom povrch trate tvoria lesné cesty. Tento štvrtý ročník preteku je príležitosťou zažiť spoločenstvo, pohyb a radosť, pričom výťažok z behu je venovaný deťom v núdzi. Organizátori kladú dôraz na kvalitnú organizáciu a podporu charitatívnych cieľov.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 2. Letné kolo
location: Lemešany, Lemešany, Lúka nad obcou Lemešany
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany, Záhrada pohybu
description: Lemešanská bežecká liga 2. Letné kolo je bežecké podujatie konané v Lemešanoch na lúke nad obcou. Pretek je rozdelený do viacerých kategórií podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane detských kategórií a nordic walking. Štart pre hlavné kategórie je o 17:00 hod., detské kategórie štartujú o 17:10 hod. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru letného bežeckého kola.

name: Beh na chatu pri Zelenom plese – Memoriál K. Jakeša
location: Tatranské Matliare, Tatranské Matliare, Kežmarská Biela voda, pri zastávke SAD
description: Beh na Chatu pri Zelenom plese je horský beh určený pre nadšencov športu a prírody, vhodný pre amatérskych aj profesionálnych športovcov. Podujatie sa koná pravidelne od roku 2005 počas druhého júnového víkendu a nesie spomienku na Karla Jakeša, významného československého horolezca. Trať vedie náročným horským terénom s výrazným prevýšením, čo robí beh výzvou pre všetkých účastníkov. Cieľom je spojiť rôzne športové skupiny a ponúknuť im jedinečný zážitok v krásnom prostredí Vysokých Tatier.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton Olomouc 2026
description: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc 2026 is a traditional half marathon that takes you through the beauty of Olomouc’s historic center. The start and finish are on Upper Square, where you can admire the Holy Trinity Column and the town hall with its unique astronomical clock. During the race, you’ll enjoy the city’s atmosphere, historic buildings, and beautiful parks. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and also offers an accompanying program.

name: Horem dolem Chospílem
description: Horem dolem Chospílem is a 9.2 km interval-start running race that follows meadows and farm tracks around Postřekov in the Chospíl area. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series and offers runners pleasant terrain in a natural setting. The interval start makes for an interesting race format. This race is suitable for runners looking for a mix of nature and sporting challenge in the Plzeň Region.

name: Sokolovský  ¼ maraton
organizer: Živý kraj – Destinační agentura pro Karlovarský kraj, z.s.
description: The Sokolov Quarter Marathon is a running event taking place on June 13, 2026, in Sokolov in the Karlovy Vary Region. The course runs mainly through scenic parts of the city and the surrounding countryside, and is approximately 10.5 km long. The event is intended both for recreational runners and for those who want to experience the atmosphere of a race in beautiful surroundings. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and a sporting experience for all participants.

name: Dobročinný běh po stopách Silver A
description: We invite you to the 3rd annual charity run and walk, In the Footsteps of Silver A, organized by the Zámeček Memorial in Pardubice. The event is suitable for athletes and non-athletes, children and adults, and the entry fees go to charitable causes. The run offers two routes—a shorter 5-kilometer route and a longer 10-kilometer route—as well as a children’s race of approximately 1 kilometer. There will also be a guided walk through the city to places associated with the Silver A parachute group, starting at the Zámeček Memorial.

name: Hradecký koloběh
description: Hradecký Koloběh is a mixed-pair race held in the beautiful surroundings of the city forests, starting at Biřička. The race combines running and cycling: one team member runs while the other rides a bike. Competitors can switch at any time during the race, adding strategy and excitement. The event celebrates team spirit and the joy of movement, with OPEN and FAMILY categories. It is held with the support of the City of Hradec Králové and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Jinecký kros
organizer: Městys Jince a Jinečáček, z. s.
description: Jinecký kros is a traditional running race held in Jince, offering a challenging course approximately 5.7 km long with around 178 metres of elevation gain. The start and finish are at the football pitch by the Biokoupaliště, which provides facilities for runners, including parking, changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The course runs along asphalt roads, forest paths and meadows, and includes crossing a wooden footbridge, running on asphalt roads and climbing Vystrkov hill. The race is suitable for adults and children, who have their own categories. The main race starts at 11:00.

name: Jindřichohradecký půlmaraton
description: The Jindřichův Hradec Half Marathon 2026 is the tenth anniversary edition of a running race offering a unique experience that combines the town’s picturesque historic centre, sections along the water, and natural stretches with significant elevation gain. The race is open to individuals running 21.1 km, as well as relay teams, families, and schools taking part in shorter races. The atmosphere is enhanced by fans and music, with race services including refreshment stations and showers. A special Rebel Run is also planned for schools, focusing on teamwork rather than time. The race starts on 13 June 2026. Participants will receive original medals and can win prizes.

name: Neveklovské běhy
organizer: kulturní a sportovní komise města Neveklov
description: Neveklov Runs is a traditional running event held in the picturesque Castle Park in Neveklov. The race offers runners of all abilities the chance to enjoy a run in the park’s pleasant surroundings and friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the wider Běžec Podblanicka running race calendar, which promotes an active lifestyle and brings athletes in the region together.

name: 7 pohoří Jeseníky
description: Jeseníky 2026 is a technical trail race in the beautiful countryside beneath Králický Sněžník, offering three courses of varying distances and elevation gain. The routes have been prepared by members of the local mountain rescue service and run mostly through natural terrain. Participants can enjoy a professionally marked course, chip timing, refreshments along the route and at the finish, and a commemorative medal. The event takes place in all weather conditions and is suitable for all trail-running enthusiasts looking for epic views and an atmosphere they won’t find anywhere else.

name: Okrouhelský běh
description: The Okrouhlá Run is a traditional race in the Českolipsko District Running League, held in the picturesque village of Okrouhlá in the Liberec Region. The race offers runners of all levels the chance to enjoy a run in a natural setting with a friendly atmosphere. The Okrouhlá Run is part of a series of regional running races that promote an active lifestyle and community sports.

name: Extrem Run 5Hills
description: Extrem Run 5 Hills is an ultratrail running race in the westernmost part of the Czech Republic, offering a challenging 91-kilometre course with 2,174 metres of elevation gain. The route crosses five peaks of Egerland and combines paved roads, cycling and hiking trails, and forest terrain. The race is intended for experienced runners seeking an extreme sporting challenge and stunning panoramas. The organizers place emphasis on accurate timekeeping and participant safety. The race takes place in the scenic Vojtanov area and also offers relay and two-person duathlon options.

name: Běh na Pajrek
description: Běh na Pajrek is the second edition of a running race organized by TJ Nýrsko, taking place on June 13, 2026, at the venue below the ski slope in Nýrsko. The race offers men an 8.6 km course (2 laps) and women a 4.2 km course (1 lap), with 152 meters of elevation gain per lap. The finish is at the same location as the start. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Ešus League, with refreshments available at the venue. The organizers note that the course may change due to construction work and provide prizes in kind for the top finishers in each category.

name: IV Bilczańska Dycha
organizer: Zakład Gospodarki Komunalnej i Rekreacji w Morawicy
description: The 3rd Bilcza 10K is a 10 km road race held in the recreational areas of Bilcza Park in the municipality of Morawica. The event is aimed at running enthusiasts of all ages. On race day, children’s races and a family festival are also held. The race is open to all and promotes active recreation in the scenic Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship.

name: 23 Wilcza Dycha
description: Borowiacka Dycha is an annual 10 km race organized by the Biegające Śliwice association. The event promotes an active lifestyle and attracts runners from the region, offering a scenic course surrounded by the Tuchola Forests. The race takes place in Osieczna and is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich. Participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.

name: 7 Szamotulska Nocna Piątka
description: Szamotulska Night Five is an annual, officially certified 5 km race held in Szamotuły. The course runs through the city streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete at a professional level and earn recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races over shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime character. The organizers look after participants’ comfort by offering refreshments after the race and awarding the winners.

name: 8 Bieg Chwalisza
description: The 8th edition of the Chwalisz Run is an annual charity race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Ściernie. The start and finish are located at Preschool No. 1 – Ściernie branch. The 5 km course runs mainly along forest trails, with minimal asphalt, offering both challenges and the joy of running for experienced competitors and beginners alike. All entry fees will go toward supporting Antoś Synowiec, a child with a rare genetic disease, underscoring the charitable nature of the event. The organizers also invite participants to join group training sessions every Thursday at 19:00.

name: Bieg Iskry
description: Bieg Iskry is a unique running event taking place on June 13, 2026, at Mielec Airport. Participants will cover a 6.5 km route along the runway beneath the illuminated lights and setting sun, creating a one-of-a-kind aviation atmosphere. The organizers provide professional medals, T-shirts featuring an Iskra aircraft, and prizes in the form of trophies and tandem-flight vouchers. After the run, participants can admire the aircraft and enjoy refreshments and dietary supplements.

name: Bieg Recepta na Zdrowie
description: The eighth nationwide “Prescription for Health” run will take place on June 13, 2026, at Arturówek in Łódź. This healthy running event promotes physical activity, integration between the running and pharmaceutical communities, and a healthy lifestyle. The routes follow a 5 km loop in Łagiewnicki Forest, with 5 km and 10 km race distances and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. Shorter races for children and young people will be held on the same route. A family picnic with free screenings and consultations will take place near the start and finish.

name: II Leśny Bieg Gminy Brzeźnio - Tumidaj
Leśna ZaDyszka
description: Leśna ZaDyszka is a race held in the picturesque Szulmierz Forest District in the Regimin municipality, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in woodland surroundings. The course consists of a 5 km loop that runs along forest tracks and an asphalt section, showcasing the beauty of the Masovian countryside. Participants can choose from three events: 5 km, 10 km (two loops), and 5 km Nordic Walking. A 1.5 km fun run without rankings is planned for children. The start and finish are located in a forest clearing by the Szulmierz–Regimin road, and times are recorded using a professional chip timing system.

name: Memoriał Mariana Szymańskiego
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Radomsku
description: The 13th Radomsko Street Run, the Marian Szymański Memorial, is an annual running event held in Radomsko in memory of Marian Szymański. The race takes place on the city streets, offering participants the chance to compete in a friendly atmosphere. It is organized by the City of Radomsko and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Radomsko, with timing provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu. The race is scheduled to start at 17:30, and online registration is open until June 10, 2026.

name: XII Wojewódzki Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar ...
description: The 12th Provincial Badger Cup Cross-Country Run is a running event organized by the Municipality of Murów. It will take place on June 13, 2026, in Zagwiździe, on the grounds of the historic Ironworks complex. The event includes several categories: a 12 km run, a 3.5 km run, children’s races, and Nordic walking. The race office will be open from 8:00 to 9:30, and timing will be electronic. This sporting event combines competition with a beautiful historic setting, encouraging physical activity and community engagement.

name: XIX Bieg Marszałka
description: The 19th Marshal’s Run is an annual road race held in Sulejówek, commemorating the tradition of the pre-war Sulejówek–Belweder marches. The main race, approximately 10 km long, takes place in June, recalling Józef Piłsudski’s settling in Sulejówek. The event also includes accompanying races, including the 3.6 km Halina Zielińska Memorial and races for children. The race has a patriotic and sporting character, with uniformed services and museum professionals taking part. The start and finish are at 94 Paderewskiego Street, beside Villa Bzów.

name: XV Bieg Szlakiem Króla Zygmunta Starego
description: The 15th Run Along the Trail of King Sigismund the Old is an annual race held in Kozienice, commemorating the historic route associated with King Sigismund the Old. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering a scenic route and sporting competition. The organizers provide professional support and a friendly atmosphere for participants.

name: 200 setny maraton - święto biegania z Ze...
XIX Bieg Zajączkowski
location: Zajączki Drugie, Gmina Krzepice, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Brutálfutás 15.0
description: Brutálfutás 15.0 is a fun obstacle race in Nyáregyháza, where participants can take on a mix of a military training course and obstacle race over distances of 2, 3 or 7 kilometres. The event is not about performance, but about good vibes and unforgettable experiences, with mud and water guaranteed. Runners can look forward to a unique finisher’s medal and plenty of mud, and can also enter as charity runners. The event attracts participants from hundreds of towns and villages across the country and has a truly fun, family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Bábolna Bio Sunset Run
description: The Bábolna Bio Sunset Run is an atmospheric evening running race held on June 13, 2026, in the center of Bábolna, in front of the Beach and Thermal Bath. Along the course, runners pass the riding stables and the famous Bábolna Arboretum and Animal Park. The race starts at sunset, with extra atmospheric lighting, and participants can choose from three distances, including a half-marathon relay. Runners receive a premium race pack with BioTechUSA refreshments, and everyone who finishes within the time limit receives a unique finisher’s medal.

name: Edelényi Kastélysziget Esti Körök 3 / 7 / 14 / 21
location: Edelény, L'Huillier-Coburg kastély, Borsodi út 7, 3780 Magyarország
description: Edelényi Kastélysziget Esti Körök is an atmospheric running race held around the L'Huillier-Coburg Castle. The race offers several distances, so every runner can find a challenge that suits them. The event is an ideal choice for those who enjoy the special atmosphere of the castle park and the experience of running in the evening. The organizers welcome participants with professional timing and a convenient registration platform.

name: Kecskeméti Sport Fesztivál
description: The Kecskemét Sports Festival is a traditional community sporting event in Kecskemét, around Benkó Hill. The event aims to promote recreational exercise and sport, welcoming participants in a family-friendly atmosphere with a variety of running events. Alongside running, the festival also features charity events and community activities, bringing sport and social responsibility together. The organizers warmly welcome everyone who wants to run and enjoy the pleasure of exercise and being close to nature.

name: UTBT (Ultra Tokaj-Bodrogkeresztúr-Tarcal)
description: The Ultra Tokaj - Bodrogkeresztúr - Tarcal running race is a challenging 63 km ultra-distance event that winds through the scenic vineyards and hills of Tokaj-Hegyalja. The race offers three different distances, so beginners and experienced runners alike can find the ideal challenge for them. The event is more than just a running race—it is an experience set amid the landscapes of one of Hungary’s most beautiful wine regions. All races start with a mass start, and runners receive refreshments along the course and at the finish.

name: BRUTÁLFUTÁS
description: Brutálfutás is a fun obstacle race in Nyáregyháza, offering an unforgettable muddy, splash-filled experience over 2.3- and 7-kilometer distances. The race combines a military training course with an obstacle race, with fun and community at its heart. Participants can look forward to a unique finisher’s medal and plenty of mud, and come from hundreds of towns and villages across the country. This race isn’t about taking things seriously—it’s about fun and a challenge, so everyone can find a distance that suits them.

name: Račiansky kros – leto
location: Bratislava, Bratislava, Knižková dolina, Bratislava – Rača (nad amfiteátrom)
description: Račiansky kros LETO je bežecké podujatie v Bratislave-Rači, ktoré ponúka tri trate s rôznou dĺžkou a prevýšením. Hlavná trať má 16 km s prevýšením 503 m, ďalšia trať 9,5 km s prevýšením 335 m a sú pripravené aj detské behy. Trate vedú prevažne lesným terénom s asfaltovými úsekmi a sú dobre značené tromi spôsobmi. Podujatie je vhodné pre rôzne vekové kategórie a ponúka ocenenia pre najlepších v kategóriách. Štart je v Knižkovej doline a časový limit je 3 hodiny pre hlavnú trať.

name: Vranovská desiatka
location: Vranov nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Dom kultúry vo Vranove nad Topľou, M. R. Štefánika 875
organizer: Mesto Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský športový klub Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský dom kultúry
description: Vranovská desiatka je tradičný bežecký pretek v meste Vranov nad Topľou, ktorý ponúka trate na 10 km a 5 km. Pretek je organizovaný Mestom Vranov nad Topľou, Mestským športovým klubom a Mestským domom kultúry. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, pričom sú vyhodnocovaní aj najlepší traja bežci z Vranova. Štart a cieľ sú pri Dome kultúry vo Vranove nad Topľou. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť, od rekreačných bežcov po súťažiacich.

name: Čeľovská sedmička
location: Čeľovce, okr. Trebišov, Čeľovce, okr. Trebišov, pred Kultúrnym domom
description: Čeľovská sedmička je bežecké podujatie konané v obci Čeľovce, okr. Trebišov, pred Kultúrnym domom. Pretek je určený pre rôzne kategórie vrátane mužov, žien, rodín a detí, pričom ponúka letnú prechádzku a súťaž pre najmenších bežcov. Podujatie je súčasťou bežeckej komunity Beh.sk a podporuje aktívny životný štýl v príjemnom prostredí obce.

name: Tatranská 15
organizer: Obecný úrad Mlynčeky, Športoví nadšenci z Mlynčekov
description: Tatranská 15 je bežecký pretek organizovaný Obecným úradom Mlynčeky a športovými nadšencami z Mlynčekov. Pretek sa koná na futbalovom ihrisku v Mlynčekoch a ponúka príležitosť pre bežcov zažiť atmosféru športového podujatia v krásnom prostredí. Štartovné je dostupné za zvýhodnenú cenu pri včasnej registrácii, pričom je možné sa prihlásiť aj v deň pretekov. Organizátori vítajú všetkých bežcov a športových nadšencov na tomto tradičnom podujatí.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem Kravaře
location: Fotbalový stadion, Alejní ulice, Kravaře, Czech Republic
description: Běh zámeckým parkem Kravaře is a running race held mainly on gravel paths through the chateau park, on a flat course. The race takes place at the football stadium in Kravaře and also includes children’s races. It is organized by Prajzský BK Kravaře, which welcomes all runners to this pleasant and friendly event.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly along gravel paths through the chateau park
Flat course
Children’s races
additional: The first category starts at 9:15, and the main category starts at 10:00. The organizer is Prajzský BK Kravaře; the contact person is Jan Ferenz. The race is mixed and takes place in the Moravian-Silesian Region, at the football stadium on Alejní Street in Kravaře. In 2026, the start was at the football stadium on Alejní Street. Price information applies to the 2026 edition and has not been confirmed for 2027.

name: Půlmaraton okolo Prahy 4
description: The Half Marathon Around Prague 4 is a unique individual running event offering a meditative running experience on the varied terrain of an urban trail. The course is approximately 21 kilometres long and follows the perimeter of the Prague 4 district, giving participants the chance to get to know the area as well as assess their own running form. There is no mass start: runners set off individually or in small groups between 9:00 and 10:00, avoiding stress and congestion at the start and on the course. Following a successful debut, the half marathon is being held for the second time and is suitable for anyone who wants to combine athletic performance with an enjoyable experience in both nature and the city.

name: Chaloupecký kros
description: The Chaloupky Cross-Country Race is a traditional running event held in the picturesque surroundings of Chaloupky near Komárov. The race offers two main routes, approximately 8 km and 4 km long, which run along paved roads, forest trails, and meadows. The main race starts at 10:00, giving participants the chance to enjoy a combination of natural beauty and sporting challenge. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup and is suitable for the general public; there are no children’s categories.

name: Běh na Hraničář
description: Běh na Hraničář is a traditional and prestigious uphill race held in the picturesque setting of the forest amphitheatre by the Úhlava River in Nýrsko. The 5 km route, with 380 metres of elevation gain, passes the ruins of Pajrek Castle and finishes at the summit of Hraničář, offering a wonderful view of Mount Ostrý. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and, after a three-year break, has been held again since 2020. After the race, participants must make their own way back to the start.

name: Dobývání Dívčích hradů
description: The Conquest of Dívčí hrady is a 2 km uphill race with an elevation gain of 135 metres, held in Hlubočepy, Prague 5. The race is part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series and offers runners the challenge of a demanding climb. The course passes through picturesque terrain with beautiful views, making the race appealing to fans of mountain running and hill running. It is suitable for anyone looking to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain.

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: The Bydgoszcz Canal Night Marathon is Poland’s oldest continuously held night marathon, taking place since 2007. The race is run in the unique nighttime setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty and along the Bydgoszcz Canal’s distinctive historic hydraulic structures: its 18th-century locks. The canal is the oldest inland waterway in Poland. The event attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering generous race packs, original medals and T-shirts, and professional timekeeping. It is growing in prestige and is known for its lively atmosphere, live music, and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: A night race in the setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty
A route along the historic 18th-century locks of the Bydgoszcz Canal
A unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
additional: There are 6 distances. Participants receive original medals, commemorative T-shirts, and generous race packs. Professional electronic timekeeping and race numbers are provided. Live music adds to the event’s appeal for runners and spectators. The event features 6 distances, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals and T-shirts, and generous race packs. Participants can expect professional course markings and artistic entertainment during the race.

name: TATRA FEST 2026
description: Tatra Fest is a unique mountain festival held in Zakopane, bringing together a variety of outdoor disciplines, including trail running, climbing, cycling, trekking, and family activities. The event includes challenging races along Tatra trails, such as the 68 km Tatra Fest Bieg and the 22 km Tatra Fest Run, offering participants unforgettable experiences amid the Tatras’ picturesque landscapes. The festival attracts both professionals and amateurs, promoting physical activity, connection with nature, and environmental responsibility. The organizers invite everyone to celebrate life and the mountain spirit together.

name: Zawojski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Zawoja Running Festival is one of the largest sporting events in the region, held amid the picturesque scenery of Babia Góra and the Police Mountain Range. The festival attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering a variety of mountain race distances and a unique atmosphere. The event aims to popularize mountain running and promote the beauty of Babia Góra National Park, combining a sporting adventure with an opportunity to discover the region’s natural and cultural wealth.

name: Bieg Charytatywny
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie, Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: The CZTERY PORY ROKU Charity Run – Stage IV is a sporting event held in Oława, in the park by the railway station. Participants can take part in a run of approximately 5 km or a Nordic Walking march along the same route. The event is charitable and coordinated by the „Biegnij Oławo” Association of Active People and the Oława Municipal Office. The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30, and the start is scheduled for the same day. The event is supported by local partners, and timing is provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl.

name: Dziki Trail
description: Dziki Groń is a demanding mountain course in the Pieniny Ultra-Trail® series, following hiking and courier routes as well as the pastures of the Little Pieniny Mountains. The race offers scenic views of the Tatras and the Beskid Mountains, with the start and finish at Dietl Square in Szczawnica. The course is intended for experienced mountain runners looking to take on challenging natural terrain. The event is part of the Pieniny Ultra-Trail mountain running festival, which promotes an active lifestyle and the Pieniny region.

name: IV Charytatywny Bieg z Żonkilem
organizer: Zespół Szkół Ekonomicznych im. Gen. Stefana Roweckiego "Grota" w Opolu
description: The 4th Charity Daffodil Run is a sporting event organized by the Gen. Stefan Rowecki “Grot” School of Economics in Opole. The event will take place on June 14, 2026, on Bolko Island by the Laba Café. Participants can take part in a 5 km run, a 2.5 km Nordic walking event, or support the cause without participating. The run is a charity event that promotes physical activity and support for those in need.

name: Suszecki dziki bieg
description: Suszecki Dziki Bieg is a running event organized by the Suszec Municipal Sports Centre, promoting an active lifestyle among children, young people, and adults. The races will take place on June 13–14, 2026, at the Gwaruś Recreation Centre in Suszec. Participants can compete over 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon (21 km) distances, as well as in races for children and young people. Combined classifications over 5+21 km and 10+21 km, with prizes in kind, are available for the most determined runners. The friendly atmosphere welcomes both recreational and more experienced runners.

name: VIII Rodzinny Festiwal Biegowy o Złotą K...
description: The 8th Family Running Festival for the Golden K takes place in Dobczyce and is organized by the Rozbiegane Dobczyce group, which has brought together runners from Dobczyce and the surrounding area since 2016. This family running event promotes physical activity and the integration of the local community. The festival welcomes all participants, regardless of age or experience level.

name: Maraton Smolecki
location: Smolec, Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Mrowna Run Grodzisk łączy w biegu
X. Sopron Trail 5 / 10 / 25
organizer: Sopron Város Polgármesteri Hivatal Sportfelügyeleti Csoportja, SMAFC Tájfutó Szakosztálya, SMAFC Tájfutó Sportjáért Alapítvány, Sopron-Trail
description: The Sopron Trail 2026 trail running race will take place on June 14, 2026, in the scenic surroundings of Sopron-Brennbergbánya. The race aims to promote trail running and showcase the wild landscapes of the Sopron Hills. Participants can choose from several distances, including 5.9 km, 10.7 km, and 25.9 km. One of the distances is part of the Alpokalja Terepkirály running series. The race also offers a special extra challenge on a timed uphill section, where the fastest male and female runners will receive special prizes. The race center is at the Brennbergbánya Cultural Center, where toilets and showers are available.

name: CROSSKOVÁCSI Dockyard Terepfutó verseny
description: The Crosskovácsi Dockyard Trail Running Race is a trail-running event offering a variety of distances in the scenic surroundings of Nagykovácsi, near Teleki-Tisza Castle. The race has four distances: mini (3 km), short (7 km), middle distance (13.5 km), and mountain half marathon (21.7 km). Each begins with a 1 km opening loop in the castle park. The courses cross varied terrain with significant elevation gain, and refreshments are available at aid stations. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. The race uses electronic timing, and the organizers pay particular attention to runner safety and medical care.

name: Unicredit Pražská štafeta RunCzech
organizer: Prague International Marathon, spol. s r.o. (RunCzech)
description: The UniCredit Prague Relay is a traditional relay race organized as part of the RunCzech series and held at Prague Exhibition Grounds. The race gives teams the opportunity to compete in different relay categories and is known for its friendly atmosphere and professional organization. The organizers emphasize fair conditions and support for the running community in Prague and throughout the Czech Republic. The race is part of the wider RunCzech running events calendar, which also includes marathons and half marathons.
course_highlights: Relay race at Prague Exhibition Grounds
Various relay categories, including special categories
Professional organization with support from experienced pacers
additional: The race pack contains everything runners need. Photography is provided by witisi.photo; photos can be pre-ordered during registration or ordered after the race. Relay categories have a dedicated lane marked with RELAY and 2RUN flags. The organizers recommend using the RunCzech mobile app for better navigation and information during the race. The Prague Relay 2027 takes place from June 22 to 24; the specific date listed for this race is June 22, 2027.

name: Kros Otakara Pachmanna
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Otakar Pachmann Cross-Country Race is a 4.4 km race through the beautiful natural surroundings of Krčský les in Prague 4. It is part of the SABZO series and gives runners the chance to enjoy natural terrain and a woodland atmosphere. It is suitable for anyone who enjoys running in nature and wants a sporting challenge in peaceful woodland surroundings.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Center for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. The event takes place in the evening and combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It is a long-standing tradition that attracts participants who want to spend time outdoors in a sporting atmosphere. The event is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix and is held regularly, promoting a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Bolechowo, in the Czerwonak municipality.
The previous recorded edition covered a distance of 5 km.
The event is part of the Active Czerwonak at Night series.
additional: The event is free and takes place in the evening, usually between 19:30 and 22:00. This recurring sporting event is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees, or required equipment.

name: 401. Malá cena Monaka
location: Restaurace Monako, Slatiňany, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Small Monaco Cup is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race is part of the long-standing history of running events organized by the KRB Chrudim club and gives athletes the opportunity to test themselves on interesting courses. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to experience a high-quality sporting event in pleasant surroundings.

name: Běh olympijského dne
description: The Olympic Run is a traditional sporting event organized by the Czech Olympic Committee. It takes place as part of Olympic Day on June 17, 2026, in Zlín.
