The run brings together different generations and levels of runners, from children to adults, and promotes Olympic values such as friendship, fair play, and respect. Participants can choose from shorter and longer routes, and the race is accompanied by sports and educational activities. Entry fees support children’s participation in sports through the Czech Olympic Foundation. The event is open to everyone who wants to enjoy being active and support a good cause.

name: Olympijský běh - Zlín
description: The Olympic Run in Zlín is a traditional sporting event held at the Youth Stadium. The race offers a classic five-kilometre course on a tartan track for adults, as well as several shorter children’s races. The event supports sports activities for children from socially disadvantaged families, with part of the entry fee donated to the Czech Olympic Foundation. Registration takes place online, and the race starts at 18:00, with the start broadcast on Czech Radio.

name: Olympijský běh - Bakov nad Jizerou
location: Bakov nad Jizerou, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Olympic Run in Bakov nad Jizerou is a traditional race featuring a flat loop that runs partly along a dirt track and a meadow beside the Jizera River, with the final section on an inline skating track. The race is open to adults and children, with children’s races over 500 and 1,000 metres. The 5 km adult race starts at 18:00 and is held under the auspices of Czech Radio. Participants contribute to the Czech Olympic Foundation through their entry fees. Online registration is open until 5 June 2026; registration will not be available on site.

name: Olympijský běh - Bedřichov
description: The Olympic Run in Bedřichov is the largest running event in the Czech Republic and kicks off Olympic Day celebrations at more than 90 locations across the country. The race takes place in the picturesque Jizera Mountains, on a 5 km course. The main category starts at 18:00 by the stadium in Bedřichov. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to celebrate the spirit of sport and Olympic values.

name: Olympijský běh - Brloh
description: The Olympic Run in Brloh is a popular regional running race held on June 17, 2026. It is open to a wide range of ages, from children to seniors, and offers courses for both adults and children. The adult course is 5 km long and runs through the picturesque village along a stream, with a turnaround point by an oak tree. Children’s races take place on the track around the football field. The event is part of Olympic Day and supports the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Brno
description: The Olympic Run in Brno is a Gold Race taking place on June 17, 2026, on the meadow by the Komec sports complex in Brno-Komárov. The race offers 5 km and 10 km courses for adults, as well as 400 m and 800 m children’s races by age category. The event is part of the Olympic Day celebrations and features a sports program. The main race starts at 18:00 and will be started live on Czech Radio. Registration is available online only until June 5, 2026, and part of the entry fee goes to the Czech Olympic Foundation. Chip timing, a changing room, baggage storage, and toilets are available for participants.

name: Olympijský běh - Budyně nad Ohří
description: The Olympic Run in Budyně nad Ohří is a traditional sporting event held at the T.J. Sokol Budyně nad Ohří tennis courts. The 5.8 km main race runs across fields, through a small forest and over a gentle hill, on a mix of asphalt, field tracks and forest paths. Children can take part in 400 m and 1,000 m races in the safe surroundings of the tennis courts. The event is part of Olympic Day, which promotes sporting values and friendship, and also supports the Czech Olympic Foundation in helping children take part in sport.

name: Olympijský běh - Bystřice pod Hostýnem
location: Městský park Zahájené, Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: The Olympic Run in Bystřice pod Hostýnem is a new addition to the running calendar. It takes place in the picturesque Zahájené town park, which combines nature with an urban atmosphere. The route is mostly on firm park paths, with short sections of slightly unpaved surface, and is suitable for experienced runners as well as families with children. During the race, participants can enjoy greenery, mature trees and peaceful parts of the park, with no significant elevation changes. The event is both a sporting and social gathering, with an accompanying program, refreshments and opportunities to cheer along the course. The entry fee supports the Czech Olympic Foundation, which helps children take part in sport.

name: Olympijský běh - Čelákovice
description: The Olympic Run in Čelákovice is a traditional running race, with its fifth edition taking place in 2026. The event offers two adult distances, 5 km and 10 km, on flat terrain along the Elbe River, with beautiful views and points of interest including the railway bridge, the Chapel of St. Wenceslas, and the courtyard of the Municipal Museum. Shorter children’s races from 200 m to 1,500 m are also available and pass through the Municipal Museum. The start and finish are on the athletics track at the Čelákovice Municipal Stadium. Online registration is open until June 5, 2026, and the main race starts at 18:00.

name: Olympijský běh - Červená Lhota
description: The Olympic Run in Červená Lhota is a traditional race that starts by the fairytale-like Červená Lhota Castle. Runners follow the blue hiking trail through the villages of Samosoly and Pohoří and across the dam of Kardaš Pond, mostly along field and forest paths. The race is ceremonially started with a shot from a historic weapon, and by taking part you support the Czech Olympic Foundation. The race is for adults over 15 and offers a pleasant sporting atmosphere, with refreshments provided by volunteer firefighters.

name: Olympijský běh - Červené Pečky
description: The Olympic Run in Červené Pečky is a new location in the Kolín area, offering a course suitable for beginners too. The adult main race is 4.5 km long and runs 90% over easy terrain around the football pitch and a small local wood, with the remaining 10% on asphalt. Shorter courses adapted to children’s age and ability are available. The event is part of Olympic Day and supports the Czech Olympic Foundation; part of the entry fee goes towards supporting children’s participation in sport.

name: Olympijský běh - Česká Lípa
description: The Olympic Run in Česká Lípa is a newcomer to the running map, centered around the renovated U Ploučnice municipal stadium. Runners head towards Holý vrch, the town’s western landmark, then return along the Ploučnice River to the stadium, where the start and finish are located. The event is open to adults and children, with several shorter races for children. The main race starts at 18:00, and online registration is open until 5 June 2026. By taking part, you contribute to the Czech Olympic Foundation, which supports children’s participation in sport.

name: Olympijský běh - Česká Skalice
description: The Olympic Run in Česká Skalice is part of the nationwide Olympic Day event, which celebrates sport and Olympic values such as friendship, fair play, and respect. The race offers routes for adults and children, and every participant contributes part of their entry fee to support children’s sports. The event is open to everyone, regardless of ability, and is an ideal opportunity to enjoy being active together in the beautiful Hradec Králové Region. The Olympic Run brings people and sports together for a day full of sporting activities and Olympic spirit.

name: Olympijský běh - České Budějovice
description: The Olympic Run in České Budějovice is a traditional race for fans of challenging terrain. The 7 km route crosses the U Špačků ford, follows the right bank of the Malše River to Roudné, and returns to the boathouse. The race is open to adults and children, with a separate 1.5 km route for the children’s races. Participants’ entry fees support the Czech Olympic Foundation. The main race starts at 18:00 by the Hanace boathouse in České Budějovice.

name: Olympijský běh - Dačice
description: The Olympic Run in Dačice is a traditional sporting event held in the beautiful grounds of the Dačice State Chateau park. The race follows a route mainly along forest and field paths, suitable for adults and children. The event also features an accompanying program, with the option to visit the chateau and the town museum. Participants’ entry fees support the Czech Olympic Foundation, which encourages children to take part in sport.

name: Olympijský běh - Děčín
description: The Olympic Run in Děčín is a traditional regional race held at the confluence of the Elbe and Ploučnice rivers. The start and finish are located in front of the Kajak Děčín boathouse. The 4.6 km main race route follows a cycle path almost through the city centre, with asphalt and paved surfaces. The event also includes children’s races over distances from 200 to 1,000 metres. Participants can enjoy the beautiful surroundings, with views of Děčín Castle, the Elbe Canyon and lookout towers, while also supporting the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Dřevěnice
description: The Olympic Run in Dřevěnice is a traditional regional running race with a course of approximately five kilometres. It starts with a challenging climb into the forest above the Dolánky part of the municipality, then heads to a pond, where the course continues on flat asphalt roads, crossing the main road. The finish is at the volleyball courts, which have full facilities. The race is suitable for adults and children, with shorter children’s races ranging from 50 to 1,200 metres. The race starts at 18:00, and registration is available online only until 5 June 2026.

name: Olympijský běh - Háj ve Slezsku
description: The Olympic Run in Háj ve Slezsku is part of the nationwide Olympic Day, which celebrates sport and Olympic values. The event offers courses for adults and children, including a shorter 4 km and a longer 8 km course for adults, as well as children’s races ranging from 60 to 1,000 metres. The start is at the school sports grounds of ZŠ Háj ve Slezsku, and the event has a welcoming atmosphere, with the opportunity to donate to the Czech Olympic Foundation. Registration is online, and the event is suitable for the general public, who can enjoy a route through the village and around the athletics track.

name: Olympijský běh - Havířov
description: The Olympic Run in Havířov is part of the country’s largest running event, which kicks off Olympic Day celebrations at more than 90 locations across the Czech Republic. The race takes place on June 17, 2026, and offers a 5 km course in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The main category starts at 18:00 by the Na Vyhlídce non-alcoholic bar in Havířov. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to celebrate the sporting day with a run.

name: Olympijský běh - Hluboké Mašůvky
description: The Olympic Run in Hluboké Mašůvky is part of the nationwide Olympic Day, which celebrates sport and Olympic values such as friendship, fair play and respect. The event offers a 5 km adult race and children’s races of 100, 200 and 300 metres. The start is at the football pitch in Hluboké Mašůvky. The main race begins at 18:00 and is started live on Český rozhlas. Participants make a contribution to the Czech Olympic Foundation, which supports children’s participation in sport. Toilets, a changing room, a baggage storage area and showers are available, and children can enjoy a bouncy castle.

name: Olympijský běh - Holešov
description: The Olympic Run in Holešov is the country’s largest running event, kicking off Olympic Day celebrations at more than 90 locations across the Czech Republic. The race takes place in the beautiful setting of the château gardens in Holešov and offers a mixed 5 km race. The main category starts at 18:00, making it an enjoyable evening run for the general public and athletes alike. The event is part of the broader running movement of the Czech Athletics Federation, which promotes running and a healthy lifestyle.

name: Olympijský běh - Holetín
description: The Olympic Run in Holetín returns after a break with a varied route along roads, paved paths, meadows and field trails. The race is open to adults and children, and by taking part you contribute to the Czech Olympic Foundation. The start and registration are at the Holetín swimming pool complex, which also has basic amenities. The race starts at 18:00, announced on Czech Radio, and online registration is available until 5 June 2026.

name: Olympijský běh - Horní Jelení
description: The Olympic Run in Horní Jelení is a traditional running race with a beautiful route through the local forest and around Pětinoha Pond. It offers races for adults and children, including a 6 km race for adults and shorter 2.5 km and 500 m races for children in different age categories. The race takes place at Komenského Square and starts at 18:00. The atmosphere is friendly, and the event supports the Czech Olympic Foundation. Registration is online, and the race is timed using chip timing.

name: Olympijský běh - Horoměřice
description: The Olympic Run in Horoměřice offers a 7 km running course completed in two laps. The route is mostly dirt and gravel, with sections of paving stones and concrete slabs. Two-thirds of each lap run gently downhill, while the final third challenges runners with an uphill stretch. Horoměřice is hosting the Olympic Run for the sixth time, and part of the entry fee is donated to the Czech Olympic Foundation. The race is suitable for adults and children, with shorter 500 m and 1,000 m races for children.

name: Olympijský běh - Hradec Králové
description: The Olympic Run in Hradec Králové is the country’s largest running event, kicking off Olympic Day celebrations at more than 90 locations across the Czech Republic. The race takes place on 17 June 2026, starting at 18:00 near ZŠ Štefánikova, and features a 5 km course. The event is open to the general public and runners of all abilities who want to celebrate this sporting day by running. It is organized by a team of organizers under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation.

name: Olympijský běh - Hudčice
description: The Olympic Run in Hudčice is a traditional regional race held on a loop around the village, along paved and dirt roads, including a climb to the quarries above the village. There are also children’s races over 200 and 700 metres. The event is open to all age groups and supports the Czech Olympic Foundation. The main race starts at 18:00, and registration is online only until 5 June 2026.

name: Olympijský běh - Chlumec nad Cidlinou
description: The Olympic Run in Chlumec nad Cidlinou is a traditional regional race held on the athletics track by Slavíček Hall. The route follows paved and dirt roads, starting and finishing at the stadium. The race is part of the Olympic Day celebrations, and participants’ entry fees support the Czech Olympic Foundation’s work promoting children’s participation in sport. Alongside the main race for adults, there is also a children’s race, making it possible for the whole family and sports enthusiasts of all ages to take part.

name: Olympijský běh - Chomutov
description: The Olympic Run in Chomutov takes place in the picturesque Bezruč Valley, where the pleasant climate and shade provide ideal conditions for achieving great results. The race features out-and-back road routes with a gentle climb to the turnarounds, rewarding runners in the second half of the race. Both shorter and longer routes are available: 10 km and 5 km, respectively. The event is suitable for the general public and supports the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Chotiměř
description: The Olympic Run in Chotiměř is part of the country’s largest running event, which kicks off Olympic Day celebrations at more than 90 locations across the Czech Republic. The race takes place on June 17, 2026, and features a 6 km mixed-surface course starting at the municipal office in Chotiměř. The main category starts at 18:00. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to celebrate the day through running.

name: Olympijský běh - Ivančice
description: The Olympic Run in Ivančice is part of a nationwide celebration of Olympic Day, bringing together athletes of all ages. The adult race runs mostly on sandy terrain along the Jihlava and Rokytná rivers, with natural landmarks at U Šneka and U Dvou bobrů. Children’s races take place on the athletics track, which is also the start and finish venue for the adult races. By taking part, you contribute to the Czech Olympic Foundation, which supports children’s participation in sport. The main race starts at 18:00 at the Ivančice Municipal Stadium.

name: Olympijský běh - Jihlava
location: Letní kino athletic oval, Jihlava, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: The Olympic Run in Jihlava traditionally takes place at the summer cinema venue and athletics track, offering a family-friendly atmosphere full of support and the joy of movement. The race is open to all age groups, with courses for adults and children on mixed terrain. Participants’ entry fees support the Czech Olympic Foundation, which helps children take part in sports. The main race starts at 18:00, and the event is part of the wider Olympic Day, celebrating sport and Olympic values.

name: Olympijský běh - Kamenice
description: The Olympic Run in Kamenice is a traditional regional race that has been held since 2016 in the picturesque Vysočina region. The race offers moderately challenging routes on unpaved paths and asphalt roads around three Kamenice ponds, with a choice of a shorter 2.5 km loop or a longer 5 km loop. Special routes of varying lengths are prepared for children according to age categories. Participants support the Czech Olympic Foundation through their entry fees, helping to promote sports among children. The main race starts at 18:00, and registration is online only until 5 June 2026.

name: Olympijský běh - Karviná
description: The Olympic Run in Karviná is a traditional race starting in the historic T. G. Masaryk Square in Karviná-Fryštát. The route passes the Larisch family chateau and through the chateau park, then heads to the city’s landmark, the Darkov Bridge, before returning via the Spa Park to the finish. The race is open to adults and children up to 15 years old, with shorter courses for the children’s races. The event supports the Czech Olympic Foundation and offers a friendly atmosphere, an accompanying programme, and the opportunity for athletes with disabilities to participate in wheelchairs (handbikes).

name: Olympijský běh - Klášterec nad Orlicí
description: The Olympic Run in Klášterec nad Orlicí is part of the country’s largest running event, which kicks off Olympic Day celebrations at more than 90 locations across the Czech Republic. The race takes place on the asphalt court by the Sokol Hall and offers 10 km and 5 km courses. The main category starts at 18:00, and the race is suitable for the general public as well as athletes. It is organized by a team of organizers in cooperation with the Czech Athletics Federation.

name: Olympijský běh - Kolín
description: The Olympic Run in Kolín is a traditional sporting event being held for the fourth time as part of the Czech Olympic Committee’s nationwide Olympic Day event. The races take place in the picturesque Borky Forest Park, with two routes: 3 km for adults and 1 km for children. The routes follow forest paths and a cycle path along the Elbe, offering beautiful views and a pleasant running surface. There’s a bouncy castle for children and a photo booth for all participants. The atmosphere is full of sporting spirit and camaraderie. The start and finish are by the bears in Borky Forest Park.

name: Olympijský běh - Kralice nad Oslavou
description: The Olympic Run in Kralice nad Oslavou is a regional running race on a 4 km route along a dirt track and partly on an asphalt road. The race is open to adults and children, with children’s races ranging from 250 to 800 metres. The start is by the football pitch, and the main race begins at 18:00, launched on air by Czech Radio. Participants’ entry fees go to the Czech Olympic Foundation. Registration is online only, until 5 June 2026; registration will not be available on site.

name: Olympijský běh - Krymlov
description: The Olympic Run in Krymlov is a traditional regional race held to celebrate Olympic Day. The event offers a 6.5 km course for adults, as well as children’s races of 200 m and 800 m. The start and registration are in the center of the village by Krymlovská hospoda, where refreshments are available before and after the race. Part of the entry fee is donated to the Czech Olympic Foundation, supporting sports development.

name: Olympijský běh - Liberec
description: The Olympic Run in Liberec is a traditional sporting event held at the Sport Park Liberec complex on the inline skating track around the athletics stadium. It offers races for children and adults, with distances from 150 metres up to 6 km, suitable for the general public, including wheelchair users and handbike riders. The main race starts at 18:00. Registration is online only, with the option to register multiple runners at once. The programme also includes a group warm-up and facilities with toilets, changing rooms, showers and a baggage storage area. The entry fee supports the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Líbeznice
description: The Olympic Run in Líbeznice is a new addition to this traditional sporting event, which brings together runners of all ages. The races take place at Areál zdraví, which offers modern sports facilities in the peaceful, leafy surroundings of the village, known for its interesting architectural features. The routes follow asphalt, paved and unpaved paths through the village and surrounding area, including the Mratínka trail, which was created from a former railway spur. The event is not only a sporting occasion but also an opportunity to support the Czech Olympic Foundation and enjoy a friendly atmosphere and the joy of movement.

name: Olympijský běh - Lovosice
description: The Olympic Run in Lovosice is part of the country’s largest running event, which kicks off Olympic Day celebrations at 90 locations across the Czech Republic. The race takes place at the athletics stadium in Lovosice and offers 8 km and 4 km courses. The main category starts at 18:00, and the race is open to runners of all abilities and sports enthusiasts. It is organized by a team of organizers under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation.

name: Olympijský běh - Mělník
description: The Olympic Run in Mělník is a traditional race held amid the picturesque natural landscape of the Elbe Lowlands, around the Elbe River and Na Polabí Park. The children’s races take place on unpaved paths in the park, while adults run along a paved asphalt cycle path with no elevation gain. The event is suitable for the general public and supports the Czech Olympic Foundation. The main race starts at 18:00, and registration is online only until June 5, 2026.

name: Olympijský běh - Město Touškov
description: The Olympic Run in Město Touškov is a traditional regional race that passes through the town’s historic centre, by the Baroque Church of St. John the Baptist and the Touškov pond. The course combines grass and asphalt surfaces and offers an enjoyable run through picturesque surroundings. The race is open to adults and children, with several course distances, and also supports the Czech Olympic Foundation. The start and registration are at the TJ Sokol sports complex. The main race starts at 18:00 and is started live on Czech Radio.

name: Olympijský běh - Most
description: The Olympic Run in Most takes place in the Matylda recreation area and offers two routes for adults—a shorter 4 km and a longer 8 km course—along the paved inline skating path around Lake Matylda. The race starts at 18:00 and is started live on Český rozhlas radio. Participants’ entry fees support the Czech Olympic Foundation. Registration is online only until June 6; registration will not be available on site. Showers, toilets, a changing room and a baggage storage facility are available for runners. Parking is available in the Matylda area.

name: Olympijský běh - Olomouc
organizer: Český olympijský výbor a Klub vytrvalostních sportů Olomouc
description: The Olympic Run in Olomouc is part of the T-Mobile Olympic Run and offers a bronze-level race with a charitable dimension. The event takes place in Olomouc-Hejčín and includes a 5 km adult race and free children’s races for children up to 15 years old. The race starts at 6 p.m., with the start broadcast on Czech Radio. The entry fee includes a race pack with a sports bag and gifts from partners, and part of the fee goes to support the Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Opava Suché Lazce
description: The Olympic Run in Opava-Suché Lazce is the country’s largest running event, kicking off Olympic Day celebrations at more than 90 locations across the Czech Republic. The race covers a 5 km course and is open to the general public and sports enthusiasts alike. It starts at the municipal football pitch at 18:00, and the event has a friendly, motivating atmosphere for all runners. It is organized by a team of organizers under the auspices of the Czech Athletic Federation.

name: Olympijský běh - Ostrava Hošťálkovice
description: The Olympic Run in Ostrava-Hošťálkovice is a traditional running race on paved paths over rolling terrain. It offers two routes for adults—a longer 10 km route and a shorter 5 km route—with the start at the sports complex by ZŠ Výhledy-Hošťálkovice. Children may also take part with permission from a legal guardian, and the event contributes to the Czech Olympic Foundation. The main race starts at 18:00 and is started live on Czech Radio. Toilets, changing rooms, showers, and parking are available by MŠ Výhledy.

name: Olympijský běh - Ostrava Komenského sady
location: Komenského sady, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Olympic Run in Ostrava’s Komenský Gardens is a traditional sporting event held in a beautiful park along the Ostravice River. The race offers routes for adults and children. The main race starts at 18:00 and is broadcast on Czech Radio. By taking part, participants contribute to the Czech Olympic Foundation, which supports children’s participation in sport. Registration is online, and the race is suitable for the general public, including wheelchair users and handbikes.

name: Olympijský běh - Ostrov u Karlových Varů
description: The Olympic Run in Ostrov near Karlovy Vary is part of Olympic Day, which celebrates sport and Olympic values. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of the castle park and follows a sandy path. Participants can run the 5 km course, and online registration is open until 5 June 2026. The main race starts at 18:00, and the event is suitable for the general public, including children accompanied by an adult.

name: Olympijský běh - Palkovice
description: The Olympic Run in Palkovice is a traditional regional race held in beautiful surroundings, with a combination of paved roads, forest paths and terrain. The adult course is approximately 5,100 metres long and includes a hill, adding interest and challenge to the race. Children can take part in races over 200 m, 400 m and 1,600 m, making it an event for the whole family. The event is also an opportunity to support the Czech Olympic Foundation and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in the community. The start and registration are behind the gym in Palkovice; the main race starts at 18:00.

name: Olympijský běh - Pardubice
description: The Olympic Run in Pardubice is a traditional race held in the Studánka forest park. The 3.8 km course runs mainly along forest paths with some asphalt sections and is suitable for beginners thanks to its mostly flat terrain with a few climbs. The event also includes 1.1 km children’s races. Participants make a contribution to the Czech Olympic Foundation, and can choose to register with or without a T-shirt.

name: Olympijský běh - Pelhřimov
description: The Olympic Run in Pelhřimov is a traditional running race held in a picturesque town on the edge of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands. The race offers courses for children and adults, including a longer 7.2 km route and a shorter 4.8 km route, which run through the town parks and surrounding area. The start is at the Senior Citizens’ Home on Radětínská Street, and the race supports the Czech Olympic Foundation. Online registration is available, with the option to sign up multiple runners at once. Pelhřimov is also known for its historic landmarks and Festival of Records and Curiosities, giving the race a unique atmosphere.

name: Olympijský běh - Praha Královka
description: The Olympic Run in Prague – Královka is part of the nationwide celebration of Olympic Day, bringing together sports enthusiasts of all ages. The race offers adult runners a challenging 3.8 km course that runs mainly on paved paths through the park, with some unpaved sections, including stairs and uneven terrain. Shorter distances of 350 m, 550 m and 1,100 m are available for children. By taking part, you contribute to the Czech Olympic Foundation, which supports children with limited financial means in pursuing sport. The main race starts at 18:00. Registration is online only and is open until 5 June 2026.

name: Olympijský běh - Praha Satalice
description: The Olympic Run in Prague-Satalice is a 5 km race that runs mainly along forest trails in the Satalice Game Reserve, a chestnut-lined avenue, and gravel paths in the forest park. The route is flat and offers runners a pleasant setting, with views over fields and a course that passes the Chapel of St. Anne. A warm-up is provided before the start, and motivational announcements are made during the race. After the race, refreshments, showers, changing rooms, and a bag storage area are available, all in a friendly atmosphere. Part of the entry fee is donated to the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Rožnov pod Radhoštěm
description: The Olympic Run in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm is part of the largest running event in the Czech Republic, which is being held for the 40th year. On race day, June 17, sports enthusiasts of all ages can enjoy running and other physical activities. The event is also open to sports clubs and associations, which can organize their own Olympic Day. Registration is available only online on the official website until June 5, with the best entry fee for adults available until the end of March.

name: Olympijský běh - Rychnov nad Kněžnou
description: The Olympic Run in Rychnov nad Kněžnou is returning to the running calendar after a long break and invites all runners to celebrate Olympic Day through movement. The main adult race is 5 km long and starts at the swimming pool complex in Včelné. Children can take part in races from 200 m to 1,500 m, depending on their age category. The event also offers an accompanying program, the chance to try SPARTAN obstacles, and facilities including a bag drop, toilets, and showers. Registration is online, with the option to sign up multiple runners at once, and the entry fee contributes to the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Strakonice
description: The Olympic Run in Strakonice is a traditional sporting event being held for the third time at the Podskalí campsite. The race offers routes for adults and children, with adults running 4 km on a mix of natural and paved paths. Children can take part in races of 350 m and 1.2 km, accompanied by an Olympic-themed programme. The main race starts at 18:00, and part of the entry fee goes to the Czech Olympic Foundation. The event is suitable for all age groups and promotes the joy of movement and a good cause.

name: Olympijský běh - Stříbro
description: The Olympic Run in Stříbro is a traditional running race that takes place mostly along forest paths and supports Olympic ideals and the Czech Olympic Foundation. The program includes a 5 km race for adults and children’s races of 600 and 1,000 metres. The event is held at the TJ Baník Stříbro stadium and offers a pleasant sporting environment, with online registration available. The main race starts at 18:00. Participants have access to changing rooms, toilets, showers and storage. The race is also open to athletes with disabilities using wheelchairs (handbikes).

name: Olympijský běh - Tachov
description: The Olympic Run in Tachov gives runners the chance to take on a mixed course combining natural and asphalt sections along the Mže River. The race is open to both children aged 15 and under and adults, with a capacity of 100 adult and 100 child participants. The start and registration are at the Tachov Sports Complex – Rychta. The main race starts at 18:00 and is started live on Czech Radio. Registration is online only until June 7; on-site registration will not be available. By purchasing an entry, you contribute CZK 20 to the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Tlučeň
description: The Olympic Run in Tlučeň offers a run along forest trails through the České středohoří hills, around Plešivec, with approximately 180 metres of elevation gain—one of the highest elevation gains among Olympic Runs. The route is shaded and is open to adults and children, with shorter courses for the children’s races. The event is part of Olympic Day and supports the Czech Olympic Foundation. The main race starts at 18:00, and the accompanying programme includes, for example, an aikido demonstration. Online registration is open until 5 June 2026; registration will not be available on site.

name: Olympijský běh - Trutnov
description: After last year’s debut, the Olympic Run in Trutnov returns for its second edition. The race offers a 5 km route with mixed terrain, starting at the athletics stadium and passing the swimming pool before following forest paths along the Poříčský Ridge, with the finish back at the stadium. Children’s races of 100 to 800 metres will take place in the stadium grounds. The event is not only a sporting challenge but also an opportunity to support a good cause, as part of the entry fee goes to the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Tuhaň
description: The Olympic Run in Tuhan is a traditional race held in the beautiful Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area. The route runs mainly through forests and meadows, with part of it on an asphalt road, offering a pleasant running experience in nature. The event also includes children’s races on the football pitch, making it suitable for the whole family. The main race starts at 18:00, and the event is also an opportunity to support the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Ústí nad Labem
description: The Olympic Run in Ústí nad Labem is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Lake Milada. The race offers routes for adults and children, with a choice of shorter or longer routes for adults. The start is near the car park above Lake Milada’s main beach, and the route follows the water before climbing gently to the finish. Part of the entry fee is donated to the Czech Olympic Foundation to support children’s participation in sport. The race is suitable for the general public who want to enjoy being active and support a good cause.

name: Olympijský běh - Valašské Klobouky
description: The Olympic Run in Valašské Klobouky is a traditional sporting event held in the beautiful, hilly landscape of the White Carpathians. The race offers two main routes for adults—a 5-kilometre and a 10-kilometre course—run mostly on asphalt. Children’s races are also held in the enclosed area of the football pitch. The start is at the TJ Spartak Valašské Klobouky football pitch, and participants make a donation to the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Vnorovy
description: The Olympic Run in Vnorovy is a traditional regional race on a 6.5 km course along local roads, field tracks and forest paths. Part of the route runs between the Morava River and the Baťa Canal, including a crossing over the Baťa Canal lock. The start and finish are on the athletics track at the Vnorovy sports complex. The race is open to adults and children, with shorter children’s races ranging from 100 to 1,000 metres. Participants make a contribution to the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Lelekovice
description: The Olympic Run in Lelekovice is a traditional race held on Olympic Day. The routes run mostly along field and forest paths, with gently rolling terrain and a steep climb before the finish. The main race is 5 km and is suitable for adults and children, while the children’s races cover shorter distances of 150 to 1,060 metres. After the race, prizes are awarded not only to the winners but also to runners selected by draw and older participants, followed by a get-together around a fire with music and the option to roast food. Online registration is open until 5 June 2026, and the main race starts at 18:00.

name: Komořany – Čihadlo
description: Komořany - Čihadlo is a 4.88 km running race with 175 metres of elevation gain, held entirely on forest and field paths. The finish is at the summit of Čihadlo. The race is part of the Hill Running Series in Prague and the surrounding area, offering runners an enjoyable experience in a natural setting on a more challenging course.

name: Běh okolo Špilberku
description: The Run Around Špilberk is a traditional running race in Brno, featuring an interesting course around Špilberk Castle. The race is open to men, women, and children of all ages and takes place in the pleasant early evening. Men run five 1.3 km laps, women run three laps, and the lap length for children is adjusted according to age. Refreshments and a baggage drop-off are available after the race. The affordable entry fee is 150 CZK, and registration takes place at the venue before the race.

name: Radimovický koňák
description: Radimovický koňák is a traditional cross-country race held in the village of Radimovice u Želče, attracting runners of all ages every year. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of South Bohemia and offers everyone from the youngest children to adult men, who make up the largest category, the chance to test their strength. The event has a long-standing tradition and is a popular sporting occasion in the region.

name: Krakonosova stovka
description: Krakonošova stovka is a traditional long-distance hike with a history dating back to 1966. The 100 km route crosses the challenging mountain terrain of the Krkonoše Mountains, with over 3,000 metres of elevation gain. It starts and finishes in Vrchlabí and passes notable places such as Špindlerův Mlýn, Sněžka and Pec pod Sněžkou. In addition to the main K100 route, shorter options are available: K50, K25 and the B25 running route. The event is for endurance hikers and runners who want to experience the beauty of the Krkonoše Mountains within a challenging 24-hour time limit.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain terrain with over 3,000 m of elevation gain
The route passes through Špindlerův Mlýn, Sněžka and Pec pod Sněžkou
Start and finish in Vrchlabí
additional: UMARA isotonic drinks are available at selected checkpoints. UMARA sports nutrition can be purchased before the start. Parking is limited due to a road closure; participants are advised to use the designated car parks and not obstruct traffic. According to the official website, registration for the 2027 edition is expected to open on 1 February 2027. Information on the price, time limit and refreshments available for K100 applies to the 2026 edition.

name: Běh metropole MČ Praha 14 - Večerní běh
description: The Běh metropole MČ Praha 14 - Evening Run is part of the BĚH METROPOLE series of public running races, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and a sense of belonging among Prague residents to their city district. The race takes place in Kejřův Park and offers a pleasant evening-running atmosphere, with the opportunity to represent your district. The start is scheduled for the evening, adding to the unique experience of running in an urban setting. The organizers emphasize competition and community spirit among participants of all ages.

name: Okolo Rudného
description: Okolo Rudného is a running race in the Vysočina region offering two distances: 8.2 km for men and 4.2 km for women. The route follows unpaved forest roads and trails, providing a pleasant running experience in nature. The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup and is suitable for runners looking for a trail run with a gentle profile. Okolo Rudného is a traditional race that attracts runners from the region and surrounding areas.

name: Nocny Bieg Firmowy Warszawa
description: The Night Corporate Run in Warsaw is a charity relay for five-person company teams, taking place on June 19, 2026, at Służewiec Racecourse. Each participant covers approximately 5 km after dark, and the team’s combined time determines the result. It’s a unique opportunity to spend an evening in an engaging nighttime atmosphere while supporting children from the Everest Foundation. The event combines sport, fun, and social support to create an unforgettable experience for participants.

name: 17 Legionowska Dycha
description: The 17th Legionowo Ten is an annual 10 km race taking place on June 19, 2026, in Legionowo. The start and finish are located outside Arena Legionowo. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and is intended for adults and people over 16 who meet the rules and regulations. The event also includes an accompanying race, “Uniformed Services Ten,” for uniformed services personnel and enthusiasts. Participants can expect electronic timing and a time limit of 1 hour and 40 minutes to complete the course.

name: Stacjonarne DaVita Run Kraków
description: The in-person DaVita Run Kraków 2026 is a charity race held in Kraków that promotes a healthy, active lifestyle and brings together nephrology professionals, patients, and running enthusiasts. Participants can choose between a 2.5 km or 5 km distance, with 60 minutes to complete the race. The entry fee is donated in full to the Polish Association Moje Nerki, and every participant receives a T-shirt featuring the event’s original design. For those unable to attend in person, a virtual race option is also available from June 18 to 22, 2026.

name: Beh Ludrovskou dolinou
organizer: Obec Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, Ružomberskie Strely o.z.
description: Beh Ludrovskou dolinou je bežecké podujatie organizované v Ludrovskej doline pri futbalovom štadióne v Ludrovej. Preteky ponúkajú štart pre detské kategórie na tráve a pre dospelých kategórie na lesnej ceste a asfalte. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú vekovú škálu bežcov od detí až po seniorov, s kategóriami rozdelenými podľa veku. Organizátormi sú Obec Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová a Ružomberskie Strely o.z., ktorí zabezpečujú príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu.

name: Prešov Running Series 2. kolo
description: Prešov Running Series 2. kolo, známy ako Šariš Run, je bežecká udalosť konaná na brehu Rybníkov vo Veľkom Šariši pod historickým hradom Šariš. Táto lokalita je novinkou v sérii a získala si veľkú obľubu medzi bežcami. Podujatie je plné športového ducha, komunity a lásky k prírode, pričom ponúka aj bohatý sprievodný program vrátane hudobných vystúpení, zdravotných stánkov, relaxačnej zóny a aktivít pre deti. Atmosféra je priateľská a rodinná, čo robí z behu nezabudnuteľný zážitok pre všetkých účastníkov.

name: Beh cez Zalužické poľa
location: Zalužice, okr. Michalovce, Zalužice, okr. Michalovce,
description: Beh cez Zalužické poľa je druhý ročník bežeckého podujatia, ktoré sa uskutoční 20. júna 2026 v lokalite Zalužice. Tento beh ponúka bežcom možnosť zažiť prírodu a krásy Zemplína v letnom období. Podujatie je súčasťou série Zemplínsky extrém, ktorá prináša rôzne bežecké výzvy v regióne.

name: toRunská vrtuľa
location: Stará Turá, Stará Turá, ATC Dubník (KEMP53 - reštaurácia)
organizer: Zuzana Jankovičová, Lívia Skurská, Monika Tomisová
description: toRunská vrtuľa je charitatívny bežecký a komunitný deň v krásnom prostredí vodnej nádrže Dubník v Starej Turej. Podujatie je zamerané na pohyb a pomoc, pričom všetky vyzbierané prostriedky zo štartovného sú venované na rehabilitácie dievčatka Simonky Zigovej. Bežecké dvojice majú 8 hodín na to, aby zabehli čo najviac okruhov okolo Dubníka, pričom atmosféra je priateľská a podporujúca. Organizátorky a dobrovoľníci zabezpečujú podujatie bez nároku na honorár, čím zdôrazňujú komunitný a charitatívny rozmer akcie.

name: Ruskovská deviatka
location: Športový areál, Nový Ruskov, Trebišov District, Slovakia

name: Tatry charity run
location: Tatranská Lomnica, Tatranská Lomnica, Relax Park Jazierko
organizer: Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, mesto Vysoké Tatry, TANAP
description: Tatry Charity Run je bežecké podujatie organizované v Tatranskej Lomnici, v Relax Parku Jazierko. Trať vedie prevažne po asfaltovom a spevnenom teréne, čo zabezpečuje pohodlný beh pre všetkých účastníkov. Pretek je určený širokej verejnosti a ponúka kategórie pre mužov a ženy rôznych vekových skupín. Organizátormi sú Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, mesto Vysoké Tatry a TANAP, ktorí zabezpečujú kvalitný priebeh podujatia. Registrácia je možná online s limitom 300 bežcov, pričom je k dispozícii aj registrácia na mieste v deň štartu.

name: Beh k Iliašovskej kapličke
description: Beh k Iliašovskej kapličke je bežecké podujatie konané v Iliašovciach na futbalovom ihrisku FK56. Preteky ponúkajú dve hlavné trate s dĺžkami 5,6 km a 10,8 km, ktoré vedú prevažne po poľných a lesných cestách. Štart pretekov je o 10:00 hodine pre hlavnú kategóriu a o 13:00 hodine pre deti. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú vekovú kategóriu bežcov, vrátane detí, a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru v prírode.

name: Doby vežu – extrémny prekážkový beh a trail
location: Brezno, Brezno, Lidl Brezno, Československej Armády 2612/68
description: Doby vežu je extrémny prekážkový beh a trail, ktorý sa koná v Brezne na Slovensku. Pretekári sa musia popasovať s náročnými prekážkami a zdolať trasu vedúcu na vrchol druhej najvyššej vyhliadkovej veže na Slovensku s výškou 40 metrov, odkiaľ sú krásne výhľady. Trať vedie prevažne lesnými chodníkmi, lúkami a potokom s minimom asfaltu a obsahuje strmé stúpania a zbehy. Okrem športového zážitku je pripravený aj sprievodný program plný zábavy pre všetky vekové kategórie. Organizátorom je M.Š.K Jašterice Brezno o.z., riaditeľom pretekov Marek Janoštiak.

name: Velíšskej přespolňák
description: Velíšskej přespolňák is a cross-country race for experienced runners, enthusiasts, and amateurs, held in the picturesque Podblanicko region. The race offers two routes, 10 km and 5.2 km long, running mainly along field and forest paths for an enjoyable running experience in nature. This race is ideal for anyone who wants to enjoy running in a clean environment while testing their abilities against other runners. Velíšskej přespolňák is a traditional event that attracts a wide running community.

name: Prague Park Race – Divoká Šárka
description: Prague Park Race – Divoká Šárka is a running race taking place on June 20, 2026, amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6. The race offers a unique atmosphere and breathtaking views for runners to enjoy on routes of 8 and 14 kilometres. The routes follow paved and unpaved roads, meadows and trails, as well as some asphalt roads with limited traffic. The race is suitable for the general public and offers refreshments along the course and at the finish. The start and registration take place at the SK ARITMA grounds in Prague-Vokovice, which are easily accessible by public transport and by car.

name: Krosový běh Chudenickým Žďárem
location: Chudenice, sportovní areál Jalovčí, hřiště pod Bolfánkem, Plzeňský
description: The Run through Chudenice’s Žďár is a young cross-country race founded in 2016. It takes place amid the picturesque autumn scenery of Žďár Hill above the village of Chudenice. The course is a challenging cross-country run with no asphalt sections, a gently undulating profile, and an appealing climb up the forest steps to Bolfánek. The start and finish are located at the local sports club grounds. The main race is 6.2 km long and offers runners both a challenge and beautiful natural scenery.

name: Příborský běh
organizer: město Příbor, Atletický klub Emila Zátopka Kopřivnice
description: The Příbor Run is a traditional running race organized by the town of Příbor in cooperation with the Scout troop and the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice. The race is open to both competitive runners and recreational runners, who can choose a distance to suit their abilities. The options include a 4.6 km recreational race, a 9.2 km competitive race, and relays made up of four runners (2 men + 2 women), with each runner completing a 2.3 km lap. There are also children’s races over various distances. The race has a friendly atmosphere and supports the region’s broad running community.

name: Běh Jana Opletala
description: The In the Footsteps of Jan Opletal Run and Jiří Vacek Memorial is a traditional running event organised by the Jan Opletal Grammar School in Litovel. The race commemorates notable figures and the history of the school and town. It takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Litovel region and is suitable for the general public looking to enjoy a sporting experience with a historical dimension.

name: Běh okolo Vraní skály
description: The Run Around Vraní Skála is a traditional running race held in Černín near Zdice, featuring a challenging course approximately 9 km long. The race combines a steep uphill road section, forest trails and narrow paths leading to the summit around Vraní Skála, followed by a rolling, mostly downhill section with a steep descent to the finish. The race starts in the square in Černín near Zdice, and the main race begins at 10:30. It is part of the Brdy Running Cup and is suitable for runners who enjoy a combination of road and trail running with significant elevation gain.

name: Běh na Kozlovský kopec
description: The Kozlovský kopec Run is a traditional road hill race in Česká Třebová, taking place on 20 June 2026. The race starts at 10:00 on Habrmanova Street, in front of the Secondary Vocational School building, and finishes at Max Švabinský Cottage on Kozlovský kopec. The 5.2 km course climbs 230 metres on asphalt and is among the more challenging races in the regional ISCAREX Cup series and the Czech Hill Running Cup. Race facilities are in the school building, where registration, changing rooms and toilets are available. You can register online in advance for a reduced entry fee or on race day.

name: Běh Memoriálu Petry Hézlové - MPH 2026 Louny
description: The Petra Hézlová Memorial is a charity sporting event held in Louny, offering running races for adults and children. The main race features 5 km and 10 km courses for men, women, and students, timed using chip timing. The event is part of a family sports afternoon and offers a varied programme of activities alongside the races. All participants receive a wooden commemorative medal, and there is a prize draw for a LIFEFIT.PRO treadmill. The memorial supports health and social projects, especially oncology.

name: Krakonošova pětadvacítka - B25
description: Krakonošova pětadvacítka (B25) is a 25-kilometer trail run held in Vrchlabí and part of the Krakonošova stovka race series. The course crosses mountainous terrain with approximately 903 meters of elevation gain and offers challenging conditions suited to experienced runners. The event takes place every June and attracts participants from across the Czech Republic who want to enjoy the beauty of the Krkonoše Mountains and the challenge of a mountain run.

name: FarmaRun
description: FarmaRun 2026 is a family sports event organized by the Libchavští chlupáči animal sanctuary farm in Horní Libchava. The race offers a main 5 km run along a pleasantly shaded, flat cycle path, suitable for both runners and walkers. Children can take part in a short 300 m run, and there is an exhibition race for the youngest children, aged 4 and under, right on the farm grounds. After the race, participants receive a commemorative medal, a refreshing drink, and light refreshments. There is also an accompanying program for the whole family.

name: Velíšskej přespolňák
description: Velíšskej přespolňák is a traditional cross-country race with a long history, held in Louny in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race is open to all age groups and offers a range of distances, from children’s races to the men’s 7,800-metre event. The Lucky Náprstková Memorial commemorates a tragic event and is part of this sporting event. The organizer is the Czech Union of Sport, which encourages the general public to stay active and participate in sport.

name: Revírní POHO běh
description: The Revírní poho běh project is a unique running race for adults and children alike, set amid the breathtaking natural surroundings of the Karviná Sea. Inspired by the region’s mining history, it makes use of the potential of the post-mining landscape and its revitalized environment. Its aim is to introduce this unique place to the public and to athletes. With the motto “Run in POHO!”, the race offers routes for everyone and the joy of movement.
additional: Also featured: a 4 × 6 km relay race, children’s races, and a health festival

name: Drabina Wałbrzyska
description: The Wałbrzych Ladder is a physically demanding mountain route in the Sudetes, passing through the Wałbrzych and Kamienne Mountains. Over a distance of approximately 78 km, participants climb nearly 4,000 metres of elevation gain and summit more than 30 peaks. The route forms a loop, and the start and finish can be at any point along the course. It is an excellent choice for anyone wishing to discover the scenic and natural attractions of this part of the Sudetes, offering an ambitious challenge without having to travel to high mountains.

name: XII BIEG WIERCHAMI
description: Bieg Wierchami is a mountain ultramarathon held in the scenic Beskid Sądecki, covering 100 km with significant elevation gain. The route follows a variety of mountain trails, offering runners a top-level challenge and beautiful views. The race starts in the courtyard of Ryter Castle, and the course features numerous aid stations and landmarks such as the Łabowska Hala Mountain Hut and Żłobki Pass. This event is for experienced trail runners who value a tough challenge and a close connection with nature.

name: 16. PKO Rybnicki Półmaraton Księżycowy
description: The Rybnik Moonlight Half Marathon is an annual running event organized by MOSiR Rybnik, attracting runners from various regions. The half-marathon course runs through the scenic areas of Rybnik, offering participants a unique sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere of competition. The event is open to all and is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the running community together.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course runs through the charming areas of Rybnik
Organized under the auspices of MOSiR Rybnik, with a long-standing tradition
An atmosphere welcoming to both recreational and experienced runners

name: I Nocny Półmaraton Piaseczyńśki
description: The Piaseczno Night Half Marathon is a unique street race held at night along the scenic, illuminated streets of Piaseczno. The 21.0975 km course is flat and fast, making it ideal for setting personal bests. Participants can expect professional organisation, certified timekeeping, well-stocked refreshment stations and comprehensive medical support. After the race, every finisher receives a commemorative medal, and a recovery area with drinks and a meal awaits at the finish. It’s an unforgettable experience under the stars in a nighttime atmosphere.

name: Mistrzostwa Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie w Biegach Przełajowych. Bieg 4: Kąty Wrocławskie
location: Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 2026 Kąty Wrocławskie Municipality Cross-Country Running Championships are a series of four races held in scenic locations across the municipality, including Krobielowice, Zachowice, Sadowice, and Kąty Wrocławskie. The courses showcase varied terrain and the natural beauty of the Bystrzyca Valley Landscape Park. Participants can enter individual races or the entire series; after completing three races, they are included in the overall standings. Each race ends with the presentation of a commemorative medal. When all four medals are collected, they form a visually cohesive whole featuring the outline of the municipality’s boundaries.

name: ULTRA TURNICKI
description: Ultra Turnicki is a unique running festival taking place on June 20, 2026, in Huwniki in the Przemyśl Foothills. The event offers summer courses of 10, 24, 48, and 75 km, winding through scenic forests, meadows, and mountain pastures, and combining sporting competition with the rich cultural dimension of the Wianki festival. The race is for runners seeking adventure and a connection with nature, away from crowded mountain trails. The organizers ensure participants’ comfort by providing transport, refreshment points, and accommodation options nearby.

name: Wieczorna Piątka
description: Wieczorna Piątka is a 5,000-meter race taking place on June 13, 2026, at the Municipal Stadium in Maków Mazowiecki. The event is held on a tartan track, with the start scheduled for 18:00. The race is divided into heats according to participants’ predicted times, allowing for smooth organization and competition at an appropriate level. The organizer is Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki, and the participant limit is 200. All runners over the age of 15 are invited to take part in this sporting event.

name: 43 Strzeliński Rogaining
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is an on-foot orienteering event organized by the PTTK Strzelin District Branch since 1996. With a long-standing tradition, it welcomes participants of different ages and experience levels. Teams of 2–5 plan their own routes, aiming to visit as many checkpoints as possible within the allotted time. Checkpoints have different point values, and participants travel on foot using only a map and compass. The event combines tourism and sport, making it appealing to enthusiasts, recreational participants, and families alike. It takes place in the picturesque Strzelin Hills, with routes ranging from a few to several dozen kilometers.

name: VI Bieg Świętojański
description: The 6th St. John’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place on June 20, 2026, in Zawichost. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic, moderately challenging course. The organizers encourage runners to prepare with training plans tailored to different experience levels, with support from experts. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes running and a healthy lifestyle.

name: VIII Nocny Bieg
description: The 8th Open Academic Championships of Łomża in Night Street Running is an annual sporting event organized by Łomża Academy under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Łomża. The race takes place on June 20, 2026, at 9:00 p.m. on the streets of Łomża, with two course options: 10 km, certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), and 5 km, uncertified. The event commemorates the founding of Łomża Academy and promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants must be at least 18 years old, and the time limit for completing the course is 1.5 hours.

name: XII Półmaraton Wierchami
description: The 12th Wierchami Half Marathon is a mountain race held in the picturesque Sącz Beskids, near Rytro. The half-marathon route follows challenging mountain trails and features numerous aid stations, offering participants beautiful views and a true off-road challenge. The event is organized by the Visegrad Marathon Association, which looks after runners’ comfort and safety. It’s a great opportunity for mountain-running enthusiasts to test themselves on a tough but scenic course.

name: Zielonka Challenge
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: ZIELONKA CHALLENGE is an individual long-distance running event and Nordic walking race held in the picturesque Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The event offers distances ranging from approximately a quarter marathon to an ultramarathon, along forest roads, tracks and ravines among nature reserves and lakes. It is known for its excellent organization, well-stocked aid stations, and unique atmosphere of sporting competition and camaraderie. The event center is in Owińska near Poznań, and the finish is at the bathing area. The event will take place on June 20, 2026.

name: Wrocławska Dycha
description: Wrocławska Dycha is an annual running event held in Wrocław, offering 5 km and 10 km distances. The race attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, providing a sporting atmosphere and the opportunity to compete on the city’s scenic routes. The event is a great way to spend time actively and bring Wrocław’s running community together.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes in central Wrocław
Scenic urban views
A welcoming atmosphere for runners of all experience levels

name: X Bieg Pamięci Powstań Śląskich
location: Góra Świętej Anny, Leśnica, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

name: I. Szentivánéji Futótűz 5 / 10 / 21
description: The 1st Midsummer Night Running Fire is a night running festival in Balatonszárszó, at Tóparti Park, held on Midsummer’s Eve. Participants can choose from several distances, including a half marathon, shorter races, and an evening walk along the shore of Lake Balaton. The event celebrates the start of the summer season and welcomes families and community sports enthusiasts as well as runners. The race is part of the Ötpróba program, which offers the opportunity to collect points for valuable rewards.

name: SZENT LÁSZLÓ TEREPFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The Szent László Trail Run is a traditional trail-running race in the Gerecse Mountains, near Baj, organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. The race is held in honor of Saint Ladislaus, the patron saint of the infantry and artillery branches. It has been held regularly since 2010, with just one cancellation, in 2013, due to flooding. Runners can test their strength on varied terrain, including forest trails and rolling hills. This friendly community event is recommended for anyone interested in outdoor activities and sport.

name: BALATON BAJNOKSÁG
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 km, 24 km, 12 km, 5 km, 5 km

name: Grobský Runfest
location: Chorvátsky Grob – Čierna Voda, Chorvátsky Grob – Čierna Voda, Areál za MŠ a ZŠ Javorová Alej
organizer: SBT Spid.com, s.r.o., Susedský Hi o.z., PavúčikSport Team o.z., obec Chorvátsky Grob
description: Grobský Runfest je dvojdňový športový festival v Chorvátskom Grobe, ktorý spája profesionálnych športovcov aj rekreačných nadšencov všetkých vekových kategórií. Ponúka bežecké trate rôznych dĺžok, detské behy, cyklistické preteky a bohatý kultúrno-zábavný program vrátane food zóny a hudobných vystúpení. Podujatie podporuje komunitu a zdravý životný štýl v príjemnom prostredí s rôznorodými aktivitami pre všetkých návštevníkov.

name: Tvrďák – Bratislava
description: Tvrďák Bratislava je najväčší slovenský prekážkový pretek, ktorý sa koná v areáli Divoká Voda v Čunove. Pretekári prekonávajú viac ako 20 prekážok na trati približne 5 km, pričom môžu súťažiť v rôznych režimoch vrátane nesúťažného fitness režimu alebo časového merania. Po preteku si účastníci môžu oddýchnuť pri bazéne, vychutnať si občerstvenie a sledovať silové súťaže. Pretek je vhodný aj pre deti od 8 do 14 rokov a ponúka medailu, fotky a video z preteku ako spomienku na zážitok.

name: Behu ulicami mesta Veľký Krtíš
location: Veľký Krtíš, Veľký Krtíš, Veľký Krtíš
description: Behu ulicami mesta Veľký Krtíš je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný Občianskym združením Bežci VK, ktorý ponúka rôzne kategórie vrátane detí, hobby bežcov a Nordic Walking. Preteky sa konajú v meste Veľký Krtíš a zahŕňajú trate od 3 000 m až po hlavný pretek 11 000 m. Štart je rozdelený na deti o 09:45 a hlavnú kategóriu spolu s Nordic Walking o 11:00. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka zľavy pre seniorov nad 60 rokov.

name: Moldavský pohár Bodvy
location: Moldava nad Bodvou, Moldava nad Bodvou, Hlavné námestie
description: Moldavský pohár Bodvy je medzinárodný cestný beh, cyklistika a inline preteky, ktoré sa konajú v Moldave nad Bodvou. Preteky ponúkajú rôzne kategórie pre bežcov, cyklistov a kolieskové korčule, s trasami vedúcimi cez okolitú prírodu a obce. Podujatie je známe svojou tradíciou a kvalitnou organizáciou, pričom štart a cieľ sú na Hlavnom námestí v Moldave nad Bodvou. Súčasťou je aj masový beh pre zdravie, ktorý umožňuje účasť širokej verejnosti.

name: Běhej lesy Týmovka - týmový závod
description: Běhej lesy Týmovka is a unique team relay running race held in the heart of the Vysočina region, offering an adventure for teams of 4 to 8 runners. The race consists of three different loops with a total distance of approximately 27.5 km, which each runner must complete over the weekend. The race also takes place at night with headlamps, adding to its uniqueness and challenge. In addition to the race, a rich programme of sports activities, cultural events and workshops is planned, while the facilities include a comfortable campsite with sanitary facilities and refreshments.

name: Velichovská sedmička
description: Velichovská sedmička is a friendly family running race held in the village of Velichovky, offering a main 7 km course along forest trails and local roads. The race is open to all age groups, including children, and encourages active leisure time in nature. The event is part of the Primátor Cup series and is ideal for sports enthusiasts and families looking for a shared sporting activity. It takes place on the last Saturday in June, with the option to take part in other shorter routes and children’s categories.

name: ČEZ RunTour Plzeň
description: ČEZ RunTour Plzeň is a family-friendly running event with a joyful, relaxed atmosphere, suitable for both recreational and elite runners. It offers a range of distances, from children’s races to 3, 5 and 10 km runs and a half marathon. The race takes place in the centre of Plzeň and is part of a series of events held throughout the Czech Republic. Participants can enjoy not only the race but also a family-friendly entertainment programme and high-quality service from start to finish.

name: Dobratický běh
description: The Dobratice Run is a traditional running race in the picturesque village of Dobratice, attracting sports enthusiasts of all ages. The race offers beautiful routes through nature and scenic surroundings, suitable for both experienced runners and families with children. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, themed categories, and valuable prizes for winners and participants. Each year brings a new theme, giving the race a unique atmosphere and adding to the joy of running.

name: Hamelika třikrát jinak
description: Hamelika Three Ways is a running race organized by Pro Sport Activities at the Hamelika site near Mariánské Lázně. The race is part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series and the Plzeň Region Running Cup, offering a sporting experience for the general public. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels, with an emphasis on a welcoming setting and a sporting atmosphere. Pro Sport Activities has a long tradition of organizing running races and looks forward to welcoming participants in 2026.

name: Sunrise Marathon / Halfmaraton
description: The Sunrise Marathon and Half Marathon take place on June 21, 2026, at Olympia Brno, Modřice. The race starts early in the morning at 4:46 so runners can experience the magical atmosphere of sunrise during the run. The course is flat and consists of five equal-length laps, running partly through nature and partly along shaded sections. The organizers provide electronic timing and support at key points along the course. The race is suitable for all runners who want to welcome summer actively and enjoy a unique running experience at dawn.

name: Hradecký kros
description: Hradecký kros is a traditional 10 km trail race held in the forests around Biřička in Hradec Králové. The race offers a unique experience on natural terrain with fewer asphalt sections, making it suitable for the general public and recreational runners alike. The event is part of the East Bohemia Running Grand Prix and attracts runners of all levels every year. The course consists of two 5 km laps over mildly undulating terrain, highlighting the race’s beauty and challenge.

name: Ivčin kopeček
description: Ivčin kopeček is a 3.4 km uphill race with 240 metres of elevation gain, part of the Běhy do kopců series in Prague and the surrounding area. The race offers runners a challenging yet appealing course in the beautiful natural surroundings of Beroun in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for fans of mountain running and uphill running who want to test their endurance and strength on a short but intense route. The race is open to the public and welcomes all runners looking to enjoy a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Perly Malopolski Wapienne Magura
location: Wapienne, Sękowa, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg Lotnej Kompanii Szturmowej
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Wypoczynku w Haczowie oraz Urząd Gminy w Haczowie
description: The 8th “Lotna” Run in Haczów is an annual running event commemorating Lieutenant Stanisław Maczek’s Lotna Assault Company and the Heroes of Haczów who fought for Poland’s independence in 1918–1921. The event features courses of approximately 12 km and 5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking route, mostly on paved and gravel roads in the Haczów municipality. The run promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and local community integration. Free children’s races are also offered, with shorter distances suited to different age groups. The race office and event base are located in the Manor Park by the Municipal Centre of Culture and Recreation in Haczów.

name: Klon Biega i Chodzi Dla Zdrowia
description: Klon Runs and Walks for Health is a local initiative organized by the Association for the Development of the Village of Klon and Surrounding Areas. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and supporters of the region. The run and Nordic walking event take place in the scenic surroundings of Klon, making them ideal for recreation and community interaction. The event is open and welcoming to all age groups.

name: X Bieg STO-nogi
organizer: Społeczne Liceum Ogólnokształcące Nr 5 STO w Milanówku
description: The X STO-nogi Run in Milanówek is a traditional 10 km road race held in the picturesque town of Milanówek. The T-shaped course consists of two 5 km loops along the town’s streets, with turnarounds by the wayside shrine and Brzozowa Street. The start and finish are at Social General Secondary School No. 5, at 41 Herberta Street. The race is organized by running enthusiasts from the STO-nogi group, who promote running among residents and visitors.

name: X Ostródzki Półmaraton św. Jerzego
organizer: Grupa Ostródzkich Biegaczy „Ostróda Runners”, Klub Sportowy PLAY, Ostródzkie Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji
description: The 10th Ostróda St. George’s Half Marathon is the anniversary edition of the half marathon held in Ostróda. The course runs along the promenade by Lake Drwęckie and through the city streets, comprising two identical loops with a total distance of 21.098 km. The race starts and finishes at the Amphitheatre at 17a Mickiewicza Street, and hydration stations are located along the course approximately every 4 km. Organizers provide a commemorative medal, a voucher for a recovery meal, and the option to choose a race package with or without a T-shirt. The event is charitable and supports the rehabilitation of a girl named Maja.

name: XI Bieg Terenowy Zgierz Malinka
description: The 11th Zgierz Malinka Trail Run takes place in the wooded areas of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka. The course features varied surfaces, climbs and descents of different lengths and gradients, large sandy patches, and narrow sections through bushes. Its cross-country character attracts runners looking to get off the pavement or prepare for mountain races. The event offers three distances: 4, 8, and 12 km, as well as a 4 km Nordic walking event and races for children and young people. Participants receive symbolic medals inspired by raspberries, while the top women and men in each distance receive trophies.

name: Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna
description: Bieg Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna is an annual running event held in the scenic area of Deczno near Świecie. The main 10 km race runs through the Recreation and Leisure Centre grounds, offering participants an attractive course and sporting competition. The event also includes free children’s races, making it a family-friendly and inclusive occasion. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and race packages with T-shirts for early registrants. The main race is limited to 300 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.

name: XI Cienińska Szóstka
location: Cienin Zaborny, Słupca County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: IAU 6,12,24 ÓRÁS, 50 ÉS 100KM VERSENY
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 km, 50 km, Félmaraton, 16.6 km, 7.7 km, 3.75 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: Kros Sázava
description: Kros Sázava is a running race in Pikovice, Central Bohemian Region, offering three routes of varying distances and elevation gains. The longest route is 15.5 km with approximately 500 m of elevation gain, the medium route is 10 km with approximately 230 m, and the hobby route is 5 km with 120 m. All routes run exclusively through nature, offering beautiful and challenging running experiences. The race is suitable for runners of various levels who want to enjoy cross-country running in a picturesque setting.

name: V Charytatywny Bieg dla Dzieci Bohaterów Biegaj - Pomagaj
5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (7) – červnový
description: Come and run on a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava River in Prague’s Braník district, where personal records are often set! The race is part of the 16th edition of VAŠE LIGA’s regular 5 km and 10 km runs, held every month. The course has been measured by a certified measurer, and the 10 km race offers the chance to achieve the qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, you can review your performance and refuel at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex. We reward both the top runners and our loyal participants.

name: Herbatka u Tadka, czyli Bieg do Herbacia...
Běh Vídrholcem
description: The Vídrholec Run is a popular running race held in Prague 9-Klánovice. It is part of the local running calendar and attracts runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a picturesque setting. The event is held under the auspices of the Czech Running Association and the Czech Athletics Federation, and offers not only competition but also the joy of exercising in nature.

name: Excalibur Race MOON Zámek Duchcov
description: Excalibur Race MOON Duchcov Castle is an obstacle race taking place from June 26 to 28, 2026, in the historic grounds of the state-owned Duchcov Castle and its surroundings. Runners will follow in the footsteps of the legendary Giacomo Casanova and take on a fast course with beautiful views of the Ore Mountains, the Central Bohemian Uplands, and the foothills of the Bílina mine. The race features modern, certified obstacles on professional ALU structures, with an emphasis on safety and quality. The atmosphere is enhanced by a medieval-knight theme that connects the physical challenge with the values of honor, loyalty, and cooperation. A varied program and facilities, including refreshments and services, are available for runners and fans.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden of the Poznań University of Life Sciences. The event is part of a series of races organized since 2014 by a group of enthusiasts who focus on the beauty of the courses and promoting running. After the race, participants will receive unique medals, different from those awarded at the spring edition, making them worth collecting. It’s a special opportunity to run in beautiful surroundings and enjoy the atmosphere of the night.

name: Australijska Dyszka w Pszczelniku
description: Australijska Dyszka w Pszczelniku is a 10 km race taking place on June 26, 2026, in Siemianowice Śląskie, in Pszczelnik Park. The course consists of four laps, and all participants start together. After each lap, the 20 runners who took the longest to complete it are eliminated and receive a so-called “almost medal” at the finish. The final lap is run by the top competitors battling for the win. The race is open to people over the age of 16.

name: Biegaj z Duchami
description: Run with Ghosts is a unique night trail run taking place on June 26, 2026, in Leśniów. Participants will take on two courses, 15 km and 9 km long, full of dark corners and surprises that create a one-of-a-kind atmosphere filled with thrills. Runners are encouraged to dress up as spectres, ghosts, and other spooky characters, adding magic and atmosphere to the event. It is not just a race, but also a test of endurance and courage in the dark, where participants face their own weaknesses and mysterious figures along the course.

name: Malofatranská stovka
description: Malofatranská stovka je horský ultramaratón v pohorí Malej Fatry, ktorý ponúka náročné trasy s výraznými stúpaniami a klesaniami. Pretek je určený pre skúsených bežcov s výbornou fyzickou kondíciou a prechádza celým pohorím vrátane Krivánskej a Lúčanskej Fatry. Podujatie je registrovaným členom ITRA a slúži ako kvalifikačný pretek pre ďalšie prestížne ultratraily. Organizátorom je Slovak Ultra Trail v spolupráci s dobrovoľníkmi a partnermi.

name: Svätojánsky beh na Domaši
location: Domaša, Domaša, Domaša rekreačné stredisko Dobra , parkovisko pri Bogárke
description: Svätojánsky beh na Domaši je tradičný bežecký pretek konaný v rekreačnom stredisku Domaša Dobrá. Pretekári si môžu vybrať medzi dvoma traťami - krátkou 5 km a dlhou 13 km, ktoré vedú prevažne lesnými cestami a trailmi s rôznorodým prevýšením. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane kategórií podľa veku a pohlavia, pričom organizátori zabezpečujú občerstvovacie stanice, šatne, toalety a zdravotnú službu. Atmosféra je priateľská a športovo súťažná, s hodnotnými vecnými cenami pre víťazov.

name: Beh za zdravie – Záhorská Bystrica
location: Záhorská Bystrica, Záhorská Bystrica, pri BYS3T PARK-u, na ulici Ota Holúsku - Krče
description: Beh za zdravie v Záhorskej Bystrici je charitatívne bežecké podujatie, ktoré spája šport s podporou zdravia a komunity.
