Uskutoční sa 27. júna 2026 v BYS3T PARKu a ponúka príležitosť zažiť skvelú atmosféru a inšpiratívne príbehy, pričom každý účastník prispieva na dobrú vec. Podujatie je otvorené všetkým vekovým kategóriám a kondičným úrovniam, pričom podporuje zdravý životný štýl a pomoc znevýhodneným osobám. Beh za zdravie vznikol v roku 2023 a každoročne podporuje vybrané osoby alebo nadácie prostredníctvom pohybu.

name: Velvet Run Košice
location: Košice, Košice, pri Urbanovej veži na Hlavnej ulici.
organizer: Progres Promotion Košice, s.r.o., Maratónsky klub Košice
description: Velvet Run v Košiciach je bežecké podujatie, ktoré sa uskutoční 27. júna 2026 pri Urbanovej veži na Hlavnej ulici. Pretekárky si môžu vybrať z disciplín 5 km, 10 km a Velvet Nordic Walking na 5 km. Podujatie je určené výhradne pre ženy a ponúka hodnotné vecné ceny pre víťazky v rôznych kategóriách. Organizátori zabezpečujú meranie časov pomocou systému MyLaps a výsledky budú zverejnené na oficiálnych stránkach.

name: Čergovský umirak
location: Drienica, okr. Sabinov, Drienica, okr. Sabinov, Chata Ride pub
organizer: Marián Gargalovič, Ondrej Janiga, Slavomír Uličný
description: Čergovský umirak je horský beh v dĺžke približne 30 km s prevýšením okolo 1000 metrov, určený pre trénovaných bežcov. Pretek sa koná v rekreačnom stredisku Drienica, s možnosťou občerstvenia a doplnkových aktivít pre rodiny. Trať vedie značeným turistickým chodníkom a pretekári sú povinní mať štartovné číslo viditeľne pripevnené na hrudi. Bezpečnosť na trati zabezpečuje Horská služba Čergov, pričom každý účastník štartuje na vlastné riziko. Po dobehnutí posledných pretekárov je pripravené vyhodnotenie a odovzdávanie cien pre najlepších mužov a ženy.

name: Beh cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky – Memoriál Františka Hečka
location: Horné Orešany okr. Trnava, Horné Orešany okr. Trnava, futbalový štadión
organizer: Bežecký klub Viktoria, Obecný úrad Horné Orešany
description: Beh cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky - Memoriál Františka Hečka je bežecký pretek v Horných Orešanoch, ktorý ponúka trať dlhú 10 300 metrov s prevýšením 100 metrov. Povrch trate je kombináciou asfaltu a terénu v pomere 50:50, čo robí pretek zaujímavým a náročným. Pretek je otvorený pre všetky vekové kategórie, od detí od 1 roka až po seniorov, vrátane kategórií mužov, žien, juniorov a domácich bežcov. Organizátorom je Bežecký klub Viktoria spolu s Obecným úradom v Horných Orešanoch. Štart pre žiakov je o 15:35 a pre ostatných o 17:00 hod.

name: Rajec RunTour Bratislava
description: Rajec RunTour Bratislava je rodinný bežecký festival, ktorý ponúka trate pre všetky vekové kategórie a výkonnostné úrovne. Pretekári si môžu vybrať z tratí 3, 5 a 10 km, ako aj z detských behov na 500 a 1000 metrov. Podujatie sa koná v dvoch lokalitách a ponúka štartovací balíček so všetkým potrebným pre bežcov. Okrem samotného behu je pripravený bohatý sprievodný program, občerstvenie na trati aj v cieli, zdravotnícky a vodičský servis, a zázemie s možnosťou prezliekania a úschovne. Celý deň je ladený ako zážitok pre bežcov aj ich rodiny s tombolou a možnosťou rytia osobných údajov do medailí.

name: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina
location: Bachledová dolina, Bachledová dolina, Bachledka Ski & Sun
description: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina je trailový beh v nádhernej prírode Vysokých Tatier, ktorý ponúka bežcom jedinečný zážitok z behu na mäkkom povrchu s čerstvým horským vzduchom. Trasa vedie cez Chodník korunami stromov, Monkova dolina a hrebeň Spišskej Magury, pričom štart je zabezpečený lanovkou. Preteky sú súčasťou série Behaj lesmi, ktorá spája športový výkon s podporou miestnych rodín a charitatívnych príbehov. Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina je výzvou pre skúsených bežcov aj nováčikov, ktorí chcú zažiť horskú prírodu a nezabudnuteľné výhľady.

name: Skyrun Kubínska
location: Kubínska hoľa, Okres Dolný Kubín, Žilinský kraj
description: Skyrun Kubínska je horský beh v krásnej prírode Oravy, ktorý ponúka trať s dĺžkou 24 km a 11 km. Pretek je venovaný pamiatke Barnabáša Üvegeša a pretekári si môžu vychutnať náročný terén s výhľadmi na okolitú prírodu. Bežci zažijú kombináciu horských chodníkov a prírodných scenérií, ktoré robia z tohto podujatia výnimočný zážitok.

name: Běh týnišťskými pralesy
description: The Run through the Týniště Forests is a charity race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Týniště nad Orlicí, offering courses for different fitness levels and age groups. The race takes place in a forest, mainly on firm forest paths, with some paved sections. The event includes a free family run for children under 18 and main races of 6, 10 and 21 km. It brings sport, families and support for a good cause together, benefiting RENEDA, a nonprofit organization that helps children facing neurological challenges.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v dlouhém horském běhu
description: The World Masters Long Mountain Running Championships will take place on June 27, 2026, in the picturesque setting of Janské Lázně in the Hradec Králové Region. This race is intended for masters athletes and offers a challenging long mountain run that will test runners’ endurance and strength amid beautiful mountain scenery. The event is part of the prestigious trail-running calendar and attracts runners from around the world. For more information, we recommend checking the organization’s official website.

name: ROZKOŠný 1/2 Maraton
description: The ROZKOŠný 1/2 Marathon is a half marathon held in Česká Skalice, following a new cycle path around the Rozkoš Reservoir. The event offers a main 21.1 km race and an accompanying 2 km run for children and mothers with strollers. The event also features entertainment, refreshments, and the option of accommodation at the campsite, creating a pleasant atmosphere for participants and spectators alike. The main category starts at 12:30, and the first category starts at 10:00.

name: Běh lužanskými hvozdy
organizer: Obec Lužany, ELMAT Kůtek s.r.o., TJ Sokol Lužany
description: Běh lužanskými hvozdy is a traditional running race held in the recreational area of the village of Lužany near Jičín, specifically at the campsite by Marešák Pond. The 50th anniversary edition will take place on 27 June 2026 and offers a range of categories and race distances suitable for a wide variety of runners, including children. The race is supported by the Hradec Králové Region and organized by the Municipality of Lužany, ELMAT Kůtek s.r.o., and TJ Sokol Lužany. Participants can expect medals, prizes in kind, and cash awards for the top finishers in each category.

name: Žhavé běhy Slováckého léta
description: The Hot Runs of Slovácké léto are traditional running races held in the historic center of Uherské Hradiště. Participants can choose from three routes of 5, 10, and 21 kilometers, which pass through picturesque countryside along the Morava River, through Kunovský les forest park, and by the Novoveská lakes. The races are suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offer a unique opportunity to enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of Slovácko. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square, adding to the atmosphere of the city’s historic heart.

name: Supermaraton Gor Stolowych
description: The Table Mountains Supermarathon is a demanding mountain race held in the picturesque Table Mountains near Karłów. The route follows hiking trails and is technically challenging, with numerous rocks, turns, and significant elevation gain. Participants can expect changing conditions, including possible snow and ice, and are required to carry suitable equipment. The event is part of the Grand Prix DFBG mountain-running series and attracts fans of ultrarunning and mountain half-marathons.

name: Sudecka 100
description: Sudecka 100 is Poland’s oldest night ultramarathon, held in the mountain setting of Boguszów-Gorce. The race course is challenging and full of excitement, giving participants the chance to test themselves over the 100 km distance. In 2026, the organizers are introducing two new events: the Sudecki Morning Half Marathon, covering 21 km, and the Night Mountain Marathon, covering 42 km. The event attracts runners from across the country and offers generous race packages and numerous attractions, including personalized medals and aid stations along the course.

name: XIII Dycha Anny Wazówny
description: The 13th Anna Vasa 10K is a 10 km road race taking place in Brodnica. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness over a middle distance, and the organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The race is open and runner-friendly, offering expert support and the chance to take part in a sporting event in the picturesque Kuyavian-Pomeranian city.

name: 7 Maraton Pędziwiatra
organizer: Amatorski Klub Miłośników Biegania Pędziwiatr Gliwice
description: The 7th Pędziwiatr Marathon is organized by the Pędziwiatr Gliwice Amateur Running Club and will take place on June 27, 2026. Participants will complete 10 laps of a 4.2195 km loop, running mainly along sheltered park paths. The race is amateur in nature and dedicated to the memory of Marek Dworski. Individual, team, and relay classifications are planned. The race starts at 10:00, at the same time as the Gliwice Park Running Challenge.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026, organized by the Amatorski Klub Miłośników Biegania „Pędziwiatr”. The events aim to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation, with the motto “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!” The approximately 4.2 km route runs mainly along forest tracks and gravel paths, with a refreshment point at the start/finish. Events take place on Saturdays once a month, starting at 10:00, in the clearing behind Piast Stadium in Gliwice.

name: III Bieg w Sławicach
description: The 3rd Sławice Run is a 10 km road race taking place on June 27, 2026, in Sławice, Mazowieckie Voivodeship. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness over a middle distance in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers welcome both beginners and experienced runners.

name: X Lubeński Cross
description: The X Lubeński Cross is a mountain cross-country race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Lubenia municipality. The start and finish are at the market square in Lubenia. The main race routes are 13.8 km and 22.3 km long, crossing varied terrain: asphalt, paved roads and dirt trails, as well as 3 or 5 green hills. The race is challenging and offers beautiful views, creating a unique sporting celebration. Children’s and youth races are also held at the stadium, divided into age and gender categories.

name: XIII Bieg Cichociemnych
description: The 13th Cichociemni Run is a cross-country race held in Sochaczew in honor of the Polish heroes, the Cichociemni soldiers. The course is challenging, with numerous natural and artificial obstacles of varying difficulty that require participants to get wet, jump over obstacles, and crawl underneath them. Held once a year in June, the race attracts people who want to challenge their limits and aren’t afraid of mud. It’s a unique opportunity to explore the banks and riverbed of the Bzura River and feel the wind in your hair during a sporting competition.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing together runners from the region and beyond. The races take place on a permanent course familiar to participants, and the atmosphere is welcoming to both experienced runners and amateurs. The event attracts large groups of runners, Nordic walkers, and canicross participants, and entry is free. The organizers ensure the event is well run and support the growth of the local running community.

name: XXI Dziesiątka Unisławska
description: The 21st Unisław 10K is an annual 10 km race and Nordic walking event held in Unisław as part of the Unisław Days celebrations. The race route follows paved roads through the scenic Chełmno Landscape Park, passing through the towns of Unisław, Stablewice, and Gołoty. The race is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and is part of the 2026 Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running. All running and Nordic walking enthusiasts are welcome to take part in this sporting event.

name: XXVII Bieg Górski Żar
organizer: Urząd Gminy Czernichów i Stowarzyszenie Bajeczne Beskidy
description: The 27th Żar Mountain Run is a 10 km mountain race taking place on June 27, 2026, in Międzybrodzie Żywieckie. It is an excellent opportunity for mountain-running enthusiasts to take on a challenging course and test their fitness. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to different experience levels. The race combines sporting competition with the beauty of the mountain scenery.

name: 32. DECATHLON Futóest
description: The 32nd Decathlon Night Run is a special night race in the heart of Budapest, around the illuminated Heroes’ Square and along Andrássy Avenue. Runners can test their strength in the quarter marathon, half marathon, pairs, and trio events while enjoying the city’s magical nighttime atmosphere. Several thousand runners from towns and cities across the country take part, and every participant receives a unique finisher’s medal and a finisher’s pack. The race starts at 21:00 on the evening of June 27, 2026, giving runners the chance to experience running among the city lights.

name: KIPRUN FUTÓEST
description: The 32nd Decathlon Night Run is a special night race in the heart of Budapest, around illuminated Heroes’ Square and along Andrássy Avenue. Runners can enjoy the city’s magical atmosphere over quarter-marathon and half-marathon distances, where history and sport meet. Thousands of runners from towns across the country take part, and participants receive a unique finisher’s medal. The race is an ideal choice for anyone who wants to experience a summer night run at an iconic venue.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly running race with a voluntary entry fee, held in Dióskert. Runners can complete the half-marathon distance by running four laps, but they can also run fewer laps. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere. All participants are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine, and receive a commemorative medal. The top three male and female runners also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.

name: Holló a Kövön, Várfutás - Palóc TM Kupa
Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu – nahoru
location: Janské Lázně, Janské Lázně, nám. Svobody – kolonáda Janské Lázně
description: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu 2026 je prestižní mezinárodní závod veteránů v horském běhu, který se koná v malebném prostředí Janské Lázně. Závody nabízejí několik náročných tratí s výrazným převýšením, které prověří vytrvalost a sílu závodníků z více než 30 zemí. Pořadatelem je TJ Maratonstav Úpice pod patronací měst Janské Lázně a Úpice. Registrace je otevřena do 24. května 2026 a závodníci se mohou těšit na profesionální organizaci a podporu sponzorů.

name: Beh údolím Idy
description: Beh údolím Idy je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný Mestskou časťou Košice-Šaca a obcou Malá Ida. Pretek sa koná v príjemnom prostredí kultúrneho strediska v Košiciach-Šaci a ponúka možnosť súťažiť v rôznych vekových kategóriách. Štartovné je symbolické, pričom domáci pretekári majú štartovné zdarma. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a podporuje aktívny životný štýl v regióne.

name: Beh na Poludňový Grúň
location: Terchová okr. Žilina, Terchová okr. Žilina, Vrátna Paseky o 10,00 hod. na údolnej stanici štvorsedačky
organizer: Občianske združenie Grúň, Chata na Grúni
description: Beh na Poludňový Grúň je horský bežecký závod v malebnej Vrátnej doline, v pohorí Malej Fatry. Trať vedie cez náročný horský terén s krásnymi výhľadmi na vrcholy ako Poludňový Grúň, Stoh a Veľký Rozsutec. Pretek je ideálny pre milovníkov prírody a horského behu, ktorí chcú zažiť jedinečnú atmosféru a výzvu v srdci Malej Fatry. Organizátori vás srdečne pozývajú vychutnať si túto športovú udalosť v krásnom prostredí Terchovej.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu - nahoru
description: The 2026 World Masters Mountain Running Championships in Janské Lázně is a prestigious international mountain running event for masters athletes, attracting competitors from more than 30 countries. The races take place on challenging courses with significant elevation gain, testing runners’ endurance and strength. The event is organised by TJ Maratonstav Úpice under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. Registration is open until 24 May 2026, and the event offers several course options of varying distances and elevation gains.

name: Sloupský lesní běh
description: The Sloup Forest Run is a traditional road race held in the picturesque surroundings of Sloup in the Moravian Karst. The course is 11.5 kilometres long and is characterised by significant elevation gain, making it a challenging and appealing race for runners. The event has a long history and attracts runners from the surrounding area, who enjoy the beauty of nature and the sporting atmosphere.

name: Lochovice - Plešivec
description: Lochovice–Plešivec is a running race in the Brdy Running Cup, taking place on June 28, 2026, in Lochovice. The course is approximately 5.5 km long with 350 metres of elevation gain. It starts with 2 km on asphalt, then continues along forest paths, with a steeper climb around the 3 km mark. The finish is at the summit of Plešivec, which offers beautiful views. The event also includes children’s races and a family run supporting the Mezi břehy home hospice.

name: Půlmaratón okolo Nového Veselí
description: The Half Marathon Around Nové Veselí is a traditional running race organized by AO TJ Sokol Nové Veselí, now being held for the 25th year. The main 21.1 km race follows a turnaround loop repeated three times on asphalt paths and third-class roads, with minimal elevation gain. Shorter races are also available for youth, school-age children, and preschoolers, making the event appealing to runners of a wide range of ages. Refreshments are provided after the race, and the winner of the main race receives a cash prize. The start is traditionally on the square in Nové Veselí.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Potůčky
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in various locations, including Potůčky, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km and the experience route covers 20 to 30 km. In addition to running, walking routes and children’s races are also available. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers the chance to discover the beautiful nature of the Ore Mountains.

name: Wielka Pętla Izerska w ramach Izerskiego Weekendu Biegowego
location: Szklarska Poręba, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Great Jizera Loop is a scenic half marathon held as part of the Jizera Running Weekend in Szklarska Poręba. The course runs through the town streets and along trails in the Jizera Mountains, offering runners a chance to connect with nature and enjoy mountain scenery. The event combines recreation and sport, promoting physical activity and the popularity of running. Participants use electronic timekeeping, and the time limit for completing the course is 3 hours.

name: XVIII Bieg w pogoni za żubrem
description: The 15th Bieg w Pogoń za Żubrem is an annual running event held in Niepołomice, attracting runners to a range of distances. The event offers 8- and 15-kilometer courses as well as a children’s race, making it appealing to a wide range of participants. The route passes through scenic areas, combining sporting competition with the beauty of the surrounding nature. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and compete in a friendly atmosphere.

name: 5 Półmaraton Zbucki
additional: The start of the 5th Zbucki Half Marathon is scheduled for June 28, 2026, at 09:00 in Zbuczyn.

name: Izery Ultra-Trail
description: Izery Ultra-Trail is a unique mountain race held in the heart of the picturesque Izera Mountains, with the start and finish in Świeradów-Zdrój. Routes of varying lengths and difficulty levels lead through wild, lesser-known areas, offering runners unforgettable views and challenges. The event attracts both experienced ultramarathoners and trail enthusiasts looking to take on demanding terrain and enjoy the beauty of nature. The organizers provide full support at aid stations and require specific equipment, ensuring participants’ safety and comfort.

name: Kresowe Trail #7
description: Kresowe Trail is a small-scale, non-commercial trail running event held amid the scenic natural surroundings of eastern Poland and the Vilnius Region. The routes pass through pristine forests, varied climbs, sand and roots, offering challenges for both beginners and experienced runners. The race is held over two distances: the shorter Szpurt (approx. 7 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), which is an ultramarathon. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, respect for nature, and connections among runners from different backgrounds.

name: Roztoczański Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Roztocze Running Festival 2026 is one of the largest running events in the Roztocze region, organized by the Lubaczów Municipality. The three-day festival takes place in Basznia Dolna, at Kresowa Osada, the start and finish venue for all races and Nordic walking events. Participants can choose from ten different distances, ranging from night races and Nordic walking events to an ultramarathon and half marathon, on routes through the picturesque Lubaczów region. The event combines sporting competition with a festival atmosphere, attracting both experienced runners and amateurs.

name: Łabiszyński Bieg Świętojański
organizer: Łabiszyński Dom Kultury, Urząd Miejski w Łabiszynie, F.W. Martex, Uczniowski Klub Sportowy Łabiszynianka
description: The Łabiszyn St. John’s Eve Run is an annual running event taking place on June 28, 2026, at the Municipal Stadium in Łabiszyn. The main 5 km race starts at 10:00, followed by children’s and youth races in four age categories. Participants in the main race will receive a medal and a sweet snack, while younger runners will receive a medal and a surprise. The best runners will be presented with awards after the races. The event is part of a running series and offers starter packages to the first people to register.

name: 3 Otwarty Bieg Sejmowy o Puchar Marszałka
Bieg Powitania Lata
location: Strzelce Wielkie, Pajęczno County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków
description: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków is a cross-country race held in Reduta Park in Kraków, with 5 km and 10 km courses. The route runs mainly along trails and forest tracks, with one significant uphill section, combining sport with history. After the race, participants and their companions can take a guided tour of historic sites of the former Kraków Fortress, making the event a unique blend of physical activity and education. The race’s mission is to promote running and knowledge of local heritage.
course_highlights: Cross-country route along trails and forest tracks
One substantial uphill section
Guided tours of historic Kraków Fortress sites after the race
additional: After the race, participants can take a guided tour of sites of the former Kraków Fortress, including forts, earthworks, caverns, field batteries and shelters. The race route is off-road and green, with history in the background. Unique trophies made from 100-year-old bricks are awarded to the top competitors in each category. After the race, participants and their companions can also take a guided tour of sites of the former Kraków Fortress, including forts, earthworks, caverns, field batteries and shelters. Information about the edition scheduled for 27 June 2027 has not been confirmed in available sources.

name: V RUNda Żubra Biegi i Nordic Walking
Rácalmás Szigetfutás
description: The Rácalmás Island Run is a friendly trail-running event held in the scenic surroundings of Rácalmás, on the protected Nagy-sziget (Great Island) and along the banks of the Danube. The varied terrain features shady forest paths, panoramic views across farmland, riverside trails and paved sections, with minimal elevation gain. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and provide accessible sporting opportunities for all ages, whether running, walking or cycling. The event hub is the historic Jankovich Mansion, an ideal venue for the start and finish as well as the accompanying activities. Participants can look forward to unique medals and T-shirts, and the event offers a friendly atmosphere close to nature.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Boskovická etapa
description: MUM – the Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage race held in Boskovice and forms part of a seven-day ultramarathon covering seven marathons. The race is known for its difficulty and long tradition, attracting runners seeking the challenge of a stage race. The Boskovice stage gives runners the chance to experience the beauty of the Moravian countryside while testing their endurance on demanding terrain. The race is suitable for experienced ultramarathoners who want to compete against others in a prestigious international event.

name: 10. Ócsai Pincesorfutás Radics József emlékére 4 / 12 / 24
description: The Ócsa Wine Cellar Row Run in memory of József Radics is a community trail-running event that passes by the sights of the town of Ócsa. The race covers a 10.5 km distance, which can be repeated for the longer distances, with 21 km and 42 km also available. The run uses individual chip timing, and its aim is to bring sport and community together in honor of József Radics. The start and finish are in front of the Egressy Gábor Leisure Center, and the course includes a varied mix of paved and dirt routes.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červen
description: Tempo Makers Osmicka is a running race in Plzeň with an 8 km course. The race is open to men and women aged 16 and over. The start and finish are at the same location, with registration and race number collection from 17:00 to 17:45. After the race, the top runners are presented with awards and a raffle is held. The race is limited to 75 participants, and each participant takes part at their own risk.

name: Lachtan
location: Zoo Praha, U Trojského zámku 3/120, Prague 7, Prague, Czech Republic
description: In Prague 6, Prague, the sea lion is primarily associated with the breeding and conservation of the South African fur seal at Prague Zoo. A theater performance called “The White Sea Lion” is also held here, aimed mainly at children and school groups, and offering interactive experiences with an environmental theme. The program is suitable for families and schools looking to combine education with entertainment and raise awareness of nature conservation.

name: Kolem Libotína
description: The Run Around Libotín is a traditional race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletics Club Kopřivnice and held in the area around Štramberk. The race features a challenging 6.5 km loop whose course was modified in recent years, resulting in new course records. The event is part of the Lašská Running League and attracts runners in various categories, who enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings and sporting atmosphere. Category winners are announced after the race, and a raffle is prepared for all participants. The Emil Zátopek Athletics Club Kopřivnice organizes the event and ensures its smooth running while supporting the running community.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Lomnická etapa
location: Olešnice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: MUM – the Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage race held over seven consecutive days, with the Lomnice stage as one of its parts. It is one of the most demanding ultramarathons in the Czech Republic, challenging runners with long distances and demanding terrain in the South Moravian Region. The race is intended for experienced ultramarathon runners who want to test their endurance and strength in beautiful countryside. The Lomnice stage takes place around Olešnice and Lomnice near Tišnov and is part of the full ultramarathon series.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Bystřická etapa
description: MUM – Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage race consisting of seven marathons on seven consecutive days. The Bystřice stage is one part of the race, offering a challenging, long run in the picturesque surroundings of Moravia. The race is intended for experienced ultramarathoners seeking the challenge of long stages and beautiful nature. Come test your strength in this prestigious ultramarathon and experience the unique atmosphere of a stage race.

name: TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA – VISEGRÁD
description: TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA - VISEGRÁD is a 220 km trail relay race connecting the historic towns of Banská Štiavnica and Visegrád. The race consists of 18 stages that run through the Štiavnica Mountains and the Danube-Ipoly National Park, offering a wealth of natural and cultural attractions. Runners can compete in teams of various sizes or in individual categories, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. The race aims to connect the two royal towns and showcase the region’s natural and historical heritage.

name: Na hoľu
description: Na hoľu je ITRA certifikované podujatie vertikálneho kilometra, ktoré sa koná na Kráľovej holi v Horehroní. Bežci štartujú z námestia obce Šumiac a trasa vedie priamo po modrej turistickej značke na vrchol Kráľovej hole. Podujatie je nominačným pretekom na Skyrunning World Championships 2024 a ponúka kvalitné zabezpečenie vrátane občerstvenia a zdravotnej služby. Registrácia je otvorená do 1. júla 2026 s limitom účastníkov a štartovné zahŕňa upomienkový predmet a občerstvenie.

name: Špačinský trojuholník
location: Špačince, okr. Trnava, Špačince, okr. Trnava, Základná škola s materskou školou
organizer: Obec Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, Základná škola s materskou školou v Špačinciach, Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Špačince
description: Špačinský trojuholník je bežecký pretek organizovaný v obci Špačince v okrese Trnava. Pretek sa štartuje o 17:00 hodine v strede obce pri Základnej škole s materskou školou. Súťažia muži v absolútnom poradí bez rozdielu veku a ženy od 40 rokov. Organizátormi sú Obec Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, Základná škola s materskou školou v Špačinciach a JDS Špačince. Štartovné je 10 € s výnimkou obyvateľov obce, ktorí majú štartovné zdarma.

name: Trail Relay Banská Štiavnica – Visegrád – štafety
location: Banská Štiavnica, Banská Štiavnica, Atletická dráha
description: Trailová štafeta Banská Štiavnica - Vyšehrad je unikátny 220 km dlhý štafetový beh, ktorý spája dve historické kráľovské mestá cez prírodné krásy Štiavnických vrchov a Dunaj-Ipeľ Národného parku. Pretek je určený pre 3-členné, 4 až 8-členné a 6-členné tímy, pričom ponúka kategórie pre skúsených bežcov aj väčšie tímy. Trasa vedie prevažne po turistických chodníkoch a prírodných rezerváciách, čím umožňuje spoznať kultúrno-historické pamiatky a prírodné krásy regiónu Slovenska a Maďarska. Organizátori kladú dôraz na budovanie susedských vzťahov a propagáciu regiónu.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - červenec
description: The 2-Mile Run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, including children under 12, who run 1.6 km. The race is ideal for anyone who runs for fun, wants to improve their personal best, or simply enjoys a pleasant run in the beautiful surroundings of the park. After the finish, every participant is treated to a warm cinnamon pancake. The course follows the park’s paved paths; adults run two laps and children run one. Everyone is timed, and the results are published online.

name: Třtická punčocha
description: Třtická Punčocha is a traditional summer running race held in the village of Třtice since 1980, always on the first Sunday in July. The race is 8.8 km long and attracts runners from all over Bohemia. Originally intended for children, it now offers age- and gender-based categories for adults as well. In addition to the summer race, the village also hosts the 4.8 km Christmas Run, held on December 26. The races are popular and have a long-standing tradition, with results and photos archived on the village website.

name: Náchod - Dobrošov
description: Dobrošov Fortress is located near the town of Náchod, in the Kladské pomezí area of the Orlické Mountains. The fortress is an important part of Czechoslovakia’s northern border fortifications and offers visitors tours of its main bunkers, ammunition store, barracks, and infirmary. An educational trail runs through the fortress, taking visitors along the line of fortifications to the Běloves spa. The area around the fortress has numerous hiking and cycling routes, offering a chance to explore the beauty of the Orlické Mountains and nearby historic towns.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Cimrmanova etapa
location: Lomnice, Tišnov District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: MUM - Moravian Ultramarathon / Cimrman Stage is the seventh and final stage of an international stage race held in Lomnice near Tišnov. The race offers challenging and varied terrain with 740 metres of elevation gain, making it a test for experienced ultramarathon runners. The start is staggered according to the results of the previous six races, adding to the competition and suspense. This race is ideal for runners seeking a combination of technical challenges and stage racing amid the beautiful scenery of the South Moravian Region.

name: Grill Run=Fun 2026
description: Grill+Run=Fun 2026 is a race held in Palowice that combines sporting competition with a friendly atmosphere and fun. The event starts at 08:00, and participants can expect professional RFID timing and comprehensive technical support. The event is organized by the LUXTORPEDA Association, which ensures high-quality organization and support for runners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and experience the spirit of sporting community.

name: XXIV Atlantis Bieg Opolski
description: The 24th Atlantis Opole Run is an annual race held since 2003 on the first Saturday of July on Bolko Island in Opole. The route runs through a designated quiet, green area in the city center, offering participants the opportunity to compete over 5 km and 10 km distances. Since 2015, the race has been called the Atlantis Opole Run, thanks to the support of Atlantis-Deweloper. The event is organized by the Opole Run Association, which promotes physical activity and sports-based community integration.

name: Kaliski Półmaraton Nocny
description: The Kalisz Night Amber Hellena Half Marathon is a unique nighttime half marathon held in Kalisz. The event attracts hundreds of runners from different cities, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a running challenge after dark. The half-marathon course passes through charming parts of the city, giving participants an unforgettable experience. The event has become a tradition and is popular with both amateur and professional runners.

name: VI Półmaraton Gęstwinami Murckowskimi
description: The 5th Murckowski Forest Half Marathon is organized by the W Kręgu Natury Association and takes place in the picturesque forests of Murcki in Katowice. The half-marathon course winds through varied woodland terrain, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and enjoy a unique atmosphere. The event is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors, whether you are an experienced runner or a beginner. The organizers provide convenient access by public transport and parking near the start.

name: XI Janikowska ZaDyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janikowie
description: The 11th Janikowo ZaDyszka is an annual road race held in Janikowo, attracting runners of different ages and ability levels. The race covers 10 km, with professional timekeeping provided using Chronotrack technology. The event is organized by the Janikowo Sports and Recreation Centre, and timing is handled by STS-Timing, ensuring high reliability and organizational support. The race is open and welcoming to everyone who enjoys physical activity.

name: XXVI Bieg o Kryształową Perłę Jeziora Na...
description: The 26th National Run for the Crystal Pearl of Lake Narie is the main race, covering a distance of 31.13 km. It takes place in the scenic surroundings of Lake Narie in Kretowiny. The start and finish are located at the Main Beach in Kretowiny. The event includes age categories for men and women, and participants can look forward to a formal opening and closing ceremony, with awards presented. The event is national in scope and attracts runners from various age groups.

name: Bieg i Nordic Walking O Buławę Sieniawską
Letnia Dwunastka
location: Nowy Targ, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Turbacz Summer Trail
location: Nowy Targ, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: IX. Holdfény Éjszakai Félmaraton és Családi Sportnap
description: The 9th Moonlight Night Half Marathon and Family Sports Day is a charity running race in Szeged, welcoming runners for a night half-marathon. The event also serves as a family-friendly sports day where participants can enjoy exercising together. It takes place on Népkert sor, an ideal setting for both running and family activities. The event is traditionally very popular, attracting more than 1,100 participants.

name: VI. Tapolca Rockwool Trail 8 /  14 km / 22 / 33 / 45
description: The 6th Tapolca Rockwool Trail is a scenic running race through the beautiful landscapes of the Balaton Uplands, around Tapolca-Diszel. The route is 80% dirt roads, cart tracks and trails, offering runners varied terrain and unrivalled panoramic views. There are five distances to choose from, and those up to 22 km can also be completed as hikes. Participants can look forward to unique finisher medals, refreshment stations and a hot meal, while the organisers strive to make the event environmentally friendly.

name: TELIHOLDFUTAM
description: The Full Moon Run is a night race in Esztergom, following a scenic route through Castle Hill, the Water Town, and the Danube riverside cycle path. The race offers three distances: 4 km, 10 km, and 15 km, with the 15 km route also passing through Prímás Island. Runners are required to use a headlamp or another light source, as some sections of the course are unlit. The event is organized by the Esztergom Futóművek Amateur Sports Association and also serves as a points-collecting stop in the Ötpróba program.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 6. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelný 2 míľový beh organizovaný Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamom v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave. Pretek je určený pre širokú škálu kategórií vrátane detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov. Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste od 9:30 a štart je o 10:00 hod. Súčasťou je aj súťaž o Putovný pohár Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu, kde sa bežci bodujú podľa výkonov a účasti v jednotlivých kolách.

name: Žaškovský minimaratón
location: Žaškov okr. Dolný Kubín, Žaškov okr. Dolný Kubín, Žaškov na začiatku obce pri rieke Orava
description: Žaškovský minimaratón je tradičný bežecký pretek, ktorý sa koná už 55. rok v obci Žaškov na Orave. Trať vedie prevažne po lesnej ceste a uliciach obce, s dĺžkou približne 12,4 km a prevýšením okolo 600 m. Bežci sú počas preteku srdečne vítaní domácimi obyvateľmi všetkých vekových kategórií, čo vytvára príjemnú a rodinnú atmosféru. Tento minimaratón je súčasťou série Šípsko - Fatranské behy a je vhodný pre všetkých nadšencov behu, ktorí si chcú užiť krásy oravskej prírody a športového ducha.

name: Cyrilometodský beh Kolonickým vrchom – Memoriál Jozefa Chomaniča
location: Kolonica, okr. Snina, Kolonica, okr. Snina, športovo-rekreačný areál Bejvoč
description: Cyrilometodský beh Kolonickým vrchom - Memoriál Jozefa Chomaniča je bežecké podujatie konané v športovo-rekreačnom areáli Bejvoč v Kolonici, okr. Snina. Preteky ponúkajú kategórie pre deti aj dospelých, vrátane viacerých vekových skupín mužov a žien. Štart detských kategórií je o 13:30 a dospelých o 15:00. Podujatie je spojené s memoriálom Jozefa Chomaniča a ponúka príležitosť pretekárom všetkých vekových kategórií zmerať si sily v peknom prírodnom prostredí.

name: Domašská desiatka na Eve
location: Vranov nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, rekreačná oblasť Domaša, Eva, pizzeria Palermo
description: Domašská desiatka na Eve je tradičný bežecký pretek konaný v rekreačnej oblasti Domaša, Eva pri Vranove nad Topľou. Pretek ponúka trate na 5 a 10 km, ktoré sú súčasťou majstrovstiev okresu Vranov nad Topľou v cestnom behu. Bežci si môžu vychutnať trať s občerstvovačkami a po dobehnutí dostanú štartovný balíček s medailou, jedlom a nápojom. Organizátori zabezpečujú zdravotnú službu a pretek sa koná za neobmedzenej premávky, pričom každý štartuje na vlastnú zodpovednosť.

name: Širokodolská časovka
description: The Široký Důl Time Trial is a short interval running race held in Široký Důl near Polička and is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026. The race takes place on an 800-metre asphalt course with 80 metres of elevation gain. Runners set off at one-minute intervals from 10:00. Registration takes place at the venue from 8:45 to 9:45. A cycling event follows the run but is not part of the running cup. The entry fee is a symbolic 50 CZK, making the race accessible to the general public.

name: Běh pod Slunečnou
description: Běh pod Slunečnou is an 8.3 km cross-country race held in Moravský Beroun in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix of Endurance and gives runners the chance to test themselves on natural terrain. The course is suitable for cross-country running enthusiasts and offers interesting natural scenery. The race is open to the general public and welcomes all runners who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and a challenge in beautiful surroundings.

name: Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 05.07.2026
description: The 7th Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 2026 is an annual running event held in Wilkowo near Świebodzin. The race attracts runners from various categories and offers the chance to compete on a route combining road and off-road sections. The organizers provide professional timing and technical support, while participants can expect efficient organization and a friendly atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to get active and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: A route combining road and off-road sections
Scenic surroundings of Wilkowo near Świebodzin
Professional electronic timing
additional: The event is organized by Super Sport, a company from Zielona Góra, which provides timing, race bib printing, and technical support. No details are available about start waves, participant limits, or race packages. Registration will be available at super-sport.com.pl, and the event attracts local runners and sports enthusiasts.

name: Pogoń za Jednorożcem
description: The Unicorn Chase is an annual running event held in Jednorożec, taking place for the eighth time in 2026. The event includes a 5 km race and Nordic walking over the same distance, as well as children’s races over shorter distances. It is organized by the “Jednorożec robi co może” Association in cooperation with local partners and patrons, offering participants sporting competition, numerous attractions, and prizes. The start and awards ceremony take place on the same day, and participants can expect professional organization and chip timing.

name: XV Limanowa Forrest
description: The 15th International Limanowa Forrest Anglosaxon Mountain Run is a unique mountain race that takes runners up Miejska Góra, 716 m above sea level, where the Millennium Cross—the tallest steel cross in Poland—is located. The course follows an Anglosaxon format and features varied terrain, including hiking trails, forest and field roads, rocky sections, and stretches of asphalt and sidewalk. The start and finish are on Bulwary Street in Limanowa, near the race office. The race takes place on July 5, 2026, at 12:00 and is organized by the Limanowa Forrest Sports Club.

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (6)
organizer: Akademia Wychowania Fizycznego im. Jerzego Kukuczki w Katowicach, Państwowa Straż Pożarna Katowice
description: The Panewniki Wild Boar Run is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the scenic Panewniki forests in Katowice. The competition takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times, with markers every kilometre. The event promotes an active lifestyle and education about proper conduct in forest areas. Both amateurs and athletes affiliated with sports clubs may take part. The organizers are the Jerzy Kukuczka Academy of Physical Education in Katowice and the Katowice State Fire Service.

name: Jutrosińska Dycha
additional: Modern timing. Training sessions from the time of registration until the race count. Average training paces listed on the website: 4.43 min/km and 4.84 min/km.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale marathon held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, surrounded by forests and fields. The 42.195 km route follows forest and country roads, with the start and finish on Polna Street. The event has a friendly, informal atmosphere, without crowds or competitive pressure, and promotes physical activity in a natural setting. The organizers offer a varied, clearly marked course, with convenient access and parking.

name: HAAS MARATON VÁLTÓ
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The HAAS Marathon Relay is a traditional relay race organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. The event combines the excitement of relay running with the beauty of nature, as participants test their strength on varied terrain around Tata. It has a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere and offers an enjoyable program for spectators as well as runners. Open to sports enthusiasts and amateur runners alike, the race is an important event in local sporting life.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Hlásná Třebaň
description: The Berounka Running Series in Hlásná Třebaň is part of a community trail race series held in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. The course passes through Karlštejn National Nature Park, with views of Karlštejn Castle, and offers runners varied terrain with forest paths and hilly sections. The race is suitable for all runners, whether beginners or experienced, and is part of a series of 12 races that encourage regular exercise and sporting activity. Refreshments, bag storage, and certificates for the top finishers in each category are provided on site.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Czerwonak Physical Culture Development Center. Held in the evening, it combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It has become a long-standing tradition, attracting participants who want to spend time outdoors running or walking in a friendly atmosphere. The event takes place around Bolechowo and lasts approximately two and a half hours.
course_highlights: Evening runs and walks outdoors
Route around Bolechowo and Czerwonak
Bringing the local community together through physical activity
additional: The event is free and takes place from 19:30 to 22:00. It is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees, or online registration.

name: 5. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: Run for Health is a charity running series organised by the TJ Jäkl Karviná athletics club, held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run is 3 km long and is open to everyone who wants to support their health while helping those in need, as the entry-fee proceeds are donated to charity. The start is traditionally at 17:45 by the Lodičky, with registration beginning at 17:00. Everyone is warmly invited to take part in this friendly, health-promoting run.

name: Běh okolo Bílé hory
description: The Run Around Bílá hora is a regular running race in Brno, offering a 1.7 km loop. Men and women run three loops, for a total of 5.1 km, while children can race over a distance adjusted to their age. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Bílá hora, near the playground, and is suitable for all age groups. The evening start is at 18:00, and runners can enjoy the community-run atmosphere, with refreshments and a place to store their belongings.

name: VUM – Valašské Ultramaraton – DEN1 – Zahřívání 🏃‍♂️

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: DEN1 - Zahřívání / DAY1 - Warm-up 999 Kč do / until 15.12.2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Všechny 3 tratě / All 3 Stages 2 099 Kč do / until 15.12.2026

description: VUM – Valašský Ultra Marathon is a demanding three-day stage ultramarathon in the heart of Valašsko and the Beskydy Mountains. The race is for runners seeking a challenge and discomfort, with progressively tougher stages that test physical and mental endurance. Each day is longer and more demanding, emphasizing self-sufficiency and the ability to recover. The race is not about speed, but about finishing safely and managing fatigue and decisions along the course. The organizers emphasize respect for nature and provide basic facilities, accommodation, and refreshments.
course_highlights: Three days, three stages with progressively increasing distance and elevation gain
Routes pass through the landscape of Valašsko and the Beskydy Mountains, including hiking trails, cycle paths, and forest roads
Maximum self-sufficiency for runners, with no conventional aid stations
additional: The entry fee includes camping in your own tent at the race venue, with the option of accommodation at a school (limited capacity). Refreshments during the race include coffee, tea, and basic refreshments before each stage, followed by fruit, vegetables, meat products, and sweet snacks after the stage. One liter of water per runner is available on the course at approximately the halfway point of each stage. Electronic timing and online runner tracking are provided. If exhausted, runners can use the organizers’ transport from the course. Every runner who completes at least one stage receives a finisher medal, while the exclusive finisher T-shirt is reserved for those who complete all three stages. The date differs between sources: the supplied date is July 11, 2027, while the event pages list July 9, 2027.

name: VUM Valašský ultramaraton
description: The Valašský Ultra Maraton (VUM) is a challenging three-day stage ultramarathon in the heart of Valašsko and the Beskids. The race is for runners seeking a challenge and discomfort, with progressively tougher stages that test both physical and mental resilience. Each day is longer and more demanding than the previous one, with an emphasis on self-sufficiency and the ability to recover. VUM is not a race for speed, but for endurance and safely completing all stages. The organizers emphasize respect for nature and runner safety.
course_highlights: Three days and three stages, with progressively increasing distance and elevation gain
Routes pass through the landscapes of Valašsko and the Beskids, including hiking trails, cycle paths, and forest roads
Maximum self-sufficiency for runners, without traditional aid stations
additional: The entry fee includes a participant pack with a cotton T-shirt, a race bib with your name or nickname, access to facilities with toilets and showers, accommodation in your own tent or at a school (limited capacity), refreshments before and after the stages, 1 liter of water on the route halfway through each stage, electronic timing, and online runner tracking. Every participant who completes at least one stage receives a finisher medal, while the exclusive finisher T-shirt is awarded only to those who complete all three stages. If you become exhausted, you can use the organizers’ transport from the course. This is not a team race, but you can run as a pair while competing as individuals. The race is self-supported: runners carry their own refreshments, and the course is not routinely marked, so navigating with GPX is mandatory. Approximately one liter of water per runner is available halfway through each stage. The ALL entry package includes access to facilities and the option of accommodation in your own tent or at a school.

name: Ultramarathon Górski - 3 x Sniezka = 1 x Mont Blanc
description: The 3 x Śnieżka = 1 x Mont Blanc Mountain Ultramarathon is a challenging mountain race held in Karpacz. It is also a qualifier for the prestigious UTMB and a member of ITRA. Runners can choose from three distances with varying levels of difficulty and elevation gain, earning ITRA points. The course follows scenic trails in the Karkonosze Mountains, including multiple ascents of Śnieżka, offering challenges for experienced ultrarunners as well as an opportunity to take part for beginner mountain runners.

name: Nízkotatranská stíhačka
description: Nízkotatranská stíhačka (NTS) je ultra trail pretek jednotlivcov s hlavným okruhom dlhým 98 km vedúcim z Telgártu na Donovaly cez hlavný hrebeň Nízkych Tatier a polovičnou trasou s cieľom na Čertovici. Pretek je kvalifikačným podujatím pre Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc a je certifikovaný ITRA. Organizuje ho občianske združenie Time Out - OZ v spolupráci so STS HIKING a Slovak Ultratrail. NTS ponúka náročnú horskú trať s krásnymi výhľadmi a výzvami pre skúsených bežcov horských tratí.

name: Rozbehni Majerovce
location: Majerovce, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, Majerovce, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, pred Obecným úradom
description: Rozbehni Majerovce je bežecké podujatie konané v obci Majerovce, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, pred Obecným úradom. Preteky ponúkajú kategórie pre deti aj dospelých s hlavnými behmi na 5 a 10 km. Štart detských kategórií je o 09:15 a hlavného preteku o 10:15. Organizátorom je Martin Folenta spolu s obcou Majerovce, ktorí srdečne pozývajú bežcov všetkých vekových kategórií na príjemný športový deň.

name: Beh Rajeckou dolinou KL Auto
location: Rajecké Teplice, Rajecké Teplice, Námestie SNP Rajecké Teplice
description: Beh Rajeckou dolinou KL Auto je bežecké podujatie v malebnom prostredí Rajeckej doliny, ktoré ponúka kombináciu asfaltových a poľných ciest. Trať vedie prevažne po poľných cestách s približne 20 % asfaltového povrchu, čo vytvára príjemnú a rozmanitú bežeckú skúsenosť. Podujatie je známe svojou výbornou organizáciou a priateľskou atmosférou, ktorá láka bežcov rôznych úrovní. Štart je na Námestí SNP v Rajeckých Tepliciach a organizátorom je Ján Valúch ml., ktorý je k dispozícii pre informácie a podporu.

name: Beh malý Caesar
location: Rajecké Teplice, Rajecké Teplice, Námestie SNP
description: Beh sv. Andreja a Detský beh Malý Caesar sú tradičné podujatia v Rajeckých Tepliciach, ktoré prinášajú športovú a rodinnú atmosféru na Námestí SNP. Beh sv. Andreja je asfaltový beh na 4,5 km trati s online registráciou, zatiaľ čo Detský beh Malý Caesar je určený pre deti vo veku 1 až 9 rokov a je bezplatný. Súčasťou podujatia je aj súťaž o najkrajšie vyzdobený detský kočík, ktorá obohacuje celkový zážitok pre účastníkov i divákov. Podujatie sa koná v popoludňajších hodinách s prezentáciou a štartom na námestí.

name: Beh zvrchovanosti Chrenovec – Brusno
location: Chrenovec-Brusno, Prievidza District, Trenčín Region, Slovakia

name: Běhej lesy Klínovec
description: Běhej lesy Klínovec is a trail race in the Ore Mountains, taking place on July 11, 2026. The race offers various routes, including a short and a long course, as well as a charity race. The start is at the summit of Klínovec, with the option to take the cable car up before running down to the Klínovec Ski Area. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races and features special speed sections, Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, with attractive prizes.

name: Libečovská 14
description: Libečovská 14 is a 14.2 km race with approximately 170 metres of elevation gain, running on both paved roads and trails. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and offers runners an interesting mix of paved and off-road sections. The course is suitable for runners looking for a challenge with gentle climbs and varied terrain. The race takes place in the picturesque Podkozí area of the Central Bohemian Region and attracts runners from the wider area.

name: Králický Sněžník Beze stopy
description: Králický Sněžník BEZE STOPY is a challenging mountain run covering 14 km with 1,050 m of elevation gain. The route starts in Heřmanice and passes via Klepáč and Malý Sněžník to the summit of Králický Sněžník. It features beautiful ridge running with views of Poland’s Kłodzko Valley and the Dolní Morava valley, as well as short, demanding descents. The race is for lovers of mountain terrain and is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Iscarex Cup. Younger runners can take on a shorter 5 km course with 440 m of elevation gain. The main race starts at 9:30, and the junior race at 11:00.

name: Hvězdonice - Ondřejov
description: Hvězdonice–Ondřejov is a 5.75 km uphill race with 255 metres of elevation gain, starting in Hvězdonice. This running race offers challenging terrain and beautiful views in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for runners looking for the challenge of an uphill course and wanting to test their strength in a mountain run. The race is part of the Svět běhu running calendar and attracts runners from a wide area.

name: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka
description: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka is a 10 km race held in Bukowiec, attracting runners eager to take on a moderately challenging course. Every participant who crosses the finish line will receive a commemorative medal. The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec, providing convenient event facilities. We invite all running enthusiasts to take part in this event, which combines sporting competition with a local atmosphere.

name: X Świerczyniecki Bieg Uliczny
description: The 10th Świerczyniec Street Race for the Mayor of the Gmina Cup is an annual running event held in Świerczyniec. The race takes place on the town’s streets, with the start scheduled for 10:00. It is organized by the Świerczyniec Volunteer Fire Brigade, and timing is professionally provided using RFID technology. The race attracts both local runners and sports enthusiasts from the surrounding area, offering exciting competition and a chance for the community to come together.

name: Bieg na Bucze
location: Górki Wielkie, Brenna, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Pozytywny Bieg Przełajowy - reaktywacja
location: Kalej, Wręczyca Wielka, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XIII Otwarte Mistrzostwa Zakopanego w Bi...
VII. Csillagok útján… éjszakai futás
description: The VII. Stars Along the Way… Night Run is a unique running experience at Platán Beach in Balatonboglár, where runners and walkers are welcomed on July 11 in a summery lakeside setting. The new venue offers a wider start-finish corridor, a paved surface throughout, and full street lighting along the route. Participants can choose between 3.5, 7, and 10.5-kilometer distances, and walking and a 500-meter children’s distance are also available. The event warmly welcomes all ages and fitness levels to experience the magic of running at night together.

name: DRÁVA FÉLMARATON
description: The Dráva Half Marathon is a traditional 21-kilometer race between Barcs and Heresznye, being held for the fifth time. Runners from several counties take part, with men and women competing in separate categories. The course is varied, and record times have been set in previous years, reflecting the race’s competitive nature and popularity. The event is organized by the local Dráva Running Club and the Heresznye Municipality, creating a friendly and competitive atmosphere for participants.

name: KÖCSI-TÓ FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Köcsi Lake running race is a traditional event with a friendly, family atmosphere, held near Balatonalmádi-Káptalanfüred, around the scenic Köcsi Lake. Everyone who wants to run or walk is warmly welcome to enjoy the natural surroundings and the community sporting experience. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sport and Environmental Protection Association, which is dedicated to sport and environmental protection. The race offers several distances, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them.

name: Malý Štrbský maratón
location: Štrba okr. Poprad, Štrba okr. Poprad, Nám. pred Kultúrnym domom
organizer: Obec Štrba, Obec Liptovská Teplička, Športový klub Štrba
description: Malý Štrbský maratón je tradičný bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná každoročne v druhej júlovú nedeľu v obci Štrba pod Tatrami. Pretekári majú na výber z dvoch hlavných tratí - 31 km a 10 km, ktoré vedú po asfaltovej ceste medzi Štrbou a Liptovskou Tepličkou. Podujatie je súčasťou projektu Tatry v pohybe a priláka bežcov z viacerých krajín, pričom atmosféra na námestí pred Kultúrnym domom je vždy živá a športovo naladená. Organizátormi sú obec Štrba, obec Liptovská Teplička a Športový klub Štrba.

name: S-Race
description: S-Race is an OCR race in Mariánské Lázně, held in front of the Ferdinand Spring Colonnade. The race offers 6 km, 12 km and 18 km courses, which run mainly along surfaced forest paths and feature more than 20 obstacles per lap. Age-group races are available for children. The start and finish are located right by the colonnade, with facilities including changing rooms, toilets, baggage storage and refreshments. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages and features staggered starts, with activities for children during the main race.

name: Koblížkový pasecký běh
description: The Koblížkový Pasecký Run is a traditional road race in Paseka near Olomouc, offering an 8.2 km course. The route runs on asphalt, paving stones and park paths, passing through the village, along the cycle path to the sanatorium and through the park of the Specialist Medical Institute, before returning to the start by the municipal office. The first categories start in the afternoon, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators alike. The event is organised by Ivan Elischer, who ensures everything runs smoothly and supports the runners.

name: Halda Trail Run
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road running adventure in Kuřimská Nová Ves, through the picturesque landscape of the Halda Stream valley and the Libochovka River. The longest route is approximately 24 km long and includes 23 stream crossings, all runnable and pleasantly refreshing in summer. The race offers three distance options (4, 14 and 24 km), which connect to one another and allow runners to change their distance during the race. The route runs mainly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails, with panoramic views, two short, steep climbs and varied terrain—something both casual runners and ambitious trail runners will appreciate.

name: Běh o Ludgerův meč
description: The Run for Ludger’s Sword is the third edition of a running race organized by Běžecký klub Náchod in cooperation with the municipality of Hořičky. The race is part of the Primátor CUP running series and the Velká cena východních Čech cup. The routes pass through the area around Hořičky, offering beautiful views of the Kladské pomezí region. They run over gently rolling terrain on gravel and forest roads, with very little asphalt. Courses are available for children, as well as the 8 km main race and a 4 km FIT route. The start and registration take place at the complex by the football pitch in Hořičky.

name: II Galicyjska 10
description: The 2nd Galician 10K of the Subcarpathian Regional Chamber of Civil Engineers is a sporting event bringing together Chamber members and their families. It will take place on July 12, 2026, in Urzejowice, in the park by the stadium. The event features 10 km races, a 7 km Nordic walking event, and children’s races in various age categories. It’s a great opportunity to spend active family time outdoors, promote a healthy lifestyle, and bring together the civil engineering community. Participants can look forward to a sporting atmosphere and fun at the finish.

name: 43 Bieg o Złoty Kłos
location: Kołaczkowo, Września County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: LÁZBÉRCI SRI CHINMOY MARATON
description: The Lázbérc Sri Chinmoy Marathon is a nationally organized running event in Hungary, held in the spirit of peace philosopher Sri Chinmoy. The race traditionally offers the experience of running close to nature and provides participants with a unique opportunity to experience physical and spiritual harmony. Runners can test their strength and endurance on varied terrain in a picturesque setting. The event has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere, and all running enthusiasts are warmly welcome.

name: Dvě kola při zdi
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Dvě kola při zdi is a traditional cross-country race in Prague’s Hvězda Game Reserve, with courses for men, women, and children. Men run the 7.8 km main course along the reserve’s perimeter walls. Women have a shorter 4 km course, but can also run the men’s course. Two shorter loops are available for children. After the race, participants can enjoy a raffle and hearty refreshments.

name: Halda
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road running race through the beautiful landscape of the Halda stream valley and the Libochovka River. It offers three routes of 4, 14 and 24 kilometres that connect to one another, allowing participants to change the distance during the race. The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails, and features 23 stream crossings, two short, steep climbs and panoramic views. The race is suitable for both casual runners and ambitious trail runners, and is thoroughly marked with arrows and course ribbons.

name: Běh o Neplachovský Hrneček
description: The Běh o Neplachovský hrneček is a traditional running race held in Neplachov, South Bohemian Region. The 14th edition takes place on Friday, July 17, 2026. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is supported by the South Bohemian Region’s budget. The event offers a sporting experience in the region’s beautiful surroundings and attracts runners from across the wider area. The organizers warmly invite all runners to take part in this popular event.

name: Kružberský Tesák
description: Kružberský Tesák is a sporting event held at the Kružberk Reservoir grounds, offering routes and categories for experienced racers, intermediate participants, and complete beginners. The event is suitable for solo runners, hikers, and families with children. It also includes Pejskiáda, a fun show and competitions for dogs of all sizes and breeds. Organizers Kateřina and Lucie, nature lovers and dog-sport enthusiasts, aim to create a friendly atmosphere and ensure an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: Leśna Eko Piątka
description: Leśna Eko Piątka is a race held in Piekary Śląskie that promotes the city and supports integration and the prevention of addiction among children and young people. The course follows asphalt and gravel roads through Dioblina Forest, with the start and finish at the MOSiR stadium at 3 Olimpijska Street. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Piekary Śląskie. Participants receive a race package including a bib, timekeeping, a medal and medical support. The time limit is 45 minutes, and the field is limited to 500 participants.

name: XIII Bieg po Chrust
location: Chróścice, Dobrzeń Wielki, Opole County, Poland

name: Kordícky Extrém
location: Kordíky okr. B. Bystrica, Kordíky okr. B. Bystrica, Obecný úrad
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Kordícky Extrém je náročný horský beh, ktorý vedie cez malebné okolie Kordíkov v okrese Banská Bystrica. Trať je určená pre bežcov, ktorí hľadajú extrémne výzvy v prírode s výrazným prevýšením a technickými úsekmi. Podujatie je súčasťou série Marathon Tour a ponúka jedinečný zážitok z behu v krásnom horskom prostredí. Organizátori vítajú všetkých bežcov, ktorí chcú otestovať svoju vytrvalosť a odvahu v tomto extrémnom teréne.

name: Mesciské pancaky
location: Mestisko, okres Svidník, Mestisko, okres Svidník, futbalové ihrisko
description: Mesciské pancaky je bežecké podujatie v Mestisku, okres Svidník, ktoré ponúka trate na 5 km a 10 km bez vekových obmedzení pre mužov aj ženy. Trať vedie prevažne po asfalte, s časťou po trávnatej ploche a poľnej ceste, čo zabezpečuje rôznorodý povrch pre bežcov. Štart pretekov je na futbalovom ihrisku v Mestisku. Registrácia je možná online alebo priamo na mieste podujatia.

name: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra
description: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra sú trailové preteky v Národnom parku Veľká Fatra, ktoré ponúkajú bežcom nezabudnuteľné výhľady na Nízke Tatry, lesné single traily a špeciálne lesné cesty. Trasy vedú cez UNESCO lokalitu Vlkolínec a zahŕňajú aj lanovku a Sidorovo. Preteky sú súčasťou medzinárodného UTMB Index Races, kde bežci získavajú body podľa výkonu a dĺžky trate. K dispozícii sú tri trate s rôznou dĺžkou a prevýšením, vhodné pre rôzne úrovne bežcov.

name: Zkus Noční Kuks
description: Try Noční Kuks, a night running race in the picturesque Baroque setting of Kuks. It offers two routes—10 km and 5 km—that pass historic landmarks such as Braun’s Nativity Scene and Kuks Hospital. Running in the dark, lit only by headlamps, offers a unique experience and atmosphere that runners will remember for a long time. The 10 km route includes the pilgrimage route of the 21st-century Stations of the Cross, while the shorter 5 km route runs along the Elbe at night and through the Count’s Alley, lined with 222 trees.

name: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc
description: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc is a family-friendly running event offering races for recreational and elite runners over 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km, as well as children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place in the picturesque setting of Smetanovy sady and is part of a nationwide series featuring unique courses. The organizers focus on excellent service, safety and fun for the whole family, with an accompanying programme and a charitable component. Every participant receives a race pack and can look forward to refreshments and support from the pacer team. ČEZ RunTour is not just a sporting event, but a full-day experience for all age groups.

name: Noční běh Rusava
description: Noční běh Rusava is an unforgettable night race in the Hostýnské vrchy, offering a 12-hour run on a single loop as well as a 5 km race. The race is suitable for both individuals and relay teams, and runners are not required to run for the full 12 hours. Race facilities include a gymnasium for resting, an all-night buffet, and aid stations. The event takes place amid the scenic ski slope and forests around Rusava, creating a unique sporting experience beneath the starry sky.

name: 7 pohoří Krušné Hory
description: The Krušné hory 2026 race is a technical trail run that takes you through the beauty of the Krušné hory mountains and the former mining landscape, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The route starts in Abertamy and passes the former Eva mine, Jelení, the Swiss Chalet on Plešivec, Merklín, the former settlement of Kaff, Pstruží and the ski area before reaching the finish. It offers three courses of varying lengths and elevation gains, appealing to both experienced runners and beginners. The race takes place in all weather conditions, and participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments along the route and at the finish.

name: Rokytnice nad Jizerou - Dvoračky
location: Horní náměstí, Rokytnice nad Jizerou, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The route from Rokytnice nad Jizerou to Dvoračky is a popular hiking trail in the western Krkonoše Mountains, starting at Horní náměstí in Rokytnice. The blue-marked trail follows the Huťský stream to the picturesque Huťský Waterfall and continues to the Dvoračky mountain lodge, known for its history and traditional cheese-making. The route offers beautiful natural scenery, especially in autumn, when the surrounding beech forests burst with color. It is suitable for hikers, ski mountaineers, and cross-country skiers, who can enjoy the snowy landscape and refreshments at the Štumpovka restaurant at Dvoračky.

name: Nocna zaDyszka 2026
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Piekarach Śląskich
description: Nocna zaDyszka is a 10 km race held as part of the 7th PKO Piekarski Half Marathon, which will take place on July 18, 2026, in Piekary Śląskie. The event attracts many runners, and the participant limit for this distance is 900. The day before, on July 17, the accompanying 5 km Leśna Eko Piątka race will also take place. The organizers invite everyone to take part and expect nearly 3,000 runners across all distances in 2026.

name: 7. PKO Piekarski Półmaraton
description: The 7th PKO Piekary Half Marathon will take place on 18 July 2026 in Piekary Śląskie. This running festival appeals to both running enthusiasts and people just starting out in the sport. The event is organised by the city of Piekary Śląskie, which invites all runners to take part. Details of the course and programme will be available closer to race day.

name: Puchar Polski Nordic Walking - II etap
XIII Półmaraton i Ćwierćmaraton
location: Chrzypsko Wielkie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bančanská desiatka
description: Bančanská desiatka je tradičný bežecký pretek v Banskom okrese Vranov nad Topľou, ktorý sa koná pred Kultúrnym domom v Banskom. Ide o obľúbené športové podujatie s dlhoročnou históriou, ktoré každoročne priláka rekordný počet účastníkov. Pretek je známy svojou náročnosťou a krásnym prostredím behu do vrchu, pričom organizuje ho Športový klub Banské. Okrem hlavného behu sa konajú aj časovky do vrchu a ďalšie sprievodné podujatia.
course_highlights: Beh do vrchu v obci Banské - Mláčky
Tradičný štart pred Kultúrnym domom v Banskom
Náročný profil trate s novým rekordom trate 14:35 min
additional: Organizátorom je Športový klub Banské, ktorý má dlhoročnú tradíciu od roku 1985. Podujatie sa koná pravidelne, pričom v roku 2025 sa uskutoční už 30. ročník Bančanskej 10/5. V rámci podujatia sa konajú aj časovky do vrchu JANTEX Banské - Mláčky, ktoré majú samostatnú históriu a kategórie. Pretek zahŕňa 10 km a 5 km štafetu, registrácia online alebo na mieste, bohatý sprievodný program vrátane nafukovacieho hradu a vystúpení.

name: YOUNG RUN Nestlé
location: Prievidza, Prievidza, Námestie J. C. Hronského
description: YOUNG RUN Nestlé je bežecké podujatie v Prievidzi, ktoré ponúka trate dlhé 21 km, 10 km a 5 km. Pretekári sú rozdelení do kategórií podľa veku a pohlavia, pričom sú k dispozícii aj štafetové disciplíny pre deti. Štart pretekov je na Námestí J. C. Hronského s rôznymi časmi štartu podľa trate. Organizátormi sú YOUNG RUN, Nestlé a Mesto Prievidza, ktorí zabezpečujú kvalitný športový zážitok pre všetky vekové kategórie.

name: Ipelský Beh
location: Lučenec - Kalonda, Lučenec - Kalonda, hrádza na Ipli
description: Ipelský Beh je bežecké podujatie konané v lokalite Lučenec - Kalonda, na hrádzi rieky Ipeľ. Trať vedie prevažne po tráve a zahŕňa aj úsek nefunkčnej železničnej trate dlhý 100 metrov. Pretek je otvorený pre rôzne vekové kategórie mužov, žien aj mládeže, vrátane nordic walking. Organizátormi sú mesto Lučenec, obec Kalonda a OZ-Novohrad, ktorí srdečne pozývajú bežcov všetkých úrovní zúčastniť sa tejto tradičnej akcie.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Fojtovice
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. Across six races in different locations, you can choose from main races of 6 to 9 km, experience routes of 20 to 30 km, a walk with checkpoints to find, and children’s races. The series is suitable for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers a varied range of routes amid the picturesque scenery of the Ore Mountains. The Fojtovice race takes place on 19 July 2026 and offers a main race, an experience route, a walk, and children’s races.

name: Šachty - Štěpánka
organizer: Český Ski klub Vysoké nad Jizerou
description: Běh Šachty - Štěpánka is a traditional race organized by the Czech Ski Club in Vysoké nad Jizerou. The race is part of the Maratonstav Czech Cup in mountain running and offers runners a challenging course in the beautiful Krkonoše Mountains. The event attracts athletes and mountain-running fans, who can enjoy both the challenge and the atmosphere of a mountain race. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test themselves on this traditional course.

name: 14. Dolnośląski Festiwal Biegów Górskich
distance_verbose: Ultramaraton, 100 mil, Ultramaraton, 100 km, Ultramaraton, 50 km, 33 km, Półmaraton, 14 km, 10 km
description: The Lower Silesian Mountain Running Festival is a prestigious trail-running event held in picturesque Lądek-Zdrój. As part of the festival, runners can take on a variety of courses with different distances and elevation gains, from short night races to mountain ultramarathons. The event attracts mountain-running enthusiasts, offering unforgettable views and technically challenging courses. In 2026, the festival will take place from 16 to 19 July, and participants can look forward to a varied programme of accompanying events and professional organisation.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque UMCS Botanical Garden in Lublin, combining sporting competition with the beauty of nature. The race is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series, known for its scenic courses and friendly atmosphere. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part in this special summer edition.

name: Piątka Królowej Bony
organizer: Gmina Różan, Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki
description: Piątka Królowej Bony is a 5 km race held at the Municipal Stadium in Różan. The event takes place on July 19, 2026, and is open to people over the age of 15. Minors must have written consent from a parent or guardian. The start and finish are located at 3 Szkolna Street. The event is organized by the Municipality of Różan and Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki, and participants can expect professional event support and timekeeping.
