name: VII Bieg Górski o Złotą Paproć
description: The 7th Golden Fern Mountain Run is a 10 km mountain race taking place in picturesque Tymbark. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a demanding route with varied terrain. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using dedicated training plans tailored to different skill levels. This event attracts runners who value challenges and contact with nature.

name: XXII Bieg Szlakiem Partyzantów z Lubatowej
FUTABUDA a Dunakanyarban
description: FUTABUDA in the Danube Bend is a self-funded, nonprofit running race taking place in Dunabogdány on Sunday, July 19, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. The race offers challenges over two distances: 6.1 km with 205 m of elevation gain and 14 km with 356 m of elevation gain. Runners receive a unique metal finisher’s medal, and the top finishers are awarded prizes by age group and overall. The race is part of the Ötpróba series but is independent of it, and registration allows for on-site changes. Places are limited to a maximum of 200 participants.

name: Běh za Sliveneckou saní
description: Běh za Sliveneckou saní is an uphill race in Prague 5–Velká Chuchle, covering 2.54 km with an elevation gain of 130 metres. The race is part of the Runs in the Hills of Prague and Surroundings series and challenges runners with a demanding climb. It is suitable for anyone looking to test their strength and endurance on hilly terrain.

name: 402. Malá cena Monaka
description: The Little Monaco Prize is a traditional running race organized by KRB Chrudim. It takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race gives athletes the opportunity to test themselves on various courses and enjoy the atmosphere of the running community. The event is part of a long-standing tradition and attracts runners of all ages. The organizers emphasize quality event management and a friendly race atmosphere.

name: Tobiášův běh Kazín - Cukrák
description: Tobiáš’s Kazín–Cukrák Run is part of the KOPEC series, which features hill races in Prague and the surrounding area. This traditional race gives runners the chance to test themselves on challenging hilly courses in the picturesque surroundings of Kazín. The KOPEC series is known for its community atmosphere and support for runners of all categories, who are automatically included in the overall standings. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys running in nature and the challenges of hilly terrain.

name: Tatra SkyMarathon 2026
description: Tatra SkyMarathon is a prestigious mountain race held in the heart of the Tatras, in Zakopane. The course crosses the ridge of the Czerwone Wierchy and Starorobociański Wierch, featuring two demanding vertical-style climbs, each with around 1,200 m of elevation gain, interspersed with challenging Tatra descents. The race is part of a running festival that highlights the sporting character of Podhale and Orawa, giving participants and spectators an unforgettable experience. The organizers invite everyone to take part and cheer along the course.

name: Dobra Run a Dobrá dvojka
location: Domaša, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, Domaša, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, RO Domaša - Dobrá
description: Dobra Run a Dobrá dvojka je bežecké podujatie v lokalite Domaša, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, ktoré ponúka trate 7 km a 2 km. Pretek je vhodný pre rôzne vekové kategórie mužov a žien, vrátane detí. Organizátorom je spoločnosť Matore s.r.o. Humenné a BAMM Bratislava, pričom pretekárov čaká príjemná atmosféra a možnosť súťažiť v rôznych vekových skupinách. Štartovné je dostupné online alebo na mieste do naplnenia limitu pretekárov.

name: Night city run Piešťany
description: Piešťany Night City RUN je tradičný nočný beh, ktorý sa koná na Námestí Slobody v Piešťanoch. Pretekári majú možnosť zúčastniť sa na 10 km trati, ktorá vedie mestom a ponúka jedinečnú atmosféru nočného behu pod záštitou Mesta Piešťany. Podujatie je otvorené pre rôzne vekové kategórie a všetci účastníci dostanú pamätnú medailu. Počas pretekov je zabezpečená elektronická časomiera a slávnostné vyhlásenie výsledkov sa koná večer po behu.

name: Extrém maratón Košice – Furča
location: Košice - Furča, Košice - Furča, pred SBD III, Furčianska 60
description: Extrém maratón Košice - Furča je náročný bežecký závod organizovaný O5 Bežeckým klubom Furča Košice. Pretek sa koná v príjemnom prostredí Furče, kde si bežci môžu vychutnať výzvy trate a atmosféru tradičného maratónu. Tento závod je určený pre vytrvalostných bežcov, ktorí hľadajú extrémnejší zážitok v rámci maratónskej vzdialenosti. Organizátori zabezpečujú kvalitné podmienky a podporu pre všetkých účastníkov.

name: Beh na Krivošťanku
location: Baffone Family Restaurant, Krivošťany, Strážske, Slovakia

name: Smilovice pomáhají - Běh pro Theu
description: Run for Thea is a charity race organized by the Smilovice Help Foundation, taking place on July 25, 2026, at the Sportcentrum Smilovice grounds. The race supports the treatment and rehabilitation of young Thea, who is facing serious health complications. Participants can choose from several routes of varying lengths and age categories, whether they want to race or simply take a walk. The event is open to everyone who wants to support a good cause and enjoy the pleasure of movement in a community atmosphere.

name: Běh na Lysou horu
description: The Run to Lysá hora is a traditional race held every year on the last Saturday in July in Krásná–Nižní Mohelnice. This 41st edition welcomes runners from the Czech Republic and Poland, all aiming to conquer Lysá hora, the queen of the Beskydy Mountains. The race starts near the Zlatník restaurant, at the crossroads leading to Lysá hora; registration and the awards ceremony also take place there. The course follows an asphalt road along a forest service road operated by Lesy ČR all the way to the summit of Lysá hora.

name: Borovská desítka
description: Borovská desítka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque village of Havlíčkova Borová in the Vysočina Region. The race offers a 10 km course with gentle elevation changes, running mostly through forest and along paved roads. The trees provide shade, making for a pleasant running experience even on sunny days. The start and finish are in the centre of the village, with aid stations along the course and at the finish. After the race, refreshments are provided, followed by an awards ceremony for winners in various categories.

name: Tatra SkyMarathon
description: Tatra SkyMarathon is a prestigious mountain race held in the heart of the Tatra Mountains, in Witów in the Podhale region. The course runs along the ridge of the Czerwone Wierchy and Starorobociański Wierch, featuring two demanding vertical-style climbs with approximately 1,200 m of elevation gain each, interspersed with challenging Tatra descents. The race is part of a running festival that highlights the sporting character of the Podhale and Orava regions, offering participants and spectators an unforgettable experience. The organizers invite everyone to take part and cheer along the course.

name: Bieg Powstania Warszawskiego
description: The Warsaw Uprising Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw, commemorating the Heroes of the Warsaw Uprising. The event attracts thousands of participants, who take part in the 5- and 10-kilometer races, creating a unique, solemn atmosphere of patriotism and historical remembrance. The race starts in waves and takes place in the evening, further highlighting its distinctive character. The organizers also offer a virtual edition, allowing participants to take part from anywhere in the world.

name: 9 Bieg Lubliniecki
description: The 9th Lubliniec Run is an annual running event organized by Mafia Team Lubliniec, taking place on July 25, 2026. The main distance is 10 km, and participants can also take part in races for children and young people. The race office is located at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec. The course will be announced soon, and the event is highly regarded, with numerous awards in the categories of small-scale races and 10 km races.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwice Park Running Challenge is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026. The events take place on Saturdays, once a month, on a 4,219.5-metre course in a municipal forest, starting and finishing by Piast Stadium. The event promotes a healthy, active outdoor lifestyle and encourages regular physical activity under the slogan “Let yourself be challenged to fight laziness!”

name: Pogórze Ultra Trail
description: Pogórze Ultra Trail is a mountain race organized by the Pogórze Ultra Trail Association, which brings together a passion for running and exploring the natural environment of the Strzyżów Foothills. The routes pass through scenic, diverse landscapes, including old deciduous forests, coniferous forests, loess ravines, and unique rock formations. Participants have the chance to run through historic shelter tunnels in Strzyżów and Stępina, as well as admire the Brzeżanka range, the Kiczora massif, Herby, and Mount Chełm. It is the region’s largest running event, attracting trail running and ultramarathon enthusiasts every year.

name: GAJA-VÖLGY TRAIL
description: The Gaja Valley Trail is a trail-running event organized by the Gaja Valley Association for the second time on July 25, 2026, in Fehérvárcsurgó, near Károlyi Castle. Runners and hikers can choose from three different distances. The focus is not on competition, but on the joy of exercise, the shared experience, and being close to nature. The event aims to promote running at every level, from beginners to experienced runners, in a pleasant summer woodland setting. The start and finish are at the Károlyi Castle Visitor Center, while the babbling Gaja Stream and the quiet of the valley create a special atmosphere for participants.

name: GULYATERELŐ FUTÓVERSENY
location: Tápiógyörgye Falumúzeum, Béke utca 2, Tápiógyörgye, Hungary

name: Beh na chatu pod Chlebom, mem. J. Morgoša
location: Turany okr. Martin, Turany okr. Martin, Turany - Šútovo – Zajacová
organizer: BS TATRAN Turany, LK NÁDEJ Turany
description: Beh na chatu pod Chlebom, memoriál J. Morgoša je horský bežecký pretek, ktorý sa koná v lokalitách Turany, Šútovo a Zajacová. Trať má dĺžku 3,1 km s prevýšením 680 metrov a vedie po horských cestách a chodníkoch. Pretek je súčasťou Turčianskej bežeckej ligy 2025 a je určený pre rôzne vekové kategórie mužov a žien. Organizátormi sú BS TATRAN Turany, mesto Turany a LK NÁDEJ Turany. Pretek ponúka výzvu pre bežcov, ktorí majú radi náročnejší horský terén.

name: Běh na Kozubovou
description: The Run to Kozubová is a traditional mountain race held in Dolní Lomná. It follows hiking trails over challenging elevation changes. The race starts by the bakery in Dolní Lomná and goes via Polana and the Pod Kykulou saddle to the tourist lodge on Kozubová. The course is approximately 5 km long, with around 500 metres of elevation gain, challenging runners with steep climbs and offering beautiful mountain views. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from juniors to veterans, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and generous prize raffle for participants.

name: XRUN - Ucieczka Św. Kingi
description: Saint Kinga’s Escape is a mountain trail race held in Krościenko nad Dunajcem, combining scenic routes through the Sącz Beskids and the Pieniny Mountains. Participants can choose distances from 14 km to 40 km, with different time limits and Sunday morning starts. The 40 km route passes through Przysłop, the Przechyba mountain shelter, Wielka Przechyba, and Pieniny National Park, finishing along a scenic path beside the Dunajec River. The event is organized by the Beskid Foundation and takes place at the amphitheatre in Krościenko nad Dunajcem.

name: Kresowe Trail #8
description: Kresowe Trail #8 is a 10 km race taking place on July 26, 2026, in Chełm. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic trail course designed for runners of varying experience levels. The organizers encourage participants to use training plans tailored to their individual abilities to help them prepare optimally for race day. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl race calendar, a platform that supports runners in their development and race planning.

name: V Festiwal Biegowy pod Chełmcem Bieg Babinicza
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Szczawnie-Zdroju
description: The 4th Chełmiec Mountain Running Festival – Babinicz Run is a running event held in picturesque Szczawno-Zdrój, at the foot of Chełmiec Mountain. Participants can choose from a range of distances, from 1 km to a full marathon, making the festival appealing to runners of varying abilities. The course runs through charming surroundings, offering both challenges and beautiful views. The event takes place in July, when the weather is typically summery, with temperatures around 25°C and sunny skies.

name: MONORERDEI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The Monorierdő Running Festival is a friendly, family-oriented running event held every year in Makkos Park, Monorierdő. Runners can choose from several distances, and the course starts and finishes in Makkos Park. A special feature of the event is a live-music aid station, where the band "The Little Pea" energizes runners twice. The event aims to promote the joy of sport and exercise, and everyone is warmly welcome to join the running community.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka
description: The Emil Zátopek Golden Marathon is part of Zátopek’s Golden Week, a series of running races held in Plzeň in honour of Emil Zátopek’s Olympic victories. The main marathon takes place on 27 July and also offers accompanying races, including a half marathon, marathon and half-marathon relays, and a 10.5 km road race. The races start in the afternoon in Štruncovy sady and the surrounding area, with a varied programme and categories for men, women, and young people. The event is known for its tradition, high-quality organisation, and welcoming atmosphere for all runners.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červenec
description: Tempo Makers Osmička is a regular running race in Plzeň, held along the Úslava River. The race is open to men and women aged 16 and over and offers a friendly atmosphere for all runners who share a passion for running and spending time together. The field is limited to 75 starters, making it an intimate and relaxed event. The start and finish are at the same location, with parking available nearby. After the race, the top finishers are announced and prizes are drawn in a raffle.

name: Bear Foot Poľana
description: BEAR FOOT POĽANA 2026 je horský beh v divokom a jedinečnom prostredí pohoria Poľana, ktoré je najvyššou a najzachovalejšou sopkou v strednej Európe. Pretek ponúka dve hlavné trate: 24 km s kumulovaným stúpaním 1300+ metrov a 10 km s 600+ metrami stúpania. Trať vedie cez turisticky atraktívne miesta ako Vodopád Bystrô, keltské hradisko Kaľamárku a vrchol Predná Poľana, pričom bežci si užijú krásu hlbokých lesov, horských bystrín a pastvín. Pretek je súčasťou ligy Slovenskej Skyrunningovej Asociácie a limitovaný na 150 pretekárov na každú trať.

name: Porubska 11-ka
location: Porúbka okr. Bardejov, Porúbka okr. Bardejov, Porúbka
description: Porúbska 11-ka je bežecký pretek konaný v obci Porúbka v okrese Bardejov, ktorý sa vyznačuje mierne zvlneným, pahorkatinným až rovinatým terénom v nadmorskej výške 196 m. Trať vedie cez oblasť Karpatskej sústavy, ktorá ponúka kombináciu rovín a kopcov, ideálnu pre bežcov hľadajúcich príjemný a prírodný beh. Pretek je organizovaný obcou Porúbka a je súčasťou miestnych športových aktivít s tradíciou a komunitným duchom. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a podporuje aktívny životný štýl v regióne.

name: Island Gladiator Slovakia
location: Lednické Rovne, Medné, Lednické Rovne, Medné, Medné
description: Island Gladiator Slovakia je OCR pretek, ktorý preverí tvoju silu, vytrvalosť a odhodlanie v autentickom prírodnom prostredí Slovenska. Trať vedie cez lúky, lesy, potoky a kopce s rôznymi technickými úsekmi a prekážkami ako steny, plazenie, ťahanie, balans a nosenie bremien. Pretek je otvorený pre mužov aj ženy, začiatočníkov aj skúsených športovcov, s časovým limitom 3 hodiny. Každý účastník získa oficiálne tričko, medailu, štartovací balíček a elektronické meranie času. Island Gladiator nie je len súťaž, ale výzva prekonať samého seba a stať sa silnejším gladiátorom.

name: Krkonošská 50
location: Areál Svatý Petr, Špindlerův Mlýn, Czech Republic
description: Krkonošská 50 is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque setting of the Krkonoše National Park, starting in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race offers a challenging 50 km course with 1,784 metres of elevation gain, following marked paths and mountain trails. The field is limited to 300 starters, and the race is divided into several age categories for men and women. The organizers emphasize environmental responsibility and safety, including a requirement to carry a mobile phone and a ban on littering outside refreshment stations.

name: Běhej lesy Bílá
description: Běhej lesy Bílá is a mountain trail race held in the beautiful surroundings of the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area. The race offers several routes, including a short and a long course; the long ČSOB 20 km route is included in the international UTMB Index. Runners can take the cable car to the summit and look forward to the special Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which add extra competitive elements and rewards. The race is suitable for all mountain trail-running enthusiasts who want to experience the beauty of the Beskydy Mountains and compete on well-marked routes.

name: Zlatá stezka
description: The Golden Trail is a historic international hiking route connecting Bohemia with the Danube region. It winds through the beautiful landscapes of Šumava and the Bavarian Forest. At 631 km long, it offers a unique experience, linking up with Germany’s Golden Trail and passing through several national parks and nature reserves. Hikers can explore historic towns, castles, observation towers, and cultural landmarks along the trail, which is equipped with information boards and rest areas. The Golden Trail is ideal for hiking and discovering the region’s natural and historical attractions in the South Bohemian and Plzeň regions.

name: Běh na Kamenný stůl
description: The Run to the Stone Table is a traditional running race held in Rataje nad Sázavou, celebrating its 10th anniversary this year. The race offers a challenging and beautiful route from the castle courtyard to the Stone Table landmark, with varied surfaces and hilly terrain. It is open to professional runners, amateurs, and families with children, with shorter routes available for the latter. The race is part of the Běhej zámky series, which brings together running races at attractive locations near castles.

name: Mšecká sedmička
organizer: Městys Mšec a TJ Sokol Mšec
description: Mšecká sedmička is a traditional running race held in Mšec in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 7 km long and follows forest and field paths, offering runners pleasant natural terrain. It starts at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field and is suitable for the general public. The event is organized by the Mšec Municipality and TJ Sokol Mšec, who ensure a friendly atmosphere and quality organization.

name: Libeř - Radlík
description: Libeř–Radlík is a 2.47 km uphill race with 170 m of elevation gain, part of the Runs in the Hills in Prague and Surrounding Areas series. The course is not entirely uphill: it includes several flat sections and one downhill, adding interest and variety to the race. The atmosphere is pleasant and the entry fee is symbolic, with generous prizes for the winners from Botanicus. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain near Prague.

name: Trail Running Cup - Krkonošská padesátka
location: Mšec, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Krkonoše Fifty is a traditional trail race held in the scenic surroundings of Špindlerův Mlýn in the Krkonoše Mountains. The race offers a challenging 50 km course with 1,784 metres of elevation gain, following marked paths and mountain trails. The start is at the Svatý Petr resort, and participants can use the central car park in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race is limited to 300 starters. Overall winners are named for both men and women, along with winners in ten age categories for men and women.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic courses that showcase the beauty of their settings. The organizers aim to promote running and offer participants a unique sporting and scenic experience. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and join a close-knit running community.

name: IX Rudzki Półmaraton Industrialny
organizer: RUDA Śląska i MOSiR Ruda Śląska
description: The 9th Ruda Śląska Industrial Half Marathon will take place on August 1 at 9:00 p.m. in Ruda Śląska. The 10.5 km route runs through the central part of the city, showcasing the region’s industrial character and post-industrial landmarks such as Chebzie railway station, the Mikołaj Shaft, the Kaufhaus housing estate, and the blast furnace at Pokój Steelworks. In addition to the half marathon, an accompanying run of approximately 10 km is organized for those who do not feel up to running the full distance. The start and finish are at the athletics stadium on Czarnoleśna Street, which also houses the race office and organizational facilities.

name: XI Czastarska Piątka
description: The 11th Czastary Five is an annual road race held in the Czastary municipality, attracting runners from various regions. The event combines sport and recreation and takes place on a 5-kilometer route through the municipality’s scenic surroundings. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and support for participants, promoting an active lifestyle and bringing the local community together.

name: Bieg z okazji 82. Rocznicy Wybuchu Powstania Warszawskiego
II Wielgomłyński Dycha
location: Wielgomłyny, Radomsko County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: Półmaraton Cross Laskowa
location: Laskowa, Limanowa County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: CSERNYE TRAIL
description: Csernye Trail is a trail running race taking place for the sixth time in 2026 in Bakonycsernye. Starting from the start area next to the sports field, runners can choose from various distances that lead across varied terrain, through forests and over hills. The organizers promise excellent event management and an enjoyable running experience, while participants can admire the natural beauty of the Bakony. The race is family-friendly and recommended for both beginners and experienced runners.

name: ORFŰI TÓ – SHOW FUTÁS
description: The Orfű Lake-Show Run is the traditional running race of the Melitta Leisure Sports Association, held around the large car park by Lake Orfű and its beach. During the race, participants must run one or two laps around Lake Pécs on the road, clockwise, not along the promenade. The race is a family-friendly event, and everyone participates at their own risk. Both professionals and amateurs are welcome. The event is held with the support of Barta Textilház and offers valuable prizes to runners, not only based on their finishing times.

name: TATAI MINIMARATON ÉS FÉLMARATON - Tata, Váralja út 13,5-21km. eredmények
Klokočovská päťka
location: Obecný úrad, Klokočov, Michalovce District, Slovakia

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 8. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelný bežecký závod organizovaný Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamom v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave. Pretek je na vzdialenosť 2 míle (3,218 km) s kategóriami pre deti, juniorov, ženy, mužov a veteránov. Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste od 9:30 a štart je o 10:00. Súťaž je súčasťou série pretekov, kde bežci zbierajú body do putovného pohára podľa výkonov a účasti v jednotlivých kolách.

name: Malý Kavečianský maratón
location: Kavečany - Košice, Kavečany - Košice, Futbalový štadión
organizer: TJ Mladosť Kavečany a MÚ MČ Košice - Kavečany
description: Malý Kavečianský maratón je bežecké podujatie v Kavečanoch pri Košiciach, ktoré ponúka trate 21 km a 7 km, ako aj detské behy. Pretek sa štartuje na futbalovom štadióne a je určený pre širokú škálu kategórií od detí až po veteránov. Organizátorom je TJ Mladosť Kavečany spolu s Mestskou časťou Košice - Kavečany. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov rôznych vekových kategórií a výkonnostných úrovní, pričom štartovné je dostupné za priaznivé ceny s možnosťou online registrácie.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Moldava
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in different destinations, including Moldava, with routes for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers. Each race offers a main running race of 6 to 9 km, an adventure route of 20 to 30 km using a map, a 5 to 8 km walk with checkpoints to find, and children’s races from 200 to 1,600 metres. The series is suitable for a wide range of people who want to explore the beauty of the Ore Mountains in an active and sporting way.

name: XI Gorce Ultra-Trail
description: Gorce Ultra-Trail is a unique mountain race held in the picturesque surroundings of Ochotnica Dolna. Participants can choose from five varied routes, ranging from 5 to 102 km and suited to different experience levels, from beginners to seasoned ultramarathoners. The routes pass through the beautiful Gorce Mountains, featuring challenging climbs and spectacular views. The time limit for the longest route is 20 hours, underscoring the event’s challenging nature.

name: Kresowe Trail #9
description: Kresowe Trail is an intimate trail-running event organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and respect for nature. The event in Narewka offers two race distances: Szpurt (7 km) and Wertep (16.6 km), along scenic routes marked with course signs and featuring an aid station. Participants can expect electronic timing, commemorative medals, and a hot post-race meal. The event emphasizes ecology and the local community, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages.

name: XXXIV Bieg Jezior
location: Stary Uścimów, Lubartów County, Lublin Voivodeship, Poland

name: KERESZTÚRI ÖNTÚLSZÁRNYALÁS FESZTIVÁL
description: The Keresztúri Self-Transcendence Running Festival is a friendly, family-oriented race that combines closeness to nature with the spirit of self-transcendence. The race takes place in the Keresztúri Forest near Budapest and offers challenges over several distances, including 5.2 km, 10.5 km, the half marathon, 31.6 km and the marathon, as well as the special Yes, I can! event. The event is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has supported running enthusiasts since 1977. The race aims to give every participant the chance to experience camaraderie through sport and the joy of surpassing themselves.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Karlštejn
description: The Berounka Running Series in Karlštejn is a community trail race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Autokemp Karlštejn. The route crosses fields, meadows, and forests to the Malá Amerika quarry, continues along the red-marked St. James’s Way to Karlštejn Castle, and finishes with a downhill run to the finish line. The race offers a friendly atmosphere, a marked route, refreshments, and bag storage. Every participant receives a race number, and the top finishers in each category receive certificates and medals.

name: Rozdělovský čtvrtmaratón
description: The Rozdělov Quarter Marathon is a running race organized by Maratón klub Kladno and held in Kladno-Rozdělov. The club focuses on endurance running and organizing races in the region. The race offers runners of all levels an opportunity to test themselves over a quarter-marathon distance in the pleasant surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. The event is part of the club’s running calendar and supports the running community around Kladno.

name: Krčský lomcovák
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Krčský Lomcovák is a traditional running race held in Krčský Forest in Prague 4. The race offers a 5 km course starting by the Velký altán, open to both men and women, with separate start times. The event is part of a fun sports afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where participants and families with children can try various activities, such as slacklining, sack racing and disc golf. The race is organized by Krčák žije magazine, which covers activities and news from Krčský Forest and its surroundings.

name: Východniarska
location: Kluknava, parkovisko pred Kaštieľom hotela Biela dáma, čierny rytier – 8.8.2026 o 9:00
description: Východniarska je horský ultra trail a diaľkový pochod pre jednotlivcov, ktorý nadväzuje na populárnu Východniarsku stovku. Trasa vedie východnou časťou Slovenského rudohoria, prevažne cez Volovské vrchy, a ponúka náročný 85 km dlhý beh s prevýšením +4200 m. Štart je v Kluknave a cieľ v Kysaku, s časovým limitom 22 hodín. Podujatie je otvorené pre verejnosť s minimálnym vekom 18 rokov a vyžaduje riadnu registráciu a úhradu štartovného poplatku.

name: Hámorská dvadsiatka
location: Obecný úrad Remetské Hámre, Remetské Hámre, Slovakia
description: Hámorská dvadsiatka je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný obcou Remetské Hámre. Napriek zrušeniu posledných dvoch ročníkov kvôli pandémii Covid-19 sa organizátori tešia na obnovenie podujatia a hojnú účasť bežcov. Pretek sa koná v krásnom prírodnom prostredí Vihorlatských vrchov, ktoré ponúka atraktívne trasy pre športových nadšencov.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez prírodné prostredie Vihorlatských vrchov
Krásne výhľady a turistické zaujímavosti v okolí
Organizované obcou Remetské Hámre s dlhoročnou tradíciou

name: Rajecký maratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: Rajecký maratón je tradičný bežecký závod organizovaný Maratón klubom Rajec, ktorý sa koná v malebnom prostredí Rajca a jeho okolia. Pretekári môžu očakávať náročnú trať s prevýšením a krásnymi prírodnými scenériami, ktoré preveria ich vytrvalosť a kondíciu. Atmosféra podujatia je rodinná a priateľská, čo potvrdzujú aj sprievodné akcie a pohostinnosť v cieli. Okrem maratónu sa organizujú aj polmaratón, štafeta, kros duatlon a populárny Rajecký Borošovec, ktorý je krosovou klasikou s prevýšením viac ako 200 metrov.
course_highlights: Trať s prevýšením viac ako 200 metrov
Krosová klasika Rajecký Borošovec s dĺžkou 14,1 km
Prírodné scenérie Rajca a okolia
additional: Rajecký Borošovec je súčasťou podujatí, ktoré otvárajú bežeckú sezónu v Rajeckej doline. Po pretekoch je pre účastníkov pripravený guľáš a domáce koláče. Trať Rajeckého Borošovca je suchá a rýchla, s možnými prekážkami ako spadnuté stromy. Podujatie má rodinnú atmosféru a priláka aj mladších bežcov a juniorov.

name: Rajecký In-line polmaratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: Rajecký In-line polmaratón je súťažný inline korčuliarsky pretek, ktorý sa koná v Rajci na Námestí SNP. Trať vedie z Rajca do obce Čičmany a späť, pričom cieľ je na obrátke maratónu v Čičmanoch. Pretekári sú povinní mať počas celej trate prilbu a zapožičané čipy, ktoré sa vracajú v cieli. Organizátor zabezpečuje občerstvenie, šatne a sprchy, ako aj bezplatnú dopravu späť do Rajca pre inline pretekárov. Záverečná cieľová rovinka je vyhradená pre bežcov, preto je potrebné rešpektovať pravidlá organizátora.

name: Rajecká štafeta
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: Rajecká štafeta je bežecké podujatie organizované Maratón klubom Rajec, ktoré sa koná na Námestí SNP v Rajci. Ide o štafetový beh, ktorý je súčasťou Rajeckého maratónu a ponúka športovcom možnosť súťažiť v tímoch. Organizátor zabezpečuje štartové čísla, meranie času a kompletnú starostlivosť o účastníkov počas pretekov. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov rôznych úrovní a podporuje komunitného ducha a športové nadšenie v regióne.

name: Rajecký detský beh
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: Rajecký detský beh je bežecké podujatie organizované Maratón klubom Rajec, ktoré sa koná na Námestí SNP v Rajci. Zameriava sa na detských a neplnoletých pretekárov, pričom kladie dôraz na bezpečnosť a zodpovednosť, vyžadujúc podpis zákonného zástupcu pre účasť. Podujatie je súčasťou širšieho bežeckého programu v Rajci a ponúka príležitosť pre mladých bežcov zažiť atmosféru pretekov v príjemnom prostredí mesta.
course_highlights: Preteky sa konajú na Námestí SNP v Rajci
Určené pre deti a neplnoletých pretekárov
Bezpečnosť zabezpečená podpisom zákonného zástupcu
additional: Pre účasť detí a neplnoletých je potrebné priniesť podpísané vyhlásenie zákonného zástupcu, bez ktorého nebude účasť povolená.

name: Měřínský kros
description: Měřín Cross-Country Run is a traditional cross-country race through the beautiful Vysočina countryside. It offers a 13 km main race over Dědkovská hora and a relaxed 8 km course suitable for recreational runners. Children aged 5 to 12 can take part in the Junior Cross obstacle race, which features a giant bouncy castle. The race is timed using chip timing, and after the run there is an evening volleyball tournament with refreshments. The start and finish are at the sports field behind the primary school in Měřín, where parking, a baggage drop, toilets, changing rooms and showers are available.

name: Mořice Run
location: Mořice, Prostějov District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: Mořice Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque village of Mořice near Olomouc. The race is part of a series of running events focused on recreational and competitive running, which the club organizes in Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for supporting regular running and endurance races, and Mořice Run offers runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy a quality race atmosphere. The club also provides support and advice to runners who want to get started or improve their training.

name: Slatinická sedmička
description: Slatinice Seven is a 7 km charity run that follows mostly off-road routes around the village of Slatinice near Olomouc. The race is dedicated to the memory of Šárka Krčková and offers runners a pleasant route surrounded by nature. The event is suitable for all runners who want to combine sport with supporting a good cause.

name: Vnorovská desítka
description: Vnorovská Desítka is a popular 10 km race held every year in August in the village of Vnorovy. The race is part of the Moravian-Slovak Running Cup and attracts over 200 runners from various countries, including Czech elite athletes and African runners. The course follows a closed asphalt loop with minimal elevation gain, with the start and finish at the elementary school. The atmosphere is lively, thanks to the large crowd and high number of participants; nearly 700 runners take part across all categories.

name: niedamiRUN - Ultramaraton Sudecki
organizer: Stowarzyszenie NIEDAMIRÓW WIOSKA CUDÓW i Foxter Sport
description: NiedamiRUN is a Sudetes ultramarathon taking place on August 8, 2026, in Niedamirów, a picturesque village located at the crossroads of three cultures. Participants can choose from four distances: 10K, 20K, 50K, and 100K, which lead through the Karkonosze Mountains, the Lubawka Gate, and the Bóbr Valley, offering challenging elevation gains and beautiful views. The routes pass through the region’s historical and natural attractions, with the start and finish in Niedamirów. It’s a unique opportunity to take on a Sudetes ultra amid the wilderness and local culture.

name: Bieg Zbója
description: Bieg Zbója is a mountain race held in the scenic area around Bielsko-Biała, on routes around the summit of Klimczok. The race’s name refers to the legend of the bandit Klimczok, who formed a gang that helped the poor and left traces behind in the form of a mountain shelter and a cave. The course is challenging, with significant elevation gain and technical climbs that test the runners’ character and endurance. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering not only a sporting challenge but also a unique atmosphere and beautiful mountain views.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Summer Edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań. The event is part of a race series that has promoted running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland since 2014. It attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate the scenic appeal and character of cross-country routes. The alternative location is Lake Rusałka, just 500 metres from the Botanical Garden, offering additional scenic appeal.

name: I Jura Night Dog Run
location: Klucze, Olkusz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 1st Jura Night Dog Run is a night canicross race taking place on August 8, 2026, in Klucze, Poland. The event offers two main courses: 10 km and a 21 km half marathon, with the option to compete individually or as part of a team. The event is limited to 500 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere and a comfortable racing experience. The race starts at 8:00 PM, highlighting the unique character of a nighttime run with a dog.

name: Złota Dycha
description: The 6th Złota Dycha is a road race held in the heart of Złotoryja, the oldest city in Poland. The event is scheduled for August 8, 2026, combining the excitement of sport with the European Gold Panning Championships. The race offers two distances—5 and 10 kilometers—and participants can compete on the city’s picturesque streets. It is organized by Złotoryja City Hall and the Złotoryja Cultural Center, with support from the local running community.

name: JAZZFŐVÁROS-FUTÁS
description: The Jazz Capital Run takes place in Kecskemét at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre, offering a running experience as a sporty complement to the jazz festival. The event traditionally puts the joy of running and the sense of community first, and is open to all ages and types of runners. It is not only a sporting event but also strengthens local community ties, while participants can enjoy exercising in beautiful surroundings and fresh air. The organizers also consider charity important, so the run is an opportunity to support a cause.

name: Beh na Kráľovu studňu
location: Lenartov, okr. Bardejov, Lenartov, okr. Bardejov, Motorest Javorina Lenartov
description: Beh na Kráľovu studňu je tradičný bežecký pretek do kopca, ktorý sa koná v malebnom prostredí obce Lenartov pri historickej Kráľovej studni, mieste stretnutia troch kráľov. Trať vedie cez krásnu prírodu a ponúka jedinečný zážitok z behu v horskom teréne s bohatou históriou a výhľadmi. Podujatie je súčasťou miestnej bežeckej ligy a priláka bežcov z celého regiónu. Organizátori vytvárajú priateľskú atmosféru a vítajú všetkých účastníkov bez ohľadu na výkonnosť.

name: Černovírský kros
location: Černovír u Ústí nad Orlicí, Pardubický
description: Černovír Cross-Country Race is a traditional running event held in Černovír near Ústí nad Orlicí. Its hilly courses combine paved and unpaved forest and field paths with asphalt. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. The start and registration are at the Sokol hall in Černovír, and the main race covers a distance of up to 5 km. The event has a friendly atmosphere and is popular with local and visiting runners.

name: Běh na Krušnou horu
description: The Run to Krušná hora is a traditional uphill race held in the village of Hudlice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race starts at the end of Dolejší Street by the forest and follows a wide gravel forest road to the Máminka lookout tower at the summit of Krušná hora. The course is 2.7 km long with 190 metres of elevation gain, offering runners a challenging but beautiful experience in nature. The event is organised by TOBI Sport s.r.o. and is part of the Czech Running Club.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce - Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the beauty of the locations. The organizers aim to promote running and provide participants with a unique sporting and nature experience. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively in beautiful surroundings.

name: Chudy Wawrzyniec
description: Chudy Wawrzyniec is a mountain ultramarathon held in the Żywiec Beskids, offering six distances from 3 km to 100 km. The event takes place on August 8–9, 2026, starting in Rajcza and finishing in Ujsoły. The courses are technically demanding, with significant elevation gain and beautiful views, and the 80 km race serves as the Polish Mountain Running Championships over the ultra distance. The organizers provide professional race management and aid stations along the course, as well as the option to transfer a race entry.

name: VII Charytatywny Bieg świętego Dominika
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Bieg Świętego Dominika w Ustroniu
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious annual running event held in Gdańsk since 1994, as an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. This unique sporting event attracts both amateur and professional runners, offering races over various distances in the picturesque city centre, on a course that loops around Neptune. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration, and creates an unforgettable atmosphere with thousands of spectators cheering on the runners and a rich programme of accompanying events. It is valued by local authorities and sponsors, underscoring its status and importance in Poland’s running calendar.

name: XI Bieg Lucka
description: The 11th Bieg Lucka is a memorial race honoring Lucjan Chorąży, held on August 9, 2026, in Skawinki near Lanckorona. The event includes a main race of approximately 14 km, a recreational run and a Nordic Walking event of approximately 5.2 km, as well as shorter races for children. The main race course leads to Mount Chełm, and after the events participants can gather for refreshments. The race has a family-friendly, mountain character and honors Lucjan, who was passionate about mountains and running.

name: Bieg na Wielką Sowę
location: Ludwikowice Kłodzkie, Gmina Nowa Ruda, Poland

name: SZUFLA FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The SZUFLA Running Festival is a traditional community running event organized by the Enthusiastic Team of Szigethalom Ultrarunners on the second weekend of every August. The 20th anniversary festival in 2026 will take place in Tököl Park Forest and feature a variety of distances, including an ultramarathon, relay, half marathon, shorter races, and hiking. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with plenty of activities for children as well as runners. Its goal is to promote sport and support the local community, with a particular focus on helping people with disabilities.

name: RossbRUNn Trail
location: Lókút Sportközpont, Bem utca, Lókút, Hungary
distance_verbose: 56 km, Maraton, 28 km, 14 km, 7 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: Stezka mužů
description: Men’s Trail is a 3 km road race that is part of the SABZO series and will take place on August 12, 2026, in Prague 4. This race is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to spend time actively in a friendly atmosphere. Although the main focus is on running, the event is part of a larger sports and social program in the region. Come and race, and enjoy a day full of activity and fun.

name: 6. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Run for Health is a charity series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run offers a 3 km route that everyone can complete at their own pace. Proceeds from the entry fee go to help those in need, giving the event purpose and added value. Registration opens at 17:00 and the run starts at 17:45 at Lodičky. Everyone is warmly invited to take part and support a good cause.

name: 15 Diecezjalna Pielgrzymka Biegowa Radom...
description: The 15th Diocesan Running Pilgrimage is a unique running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The race follows a route from Radom to Częstochowa and combines a passion for sport with the spiritual dimension of a pilgrimage. It is not only a competition, but also a community experience that attracts runners from different backgrounds. The event takes place on August 11–13, 2026, and is an important fixture on the region’s running calendar.

name: Chminianskonovovesský beh
location: Chminianska Nová Ves, okr. Prešov, Chminianska Nová Ves, okr. Prešov, futbalové ihrisko OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves
organizer: ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný a obec Chminianska Nova Ves
description: Chminianskonovovesský beh je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný obcou Chminianska Nová Ves a ThLic. Mgr. Pavlom Uličným. Pretek sa koná na futbalovom ihrisku OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves v okrese Prešov a ponúka kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny mužov, žien aj dorastu. Ide o komunitnú športovú udalosť, ktorá podporuje aktívny životný štýl a športové nadšenie v regióne.

name: Runica Nevoľné
location: Nevoľné, okr. Žiar nad Hronom, Nevoľné, okr. Žiar nad Hronom, futbalové ihrisko
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Runica Nevoľné je bežecké podujatie konané na futbalovom ihrisku v Nevoľnom, okr. Žiar nad Hronom. Pretek ponúka jedinečný zážitok v srdci Slovenska, kde si bežci môžu užiť príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu. Trať je vhodná pre rôzne úrovne bežcov a podujatie je súčasťou bežeckej série Marathon Tour. Organizátori vítajú všetkých bežcov, ktorí chcú zažiť športové vyžitie v peknom prostredí.

name: Štafetový beh 345 km od Tatier k Dunaju Jasná – Bratislava
location: Demänovská dolina, Demänovská dolina, Jasná, Demänovská dolina
description: Štafetový beh od Tatier k Dunaju je najväčší štafetový beh na Slovensku s dĺžkou trate 345 km. Tímy pozostávajúce zo 6 alebo 9 až 12 členov štartujú v Jasnej v Nízkych Tatrách a bežia nonstop cez deň aj noc, aby v cieli na nábreží Dunaja v Bratislave ukončili pretek. Trať je prevažne asfaltová s celkovým prevýšením približne 3990 metrov stúpania a 4870 metrov klesania. Bežci absolvujú 36 úsekov rôznej dĺžky a náročnosti, pričom každý člen tímu pri 12-člennom družstve beží tri úseky. Preteky sú výzvou pre tímového ducha a vytrvalosť v krásnom prostredí Slovenska.

name: Reuter Run Boršov nad Vltavou
description: Reuter Run in Boršov nad Vltavou is a 12.5 km running race taking place on 15 August 2026 from 11:00 at Kemp Poslední štace. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and offers runners the chance to test themselves on an interesting course in the South Bohemian Region. The organiser is Zdeněk Richtr, and the race is suitable for a wide range of runners, including registered Cup members and other runners. The course surface is not specified in detail, but the race is part of a long-standing series with clear rules.

name: Běžecký mítink Bohuňovice
description: The running meet in Bohuňovice near Olomouc is a cross-country race offering men a 12.2 km course and women a 6.1 km course. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners and attracts runners who enjoy more challenging terrain. The meet is suitable for anyone who wants to test their strength in a natural setting with varied terrain. The event is a traditional gathering for the region’s running community.

name: 7 pohoří Šumava
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races feature technical trails, epic views, and a unique atmosphere that will test every runner’s strength, willpower, and determination. Whether you’re an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, 7 Mountains challenges you to conquer every course and become a legend. The Šumava race offers routes that pass over the peaks of Špičák and Pacíř, around glacial lakes and through deep forests, with up to 900 m of elevation gain.

name: Jablonská osmička
description: Jablonská osmička is a running race in Jablonné nad Orlicí, held on 15 August 2026. This fifth edition features an 8 km main race, children’s races, and a fun beer relay for teams of four. After the race, the programme continues with a Food Festival and Jabloffest, featuring music and activities for children at the swimming pool grounds. The race is suitable for both athletes and recreational runners, and includes a generous raffle and gift bags for registered participants.

name: Křivinský kros
description: Křivinský Cross is a running race held in Křivice, featuring a 7.5 km main course with 275 metres of elevation gain and an 800-metre children’s course. The race runs mostly along forest roads and trails through hilly terrain, making for a challenging and interesting run. Starts are staggered from 9:30 a.m.: children go first, followed by juniors and then the main categories. The race is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix and is open to the general public, with a voluntary entry fee. After the race, the results are announced and a short raffle is held for participants.

name: 303 Maraton Antoniego Fili
organizer: Polska Fabryka Wodomomierzy i Ciepłomierzy FILA Sp. z o.o.
description: The 303 Antoni Fili Marathon is a marathon taking place in Sztum, Mazowieckie, Poland, scheduled for August 15, 2026. Runners have access to a professionally prepared training plan tailored to different ability levels to help them prepare optimally for race day. The event is an excellent opportunity for runners looking to take on the marathon distance in scenic surroundings. Organizers provide expert support and access to a platform for managing race information.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the beauty of the locations. The organizers’ goal is to popularize running and provide participants with a unique sporting and scenic experience. Join this friendly and dynamic running event.

name: XXXIII Bieg im. Marszałka Józefa Piłsudskiego
Jazerný maratón
location: Košice - sídlisko Nad Jazerom, Košice - sídlisko Nad Jazerom, splav Jazero 0-tý km /Jenisejská ul./Košice
description: Jazerný maratón je bežecká výzva konaná v Košiciach na sídlisku Nad Jazerom, ktorá ponúka trate od 5 do 42 km. Beží sa na 2,5 km dlhom úseku po hrádzi rieky Hornád s kvalitným asfaltovým povrchom a minimálnym prevýšením, čo robí trať vhodnou pre rôzne úrovne bežcov. Podujatie má už 15-ročnú tradíciu a je ideálne pre tých, ktorí hľadajú rýchly a príjemný beh v prírode blízko mesta. Organizátori vítajú všetkých bežcov, ktorí si chcú zmerať sily na rôznych vzdialenostiach.

name: Žebrácká pětadvacítka
description: The Žebrák 25 is a traditional August road race on roads and forest trails in the Křivoklát region, held annually in Žebrák. It offers several distances, including the main 25 km race, a 10 km run, a 10 km walk, and a family run for children. The main race starts at 10:00 by the elementary school in Žebrák, while the senior categories start at 9:00. The event is part of the celebrations of the St. Lawrence pilgrimage fair and offers a wonderful sporting experience in the picturesque Křivoklát region.

name: MFB MarathOn LABE
description: MarathOn LABE is a traditional international running festival held in Kolín and Poděbrady, offering a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race, and other running events. The marathon course is an out-and-back route on forest, paved, and asphalt roads, certified by the Czech Athletics Federation (ČAS). The event is suitable for runners of all levels and features a rich program, including children’s races and family entertainment. It is organized by the Kolínská 14 association, which has supported an active and healthy lifestyle in the region since 2011.

name: Tyršův běh na Sokol
description: The Tyrš Run to Sokol is a traditional forest race in Malá Skála, offering a challenging 2 km course with 300 metres of elevation gain. The race is for nature-running enthusiasts who don’t mind hills and technical terrain full of roots, holes and rocks. Runners start at one-minute intervals, and the race has a long tradition; in 2021, it was held for the 36th time. Everyone interested in this type of race is warmly welcome.

name: Marceliński Bieg Letni 2026
description: Marceliński Summer Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the location’s aesthetic appeal. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience amid beautiful natural surroundings.

name: SÁRKÁNYFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The Dragon Run is an exciting running race organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. The event is a trail run on a varied and challenging course that combines the experience of being close to nature with the enjoyment of sport. It has a friendly atmosphere, is open to all age groups, and fosters a sense of community among runners. The race takes place in Súr, Hungary, and the organizers place great emphasis on smooth event operations and participant satisfaction.

name: Žvahov - Ivův běh
description: Žvahov - Ivův běh is a 3.7 km trail race held in the Děvín area of Prague 5. The race is part of the SABZO series and gives runners the chance to enjoy running in a natural setting, with gentle hills and interesting views. It is suitable for anyone who enjoys short but more challenging trail courses. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and test yourself against other runners amid the beautiful Děvín Hills.

name: ČEZ Lipno Sport Festival
description: The ČEZ Lipno Sport Festival is a traditional sporting event in Lipno nad Vltavou, offering a wide range of races for all ages and sports enthusiasts. The festival includes running races such as the Lipno Half Marathon, the 10 km COOP RUN and a family run, as well as cycling races, including 60 km and 20 km gravel and MTB routes. The event also features children’s races and evening runs along the scenic Čertovy proudy cycling path. Participants can enjoy the beautiful Šumava countryside and a varied programme of cultural activities.

name: Běh okolo Olympie
description: The Run Around Olympia is a running race in Brno, taking place on August 20, 2026, in the Chrlice area. The race features a 5.3 km loop, with men and women competing in a single category and starting together. A separate race is held for children, with the loop distance determined before the start. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant atmosphere, refreshments, and on-site baggage storage.

name: Šárecká 5
description: Šárecká 5 is a 5.3 km cross-country race held in the picturesque natural area of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6. This varied race gives runners the chance to enjoy a run in one of Prague’s most beautiful areas, with more challenging terrain. It is organized by SABZO Praha under the direction of Michal Procházka and is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s running activities. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys trail running and natural scenery.

name: Cestou Grófa Júliusa Andrássyho
location: Trebišov, Trebišov, priestor pri Mestskom kultúrnom stredisku
description: Beh Cestou Grófa Júliusa Andrássyho sa koná v Trebišove pri Mestskom kultúrnom stredisku a ponúka rôzne kategórie vrátane behu, letnej prechádzky, jazdy na bicykli, nordic walkingu a virtuálneho preteku. Štart je plánovaný na 21. augusta 2026 o 16:15 pre deti a o 16:25 pre hlavnú kategóriu. Podujatie je vhodné pre všetky vekové kategórie, vrátane detí do 7 rokov a starších detí do 13 rokov. Organizátorom je Ing. Michal Majcher, ktorý zabezpečuje príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu pretekov.

name: Běh městem Strakonice
organizer: Město Strakonice, Okresní sdružení Česká unie sportu Strakonice
description: The 23rd Strakonice City Run is a traditional running race held on August 21 at the Summer Cinema in Strakonice. Runners of all ages can test themselves on 3.3 km and 6.6 km courses through the city. Both distances start together at 18:00. All participants have a chance to win prizes in a large raffle drawn from race numbers. Entries can be submitted by email or on race day.

name: Rusínska 100 a 66
description: Rusínska 100 a 66 je neskoro letný ultrabeh a diaľkový pochod so štartom aj cieľom v meste Stropkov. Trasy vedú Ondavskou vrchovinou v Zemplínskej župe a pokračujú do Šarišskej župy cez mesto Svidník, prechádzajúc regiónom rusínskych obcí a po hranici s Poľskom. Trasa R100 sčasti prechádza chránenou krajinnou oblasťou Východné Karpaty. Podujatie je súčasťou Slovenskej Ultratrailovej Ligy a je certifikované u ITRA, zaradené medzi preteky ITRA National League. Organizátorom je o.z. Klub bežcov Stropkov, ktorý zabezpečuje srdečnú pohostinnosť a kvalitnú organizáciu.

name: Hradný gaštanový beh Modrý Kameň
location: Modrý Kameň, Modrý Kameň, park pred vstupom do Hradu Modrý Kameň
organizer: Mesto Modrý Kameň v spolupráci s občianskym združením Bežci VK
description: Hradný gaštanový beh Modrý Kameň je bežecké podujatie konané v parku pred vstupom do Hradu Modrý Kameň. Preteky ponúkajú rôzne kategórie vrátane hobby pretekov pre deti a juniorov na 5 km, hlavného preteku na 10 km pre dospelých a nordic walking na 5 km. Trať vedie po asfalte, lúkach, lesných a poľných cestách, čo poskytuje pestrú a príjemnú bežeckú skúsenosť. Organizátorom je Mesto Modrý Kameň v spolupráci s občianskym združením Bežci VK. Štart pre deti je o 10:00 hod., pre dospelých o 11:00 hod.

name: Čachtický polmaratón
location: Čachtice okr. Nové Mesto n. Váhom, Čachtice okr. Nové Mesto n. Váhom, námestie
description: Čachtický polmaratón je tradičný polmaratónsky beh, ktorý sa uskutoční 22. augusta 2026 v obci Čachtice. Trať vedie prevažne po asfaltovom povrchu cez ulice Čachtíc do Višňového a Hrachovišťa, s krátkym úsekom lesnej cesty. Profil trate je mierne zvlnený s maximálnym prevýšením do 90 metrov. Štart je na námestí v Čachticiach a cieľ v areáli Základnej školy v Čachticiach. Počas trate sú zabezpečené občerstvovacie stanice na viacerých miestach.

name: Forbaský beh pomoci
location: Forbasy, okres Stará Ľubovňa, Forbasy, okres Stará Ľubovňa, areál Ščava
description: Forbaský beh pomoci je charitatívny bežecký pretek, ktorý sa koná v areáli Ščava vo Forbasoch, okres Stará Ľubovňa. Ide o podujatie s dobrovoľným štartovným, ktoré podporuje pomoc a solidaritu. Bežci si môžu užiť príjemnú atmosféru a zároveň prispieť na dobrú vec. Organizátorom je Valer Kuffa, ktorý je k dispozícii pre informácie a podporu účastníkov.

name: Lukačovská 5
location: Lukačovce, okr. Humenné, Lukačovce, okr. Humenné, Futbalové ihrisko
description: Lukačovská 5 je bežecký pretek konaný na futbalovom ihrisku v Lukačovciach, okr. Humenné. Pretek ponúka hlavný beh na 5 km a detské behy, pričom kategórie sú rozdelené na mužov, ženy a nesúťažnú kategóriu Nordic Walking. Organizátorom je obec Lukačovce, ktorá zabezpečuje príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu pretekov. Štart pre deti je o 10:00 a hlavný beh začína o 11:00 hodine.

name: Harhovská desiatka
location: Spišský Hrhov, Spišský Hrhov, pred Obecným úradom
description: Harhovská desiatka je bežecké podujatie v Spišskom Hrhove, ktoré ponúka trať dlhú 10 km a kratšiu 3,5 km pre rekreačných a začínajúcich bežcov. Preteky sú rozdelené do viacerých vekových kategórií pre mužov aj ženy, vrátane špeciálnej kategórie pre obyvateľov obce Spišský Hrhov. Organizátorom je obec Spišský Hrhov a štart pretekov je pred Obecným úradom. Štartovné sa platí na prezentácii a je 10 € pre 10 km a 5 € pre 3,5 km trať.

name: Brezovský letný beh
location: Rimavské Brezovo, Rimavské Brezovo, Športové ihrisko
description: Brezovský beh zdravia je tradičný bežecký pretek v obci Brezov, okres Bardejov, ktorý ponúka trať vedúcu po asfalte, poľnej a lesnej ceste. Pretek je určený pre mužov a ženy, vrátane mládeže do 15 rokov a nad 15 rokov. Organizátori pripravili dve štartovné kategórie s veľkým a malým balíčkom, ktoré umožňujú zúčastniť sa tejto športovej udalosti v príjemnom prostredí pri Obecnom úrade v Brezove. Pretek je vhodný pre bežcov rôznych vekových kategórií a úrovní výkonnosti.

name: Behaj lesmi Čičmany
description: Behaj lesmi Čičmany je bežecký pretek v malebnom prostredí slovenskej ľudovej dediny Čičmany, ktorý ponúka trať cez Strážovské vrchy s nádhernou prírodou, neporušenými lesmi a rozľahlými lúkami. Preteky sú súčasťou série Behaj lesmi a sú zaradené do UTMB Index Races, čo zaručuje medzinárodné uznanie a hodnotenie. Súťažiť môžete na rôznych tratiach vrátane dlhého 20 km behu s prevýšením 718 m, strednej 11 km trati Lesnícka s prevýšením 380 m a krátkej 5 km trati. Súčasťou pretekov je aj špeciálna Conti Speed Section, kde najlepší bežci môžu získať hodnotné ceny.

name: Morava Run - proti proudu
description: Morava Run – Against the Current is a relay race that runs across Moravia along the River Morava. Teams consist of 7 to 12 members. The approximately 280 km route is divided into 30 sections of around 9 km, which teams allocate according to their abilities and strategy. The race starts in southern Moravia in the Soutok Protected Landscape Area and follows the river upstream through Slovácko, Haná and the Litovelské Pomoraví Protected Landscape Area to the source of the Morava on Králický Sněžník. The event is aimed at amateur runners and emphasizes teamwork and team building, with no pace limit.

name: Brdský půlmaraton
description: The Brdy Half Marathon is a traditional trail running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Kytín in the Central Bohemian Region. The race offers two routes: a more challenging 21 km course with 430 m of elevation gain and a shorter 9 km course with 158 m of elevation gain. Both have refreshment stations. On the longer course, overall winners and age and gender categories are recognized, while the shorter course awards the fastest men and women overall. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup series and is suitable for those who enjoy running in nature, with beautiful views and varied terrain.

name: Hrabovský 1/2 a 1/4 maraton
description: The Hrabová Half and Quarter Marathon is a traditional running race held in Ostrava-Hrabová, offering half-marathon and quarter-marathon courses. The race is part of the Hrabová Cup and the Moravian-Silesian Running Cup. Participants receive medals, and refreshments, changing rooms, and an accompanying program are available. The start and registration take place at the TJ Sokol Hrabová sports field. The course runs through an urban setting with a pleasant atmosphere and is suitable for a wide range of runners.

name: Jesenický maraton
description: The Jeseníky Marathon is a legendary and challenging mountain marathon in the Czech Republic, held in the Jeseníky Mountains since 2009. The marathon and half-marathon follow the same course every year, but changeable weather and mountain terrain make it feel different each time. Runners traverse the ridge of forested mountains, passing springs, primeval forests, stone fields and peat bogs, creating a unique atmosphere and challenge. The Jeseníky Marathon is for experienced endurance runners looking to conquer the highest mountain range in Moravia and Silesia.

name: Běh na Svatý Hostýn
location: Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Svatý Hostýn is a mountain race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem in the Zlín Region. Part of the Czech Hill Running Cup, it offers a challenging 5 km race with 422 metres of elevation gain, with most of the course on paved roads. The race is open to both experienced runners and the general public, attracting running enthusiasts from across the country. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of Svatý Hostýn.

name: Běh k Božímu hrobu
description: The Run to the Holy Sepulchre is a traditional running event held at Svatý Hostýn in the Zlín Region. It is part of the broader range of pilgrimage activities and sporting events at the site. The event features an uphill run finishing at the Holy Sepulchre and is an important part of the regional sporting calendar. Get ready to experience the atmosphere of this pilgrimage site and enjoy a sporting challenge in the beautiful surroundings of Svatý Hostýn.

name: Běh na Čupek
description: The Run to Čupek is a newly established race in Metylovice that has already attracted two hundred runners. The course is scenic and challenging, providing participants with an interesting experience. The race is part of the calendar of Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, and its future place on the schedule is eagerly anticipated.

name: Vavřinecký běh Moravským krasem
description: The Vavřinec Run through the Moravian Karst is a sporting event held in the village of Vavřinec in the South Moravian Region and is part of the District Running League. The event takes place on August 22, 2026, and offers various running categories suitable for the general public. It is an ideal opportunity for running enthusiasts who want to discover the beauty of the Moravian Karst and enjoy an outdoor sporting experience.

name: IV Festiwal Pustelnika
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz rozwoju Wysowej-Zdroju „Przekrocz Granice”
description: The 4th Pustelnik Festival is an annual sports and recreation event organized in the picturesque town of Wysowa-Zdrój by the Przekrocz Granice Association. The festival brings together sport, culture, and nature, offering participants the chance to take part in runs, marathons, and MTB and E-BIKE races. It’s a unique opportunity to discover the charms of the Low Beskids, spend time actively, and connect with the local community.

name: XI Bieg Obrońców Płocka 1920r
description: The International Run of the Defenders of Płock 1920 is an annual running event organized by the Płock Biega No Age Limit Club. The run commemorates the defenders of Płock in 1920 and attracts runners from various places. The event is international in character and takes place in the picturesque city of Płock, offering participants sporting competition and a chance to connect.

name: KESZTHELYI KILOMÉTEREK
description: Keszthely Kilometers is a traditional running race on the shores of Lake Balaton, taking place on August 22–23, 2026, in the rear park of Festetics Palace. Participants can choose from several distances, ranging from 3 km to the half marathon, in individual or relay categories. Children’s races are also held for the youngest runners, with different distances for each age group. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere, and the lakeside setting offers runners a special experience.

name: Minimaratón
location: Banská Bystrica, Banská Bystrica, Atletický štadión na Štiavničkách
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT OZ, Minimaratón OZ
description: Minimaratón je jedinečné bežecké podujatie určené výhradne pre rodiny s deťmi, ktoré sa koná na atletickom štadióne na Štiavničkách v Banskej Bystrici. Podujatie ponúka rôzne kategórie podľa veku detí, od najmenších bežcov po staršie deti, vrátane mamičiek s kočíkmi. Trať je prispôsobená vekovým skupinám, s okruhmi 400 m a 200 m. Okrem športového zážitku je pripravený aj sprievodný program s aktivitami pre deti a stretnutiami so športovcami. Každý účastník dostane pamätné štartové číslo, medailu a občerstvenie po dobehu.

name: Beh na boso Tatry
location: Veľká Lomnica, Veľká Lomnica, Golfový rezort Black Stork
description: Beh na boso Tatry je bežecké podujatie v krásnom prostredí Golfového rezortu Black Stork vo Veľkej Lomnici. Pretekári si môžu vybrať medzi nesúťažnými behmi pre deti a dospelých a súťažným behom na 5 km. Trať vedie po pokosenom trávniku, cez cestičky a kamienky, čo vytvára krosový charakter trate. Podujatie je vhodné pre všetky vekové kategórie a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru v prírode Tatier. Organizátorom je OZ Beh na boso Tatry, ktorý zabezpečuje kvalitný priebeh pretekov.

name: Slopenská desítka
description: Slopenská desítka is a traditional cross-country running race held in the picturesque village of Slopné near Luhačovice. The race offers a challenging course with varied terrain, including asphalt roads, steep climbs and descents through forest terrain. The start is located below the church and the finish is on the sports field, where a rousing crowd awaits the runners. The event is suitable for the general public, including junior categories and family relay teams. The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín series and the KRAKONOŠ Czech Mountain Running Cup.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Stříbrná
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in different locations, including Stříbrná, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km and the adventure route covers 20 to 30 km. In addition to the main races, there are children’s races and walking routes with map-based checkpoints. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers a beautiful natural setting in the Ore Mountains.

name: Běh pro Střížák
description: Běh pro Střížák is a traditional race held on Střížovický vrch in Ústí nad Labem, now in its 16th year. The course is a loop run three times, with one significant climb and descent; otherwise, it is gently undulating. The event also includes shorter children’s and youth races, making it accessible to the wider public. The race has an interesting story: the course passes through an area that was once threatened by a planned development, which was cancelled thanks to local residents’ opposition.

name: 7. PKO Tarnogórski Półmaraton oraz Tarnogórska Srebrna Dyszka
description: The 7th PKO Tarnogórski Half Marathon and Tarnogórska Srebrna Dyszka are the region’s biggest running celebration, taking place on 23 August 2026. The 21.0975 km half-marathon course runs entirely on paved streets in Tarnowskie Góry, with vehicle traffic partially closed. Refreshment and hydration stations are provided for participants, and the half-marathon time limit has been extended to 3 hours so everyone can cross the finish line with a smile and earn a medal. The Srebrna Dyszka is a run of approximately 10.5 km, complementing the event’s running programme.

name: IV BIEG PEŁNEJ MISKI
description: Bieg Pełnej Miski is a charity running event held in Szubin, aiming to support animal shelters through the “Pełna Miska” campaign. The race has been held annually since 2023, and the next edition is scheduled for August 23, 2026. The event combines sporting competition with the goal of helping homeless animals, engaging the local community and running enthusiasts. The organizers encourage people to take part and work together to support animals.

name: Běh Smetánkou
location: Smetánka Park, Prague 9, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Běh Smetánkou is a 3.5 km trail race held in Prague 9 and part of the SABZO series. The race gives runners the chance to enjoy a run in natural surroundings on varied terrain. It is suitable for anyone looking for a short but dynamic race in a pleasant atmosphere. The race is a longstanding part of Prague’s running season and attracts runners from the surrounding area.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Czerwonak Physical Culture Development Centre. The event takes place in the evening and combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It is a long-standing tradition that attracts participants who want to spend time outdoors, running or walking in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 5 km distance confirmed for the 2026 edition
Evening event format in Bolechowo
Part of the Active Czerwonak at Night series
additional: The event is free and takes place in the evening, usually from 19:30 to 22:00. It is a recreational sporting event and part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees or required equipment. Previous editions took place in the evening; 82 participants took part in 2026.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (9) – srpnový
description: VAŠE LIGA’s 5 km and 10 km races are a regular running series in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The races are suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to pros, and personal records are often set here. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to run a qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, participants can get together and refuel at a local restaurant. The series is part of its 16th edition and rewards not only the top runners but also loyal participants.

name: Běh Modřanskou roklí - Memoriál Zdeňka Buriana
description: The Běh Modřanskou roklí – Zdeněk Burian Memorial is a 4 km race along a gently rolling course in the Modřanská rokle Nature Reserve in Prague 4. The race is part of the SABZO series and features a staggered start, allowing the event to run smoothly. The course is suitable for runners who want to enjoy a run in nature with moderate elevation changes. It is ideal for anyone looking for a short but technically interesting race in beautiful surroundings.

name: Beskydská sedmička
description: IMOS Beskydská sedmička is an extreme mountain marathon across the entire Beskydy Mountains, running from Třinec to Frenštát pod Radhoštěm. This demanding race is approximately 101 km long with 5,500 m+ of elevation gain. It is the Czech Mountain Marathon Championship for individuals and is open to both solo runners and pairs. The race starts at night at 23:00 from the athletics stadium in Třinec, and the finish line closes after 28 hours on Sunday morning. The race offers a unique experience of the Beskydy mountain landscape and well-stocked aid stations along the course.

name: Letni Ultra Świr
description: Letni Ultra Świr is a unique 24-hour ultramarathon held on a 15 km loop near Grybów. It is a challenge for runners who want to test the limits of their endurance and enjoy an atmosphere full of sweat, dust and fatigue, but also laughter and madness. The event attracts long-distance running enthusiasts, offering a one-of-a-kind experience and intense emotions.

name: Beh vďaky Senica – Prietrž – pamätník SNP u Rehušov
location: Pamätník SNP u Rehušov, Prietrž, Senica District, Trnava Region, Slovakia

name: Kácovský běh
description: The Kácov Run is a traditional running race held on the last Saturday in August in the picturesque Posázaví region. It offers three main routes—the Nineteen, the Ten, and the Loop—with varied terrain and elevation that will challenge both experienced runners and beginners. The start and finish are in the center of Kácov, with aid stations on the longer courses. The race is timed using chip timing and accompanied by a varied program, including children’s races and a raffle.

name: Cross Parkmaraton
description: Cross Parkmaraton in Krásná Lípa is a traditional running race in the picturesque setting of Bohemian Switzerland National Park. It offers a range of events, including a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, Nordic walking, relays and canicross. The course crosses hilly terrain, mainly along forest paths, with beautiful views of the Lusatian Mountains. The race is suitable for the general public and welcomes runners of all ages, as well as families with children.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain, mainly along forest paths
Picturesque scenery in Bohemian Switzerland National Park
Views of the Lusatian Mountains
additional: The Canicross and 42 km Marathon start at 8:00; the other events (5 km, 10 km Nordic Walking, 10 km, 21 km and relays) start at 10:00. Relays are for teams of four, with each runner covering approximately 5 km on the half-marathon course. Categories are awarded by age and gender. Runners who do not meet the marathon cutoff may switch to the half marathon. Results are announced in stages from 10:05 to 14:00. The organizer provides changing rooms and showers. Canicross starts in C. Dittrich City Park; the other events start at Křinické Square. The official website also lists 10 km Nordic walking, relays, canicross and children's races.
