name: Chomutovský půlmaraton
description: The Chomutov Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque town of Chomutov in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race offers a fast and scenic course through the town’s historic center, past the unique Kamencové Lake and beautiful natural areas such as Bezruč Valley. The event also includes children’s races and relay races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. Participants in the main race can look forward to refreshments along the course and at the finish, as well as a finisher’s medal.

name: Běhej lesy Jizerská
description: Běhej lesy Jizerská is a trail race held on August 29, 2026, in the picturesque Jizera Mountains in Bedřichov. It offers various routes, including short and long distances and an ultramarathon, passing through beautiful natural locations such as Hřebínek, Smědava, Jizerka, and Olivetská hora. The race is part of the Běhej lesy series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, offering international ranking points. Runners can also take part in the Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which add extra competitive elements and prizes.

name: Proběhni si Zoo Ústí nad Labem
description: Run through Ústí nad Labem Zoo is a running event held on the grounds of the zoological garden in Ústí nad Labem. The run offers a unique opportunity to combine sporting activity with a visit to the zoo and admire the animals in their natural surroundings. The event is suitable for all age groups and encourages active leisure time in nature. We look forward to your participation and sharing an experience in the beautiful setting of the zoo.

name: Półmaraton Roztoczański im. Czesławy Kwoki , Nielisz - Zamość
11 Bieg Kurierów Sądeckich
description: The Sądecki Couriers Run is a historic mountain race held in the Sądecki Beskids, on a route from Rytro to the PTTK mountain shelter on Przehyba. The course is marked and features varied surfaces: 15% asphalt, 5% gravel roads, and 80% forest trails, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and tackle challenging terrain. The race commemorates couriers from World War II, and the course record is just under an hour. The organizer provides timekeeping, medical support, a commemorative medal, and a hot meal after the race.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwice Park Running Provocation is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026. They take place once a month on Saturdays in the park behind Piast Stadium. The 4,219.5-metre route runs mainly along forest trails and gravel paths, with some sections on asphalt. A refreshment point is located at the start/finish line. The event aims to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation under the slogan “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!”

name: Kunicki Bieg Reggae
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Kunicach
description: Kunicki Reggae Run is a nationwide sporting event held on the picturesque Lake Kunickie in Kunice. Participants can choose from three certified running routes: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. The start and finish are in front of the GOKiS in Kunice at 11 Słoneczna Street. The event combines sporting competition with a friendly atmosphere and reggae music, attracting a growing number of participants from across Poland.

name: NorDan RUN
description: NorDan RUN is a race held in the picturesque town of Wolsztyn, with routes following paths through the municipal park along Lake Wolsztyńskie. Participants can choose from several distances, from shorter races for children to challenging 48 km routes with checkpoint and refreshment stations. The start and finish are located at the “Fala Park” venue, offering convenient race arrangements and beautiful views. The race is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and enjoy the surrounding nature.

name: Tatraman
description: Tatraman is a challenging half-Ironman-distance triathlon held in the scenic areas of Polish and Slovak Spiš and the Tatra Mountains. The course starts in Niedzica on Lake Czorsztyn, crosses mountainous terrain, and finishes at the summit of Kasprowy Wierch. The event is aimed mainly at experienced athletes, but amateurs can also test their skills on this extreme course. Tatraman combines sporting competition with beautiful views and highland hospitality.

name: X Jubileuszowy Charytatywny Cross
description: The 10th Anniversary Charity Cross-Country Run and Nordic Walking event in Iwonicz-Zdrój is an annual sporting event held at Dietl Square in Iwonicz-Zdrój. The event combines a cross-country run and a Nordic walking march, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in this beautiful spa town. This anniversary edition attracts participants of different age groups and ability levels. The organizers invite everyone to take part and emphasize the event’s charitable nature.

name: Piąteczka dla każdego
location: Nowy Dwór Mazowiecki, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XI Bieg Dożynkowy
location: Kobylarnia, Gmina Nowa Wieś Wielka, Poland

name: XVII Maraton Pieszo i Rowerem Dookoła Lubina
BUDAI NIGHT TRAIL
description: The Budai Night Trail is an exciting trail running race held at night on the scenic forest trails of the Buda Hills. Participants run with headlamps, enjoying a unique experience in the dark across varied terrain. The race offers two challenging distances, 13.5 km and 17.3 km, with significant elevation gain. The event has a friendly, family-like atmosphere, and the start is at the Sports Hall in Telki.

name: MOVE SZOMBATHELY SUNSET RUN
description: The MOVE Szombathely Sunset Run is a unique evening and night running race in Szombathely’s main square, offering both children and amateur runners the opportunity to take part. The sunset and the atmosphere of the city center give the race its special feel, creating an enjoyable and motivating running experience. The event aims to make running accessible to all age groups while also providing a shared community experience.

name: SUHANJ!6
description: SUHANJ! 6 is a charity running race that supports people with disabilities and helps fund the nonprofit work of the SUHANJ! Foundation. The race takes place at the Margaret Island Athletics Centre, where participants run as many laps as possible in 6 hours on a flat, accessible 3.5 km loop. The race starts at midnight, and a sunrise is guaranteed. You can enter as an individual or as part of a team of 2–10 people, with unlimited relay changes allowed. The Éj Félmaraton also starts at midnight and follows the SUHANJ! 6 course; it is limited to 200 participants.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly, looped running race held in Dióskert, Törökbálint. Runners complete the half-marathon distance in four loops, but they can also run fewer loops. The entry fee is voluntary, at 500 Ft per loop, to help cover the costs of the race. All participants can enjoy an apple, hot tea and mulled wine, and receive a commemorative medal. The top three male and female finishers each receive a unique medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.

name: Draždiak Run
location: Bratislava - Petržalka, Bratislava - Petržalka, Veľký Draždiak (Pláž pri bufete Barracuda).
description: Draždiak Run je bežecké podujatie konané v Bratislave, v lokalite Veľký Draždiak, Petržalka. Pretekári môžu očakávať trate vedúce po štrkových a turistických chodníkoch, vhodné pre rôzne vekové kategórie a úrovne. Súčasťou sú detské behy, 5 km trate pre dospelých, nordic walking a rodinný beh so psom. Organizátorom je Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, ktorá zabezpečuje príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu.

name: Beh pod Sninským kameňom
location: Snina, Snina, Rekreačná oblasť Sninske rybníky - OMW Snina
description: Beh pod Sninským kameňom je bežecké podujatie v rekreačnej oblasti Sninské rybníky v Snine, ktoré ponúka trate pre deti aj dospelých. Preteky sa konajú na povrchu asfaltu a poľných ciest, pričom detské kategórie majú vzdialenosti od 50 do 600 metrov podľa veku. Hlavná kategória štartuje o 16:30 hodine a je rozdelená podľa vekových skupín mužov a žien. Organizátorom je BehajmeSpolu o.z. v spolupráci s mestom Snina, pričom štartovné je 15 € pri online registrácii a 20 € na mieste.

name: Běh teplickými skalami
description: The Run through the Teplice Rocks is a public trail race held every year on the last Sunday in August in Teplice nad Metují. The race dates back to 1994 and is part of the sports program of the International Mountaineering Film Festival. The 9 km course follows the Metuje River to the rock city, includes sandy sections and stairs, and returns along the same route. Since 2011, the event has also included a children’s race with age categories. The start and finish are at the TJ Slavoj football field.

name: Běh zámeckou zahradou
organizer: Tělocvičná jednota Sokol Lysá nad Labem
description: The Castle Garden Run is a traditional running race held in the castle park in Lysá nad Labem. The 62nd edition takes place on 30 August 2025 and is open to a wide range of participants, from preschoolers to seniors. The race offers a pleasant setting in a historic park and encourages sporting activity for all age groups. It is organised by T. J. Sokol Lysá nad Labem, which has long supported sport for everyone.

name: Běh Bezděkovem
description: Běh Bezděkovem is a traditional cross-country race covering approximately 9 km, held in the picturesque surroundings of Bezděkov pod Třemšínem. The course runs mainly along forest paths through hilly terrain with moderate elevation changes and includes a mix of paved and stony sections. The race starts at the hunting lodge and features a challenging climb with gradients of up to 7% that will test runners’ fitness. After this demanding section comes a final descent and a flat finish, giving runners a chance to show their speed. The event also includes children’s races, making it appealing to a wide audience.

name: Kolínská desítka
description: Kolínská desítka is a 10 km out-and-back race on paved roads and a well-maintained forest path around the Mirka Tučka sports stadium in Kolín. The race is part of the Kolín Grand Prix and offers runners a pleasant mix of paved surfaces and natural surroundings. It is suitable for all runners looking for a fast yet scenic run in nature. Come enjoy the race atmosphere and test yourself against other runners in the beautiful surroundings of Kolín.

name: Rakovnická 15
description: Rakovnická Patnáctka is a 15 km road race whose start alternates each year between the towns of Rakovník and Křivoklát. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and offers runners the chance to test themselves on an attractive course in the beautiful surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for all runners looking for a quality road race with a tradition and the atmosphere of a regional running cup.

name: Sázava - Lázek
description: Sázava-Lázek is an uphill race covering 7.9 km with an elevation gain of 375 metres. The course starts on asphalt and continues along field and forest paths, with the steepest climb near the finish. This race offers challenging and varied terrain for runners seeking a challenge in the natural surroundings of the Pardubice Region.

name: Běh okolo Hříšné Milady
description: The Run Around Hříšná Milada is a cross-country race near Česká Lípa in the Liberec Region, offering two distances of 12 km and 6 km. The route runs mainly along forest roads and hiking trails that are open to regular traffic. The race is part of the District Running League and is suitable for trail running enthusiasts looking for natural terrain with technical challenges. The main category traditionally starts at 11:45, making it easy for a wide range of runners to take part.

name: Všenory - Jíloviště
location: Všenory, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

name: 11 Bieg po Oddech
description: The 11th Bieg po Oddech is a charity 5 km run through the streets of Zakopane, taking place on August 30, 2026. The event supports people with cystic fibrosis, and every participant receives a T-shirt and a medal. After the race, a family picnic with games and competitions is held. The run promotes physical activity as part of rehabilitation and support for people with the condition, as well as social integration.

name: Jurajskie Mistrzostwa NA SKRAJU PRZEŁAJU
description: The Jurassic Championships ON THE EDGE OF CROSS-COUNTRY are challenging cross-country races held in scenic Przewodziszowice near Żarki, in the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. The courses run across Jurassic hills, limestone outcrops, dense forests, winding trails, rocky climbs, and open spaces with panoramic views of the Jurassic Landscape Park. The event offers a variety of distances, from short races for beginners and Nordic walkers to the demanding Trentaraton for experienced runners. It’s a great opportunity to compete and enjoy the beauty of nature.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held on the shores of historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon in 1984. Athletes can expect calm, warm waters for the swim, a fast and flat bike course through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań, and a run towards the city centre, finishing at the Poznań International Fairgrounds—a modern symbol of the city. This unique event combines sporting competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.

name: Kresowe Trail #10
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Maratony Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in nature. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The events are open to both beginners and experienced runners, and aim to build a running community based on passion, competition, and friendship. They are non-commercial and small-scale, with a limited number of participants to ensure safety and high-quality organization.

name: Półmaraton Buski
organizer: Buski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Busku-Zdroju
description: The Busko Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Busko-Zdrój. In 2026, it will take place on August 30. The race starts at the Municipal Stadium at 8:30 a.m. The half-marathon course passes prominent hotels and sanatoriums, the picturesque Spa Park, and charming pedestrian streets, giving the race a distinctive atmosphere. The time limit for completing the 21.0975 km distance is 3 hours and 30 minutes. The race is open to both experienced runners and amateurs.

name: VII Maraton od Zmierzchu do Świtu
NYAKVÁGÓ MARATON
distance_verbose: Maraton, 22.5 km, 14 km, 7.3 km, 3000 meter, 0.4 km
description: The Nyakvágó Marathon is a challenging trail-running race in the Kiskunság near Ballószög, offering the marathon distance under tougher conditions. The event offers a range of distances, including 14 km, 22.5 km, and 42 km runs, as well as a mountain-bike race. The course is close to nature and follows agricultural dirt roads, with aid stations every 4–5 kilometers. The event aims to promote an active lifestyle and bring the local community together. Participants must protect nature and follow the rules, and mountain bikers are required to wear helmets.

name: UFO ÓCSA FUTÁS
description: The UFÓ Ócsa Run is a popular city running race held in Ócsa, near the Egressy Gábor Leisure Centre. The event offers challenges over several distances, including 10.5 km and 21 km races that pass through the city's landmarks. The race uses unique chip timing, and places are ranked by gun time. With age restrictions and a limited number of participants, the event welcomes runners in a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: Běh Anny-Marie
description: The Anna-Marie Run is a race held in Prague 4, offering a 6.6 km course over mixed terrain through Milíčovský Forest and over an artificial hill. The event is organized by the SABZO Praha association and is part of its running series, attracting runners of all levels. The course includes both forest paths and paved sections, making the race appealing to different types of runners. The race takes place on September 2, 2026, and offers a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere in Prague.

name: EMU 6 DAYS RACE / GOMU 6 DAYS WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP
description: The EMU 6-Day Race, also known as the GOMU 6-Day World Championship, is one of the world’s most prestigious multi-day ultramarathon events, held in Balatonfüred. During the race, participants run for six days, testing their stamina and endurance. The event is traditionally the pinnacle of multi-day ultrarunning, and world records have been set there. Competitors face a unique challenge that tests both their physical and mental strength.

name: Z Ľubotína na hrad Plaveč
location: Ľubotín, Ľubotín, Polyfunkčný dom Ľubotín (budova za obecným úradom)
description: Beh Z Ľubotína na hrad Plaveč je tradičný bežecký pretek, ktorý štartuje v obci Ľubotín pri Polyfunkčnom dome. Pretek ponúka kategórie pre mužov, ženy, juniorov, nordic walking a hobby beh na 4 km. Štart hlavnej kategórie je o 17:30, detské kategórie začínajú o 16:30. Organizátormi sú obce Ľubotín a Plaveč, ktoré vítajú bežcov všetkých vekových kategórií a úrovní. Pretek je vhodný pre tých, ktorí chcú zažiť beh v peknom prostredí s cieľom na hrade Plaveč.

name: Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3
description: Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3 is a nighttime 10 km race taking place on September 4, 2026, in Jelcz-Laskowice. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for autumn races. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different experience levels so everyone can prepare for the race effectively. The event is for runners who enjoy the atmosphere of running at night and the thrill of competition.

name: Beh Novoveskou Hutou
location: Novoveská Huta, Spišská Nová Ves, Slovakia
organizer: Športový Klub ROHALS a Mesto Spišská Nová Ves

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: muži nad 60 a ženy nad 50 rokov - 3 €

price_tiers.distance: Dorast a beh pre zdravie 5 km

description: Športový klub Rohals vás srdečne pozýva na 16. ročník Behu Novoveskou Hutou, ktorý sa uskutoční v Novoveskej Hute. Pre dospelých je pripravená nová trať dlhá 12,2 km vedúca na Vojtechovu samotu a späť, jednotná pre ženy aj mužov. Pre tých, ktorí preferujú kratšie trate, je k dispozícii 5 km trať. Deti a mladí bežci budú súťažiť na kratších tratiach v uliciach Huty podľa vekových kategórií. Po behu si účastníci môžu doplniť energiu gulášom, deti sa môžu tešiť na divadielko a dospelých zabaví kapela 3násť ciest.
course_highlights: Nová trať pre dospelých vedie na Vojtechovu samotu (Šadroň) a späť
Dĺžka trate pre dospelých je 12,2 km, jednotná pre ženy a mužov
Krátke trate pre deti v uliciach Novoveskej Huty podľa vekových kategórií
additional: Prezentácia pre žiactvo je od 11:30 do 12:45, pre dorast a dospelých do 14:45. Štart možný len v jednej kategórii. Po behu je zabezpečený guláš, deti majú divadielko a dospelých zabáva kapela 3násť ciest. V kategóriách dospelých sa súťaží o body do Bežeckej ligy okresu Spišská Nová Ves. Trať 12,2 km a 5 km, kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny, registrácia v deň podujatia, sprievodné aktivity pre deti a dospelých

name: Marathon Chopok
description: Marathon Chopok je náročný horský beh v nádhernom prostredí Nízkych Tatier, ktorý preverí vaše schopnosti na rôznych povrchoch a terénoch. Pretek sa koná 5. septembra 2026 so štartom o 7:00 zo Srdiečka a cieľom na Chopku vo výške 2004 m n.m. K dispozícii sú dve hlavné trate: SkyMarathon Chopok s dĺžkou 43 km a prevýšením 2600 m, a kratšia Sky Race Jasná Trail s dĺžkou 21 km a prevýšením 1400 m. Na dlhej trati je tiež možnosť štartovať v štafetách. Trať vedie po južnej aj severnej strane Chopku, vrátane hlavného hrebeňa, a ponúka krásne výhľady a rôznorodý terén.

name: Kokava Trail
description: Kokava Trail je certifikovaný trailový beh so štartom a cieľom v Kokave nad Rimavicou, ktorý vedie okruhmi pohorí Veporské vrchy a Stolické vrchy. Preteká sa na dvoch tratiach - hlavná trať má dĺžku 78 km s prevýšením +3330 m a časovým limitom 18 hodín, kratšia Pasiečky Trail má 23 km a +1200 m prevýšenia s limitom 7 hodín. Trasa je rôznorodá, s 45 % lúčnych úsekov, 45 % lesných chodníkov a 10 % asfaltu, pričom neobsahuje ťažké technické pasáže, ale niekoľko strmších zostupov a výstupov. Pretekáči ocenia šesť občerstvovačiek a povinnú výbavu, ktorá zahŕňa izotermickú fóliu, čelovú lampu, mobil s nabitou SIM kartou, GPS zariadenie, reflexnú vestu a dostatok tekutín. Víťazi v kategóriách Muži, Ženy, Muži 50+ a Ženy 50+ získajú medaily a vecné ceny počas vyhlásenia v kultúrnom dome.

name: Prešov Running Series 3. kolo
description: Prešov Running Series 3. kolo je súčasťou série bežeckých podujatí v Prešove, ktoré sa konajú počas roka 2026. Podujatie je určené pre všetky vekové kategórie a úrovne bežcov, od začiatočníkov až po profesionálov. Trate sú pripravené tak, aby spájali komunitu, podporovali zdravý životný štýl a prinášali radosť z pohybu. Súčasťou štartovného je časomiera, medaila, občerstvenie a sprievodný program. Deti, ktoré sú členmi Prešov Running Team, môžu bežať zdarma.

name: 6 hodinovka pod Šarišským hradom
location: Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, Ul. Doliny
description: 6 hodinovka pod Šarišským hradom je vytrvalostný bežecký pretek konaný v lokalite Veľký Šariš, okr. Prešov. Pretek je určený pre jednotlivcov i štafety, pričom kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia. Štartovné je jednotné pre všetkých bežcov a pretek ponúka možnosť otestovať svoju vytrvalosť v šesťhodinovom behu v krásnom prostredí pod hradom. Organizátormi sú Gejza Sabanoš a Ondrej Fedor, ktorí zabezpečujú hladký priebeh podujatia.

name: Ozorovská dvanastka
location: Malé Ozorovce, Malé Ozorovce, Parkovisko pred KD
description: Ozorovská dvanástka je bežecký pretek konaný v Malých Ozorovciach, ktorý ponúka trate pre deti aj dospelých. Pretek je organizovaný OZ Zorovčan v spolupráci s obcou Veľké Ozorovce a pretekári môžu súťažiť na 6 km a 12 km tratiach s kategóriami podľa veku a pohlavia. Štart pre deti je o 9:00 a pre dospelých o 10:00 hodine. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru v blízkosti kultúrneho domu.

name: Horský kros Gerlach
location: Gerlachov okr. Poprad, Gerlachov okr. Poprad, Gerlachov od pomníka ( Prezentácia: Obecný úrad Gerlachov )
description: Horský kros Gerlach je tradičný horský beh do vrchu, ktorý vedie z obce Gerlachov cez Velickú dolinu až k horskému hotelu Sliezsky dom. Trať má dĺžku 8400 metrov s prevýšením 879 metrov a pretekári prekonávajú kamenistý chodník a miestami asfaltovú cestu. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov, ktorí majú radi náročný horský terén a krásne výhľady na Vysoké Tatry. Súčasťou pretekov sú aj detské behy a možnosť zakúpiť si štartovné s originálnymi ponožkami Horského krosu Gerlach.

name: Beh za Tatry
location: Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, pod vyhliadkovou vežou Tatras Tower
organizer: Barbora a Slavomír Ogurčákovci v spolupráci s občianskym združením Žiť Tatry
description: Beh za Tatry je bežecké podujatie konané v malebnom prostredí Štrbského Plesa vo Vysokých Tatrách, pod vyhliadkovou vežou Tatras Tower. Preteky ponúkajú štart pre deti o 14:00 a pre dospelých o 16:00 hod., pričom trať vedie po prírodnom povrchu pozdĺž brehu jazera a bežeckých lyžiarskych tratiach. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, čo umožňuje širokú účasť bežcov rôznych vekových skupín. Organizátormi sú Barbora a Slavomír Ogurčákovci v spolupráci s občianskym združením Žiť Tatry, ktorí zabezpečujú príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu.

name: Veľatský lesný beh
description: Veľatský lesný beh je tradičné bežecké podujatie organizované občianskym združením OZ Stopa v obci Veľaty. Pretek sa koná na ihrisku FK Veľaty a ponúka trate rôznych dĺžok pre mužov a ženy od 15 rokov, pričom detské behy sú pripravené priamo na futbalovom ihrisku. Podujatie je známe svojou priateľskou atmosférou, dobrovoľným štartovným formou daru a zabezpečeným občerstvením. Počas dňa pretekárov sprevádzajú dobrovoľníci a výsledky sú merané časomiery s vyhlásením víťazov a odovzdaním vecných cien.

name: Telekom Night run
distance_verbose: 50 km, Maratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3.2 km

name: SOKOLOVSKÁ 12/24 RUN
description: Sokolovská 12/24 RUN is an endurance running race lasting 6, 12 or 24 hours, open to individuals, pairs and teams of four. The race takes place on an easy, gently undulating loop around the Michal Natural Swimming Area in Sokolov. It starts on Saturday, 5 September 2026 at 11:15. Camping accommodation with full facilities is available. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners and offers various age and team categories, with exchanges permitted in the transition area by the refreshment stand.

name: Běh kolem Světa
description: Běh kolem Světa is a traditional running event held in Třeboň, following a route around the Svět pond. Since its launch in 2012, the race has gained a loyal following and offers an attractive 11.7 km course that follows the Svět Nature Trail. The event takes place every September and is popular for its natural scenery and varied terrain, including dirt, mud, sand, grass, wooden footbridges, and sections of asphalt. The race is suitable for runners of all abilities, and entry can also be purchased as a Christmas voucher.

name: Mirovice - Běh do háje
location: Mirovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

name: Podhostýnská 10
location: Zámecký park, Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Czech Republic
description: Podhostýnská 10ka is a running race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem, offering 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as children’s races. The event takes place in the castle park and is part of the Běhy Zlín running series. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all ages who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in beautiful surroundings. The organizers emphasize tradition and high-quality race organization.

name: Běh Plzeňské teplárenské kolem Boleveckých rybníků
description: The Plzeňská teplárenská Run around the Bolevec Ponds is a traditional running event organized by Pro Sport Activities, offering races for children and adults in the picturesque setting of the Bolevec Ponds in Plzeň. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup and is suitable for the general public, including the youngest runners. Entry is free, and the first 300 people to register will receive a voucher for refreshments. In addition to the races, there is a program for children and an autograph session with athletes.

name: Birell Večerní Běh na 10 km Praha
description: The Birell Prague Evening 10 km Run is a traditional night race offering a unique atmosphere as Prague’s streets light up. The race starts at dusk, giving runners the chance to experience the city’s beauty in an unusual light. You can take part individually or as part of a team and enjoy the magical nighttime atmosphere beneath the stars. The race is part of the RunCzech running series and attracts thousands of runners every year.

name: adidas Běh pro ženy 5 km Praha
description: Come and run the adidas Women’s 5K in Prague, the largest race created specifically for women. The 5 km course is suitable even for runners with no prior training, with a 50-minute time limit. Enjoy the unique atmosphere and the support of thousands of women at an exclusive race with no men on the course. Sign up with your friends and share the joy of running and solidarity.

name: Barokomaraton
description: Barokomaraton is the 19th edition of a cross-country race held in the picturesque town of Plasy and the valley of the Střela River. The race is intended both for experienced runners and for those who run for pleasure and want to enjoy the beautiful autumn scenery. Runners can expect routes along forest and field paths, with regular refreshment stations. The organizers are also preparing a cultural program, entertainment for children, and refreshments, making Barokomaraton an enjoyable day of sport and relaxation for the whole family.

name: Strážný nahoru a dolů
description: Strážný Up and Down is part of the ISCAREX Cup, a traditional series of running races in the Pardubice Region. The race offers a challenging uphill and downhill run in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Dobrouč. The organizers provide a great sporting atmosphere and facilities for all participants. The event is suitable for experienced runners and recreational athletes who want to try running on hilly terrain.

name: Lupenická dvanáctka
description: The Lupenice Twelve is a traditional running race in Lupenice, held for the 33rd year. The race offers a 12 km course with 98 metres of elevation gain, running entirely on asphalt and clearly marked. The start is at the Lupenice sports complex, and the race is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix. All participants run at their own risk, and those under 18 must provide parental consent.

name: Jenštejnská pětka
description: The Jenštejn Five is an annual 5 km running race held in the village of Jenštejn since 2014. In addition to the main race, other running categories are also held, making the event accessible to a wide range of runners. It is a traditional sporting gathering in the Central Bohemian Region and offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in the picturesque setting of Jenštejn.

name: Zbraslavská Závist
description: Zbraslavská Závist is a trail uphill race that starts in Prague-Zbraslav near the former mini zoo and leads to the former Celtic hillfort at the top of Závist. The course is 3.5 km long with 190 metres of elevation gain, offering a challenging and interesting running experience. The race is suitable for athletes ready for a fast start and a demanding climb. It is organised by KOPEC, z.s., under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation, and is part of Prague’s traditional running calendar.

name: RAWki na Surowo
description: RAWki na Surowo is a mountain trail race held in the magical Bieszczady Mountains, taking runners across the scenic alpine meadows of Mała and Wielka Rawka. The 29 km course with 1,550 m of elevation gain passes through Bieszczady National Park, requiring the race to be held without aid stations or course markings. The event is certified by ITRA and UTMB and is part of the MTrail Running Series. The start and finish are in Wetlina, and the race follows a self-supported format, emphasizing its rugged character.

name: Chojnik Karkonoski Festiwal Biegowy
description: Chojnik Karkonoski Running Festival is a mountain running event held in Sobieszów, in the heart of the Karkonosze Mountains. The festival offers a range of distances, from a family-friendly educational run to a challenging 102 km ultramarathon with over 5,000 m of elevation gain. The routes follow scenic, rocky trails in Karkonosze National Park, offering unique views and challenges for runners of varying experience levels. The event brings people together and promotes running as a team sport, as well as nature education.

name: Olkuski Bieg Uliczny
description: The Olkusz Street Run VII Silver Ten is an annual running event organized by the Olkuszbiega Association, the Olkusz Municipal and Town Office, and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Olkusz. The 10 km main race consists of two 5 km loops, with chip timing and markers every kilometer. The route follows streets with asphalt and partial cobblestone surfaces; the start and finish are in the Market Square in Olkusz. The event promotes an active lifestyle and running as a form of recreation for all age groups.

name: Półmaraton Praski
description: The Praski Half Marathon is an annual running event in Warsaw that attracts both recreational and experienced runners. The half-marathon course passes through the scenic and historic parts of Praga, offering participants unique views and atmosphere. The event takes place at night, adding a distinctive character and appeal. The organizers provide professional support, timekeeping, and race packages including an official T-shirt.

name: I Mistrzostwa Śląska Osób z Niepełnosprawnościami
V Bieg Pamięci Ofiar Bombardowania Węzła Kolejowego
SÜMEG TRAIL
description: The Sümeg Trail is a major sporting event in the town of Sümeg and has attracted running enthusiasts for five years. The race offers challenges over four distances, which participants can complete amid the town’s distinctive and beautiful surroundings. The event also includes a range of sports activities and health screenings, with yoga classes, meditation and other forms of exercise on offer alongside the running. The Sümeg Trail is a lively community event that promotes sport and a healthy lifestyle.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 9. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelný 2 míľový bežecký závod organizovaný Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamom v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave. Preteky sú určené pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov, ktorí sú rozdelení do kategórií. Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste pri volejbalovom ihrisku od 9:30, štart je o 10:00. Súťaž je súčasťou série pretekov, kde bežci zbierajú body do Putovného pohára Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu podľa svojich výkonov a veku.

name: Dukelský beh mieru
location: Svidník, Svidník, Štart: Dukliansky priesmyk, Cieľ: pešia zóna Svidník
description: Dukelský beh mieru je jeden z najstarších a najvýznamnejších bežeckých podujatí na Slovensku, ktorý sa koná každoročne v prvú septembrovú nedeľu. Trať vedie z Dukly do centra Svidníka a meria 19 kilometrov s prevýšením od 479 m n.m. na štarte po 244 m n.m. v cieli. Bežci prechádzajú historickou trasou spojenou s Karpatsko-duklianskou operáciou, ktorá pripomína obete a boj za mier v rokoch 1944-1945. Podujatie má bohatú históriu a silný emotívny význam, pričom sa na ňom stretávajú výkonnostní bežci aj amatéri.

name: Vorkloster run (1. etapa)
description: Vorkloster Run is a stage race held in the picturesque foothills of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands, amid the medieval atmosphere of Porta Coeli Monastery. The race features three stages of varying distances and profiles, from a fast, flat stage to more challenging hilly sections. It is organized by the experienced DálRunDál team in cooperation with the Porta Coeli Monastery Brewery, which adds to the authentic experience. The routes are carefully marked and run mostly away from traffic, offering beautiful views of the surrounding countryside and historic landmarks.

name: Ostrava City Marathon
location: Masarykovo náměstí, Moravská Ostrava, Ostrava, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ceny absolutního pořadí (ženy i muži) 1. 5.000,- Kč 2. 3.000,- Kč 3. 2.000,- Kč 4. 1.000,- Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ceny absolutního pořadí (ženy i muži) 1. 4.000,- Kč 2. 3.000,- Kč 3. 2.000,- Kč 4. 1.000,- Kč

description: The Ostrava City Marathon is the oldest marathon in the Czech Republic, bringing a sporting atmosphere to the centre of Ostrava every year and connecting the world of running with the city’s industrial spirit. It offers a wide range of race categories, from children’s runs and relays to the classic marathon, and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The running festival is open to everyone who wants to experience its unique atmosphere and support the charitable MiniMarathon. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square, allowing runners and spectators alike to enjoy the centre of Ostrava in motion.
course_highlights: The marathon course runs through Ostrava’s historic centre
Refreshments are available on the course approximately every 5 km and at the finish
Accompanying activities and an exercise programme with INDIVIDUAL FITNESS
additional: Online registration is open until 28.8.2026 at 23:59, after which it closes. On-site registration is available only on Saturday 5.9.2026, subject to capacity, except for the non-competitive MiniMarathon. Race numbers are personalised according to the registered race distance; electronic timekeeping is provided by non-returnable chips included with the race number. Refreshments, toilets, showers, changing rooms and baggage storage are available for participants. Start times: marathon and half marathon at 09:00, relay at 09:20, children’s races from 09:45. The accompanying programme includes an exercise programme with INDIVIDUAL FITNESS and a performance by Judo Club Baník Ostrava. The MiniMarathon is a charity run. According to the organiser, the event takes place in all weather and is wheelchair accessible.

name: Podčerchovský kros
description: The Podčerchovský Cross-Country Run is a challenging cross-country race held on Babí hora near Chodov. It follows forest paths with several tough climbs. The longest loop is 2.5 km and is also suitable for runners wearing spikes. The race is open to all age groups, with various distances ranging from children’s races to the men’s main event. Results are announced shortly after the race, and winners receive medals and prizes, with cash awards also offered in the main category.

name: Běh na Lahti
description: We invite you to the 47th edition of the traditional Běh na Lahti running race, taking place on September 6, 2026, in Děčín. The race offers two courses: the main course is nearly 10 km long with 230 meters of elevation gain, passing the Kvádrberk viewpoint and continuing above the village of Ludvíkovice; the shorter course is just under 5 km long with 130 meters of elevation gain. The route runs through the forests above the sandstone canyon of the Elbe River, offering beautiful views and a challenging run. Check-in and registration take place at the start from 8:00 to 9:45. The race starts at 9:00.

name: Rychnov pomáhá během
description: Rychnov Helps Through Running is a charity race held in Rychnov nad Kněžnou, offering routes for children and adults in various age categories. The race takes place in early September and is known for its friendly atmosphere, accompanying program, and support for those in need. Every participant receives a race pack and a medal, while the best runners in each category win valuable prizes. The event also includes an autograph session and a fun quiz with prizes, contributing to a family-friendly atmosphere and community spirit.

name: Běh mezi mosty
description: The Run Between the Bridges is a charity sporting event organized by the Athelas Home Hospice and the Friends of the Stone Bridge in Písek Association. Reviving the tradition of the original race, it is for everyone who wants to support seriously ill patients and their families. Participants can run, walk, or make a symbolic contribution. The entry fee is a donation that helps provide care at home for those who can no longer run. The event takes place in Písek and offers a variety of routes, including children’s runs and family walks.

name: Jihlavský půlmaraton
location: Sportovně relaxační centrum Český mlýn, Jihlava, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 500 Kč na osobu při elektronickém přihlášení a bezhotovostní platbě.

description: The Jihlava Half Marathon is a traditional 21.0975 km race run over two laps in the Český mlýn Sports and Recreation Centre in Jihlava. The race is open to individuals, pairs and teams of four, and the course is officially measured and marked every kilometre. In addition to the main race, the programme includes children’s races, a family run and a 10 km race. The event features a wide range of activities for the whole family and supports Nikča, who is facing serious health problems.
course_highlights: Officially measured 21.0975 km course over two laps (10.54 km each)
Refreshment stations approximately every 3 km with water and isotonic drinks
Start and finish at the Český mlýn Sports and Recreation Centre in Jihlava
additional: The race bib includes a timing chip that does not need to be returned. Relay teams receive a chip at registration and return it after the race. Registration and race bib collection take place at Decathlon Jihlava on the Friday before the race and at the start venue on race day. Refreshments are available on the course, with more at the finish, along with accompanying activities including sports and entertainment for children. Parking is recommended at the free car parks at Kaufland, OBI, Albert Hypermarket and Vodní ráj. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the venue. The 2027 edition takes place on 5 September, with the start scheduled for 11:00. The programme also includes the Decathlon 10 km race and a family run. The event facilities are at the Český mlýn complex.

name: Horský čtvrtmaraton Jablonné nad Orlicí - Suchý vrch
description: The Jablonné nad Orlicí–Suchý vrch Mountain Quarter Marathon is a mountain race taking place on 6 September 2026 in Jablonné nad Orlicí. The course climbs through mountain terrain to Suchý vrch and is part of the Czech Cup in Hill Running and the Krkonoše Cup in Hill Running. The race covers approximately 10 km with around 580 metres of elevation gain. The course challenges runners’ endurance and their ability to run on technical mountain terrain. Registration is available on site, and the race is intended for runners looking for a challenge in nature.

name: 14 Tyski Półmaraton
description: The 14th Tychy Half Marathon is a 21.0975 km race certified by the PZLA. It runs through the streets of Tychy and around Lake Paprocany. The start, finish, and race village are located at the Tychy Athletics Stadium. The event promotes an active lifestyle and the city’s sporting spirit, and offers numerous activities, including children’s races, massages, and sports demonstrations. The course was modified in 2022 to reduce the number of uphill sections, making it more participant-friendly. The race is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Tychy and has been growing in popularity since 2012.

name: 26 Eco Półmaraton Wałbrzych
description: The 26th edition of the Toyota Eko Half Marathon Wałbrzych is one of the most important running events in the region and the country, attracting runners from all over Poland. Following last year’s organizational success and record attendance, the event once again confirms its strong position on Poland’s sporting map. Participants gave the half-marathon course very high ratings, and the unique atmosphere created by Wałbrzych’s supporters gives the event its unmistakable character. We warmly invite you to take part or cheer on the runners.

name: Bieg KoBBiet
description: Bieg KoBBiet is an annual race held in Bielsko-Biała. In 2026, it will take place on September 6 at the Municipal Stadium. The event is dedicated to the memory of Ewa Szymanek-Płaska, head of the Education and Sports Department at Bielsko-Biała City Hall. This year’s race supports children on the autism spectrum. Registration opens on April 10, 2026, at 10:00. The race is held under the honorary patronage of Bielsko-Biała Mayor Jarosław Klimaszewski.

name: Szybka Piątka Sokoła
description: Szybka Piątka Sokoła is a 5 km race held in Bukownica, Mazowieckie. It’s a great opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness on an easy asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to their individual levels and offer support from experts. The event has a friendly, motivating atmosphere and is ideal for those who want to improve their fitness and enjoy running.

name: XVIII Bieg Koguta
description: The 18th Bieg Koguta is a 10 km race held in Oława on September 6, 2026. The event is organized by the Oławska Grupa Biegowa in cooperation with local institutions, and participants can expect professional timekeeping. The race office will be open both the day before the race and on race day, making it easier to collect race packs. The race is open and welcoming to runners of different ability levels.

name: Bieg na Rowerze - Rower na Biegu
Běžecká série Berounka – Srbsko
description: The Berounka Running Series in Srbsko is a community trail race run mostly along the Heart of the Bohemian Karst Nature Trail. The route starts at the railway station and passes over the Srbsko footbridge, by the Bubovice Waterfalls and through the Kačák Valley along the Berounka River to the finish. The race offers beautiful natural scenery, a friendly atmosphere, and on-site refreshments and storage for personal belongings. Each participant receives a race number, and the top three finishers in each category receive diplomas.

name: S kopečka do kopečka
description: The S kopečka do kopečka Run is a traditional endurance race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering runners the chance to test themselves on a challenging course in Olomouc. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix of Endurance Runners series and is open to both recreational runners and competitive athletes. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for anyone looking to enjoy a run in beautiful surroundings and take on the challenge of hilly terrain.

name: Novostrašecký běh - Memoriál Vildy Šubrta
description: Novostrašecký běh – Vilda Šubrt Memorial is a traditional running race held in Nové Strašecí, featuring a 6 km course. The race takes place at the SK Nové Strašecí football stadium and in the surrounding area, on a mix of asphalt, field and forest paths. The main category is scheduled to start at 18:00. The race is suitable for the general public; adults pay an entry fee of 100 CZK, while children can take part for free. Online registration is available even on race day, making it easy to participate.

name: Geofyzikální běh
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Geophysical Run is a traditional running event organized by the Institute of Geophysics of the Czech Academy of Sciences. It takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Krč Forest in Prague 4. The event has a long history dating back to 1985 and offers a sporting experience in nature with a scientific background. It is open to the general public and combines physical activity with the popularization of geophysics and the natural sciences.

name: 7. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Run for Health is a charity series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run offers a 3 km route that everyone can complete at their own pace. Proceeds from entry fees go to help those in need, giving the event purpose and added value. The start is traditionally at 17:45 at Lodičky, with registration beginning at 17:00. Everyone is warmly invited to take part and support a good cause.

name: Witzenmann Opavská míle
description: The Witzenmann Opava Mile is a prestigious one-mile (1609 m) running race that continues the tradition of the Stanislav Mikeska Memorial. The race is open to a wide range of participants, including professionals, amateurs, children, families, corporate and school teams, people with disabilities, and wheelchair users. It takes place in Opava and is supported by its presenting partner, Witzenmann Opava. The course record is held by Filip Sasínek, with a time of 3:55 minutes set in 2023. The race is held regularly and is one of the most significant running events in the Czech Republic.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Liberec
description: The Night Run for Světluška in Liberec is a charity running event held on September 10, 2026, at the Vesec sports complex. Participants can choose between a 3 km course (1 lap) and a 6 km course (2 laps), with the run starting at 8:00 p.m. The entry fee is 500 CZK, half of which supports the Světluška project and half of which goes toward direct assistance for people with severe visual impairments. The event offers an accompanying program, including a concert, and race packs with a headlamp or sports headband for those who register early.

name: Běh Akátkami
description: Běh Akátkami is a regular running race in Brno-Židenice, with courses for men, women, and children. Men run 5.2 km (3 laps), women 3.6 km (2 laps), and children of any age have their own 1.6 km lap. The race takes place in the evening, with registration from 17:15 and the main race starting at 18:00. Refreshments and baggage storage are available after the finish. Participants compete at their own risk and can use public transport and parking nearby.

name: Prajzské kilo
description: Prajzské kilo is an ultratrail race through the Hlučínsko region, recalling the historic borders and stories of a region divided in 1742. The race offers three distances—30, 50 and 100 km—with different time limits and elevation gains. You’ll run through a landscape of old roads, chapels and field tracks, bearing the traces of history and the identity of local residents. The race counts toward the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup and also offers points for the UTMB Index and ITRA. Participants receive a unique medal and T-shirt, with refreshments along the course and at the finish. Childcare is available for the shorter distances.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026
distance_verbose: 100 mil, 50 mil, Ultramaraton, Maraton, 24 km, Półmaraton, 10 km
description: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026 is a mountain trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Table Mountains, near Radków Reservoir. The courses pass through rocky mazes, technical trails, and beautiful rock formations such as Szczeliniec Wielki and Błędne Skały. The event attracts both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners, offering a range of distances and a unique atmosphere close to nature. Radków is an ideal place for a sporting adventure and a chance to recharge amid nature.

name: Nočný beh mestom Lučenec
description: Nočný beh mestom Lučenec je nočný bežecký pretek vedený osvetlenými ulicami mesta Lučenec s dĺžkou trate 4,5 km. Podujatie je určené pre širokú verejnosť vrátane juniorov a dospelých, s kategóriami podľa veku a pohlavia. Organizátorom je Mesto Lučenec a OZ Novohrad, pretek sa koná pri Synagóge s elektronickou časomierou a čipovou technológiou. Štart je plánovaný na 19:30 a pretekárov čaká pamätná medaila, štartové číslo, občerstvenie a sprievodný program.

name: Školáčik detský beh
description: Školáčik detský beh je bežecké podujatie pre deti rôznych vekových kategórií, ktoré sa koná v Lučenci pri synagóge. Organizátormi sú mesto Lučenec a OZ Novohrad. Preteky sú určené pre chlapcov a dievčatá od 3 do 15 rokov vrátane, vrátane detí so zdravotným hendikepom. Štartovné je symbolické a podporuje účasť detí na športových aktivitách v príjemnom prostredí mesta.

name: Beh okolo Lysej
location: Lysá pod Makytou okr. Púchov, Lysá pod Makytou okr. Púchov, pri kultúrnom dome
description: Beh okolo Lysej je tradičný bežecký pretek v obci Lysá pod Makytou, ktorý ponúka rôzne kategórie pre deti, juniorov, ženy a mužov podľa veku. Preteky sa konajú pri kultúrnom dome a sú organizované Bežeckým klubom Lysá pod Makytou. Štart pre deti je o 11:00, pre kategórie E, ženy a juniorov o 12:30 a pre mužov o 13:00. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a podporuje aktívny životný štýl v regióne.

name: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky
description: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky sú nočné trailové preteky v krásnej vinárskej oblasti Topoľčianok, ktoré sa uskutočnia 12. septembra 2026. Bežci si užijú trasy vedúce okolo Zámku v Topoľčiankach a Hradu Hrušov, s lesnými cestičkami a atmosférou pod hviezdami. Preteky sú súčasťou série Behaj lesmi a sú zaradené do medzinárodného UTMB Indexu, čo zvyšuje ich prestíž. Súťažiť sa bude na dvoch hlavných trasách - 11 km a 22 km, pričom na trati je aj rýchlostný úsek Conti Speed Section s hodnotnou výhrou.

name: Marina Liptov RUN
location: Bobrovník, okres Liptovský Mikuláš, Bobrovník, okres Liptovský Mikuláš, Marina Liptov
organizer: Olympijský klub Liptova a rezort Marina Liptov
description: Marina Liptov RUN je športovo-rekreačné podujatie v krásnom prostredí rezortu Marina Liptov pri Liptovskej Mare. Tento netradičný beh ponúka spojenie prírody a kvalitných služieb v harmónii so štyrmi živlami - ohňom, vodou, zemou a vzduchom. Bežci si môžu užiť pokojné a inšpiratívne prostredie s výhľadmi na okolitú prírodu a možnosťou relaxu po behu v rezorte. Marina Liptov je ideálnym miestom pre športovcov aj rodiny, ktorí hľadajú zážitok v prírode.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 3. Jesenné kolo
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany
description: Lemešanská bežecká liga - III. jesenné kolo je bežecká súťaž organizovaná v obci Lemešany v krásnom prostredí Záhrady pohybu. Pretek je určený pre všetky vekové kategórie a výkonnostné úrovne, ponúkajúc príjemnú atmosféru a možnosť športového vyžitia na čerstvom vzduchu. Organizátorom je Záhrada Pohybu, ktorá sa stará o kvalitné podmienky pre šport a rekreáciu.

name: Beh pre Labky jesenný špeciál
location: Košice, Košice, Košice - časť Kavečany, chata Hrešná
organizer: Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov
description: Beh pre Labky jesenný špeciál je bežecké podujatie v Košiciach, časť Kavečany, pri chate Hrešná, ktoré organizuje Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov UVP. Pretek je určený pre rôzne kategórie vrátane žien, mužov, detí a bežcov so psami, vrátane psov z útulku. Trať má dĺžku 5 km a ponúka príjemnú jesennú atmosféru v prírode. Štartovné je dostupné online za zvýhodnenú cenu a na mieste za vyššiu sumu. Podujatie podporuje adopciu psov a spája bežcov so zvieratami v priateľskom prostredí.

name: Night run Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce, R M s.r.o.
description: Night run Michalovce je nočný bežecký pretek, ktorý sa koná na Námestí osloboditeľov v Michalovciach. Pretek ponúka tri trate rôznych dĺžok: 10 km, 5 km a 3 km, vhodné pre rôzne vekové kategórie a výkonnostné úrovne. Štart pre dospelých je o 19:00 hod., detské preteky začínajú o 17:00 hod. Organizátormi sú Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce a R M s.r.o. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť, ktorá si chce užiť športovú atmosféru v nočnom prostredí mesta.

name: Okolo Kolovrat
description: The Run Around Kolovraty is a traditional race that takes you through the beautiful surroundings of Kolovraty, including the neighboring municipalities of Uhříněves and Lipany, as well as part of Říčany. It offers 11 km and 21 km routes, with the shorter distance also available as a two-person relay. The routes run mainly along tree-lined field, meadow, and forest paths, promising a wonderful running experience in nature. The race is suitable for all runners looking to improve their time or set a personal course record.

name: ČEZ RunTour Brno
description: ČEZ RunTour Brno is a family-friendly running event held near the Brno Reservoir, offering courses for all ages, from children to experienced runners. Choose from distances of 500 m, 1 km, 3 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21.1 km). The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, excellent facilities, and activities for the whole family. Every participant receives a race pack and contributes to charity. ČEZ RunTour is an ideal opportunity for recreational and elite runners alike to enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of the Brno Reservoir.

name: Běh na Boží horu
description: The Run up Boží hora is a traditional race in Ivančice, challenging participants to climb 109 steps to Boží hora. Runners set off individually at one-minute intervals, ensuring a smooth race. The event is part of the wide range of activities organized by the Ivančice Leisure Centre, which has a long tradition and the support of the city. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a unique sporting experience in an attractive setting.

name: Běh Kovohutěmi
description: Běh Kovohutěmi is a traditional running race held in Lhota u Příbramě since 1967. The event features a 12 km main course as well as races for children and young people. It takes place at the TJ Kovohutě stadium and is popular with runners of all ages. Every year, it attracts many participants and is part of the Brdy Running Cup.

name: Strojařská desítka
location: Správa údržby silnic Zlínského kraje, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: Strojařská desítka is a traditional road race in Zlín, now held for the 42nd year. The race offers 10 km and 5 km courses with 153 metres of elevation gain on a certified out-and-back route between Zlín’s Maják, the U Boudy crossroads, Salaš and back. The start is always at 10 a.m. by the headquarters of the Road Maintenance Administration on K Majáku Street. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all categories who want to compete in the beautiful surroundings of Zlín.

name: Běh přátelství Klenčí pod Čerchovem - Waldmünchen
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Klenčí pod Čerchovem–Waldmünchen Friendship Run is part of the Běžec Chodska running series, which offers a diverse range of races in the Chodsko region. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem and attracts runners of all ages. The course is suitable for those who enjoy nature and trail running, while the race atmosphere encourages friendly gatherings among the running community. The Běžec Chodska series is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, ensuring an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: Bezdězský půlmaraton
description: The Bezděz Half Marathon is a running race held in the picturesque Máchův kraj region around Bezděz Castle. It offers two routes of approximately 13.6 km and 21.2 km, with elevation gains of 200 to 300 metres, along forest roads, trails and short stretches of asphalt. The race is suitable for the general public and also includes children’s races. Refreshments, baggage storage, toilets, and an awards ceremony with a raffle are available at the venue. The field is limited to 500 runners, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities.

name: 7 pohoří Krkonoše
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races offer technical trails with epic views and an atmosphere you won’t find anywhere else. Whether you’re an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, 7 Mountains will test your strength, willpower, and determination. Conquer all seven mountain ranges and become a trail-running legend.

name: Běh k Mohyle Hanče a Vrbaty
description: The Run to the Hanč and Vrbata Cairn is a traditional mountain race held in the Krkonoše Mountains. It starts at the White Bridge over the Elbe in Špindlerův Mlýn and finishes at the Hanč and Vrbata Cairn. The 9 km route, with 696 metres of elevation gain, runs mostly on asphalt and trails, offering beautiful views and unforgettable experiences. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners across different age categories. After the race, refreshments and a raffle are available, and public transport can be used to return from the finish.

name: ČEZ RunTour Ostrava
location: Dolní Vítkovice, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

name: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 10th PKO Charity Run is a nationwide initiative that combines the excitement of sport with meaningful support for an important social cause: the mental health of children and young people. The event will take place across Poland on 12 September 2026, inviting participants to run together and take action for their communities. Every lap, kilometre and minute on the course matters, highlighting the spirit of community and support. This anniversary edition invites runners to take part and show their support.

name: Bieg 7 Dolin
description: Bieg 7 Dolin is a 100 km mountain ultramarathon held in the scenic Sądecki Beskids, starting and finishing in Piwniczna-Zdrój. The course follows challenging mountain trails with significant elevation gain, offering participants exceptional views and a chance to connect with nature. The race is part of the Running Festival, which combines sporting competition with promoting the region and an active lifestyle. The time limit for completing the course is 19 hours, and aid stations and drop bags are available along the route. It is a challenge for experienced mountain runners looking to take on demanding but beautiful terrain.

name: IX Bieg o Puchar Miasteczka Siewierz Jeziorna
5 Aktywna Piątka
description: The 5th edition of the “Aktywna Piątka” run will take place on September 12, 2026, in Frydek, in the Miedźna Municipality. This is a fast road race on a course exactly 5 km long, certified by the Polish Athletic Association, starting at 11:00. The event will also host the Silesian Voivodeship Championships in the 5 km, and the participant limit is 600. An accompanying Family Run for children and young people up to age 15 will be held over three distances.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The Grand Prix Truchtacza in Mysłowice is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing runners from different regions together. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or ability, and participants can compete in running, Nordic walking, and canicross. The races take place on forest and urban routes, creating a welcoming atmosphere of sporting competition and community. The Grand Prix is a long-standing tradition and passion that brings runners together year after year.

name: Bieg przez Most – Białołęcka Triada Biegowa
II Ćwiartka Drzymały
location: Miasteczko Krajeńskie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

Orawski Półmaraton Rysim Tropem
location: Lipnica Wielka, Nowy Targ County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

location: Oleszka, Zdzieszowice Municipality, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

location: Sieroszewice, Sieroszewice Municipality, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVIII Bieg Papieski
location: Służewo, Aleksandrów Kujawski County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 36. BorsodChem Bódva-völgyi Maraton
description: The 36th BorsodChem Bódva Valley Marathon is a traditional running race held near Edelény. It offers runners a range of distances, so everyone can find a suitable challenge. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere, and participants are provided with professional RFID chip timing. Runners can enjoy the natural beauty of the Bódva Valley and its varied terrain.

name: XI. Moonlight Run
description: The XI Moonlight Run is an atmospheric running race in the town of Szob, taking place on September 12, 2026. Participants receive timing, a race bib, and a unique finisher’s medal. Refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish, where runners can enjoy traditional lard bread with onions. The event takes place under medical supervision, and the organizers prioritize the experience of taking part.

name: ATOMFUTÁS
description: ATOMfutás is a popular running race in the city of Paks, taking place on September 12, 2026, around the ASE sports hall. The event offers runners several distances, so everyone can find a suitable challenge. Traditionally, the race offers significant early-bird discounts to entrants and has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. The event aims to strengthen sport and community, while participants enjoy varied courses and the beauty of the Paks surroundings.

name: BRUTÁLATOM
description: BrutálAtom is a challenging running race organized by the Atomerőmű Sports Club in the city of Paks, near the ASE sports hall. The race offers runners several distances, including options for children and adults, at different difficulty levels. The event traditionally takes place in mid-September and offers participants a unique experience thanks to its venue and organization. The race’s honorary patron is Olympic champion Dr. Antal Kovács, further enhancing its prestige.

name: MOONLIGHT RUN
description: MOONLIGHT RUN is a special night race in the town of Szob, taking place on September 12, 2026. The start and finish are at the Church of Saint Ladislaus, and participants receive a unique finisher’s medal. Refreshments and medical supervision are provided during the event, and traditional lard bread with onions awaits runners at the finish. The race is organized by Proathlon Bt. with the support of the local governments.

name: SZŐLŐSKÖR
distance_verbose: 50 km, 36 km, 18 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1.2 km

name: Beh Ždaňou
location: Ždaňa, okr. Košice okolie, Ždaňa, okr. Košice okolie, Obecný úrad
description: Beh Ždaňou je bežecké podujatie v obci Ždaňa v okrese Košice-okolie, ktoré ponúka trate pre rôzne vekové kategórie a výkonnostné úrovne. Preteká sa na tratiach 2,5 km a 5 km, pričom kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí, dospelých aj seniorov. Organizátori vítajú všetkých bežcov, ktorí si chcú užiť športový deň v príjemnom prostredí obce.

name: Beh okolo Spišského hradu
location: Spišské Podhradie, Spišské Podhradie, Pred MsÚ
description: Beh okolo Spišského hradu je tradičný bežecký pretek v Spišskom Podhradí, ktorý ponúka kombináciu asfaltových a spevnených poľných ciest s trávnatým povrchom. Trať vedie okolo historického Spišského hradu a je vhodná pre rôzne vekové kategórie vrátane detí a dospelých. Organizátorom je Mesto Spišské Podhradie, ktoré zabezpečuje príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu pretekov. Štartovné je dostupné online alebo na mieste, pričom obyvatelia Spišského Podhradia majú štartovné zdarma.

name: Okolo Muňáku
location: Munice u Hluboké nad Vltavou, Jihočeský
description: Okolo Muňáku is a family running race in Munice near Hluboká nad Vltavou, offering a relaxed atmosphere and a fast course around Munický Pond. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is open to all age groups, including children’s races. Each edition supports the charity Centrum Bazalka, which receives part of the entry fees. After the race, there is a varied program, including a raffle and prizes for the fastest runners.

name: Vrchlabský 1/2 Maraton
description: The Vrchlabí City Half Marathon is the inaugural edition of the half marathon, held in the heart of the Krkonoše Mountains at T. G. Masaryk Square in Vrchlabí. During the race, participants can enjoy a sporting challenge on asphalt roads, field paths and forest trails, as well as a cultural programme and a friendly atmosphere. In addition to the main half marathon, shorter 2 km and 9 km routes are available for children, juniors and families with children, taking them through the town and its side streets. The event brings together running, experiences and community, and is co-funded by the State Environmental Fund of the Czech Republic.

name: Forestova čtrnáctka
description: Forestova čtrnáctka is a 14 km running race around Záluží near Plzeň, featuring a mix of field, forest, and gravel roads with light trail terrain. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children and young people, who can enter for free. Runners can look forward to plenty of refreshments, a participant medal, and race photos. Registration opens at 9:00, and the start is scheduled by 9:45. The race takes place in all weather conditions. The organizer emphasizes participant safety and fitness to compete; runners take part at their own risk.

name: Králický Lískovec
description: Králický Lískovec is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Lískovec hill and its vicinity in Králíky, Pardubice Region. The race offers various distances, from short children’s categories to the 8 km main race, which is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The main race starts at 11:30, while the children’s categories start from 10:30. The race is suitable for the general public and prizes are awarded to winners in each category. Registration is available on-site on race day from 8:00 to 9:45.

name: Kokořínský kros
description: Kokořín Cross is a trail race held amid the picturesque scenery of the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, not far from Prague. The race offers three main routes of 15 km, 10 km and 5 km, which pass through romantic ravines and by unique sandstone towers. The start and finish are located in the municipal spa complex in Mšeno, which provides facilities including refreshments and a children’s corner. The race is suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offers a wide range of categories, with the option to change route distance even on race day.

name: Hostivařská 15°
description: Hostivařská 15 is a family-friendly trail race in the natural surroundings of Prague’s Hostivař district, offering more than just a test of performance. The race takes place around the reservoir, golf course and meanders of the Botič River, with mostly forest trails and very little asphalt. There is no timing equipment at the start; the winner is the runner who estimates their time most accurately. The atmosphere is outdoorsy and brewery-themed, and the event is suitable for all ages, including children.

name: 4Drun
description: 4Drun is a traditional running race organized by Sportovní klub DDsport, z.s., held in the picturesque surroundings of Dubany near Prostějov. The race offers a 10.2 km course through the area around Dubany, neighboring villages, and nearby cycle paths, combining asphalt and cross-country sections. The program also includes a 2 × 5 km relay, a 4 km family run, and children’s races, making the event suitable for all age groups. A varied program of accompanying activities is planned for race day, and every participant receives a commemorative medal.

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: The 2nd Złotów Ten is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in Złotów. Participants complete two 5 km laps, for a total distance of 10 km. The event is organized by the Złotów Center for Social Activity and aims to promote an active lifestyle and bring the local running community together. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part.

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
description: Tor Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting automotive events held at the race track in Poznań. Participants can take part in competitive racing, training sessions, and qualifying rounds held throughout the 2026 season. The event is aimed at automotive enthusiasts and also offers car rentals and one-on-one training with instructors. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of motorsport and improve your skills on a professional track.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
description: The 11th Run of Hope and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers’ Championships are charity races organized in Środa Wielkopolska, supporting the work of the Piotr Hospice. The event combines sporting competition with an important social cause, engaging the local community and the legal profession. It is an established tradition that promotes physical activity and solidarity.

name: XRUN - Vistula Trail
description: Vistula Trail is a mountain trail race held in Wisła, offering a variety of distances, from short routes for children to challenging mountain courses. Runners can enjoy scenic views of the Beskids, starting either in the center of Wisła or on the Czech side in Třinec. The routes pass notable landmarks such as Soszów Wielki, the Soszów Mountain Shelter, and Czantoria, combining an international adventure with the character of the Beskids. This event is for mountain-running enthusiasts who value variety and the beauty of the natural landscape.

name: 16 Bieg Częstochowski
description: The 16th Częstochowa Run is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in the center of Częstochowa. The 10 km course runs along the city’s main thoroughfares, including the area around Jasna Góra, giving the race a distinctive prestige. The course is officially certified, attracting runners aiming for a fast pace and personal bests. It’s an excellent opportunity for sporting competition in a picturesque urban setting.

name: Bieg na Skałę
organizer: Centrum Kultury, Sportu i Rekreacji w Skale
description: Bieg na Skałę is a unique sporting event that combines physical activity with the natural beauty of Ojców National Park. The race route follows scenic paths and hills, offering participants varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky sections, and steep climbs. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to enjoy a sense of adventure and the fresh air. After the race, participants can look forward to commemorative medals, prizes, and a range of activities, including games for children. The event takes place in a friendly, sporty atmosphere.

name: Chyża 10
description: The 12th Chyża Ten is a fast and popular 10 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Running Club. The event takes place in Nowy Tomyśl and is part of the Nowy Tomyśl County Grand Prix series of running events. The race starts at 9:00, and the race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and a well-prepared course.

name: XV Półmaraton Damak
description: The 15th Damak Half Marathon in Tarczyn is a family celebration of running, guaranteeing a great atmosphere and unforgettable experiences. The half-marathon course winds through picturesque fields, forests, and apple orchards, giving the race a unique character. The event attracts runners of all ages and also offers races for children and youth. The organizers look after participants by providing attractive race packs and support from sponsors.

name: XXI Radomski Maraton Trzeźwości
description: The Radom Sobriety Marathon is an annual running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The races take place on the scenic trails of the Kozienice Forest near Jedlnia-Letnisko, giving participants the opportunity to compete in the marathon, half marathon and other accompanying races. The marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and sobriety, while also bringing together the local running community. This event has a well-established tradition and attracts both amateur and experienced runners.

name: Żyrardów w Biegu
description: Żyrardów on the Run is an annual running event organized by the Żyrardów Cycling Association, taking place on September 13, 2026, by the Żyrardów Reservoir. Participants can choose between two distances: 10 km and 5 km, both running around the reservoir in multiple laps and finishing on the reservoir grounds. The event promotes physical activity, community, and a friendly sporting atmosphere, while also helping promote the city of Żyrardów and the Mazovia region. The race is open to adults, and athletes using active wheelchairs may also take part in the 10 km race.

Kis-Balaton RUN 2026
description: The Kis-Balaton Loop Running Race is an increasingly popular running event in Zalakaros, advertised nationwide and organized by Zalakarosi Futrinkák. It offers several distances, including a 35 km individual and relay race, a half marathon, and children’s and family races. The event is traditionally held in September, with the start and finish at Karos Korzó. The race is cup-free, so participants must bring their own drinking cups. The event has a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere and offers valuable prizes and finisher medals.

name: Malý Pieninský maratón – mem. Bohuša Ježíka
location: Červený Kláštor okr. Kežmarok, Červený Kláštor okr. Kežmarok, Kúpele Smerdžonka
organizer: Malý pieninský maratón – memoriál Bohuša Ježíka
description: Malý Pieninský maratón - memoriál Bohuša Ježíka je bežecké podujatie v Červenom Kláštore, ktoré ponúka trať dlhú 18 km s prevýšením 163 metrov. Trať vedie prielomom rieky Dunajec, pričom povrch je z polovice asfaltový a z polovice lesný. Štart je naplánovaný na 10:00 hod. a súčasťou štartovného je medaila, darček, štartové číslo, občerstvenie na trati a v cieli, obed a tombola. Okrem hlavného behu je k dispozícii aj nesúťažná štafeta 9+9 km.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - září
description: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli is a regular 8 km running race held in the pleasant surroundings of Plzeň. The race is for all runners who share a passion for running and spending time together. The start and finish are at the same location, with parking available for participants. The event offers a friendly atmosphere and is suitable for various age groups.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (10) – zářijový
description: The 5 km and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY is a regular running series in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava where personal bests are often set. The races are part of the 16th edition and are suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to pros. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the chance to meet the qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, participants can get together and refuel at a local restaurant, adding to the relaxed running atmosphere.

name: Podzimní běh okolo Europlantu
description: The Autumn Run around Europlant is a traditional running race held in Prague’s Horní Počernice district. The race is 7.5 km long and combines paved and off-road sections. It starts in the early evening, with slower runners setting off earlier. The event is open to all runners and is supported by Prague 20. After the race, participants are rewarded with potatoes provided by the sponsor, Europlant.

name: Běh proti násilí
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic
organizer: Asociace pro práci s lidmi, kteří se dopouštějí násilí z.s.
description: Run Against Violence is a traditional charity run held in Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague 6. It supports the Stop Violence program and clients taking part in long-term therapies focused on managing anger and aggression. The run brings together participants of all ages who want to show their support and offer hope to those trying to change their behavior. The 5 km course is suitable for anyone who wants to support a good cause while enjoying exercise in nature. The event is organized by Diakonie ČCE, a major provider of social services in the Czech Republic.

name: Maraton 3 Jezior / Three Lakes Marathon
description: The 3 Lakes Marathon is a mountain running festival held in the scenic Beskid Mały region, in the Soła River valley. The main distance is an ultramarathon of approximately 43 km with around 2,485 m of elevation gain, taking runners through the highest parts of the Beskid Mały Mountains, with beautiful views of three lakes and the surrounding mountains. The course combines challenging climbs and technical descents, giving participants the chance to discover both the region’s wild nature and its historic sites. The event takes place during the beautiful transition from summer to autumn, adding to the charm of the route and its surroundings.

name: 23 Przejście Dookoła Kotliny Jeleniogórs...
description: The Hike Around the Jelenia Góra Valley is one of Poland’s best-known long-distance hiking events, held since 2004. Participants cover a route of approximately 140 km around the Jelenia Góra Valley, crossing the Karkonosze, Rudawy Janowickie, Kaczawskie Mountains and Izera Mountains. The event commemorates GOPR rescuers. The entry fee includes race materials, a souvenir, a hot meal and a certificate.
