The challenging route has approximately 5,500 m of elevation gain, and participants have a 48-hour time limit to complete it.

name: 3 Backyard Ultra Zagłębie
description: Backyard Ultra Zagłębie is a unique ultramarathon run on a 6.706 km loop around Pogoria 3 Lake in Dąbrowa Górnicza. Runners start every hour, and the last person to finish each lap continues running until only one winner remains. The course combines varied surfaces—asphalt, dirt and forest paths, and a beach section—requiring both endurance and technical precision. The event is the final of the Polish Backyard Ultra League and attracts fans of extreme challenges from across Poland.

name: Ogólnopolskie Mistrzostwa Policji
location: Łazy, Zawiercie County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Big Bear's Ultra
description: Big Bear's Ultra je náročný ultra trailový pretek okolo mesta Žilina, ktorý ponúka jedinečný zážitok z behu v prírode s krásnymi výhľadmi na okolitú krajinu. Preteky sa konajú v blízkosti Považského múzea a Budatínskeho hradu a zahŕňajú rôzne vzdialenosti, ktoré preveria vytrvalosť a odhodlanie bežcov. Trať vedie cez kopce a horské oblasti s výrazným prevýšením, čo robí z tohto podujatia výzvu pre skúsených bežcov. Organizátori kladú dôraz na ekologický prístup a bezpečnosť účastníkov.

name: Oktoberfest Run Nitra 2026: Half Marathon
description: Oktoberfest Run Nitra 2026: Half Marathon je certifikovaný polmaratón s medzinárodným statusom World Athletics, ktorý sa koná v historickom centre Nitry na Svätoplukovom námestí. Podujatie spája šport, komunitu a charitu a ponúka bežcom jedinečný zážitok v atmosfére Oktoberfestu. Okrem polmaratónu sú súčasťou festivalu aj štafety, rodinné a seniorské behy, charitatívne behy a detské kategórie. Organizátori kladú dôraz na zdravý životný štýl, inklúziu a komunitnú spoluprácu v regióne.

name: Kopaničiarska 10-tka
location: Myjava, Myjava, pred MsÚ v Myjave
organizer: TJ Spartak Myjava Atletický oddiel a mesto Myjava
description: Kopaničiarska 10-tka je bežecký pretek v Myjave, ktorý ponúka trať dlhú 10 km pre mužov a ženy, s kratšími variantmi pre ženy a kategóriu Buď - fit. Preteky sa konajú pred Mestským úradom v Myjave a sú organizované TJ Spartak Myjava Atletickým oddielom a mestom Myjava. Štart hlavného preteku je o 13:00 hod., zatiaľ čo žiaci a žiačky základných škôl štartujú o 10:00 hod. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú vekovú škálu bežcov, vrátane kategórií podľa veku a špeciálnych skupín Buď fit a detí.

name: Dobšinská desiatka
location: Dobšiná okr.Rožňava, Dobšiná okr.Rožňava, Dobšiná, Lanyiho Huta
description: Dobšinská desiatka je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný občianskym združením ŠK Dobšiná, ktorý sa koná v malebnom prostredí Lányiho Huty v Dobšinej. Preteky ponúkajú členitú trať s kombináciou lesných ciest a asfaltu, vhodnú pre bežcov rôznych kategórií vrátane nordic walking. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj sprievodné akcie ako autogramiáda slovenských olympionikov a rodinné aktivity, ktoré vytvárajú príjemnú atmosféru pre všetkých účastníkov.

name: Kapušianska 5-ka
description: Kapušianska 5-ka je bežecký pretek konaný v Kapušanskom parku v obci Kapušany. Pretek je určený pre rôzne vekové kategórie vrátane juniorov, dospelých a veteránov. Ide o príjemnú športovú udalosť, ktorá podporuje aktívny životný štýl a komunitné športovanie. Organizátorom je obec Kapušany, ktorá zabezpečuje aj kontaktnú podporu pre účastníkov.

name: Letné športové hry pracovníkov U.S.STEEL
location: Košice, Košice, vstupný areál USS Košice Šaca
description: Letné športové hry pracovníkov U. S. Steel Košice sú tradičným podujatím, ktoré sa koná už 34 rokov a prináša zamestnancom možnosť súťažiť v rôznych športových disciplínach. Hry zahŕňajú atletiku, bedminton, bowling, tenis, futbal, stolný tenis, plážový volejbal, cyklistiku, šach a šípky. Podujatie je určené pre zamestnancov U. S. Steel Košice a podporuje športového ducha a kolektívnu súťaživosť v príjemnom prostredí areálu USS Košice Šaca. Okrem súťaží sa organizujú aj golfové turnaje a ďalšie športové aktivity.

name: Generali Trail Hubkovou
description: Generali Trail Hubkovou je bežecký pretek v Humennom, ktorý organizuje Bežecký klub Humenné s podporou mesta a miestnych sponzorov. Pretek sa koná na námestí pri MsKS a ponúka kategórie pre mužov, ženy, juniorov a deti. Štart hlavného preteku je o 13:00, detské kategórie začínajú o 11:00. Účastníci si môžu vybrať z viacerých štartovných balíčkov, ktoré zahŕňajú medailu, reklamný balíček, tombolu, občerstvenie a funkčné tričko. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru s občerstvením na trati.

name: Běh pro hospic Červený Kostelec
description: Run for Hospice is an open charity race held in Červený Kostelec, with courses for all age groups. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, and includes children’s courses along a forest path, as well as 2, 5 and 10 km courses over rolling mixed terrain, mostly asphalt with some forest and field paths. The event is part of the Primátor CUP running series and supports hospice services provided by the Červený Kostelec Regional Charity. Participants can enjoy the pleasant countryside around the Kostelec ponds, with views of the surrounding mountains.

name: Zátopkova 10
description: Zátopkova 10 is a traditional running race held in Lomená Alej in Stará Boleslav. The course consists of two five-kilometre loops along forest trails. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup 2026 series and offers a 10 km main race, a two-runner relay, and children’s races over 500 and 1,000 metres. The course is mostly flat, and the start is staggered, with an on-course refreshment station. Runners receive a race number with a timing chip, a commemorative medal, and additional services including refreshments and photos from the course.

name: Li.T.R. – Lipno.trail.run.
description: Li.t.r. is a weekend trail festival featuring a 108 km main race with over 2,000 metres of elevation gain around Lipno. The run offers a unique opportunity to discover the little-known Lipno region, its history and its stories during a demanding ultratrail. The race is open to both solo runners and teams, and is complemented by a programme of activities from Friday to Sunday. The atmosphere is friendly and community-focused; the event is organised by runners for runners, with respect for nature and local culture.

name: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Mírové náměstí, Ústecký
description: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem 2026 is a traditional running race with a fast, flat course that follows the Elbe River and passes the local chemical plant. This half marathon is known as the “Ferrari among races” for its speed and the records that are often set. During the race, runners can enjoy beautiful views of the Bohemian Central Highlands and Střekov Castle. The festival offers various running events, including a half marathon, a half-marathon relay, a 10 km race, and family runs.

name: Mladé Běchovice
description: Mladé Běchovice is a traditional running race for children aged 1 to 18, held on a grass field in Prague-Běchovice. The race offers courses of varying lengths, from 50 to 1,300 metres, to accommodate participants across a wide age range. Around 800 children take part each year, making it a significant sporting event for young runners. In 2026, the popular race will be held for the 61st time.

name: Běh Moravským krasem
description: Run through the Moravian Karst is part of the Blansko District Running League, which dates back to 1976. The race gives runners from the Blansko area and beyond the chance to test themselves in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Moravian Karst. It is suitable for the general public and forms part of a year-round competition that promotes running in the region. The organizers aim to provide quality services and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.

name: Litovelská nealkoholická čtrnáctka
description: Litovelská Non-Alcoholic Fourteener is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque town of Litovel in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of a running series and offers an opportunity for recreational and competitive runners alike. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in central Moravia. The race is suitable for the general public, and its name—which refers to the event’s non-alcoholic nature—also reflects its friendly atmosphere.

name: Podzimní běh Heřmanův Městec
description: The Autumn Run in Heřmanův Městec is a traditional running race held in a beautiful castle park. It offers two main distances, 5 km and 10 km (two laps), as well as children’s races in the start and finish area. The race is part of the Vládce Mrdic sports league and attracts runners of all ages who enjoy the pleasant autumn atmosphere and excellent facilities.

name: Hořovický cvoček
description: Hořovický cvoček is a traditional running race held in Hořovice, offering a course approximately 12 km long. The route follows forest paths and paved roads, starting on Valdecká Street by the water tower and heading towards Hvozdec. The main race starts at 10:00 and is for adult runners, with no children’s categories. The entry fee is 150 CZK with pre-registration and 200 CZK on the day. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup and has a long history, with results and statistics available.

name: Kačina Run
description: Kačina Run is a running race held in the beautiful grounds of Kačina Castle and its expansive park. It is part of the BĚHEJ ZÁMKY STŘEDNÍ ČECHY series. The race offers courses for children of up to 800 metres and 5 km and 10 km courses for adults, running mostly on gravel and forest paths. The event is suitable for anyone who enjoys exercise and nature, and offers a friendly atmosphere with refreshments along the course and at the finish. The start and event facilities are located behind Kačina Castle, where registration and the awards ceremony also take place.

name: Leskros Mácháč
description: Leskros Mácháč is a new event this season, with beautiful routes ideal for running and canicross in the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, not far from Lake Máchovo. The routes follow soft sandy trails covered with pine needles, making for a pleasant running experience in a natural setting. The event offers a range of distances, from children’s races up to 21 km, including running, canicross, walking/running, and dog trekking categories. Race facilities include refreshment stations for people and dogs, massages, taping, and canine physiotherapy advice, helping all participants feel at ease.

name: Štramberský Jasoň
organizer: Spolek Bezva běh pro bezva lidi z. s.
description: Štramberk Jasoň is a traditional hiking march and running event taking place on September 19, 2026, in Frýdlant nad Ostravicí and the surrounding area. It offers 22 routes of varying lengths, from 6 km to 67 km, including both race and hiking options. Participants can choose routes passing through Lysá hora, the Palkovické hůrky, Velký Javorník and other scenic locations in the Moravian-Silesian Region. At the finish in Štramberk, all registered participants receive an original medal and can order a printed T-shirt. The event is suitable for a wide range of participants, including families with children, and also offers routes suitable for strollers and seniors.

name: Havlíčkova pětka
location: Havlíčkovo náměstí, Havlíčkův Brod, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: Havlíčkova Pětka is a running race of approximately 5.2 km, running mainly along cycle paths and pavements beside the Sázava River in Havlíčkův Brod. It is suitable for those who do not have a relay team or find a half marathon too challenging. The race starts from Havlíčkovo Square, and part of the entry fee goes toward supporting sports equipment for young people. The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny running cup and offers refreshments at both the start and finish.

name: Běh rodným krajem Emila Zátopka
description: The Run Through Emil Zátopek’s Native Region is a traditional race dedicated to the legacy of the famous Olympic athlete Emil Zátopek. It is held each year on the Saturday closest to his birthday, 19 September. The race starts in his hometown of Kopřivnice, by the statue of Emil Zátopek, and finishes at the Wallachian Open Air Museum in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm after a challenging 22.3 km course with a hilly profile. The race is open to participants aged 15 and over and also offers accompanying runs for children and the public. After the race, the winners are ceremonially presented with awards in the presence of distinguished guests.

name: Kocelovice-Hornosín-Kocelovice
description: The Kocelovice–Hornosín–Kocelovice cross-country run is a traditional sporting event organized by the municipality of Kocelovice in the South Bohemian Region. The run takes place on Saturday, September 19, 2026, and participants can expect a route from Kocelovice to Hornosín and back. The event is suitable for running enthusiasts and anyone looking for an active day out in scenic terrain popular with hikers and cyclists. The start and finish are by the former school building in Kocelovice, where the race is also organized. The event lasts approximately four hours.

name: Havlíčkobrodský půlmaraton
description: The Havlíčkův Brod Half Marathon is a traditional running event held in Havlíčkův Brod, celebrating its 14th edition in 2026. The main half-marathon course follows public cycle paths and sidewalks, mostly along the Sázava River, and passes through Havlíčkův Brod Square. The event also includes children’s races, relays, and the shorter Havlíčkova Pětka, making it accessible to the general public across a range of age groups and ability levels. The race offers quality facilities, refreshments on the course and after the race, professional timing, and a rich accompanying program.

name: Běh pro Hospic Anežky České
description: The Run for Anežka Česká Hospice is an open charity race held in Červený Kostelec, offering courses for all age groups. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, and includes children’s courses along a forest path, as well as 2, 5 and 10 km courses over rolling mixed terrain, mostly on asphalt with some forest and field paths. The event is part of the Primátor CUP running series and supports hospice services. Race numbers are distributed from 8:15, and the main race winners are announced at 12:00.

name: Jilemnice - Žalý
description: Jilemnice–Žalý is a hill race with a total elevation gain of 569 metres, held in the picturesque surroundings of Jilemnice in the Liberec Region. The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup and features a challenging 9.5 km course. The start is in Jilemnice’s town square, and the race is suited to runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain. It is organised by ČKS SKI Jilemnice, z.s., which provides professional organisation and support for participants.

name: Soběchlebský Š-krpál
organizer: místní běžečtí nadšenci ve spolupráci s obcí Soběchleby a SDH Soběchleby
description: Soběchlebský Š-krpál is a traditional running race held in the area around the village of Soběchleby since 2017. The main course is approximately 11.7 km long, with 268 m of elevation gain, and runs 90% on unpaved farm and forest roads. Since 2024, the event has also included a 6 km fitness run, suitable for beginner runners and walkers. The start and finish are at the football pitch in Soběchleby, which has facilities including changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The accompanying programme includes children’s races for various age groups.

name: Černošický běh
description: The Černošice Run is a traditional race held in Černošice, offering routes for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The event takes place at the sports field at the end of Husova Street and includes short children’s races, a family relay, and longer routes for adult runners. Starts are staggered from 14:00 to 15:40, allowing participants of different age groups to take part comfortably. The event is suitable for families and runners looking for a sporting challenge in a pleasant town setting.

name: XI Bieg po Gminie Zduńska Wola
17. PKO Bytomski Półmaraton
organizer: Klub MKS MOSM Bytom, Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Bytomiu, Centrum Handlowe Plejada
description: The 17th PKO Bytom Half Marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and brings together the local community of Bytom and the surrounding area. The race takes place on a certified, paved 21.097 km course consisting of a single loop. The start and finish are located at G City Plejada Shopping Centre in Bytom. Participants can expect refreshment and hydration stations, as well as support from pacemakers. After the race, they can personalize their medal by having their finishing time engraved.

name: PKO Wieczorny Półmaraton Łódź
description: PKO Łódź Evening Half Marathon is a new, atmospheric running event held in the center of Łódź. The start and finish are located on the grounds of the revitalized EC1 power and heating plant, which is now a center for culture and science. The 21.097 km course passes through the city’s most recognizable places, combining its industrial history with modernity. This is a race where not only the result matters, but also the unique atmosphere and energy of the city.

name: 30 Międzynarodowy Bieg Uliczny Bieg Rekreacyjny 10 km
Gontyniec Celtic Trail
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race, lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km through the scenic Gontyniec massif. Runners cover as much distance as possible, with fully equipped aid stations after each loop. The course offers changing scenery at different times of day, beautiful views of the Noteć Valley, and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as beehives shaped like ancient gods. It’s a special experience for runners seeking a challenge and unforgettable memories.

name: XIV Jastrzębska Dziesiątka
description: The 14th “Jastrzębska Dziesiątka” Street Run is an annual road race held in Jastrzębie-Zdrój. Participants cover a distance of 10 km along the city’s central streets. The start and finish are located at the Sports and Entertainment Hall at 6 Jana Pawła II Avenue. The participant limit is 600, and the race is scheduled to start at 17:00 on September 19, 2026. The accompanying run takes place from 15:00 to 15:50 on the same day.

name: Rollercoaster 21 WMRA Mountain Running World Cup
Tam i z powrotem
location: Złoty Stok, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 44 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Łagiewniki, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: dm Balaton Run 5 / 10 / 21
description: The dm Balaton RUN will take place in Zamárdi on September 19, 2026, offering runners the chance to run along one of the Balaton’s most beautiful stretches of shoreline. The event is family-friendly and recommended for beginners and experienced runners alike, with several distances: 2.3 km, 5.25 km, 10.5 km, half marathon, and half-marathon relay. The race pack includes a premium Mizuno T-shirt, a custom-designed finisher’s medal awaits at the finish, and eco-friendly, cup-free refreshments are provided. The route runs mostly along the waterfront, allowing participants to enjoy the atmosphere of Lake Balaton and the early autumn sunshine.

name: BAKONYALJA FUTÁS
description: Bakonyalja Running is a traditional trail-running race held in and around Tárkány and Ászár. The race is organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which supports running and orienteering through several sections. Runners can test themselves on varied terrain in a natural setting while enjoying the scenic landscapes of Bakonyalja. The event has a friendly atmosphere and is open to all age groups.

name: DOMB42X (2.)
distance_verbose: 50 miles, Maraton, Félmaraton, 14 km, 7 km, 3000 meter, 0.8 km, 0.4 km
description: DOMB42X is a unique running race held on Benkó Hill, the highest point in Kecskemét, where participants run up and down the nearly 50-meter-high hill multiple times. One lap of the course is 1.0047 km, and runners complete 3 to 42 laps depending on their chosen distance, ranging from a half marathon to an ultramarathon. A distinctive feature of the race is its substantial elevation gain, which exceeds 2,000 meters over the marathon distance. The event is family-friendly: admission is free for spectators, and the leisure park offers them numerous activities and sporting opportunities.

name: Runway Run 2026
location: Budapest Ferenc Liszt International Airport, Budapest, Hungary

name: Túrkevei Bagolyfutam
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 0.75 km, 0.4 km

name: Bešeňovský charitatívny beh pre MAPENZI
organizer: Občianske združenie MAPENZI by Generation of love, Obec Bešeňov
description: Bešeňovský charitatívny beh pre MAPENZI je bežecké podujatie organizované občianskym združením MAPENZI by Generation of love a obcou Bešeňov. Preteky sa konajú na futbalovom ihrisku v Bešeňove a ponúkajú kategórie na 10 km, 5 km, detské behy a rekreačný beh 2 km. Štart detských behov je o 15:00 a hlavného behu o 16:00. Podujatie má charitatívny charakter a je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane rôznych vekových kategórií.

name: Olšavský pohár – Memoriál Júliusa Kažimíra
location: Ruskov okr. Košice okolie, Ruskov okr. Košice okolie, pred Obecným úradom
organizer: Obec Ruskov and Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Ruskov
description: Olšavský pohár - Memoriál Júliusa Kažimíra je bežecký pretek konaný v obci Ruskov v okrese Košice okolie. Pretek ponúka dve hlavné trate s dĺžkami 16,8 km a 9,7 km, pričom štart je pred Obecným úradom. Súťažiť môžu muži, ženy aj deti v rôznych vekových kategóriách. Organizátormi sú obec Ruskov a Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Ruskov v spolupráci s okolitými obcami. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť, vrátane seniorov a detí, ktorí majú štartovné zdarma.

name: Trail Český ráj
description: Trail Český ráj is a popular trail half marathon that takes you through the heart of Český ráj, including the courtyard of Kost Castle, pine groves and sandstone cliffs. This race continues the popular ELEVEN PŮLMARATON ČESKÝ RÁJ, now in its eleventh edition, and offers what is probably the most beautiful trail half-marathon course in the Czech Republic. The start is by Komárov Pond, and the finish is a reward for every runner. The race also offers runners a wide range of services, including refreshments, changing rooms and medical assistance.

name: PoHodová devítka
description: PoHodová Devítka is a traditional running race in Velká Bíteš, held in September after the local festival. The main course is 9 km long and suitable for all runners, while children can compete on shorter courses. The race offers a friendly atmosphere and is open to the general public, with categories for children and youths. About one third of the route is on asphalt and two thirds on unpaved roads. The race takes place amid normal road traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.

name: Memoriál Matěje Mauera
description: The Matěj Mauer Memorial is a 9 km running race that runs mostly along forest trails, with one longer climb. The race takes place in the picturesque Capartice area near Plzeň and is part of the Běžec Chodska series. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves in a natural setting on a more challenging course. It is suitable for runners seeking a trail challenge and the atmosphere of a traditional race.

name: 12 Bieg "Król Parku"
location: Park Miejski w Mosinie, Mosina, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 12th “King of the Park” Run is an annual running event organized by the Mosina Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place in the scenic surroundings of the town park, offering participants an attractive course and sporting competition. It attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, promoting an active lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The organizers provide professional support and a generous race pack.

name: 49 Półmaraton Lechitów
description: The 49th Lechit Half Marathon is Poland’s oldest half marathon, held continuously since 1978. The 21.0975 km race route runs from the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki to the finish at St. Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno, following the route of Otto III’s historic journey. The race attracts thousands of runners every year and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix. The organizers provide professional race services, timekeeping, and course safety. Participants receive a race package with a medal and a recovery meal.

name: 6 Półmaraton Aleją Dębów Czerwonych
organizer: Gmina Łęka Opatowska, Gmina Wieruszów, Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Turystyki w Wieruszowie, Spółdzielnia Socjalna Green Service
description: The 6th Red Oaks Avenue Half Marathon is a half-marathon race (21.097 km) taking place on September 20, 2026, in Wieruszów. The event is organized by the Łęka Opatowska Municipality, the Wieruszów Municipality, and the Municipal Sports and Tourism Centre in Wieruszów. The race is open and welcoming to runners, and the course runs along the scenic Red Oaks Avenue. The race office will be open on the day of the event from 08:00 to 11:30, and timing will be electronic. The event is supported by local partners and sponsors, and participants can expect professional organization and excellent race-day conditions.

name: 7 H2O Półmaraton
description: The 7 H2O Half Marathon is a 21.097 km race taking place on September 20, 2026, in Wrocław. The flat route is on asphalt with sections of compacted gravel and follows a single loop, starting and finishing at 3 Międzyrzecka Street. The event promotes running and physical activity among Wrocław residents, offering participants professional organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race has a 3-hour time limit and provides hydration points and a recovery meal after the finish.

name: Bieg Charytatywny
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie, Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: The CZTERY PORY ROKU Charity Run – Stage IV is a sporting event held in Oława, in the park by the railway station. Participants can take part in a run of approximately 5 km or a Nordic Walking event on the same route. The event is charitable in nature and is coordinated by the Active People Association “Biegnij Oławo” and the Oława Municipal Office. The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30, and the event is scheduled to start on December 20, 2026. The event is supported by local partners, and timing is provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl.

name: Festiwal Górski Maraton Trzech Jezior
description: The Three Lakes Mountain Marathon Festival is a unique running event in the scenic land of the Beskid lakes, featuring four distances: the 3.5 km Czupel Vertical with 600 m of elevation gain, a 43 km marathon, 21 km, and 17 km. The routes pass through the wild mountain terrain of the Little Beskids, offering participants beautiful views, varied terrain, and a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. The event brings the running community together and promotes an active lifestyle as well as the area’s tourist and cultural attractions. Races take place on September 18–20, 2026, and the main marathon is an ultramarathon with demanding climbs and technical descents.

name: Prószkowski Bieg Uliczny
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Prószkowie
description: The Piotr Blachucik Prószków Street Race is one of the region’s most atmospheric running events, taking place on September 20, 2026, in Prószków. The race offers a dynamic course and sporting excitement, while children’s races are also held before the main event to promote physical activity from an early age. It’s a day full of energy, smiles, and friendly competition, ideal both for runners aiming for a result and for anyone looking to spend time actively.

name: 4 Wilczy Pęd na Trójmorski Wierch
location: Jodłów, Międzylesie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg na Zamek po miecz Spycimira
XI Gminna Zadyszka
location: Kurnos Drugi, Bełchatów County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: XIX Mazowiecki Bieg Norwidowski
location: Dębinki, Gmina Zabrodzie, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 6. Liget élményfutás 7 / 3.5
description: The 6th Liget Fun Run is a special running event in Budapest’s City Park, where families and friends can enjoy the pleasures of sport and the excitement of more than 20 obstacles together on the 3.5- and 7-kilometer courses. It’s not about competition, but about the experience, where smiles and shared adventures matter most. Participants will receive a unique finisher’s medal and a finisher’s pack, ensuring an unforgettable day. The event is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners who want to take part in a fun, community-focused experience in the enchanting surroundings of City Park.

name: FESTÉK BÁZIS JÁNOSHÁZAI FÉLMARATON
description: The FESTÉK BÁZIS Jánosháza Half Marathon is a fun, well-organized running event that amateurs and professionals alike can enjoy. The race takes place on safe, traffic-free routes, and every finisher receives a medal and a surprise finisher’s pack. The event also offers accurate timekeeping, refreshments every 5 km, and an online photo gallery. At the end of the race, the organizers treat participants to beef stew prepared on site, ensuring a welcoming community atmosphere after the run.

name: 404. Malá cena Monaka
description: The Little Monaco Prize is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race has a long history and is part of the KRB Chrudim club’s running calendar. It offers a sporting atmosphere and an opportunity to test yourself on an interesting course in beautiful surroundings. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Zlín
description: The Night Run for Světluška in Zlín is a charity running event held on September 24, 2026, at náměstí Míru. The start is at 8:00 p.m., and participants can choose a route to suit them or walk it. Entry packages are available in two options—with a headlamp or a sports headband. Part of the entry fee goes toward helping people with severe visual impairments, underscoring the event’s charitable nature. There is also an accompanying program for all participants.

name: Běh okolo Campusu
organizer: Běžecký spolek z.s. a Sportuj s námi, z.s.
description: The Run Around Campus is a running race in Brno, held in the Bohunice district. The race features a 5.6 km loop, with men and women competing in a single category. The program also includes a children’s race for children of any age, with the loop length determined before the start. The event is friendly and open to all runners, offering a chance to discover interesting places in Brno.

name: Beh Tokajskými vinicami
location: Oddychové centrum, Čerhov, Trebišov District, Slovakia
description: Beh Tokajskými vinicami je tradičný bežecký závod konaný v obci Čerhov v okrese Trebišov. Trať vedie malebnými tokajskými vinohradmi, ktoré ponúkajú krásne prírodné scenérie a príjemné prostredie pre bežcov všetkých vekových kategórií. Podujatie je vhodné pre amatérov aj skúsených bežcov, ktorí si chcú užiť športový deň v prírode a zároveň spoznať jedinečný región Tokaj. Organizátorom je obec Čerhov, ktorá zabezpečuje príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitnú organizáciu.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez tokajské vinohrady s krásnymi výhľadmi
Prírodné prostredie s miernym prevýšením
Kombinácia asfaltových a lesných ciest
additional: Podujatie sa koná v Oddychovom centre v Čerhove. K dispozícii je mapka trate na stránke obce. Nie sú uvedené konkrétne časy štartu ani rozdelenie na vlny. Informácie o registrácii sú dostupné na samostatnej stránke. Nie sú uvedené ceny štartovného ani kategórie pretekov.

name: Eleven Večerní běh
description: ELEVEN Evening Run is a 5 km night race held in the early evening at the VOLT brewery grounds in Jablonec nad Nisou. The route runs around three reservoirs and is suitable for men, women and young people aged 16 and over, as well as children up to 15 years old. The race offers a sporting atmosphere, chip timing and valuable gifts for the first participants to register. The start and finish are at the brewery grounds, where race numbers can also be collected.

name: Běh Březinou v Polné
description: The Březinou Run in Polná is a traditional running race organized by Běžecký tým Polná and Běžec Vysočiny z.s. and held at the football stadium in Polná. The race offers courses for different age categories, from the youngest children to veterans, with the main 9.5 km race following field and forest paths through the valley of the Šlapanka River. The race starts at 17:00, and participants can expect a pleasant atmosphere and commemorative prizes for the top finishers in each category. The race has a long tradition, with more than 39 editions since 1992.

name: Horský beh Pačanským chotárom
location: Pača, okr. Rožňava, Pača, okr. Rožňava, pred Kultúrnym domom
description: Horský beh Pačanským chotárom je bežecké podujatie v obci Pača, ktoré ponúka dva hlavné trate - náročnejší hlavný beh s dĺžkou 13,5 km a prevýšením 492 m a kratší hobby beh s dĺžkou 6,3 km a prevýšením 203 m. Trasy vedú kombináciou asfaltových a lesných ciest s krásnymi výhľadmi a občerstvovačkami na trati. Pretekári štartujú a cieľia pred kultúrnym domom v Pači, pričom organizátori zabezpečujú navigáciu a označenie trasy. Podujatie je vhodné pre pokročilých aj rekreačných bežcov a ponúka športovú atmosféru s občerstvením a tombolou.

name: Rybnícka 10-ka a 5-ka
location: Rybník, okr. Levice, Rybník, okr. Levice, futbalový štadión
organizer: Obec Rybník, ZŠ s MŠ Rybník
description: Rybnícka 10-ka a 5-ka je bežecké podujatie konané na futbalovom štadióne v obci Rybník, okres Levice. Preteká sa na dvoch vzdialenostiach - 5 km a 10 km, pričom súťažia rôzne vekové kategórie mužov a žien. Štart pre deti je o 9:00 hod., pre dospelých o 11:00 hod. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane stredoškolákov a seniorov, ktorí majú zľavnené štartovné. Organizátori zabezpečujú príjemnú atmosféru a kvalitné zázemie pre bežcov.

name: Behaj lesmi Devín
description: Behaj lesmi Devín sú jedinečné trailové preteky pri Bratislave, ktoré ponúkajú beh po trase s výhľadom na sútok Dunaja a Moravy a Devínsku Kobylu. Trasy vedú historickou Jantárovou cestou a rozkvitnutými alejami medvedieho cesnaku, čo robí beh nezabudnuteľným zážitkom. Preteky sú súčasťou série Behaj lesmi a sú zaradené pod UTMB Index Races, čo zaručuje medzinárodné bodové hodnotenie. Súťažiť môžete na krátkej 12 km trase alebo polmaratóne 22 km, pričom na oboch trasách je vyznačený rýchlostný úsek Conti Speed Section s hodnotnou výhrou.

name: S Ankou za život
description: Beh S Ankou za život je charitatívne podujatie, ktoré sa koná v Košiciach pri Dóme sv. Alžbety. Štartovné je dobrovoľný príspevok a celý výťažok zo štartovného je venovaný zariadeniu Oáza - nádej pre nový život. Organizátorom je Pastoračné centrum Anky Kolesárovej z Vysokej nad Uhom. Bežci tak môžu spojiť športový výkon s podporou dobrého cieľa.

name: Hutčanská 5 s vierou – beh srdcom i telom
description: Beh Srdcom i telom v Nižnej Hutke je každoročné bežecké podujatie, ktoré ponúka trať pre skúsených bežcov na 5 km a zábavnú trasu pre najmenších na 500 m. Okrem športového zážitku je súčasťou programu duchovné zamyslenie, občerstvenie, panelová diskusia a hudobný program. Podujatie vytvára príjemnú komunitnú atmosféru a podporuje súťaživosť i radosť z behu.

name: Mělnický vinařský běh
description: The Mělník Wine Run is a traditional running race in Mělník, offering 10 km and 21 km courses. The race takes place on a single loop with beautiful views of the castle and vineyards, and the route passes historic and natural attractions in the surrounding area. After the finish, participants can enjoy a tasting of local wines, a commemorative glass, a free lunch, and a large prize draw. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own free races. The event is organized by the Run the World association, which promotes running as a friendly community activity.

name: Grymovská pětka
description: Grymov Five is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering athletes the chance to test their abilities in the pleasant surroundings of the town of Grymov. Liga stovkařů Olomouc is a club specializing in recreational and competitive running that organizes a number of endurance races in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of its running calendar and attracts runners of various ages and ability levels. The club also supports runners with training and race preparation, ensuring a high-quality sporting experience.

name: Běh Bohutínem
description: Běh Bohutínem is a traditional running race organized by SK Sporting Bohutín and held at the Litavan football pitch. The race offers an 8 km course for men and a 4 km course for women, with a surface combining asphalt and forest trails. The event also includes children’s races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. The main race starts at 13:00, and the atmosphere is friendly and sporty.

name: Běh Zlínského kraje
description: The Zlín Region Run is part of the Zlín Region Day celebrations, taking place on 26 September 2026 in Zlín. The event offers not only a sporting experience in the form of a 6 km run, but also a cultural programme, regional cuisine and family activities. The run is open to the general public and is part of a fun-filled day featuring crafts and regional products. The event is organised by the Zlín Region, which supports sport and local traditions.

name: Běh Velké skály
description: Běh Velké skály is a traditional running race held in Děčín, offering 11 km and 6.5 km courses through forest and urban terrain. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for the general public, including children, for whom special races are held. The race starts at the ASK Děčín athletics stadium, and its atmosphere is enhanced by the beautiful surrounding countryside and rock formations. The race is now in its 56th edition and is known for its exceptional atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Plzeňský kardioběh
description: The Plzeň Cardio Run is Plzeň’s largest cross-country race, with 5.8 km and 10 km courses. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup and also serves as the Czech Republic Cross-Country Championship for healthcare professionals. It is organized by Pro Sport Activities, an agency with a long-standing tradition of organizing sporting events in Plzeň and the surrounding area. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a quality sporting experience in the natural surroundings of Plzeň-Roudná.

name: 7 pohoří Beskydy
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountain Ranges is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The Beskydy race takes place at the Horečky amphitheatre in Trojanovice and offers technical trails, epic views and an atmosphere you won’t find anywhere else. The routes follow forest roads and paths, with climbs up interesting hills and long descents. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and can look forward to refreshments and professional facilities.

name: ŠumpeRUN
location: Historical Centre of Šumperk, Šumperk, Czech Republic
description: ŠumpeRUN is a popular city race through the historic center of Šumperk. The eighth edition offers races for the general public, including the main 10 km race, a 3.33 km race, three-person relay teams, and children’s races of various lengths. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit while celebrating the city’s cultural heritage. For 2026, a varied program of activities is planned, including group warm-ups and music along the course.

name: K3-run
description: K3 – the Krčmaň Run over Three Peaks is an 11.3 km race with approximately 350 metres of elevation gain. The route passes through beautiful countryside over three peaks, mainly on paved paths and partly on grass, with predominantly firm surfaces. This run offers athletes an enjoyable experience in nature and a challenge in the form of climbs and trail running.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: The 146th Gliwice Park Run Challenge is an annual running event held in Gliwice, combining sport, a friendly atmosphere and time in the city’s green spaces. The run is open to experienced runners and anyone looking to spend time actively without the pressure of competition. The start traditionally takes place in the clearing behind the Piast Stadium, and the race office opens at 9:00, with the run starting at 10:00. Advance registration and an entry fee are required. It’s a great opportunity to end February actively and head into the upcoming spring season with renewed energy.

name: X Cross Doliny Małej Panwi
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Mała Panew Team Zawadzkie Koło Towarzystwa Przyjaciół Lasu "Dolina Małej Panwi"
description: X Cross Doliny Małej Panwi – In Pursuit of the Beaver is a running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque surroundings of Zawadzkie. The event offers 5.3 km and 10.3 km routes through the Mała Panew Valley, giving participants the chance to connect with nature and enjoy an active break. It is organised by the Mała Panew Team Zawadzkie Association and the “Dolina Małej Panwi” Circle of the Society of Friends of the Forest.

name: XI Bieg po Gminie Zduńska Wola
XIII Bieg Branicki
description: The 13th Branice Run is a 10 km road race taking place on September 26, 2026, in Branice, Opole Voivodeship. Runners can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy a sporting atmosphere. The organizers provide expert support and the option to manage race information through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: XXI Mikołowski Bieg Uliczny
description: The 21st Henryk Biskupiak Mikołów Street Race is the biggest sporting celebration in Mikołów and takes place annually. The street race attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, promoting physical activity and the spirit of sporting competition. Participants can take on a route through the city streets, while the organizers provide professional support and an atmosphere full of sporting excitement. The event is an excellent opportunity to bring the local community together and promote a healthy lifestyle.

name: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków
description: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków is a cross-country race held in Reduta Park in Kraków, with 5 km and 10 km routes. The course runs mainly along paths and forest tracks, with one significant climb, combining sport with the opportunity to learn about the history of the Kraków Fortress. After the race, participants can explore historic fortifications and sites of the former Kraków Fortress with a guide, making the event a unique combination of physical activity and historical education. The organizers are members of the Adventure Association, who have been involved in organizing sporting and adventure events for years.
course_highlights: Cross-country course along paths and forest tracks
One substantial climb on the course
Visit to historic sites of the Kraków Fortress after the race
additional: After the race, participants and accompanying persons can visit historic sites of the former Kraków Fortress with a professional guide. The top finishers receive unique trophies made from 100-year-old bricks. The race routes are off-road and green, with history in the background. Guided visits to sites of the former Kraków Fortress are available after the race. Information about the distances, course, and location comes from previous editions; details of the edition on 25.09.2027 have not been confirmed.

name: VIII Bieg Szlakiem Kolejowym
location: Czerwona Woda, Gmina Węgliniec, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Masterprint Tihany Cross Terepfutás és Nordic Walking 5 / 10 / 20 / 30
description: The Masterprint Tihany Cross trail running and freestyle Nordic walking race takes place on the picturesque Tihany Peninsula, with a range of distances: 5, 10, 20 and 30 km. The course winds through beautiful autumn lavender fields and hilly forest trails marked with red marker tape. The event is family-friendly, with children’s races and a relay race. The race centre is located on the shore of Lake Belső, where the refreshment stations and finish area are well equipped. Runners can also order a professional technical running shirt.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly, multi-lap running race held in Dióskert. Runners can complete the half-marathon distance by running four laps, but they can also choose to run fewer laps. The entry fee is voluntary: 500 Ft per lap, which helps cover the costs of the race. All participants can look forward to an apple, hot tea and mulled wine, as well as a commemorative medal. The top three men and women will each receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.

name: BUCI FUTÁS
location: Soroksár Sportcsarnok, Sportcsarnok utca 2, Soroksár, Budapest, Hungary

name: BÜK–CSEPREG FÉLMARATON
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 10 km, 7 km, 1.8 km, 0.6 km, 0.4 km

name: ULTRA MÁRTÉLY
location: Bodnár Bertalan Természet- és Környezetvédelmi Oktatóközpont, Mártély, Hungary

name: Mariatálsky štvanec
description: Mariatálsky štvanec je tradičný bežecký závod v krásnej prírode Malých Karpát, ktorý ponúka rôzne disciplíny pre hobby bežcov aj výkonnostných pretekárov. Podujatie sa koná v obci Marianka s rodinnou atmosférou a vrcholí prekrásnym západom slnka. Súťažiť môžete v kategóriách na 6 km, 10 km, 15 km, v trojčlenných tímoch na 3×6 km, alebo v detských behoch Beh Záhoráčik. Štart a cieľ sú na futbalovom ihrisku, pričom preteky sa riadia pravidlami Slovenského atletického zväzu.

name: MTBIKER Kylof Ľubietová
location: Ľubietová, okr. Banská Bystrica, Ľubietová, okr. Banská Bystrica, OÚ Ľubietová
description: MTHIKER Kylof Ľubietová je bežecký závod, ktorý spája históriu, prírodu a dobrú náladu v malebnom prostredí srdca Slovenska. Preteká sa na troch tratiach: 4,3 km hobby trať pre začiatočníkov a mladých od 13 rokov, 10 km hlavný beh pre výkonnostných aj hobby bežcov a detské behy na 850 m pre deti od 6 do 12 rokov. Trať ponúka stúpania, krásne výhľady na Nízke Tatry a pretekári môžu súťažiť o finančné odmeny a hodnotné ceny. Po dobehu čaká na účastníkov tradičný granadír a originálna medaila patriaca do Marathon Tour.

name: Gréta Run
location: Liptovská .Sielnica okres L. Mikuláš, Liptovská .Sielnica okres L. Mikuláš, 8,7 km štart z Kvačianskej doliny (ústie) , 15 km štart z Koliby Gréta
description: Gréta Run je tradičný bežecký pretek v malebnom prostredí Kvačianskej doliny a Liptovskej Sielnice, ktorý ponúka trate rôznych dĺžok pre deti aj dospelých. Preteky vedú po žltej turistickej značke a hrádzi, s cieľom v Kolibe Gréta, kde pretekárov čaká občerstvenie a kultúrny program. Súčasťou podujatia je aj bohatý sprievodný program pre rodiny a deti. Organizátorom je Olympijský klub Liptova, ktorý zabezpečuje kvalitné technické a zdravotné služby.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 5. kolo
description: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 - 5. kolo je bežecké podujatie organizované 3klubom Šamorín v spolupráci s mestom Šamorín. Preteky sa konajú v príjemnom prostredí Lesoparku Pomlé v Šamoríne a sú určené pre rôzne vekové kategórie od predškolákov až po dospelých. Štart detských kategórií je o 10:00 hod., hlavný beh začína o 10:30 hod. Podujatie ponúka možnosť zapojiť sa do ligy a zažiť športovú atmosféru v komunitnom prostredí.

name: Běchovice - Praha, MČR v silničním běhu mužů, žen, juniorů a juniorek
description: Běchovice–Prague is a legendary 10 km road race with the longest unbroken tradition in Europe, now being held for the 130th time. The race is the official Czech Republic Road Running Championships and features a challenging 10,031-metre course that will test every runner. The exceptional atmosphere is complemented by modern facilities, including an accompanying programme and commemorative medals. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from juniors to veterans, and also offers a relay race.

name: Běh metropole Praha 1
description: Běh Metropole is a series of public running races held in various districts of Prague. Its aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle and a sense of belonging among residents of their district. The race is open to all age groups, from children to seniors, as well as people with disabilities, who represent their district. Every start earns points in the competition to determine Prague’s most sporting district. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with original medals and gifts for participants.

name: 48. Maraton Warszawski
description: The 48th Warsaw Marathon is a special running event held in the heart of Warsaw, attracting thousands of runners. The course passes through the capital’s most beautiful and historic locations, offering unique views and an unforgettable atmosphere. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and T-shirt, while spectators can enjoy numerous attractions and cheering zones. It is a celebration of running that brings together sport, culture, and community.
course_highlights: Start beneath the Palace of Culture and Science in the centre of Warsaw
The course passes along Krakowskie Przedmieście and Nowy Świat, over Poniatowski Bridge with views of the Vistula, and by PGE Narodowy
Road closures ensure safe and comfortable running conditions
additional: The race number must be worn on the front of the clothing and must not be covered or altered. The start and finish are in the city centre, near metro stations. On race day, baggage storage, changing rooms, and toilets are available. The event features numerous attractions and cheering zones, as well as a programme at the Marathon Fan Zone and EXPO Sport&Fitness. Participants can join the #BiegamDobrze charity programme with a free race number. Races include a 10 km event (Warszawska Dycha) and the Mini Marathon for children and young people, held during the same weekend. Registration is available through the official website, and the event also includes a half marathon and a 5 km race. The organisers provide attractions and support for participants.

name: 21. Kamień Extreme - Rybnik
description: The 21st Kamień Extreme is a challenging mountain run held in Rybnik, attracting fans of extreme running challenges. The race takes place on September 27, 2026, and offers professional timing using RFID technology. The event is organized by MOSiR Rybnik, providing participants with smooth organization and a sporting atmosphere. The race starts at 12:00, and registration closes on September 17, 2026, at 23:59.

name: 1 Półmaraton Ostrzeszowski
description: The 1st Ostrzeszów Half Marathon – Along the Crown of the Wielkopolska Hills 2026 is a unique half-marathon taking place in picturesque Ostrzeszów. The course leads over two hills and past two springs, offering participants one-of-a-kind views and terrain challenges. It’s a great opportunity to experience the natural beauty of Wielkopolska and enjoy a sporting adventure in a friendly atmosphere. We invite all runners to take on the challenge and join the event.
course_highlights: Course over two hills
Route passes two springs
Picturesque landscapes of Wielkopolska

name: 16 Bieg im. Pawła Lorensa
description: The 16th Paweł Lorens Memorial Run is an annual 10 km race held in the picturesque setting of Lake Paprocany in Tychy. The race commemorates the achievements of outstanding runner Paweł Lorens, a multiple Polish Championship medalist and promoter of athletics in the region. The course is flat and fast, following compacted paths along the pedestrian promenade and a paved sidewalk. Free children’s races are also held on race day, with registration available on the day of the event.

name: Kresowe Trail #11
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate, non-commercial trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in natural surroundings. The races take place mainly in the Podlasie region and surrounding areas, offering two distances: Szpurt (approx. 6–8 km) and Wertep (approx. 17–21 km). The events have a limited number of participants, helping ensure safety and respect for nature and local communities. They welcome both beginner and experienced runners and also include Nordic walking competitions. The 2026 season will conclude with the final race in Michałowo on September 27.

name: X Półmaraton Crossowy
description: The X TOYOTA Cross Half Marathon is a cross-country race held in Jelcz-Laskowice on September 27, 2026. The event is organized by KB Harcownik Jelcz-Laskowice, and the race office is open from 08:00 to 10:30 at the Nad Stawem center. Participants can compete in the 21.1 km and 10.5 km races, or take part in the 10.5 km Nordic Walking event. The event is supported by local institutions and partners, and timing is electronic, using modern equipment.

name: XXVIII Jesienne Biegi Małkińskie
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Małkini Górnej
description: The 28th Małkinia Autumn Runs is an annual running event held in Małkinia Górna, attracting runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The competition takes place on cross-country routes, offering participants the chance to compete amid beautiful autumn scenery. The event is part of the Cross-Country Running and Nordic Walking Grand Prix, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in the local community.

name: Festiwal Biegowy i Nordic Walking
location: Olszewo-Borki, Ostrołęka County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Nice To Fit You Warszawska Dycha
Nowotarski Półmaraton
location: Nowy Targ, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XII Zielona Wierzchosławicka Dycha
location: Wierzchosławice, Tarnów County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: ESZTERGOM FÉLMARATON
description: The Esztergom Half Marathon is a running event with a variety of distances, held in Esztergom’s historic districts, including Castle Hill and the Water Town, as well as on the riverside cycle path. Individual and relay runners can choose from several distances, and shorter races are organized separately for children. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and also serves as a points-collection station for the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to collect points and earn rewards. The event’s honorary patrons include the Mayor of Esztergom and well-known athletes, adding to its prestige.

name: Wink-Intretech KapuvárRun 2026
description: The Wink-Intretech KapuvárRun 2026 will be held for the fifth time in Kapuvár, in Eszterházi Park. The race takes place on completely flat city streets and attracts more Hungarian and international runners each year. The event aims to share the joy of movement and the sense of community, with a great atmosphere and togetherness at its heart. The experience continues after the finish, with award ceremonies and a large event tent where spectators can comfortably cheer on the runners.

name: Fut a Börs
location: Budaörs Városi Uszoda, Hársfa utca 6, Budaörs, Hungary

name: II. Kerületi Kaptató
location: Gyarmati Dezső Swimming Pool, Máriaremetei út 224, Budapest II. kerület, Hungary

name: Svatováclavský běh Blažovicemi
organizer: Spolek přátel Svatováclavského běhu - sdružení Vévoda
description: The St. Wenceslas Run through Blažovice is a traditional cross-country and trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Blažovice in the South Moravian Region. It offers two main routes of 10 km and 5 km, running mostly along natural paths and forest trails. The event also includes community runs and children’s races ranging from 50 to 1,100 metres, making it appealing to a wide audience and families with children. It is organised by the Friends of the St. Wenceslas Run Association, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organisation.

name: Běh Neumannovou stezkou
description: The Neumann Trail Run is a traditional running race organized by the T. J. Sokol Unhošť running club in the picturesque, wooded surroundings of Unhošť. The race offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in nature and is complemented by children’s races. Runners who register in advance receive a lower entry fee. The event has a long history and is held regularly in autumn.

name: MilešovKa(p)
description: MilešovKa(p) is a traditional 17.5 km running race from Teplice to Milešovka, with 846 m of elevation gain. The course follows asphalt roads, hiking trails, and dirt and forest paths, and is marked with the Czech Tourist Club’s red and blue trail markings. The race is open to the general public and offers awards for the top finishers in each category, hill climbers, and age-record holders. It is organized by SPONA Teplice, an association that supports amateur sport in the region. The results are announced alongside other running events in November.

name: Běh kolem Panské skály
description: The Run Around Panská skála is a popular trail race taking place on September 28, 2026, in Kamenický Šenov-Prácheň in the Liberec Region. The race offers 3 km and 6 km routes through hilly terrain around Panská skála and is part of the Českolipsko District Running League. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and experienced racers, offering a unique experience of running in nature with beautiful views.

name: Podzimní běh projektantů "Od hospody k hospodě"
description: The Designers’ Autumn Run “From Pub to Pub” is a traditional running event held in the picturesque surroundings of Krč Forest in Prague 4-Krč. The race is popular with runners and has been held for many years, welcoming all running enthusiasts and nature lovers. Organizers Pepa Krejčí and Honza Vočko warmly invite you to take part in this popular race, which offers an enjoyable experience in nature. Registration is available on race day, approximately one hour before the start.

name: ACE BATTLE RUN:  ACE BATTLE Mile indywidualni zawody rankingowe na dystan...
Běh Karla Havlíčka Borovského
location: Park Budoucnost, Havlíčkův Brod, Czech Republic
description: The Karel Havlíček Borovský Run is a traditional circuit race in Havlíčkův Brod, offering distances for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The route runs through Budoucnost Park and passes notable landmarks, including the memorial to the victims of the world wars and the statue of Karel Havlíček Borovský. The race is suitable for all age groups and features a mix of paved and unpaved paths with gentle elevation changes. The start and finish are at the elementary school at V Sadech 560, where showers and toilets are also available.

name: Baran Trail Race
description: Baran Trail Race is a recurring running event held in scenic Węgierska Górka. The event offers a range of distances from 10 km to 100 km, along challenging mountain routes with beautiful views and natural terrain. It attracts both amateurs and experienced runners, offering unique challenges and an exciting atmosphere. The organizers ensure the event runs professionally and participants stay safe.

name: Jarabský polmaratón
location: Jarabá, Brezno District, Banská Bystrica Region, Slovakia
description: Jarabský polmaratón je jedinečný horský trailový pretek v Nízkych Tatrách s dĺžkou 22,1 km, ktorý ponúka náročnú trasu plnú stúpaní, klesaní a technického terénu. Pretek je určený pre milovníkov trailového behu a aktívneho oddychu, ktorí si môžu vychutnať krásne výhľady a atmosféru komunity bežcov od profesionálov po rekreačných športovcov. Podujatie má tradíciu od roku 2015 a nesie v sebe ducha priateľského bežeckého stretnutia „Choď ako môžeš okolo Jarabej“. V roku 2025 je zaradený do Slovenskej skyrunningovej ligy, čo podčiarkuje jeho kvalitu a výzvu.

name: U.S.Steel Family Run – Minimaratón
description: U. S. Steel Family Run - Minimaratón je bežecké podujatie v Košiciach, ktoré je súčasťou tradičného Medzinárodného maratónu mieru. Bežci všetkých vekových kategórií sú vítaní bez vekového obmedzenia. Podujatie sa riadi pravidlami World Athletics a Slovenského atletického zväzu, pričom organizátori zabezpečujú kvalitnú prípravu a organizáciu. Štart a cieľ sú situované na Hlavnej ulici v Košiciach, čo umožňuje atraktívny mestský beh.

name: Karpaty Run – Bratislava Trail Run
location: Malokarpatské Námestie 1, Bratislava - Lamač, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Karpaty Run - Bratislava Trail Run je najväčší bežecký trailový festival v Malých Karpatoch, ktorý ponúka trasy rôznej dĺžky a náročnosti pre bežcov aj turistov. Preteky sa konajú v príjemnom prírodnom prostredí s dôrazom na ochranu prírody a zdravý životný štýl. Trasy vedú prevažne lesnými zvážnicami a trailmi s minimálnym asfaltovým povrchom, vhodné pre mierne pokročilých až pokročilých bežcov. Organizátorom je občianske združenie Hojta, ktoré podporuje športovanie a ekologické hodnoty.
course_highlights: Trasy vedú 65 % lesnou zvážnicou a 33-35 % lesným trailom
Prevýšenie od 80 m do 876 m podľa dĺžky trate
Občerstvenie na trati na viacerých miestach podľa dĺžky trate
additional: Štart je 700 m od Malokarptského námestia v Lamači s presunom 20 min pred štartom. Časový limit nie je stanovený pre väčšinu tratí, okrem najdlhších, kde je limit 5 alebo 7 hodín. Na trati sú občerstvovacie stanice podľa dĺžky trate. Možnosť zakúpiť občerstvenie na Bielom Kríži. Preteky sa konajú 3. októbra 2026, registrácia je možná prostredníctvom oficiálnej stránky, pretekárske kategórie zahŕňajú rôzne vekové skupiny, preteky sú bez časového limitu pre väčšinu vzdialeností.

name: PUMA Třeboňský půl/maraton 10 a 5 km
description: The Puma Třeboň Marathon, Half Marathon, 10 km and 5 km races run through the unique natural landscape of the Třeboňsko Protected Landscape Area. The courses are flat with minimal elevation gain, mostly following paved cycling paths and forest trails, allowing runners to achieve personal bests in beautiful, peaceful surroundings. The race starts in Třeboň’s Renaissance square and passes through a historic gate into a nature reserve that is a candidate for UNESCO listing. The ideal October date offers pleasant running weather and a motivating atmosphere, with professional pacers on the course.

name: Run Berounka Run
description: Run Berounka Run is a relay race for teams and individuals that follows the Berounka River from Újezd u Svatého Kříže to Prague-Radotín. The 130 km route is divided into 6 legs, with over 3,100 metres of elevation gain, mainly on forest and field roads. The race starts on 3 October 2026 from 5:00 a.m. in several waves; the Ultra category starts the evening of 2 October. The race is open to teams of 2 to 6 runners and individuals in the Ultra category. Winners are announced in several categories, and refreshments are provided at the finish.

name: 24DS (24 Dlouhé Stráně)
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: 24DS is a 24-hour endurance challenge in the unique setting of the Hrubý Jeseník mountains, running from Kouty nad Desnou to the upper reservoir of the Dlouhé Stráně pumped-storage hydroelectric power station. The race offers stunning views of the Jeseníky Mountains and combines day and night running with sunrise and sunset. The demanding route has 820 metres of elevation gain and is 90% trail, making it suitable for individuals and pairs. The Kouty nad Desnou resort offers comfortable facilities, including restaurants, accommodation and parking.

name: Běh kolem Hejtmanu
description: The Run Around Hejtman is a traditional sporting event held in Chlum u Třeboně in the Třeboň region on the second Saturday in October. The main event is a 10 km run with a time limit of 1 hour and 20 minutes, following local roads and fishpond dams through picturesque surroundings. The race is open to the public and takes place amid regular road traffic, with an emphasis on safety and compliance with the rules. Shorter races are organized for children and young people up to 15 years old, with on-site registration on race day. The organizer is TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně, z.s.

name: ČEZ RunTour Praha
location: Praha, Park Ladronka (u televizní věže), Praha
description: ČEZ RunTour Prague is a family-friendly running event offering distances of 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km for recreational runners and elite athletes, as well as children’s races over 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ladronka Park and is part of a nationwide series held at eight unique locations. The organisers focus on excellent service, safety and fun for the whole family, including an accompanying programme and a charitable element. Every participant receives a race pack and can support charity by taking part.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - říjen
location: Příluky, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The 2 Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of fewer than two laps on a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant can look forward to a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish as a reward for their effort.

name: Běh na Čerťák
description: Běh na Čerťák is a traditional race organized by AK Běžci z Rýmařova, held at the Flemmich Garden complex in Rýmařov. The race offers courses for various age categories, from preschoolers to seniors, with the main route running along forest roads and over the summit of Kamenná hora. The start is at the SKI Flemmich Garden complex, and the course includes field roads, meadows, and forest trails with beautiful views. Refreshments and the results ceremony are provided after the race at the SKI complex. The race is part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region, and category winners receive prizes.

name: Benešovská osmička
description: Benešovská osmička is a traditional cross-country race in Benešov near Semily, held for more than half a century. The race offers courses for the whole family, from preschool children to veterans, with the main 8,000-metre race winding through the picturesque countryside around the village and along the slopes of Benešov Hill. The start and race facilities are at the sports complex in Horní Benešov. Prizes are provided for competitors, and light refreshments are available for all participants and spectators.

name: Běh města Příbrami
description: The Příbram City Run is a traditional running event held for the 32nd year in the picturesque setting of Nový rybník in Příbram. The event offers various categories, including the 10 km main race, relays, and children’s runs, welcoming a wide range of runners. It is suitable for families, students, and individuals looking to enjoy a sporting day in a friendly atmosphere. Start times and registration are tailored to each category to ensure everything runs smoothly and is well organized.

name: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run
location: Liberec, Náměstí Dr. E. Beneše před libereckou radnicí, Liberecký
description: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run is a race in nature that gives runners the chance to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and enjoy running along forest trails in the Jizera Mountains. It is the final race of the season and runs through the forest, around a reservoir, across a granite quarry, and back. Runners can choose between a shorter 12 km route and a longer 22 km route, allowing them to test their strength amid beautiful natural scenery.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - říjen
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open race for runners of all ages and abilities who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. The course follows Stromovka’s paved paths. Adults run two laps (3.2 km), while children aged 12 and under run one lap (1.6 km). After the race, everyone is rewarded with a warm cinnamon pancake. The race is part of the year-round Lívancový pohár, which encourages regular participation and reflection on performance.

name: SILESIA kros 1/2marathon ZRUŠENO
description: SILESIA Cross 1/2 Marathon is a traditional cross-country running race held in Opava-Kylešovice, with its event hub at the U Chovatelů grounds. The race offers 21 km and 13 km courses that pass through scenic locations including Raduň, Vršovice, Chvalíkovice, Hradec nad Moravicí, Branka and Opava. The course is challenging and partly uses roads open to traffic. Participants must follow fair-play rules and respect nature. Times are recorded electronically without chips, and the awards ceremony takes place at the finish venue. The 2026 race has been cancelled, but information about previous editions and courses is available.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem
description: The Run Through the Chateau Park is a race set in the picturesque surroundings of Vlašim Chateau Park. The 8.4 km course combines off-road and paved sections, offering runners a varied experience. The race is organized by Atletika Vlašim, z.s., and is part of the official Czech Running calendar. The event is ideal for runners looking to enjoy a run in a beautiful park with a historic atmosphere.

name: Z(a)tracené vrchy
description: Z(a)tracené vrchy is an adrenaline-fueled team orienteering-and-beer race that combines running, walking, and crawling, held in the scenic terrain of Bordovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. Participants must complete the course carrying a 10-liter keg of beer on their backs, take part in mini-games at checkpoints, and drink the beer at the checkpoints. The race combines a physical challenge with teamwork and fun, and the course winds through rugged terrain with climbs and descents. The winning team receives a perpetual trophy and gift packages. The event is for adults over 18 and emphasizes participant safety and responsibility.

name: Běh Pístovickou riviérou
description: The Pístovice Riviera Run is a traditional cross-country race along forest paths above the Pístovice Riviera recreation area in Pístovice near Vyškov. The race is open to everyone who enjoys healthy exercise, from children to adults, and takes place in all weather. The course is uneven, with possible puddles and mud, and includes uphill and downhill running and walking. The organizers, Lyžařský klub Vyškov, warmly invite runners and spectators to take part and support sport in the region.

name: Cibulka - Košířský okruh
description: Cibulka - Košířský Circuit is a popular running race held in Prague’s Košíře district, featuring a course approximately 4.5 km long. The race is part of a series of local running events and is intended for recreational runners as well as those looking to improve their performance in a natural setting. The route follows forest roads and trails around the Cibulka lookout tower, providing a pleasant and varied environment for running. The event is suitable for all ages and running levels, with an emphasis on enjoying exercise outdoors.

name: Běh za bořetickým burčákem
description: The Run for Bořetice Burčák is a traditional sporting event held in the picturesque wine-growing village of Bořetice, in the heart of the Blue Mountains. The run gives participants the chance to experience the beautiful landscape of vineyards and wine cellars characteristic of this part of South Moravia. The event is organized by the Bořetice Municipal Cultural Commission, SDH Bořetice, and the Republic of Kraví hora, and is part of the village’s rich cultural calendar. The run is scheduled to start in the afternoon on October 3, 2026, at Sólo by the cultural center.

name: ING Biegnij Warszawo
description: ING Run Warsaw is one of Poland’s best-known running events, bringing thousands of participants together in the heart of the capital each year. The race takes place on the first Saturday of October and offers a 10-kilometer course passing through Warsaw’s most iconic landmarks. The FUNRUN format focuses on the joy of being active, without pressure or competition, encouraging participants to run, walk, or jog at their own pace. Along the route, participants are supported by music zones, cheering spectators, and motivating partner points, and every participant receives a commemorative Nike Dri-FIT T-shirt and a medal at the finish.

name: VIII Bieg Zielonym Szlakiem Niziny Mazow...
description: The 8th Run Along the Green Trail of the Masovian Lowland is a 5 km race taking place on September 27, 2026, in Czerwonka Włościańska. The start and finish are located at the Primary School in Czerwonka. The event is organized by local sports clubs and institutions, and the course runs through the scenic terrain of the Masovian Lowland. The event is open to adults and young people over the age of 15 with the consent of a legal guardian.

name: XIII Podbieg na Makowicę
description: The 13th Podbieg na Makowicę is a 10 km mountain race taking place on October 3, 2026, in Rytro, Małopolska. The course has a challenging profile with uphill sections, making it an excellent challenge for runners who enjoy mountain routes. The organizers encourage runners to prepare using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes running and supports runners in their preparations.

name: XXXVII Oskie Biegi im. Krzysztofa Malinowskiego
JÁSZFÉNYSZARUI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.6 km, 0.3 km
organizer: Petőfi Sándor Művelődési Ház és Könyvtár Jászfényszaru
description: The 7th Jászfényszaru Running Festival is a recreational running event held in Jászfényszaru at Szentcsalád Square. It offers distances for several age groups, from kindergarten children to adults, on paved roads and short dirt sections. The quarter marathon features chip timing, refreshment stations and medals. All distances are free to enter. The event aims to promote community sports and running, in memory of István Maróti.

name: MAPEI TIHANYI FÉLMARATON (XI.)   .
description: The MAPEI Tihany Half Marathon is a traditional running event held for the 11th time in Tihany, offering a range of distances for runners from beginners to advanced athletes. The race is distinguished by the beautiful panoramic views of the Balaton Uplands and its challenging, varied terrain, which takes in the peninsula’s most scenic areas. Many runners choose the half-marathon distance for their first half marathon, as the course and its spectacular sections make for an unforgettable experience. The event is family-friendly, with a baby run for the youngest participants. Runners in every distance receive a finisher’s medal, refreshments, and a running shirt.

name: MVM Sopron Félmaraton
location: Városi Stadion, Káposztás u. 4., Sopron, Hungary

name: Medzinárodný maratón mieru
description: Medzinárodný maratón mieru v Košiciach je tradičný bežecký sviatok, ktorý sa koná 4. októbra 2026 na Hlavnej ulici. Organizovaný Maratónskym klubom Košice, ponúka maratónsku trať, polmaratón a ďalšie disciplíny, pričom štart a cieľ sú situované v centre mesta. Podujatie je známe svojou dlhou históriou a kvalitnou organizáciou, vrátane Majstrovstiev Slovenska v polmaratóne. Bežci môžu očakávať profesionálnu časomieru a bohatý sprievodný program.

name: Majstrovstvá SR v polmaratóne mužov a žien - MMM 2026
OLFINCAR HRADECKÝ PŮL/MARATON
description: OLFINCAR Hradec Králové Half Marathon is the largest sporting event in Eastern Bohemia and has been held since 2013. The race offers certified courses, including a marathon, half marathon, relay, 10 km race, and children’s races. The course is one of the fastest in the Czech Republic and is considered one of the most scenic urban courses. In 2026, the event will also host the Czech Masters Half Marathon Championships and the Czech Championships for emergency and security services in the half marathon. The facilities at the new football arena in the city center provide runners with comfortable services.

name: Horský běh Alfrédka - Memoriál Miroslava Čermáka
description: The Alfrédka Mountain Run – Miroslav Čermák Memorial is a race run mainly along forest roads, covering 13.6 km with 430 m of elevation gain. It is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix and the Czech Mountain Running Cup. The challenging route through the beautiful countryside of the Moravian-Silesian Region is ideal for fans of mountain running and endurance events. The race takes place in Stará Ves near Rýmařov and is suitable for experienced runners looking for a trail challenge.

name: Běh okolo Panoramy
description: The Run Around Panorama is a traditional cross-country race through challenging mountain terrain around Jáchymov’s football stadium. The race is open to all age groups and is being held for the 33rd year. The event is organised by Tělovýchovná jednota Jáchymov and offers a sporting experience in the beautiful surroundings of the Ore Mountains.

name: Běh údolím Orlice
organizer: Tělovýchovná jednota Sokol Klášterec nad Orlicí
description: The Orlice Valley Run is a traditional cross-country race held in Klášterec nad Orlicí, offering routes through meadows and along local roads over hilly terrain. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. Winners receive medals, prizes and cash awards. The start and finish are at the football pitch by the school, and the main race begins in the morning.

name: Slatinský kros
description: Slatinský Cross-Country Run is a traditional cross-country running race held in Brno-Slatina, now in its 19th year. The race takes place in Terénky Park on Dědická Street and features a grassy course with rolling terrain, putting runners to the test in a pleasant natural setting. The event is held under the auspices of the Brno-Slatina Municipal District and is suitable for the general public. Participants can look forward to trophies, medals, and valuable prizes.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - říjen
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race focuses on the joy of running and competing primarily against yourself. It takes place in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc by the fountain, except for some June and August races, which are held by the river. The run is part of a cup competition, where results are adjusted using an age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.

name: Roštejnské stráně
description: Roštejnské stráně is a traditional cross-country race organized by Orel Telč and part of the Orel Running League. This 14th edition takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ranč u Lipek in Telč and offers various categories, including family relays and a fun run for beginners. The race is open to all age groups and emphasizes fair play and sportsmanship. Winners will receive medals, certificates, and prizes, with special awards also presented to the youngest and oldest runners.

name: Běh kolem Lužnice
