name: Tálínská desítka
location: Náves před obecním úřadem, Tálín, Czech Republic
organizer: Obec Tálín a Progres TT Tálín
description: Tálínská desítka is a traditional running race held in the village of Tálín, bringing together athletes of all ages in the village’s picturesque setting. The race is part of the village’s sports calendar and supports community life and sporting activities for local residents and visitors. The event is organized in cooperation with local sports clubs, including Triatlon Team Tálín, and offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners. The start and finish are on the village square in front of the municipal office, creating a friendly atmosphere and making the race easily accessible to participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the village square in front of the municipal office in Tálín
Picturesque village setting suitable for running
Event suitable for all age groups, including people with physical disabilities
additional: The race is part of Tálín’s sporting events, which support community life and are open to the general public, including children, seniors, and people with physical disabilities. It is organized by local sports clubs Triatlon Team Tálín and Galaxy Cyklošvec Písek. The village also has the V OBRAZE mobile app for following current information. The date October 23, 2027, has not been confirmed by available sources; sources refer to the 2026 edition.

name: Třebíčský maraton
description: The Třebíč Marathon invites you to run through the picturesque streets of Třebíč’s historic centre, where you can admire the atmosphere of its UNESCO landmarks, including the iconic Basilica of St. Procopius. In addition to the marathon, you can choose the half-marathon or the shorter 10K, both of which also pass through the city’s historic and natural beauty. Refreshment stations await you along the course and at the finish, followed by a relaxing AfterRun party—the perfect way to round off a day of sport. Families can also enjoy children’s races right in the city centre, with an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: Picturesque streets in Třebíč’s historic centre
The atmosphere of UNESCO landmarks, including the Basilica of St. Procopius
Refreshment stations along the course and a welcoming atmosphere
additional: The registration fee must be paid within 14 days of registration; otherwise, the registration will be cancelled. After completing online registration, you can also register on site, but the number of race packs is limited. An AfterRun party will round off the day after the race. Children’s races take place right in the city centre, with a lively atmosphere. The event offers a marathon, half-marathon, 10K race and children’s races. Prices published for the 2026 edition may not apply to 2027.

name: Slapy Trail Maniacs
description: Slapy Trail Maniacs is a marked trail race around the Slapy Reservoir, offering three challenging routes of 61 km, 47 km, and 33 km. The main course, with 2,300 metres of elevation gain, follows roads, paths, stream crossings, rocky outcrops, and steep drops, making for a varied and technically interesting run. There are two course premiums—a climbing premium and a speed premium—and the race is also suitable for earning ITRA points. Medals, diplomas, prizes in kind, and prize money are prepared for the top runners. The organizer is Š&P Outdoor z.s., which provides high-quality organization and support for runners.
course_highlights: 61 km main course with 2,300 m of elevation gain
Routes follow roads, paths, stream crossings, rocky outcrops, and steep drops
Climbing and speed premiums on the course
additional: Participants who complete the 61 km or 47 km routes can earn ITRA points. Medals, diplomas, prizes in kind, and prize money await the fastest runners. The organizer is Š&P Outdoor z.s.; the contact person is Ondřej Kutiš. The marked race features technically challenging terrain around the Slapy Reservoir. Race facilities are listed at Hořovická chata in Borotice. Information about the routes and prices comes from a previous edition and may not apply to the 2027 edition.

name: Olomoucký kros
location: Přírodní koupaliště Poděbrady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Olomouc Cross is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the natural surroundings of the Poděbrady swimming pool in Olomouc. The race is part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region and gives athletes the opportunity to test their fitness and performance in a beautiful natural setting. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for the general public as well as competitive runners who want to test themselves in a cross-country race.
course_highlights: Run in the natural surroundings of the Poděbrady swimming pool
Part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region
Cross-country race with natural obstacles
additional: Available information about previous editions relates to races for children and young people; the program for the 2027 edition has not been confirmed.

name: Skalička run
location: Obecní hřiště, Skalička, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Skalička Run is the fifth edition of a successful off-road running event, held mainly in the valley of the Lubě stream in the South Moravian Region. The race offers three distances—22 km, 13 km and 7 km—on cross-country and trail terrain. It starts at the municipal sports ground in Skalička and is suitable for nature-running enthusiasts seeking different levels of difficulty. The event is organized by DálRunDál z.s., led by Pavel Matoušek.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly through the valley of the Lubě stream
Cross-country and trail terrain
Distances of 22 km, 13 km and 7 km
additional: The race is organized by DálRunDál z.s.; the contact person is Pavel Matoušek. The start is at the municipal sports ground in Skalička. Race type: cross-country/trail. The first category starts at 11:15. The first category start time is listed as 11:15; the start location is the municipal sports ground.

name: Leskros Hradečák
location: Kemp Stříbrný rybník, Malšova Lhota, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Hradečák is part of Leskros, the largest Czech running and canicross series, offering an authentic trail-running experience. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Stříbrný rybník campsite in Malšova Lhota near Hradec Králové, and includes various running and canicross categories as well as the unique Leskrosí jednadváca race. Individuals and whole families can take part, with children’s races and a charity walk also on offer. The series emphasizes fairness, transparency, and support for nonprofit organizations through entry fees and donations.
course_highlights: Authentic trail running in interesting locations across the Czech Republic
Canicross on the main route, approximately 4 km, with OPEN and ELITE categories
The unique Leskrosí jednadváca: 19–22 km along an unmarked route through beautiful places in the surrounding area
additional: The race offers running, canicross, and Leskrosí jednadváca categories. The Rozběháček children’s running program is free. A 4 km charity walk is also part of the event. Results for individual races and the whole series are announced. Registration and entries are managed through the Rozběháme Česko app. The organizer is the nonprofit organization Rozběháme Česko z.ú., which supports charitable projects. For the 2026 edition, the first category was scheduled to start at 8:00; this time may not apply to the 2027 edition.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Prokopské údolí
location: Prokopské údolí, Praha 5, Prague, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: děti 0-5 let: 60 Kč pro přihlášené a zaplacené předem

description: KEEN Prague Park Race – Prokopské údolí is a traditional autumn running race set in the beautiful natural surroundings of Prague’s Prokopské and Dalejské valleys. It offers two main courses, approximately 8.7 and 14.3 km long, on paved and unpaved paths, meadows and trails, with limited traffic on the asphalt roads. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants and has a relaxed atmosphere, refreshments and children’s races. The field is limited to 500 runners, helping ensure a comfortable event. The organizers emphasize clear course markings and runner safety.
course_highlights: Courses run through the beautiful, rugged landscape of Prokopské and Dalejské valleys
Two courses of approximately 8.7 km and 14.3 km, with every kilometre marked
Courses combine paved and unpaved paths, meadows, trails and asphalt roads with limited traffic
additional: Race-day check-in and registration take place from 9:00 to 10:45. The children’s races start from 10:00; the main races start at 10:45 (8 km) and 11:00 (14 km). The field is limited to 500 runners. On-site registration is available for an additional fee of 600 Kč if capacity has not been reached. There is one refreshment station on the course. The timing chip is attached to the race bib and does not need to be returned after finishing. Trail shoes with a more aggressive tread are recommended. The venue has toilets, baggage storage, changing tents, a results ceremony and a raffle. Course, price and start-time details are from the 2026 edition; information for the 2027 edition has not been confirmed in available sources.

name: Běhej Valachy
location: Hotel Galik, Velké Karlovice, Czech Republic
description: Běhej Valachy is a trail-running race across the rugged hills of the picturesque Velké Karlovice valley. The course follows the Hanzlůvka valley and passes the Za Miloňovou bell tower before climbing to the ridge of the Vsetín Beskids, below Vysoká and up to Člověčí. From there, it descends along a steep ridge with beautiful views of the Beskids and Javorníky. The race offers unique views, challenging climbs, and a memorable experience of movement and nature. It also includes children’s races for various age groups and a family race.
course_highlights: The course follows the Hanzlůvka valley and passes the Za Miloňovou bell tower on its way to the ridge of the Vsetín Beskids.
Beautiful views of the Beskids and Javorníky from a steep ridge.
A challenging climb past the U Křenků cottage and a mountain sprint at an elevation of 938 m above sea level.
additional: There are mass starts for adults running 12.5 km and 6.5 km, as well as a 3.2 km family race. Children’s races are divided into age categories from 4 to 15 years. The start area opens at 11:45; check-in and registration for children take place from 8:00 to 9:15, and adult check-in runs from 9:30 to 11:30. The finish straight is attractive and offers plenty of room for a final sprint. The organizer reserves the right to change the schedule on race day. According to information available for the 2026 edition, the races on offer are 12.5 km, 6.5 km, and a 3.2 km family run, alongside the children’s races. Facilities include registration, a changing room, showers, and refreshments; prices for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka Ostrava
location: Městský stadion Ostrava-Vítkovice, Ostrava, Czech Republic
description: The Emil Zátopek Golden Marathon Ostrava is a prestigious running event offering a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race, and mixed team race on a fast, certified course in Ostrava-Vítkovice. The event takes place at the Ostrava-Vítkovice City Stadium, with both the start and finish on the stadium track. Runners can follow in the footsteps of the legendary Emil Zátopek and experience the atmosphere of a professionally organized race with an accompanying program and high-quality event organization. The race package includes an original technical shirt, a medal, and refreshments during and after the race. The event is suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes.
course_highlights: Fast, certified course in Ostrava-Vítkovice
Start and finish on the track at the City Stadium
8 aid stations on the marathon course offering water, fruit, and energy supplements
additional: The race bib with timing chip must be worn on the chest for accurate timekeeping. After the start, marathon runners complete one lap of the stadium track before heading out onto the course. Lead and follow vehicles and cyclists accompany the front and back of the field. Changing rooms, toilets, and baggage storage are available at the stadium. Parking is available for a fee at Ostravar Arena or, in limited numbers, free of charge on nearby streets. After the race, a generous selection of refreshments, an expo, and free physiotherapy are available. The 2026 edition, originally scheduled for 24 October 2026, was moved to 2027 because of road reconstruction in Ostrava and the surrounding area. The date 23 October 2027 has not been confirmed on the official website.

name: Moravská Sázava
location: Horský Resort Buková Hora, Červená Voda, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné ULTRA 50 je stanoveno na 1.000,- Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné DVOJIC je stanoveno na 1.000,- Kč / člen dvojice

description: Moravská Sázava Ultra 50 is a 50 km ultrarunning race that follows the valleys of the Moravská Sázava River from Zábřeh to the summit of Buková hora. The course offers a varied mix of forest roads, natural trails and paved sections, with a total elevation gain of 1,369 metres. The race is suitable for experienced ultrarunners as well as runners looking for a new challenge, and finishes at the summit of Buková hora, from where participants can comfortably ride the cable car down. After the race, camping is available in the finish area, with showers and breakfast on Sunday morning.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1,369 m of elevation gain
A mix of forest roads, natural trails and paved sections
Finish at the summit of Buková hora, with the option to ride down by cable car
additional: Participants receive an ID wristband, race bib and GPS tracker. Aid stations along the course provide water, sports drinks, Coca-Cola and fruit. After the race, camping is available at the finish, with access to showers. The finish area is at the cable car’s upper station, and participants can comfortably ride down by cable car. Results are timed electronically and manually. GPS trackers are mandatory and are used to track participants online. The race is included in the UTMB Index 50K and ITRA 50K - 2. The race base is at Horský Resort Buková Hora.

name: Běh kolem Asuánu
location: Jižní konec retenční nádrže Asuán, Jinonice, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Asuán is a traditional cross-country race held on the dam of the Asuán retention reservoir in Prague’s Jinonice district. It offers courses of various lengths for all age groups, from the youngest children to adults, on gently undulating natural terrain, finishing on a paved straight. The race can only be reached on foot from several nearby bus stops and is organized by Atletika Stodůlky z.s. The entry fee is voluntary, making the event accessible to runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Gently undulating course on natural terrain
Paved finishing straight
Start and race office on the dam of the Asuán retention reservoir, accessible on foot
additional: Race categories are divided by age, with course distances ranging from 250 m for the youngest runners to 3600 m for men. The start and race office are located at the southern end of the Asuán retention reservoir. Access is on foot only from the Ovčí hájek and Galerie Butovice bus stops and the Volcano complex. Information about the 2027 edition was not confirmed in the available sources.

name: Běh do vrchu na Pastýřskou stěnu
location: Pastýřská stěna, Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic

name: Łemkowyna Trail
location: Krynica-Zdrój, Powiat nowotarski, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
distance_verbose: Ultramaraton, 100 km, Ultramaraton, 50 km, Maraton, 28 km, 10 km
description: Łemkowyna Trail is a mountain race along a route marked by the Main Beskid Trail in the Low Beskids. The event takes place around Krynica-Zdrój and Komańcza, offering a range of distances from 10 km to a 150 km ultramarathon. The course features substantial elevation gain and challenging natural terrain, making it a test for trail-running and mountain-adventure enthusiasts. The event has a strong tradition and attracts runners from across Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: Route marked by the Main Beskid Trail
Significant elevation changes of up to +5,860 m and -5,970 m on the longest distance
A range of distances from 10 km to 150 km, with time limits
additional: Participants can switch between courses until October 1, 2026. Participant limits for individual distances range from 300 to 550. Starts are scheduled across October 17 and 18, 2026, with different start times for each distance. Each distance has a time limit. The event takes place on natural mountain trails with substantial elevation changes. Courses include elevation gains of up to 740 m for the 30 km and 150 km ultramarathon distances, with time limits of up to 35 hours. Registration is available online, with options for entry-fee refunds and transfer of race packages.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL

description: The CITY TRAIL Grand Prix with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Wrocław’s Osobowicki Forest. The event is recreational and sporting in nature, promoting physical activity outdoors and a healthy lifestyle. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in local and overall rankings. The main race starts at 11:00. The event is open to people aged 16 and over; younger participants may take part under parental supervision.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through the urban forest of Osobowicki Forest in Wrocław
A cross-country race in natural surroundings, through woodland and parkland
A series of four races per season in each location
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. Race bibs and timing chips are collected on race day. A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. A pass for the entire series allows participants to take part in four races in a given city. Pass holders can also take part in one race in another city free of charge, after notifying the organizers by email in advance. There is no participant limit. The main race starts at 11:00, and the event ends at around 12:15. It is not possible to drive directly to the start and race office; parking is available along Osobowicka Street. The series also includes children’s races.

name: XXIII Bieg śladami ks. Józefa Londzina
SZÁDVÁR TRAIL
description: The Compressport Szádvár Trail is an exciting trail-running race that winds through the wild, rugged mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst. Participants can discover deer hidden in the forest, a monastery ruin nestled among the trees, the grueling climb up Szádvár, panoramic views from Esztramos Hill, and the atmospheric wine-cellar row near Bódvaszilas. This challenging race welcomes adventure-seekers to Szögliget in October.
course_highlights: The wild, rugged mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst
A monastery ruin nestled among the trees
Panoramic views from Esztramos Hill
additional: The race takes place in October 2026, on varied terrain featuring mountains, valleys, and forests. Participants can register online and enjoy the scenic landscape and challenging course.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap running race takes place in Dióskert, where participants can complete the half-marathon distance in four laps. Those who would prefer to run fewer laps may do so. The race has a voluntary entry fee of 500 HUF per lap, and registration takes place at the venue. After the race, runners are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine. Every participant receives a finisher’s medal, and the top three male and female finishers also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The race route is four laps covering the half-marathon distance
Participants may complete fewer laps
Location: Törökbálint, Dióskert
additional: Registration takes place at the venue. The suggested voluntary entry fee is 500 HUF per lap. Participants are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. The top three male and female finishers receive a special medal. Hilly terrain; four laps for a half marathon; options to run fewer laps; refreshments provided; medals for all; awards for top finishers.

name: Račiansky kros – jeseň
location: Knižková dolina, Bratislava – Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Račiansky kros - jeseň je tradičný bežecký pretek konaný v Bratislave, v lokalite Knižková dolina, Bratislava - Rača. Pretek ponúka bežcom možnosť zažiť jesennú atmosféru v príjemnom prostredí amfiteátra a okolia. Organizátori OZ PERUN zabezpečujú kvalitnú prípravu a občerstvenie pre účastníkov. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a bežeckých nadšencov rôznych vekových kategórií.
course_highlights: Pretek v prírodnom prostredí Knižkovej doliny
Štart a cieľ v amfiteátri Bratislava - Rača
Jesenná atmosféra a kvalitné občerstvenie
additional: Prihláška a súhlas dotknutej osoby sú dostupné na stránke. Organizátorom je OZ PERUN. IBAN pre platby: SK09 8330 0000 0025 0082 7935. Trať pozostáva z 80% lesných ciest a 20% asfaltu; preteky sú určené pre mužov, ženy aj deti; registrácia je možná online aj na mieste s obmedzeným počtom štartov; súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské preteky a občerstvenie po preteku.

name: T1 Ring kros
location: Areál T1 ring, Vechec, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
description: T1 Ring kros je bežecký pretek konaný v areáli T1 ring vo Vecheci, okres Vranov nad Topľou. Pretek ponúka dve hlavné trate - 9 km s prevýšením približne 210 metrov a 4 km trať, pričom súčasťou je aj nesúťažná disciplína Nordic Walking. Súťažiť môžu muži a ženy v rôznych vekových kategóriách, deti majú samostatný štart. Pretek je súčasťou Bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance 2025 a štartuje o 13:00 hod. pre hlavnú kategóriu a o 11:00 hod. pre deti.
course_highlights: 9 km trať s prevýšením cca 210 metrov
4 km hobby trať a Nordic Walking nesúťažná disciplína
Pretek v areáli T1 ring vo Vecheci
additional: Štart detí o 11:00 hod. Kategórie mužov a žien podľa veku. Súčasť Bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance 2025. Preteky sa konajú v areáli T1 ring, s možnosťou registrácie online aj na mieste, štartovné od 8 do 20 eur, začiatky pretekov o 11:00 a 13:00.

name: Košickopolianska desiatka
description: Košickopolianska desiatka je bežecké podujatie organizované obcou Košická Polianka, ktoré sa koná pred kultúrnym domom v Košickej Polianke. Hlavný pretek štartuje o 13:00 hodine, detské kategórie začínajú o 11:00 hodine. Pretek je rozdelený do viacerých vekových kategórií pre mužov, ženy a deti, čo umožňuje širokú účasť bežcov rôzneho veku. Organizátori vítajú všetkých bežcov, ktorí si chcú užiť športový deň v príjemnom prostredí obce.
course_highlights: Štart a cieľ pred kultúrnym domom v Košickej Polianke
Viacero vekových kategórií pre mužov, ženy a deti
Príjemné prostredie obce Košická Polianka
additional: Detské preteky začínajú o 11:00 hod. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku od 0 rokov až po seniorov. Organizátorom je obec Košická Polianka, kontaktné telefóny a e-maily sú k dispozícii pre záujemcov o informácie. Pretek je súčasťou série ročníkov a ponúka možnosť zúčastniť sa na 10 km trati s rôznymi kategóriami pre všetky vekové skupiny, vrátane detských pretekov.

name: Běh metropole MČ Praha 6
location: Park Ladronka, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Běh metropole is a series of public running races held in various districts of Prague, aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle and residents’ sense of belonging to their district. The race in Prague 6 takes place in Ladronka Park and offers a chance to test your strength in a friendly atmosphere. Each participant represents their district and contributes to the competition to find Prague’s most athletic district. Original medals are prepared for runners as keepsakes from each edition.
course_highlights: Race in Ladronka Park in Prague 6
A series of races held across Prague’s districts
Promoting a healthy lifestyle and community spirit
additional: Each participant represents the district where they have permanent residence and contributes to the districts’ scores. Special medals are prepared for each category as unique keepsakes from the race. The official website lists a previous edition in Ladronka Park; the date 24 October 2027 is not confirmed by the available sources.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz Rozwoju i Integracji Chwałowic
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale running event held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, surrounded by forests and fields. The marathon course runs through wooded and rural areas, offering runners peace and contact with nature, with a distinctive point on the loop at Napoleon’s Stone. The race has a friendly, informal character, without competitive pressure or crowds, creating a welcoming atmosphere for logging miles together. The organizers, including local runner Arek Tołłoczko, take care of course markings and participants’ comfort. In 2024, a series of four marathons on this course is planned, taking place at different times of the year.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km course through forests and picturesque fields
A loop featuring the distinctive Napoleon’s Stone as a landmark
Every kilometre marked, with the start/finish on Polna Street
additional: A 7 km running route laid out and marked by the Harcownik Running Club from Jelcz-Laskowice; convenient parking; no crowds and a relaxed atmosphere without competitive pressure; a planned series of four marathons in 2024, taking place in winter, spring, summer and autumn. Sources describe a 42.195 km marathon course; there is no confirmed information about the entry fee or registration for the 2027 edition.

name: XLIV Perła Paprocan
description: Perła Paprocan is a marathon held around Lake Paprocany in Tychy on a 7 km loop. Participants can choose any distance by running multiples of the loop, up to a full marathon. The event is recreational and intended for training, with no need to declare a distance in advance. Every participant receives a commemorative medal at the finish. The organizers emphasize that the atmosphere and sense of community among runners matter more than competition. Tychy is the only city in Poland where a marathon is held twice a year, and Perła Paprocan is one of those editions.
course_highlights: A 7 km loop around Lake Paprocany
Paved sections (over 50%), along with compacted paths and forest trails
A station with drinks, fruit, and sweets after each loop
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the Irysy restaurant by Lake Paprocany in Tychy (ul. Parkowa 17) on October 23, 2026, from 14:00 to 17:00; October 24, 2026, from 10:00 to 15:00; and on race day from 8:00 to 9:30. A third party may collect a race number with written authorization. Participants under 18 must have consent from a parent or guardian. Valuables can be left in the storage area, marked with the race number.

description: The Enamelled Pheasant is the final race in the Ruler of Mrdice series, held in the picturesque pheasantry in Heřmanův Městec. This traditional 1,500-metre race offers an opportunity to test your strength in a friendly atmosphere. The Heřmanův Městec Running Club organizes a range of sporting activities and group training sessions throughout the year, complementing the racing season. The Enamelled Pheasant is an ideal event for runners who want to end the season with joy and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: A 1,500-metre race in the pheasantry
Part of the Ruler of Mrdice series
A traditional race in Heřmanův Městec
additional: The race is part of the Ruler of Mrdice series, which includes classic races as well as open, timed group training sessions. The running club holds regular group runs every Tuesday in a friendly atmosphere. A course map and results from previous editions are available. The race is the final round of the Mrdice League. In 2026, the first category was scheduled to start at 18:00; the 2027 race date had not been confirmed in the available materials.

name: Podzimní půlmaraton VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
location: Cycling path near Kempinku, Braník, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The VAŠÍ LIGY Autumn Half Marathon 2026 is a 21.1 km road race held in Prague 4-Braník on the cycle path by Kempink. The route follows a beautiful, flat and fast path along the Vltava from Braník to Vrané and back, often enabling runners to achieve personal bests. The race offers a relaxed running atmosphere and is suitable for anyone looking to experience a high-quality half marathon in pleasant surroundings. The first category starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: A beautiful route along the Vltava on a cycle path
A flat and fast course
Route from Braník to Vrané and back
additional: The race takes place on a flat cycle path that is suitable for fast times and personal bests. It is organized by VAŠE LIGA; Petra Lundák can be contacted. A relaxed atmosphere is guaranteed.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nepomuk
location: Sokolovna Nepomuk, Nepomuk, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nepomuk is a fun run with no racing, held on October 28. Routes are available for adults and children and run mainly along paved paths and roads through the town of Nepomuk. The event base is at the local Sokol grounds, where participants can collect their race pack and receive a beautiful medal shaped like the Republic after finishing. Sports activities are set up for children, and refreshments are available at the finish. Parking is available on nearby streets and in the gym’s parking lot.
course_highlights: The route runs mainly along paved paths and roads through the town of Nepomuk
The route passes St. John of Nepomuk Church and crosses the Mihovka stream
The finish is at the Sokol gym, with a slight uphill section
additional: No finishing times are recorded, and no results list with rankings is produced. The race pack includes a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. Sports activities for children are available at the event grounds. There is a place to leave belongings and refreshments. Parking is available on nearby streets and in the gym’s parking lot.

name: Provodovský běh
location: Provodov, Zlín District, Zlín Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: On-line registrace za zvýhodněné startovné bude ukončena 25.10.2024

late_fee.price: dražší startovné při registraci na místě v den závodu

description: The Provodov Run is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Provodov near Zlín. It offers three distances of 5, 11 and 21 kilometres, running mainly along field and forest paths. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in shorter age-based races free of charge. It is organised by UnArt Provodov, p.s., and takes place regardless of the weather, with an emphasis on safety and fair play. The start and registration are at Areál mládí and the FC Rak Provodov football pitch.
course_highlights: Trail race mainly along field and forest paths
Three distances: 5 km, 11 km and 21 km, with varying levels of difficulty
Free children’s races, with distances from 30 to 750 metres depending on age
additional: Race registration opens at 9:00 at Areál mládí. The race number must be clearly displayed on the chest. First aid is provided by members of the Czech Red Cross (ČČK). The race takes place regardless of the weather; only extreme conditions may cause it to be postponed or cancelled. The organiser reserves the right to change the programme and rules without prior notice.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Březník
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Březník is a fun run with no competition, held on October 28. The routes follow the Oslava and Chvojnice valleys, mostly on asphalt and forest paths with gentle descents and climbs. Capacity is limited to 20 adults and 30 children, so early online registration is required. Everyone can look forward to a beautiful republic-shaped medal at the finish and a race pack with gifts. The run takes place on the boundary of the Divoká Oslava National Nature Reserve, in a private area with open restrooms.
course_highlights: The route follows the Oslava and Chvojnice valleys on asphalt and forest paths
A challenging route with rugged terrain and a steep descent on the 6.2 km course
A run on the boundary of the Divoká Oslava National Nature Reserve
additional: No finish times are recorded, and no results list with rankings is produced. Capacity is limited to 20 adults and 30 children. The race pack contains a race number and gifts. A republic-shaped medal is awarded at the finish. Open restrooms are available. The route includes asphalt and unpaved forest paths, including a challenging section with a steep descent on the 6.2 km course.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Děčín
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Děčín is a traditional race held on 28 October to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The main race route is 5 km long and winds through the picturesque town, past the castle gardens and Mariánská louka, across the new bridge with views of the Elbe, and along the flat Elbe embankment, finishing by crossing Tyršův Bridge back to Smetanovo nábřeží. Children can choose between two distances: 5 km for older children and 1 km for the youngest, both following a similar route to the adults’ race. The event offers professional timing, a race pack, and a medal shaped like the country for all participants.
course_highlights: 5 km loop through the castle gardens and Mariánská louka
Cross the new bridge with views of the Elbe
Flat stretch along the Elbe embankment and crossing Tyršův Bridge
additional: The race is professionally timed. Every participant receives a medal shaped like the country at the finish. The race pack includes a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. Online registration closed on 25 October.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Dolní Újezd
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Dolní Újezd is a traditional race held on October 28 to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The race offers a main 8.9 km route through the countryside, with moderate elevation changes and a combination of asphalt and hard-packed farm roads. Children can choose flat 1.4 km routes based on their age categories. All participants receive a race pack and a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Facilities with refreshments, changing rooms, and parking are available for runners’ comfort.
course_highlights: Main race route: 8.9 km with 112 m of elevation gain
A combination of asphalt and hard-packed farm roads
Children’s 1.4 km routes on a flat asphalt road
additional: Start and finish by the Sokol Hall in Dolní Újezd. Facilities include changing rooms, refreshments, and parking. Registered participants receive a race pack and medal. No timing system is used, but results and a winners’ ceremony are provided. On-site registration beyond the race capacity does not guarantee a medal or race pack.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Kutná Hora
location: Oleška, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, organized on October 28 by the Czech Sokol Association. In Kutná Hora, the run will take place for the first time, offering a sporting atmosphere and a chance to meet people with a connection to Sokol. The main race route is just under six kilometers long, with the start and finish at the Sokol gym, which provides facilities including changing rooms, toilets, and refreshments. The event is suitable for families and individuals, with an emphasis on safety and professional organization.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Sokol gym, with full facilities
Main race of just under 6 km in the beautiful surroundings of Kutná Hora
Children’s courses are safely routed within the grounds, with no need to cross roads
additional: The race capacity is set at approximately 155 runners to ensure quality organization and timekeeping. A team of volunteers is ready to help with course navigation and event organization. Facilities at the Sokol gym include changing rooms, toilets, and refreshments. The children’s courses are safely routed within the grounds so children do not have to cross roads.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Louňovice pod Blaníkem
location: Louňovice pod Blaníkem, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Louňovice pod Blaníkem is a traditional race held in honour of the founding of Czechoslovakia and takes place on 28 October. The 5.6 km main race starts from the square and passes through the natural and historic sights of Malý Blaník, including its highest point, where the Chapel of St Mary Magdalene stands. The route combines paved sections with field and forest trails. At the finish, participants receive a beautiful medal shaped like the republic, and main-race entrants can enter a raffle. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series and is timed professionally.
course_highlights: The route passes through the natural and historic sights of Malý Blaník
Run past the Chapel of St Mary Magdalene at the highest point of Malý Blaník
A mix of paved roads, field paths and forest trails
additional: The start and finish are on the square in Louňovice pod Blaníkem, in front of the chateau. A raffle for main-race entrants is held after the winners’ awards ceremony. Every participant receives a medal shaped like the republic at the finish. All races are timed professionally. The main race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Lužice
location: Lužice, Hodonín District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Lužice is a traditional race celebrating the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on 27 October 2027. Runners follow paved paths and roads through a beautiful new park created after a tornado, past orchards and vineyards. Shorter routes for children are set up in the Sokol Hall grounds, which also provide changing rooms, showers and refreshments. At the finish, everyone receives a beautiful medal shaped like the country and a race pack with gifts from the organizers and partners.
course_highlights: The route passes through a new park created after a tornado
The route goes past orchards and vineyards around Strání
Paved paths and roads in Lužice
additional: The race is held without chip timing, but finish times are recorded and winners are announced. Changing rooms, toilets, showers and refreshments are available in the Sokol Hall grounds. Sports equipment and games are provided for children. Parking is available by the Sokol Hall and the Sports Hall.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Mníšek pod Brdy
location: Státní zámek Mníšek pod Brdy, Mníšek pod Brdy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Mníšek pod Brdy is a traditional race held in honor of the founding of Czechoslovakia. It takes place on October 28. The race starts by the state chateau and runs through the picturesque surroundings, including Sokol Hall on Vrška, ponds, and the U Káji Maříka Inn. There are various race distances for adults and children, with predominantly asphalt surfaces and easy courses. At the finish, all participants receive a beautiful medal in the shape of the republic, and a race pack with a race number and gifts is provided. The start area has tents for registration and changing, toilets, refreshments, and benches.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the state chateau in Mníšek pod Brdy
The route passes Sokol Hall on Vrška and ponds
The course is asphalt; children's loops are on a grassy area
additional: The event is held in RACE format without timing, but finish times are recorded and winners are announced. Parking, a bag drop, and a rest area are available at the start.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nový Bydžov
location: Nový Bydžov, Hradec Králové District, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nový Bydžov is a traditional race held on October 28 in honour of the founding of Czechoslovakia. The event offers routes for adults and children. The main adult race is 4.8 km long and runs partly through the town and partly along dirt roads, crossing two bridges over the Cidlina River. Shorter children’s races take place on the athletics track at the Sportring complex. At the finish, all participants receive a commemorative medal in the shape of the republic and a goody bag. The race takes place in live traffic, with organisers and volunteers stationed at intersections, and is suitable for runners of all categories.
course_highlights: 4.8 km route with 30% asphalt and 70% dirt roads
Cross the Cidlina River via two different bridges
The most challenging section is the uphill climb in the village of Humburky
additional: The race takes place in live traffic, with organisers at intersections and volunteers along the route. The lead runner is guided by a cyclist. Children’s races take place on the athletics track; times are not recorded, and placings are indicative. A goody bag and medal are included in the race. In bad weather, goody bags are handed out in the lobby of the Sokol hall; otherwise, distribution takes place outdoors by the clay court.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Uherský Brod
location: Uherský Brod, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Uherský Brod is a traditional race held in honor of the founding of Czechoslovakia, taking place on October 28. The race offers several routes for different age groups, including 5 km and 8 km races for adults and shorter races for children. The routes pass through the town center, residential neighborhoods, around a pond, and past allotment gardens. Timekeeping is professionally managed, and the fastest runners receive awards. Every participant receives a race pack and an original medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Participants under 18 may register only with the consent of a legal guardian. Registration is also available on site.
course_highlights: The 5 km route passes through the town center, residential neighborhoods, and around a pond
The 8 km route continues further into the countryside, passing a spring and an observatory
The start and finish are at the Sokol stadium, with professional timekeeping
additional: Race times are recorded by professional timekeepers. At the race facilities, every participant can collect a race pack containing a race number and gifts. A beautiful medal shaped like the republic awaits everyone at the finish. Participants under 18 may register only with the consent of a legal guardian. Registration is also available on site.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28 by the Czech Sokol Association. It draws inspiration from the historic 1919 relay race, “Rozestavný běh,” and has become a modern tradition that grows every year, connecting dozens of locations in Czechia and abroad. The race offers runners of all ages, including children, an opportunity to celebrate the founding of the republic through movement. The routes vary and often pass through both urban and natural areas, allowing participants to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of each location.
course_highlights: The route in Děčín passes through the castle gardens, Mariánská louka, the new bridge with views of the Elbe, and the flat Elbe riverbank
Children’s races have shorter routes, some of which follow the same route as the adult race
The routes are mostly flat, with varied sections and iconic landmarks in each city
additional: Registration is available online only and is valid once the entry fee has been paid. Children aged 15 to 18 may take part only in the main race. A race T-shirt can be purchased during registration and must be ordered by October 15. On-site registration is available only while capacity remains and does not include a race pack or a medal for late entrants. Races are divided into the BĚH, ZÁVOD, and VELKÝ ZÁVOD levels, each with different rules. In Děčín, times are recorded using professional timing, and participants receive a republic-shaped medal at the finish.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Milovice
location: Milovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Milovice is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28. The race offers an easy 5.8 km trail suitable for beginner and experienced runners, with a partly paved and road surface. Children can enjoy simple oval courses around Haken Stadium, with distances varying by age. At the finish, all participants receive a beautiful medal shaped like the republic and a race pack with gifts from the organizers and partners.
course_highlights: An easy 5.8 km trail with a partly paved and road surface
Children’s courses around Haken Stadium with an oval gravel surface
A course suitable for beginner and experienced runners; trail shoes are recommended
additional: The race pack includes a custom-designed bag featuring #SBR graphics, Halls Ice Team & Cola (adults only), and an original medal at the finish. On-site registration takes place at Haken Stadium, which also has changing facilities and restrooms. Parking is available near the stadium. For refreshments, you can visit the RKDM restaurant and Clock Cafe next to the stadium.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Písek
location: Palackého sady, Písek, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Písek is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on 28 October. The race offers several routes for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults, and is part of the broader tradition of runs organised by the Czech Sokol Community. The route passes through the picturesque Palacký Gardens, across the Stone Bridge and along the river, with professional timing and awards for the fastest runners. Every participant receives a race pack and an original republic-shaped medal at the finish.
course_highlights: Start in Palacký Gardens by the music pavilion
Across the Stone Bridge and along the Otava River
The route crosses the footbridge to the right bank and returns to the Ševčík Pavilion
additional: The race pack includes a custom-designed bag featuring SBR graphics, a medal at the finish, and the option to order an official Alpine Pro T-shirt for an additional fee. The main race is limited to 180 runners. Registration and race-pack collection close at 11:45 for the children's routes and at 13:30 for the main race. If capacity is not reached, on-site registration is available.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Prostějov
location: Náměstí T. G. Masaryka, Prostějov, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Prostějov is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on 28 October. The race offers different distances for adults and children, all running through the city centre on paved roads, with a 2.5 km loop. The start and finish are on T.G.M. Square, where participants can expect professional timekeeping, a race pack and a beautiful republic-shaped medal at the finish. Music, sports demonstrations and refreshments for runners and spectators add to the atmosphere. The route is flat, wide enough and safe, with no parked cars, making for a comfortable run through the historic centre of Prostějov.
course_highlights: The route runs through the city centre on paved roads
A 2.5 km loop, completed once, twice or four times depending on the race distance
A flat, sufficiently wide course with no parked cars
additional: Start and finish on T.G.M. Square. The clock on the town hall building starts at 14:00. Facilities include changing rooms for women and men, and storage for valuables and backpacks. Apple Pay or Google Wallet accepted. A commemorative ceremony at the statue of T. G. Masaryk and the results announcement. Music and sports demonstrations. Traffic is diverted away from the route, and the municipal police manage parking in the city centre.

Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka skvelú atmosféru, občerstvenie a medaile pre všetkých účastníkov. Víťazi v kategóriách mužov a žien získavajú medaile a vecné ceny. Organizátorom je bežecký klub ZasRun, ktorý zabezpečuje aj časomieru a výsledkový servis.

The start and registration take place at the same location by the water tower on Podlužská Street in the forest, providing easy access and a forest-run atmosphere.

The event also includes the charitable Vinařská míle run, which is open to children and adults. The race has a friendly atmosphere and supports the running community and local charity projects.

Marathon and half-marathon courses with beautiful views of the South Moravian countryside

Registration is available online or on site. Race routes include various wine-growing locations, including Vrbice, Hradištěk and Čejkovice, with participation available in different categories, including relay races and special categories for blind runners.

The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and offers runners a pleasant route through natural surroundings. It is suitable for runners looking for a quality run on asphalt and forest trails in picturesque countryside. Come enjoy the sporting atmosphere and test yourself against other runners at this traditional event.

Runs on asphalt and firm forest trails
Part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup

The events take place once a month on Saturdays, and the 4,219.5 m course runs mainly along forest paths and gravel tracks, with sections of asphalt. The event promotes a healthy, active outdoor lifestyle and encourages regular exercise under the slogan “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!”

description: Gorlicki Mountain Run is an annual running event held in the picturesque Low Beskids, near Radocyna and Wysowa-Zdrój. The race offers three distances: 8.2 km, 24.4 km, and a Vertical race to Magura Małastowska. The courses feature significant elevation gain and beautiful views, and the participant limit is strictly controlled, ensuring an intimate atmosphere. The organizers provide professional race services, awards ceremonies, and cash prizes. Taking part is an excellent opportunity to test your strength on mountain terrain.
course_highlights: 24.4 km course with 610 m of elevation gain
8.2 km course with 160 m of elevation gain
2.3 km Vertical race with 340 m of elevation gain to Magura Małastowska
additional: Participant limits: 24 km — 250 people, 8 km — 150 people, Vertical — 150 people. The start and finish for the 8 km and 24 km races are at the State Forests Centre in Radocyna; the Vertical race starts at Magura Ski Park / Małastów. Time limits: 5 hours for 24 km, 1 hour for the Vertical. Entry fee refunds are available until 31.10.2027. Race bibs must be visible on the front of shirts or shorts.

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Strážske
description: Beh oslobodenia mesta Strážske je tradičný bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná na počesť výročia oslobodenia mesta. Tento športový sviatok priláka bežcov rôznych vekových kategórií, vrátane mládeže a dospelých, ktorí súťažia na rôznych dĺžkach tratí. Podujatie organizuje mesto Strážske v spolupráci s bežeckým klubom MBO Strážske a je známe svojou dlhou históriou a silnou komunitnou atmosférou. Bežci si môžu užiť atmosféru mesta a zároveň si zmerať sily v priateľskom a súťažnom prostredí.
course_highlights: Viacero kategórií vrátane mládeže a dospelých
Štart pred budovou Mestského úradu v Strážskom
Tradičný beh s dlhou históriou a komunitnou podporou
additional: Podujatie má dlhoročnú tradíciu, v roku 2026 sa uskutoční 49. ročník. Bežci sú rozdelení do viacerých vekových kategórií vrátane predškolákov, žiakov a dospelých. Po behu sa oceňujú najrýchlejší v jednotlivých kategóriách a organizuje sa tombola s hodnotnými cenami. Trať vedie mestom Strážske s cieľom pred budovou Mestského úradu.

Tratě jsou vedeny v okolí Zamilované hájku částečně po asfaltových nebo hlinito-štěrkových, popř. lesních pěšinách. Start je na louce před bistrem Zamilec. Závodníci na 5 km běží jedno kolo, desítkáři dvě. Součástí je závod týmů a dětský závod.

name: Běh na Dobrošov
location: Náchod-Běloves, Náchod, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Dobrošov is a public uphill race with a mass start, held in Náchod-Běloves in the Hradec Králové Region. The race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and gives athletes the chance to test themselves on a challenging uphill course. It is organized by the Redpoint Teplice nad Metují club and is popular with runners who enjoy challenges in a natural setting. Runners of all ages and ability levels traditionally take part.
course_highlights: Uphill race with a mass start
Challenging course through the natural surroundings of Náchod-Běloves
Part of the Běžecké vršky series
additional: This is a public mountain race with various categories, including historical information about the race and related events.

name: Běh Labským údolím
location: Dolní Žleb, Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: LABÁCI (Děčínský horolezecký oddíl a Klub orientačního běhu Děčín)
description: The Run through the Elbe Valley is a traditional autumn running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Žleb, near Děčín. The race offers routes of various lengths, running mainly along forest roads and trails over varied terrain. It is organised by the Labáci group, which continues the long-standing tradition of local organisers. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including veterans and youth.
course_highlights: 16 km main course and 8 km shorter course over varied terrain
Mostly forest roads and trails
Picturesque autumn setting in the Elbe Valley
additional: Race-day check-in takes place from 10:45 at the “U Kosti” pub in Dolní Žleb. Travelling to the race by train is recommended. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup. Registration will open during spring 2026. Registration runs until 30 October 2025; the start is scheduled for 1 November at 12:00, with check-in until 10:45. Train transport from Děčín is available.

name: TRAIL LÁZNĚ VELICHOVKY
location: Lázně Velichovky, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trail Lázně Velichovky is the third edition of an autumn trail race in the historic spa town of Velichovky. It offers varied and beautiful running terrain, with the start and finish on the spa colonnade, where covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant are available. The race is complemented by spa amenities, including a café, and offers original medals, gifts and a race pack. The atmosphere is friendly, and the race is suitable for all lovers of trail running and spa surroundings.
course_highlights: The most colourful autumn running terrain
Start and finish on the spa colonnade
Covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant
additional: The race includes an original medal, race pack, electronic timing chip, refreshments during the race and at the finish, changing rooms, baggage storage, toilets, medical services and an accompanying programme. Gladiator Race clothing is also available for purchase, and parking is available near the event centre. Online registration via reg-sportvisio.cz, medals, chip timing, course photos, certificates, refreshments and spa services.

description: Jizerun is a relay race connecting Prague and the Jizera Mountains. Teams of 4–5 runners cover a total of 164 km along cycle paths and Jizera Mountain trails in a single day. The race offers a unique team experience, with a choice of two entry packages featuring different benefits such as a sports T-shirt, headband, evening buffet and finisher medals. The event is open to men’s, women’s, mixed and corporate relay teams and is supported by general partner Metrostav a.s.
course_highlights: 164 km route from Prague to the Jizera Mountains
A combination of cycle paths and Jizera Mountain trails
Relays for teams of 4–5, with each runner completing at least 3 legs
additional: Entry packages are for teams of 5. The RUN&FUN package includes T-shirts, headbands, a buffet dinner, finisher medals, refreshments, race bibs, GPS tracking and a finisher party with live music. The NO FUN, JUST RUN package includes finisher medals, refreshments, race bibs, GPS tracking and a finisher party. Facilities and services include mobile toilets, showers at the finish, medical services, an announcer and full event support. When registering, the captain’s details must be provided; team members and T-shirt sizes can be added later. Each team member must run at least 3 legs, and only one car per team is allowed. The race supports a fundraiser for hospice and hospice care in the Czech Republic. Registration opens in April 2026.

name: Běh kolem Práchně
description: Běh kolem Práchně is a traditional running race in Horažďovice, offering a 9.5 km course. Since 2024, the updated route has followed the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit. The start and finish are located in front of Envicentrum PROUD, which provides runners with facilities including changing rooms, toilets and refreshments. The results are announced at approximately 12:00 after the race. The event is organized by DDM Horažďovice and KČT Horažďovice, who ensure a pleasant atmosphere and a smooth event.
course_highlights: The 9.5 km course follows the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit
Start and finish in front of Envicentrum PROUD, with full facilities
A mixed-type race in the picturesque surroundings of Horažďovice
additional: The results are announced at approximately 12:00 at Envicentrum PROUD, where refreshments, changing rooms and toilets are available. The course follows the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit, with the start and finish in front of Envicentrum PROUD and refreshments and facilities available after the race.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - listopad
description: The 2 Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is welcomed at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward for their effort.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit, just under two laps long (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children up to 12 years old (boys and girls). Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in both adult and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start include by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus no. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). Races take place on the first Saturday of every month, start at 9:00, and registration is from 8:15 to 8:55; you can arrive by bike, on foot, by car, or by trolleybus. The course is a precisely measured asphalt circuit; the main course is 3.2 km long and the children's course is 800 m long.

name: Memoriál MUDr. Josefa Podmolíka - Běžecký festival Otrokovice 2026
description: The Otrokovice Running Festival is a traditional sporting event offering a wide range of races, including a marathon, half marathon, half-marathon relay, decamarathon and youth races. The MUDr. Josef Podmolík Memorial is the flagship half-marathon race, held in the beautiful surroundings of Otrokovice. Runners can enjoy a well-maintained course with electronic timing and the atmosphere of a running festival with a varied program for all age groups. Race check-in and the awards ceremony take place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and marathon courses in Otrokovice with chip timing
A 4.2195 km decamarathon loop
Youth races over various distances from 200 m to 1,700 m
additional: Race check-in takes place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall. Runners must collect their race number and chip for electronic timing. Winners are presented with their awards after each race in turn, and winners are required to attend the ceremony. Registration is by email. The event includes various age groups and races on city streets and at the sports hall.

name: Svatojánská 20
location: TJ Lokomotiva Beroun, Beroun, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Svatojánská 20 is a traditional running race held in Beroun, offering two main routes of 11 and 18 kilometres. The start and finish are at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium. The routes run mainly on paved roads and cycle paths along the Berounka River and the Loděnice Stream, with turnarounds at the settlement of V Kozle (11 km) and in Svatý Jan pod Skálou (18 km). The race is open to a wide range of age groups and offers refreshments at the finish, as well as cash and non-cash prizes for the top runners.
course_highlights: The routes run mainly on paved roads and cycle paths along the Berounka River and the Loděnice Stream
The 11 km route turns around at the settlement of V Kozle; the 18 km route turns around in Svatý Jan pod Skálou
The start and finish are at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium
additional: On-site check-in and registration on race day from 11:00 to 12:40. Runners who register in advance and pay by 5 November will receive a race number bearing their name. Finish-line refreshments include tea and biscuits. The race takes place in open traffic; participants must obey traffic regulations and take part at their own risk. Parking is available around the stadium; nearby car parks are recommended because of the blue parking zones. Online and on-site registration are available. Medals and certificates are awarded, and cash prizes are paid.

name: Kovářská pětka
location: Baťovský areál, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Kovárna VIVA a spolkem Běhy Zlín
description: Kovářská pětka is a traditional 5-kilometre city road race held in the Baťa complex in Zlín. The race is open to both adults and children and is organised by Kovárna VIVA in cooperation with the Běhy Zlín association. The event offers a high-quality sporting experience in the centre of the regional capital, with international participation. It attracts a wide running community every year and is known for its friendly atmosphere and well-organised proceedings.
course_highlights: The course runs through the former Baťa complex in Zlín
A 5-kilometre road race in an urban setting
The race is suitable for adults and children
additional: The race is part of a year-round competition for runners from the Zlín region. The organisers provide online results and event photos. Children’s categories are also included. The event provides professional timing and support for the regional running community. It is part of a series of races in Zlín, offers various age categories and is suitable for the general public.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - listopad
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running levels, including children up to 12 years old, who run 1.6 km. The race is suitable for slow and fast runners, experienced runners and beginners who want to improve their personal best, train, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park setting. After the finish, everyone receives a warm cinnamon pancake. Times are recorded for every participant and results are published online; they count toward the year-round Lívancový Cup.
course_highlights: The course runs along Stromovka’s paved paths
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km); children run 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful setting of Královská obora–Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate area (beneath the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45. Online pre-registration is available for faster check-in. Arriving by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop) is recommended. Parking is available by the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. Tents are available for changing and leaving belongings (unattended), along with a mobile valuables storage service. Toilet cabins are available on site. Start at 9:07; registration from 8:15 to 8:45; online registration available. The race takes place in Královská obora–Stromovka Park. Parking is by the bridge to Císařský Island; changing facilities and toilets are available.

name: Labský půlmaraton
location: Lysá nad Labem, Lysá nad Labem, Středočeský, Czech Republic
description: The Labský Half Marathon is a running race held in Lysá nad Labem, offering two courses of approximately 12.5 km and 21.3 km. The routes pass through the flat Polabí forest, on a mix of paved and unpaved roads, trails, and short sections of asphalt or concrete. The start and finish are at the racecourse, where refreshments, baggage storage, and other facilities are available. The race is suitable for the general public and is limited to 700 participants. The program also includes children’s races with distances varying by age.
course_highlights: The courses are flat and run through the beautiful Polabí forest
Start after approximately 1 km on the racecourse
Refreshment stations at km 8 and 17 on the 21 km course, and one station at km 8 on the 12 km course
additional: The race is limited to 700 participants. Baggage storage, changing tents, toilets, refreshments, and a raffle are available for runners. Parking in the venue costs 50 CZK per car. Children’s races range from 200 to 1,000 metres depending on age. The route is marked with ribbons, signs, and flour arrows, and each kilometre is marked approximately. The race includes children’s races, registration is available online, and the route may be modified due to reconstruction work in the area.

name: Závod dvojic
description: Hostivařské dvojice is a relay running race for pairs, offering a unique team-running experience in the beautiful surroundings of Hostivař. The race is for pairs who want to enjoy a sporting challenge as well as the friendly atmosphere. The route passes through scenic terrain and is suitable for runners of all levels. Come for a run and enjoy a great sporting event in a welcoming community.
course_highlights: Relay race in pairs
Scenic surroundings of Hostivař
Friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, in Kladno. It is a team relay event, and registration is available online.

name: Hornická desítka
location: Národní dům, Frýdek-Místek, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hornická desítka is a traditional running race held in Frýdek-Místek. It has been held since 1980, with interruptions, and the tradition was revived in 1996. The event offers various running disciplines, including youth races, a Run for Health and the main 10 km race. It celebrates exercise and sporting spirit, attracting hundreds to thousands of participants of all ages. It is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere. The race starts at the National House in Frýdek-Místek and is suitable for the general public, including families with children.
course_highlights: The course runs in the Frýdek-Místek area; the event dates back to 1980
A main 10 km race, accompanied by youth races and a Run for Health
Start and finish at the National House in Frýdek-Místek
additional: The event includes a non-competitive parents-and-children run, youth races, a Run for Health and the main 10 km race. It is known for its excellent organization and relaxed atmosphere. The organizer is Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s. The race takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at the National House in Frýdek-Místek. The event involves road closures and traffic measures.

name: Malá Pardubická cross country
location: Labe and vicinity, near TJ Dynamo canoe club, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Malá Pardubická - cross country is a traditional cross-country race organized by the AC Pardubice athletics club. The race takes place near the Elbe River and close to the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoe club. The organizers warmly invite all runners and running fans to this popular event, which offers a sporting experience in a natural setting. The race regulations and further information are available on the club’s website.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on natural terrain near the Elbe River
Start and finish close to the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoe club
A traditional running event organized by AC Pardubice
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, is open to the general public, including children and young people, and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: Žandovská desítka
description: Žandovská desítka is a traditional 10-kilometer race held in Žandov in the Liberec Region. The event is part of the Českolipsko District Running League and welcomes runners of all ages. The course runs on both roads and trails, offering varied surroundings for competitors. The race is popular with the regional running community and provides an opportunity to challenge yourself and meet fellow running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The course runs on both roads and trails
Part of the regional Českolipsko running league
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race takes place in November 2026. Registration and further details are not specified. The event is part of a broader series of regional races.

name: Dobřichovický běh
location: Škvárový stadion TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Dobřichovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Run is part of the Brdy Running Cup and offers runners a course approximately 6 km long. The race starts at the cinder track at TJ Sokol Dobřichovice and follows farm roads, providing pleasant running terrain. The event is suitable for both adults and children, who have their own races. The main race starts at 13:00 and is organized by ASK Dipoli.
course_highlights: Course approximately 6 km long
Starts at the cinder track at TJ Sokol Dobřichovice
The course follows farm roads
additional: Start location: TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Pražská 375. The course was measured by GPS at 5.72 km, though the race information lists it as 6 km. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup, which also includes children's races. The course combines a cinder track and farm roads. The course includes a cinder track and farm roads; online registration is available; races are suitable for all age groups.

name: Velká kunratická
location: Kunratický les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Velká kunratická is one of the oldest running races in the Czech lands. It is held every year on the second Sunday in November in Kunratice Forest in Prague. The race has been run continuously since 1934 and is known for its challenging course and changeable weather, which contribute to its unique atmosphere. A wide range of runners take part, from young children to veterans, competing on six courses ranging from 370 to 3,100 metres. The event is organised by the Spartak Praha 4 athletics club.
course_highlights: Challenging courses through Kunratice Forest
Six courses ranging from 370 m to 3,100 m
Wave starts in pairs, with a 10-second interval
additional: All categories start in pairs at 10-second intervals. Official BUSHMAN-brand T-shirts are available exclusively during registration. Ordered T-shirts can be collected at the tent on the dam. The total number of participants is limited to 3,600, with a limit of 2,700 runners on the route over Hrádek. Registration changes can be made by email until 14 October 2026; after that, they can only be made at check-in. The race takes place in November, with the number of participants limited to 3,400. Online registration opens on 5 October 2026, and on-site registration is available. There are various age and performance categories.

tiers.description: Obsahuje : 5x funkční účastnické triko, 5x čelenka, 5x večeře formou rautu v Parkhotelu Smržovka, 5x finisher medaile, předstartovní káva a drobné občerstvení na startu a v cíli, startovní čísla, výsledkový servis a online GPS tracker, finisher párty s živou hudbou.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Obsahuje : 5x finisher medaile, předstartovní káva a drobné občerstvení na startu a v cíli, startovní čísla, výsledkový servis a online GPS tracker, finisher párty s živou hudbou.

description: Jizerun is a relay running race from Prague to the Jizera Mountains, following the Jizera River. Teams of 4–5 runners cover a total of 165 km along cycle paths and trails in the Jizera Mountains in a single day. The race offers a unique sporting experience and the chance to work as a team in men’s, women’s, mixed, and corporate categories. The route is divided into several stages of varying difficulty, allowing each runner to choose a suitable segment.
course_highlights: A 165 km route from Prague to the Jizera Mountains along cycle paths and trails
A relay race for teams of 4–5 in several categories
Stages with difficulty ratings from 1 to 8 on a 10-point scale, across varied terrain
additional: The entry fee includes timing, GPX tracking and the JIZERUN app, portable toilets, finish-area facilities including showers, a speaker and sound system, medical services throughout the race, gifts from partners, photos and video, and full event staffing and all relevant permits. The route is divided into 14 stages of varying lengths and difficulty; for example, the Bradlec–Klášter stage is 14.7 km and rated 7/10. The 2026 edition is sold out; the organizer mentions a waiting list. Teams consist of four or five runners.

description: The Run Against Addiction is a running race in Homolka Forest Park in Plzeň, with courses for different age groups, from children to adults. The route follows paved paths and includes both flat children’s courses and the varied terrain of the 6 km main race. There is also a relay race for teams of three, with each runner completing one lap. The event is suitable for runners of all abilities who want to support the fight against addiction and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in nature.
course_highlights: The route follows paved paths in Homolka Forest Park
The 6 km main race features varied terrain and three laps
The children’s courses are flat and adapted to different age groups
additional: Race numbers are distributed from 9:00 to 10:30. Children’s races begin at 10:00, with staggered starts by age group. The men’s and women’s main races and the relay start at 11:30. The relay has three runners, each completing one lap of approximately 2,000 m. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 12:15. A recommended route is available on Garmin Connect as a single lap, which will be run three times during the race. The organizer lists children’s races and a 6 km race; Kudy z nudy also lists a 3 × 2 km relay for 2026. The race regulations available on the organizer’s website are for the 2024 and 2025 editions, so prices from those editions have not been assigned to the 2026 race.

name: Krumlovská 11
location: Hornobránský rybník, Český Krumlov, Czech Republic

tiers.description: Startovné 500 Kč (věk 60+: 250 Kč) pro ženy i muže, starší i mladší, zdatné i méně zdatné běžce

description: Krumlovská 11 is a St. Martin’s charity run held on 8 November 2026 at Hornobránský Pond in Český Krumlov. It offers a main run of approximately 11 km for runners aged 15 and over, a family run for children aged 2 to 15, and relay races. The route passes through beautiful countryside via Křížová hora and Přídolí. The event supports the Personal Assistance social service, which helps children with disabilities and seniors in the region. There is also a varied program of accompanying activities and running T-shirts available to purchase.
course_highlights: Main route: approx. 11 km via Křížová hora and Přídolí
Family run: 1–2 km depending on age category
Relay race: 2 × 5.5 km, with the baton exchange at Hornobránský Pond
additional: The main run and relay races start at 12:11; the family run begins from 10:01, with staggered start times for the different categories. The main run has a capacity of 200 runners, and the family run a capacity of 200 children. Race packs with bib numbers can be collected at the venue from 8:45 to 11:30. Running T-shirts and St. Martin’s goose are available to purchase for an additional fee. Relays may be women’s, men’s, mixed or corporate. The event is a charity event, with proceeds supporting the Personal Assistance social service in Český Krumlov. The start and finish are at Hornobránský Pond; the main run starts from 12:11. Online registration is open until 30 October 2026 and is mandatory. The race has a capacity of 200 participants.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - září

name: BĚHÁMOS - rodinné běžecké závody
description:
🏃‍♀️🏃 BĚHÁMOS – family running races by Holasice Primary and Nursery School
On Sunday, October 4, from 10:00, we’ll get Holasice moving!
Register HERE:
https://forms.gle/duaUcTh2u7ZRpg1v8

We don’t just want to organize a race to see who gets the best times. We want to create a day when children, parents, grandparents, friends and neighbors can all meet in one place. In short, a sports gathering with a family atmosphere.

https://mapy.com/s/locojejatu

AMOS’S LITTLE SPROUTS

description: What sets the Nieuchwytni Run apart from other events is its regionally unique “moving finish line” format. Participants do not run toward a designated point; instead, they try to stay ahead of the pursuit team for as long as possible. The runners will start at 10:00, and exactly 15 minutes later the “finish line” will set off along the course—a cyclist and a car equipped with professional timing equipment. The moment these vehicles overtake a runner marks the end of their race, and their result is recorded. The pursuit team will gradually increase its speed, from an initial 15 km/h to 35 km/h in the final stage of the race.
